title: Medical Image Alignment Assessment as a Test of Generalist Visual Reasoning in Frontier Multimodal Models
summary: Frontier multimodal large language models (MLLMs) are increasingly positioned as general purpose visual reasoners as part of the quest for artificial general intelligence. A key test of this generality is whether they can perform novel visual judgments that humans can make reliably from visual evidence and task instructions, without task-specific parameter optimisation. We investigate this question through the task of medical image alignment assessment, where the goal is to establish whether there is anatomical correspondence between two images. Human visual assessment of image alignment is still the gold standard and most common approach; however, it requires trained operators and is impractical to scale for large datasets. We evaluate recent generations of MLLMs on two exemplar medical image alignment tasks, varying both prompting strategies and image-presentation methods. We compare against a locally fine-tuned MLLM and a task-specific CNN to examine the trade-off between frontier general purpose models and smaller models that require specific task optimisation but can be used locally. We show that are reaching an inflection point, where frontier MLLMs can now perform effective visual assessment of medical image alignment. Models released only a few months ago generalise poorly and, in some settings, perform barely above chance, whereas GPT-6 achieves over 85% across almost all scenarios tested. Fine-tuned local models can match or exceed frontier-model performance on the tasks on which they are trained, but transfer substantially less effectively to unseen settings. These findings identify medical image alignment as a useful test bed for generalist visual reasoning and suggest that frontier multimodal models are beginning to acquire capabilities that could support a common quality-control mechanism across heterogeneous medical-imaging pipelines.

AI.tldr: 该研究以医学图像配准评估为测试平台，考察前沿多模态大模型（MLLMs）能否在无任务特定优化下完成新颖的视觉判断，结果显示前沿模型已跨过性能拐点。
AI.motivation: 前沿MLLMs被定位为通用视觉推理器，其通用性关键在于能否仅凭视觉证据与任务指令完成人类可可靠判断的新颖视觉任务，而无需任务特定参数优化
AI.method: 在两个示例性医学图像配准任务上评估近几代MLLMs，变化提示策略与图像呈现方式，并与本地微调MLLM及任务特定CNN对比
AI.result: 仅数月前发布的模型泛化差、部分场景仅略高于随机水平；GPT-6在几乎所有测试场景中准确率超85%。微调本地模型在其训练任务上可匹敌或超越前沿模型，但对未见过场景的迁移效果明显更差
AI.conclusion: 医学图像配准可作为通用视觉推理的有效测试床，前沿多模态模型正开始获得可支撑异构医学影像流水线统一质控机制的能力

title: RADC: Risk-Aware Dual Caching for Vision-Language Test-Time Adaptation
summary: Cache-based test-time adaptation (TTA) for vision-language models is often hindered by background bias in global representations and unreliable entropy-based cache admission under representation variations. To address these limitations, we propose RADC, which enhances prototype learning through reliable dual caching. RADC introduces a Semantic Foreground Cache that aggregates category-consistent spatial evidence from CLIP representations, yielding foreground prototypes that complement the global cache while mitigating background interference. To reliably manage both caches, Gaussian Risk Admission models multi-view representations as diagonal Gaussian distributions and jointly considers class separation and feature uncertainty to prioritize reliable cache candidates. RADC integrates zero-shot logits with complementary global- and foreground-cache predictions for robust inference. Extensive experiments on cross-domain and out-of-distribution benchmarks demonstrate consistent state-of-the-art performance.

AI.tldr: 提出 RADC，通过语义前景缓存与高斯风险准入机制改进基于缓存的视觉语言模型测试时适应，缓解背景偏置与熵准入不可靠问题，在跨域与分布外基准上取得一致的最优性能。
AI.motivation: 现有基于缓存的视觉语言模型测试时适应（TTA）存在两个瓶颈：一是全局表示包含背景偏置，导致原型不纯；二是基于熵的缓存准入在表示变化下不可靠，难以甄别高质量缓存样本。
AI.method: RADC 采用双缓存增强原型学习：语义前景缓存从 CLIP 表示中聚合类别一致的空间证据，生成前景原型以补充全局缓存并抑制背景干扰；高斯风险准入将多视图表示建模为对角高斯分布，联合考量类间分离度与特征不确定性以筛选可靠缓存候选；推理时将零样本 logits 与全局缓存、前景缓存预测融合。
AI.result: 在跨域与分布外（OOD）基准上的大量实验表明，RADC 取得一致的当前最优性能。
AI.conclusion: 双缓存结构结合可靠性驱动的准入策略，可同时缓解背景偏置与准入不可靠问题，为视觉语言模型的无监督测试时适应提供有效且稳健的方案。

title: UniPro: Unified Multi-Mode Medical Image Segmentation from 2D Images to 3D Volumes via Propagation
summary: Medical image segmentation remains fragmented along two axes: segmentation paradigms and data dimensionality. Existing methods are typically developed separately for semantic, in-context, and interactive segmentation, and are further specialized to either native 2D images or 3D volumetric data. In clinical practice, however, segmentation workflows take many forms: a case may be initialized by semantic prediction, reference-guided segmentation, or user interaction. Regardless of how it begins, fine-grained refinement is naturally performed on 2D views; for volumetric scans, such 2D edits must propagate coherently to the rest of the volume. We present UniPro, a unified model that bridges segmentation paradigms and data dimensionality, using propagation to extend 2D segmentation to 3D volumes. Our key insight is that volumetric propagation and in-context segmentation share the same reference-conditioned prediction mechanism, differing only in whether the reference image-mask pairs come from other cases or from previously segmented neighboring slices. Building on this view, UniPro supports semantic, in-context, interactive, and propagation-based segmentation within a single slice-based framework, using class priors, reference exemplars, user clicks, and neighboring-slice predictions as mode-specific conditioning inputs. To improve propagation reliability, UniPro further incorporates bidirectional and 3D supervision to regularize slice-wise propagation beyond per-slice losses. Extensive experiments across diverse modalities and anatomies show that UniPro achieves strong performance across all segmentation settings, enabling annotation-efficient 3D segmentation from sparse 2D initialization and reducing slice-by-slice correction effort.

AI.tldr: UniPro是一个统一医学图像分割模型，将语义、上下文、交互式分割与2D/3D维度统一到基于切片的框架中，以传播机制将2D分割扩展到3D体数据。
AI.motivation: 现有医学图像分割方法沿两条轴线碎片化：一是分割范式（语义/上下文/交互式分割各自独立开发），二是数据维度（2D图像与3D体数据各自专用）。而临床工作流实际是混合的：病例可能由语义预测、参考引导或用户交互初始化，且精细修正在2D视图上完成，需要一致地传播到整个体积。缺乏统一模型来桥接这些范式与维度。
AI.method: 核心洞察是体数据传播与上下文分割共享同一"参考条件预测"机制，区别仅在于参考图像-掩码对来自其他病例还是来自已分割的相邻切片。基于此，UniPro在单一基于切片的框架内支持语义、上下文、交互式与传播式分割，分别以类别先验、参考示例、用户点击、相邻切片预测作为模式特定条件输入。为提升传播可靠性，引入双向与3D监督，超越逐切片损失来正则化切片间传播。
AI.result: 在多种模态和解剖结构上的大量实验表明，UniPro在所有分割设置下均取得强劲性能，能够从稀疏2D初始化实现标注高效的3D分割，并减少逐切片修正的工作量。
AI.conclusion: UniPro通过将体数据传播视为参考条件预测，成功统一了不同分割范式与数据维度，实现单一框架下多模式分割，并借助双向与3D监督提升传播可靠性，为标注高效的3D分割提供了可行方案。

title: Beyond the Linear Representation Hypothesis: Non-Linear Activation Steering in Text-to-Image Models
summary: Mechanistic interpretability often relies on the Linear Representation Hypothesis (LRH), which assumes that high-level concepts are encoded as linear directions in activation space. Yet a natural visual concept does not necessarily require a linear visual transition: between sunny and stormy lies an intermediate weather state such as a sky with a few white clouds, not simply a weaker storm; between a caterpillar and a butterfly, the progression is not a caterpillar with continuously growing wings. This raises the question of whether such true intermediate states are also represented nonlinearly by the model. Indeed, when we prompt text-to-image models directly for intermediate attributes, their activations rarely fall along the straight direction connecting the endpoints. Therefore, we propose KANSteer, which models concept traversal as a curve passing through its intermediate states. Seeking a representation that is both simple and interpretable, we propose to use Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks (KANs), which provide a one-dimensional coordinate whose learned functions define the trajectory. This allows the steering direction to vary along the concept while preserving an interpretable representation. Across several concepts and text-to-image diffusion transformers, we find that their activation trajectories substantially deviate from straight lines, and that KANSteer provide a closer fit and smoother traversal of intermediate attributes than linear steering.

AI.tldr: 提出 KANSteer，用 Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks 将概念遍历建模为穿过中间状态的曲线，而非线性方向，从而更准确、更平滑地实现文本到图像扩散模型中的概念调控。
AI.motivation: 机械可解释性常依赖线性表示假设（LRH），假设高层概念以激活空间中的线性方向编码。但许多自然视觉概念的过渡并非线性：如晴天到暴风雨之间存在"几朵白云"这样的中间天气状态，而非单纯的弱化暴风雨；毛毛虫到蝴蝶也不是翅膀不断变大的毛毛虫。这引出一个问题：模型是否也以非线性方式表示这些真实中间状态。实验发现，直接提示文本到图像模型生成中间属性时，其激活很少落在连接两端点的直线方向上。
AI.method: 提出 KANSteer，将概念遍历建模为一条穿过中间状态的曲线以刻画沿概念变化的调控方向，同时保持可解释的表示。具体采用 Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks（KANs），提供一个一维坐标，其学习到的函数定义该轨迹，使调控方向可随概念变化而改变。
AI.result: 在多个概念和多种文本到图像扩散 Transformer 上进行实验，发现其激活轨迹显著偏离直线；相比线性调控，KANSteer 能更贴近地拟合并更平滑地遍历中间属性。
AI.conclusion: 概念在激活空间中的表示往往是高度非线性的，线性表示假设不足以刻画真实的中间状态。将概念遍历建模为用 KAN 学习的曲线，可在保持可解释性的同时实现更准确、更平滑的概念调控。

title: DistScene: Object-to-Scene Distillation for 3D Scene Generation
summary: We present DistScene, a framework for single-image compositional 3D scene generation by jointly modeling the environment and individual objects. Unlike existing methods that represent scenes primarily as collections of objects, we model the environment as an explicit scene component to provide geometric context for object placement. Specifically, we introduce Scene-Frame Generation, which jointly generates separate environment and object components in a shared coordinate frame, allowing their geometry and relative placement to be learned together. Then we introduce Object-Centric Refinement to refine each object in a local frame with scene context. Finally, we develop Object-to-Scene Distillation to transfer pretrained object-generation priors to scene generation through automatically composed and rendered synthetic scenes. Evaluations on indoor and outdoor benchmarks demonstrate improved scene-level spatial coherence over the evaluated baselines. Project page: https://coolbeam.github.io/DistScene/

AI.tldr: 提出 DistScene 框架，通过联合建模环境与单个物体，实现单图像组合式三维场景生成，提升了场景级空间一致性。
AI.motivation: 现有单图像三维场景生成方法主要将场景表示为物体集合，缺乏显式的环境表示，难以为物体放置提供几何上下文，导致场景级空间一致性不足。因此需要将环境作为显式场景组件建模。
AI.method: 方法包含三个核心组件：(1) Scene-Frame Generation，在共享坐标系中联合生成分离的环境与物体组件，使几何与相对布局共同学习；(2) Object-Centric Refinement，在局部坐标系中结合场景上下文对每个物体进行细化；(3) Object-to-Scene Distillation，通过自动合成并渲染的场景，将预训练物体生成先验迁移至场景生成。
AI.result: 在室内与室外基准上的评测表明，相较于对比基线，方法在场景级空间一致性方面取得提升。
AI.conclusion: 将环境显式建模为场景组件并进行联合生成与蒸馏，是提升单图像组合式三维场景生成空间一致性的有效途径。

title: BoT-Feedback: Grounding Multimodal Reasoning in Biomechanical Evidence for Explainable Human Action Feedback
summary: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have demonstrated impressive capabilities in visual understanding and multimodal reasoning, yet they remain fundamentally limited in Human Action Feedback Generation. Existing methods infer coaching feedback directly from visual observations, producing generic advice, limited interpretability, and physically implausible hallucinations. In contrast, expert human coaches diagnose performance through explicit biomechanical reasoning over joint kinematics, posture, and body dynamics. We introduce BoT-Feedback, a framework that grounds MLLM reasoning in structured biomechanical evidence. Our key contribution is Biomechanics of Thought (BoT), a four-stage reasoning framework that progressively identifies the action, localises the critical body regions, analyses quantitative biomechanical differences between expert and student performances, and synthesises interpretable coaching feedback. To support this reasoning process, we develop a plug-and-play Biomechanical Data Parser (BDP) that converts videos into structured biomechanical descriptors and an alignment strategy that temporally matches expert and student motions. We further introduce BiomAF, a benchmark containing paired teacher-student videos, 3D skeletons, biomechanical attributes, and expert-coaching annotations. Experiments across twelve open- and closed-source MLLMs demonstrate that grounding reasoning in biomechanical evidence consistently improves feedback quality, interpretability, and robustness while substantially reducing biomechanical hallucinations. BoT-Feedback improves the average expert evaluation score from 2.07 to 2.95 (+40%), enabling compact open-source MLLMs to approach the performance of substantially larger proprietary systems for explainable action feedback generation.

AI.tldr: 提出BoT-Feedback框架，通过将多模态大模型推理锚定在结构化生物力学证据上，提升人体动作反馈生成质量。
AI.motivation: 现有MLLM直接从视觉观察推断教练反馈，产生内容笼统、可解释性差且存在物理不合理的幻觉，而人类专家教练依赖对关节运动学、姿态与身体动力学的显式生物力学推理进行诊断。
AI.method: 提出Biomechanics of Thought（BoT）四阶段推理框架，依次识别动作、定位关键身体区域、分析专家与学生的定量生物力学差异并合成可解释的教练反馈；配套开发即插即用的Biomechanical Data Parser（BDP）将视频转换为结构化生物力学描述符，并设计时间对齐策略匹配专家与学生动作。同时构建BiomAF基准，包含配对师生视频、3D骨架、生物力学属性及专家反馈标注。
AI.result: 在12个开源与闭源MLLM上的实验表明，以生物力学证据锚定推理可持续提升反馈质量、可解释性与鲁棒性，并显著减少生物力学幻觉。BoT-Feedback将平均专家评估分从2.07提升至2.95（+40%），使紧凑型开源MLLM在可解释动作反馈生成上接近更大规模专有系统的性能。
AI.conclusion: 将MLLM推理建立在结构化生物力学证据之上，是提升人体动作反馈生成质量、可解释性与可靠性的有效途径，并有助于缩小开源与专有模型之间的差距。

title: Event Cameras for Melt-Pool Monitoring in Additive Manufacturing: A Benchmark and a Cross-Machine Transfer Analysis
summary: Melt-pool monitoring is central to qualifying metal additive manufacturing (AM), yet no public event-camera benchmark exists for this domain. Event cameras report per-pixel brightness changes with microsecond timing instead of reading full frames, giving the temporal resolution AM transients demand at a fraction of the data rate. We present SynAM-E (Synthetic AM Events), the first public multi-source simulated event-camera benchmark for metal-AM melt-pool monitoring: 85 physics-calibrated event shards from 15 sources across 8 institutions, with public baselines and fixed cross-machine evaluation splits. On a single-machine case study, event-spatial monitoring matches dense-frame accuracy (0.874 versus 0.863 macro-F1), and the absolute intensity that events discard adds only +0.006 under fusion. On the NIST Additive Manufacturing Metrology Testbed (AMMT) build, a near-sensor event-rate counter recovers a raw-frame-confirmed 528.7 Hz intensity oscillation at ~380 times less sensor readout than the frame stream requires. A compact 93 k-parameter spiking model runs at 15 times lower modeled inference energy for a 0.073 macro-F1 cost. Every cross-source task includes a built-in trust test against camera identity shortcuts: process-type classification passes while material classification remains confounded by camera band, a corpus-structural limitation the release documents and the trust test exposes.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了SynAM-E，首个面向金属增材制造熔池监测的公开多源仿真事件相机基准，包含来自8家机构15个数据源的85个物理校准事件分片，并提供了基线方法与固定跨机评估划分。
AI.motivation: 熔池监测是金属增材制造质量认证的核心环节，但该领域缺乏公开的事件相机基准。事件相机以微秒级时间精度记录逐像素亮度变化，而非读取完整帧，能在极低数据率下满足增材制造瞬态过程对时间分辨率的需求，因此亟需建立相应基准以推动该方向研究。
AI.method: 构建SynAM-E基准：85个物理校准的事件分片，覆盖15个来源、8家机构，配备公开基线与固定跨机评估划分。在单机案例中对比事件-空间监测与稠密帧监测；在NIST增材制造计量测试台（AMMT）构建上，采用近传感器事件率计数器进行验证；并训练紧凑的93k参数脉冲神经网络模型；同时为每个跨源任务设计针对相机身份捷径的信任测试。
AI.result: 单机案例中事件-空间监测与稠密帧精度相当（macro-F1为0.874 vs 0.863），事件丢弃的绝对强度在融合下仅带来+0.006的提升；在NIST AMMT构建上，近传感器事件率计数器以约380倍更低的传感器读取量恢复了原始帧确认的528.7 Hz强度振荡；紧凑的93k参数脉冲模型以15倍更低的建模推理能耗运行，macro-F1仅损失0.073。过程类型分类通过信任测试，而材料分类仍受相机波段混淆影响。
AI.conclusion: SynAM-E为金属增材制造熔池监测提供了首个公开事件相机基准，验证了事件相机在时间分辨率与能效上的优势。同时，信任测试揭示了语料库的结构性局限——材料分类受相机波段混淆，该局限已在发布文档中说明并由信任测试暴露。

title: Visual-Invariance-Augmented Feature Optimal Alignment for Transferable Adversarial Attacks against Closed-Source MLLMs
summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) remain vulnerable to transferable adversarial examples, especially in black-box settings where only open-source surrogate models are accessible. Existing targeted transfer attacks mainly align adversarial and target samples using global image-level features, such as encoder [CLS] embeddings. However, such coarse alignment insufficiently exploits patch-level visual structures, limiting transferability across heterogeneous closed-source MLLMs. We propose IAU-FOA, a visual-invariance-augmented feature optimal alignment attack with adaptive unbalanced transport, to improve targeted transferability against closed-source MLLMs. IAU-FOA aligns adversarial and target samples at both global and local levels: a cosine-based objective narrows their global semantic gap, while patch tokens are clustered into compact local patterns and matched through optimal transport for fine-grained feature alignment. Balanced optimal transport enforces fixed marginal masses even for local clusters without reliable counterparts, potentially introducing misleading alignment gradients. We therefore introduce confidence-adaptive unbalanced transport to relax these constraints for weakly matched clusters, aiming to reduce unreliable local alignment and improve adversarial transferability. We further study the effect of input transformations and propose visual-invariance augmentation, which applies bidirectional pixel-intensity rescaling and per-channel white-balance adjustment to simulate exposure, contrast, illumination, and color-temperature variations. This strategy encourages adversarial perturbations to generalize across different visual encoders. Extensive experiments on open-source and closed-source MLLMs show that IAU-FOA consistently outperforms state-of-the-art transferable attack methods. Code is available at https://github.com/jiaxiaojunQAQ/IAU-FOA.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 IAU-FOA，一种结合视觉不变性增强与自适应非平衡最优传输的特征对齐攻击方法，通过在全局与局部两个层面进行对齐，提升针对闭源多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）的目标迁移攻击性能，并在开源与闭源模型上取得优于现有方法的攻击效果。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态大模型在迁移性对抗攻击下仍存在脆弱性，在黑盒场景中仅能访问开源代理模型。现有目标迁移攻击主要依赖图像级全局特征（如编码器 [CLS] 嵌入）进行对抗样本与目标样本对齐，这种粗粒度对齐难以充分利用patch级的视觉结构信息，限制了跨异构闭源 MLLMs 的迁移能力。
AI.method: 1. 全局对齐：采用基于余弦相似度的目标函数缩小对抗样本与目标样本的全局语义差距。2. 局部对齐：将patch token聚类为紧凑的局部模式，并通过最优传输进行匹配，实现细粒度特征对齐。3. 置信度自适应非平衡传输：针对缺乏可靠对应关系的局部簇，放宽平衡最优传输的固定边缘质量约束，减少不可靠的局部对齐及其误导性梯度。4. 视觉不变性增强：研究输入变换影响，提出双向像素强度重缩放与逐通道白平衡调整，模拟曝光、对比度、光照和色温变化，促使扰动在不同视觉编码器间泛化。
AI.result: 在开源与闭源 MLLMs 上的大量实验表明，IAU-FOA consistently（持续）优于当前最先进的迁移攻击方法。代码已开源：https://github.com/jiaxiaojunQAQ/IAU-FOA。
AI.conclusion: IAU-FOA 通过全局-局部多层级特征对齐、自适应非平衡最优传输以及视觉不变性增强，有效提升了针对闭源 MLLMs 的目标迁移攻击能力，验证了细粒度局部对齐与鲁棒视觉变换建模在提升对抗迁移性方面的有效性。

title: Hierarchy-GBP: Accelerating Factor Graph Inference via Abstraction and Recovery
summary: Gaussian Belief Propagation (GBP) is a distributed inference algorithm that passes messages in graphical models, making it attractive for scalable spatial intelligence. However, we find GBP most effective locally: it rapidly smooths message errors that vary sharply between neighbor variables, but corrects global errors across distant graph regions incrementally through long-range message propagations. We propose Hierarchy-GBP (H-GBP), an iterative, two-stage framework that accelerates GBP by first solving these global errors with a coarse graph approximation (abstraction) and projecting the results back to the original graph (recovery), then refining the remaining local errors with GBP. We prove H-GBP convergence to the optimum by deriving the combined matrix operator of our abstraction and recovery steps and analyzing its spectral radius. Experiments on linear sparse graphs show that H-GBP converges fundamentally faster than standard GBP. Moreover, we validate H-GBP on two important spatial problems: Pose Graph Optimization (PGO) and Bundle Adjustment (BA). H-GBP markedly accelerates large-scale PGO and achieves state-of-the-art runtime across all tested BA scales.

AI.tldr: 提出两阶段迭代框架 H-GBP：先用粗图近似求解全局误差并投影回原图，再用高斯置信传播（GBP）细化局部误差，理论上证明收敛并显著加速大规模空间推理任务。
AI.motivation: GBP 作为图模型上的分布式推理算法，具有可扩展性，适合空间智能。但其实际效力局限于局部：能快速平滑相邻变量间剧烈变化的局部消息误差，而对相距较远的图区域间的全局误差只能通过长程消息传播逐步修正，导致在含长程相关性的问题上收敛缓慢。
AI.method: 提出 H-GBP，一个迭代的两阶段框架：第一阶段对原图做粗粒度图近似（abstraction），在粗图上求解全局误差，并通过恢复（recovery）算子将结果投影回原图；第二阶段用标准 GBP 细化残余的局部误差。理论部分推导抽象与恢复步骤的组合矩阵算子，通过分析其谱半径证明 H-GBP 收敛到最优解。
AI.result: 在线性稀疏图上，H-GBP 的收敛速度从根本上快于标准 GBP。在实际空间任务上，H-GBP 显著加速大规模位姿图优化（PGO），并在所有测试规模的捆集调整（BA）上达到最优运行时（state-of-the-art runtime）。
AI.conclusion: 通过将全局误差交由粗图抽象求解、局部误差交由 GBP 细化，H-GBP 弥补了 GBP 仅擅长局部平滑的缺陷，在保持收敛性与最优性的同时实现了分布式推理的显著加速。

title: State-Aware Interaction MIL for Rare Joint Molecular Phenotype Prediction in Colorectal Cancer and Lung Adenocarcinoma
comment: Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on AI at Scale for Clinical Impact (ASCI): Cancer Pathology Foundation Models
summary: Joint molecular phenotype prediction is complicated by small joint-positive populations and overlapping histological features across alternative molecular states. Existing computational pathology approaches typically predict biomarkers independently or formulate the joint-positive phenotype as a binary endpoint. Independent prediction does not model interactions between biomarker-specific histological representations, whereas binary joint prediction collapses the double-negative and two single-positive configurations into a single negative class. We propose State-Aware Interaction MIL, a weakly supervised method that preserves biomarker-specific histological representations, models their interaction, and supervises the complete four-state molecular configuration. We evaluate the proposed approach for joint BRAF+/MSI+ prediction in colorectal cancer and EGFR+/TP53+ prediction in lung adenocarcinoma using frozen UNI2-h and CONCH pathology foundation-model representations. With UNI2-h, State-Aware Interaction MIL achieved an average precision of 0.5566 in colorectal cancer (joint-positive prevalence 6.8%) compared with 0.5161 for NaiveMTL, and 0.2784 in lung adenocarcinoma (joint-positive prevalence 8.6%) compared with 0.2525 for IndependentPair. With CONCH, State-Aware achieved an average precision of 0.4410 compared with 0.3932 for DirectJoint in colorectal cancer and 0.1659 compared with 0.1226 for DirectJoint in lung adenocarcinoma. These results indicate that pathology foundation-model representations contain predictive information for rare joint molecular phenotypes and that preserving biomarker-specific representations within a structured molecular-state formulation can improve prediction of these phenotypes from histopathology.

AI.tldr: 提出State-Aware Interaction MIL，一种弱监督方法，保留生物标志物特异性组织学表征、建模其交互并监督完整四状态分子构型，用于联合分子表型预测。
AI.motivation: 联合分子表型预测面临联合阳性样本稀少及不同分子状态间组织学特征重叠的挑战。现有计算病理方法或独立预测各生物标志物（未建模表征间交互），或将联合阳性视为二分类终点（将双阴性与两种单阳性合并为单一阴性类），均存在建模缺陷。
AI.method: 提出State-Aware Interaction MIL弱监督方法：保留生物标志物特异性组织学表征，显式建模其交互，并对完整四状态分子构型进行监督。在结直肠癌BRAF+/MSI+与肺腺癌EGFR+/TP53+联合预测任务上，基于冻结的UNI2-h和CONCH病理基础模型表征进行评估。
AI.result: UNI2-h下，结直肠癌AP达0.5566（联合阳性率6.8%），优于NaiveMTL的0.5161；肺腺癌AP为0.2784（联合阳性率8.6%），优于IndependentPair的0.2525。CONCH下，结直肠癌AP为0.4410（对比DirectJoint的0.3932），肺腺癌AP为0.1659（对比DirectJoint的0.1226）。
AI.conclusion: 病理基础模型表征包含罕见联合分子表型的预测信息；在结构化分子状态表述中保留生物标志物特异性表征可提升从组织病理学预测此类表型的效果。

title: Learning to Curate What You Generate for Generalizable Few-Shot Class-Incremental Learning
summary: Few-shot class-incremental learning (FSCIL) aims to learn novel classes from limited annotations while preserving prior knowledge. Existing methods typically assume a sufficiently large base session, but this assumption fails when both base and incremental data are scarce, leading to weak initial representations, semantic drift, and unstable boundaries. We study this underexplored yet realistic setting, termed Generalizable FSCIL (G-FSCIL), where the base session itself contains only a few classes. Although synthetic data can alleviate supervision scarcity, naively mixing generated samples often introduces semantic noise and exacerbates old-new boundary conflicts. To address this, we propose a framework that curates trustworthy synthetic knowledge for stable G-FSCIL. Specifically, we first construct class-specific synthetic candidate pools using a frozen latent diffusion model, where class inversion is performed at the first observation and the resulting condition embeddings are reused for on-demand generation. Building on these candidates, we learn a knowledge curation strategy that selects samples with both semantic consistency and visual diversity, and distill this process into a transferable selection policy during the base session, which is then reused without further optimization. Leveraging the curated synthetic data, we further design a boundary-stable incremental adaptation scheme, including synthetic-informed prototype initialization and bidirectional boundary calibration to mitigate old-new conflicts. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method consistently outperforms existing FSCIL baselines, with reduced forgetting and improved balance between old and new classes. Code is available at https://github.com/NiHaoWoJiaoYYC/G-FSCIL.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究基类样本也稀缺的广义小样本类增量学习（G-FSCIL），提出借助扩散模型生成并按策略筛选可信合成知识，配合边界稳定的增量适应方案，缓解语义漂移与新旧类冲突。
AI.motivation: 现有FSCIL方法普遍假设基会话有充足数据，但当基类与增量数据都稀缺时，初始表征弱、语义漂移严重、新旧类边界不稳定。直接混入合成数据又会引入语义噪声并加剧新旧边界冲突，因此需要一种能筛选可信合成知识并稳定边界的G-FSCIL框架。
AI.method: 1) 用冻结的潜扩散模型构建类特定合成候选池，首次观测时做类反演并将条件嵌入复用于按需生成；2) 学习知识筛选策略，挑选兼具语义一致性与视觉多样性的样本，并在基会话中蒸馏为可迁移的选择策略，后续无需再优化即可复用；3) 基于筛选后的合成数据设计边界稳定增量适应，包括合成信息引导的原型初始化与双向边界校准。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，该方法持续优于现有FSCIL基线，遗忘更少，并在新旧类之间取得更好的平衡。
AI.conclusion: 在基会话仅含少量类的G-FSCIL设定下，通过可信合成知识筛选与边界稳定增量适应，可有效缓解监督稀缺、语义漂移和边界冲突问题，提升增量学习的稳定性与泛化性。

title: DTFormer: Text-Guided Semantic Alignment for RGB-D Segmentation
comment: This is submitted to IEEE Journal
summary: RGB-D semantic segmentation has made notable progress by fusing RGB and Depth, yet mainstream models still learn features almost exclusively from pixel-level supervision, lacking direct high-level semantic constraints. This raises a central question-can external knowledge such as language priors inject stronger semantic discriminability into mainstream RGB-D segmentation models. We present DTFormer, a novel tri-modal (RGB-D-Text) semantic segmentation framework. At its core is Text-guided Semantic Alignment Module (TSAM) that first encodes textual cues into a set of semantic prototypes and then explicitly aligns multi-modal RGB-D features with these prototypes at multiple encoder and decoder layers. This design imposes strong semantic regularization on representation learning, guiding the network toward more discriminative features. Extensive experiments on multiple benchmarks show that DTFormer delivers consistent gains while remaining simple and efficient. Our results demonstrate that explicit semantic alignment offers an effective and practical route to improving RGB-D semantic segmentation. The code will be released upon acceptance.

AI.tldr: 提出DTFormer三模态（RGB-D-文本）语义分割框架，通过文本引导语义对齐模块（TSAM）将文本先验编码为语义原型并与多模态特征显式对齐，从而引入高层语义约束，在多个基准上取得一致增益且简单高效。
AI.motivation: 现有RGB-D语义分割虽在RGB与Depth融合上取得进展，但主流模型几乎仅依赖像素级监督学习特征，缺乏直接的高层语义约束。核心问题：语言先验等外部知识能否为主流RGB-D分割模型注入更强的语义判别能力。
AI.method: 提出DTFormer，一种新颖的三模态（RGB-D-文本）语义分割框架。其核心是文本引导语义对齐模块（TSAM）：首先将文本线索编码为一组语义原型，然后在多个编码器和解码器层上将多模态RGB-D特征与这些原型进行显式对齐。该设计对表示学习施加强语义正则化，引导网络学习更具判别力的特征。
AI.result: 在多个基准上的大量实验表明，DTFormer在保持简单高效的同时带来一致的性能增益。
AI.conclusion: 结果证明显式语义对齐为改进RGB-D语义分割提供了一条有效且实用的途径；代码将在论文接收后发布。

title: Anchor and Adapt: Asymmetric Prompt Adaptation for Few-Shot Industrial Anomaly Detection
summary: In few-shot industrial anomaly detection, the few normal target images provide no direct defect supervision, making anomaly prompts difficult to learn from these samples alone. Some vision-language methods therefore use manually specified descriptions to supply explicit anomaly semantics. However, constructing these descriptions requires product-specific effort, and their effectiveness depends on prompt selection. We propose Anchor and Adapt, a two-stage prompt learning framework that separates the acquisition of anomaly semantics from adaptation to target normal appearance. Stage I learns transferable normal and abnormal anchors from annotated auxiliary data. Stage II keeps these anchors fixed and adapts an additional normal branch using the few target normal samples. The inherited and adapted normal branches jointly characterize target normality, with text-anchor regularization encouraging consistency with the generic normal prior and separation from the abnormal anchors. This design retains learned anomaly knowledge while reducing dependence on category-specific anomaly templates, without requiring synthetic anomaly generation. Cross-dataset experiments between MVTec-AD and VisA under 1-, 2-, and 4-shot settings demonstrate competitive detection and localization performance. Controlled ablations assess the roles of transferred anchors, asymmetric adaptation, dual-normal representations, and anchor regularization.

AI.tldr: 提出两阶段提示学习框架"Anchor and Adapt"，将异常语义获取与目标正常外观适应解耦：阶段I从辅助数据学习可迁移的正常/异常锚点，阶段II固定锚点并仅用少量目标正常样本适配一个附加正常分支，在MVTec-AD与VisA跨数据集1/2/4-shot设定下取得有竞争力的检测与定位性能。
AI.motivation: 少样本工业异常检测中，少量正常目标图像不含直接缺陷监督，异常提示难以从这些样本中学习；部分视觉-语言方法依赖人工指定描述来提供异常语义，但描述构建需针对具体产品、耗时且效果依赖提示选择。作者希望在不依赖类别专属异常模板、也无需合成异常生成的前提下，保留已学到的异常知识。
AI.method: 两阶段提示学习框架。阶段I：从带标注的辅助数据学习可迁移的正常锚点与异常锚点。阶段II：固定这些锚点，利用少量目标正常样本额外适配一个正常分支。继承的正常分支与适配的正常分支共同刻画目标正常性；通过文本锚点正则化，鼓励与通用正常先验保持一致并与异常锚点分离。
AI.result: 在MVTec-AD与VisA之间的跨数据集实验、1-shot/2-shot/4-shot设定下，检测与定位性能具有竞争力。消融实验考察了迁移锚点、非对称适配、双正常表征与锚点正则化的作用。
AI.conclusion: 通过将异常语义获取与目标正常外观适应分离，该框架在保留已学异常知识的同时降低了对类别专属异常模板的依赖，且无需合成异常生成，为少样本工业异常检测提供了有效且低标注成本的提示学习方案。

title: WiSPER: Pose-Supervised Predictive and Residual Flow Refinement For Multi-Person 3D Pose Estimation With WiFi CSI
summary: Multi-person 3D pose estimation with WiFi channel state information (CSI) is challenging because reflections from different people overlap without directly identifying individual joints. Existing masked embedding objectives capture wireless relationships without explicit pose supervision, while structured decoders can retain coordinate errors. We propose WiSPER, a two-stage framework combining pose-aware predictive pretraining with conditional residual flow refinement. Pose-Aware Masked Embedding Learning (PAMEL) couples masked latent prediction with auxiliary pose-set supervision on the same CSI context, guiding the encoder toward joint localization from partial observations. Residual Flow refinement with Transformer (ReFT) generates a set of pose candidates to accommodate a variable number of people and refines each candidate through a conditional flow guided by its coarse coordinates and per-joint decoder features. Both stages use paired CSI and pose annotations during training, while inference requires only CSI. Experiments on the PiW3D dataset show that WiSPER achieves an overall mean per-joint position error of 63.72 mm, a 40.0% reduction relative to WiFi-JEPA. For experiments with two and three people, WiSPER reduces MPJPE by 42.1% and 38.1%, respectively. Pose-supervised pretraining configurations obtain lower errors than CSI-only JEPA, and enabling the trained residual refiner reduces overall MPJPE by 13.8-15.6% across the evaluated configurations.

AI.tldr: 提出WiSPER两阶段框架，将姿态感知的掩码嵌入预训练与条件残差流细化相结合，在PiW3D上实现63.72 mm的MPJPE，相较WiFi-JEPA降低40.0%。
AI.motivation: 基于WiFi CSI的多人体3D姿态估计存在难点：不同人体的反射信号相互重叠，且无法直接区分个体关节。现有掩码嵌入目标虽能在无显式姿态监督下捕捉无线关系，但结构化解码器仍会残留坐标误差。因此需要一种既能利用部分观测进行关节定位、又能容纳可变人数并修正粗坐标误差的框架。
AI.method: WiSPER为两阶段框架。第一阶段PAMEL（Pose-Aware Masked Embedding Learning）在同一CSI上下文上，将掩码隐变量预测与辅助姿态集监督耦合，引导编码器从部分观测中实现关节定位。第二阶段ReFT（Residual Flow refinement with Transformer）生成一组姿态候选以容纳可变人数，并依据各候选的粗坐标与逐关节解码器特征，通过条件流对每个候选进行细化。两阶段训练均使用配对的CSI与姿态标注，而推理仅需CSI。
AI.result: 在PiW3D数据集上，WiSPER整体平均逐关节位置误差为63.72 mm，相较WiFi-JEPA降低40.0%；两人和三人实验下MPJPE分别降低42.1%与38.1%。姿态监督预训练配置的误差低于仅CSI的JEPA；启用训练好的残差细化器后，各评估配置整体MPJPE降低13.8%–15.6%。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，姿态感知的掩码嵌入预训练与条件残差流细化相结合，可有效提升基于WiFi CSI的多人体3D姿态估计精度，且推理阶段仅依赖CSI。

title: Artemis: Geometry-Grounded Multi-Agent Driving World Models with Shared 3D State and Progressive Memory Update
comment: The first three authors contributed equally, and their order was determined by drawing lots. Project Lead: Jiuming Liu. Corresponding Author: Ayush Tewari. Project page: https://liujiuming123.github.io/Artemis/
summary: Recent video world models have witnessed the paradigm shift from single-agent to multi-agent involvements, which can reveal more complicated dynamics and cross-agent interaction in the real world. However, existing approaches commonly adopt implicit inter-agent communications via cross attention, which lack explicit geometry constraints and unified 3D state, thereby leading to poor multi-view consistency and struggling with recovering out-of-sight agents. In addition, most of them assume a static background, failing to represent uncontrolled background dynamics. To address these problems, we propose Artemis: a geometry-grounded multi-agent world model with explicit memory sharing. An explicit 3D world map is reconstructed from multi-agent observations to enforce a unified 3D state across agents, offering high cross-view consistency. Specifically, an action-guided geometric injection module is developed to simultaneously render decomposed foreground-background control maps, which are then injected into a diffusion transformer through a designed GeoAdapter block. Compared to previous methods assuming static-only background, our GeoAdapter can also distinguish uncontrolled non-agent dynamics, which are conditioned on their own multi-frame history positions to provide consistent motion cues. Keyframes selected from progressive video rollouts are used to progressively update the reconstructed 3D world maps. To effectively capture complex dynamic patterns, we curate a novel dataset sampled from the CARLA simulator called MA-CARLA. Extensive experiments demonstrate the superiority of our proposed method in terms of visual fidelity and cross-view consistency in the generated videos. In addition, our Artemis can support simultaneous multi-modal rollouts with both 2D video and 3D point map maintenance, scale to scenarios beyond two agents and multi-camera setting.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Artemis，一种基于几何基础、具备显式记忆共享的多智能体世界模型，通过重建显式三维世界地图实现跨智能体统一 3D 状态，并结合动作引导的几何注入与 GeoAdapter，实现高跨视角一致性的多智能体视频生成。
AI.motivation: 现有视频世界模型从单智能体转向多智能体，但主流方法通过交叉注意力进行隐式智能体间通信，缺乏显式几何约束与统一 3D 状态，导致多视角一致性差、难以恢复视野外智能体；同时多数方法假设静态背景，无法表达不可控的背景动态。
AI.method: Artemis 从多智能体观测重建显式 3D 世界地图，以强制跨智能体的统一 3D 状态；提出动作引导的几何注入模块，同时渲染解耦的前景-背景控制图，并通过 GeoAdapter 块注入扩散 Transformer；GeoAdapter 还能区分不可控的非智能体动态，以其多帧历史位置为条件提供一致运动线索；从渐进式视频 rollout 中选取关键帧，逐步更新重建的 3D 世界地图；并构建 MA-CARLA 数据集以捕捉复杂动态模式。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，所提方法在生成视频的视觉保真度与跨视角一致性上具有优越性；Artemis 支持 2D 视频与 3D 点图维护的同步多模态 rollout，可扩展至两个以上智能体及多相机场景。
AI.conclusion: Artemis 通过显式几何与记忆共享机制，有效缓解了多智能体世界模型中跨视角一致性差、视野外智能体恢复困难及背景动态不可控等问题，并具备良好的可扩展性与多模态输出能力。

title: Crop Yield Prediction for Punjab, Pakistan: A Tree-Ensemble and Leaf-Health Prototype, and What Random Validation Hides
summary: Yield forecasts help planners and farmers decide on inputs, storage and imports, but small agricultural tables can make reported accuracy fail on a new season. We built a crop-yield prototype for Punjab, Pakistan that combines Random Forest, XGBoost, support vector regression and a Ridge-stacked ensemble with a MobileNetV2 leaf-health classifier, and deployed it as a web application with SHAP explanations. A random 80/20 split of a merged Kaggle-derived table (414 rows) gives the ensemble an R2 of 0.991. An audit showed that the table contains only 46 independent observations: a join with nine temperature records per year copied every crop-year nine times. Holding out whole years takes XGBoost on the same rows from R2 = 0.994 to -0.20. On deduplicated data, and on a longer FAOSTAT table (1990-2024, 70 observations), a per-crop linear trend (leave-one-year-out RMSE 0.29 Ton/Ha) beats every model not given the year (0.84-1.06). Neither pesticide use nor national temperature change explains the trend residuals. An apparent pesticide gain in the Kaggle table disappears on FAOSTAT, where the pesticide series is mostly imputed and the two releases disagree. An independent district-level wheat panel (36 districts, 13 seasons) shows that most variation in Punjab is spatial and that a district mean with a common trend matches the learned models. The leaf classifier reaches 99.87% accuracy on held-out PlantVillage images and recalls 96.4% of 336 unseen diseased leaves after near-duplicates were removed. However, no leaf image is paired with a yield record, so the health score used in the yield models had to be constructed and adds nothing. We report these negative findings together with the prototype.

AI.tldr: 该论文构建了巴基斯坦旁遮普省的作物产量预测原型（RF/XGBoost/SVR/Ridge堆叠集成+MobileNetV2叶片健康分类器+SHAP解释性Web应用），但审计发现Kaggle表格因重复连接仅含46个独立观测，导致报告的高R²严重虚高；去重与FAOSTAT数据上简单线性趋势及区县均值即可匹敌复杂模型，叶片健康分数因无配对数据而无增益，论文以负面结果报告为主。
AI.motivation: 产量预测对农户与规划者的投入、储存和进口决策至关重要，但小型农业数据集常导致已报告的精度在新季节失效。作者希望为旁遮普省构建一个可解释、可部署的产量预测原型，并系统检验"高精度"是否真实可信，揭示易被忽视的数据泄漏与冗余问题。
AI.method: 融合四个回归器（Random Forest、XGBoost、SVR、Ridge堆叠集成）与MobileNetV2叶片健康分类器，部署为带SHAP解释的Web应用。使用Kaggle衍生合并表（414行）进行随机80/20划分评估，随后开展数据审计（识别独立观测数、重复连接来源）；采用整年留出（leave-one-year-out）验证，并引入FAOSTAT长表（1990–2024，70个观测）与区县级小麦面板（36区县，13季）进行交叉验证；叶片分类器在去除近重复后的PlantVillage及336张未见病叶上评估。
AI.result: 随机80/20划分下集成R²=0.991，但表格实为46个独立观测（每年9条温度记录使作物-年份重复9次）；整年留出时XGBoost从R²=0.994骤降至-0.20。去重及FAOSTAT上，逐作物线性趋势（留一年RMSE 0.29 Ton/Ha）优于所有未提供年份信息的模型（0.84–1.06）；农药使用与全国温度变化均无法解释趋势残差，Kaggle表中的农药增益在FAOSTAT上消失（该序列多为插补且两版本不一致）。区县面板显示旁遮普大部分变异为空间性，区县均值加共同趋势即可匹敌学习模型。叶片分类器在留出PlantVillage上达99.87%精度，去近重复后对336张未见病叶召回96.4%，但因无叶片图像与产量记录配对，构造的健康分数无增益。
AI.conclusion: 小型农业数据集上的高精度指标可能源于重复观测导致的数据泄漏，随机划分会严重高估泛化能力。经审计与外部数据验证，简单线性趋势/区县均值即可匹敌复杂集成模型，叶片健康分数因缺乏配对数据而无贡献。作者以负面结果与原型并列报告，提醒农业机器学习研究须先审计数据独立性并进行时空外推验证。

title: Decomposition-Guided Curvelet Thresholding for Sharp-to-Soft CT Kernel Conversion
summary: Image denoising is a crucial task in image processing, focused on improving image quality by minimizing noise while maintaining essential structural elements. This study presents a hybrid denoising framework that combines several decomposition techniques, including empirical mode decomposition (EMD), variational mode decomposition (VMD), multichannel EMD (MEMD), and bidimensional EMD (BEMD), with curvelet transform thresholding. Each decomposition mode undergoes processing through both soft and hard thresholding, and the denoised modes are combined to rebuild the final image. Comprehensive evaluations of standard CT image datasets reconstructed with various kernels (B50, B46, B41, B36) reveal substantial enhancements in denoising efficacy. VMD consistently achieves the highest peak signal-to-noise ratio (PSNR) and structural similarity index (SSIM), signifying exceptional noise reduction and feature preservation. The study analyses the trade-offs between soft and hard thresholding: soft thresholding maintains intricate visual details, whilst harsh thresholding provides enhanced noise reduction. The suggested method surpasses traditional techniques in both reference and non-reference quality criteria, indicating its potential for broader application in medical imaging and future incorporation with adaptive thresholding algorithms.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出一种混合去噪框架，将EMD、VMD、MEMD、BEMD等分解方法与曲波变换阈值处理结合，在标准CT图像数据集（B50、B46、B41、B36核重建）上验证，其中VMD的PSNR与SSIM最优，且优于传统方法。
AI.motivation: 图像去噪需在降低噪声的同时保留关键结构信息。单一分解方法或单一阈值策略难以兼顾去噪效果与细节保持，因此需要探索多分解方法与阈值处理相结合的混合框架，并评估其在医学CT图像中的适用性。
AI.method: 构建混合去噪框架：先用EMD、VMD、MEMD、BEMD对图像进行模态分解，再对每个分解模态施加曲波变换阈值处理，分别采用软阈值与硬阈值两种策略；将处理后的模态重建为最终图像。在标准CT数据集（B50、B46、B41、B36四种重建核）上进行综合评价，比较各分解方法与阈值策略的PSNR、SSIM及参考/非参考质量指标。
AI.result: VMD在PSNR和SSIM上持续取得最高值，表明其在噪声抑制与特征保留方面表现最佳。软阈值更利于保持复杂视觉细节，硬阈值则提供更强的噪声抑制，二者存在权衡。所提方法在参考与非参考质量指标上均超过传统去噪技术。
AI.conclusion: 多分解方法与曲波阈值相结合的混合框架可有效提升CT图像去噪性能，具有在医学影像领域推广及与自适应阈值算法进一步融合的潜力。

title: A BEMD-Based Quaternion Filtering Approach Sharp-to-Soft Kernel CT Image Conversion
summary: The quality of computed tomography (CT) images is significantly affected by the selection of reconstruction kernels: sharp kernels improve spatial resolution but increase noise, whereas soft kernels diminish noise at the expense of edge clarity. This study presents an innovative enhancement framework utilising Bidimensional Empirical Mode Decomposition in conjunction with Quaternion Bilateral Filtering (BEMD--QBF) to convert sharp-kernel CT images into representations resembling soft-kernels, while maintaining critical anatomical structures. The technique disaggregates each image into intrinsic mode functions via BEMD and analyzes them inside a cohesive quaternion framework to attain efficient noise reduction and structural integrity. The proposed methodology is evaluated using several reconstruction kernels (B50, B46, B41, B36, B35, B31) and compared with recognised filtering strategies, including Non-Local Means, Anisotropic Diffusion, Bilateral Filtering, and Quaternion Bilateral Filtering. Quantitative evaluations of the Structural Similarity Index (SSIM) and Peak Signal-to-Noise Ratio (PSNR) indicate that BEMD-QBF consistently attains superior structural fidelity and competitive noise reduction across all evaluated kernels. The results underscore the efficacy of the proposed strategy as a viable approach to enhancing post-reconstruction CT images, yielding superior image quality without requiring access to raw projection data.

AI.tldr: 提出BEMD-QBF框架，将锐核CT图像转换为类软核表现，兼顾结构保真与降噪。
AI.motivation: CT重建核选择存在分辨率与噪声的权衡：锐核提高空间分辨率但引入噪声，软核降噪但损失边缘清晰度，且后处理通常缺乏原始投影数据。
AI.method: 结合二维经验模态分解（BEMD）与四元数双边滤波（QBF）：用BEMD将图像分解为内禀模态函数，在统一的四元数框架内对各分量进行分析处理，实现降噪并保持结构完整，无需访问原始投影数据。
AI.result: 在多种重建核（B50、B46、B41、B36、B35、B31）上评估，并与非局部均值、各向异性扩散、双边滤波、四元数双边滤波对比；SSIM与PSNR指标显示BEMD-QBF在各核下均取得更高的结构保真度和有竞争力的降噪效果。
AI.conclusion: BEMD-QBF是一种可行的CT后重建图像增强方法，能在不依赖原始投影数据的情况下提升图像质量，使其表现接近软核图像。

title: On Color Alignment in VAE Latent Spaces and Its Applications
summary: Variational autoencoders (VAEs) are a key part of modern text-to-image models, which generate images within their latent space. VAEs are known to disentangle the main factors of variation in the data, and color is known to be one of the most structured of these in natural images: decorrelating it yields one luminance axis and two opponent-color axes. Color should therefore be expected to emerge as a distinct factor in the VAE latent space. Yet how these latent spaces represent color remains largely unexplored. In this work, we show that the VAEs of text-to-image models share a color subspace aligned with brightness and opponent-colors. Through a linear approximation of the encoder and targeted latent steering, we find this subspace consistently across a broad range of VAEs, from SD1.5 to FLUX.2 and Z-Image. Building on this characterization, we propose three applications: ColorTuning, which achieves state-of-the-art in precise numerical color generation on the fine-grained CSS3/X11 system of GenColorBench, saturation control, to adjust the global chromatic intensity, and color transfer, to change the palette to match a reference. The code and models are publicly available at https://julian075.github.io/Color_Subspace/

AI.tldr: 本文揭示文本到图像模型的VAE潜空间中存在一个与亮度及对立色对齐的颜色子空间，并通过线性近似编码器与潜变量操控验证其跨模型一致性，进而提出ColorTuning、饱和度控制与颜色迁移三项应用。
AI.motivation: VAE是现代文本到图像模型的核心组件，其潜空间被认为能解耦数据主要变化因子；颜色在自然图像中高度结构化，去相关后呈一个亮度轴与两个对立色轴，理应作为独立因子体现在潜空间中。然而目前对潜空间如何表征颜色仍缺乏系统研究。
AI.method: 通过对编码器进行线性近似并结合有针对性的潜变量操控，在从SD1.5到FLUX.2、Z-Image等广泛VAE中识别并验证颜色子空间的存在。
AI.result: 发现文本到图像模型的VAE共享一个与亮度和对立色对齐的颜色子空间，且该子空间在多种VAE中稳定一致；基于该表征实现三项应用：ColorTuning在GenColorBench的细粒度CSS3/X11系统上取得精确数值颜色生成的SOTA，饱和度控制可调节全局色彩强度，颜色迁移可将调色板匹配至参考图像。
AI.conclusion: 颜色以结构化子空间形式普遍存在于文本到图像模型的VAE潜空间中，可被线性刻画与有效操控，为精确颜色生成与编辑提供统一基础，代码与模型已公开。

title: Graph-Based Recognition of Simulated Train-Driver States From Facial and Upper-Body Keypoints
summary: Driver fatigue poses a significant challenge to railway safety, with traditional systems like the dead-man switch offering limited and basic alertness checks. This study presents a vision-based monitoring system that relies solely on a single front-facing RGB camera and a graph neural network to classify simulated train-driver states into alert, not-alert, and an emergency class comprising acted emergency-like behaviours. To optimize input representations for the model, an ablation study was performed, comparing three feature configurations: skeletal-only, facial-only, and a combination of both. Experimental results show that combining facial and skeletal features yields the highest accuracy (81%) for the three-class model under the light condition, outperforming models that use only facial or skeletal features. Furthermore, the combination of facial and skeletal features achieves 99% accuracy in the alert/not alert classification in light condition. Additionally, we introduced a controlled RGB video dataset containing alert, not alert, and acted emergency-like behaviours recorded under three illumination conditions. These contributions represent a step toward passive and non-contact train-driver state recognition based on facial and upper-body dynamics.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种仅依赖单目RGB摄像头与图神经网络的视觉列车司机状态监测系统，将模拟驾驶状态分为警觉、非警觉和紧急三类。通过消融实验比较骨骼、面部及二者融合三种特征配置，结果显示面部与骨骼融合特征在光照条件下三类任务准确率最高（81%），在警觉/非警觉二分类中达99%。同时发布了涵盖三种光照条件的受控RGB视频数据集。
AI.motivation: 传统列车安全监测手段（如死人开关）仅能提供有限且基础的警觉性检查，难以有效应对司机疲劳带来的安全挑战。因此需要一种被动、非接触式的司机状态识别方法。
AI.method: 构建仅依赖单个前向RGB摄像头与图神经网络的视觉监测系统；开展消融实验，比较三种输入特征配置：仅骨骼特征、仅面部特征以及面部与骨骼特征融合；采集并构建包含警觉、非警觉和模拟紧急行为、覆盖三种光照条件的受控RGB视频数据集。
AI.result: 面部与骨骼特征融合在三分类模型中于光照条件下取得最高准确率81%，优于仅使用面部或仅使用骨骼的模型；在警觉/非警觉二分类任务中，该融合特征在光照条件下达到99%的准确率。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明融合面部与上半身动态特征可有效提升列车司机状态识别性能，所提系统与数据集为实现基于面部和上半身动态的被动、非接触式司机状态识别迈出了重要一步。

title: A Data-Centric Review of Plant Disease Datasets: Taxonomy, Critical Analysis, Environmental Variability, and Implications for Precision Agriculture
summary: Despite rapid advances in artificial intelligence, reliable real-world plant disease detection remains a persistent challenge. Visual and deep learning approaches have shown promising results, but their deployment under field conditions remains limited. A key bottleneck is the reliance on laboratory-generated datasets that lack environmental diversity, realistic backgrounds, and balanced class distributions, resulting in poor generalization. In contrast, datasets collected directly from agricultural environments capture natural variability and better reflect challenges faced by farmers across regions. This review presents a critical analysis of visual and deep learning approaches for plant disease detection, with emphasis on plant disease datasets. It establishes a taxonomy based on acquisition setting, accessibility, plant diversity, disease composition, class structure, and imbalance severity, and examines their implications for model generalization and real-world deployment. A comparative analysis of laboratory and real-field datasets identifies critical gaps that hinder disease detection. The review further analyzes how multi-level dataset imbalance, including intra-class, inter-crop, and cross-dataset imbalance, and limited environmental variability affect model performance and robustness, an area insufficiently examined in existing surveys. Beyond image-based approaches, it highlights the importance of integrating environmental parameters such as temperature, humidity, and leaf wetness with image data to improve prediction under dynamic field conditions. Finally, the review identifies key challenges, research gaps, and future directions concerning dataset construction, environmental variability, structural imbalance, standardization, and multimodal disease monitoring. It provides a foundation for developing next-generation multimodal frameworks for precision agriculture.

AI.tldr: 该综述聚焦植物病害检测中的"数据瓶颈"，提出基于采集环境、可获取性、植物多样性、病害组成、类别结构与失衡严重程度的数据集分类体系，比较实验室与真实田间数据集的差距，剖析多层类别失衡与环境变异对模型泛化与部署的影响，并倡导融合温湿度、叶面湿度等环境参数的多模态病害监测框架。
AI.motivation: 视觉与深度学习方法在植物病害检测上表现良好，但田间部署受限，核心瓶颈在于依赖实验室生成的数据集——缺乏环境多样性、真实背景与均衡类别分布，导致泛化能力差；而直接采集于农业环境的数据集更能反映自然变异与农户实际挑战，却缺乏系统性梳理与分析。
AI.method: 采用批判性综述方法：构建数据集分类体系（采集环境、可获取性、植物多样性、病害组成、类别结构、失衡严重程度）；对实验室数据集与真实田间数据集进行对比分析；分析多层类别失衡（类内、跨作物、跨数据集）与环境变异性的影响；并考察环境参数（温度、湿度、叶面湿度）与图像数据融合的多模态方法。
AI.result: 识别出实验室与真实田间数据集之间存在阻碍病害检测的关键差距；指出多层类别失衡与有限环境变异显著影响模型性能与鲁棒性，而这一方向在既有综述中研究不足；表明融合环境参数与图像数据可提升动态田间条件下的预测效果。
AI.conclusion: 综述归纳了数据集构建、环境变异性、结构性失衡、标准化与多模态病害监测等方面的关键挑战、研究空白与未来方向，为精准农业的下一代多模态框架奠定基础。

title: MoonGS: High-quality Representation of the Lunar Surface via Gaussian Splatting Using Robust Depth Features from Image Pairs
summary: High-quality 3D reconstruction of lunar terrain from sparse rover images is indispensable for autonomous lunar exploration, but remains challenging because viewpoint overlap is insufficient, surface textures are weak, and data volume is limited. We propose MoonGS, the first feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting framework tailored to lunar scenes. Given only two input images, MoonGS predicts pixel-aligned Gaussian primitives in a single forward pass and renders photorealistic novel views without any per-scene optimization. MoonGS (i) adopts an adaptable backbone design that seamlessly integrates advanced vision foundation models to extract robust depth features; (ii) integrates semantic priors in two manners: merging semantic cues with visual features to refine Gaussian parameter estimation, and adopting a semantic ranking loss that regularizes background depth; and (iii) employs an entropy-guided heuristic resampling strategy to augment sparse observations by selecting the most informative distant viewpoints with negligible overhead. Experiments on the LuSNAR benchmark and our synthetic weak-texture MoonBlender dataset show that MoonGS surpasses state-of-the-art feed-forward NeRF/3DGS baselines by +4.9 dB PSNR, +0.29 SSIM, and 40\% lower LPIPS while maintaining sub-second inference. Furthermore, we validate the broad applicability of our framework by demonstrating that it effectively leverages state-of-the-art backbones, including VGGT, to significantly boost performance. Qualitative evaluations on Chang'e mission imagery also show the best visual quality among compared methods, indicating robustness on real lunar data. The source code and dataset are publicly available at https://github.com/InRobots/MoonBlender.

AI.tldr: MoonGS是首个面向月面场景的前馈式3D高斯泼溅框架，仅用两幅输入图像即可单次前向预测像素对齐高斯基元，无需逐场景优化，在新视角合成上显著超越现有前馈NeRF/3DGS基线。
AI.motivation: 稀疏月球车图像的高质量三维重建对自主月球探测至关重要，但面临视点重叠不足、地表纹理弱、数据量有限三大困难，现有方法难以适用。
AI.method: 提出MoonGS前馈式3DGS框架：(i) 可适配骨干设计，集成先进视觉基础模型提取鲁棒深度特征；(ii) 以两种方式引入语义先验——将语义线索与视觉特征融合以精化高斯参数估计，并采用语义排序损失正则化背景深度；(iii) 熵引导的启发式重采样策略，以极小开销选取最具信息量的远距离视点来增广稀疏观测。
AI.result: 在LuSNAR基准与自建弱纹理MoonBlender数据集上，较SOTA前馈NeRF/3DGS基线提升+4.9 dB PSNR、+0.29 SSIM，LPIPS降低40%，且保持亚秒级推理；可有效利用VGGT等先进骨干进一步提升性能；在嫦娥任务影像上定性评估取得最优视觉质量，验证真实月面数据鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: MoonGS为稀疏月面图像的前馈三维重建提供了有效方案，兼顾高保真新视角合成与实时推理，并具备对先进骨干与真实月球数据的良好泛化能力，代码与数据集已开源。

title: R2RI: A Multi-View Event and RGB Dataset for Robot-to-Robot Interaction
summary: Understanding and modeling interactions between autonomous agents is a fundamental challenge in robotics, with broad implications for collaborative systems, social robotics, and human-robot coexistence. Although the study of robot interactions has emerged as a compelling research direction, progress has been severely hampered by the absence of large-scale benchmarks. In this paper, we introduce Robot-to-Robot Interaction (R2RI), the first dataset specifically designed to address the Robot-Robot Interaction (RRI) task. R2RI consists of different humanoid robots and realistic interactions modeled on real human social behaviors. Complementary viewpoints are available, \textit{i.e.}, an egocentric perspective from each robot's onboard sensors, and an exocentric perspective from external fixed cameras, thus enabling rich spatial and contextual understanding of the interaction dynamics. The dataset comprises more than $6.5$M frames and $\approx5000$ videos at $120$ fps, including Event and RGB domains. We investigate pros and cons of each domain, comparing state-of-the-art approaches for a number of key sensing and interaction based tasks. We publicly release the dataset and its annotations for all tasks and modalities at https://github.com/MagriniGabriele/R2RI.

AI.tldr: 本文提出R2RI，首个面向机器人-机器人交互（RRI）任务的数据集，包含多种人形机器人和基于真实人类社会行为建模的交互，提供自我中心与外中心互补视角，含超650万帧、约5000段120fps视频，涵盖Event与RGB域，并对比了当前先进方法在多项感知与交互任务上的表现。
AI.motivation: 自主智能体间交互的理解与建模是机器人学的核心挑战，对协作系统、社交机器人及人机共存意义重大。尽管机器人交互研究已成为重要方向，但缺乏大规模基准数据集严重阻碍了进展。
AI.method: 构建R2RI数据集：采用多种人形机器人，交互行为以真实人类社会行为为蓝本建模；提供互补视角——每个机器人机载传感器的自我中心视角与外部固定相机的外中心视角，从而支持对交互动态的丰富空间与上下文理解。数据规模超过650万帧、约5000段视频，帧率120fps，包含Event与RGB两种模态。
AI.result: 数据集包含多机器人、多视角、多模态的大规模交互数据；作者分析了Event与RGB各域的优势与局限，并在多项关键感知与交互任务上对比了当前先进方法。
AI.conclusion: R2RI填补了RRI任务缺乏大规模基准的空白，数据集及其所有任务与模态的标注已在 https://github.com/MagriniGabriele/R2RI 公开释出，为后续机器人交互研究提供基础平台。

title: PlaySuite: A Large-Scale Benchmark for Interactive Visual Intelligence
summary: Recent advances in multimodal foundation models yield strong performance on static perception and reasoning benchmarks, yet such evaluations largely overlook a central aspect of intelligence: acting competently in dynamic environments over extended time horizons. We introduce PlaySuite, a large-scale benchmark for evaluating interactive visual intelligence across more than 5K open-source video games curated from PyWeek and itch.io. Spanning diverse genres and engines, including Pygame, HTML5, Godot, and Unity, these independent games are largely out-of-distribution for current models, reducing the likelihood that success can be achieved by retrieving memorized walkthroughs or web-scale training artifacts. To enable scalable evaluation across heterogeneous titles, we develop a unified closed-loop interaction framework optimized for HPC clusters alongside a Video-LLM-as-a-judge protocol that maps observable gameplay milestones to standardized progress levels. We evaluate fourteen recent open models spanning vision-language models, computer-use agents, and vision-language-action models. Our results yield strong evidence of a perception-action gap: despite strong reasoning capabilities, current models struggle to make sustained progress and exhibit recurring failures in spatial grounding, action execution, and self-correction. PlaySuite provides a reproducible and extensible testbed for measuring progress from visual perception to goal-directed interaction, and a foundation for developing models that can act, adapt, and generalize in dynamic visual environments.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 PlaySuite，一个基于 5K+ 开源视频游戏的大规模交互式视觉智能基准，并揭示当前多模态模型存在显著的“感知—行动鸿沟”。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态基础模型评估主要集中于静态感知与推理任务，忽视了智能的核心要素——在动态环境中长时间跨度下的胜任行动能力。同时，现有游戏类基准多依赖模型可能记忆过的热门游戏或训练数据中的走查攻略，难以真实衡量泛化性的交互智能。
AI.method: 从 PyWeek 与 itch.io 收集超过 5,000 款开源视频游戏，覆盖 Pygame、HTML5、Godot、Unity 等多种引擎与类型。构建面向 HPC 集群优化的统一闭环交互框架，以实现异构游戏的规模化评估；并提出 Video-LLM-as-a-judge 协议，将可观测的游戏里程碑映射为标准化进度等级。对 14 个近期开源模型进行评估，涵盖视觉语言模型、计算机使用智能体与视觉—语言—行动模型。
AI.result: 评估结果提供了“感知—行动鸿沟”的有力证据：尽管模型具备较强推理能力，但在持续取得进展方面表现不佳，并在空间定位、动作执行与自我纠错方面反复失败。这些独立游戏对当前模型多为分布外数据，显著降低了通过检索记忆走查或网络训练产物取得成功的可能性。
AI.conclusion: PlaySuite 为衡量从视觉感知到目标导向交互的进展提供了可复现、可扩展的测试床，也为开发能够在动态视觉环境中行动、适应与泛化的模型奠定了基础。

title: CALR: Continuous Anchored Latent Reasoning via Render-of-Thought Compression
summary: Visual latent reasoning compresses rendered derivations into compact intermediate states, reducing textual reasoning overhead. Existing approaches differ in how they represent these states: continuous methods avoid vocabulary constraints, whereas discrete methods improve accuracy through quantization into a finite codebook. Our analysis of representative continuous and discrete systems identifies two functional requirements: answers must rely on latent states, and those states must carry valid, problem-specific reasoning. Continuous latents influence answers despite collapsed reasoning content, whereas discrete latents retain recoverable intermediate reasoning that answer prediction largely bypasses. To address these challenges, we propose Continuous Anchored Latent Reasoning (CALR), which connects latent formation with answer use through functional anchoring. With reference latents from information-balanced compression, CALR couples latent-mediated answer supervision with derivation-level semantic anchoring: the former routes answer supervision through intermediate states, while the latter grounds their decoded content in problem-specific derivations. A parallel-to-autoregressive curriculum develops sequential reasoning by conditioning subsequent latent blocks on generated prefixes. Evaluations on five mathematical reasoning benchmarks across model families show substantial accuracy gains. Under matched budgets, CALR gains 26.0 percentage points over a comparable continuous latent reasoning method. Further analyses show that its latents support answer prediction and carry problem-specific intermediate reasoning.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出连续锚定潜在推理（CALR），通过"功能锚定"将潜在状态的形成与答案使用耦合，解决连续方法推理内容坍缩、离散方法答案绕过推理的问题，在五个数学推理基准上取得显著提升。
AI.motivation: 视觉潜在推理将渲染的推导过程压缩为紧凑的中间状态，以降低文本推理开销。现有方法在状态表示上存在分歧：连续方法不受词表约束，离散方法通过量化为有限码本提升准确率。作者对两类代表性系统的分析揭示两项功能需求——答案必须依赖潜在状态，且潜在状态必须承载有效、问题特定的推理。然而连续潜在虽影响答案，其推理内容却发生坍缩；离散潜在虽保留了可恢复的中间推理，答案预测却大体绕过这些推理。二者均未同时满足上述需求，因此需要新的方法。
AI.method: 提出连续锚定潜在推理（CALR），通过功能锚定将潜在状态的形成与答案使用相连接。具体地，以信息均衡压缩得到的参考潜变量为基础，CALR 将"潜变量中介的答案监督"与"推导级语义锚定"相耦合：前者使答案监督经由中间状态传递，后者将其解码内容锚定到问题特定的推导上。此外，采用平行到自回归的课程学习，通过让后续潜在块以已生成前缀为条件，逐步培养顺序推理能力。
AI.result: 在五个数学推理基准、多种模型家族上的评估显示准确率显著提升。在预算匹配条件下，CALR 相比一种可比的连续潜在推理方法获得26.0个百分点的提升。进一步分析表明，其潜在状态既支持答案预测，又承载问题特定的中间推理。
AI.conclusion: CALR 通过功能锚定弥合了连续潜在表示的"无词表约束"优势与推理内容可验证性之间的鸿沟，使潜在状态同时满足"影响答案"和"承载有效推理"两项功能需求，为视觉潜在推理提供了兼具性能与可解释性的方案。

title: Deep Learning Based Illegal Bowling Action Detection
summary: Cricket, often referred to as the "gentleman's game," adheres to a strict rule set for both batsmen and bowlers, where each delivery can significantly impact the match outcome. Detecting illegal bowling actions is crucial for maintaining fair play, yet it remains challenging for umpires to monitor in real time. Existing sensor-based solutions have limitations in live match scenarios, making real-time assessment difficult. This paper proposes a computer vision-based deep learning solution to detect illegal bowling actions in live cricket matches. To develop and evaluate our approach, we compiled a dataset of 62 videos featuring 11 male bowlers, capturing both legal and illegal bowling actions from multiple angles-front, back, and side. However, the dataset predominantly comprises right-handed bowlers with conventional actions. The proposed system identifies two key frames, the shoulder frame and the release frame from video footage of a bowler's delivery and analyzes the change in the bowling arm's angle between these frames. If the angle difference exceeds a predefined threshold (e.g., 15 degrees), the delivery is flagged as potentially illegal. We evaluated the system on a custom dataset and achieved a high true positive rate, suggesting the system's potential effectiveness in real-time match settings. However, further research is required to validate the system across diverse environmental conditions and larger datasets to ensure generalizability and robustness in various live match scenarios. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first AI-based computer vision method for detecting illegal bowling actions in cricket.

AI.tldr: 提出首个基于计算机视觉与深度学习的板球非法投球动作检测方法，通过定位肩部帧与出手帧并计算投球臂角度变化（阈值15°）判定违规，在自建62段视频数据集上取得高真阳性率。
AI.motivation: 板球对投球动作有严格规则，非法投球（如肘部过度伸展）会破坏公平竞赛。现有基于传感器的方案难以在真实比赛中实时监测，裁判也无法实时准确判断，因此需要一种面向直播场景的自动化检测手段。
AI.method: 构建含62段视频、11名男性投球手、覆盖正面/背面/侧面多角度及合法与非法动作的数据集；采用基于深度学习的计算机视觉流程，从投球视频中定位两个关键帧——肩部帧与出手帧，计算两帧之间投球臂角度的变化量，若角度差超过预设阈值（如15度）则判定该次投球为疑似非法。
AI.result: 在自建数据集上评估，系统取得较高的真阳性率，表明其在实时比赛场景中具有应用潜力；但数据集以右手投球手和常规动作为主，且尚未在多样环境条件与更大规模数据上验证。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为板球非法投球动作检测提供了首个基于AI与计算机视觉的方法，验证了关键帧角度分析思路的可行性。后续需在多样化环境条件与更大数据集上进一步研究，以保证系统的泛化性与鲁棒性。

title: Hybrid Cross-Modal Attention Network for Early Breast Cancer Detection in Low-Resource Clinical Settings
comment: 5 double pages numbers, conference paper presented at AI4SD 2026 (https://www.mu.edu.et/index.php/component/content/article/artificial-intelligence-for-sustainable-development-conference-participants?catid=69&Itemid=101)
summary: Breast cancer is the leading cause of cancer-related mortality among women in Sub-Saharan Africa, where delayed diagnosis results from limited radiology expertise and fragmented clinical data systems. Although deep learning models have demonstrated strong performance in mammographic analysis, most rely solely on imaging data and are trained on Western populations, limiting their applicability in African healthcare settings. This paper presents a Hybrid Cross-Modal Attention Network (HCMAN) that integrates mammogram images with structured clinical data using transformer-based cross-modal attention mechanisms. The model was developed and validated using a locally collected dataset of 2,560 mammogram images from 1,024 patients across four Ethiopian referral hospitals, with biopsy-confirmed ground truth labels. The proposed framework achieves 97.8% accuracy, 97.2% sensitivity, 98.3% specificity, and an AUC of 0.987, significantly outperforming image-only baselines. The system demonstrates robustness to low-quality images typical of resource-limited settings, with only 3.2% performance degradation compared to 8.7% for image-only models. Cross-modal attention analysis reveals clinically appropriate behavior: higher reliance on clinical features for ambiguous cases such as dense breasts and young patients. The model's lightweight architecture enables deployment on standard hospital workstations (<2 seconds inference on CPU). This work advances sustainable, context-aware AI solutions for equitable breast cancer diagnostics in Africa.

AI.tldr: 本文提出混合跨模态注意力网络（HCMAN），将乳腺X线图像与结构化临床数据通过Transformer跨模态注意力融合，在埃塞俄比亚四家转诊医院1024例患者的2560张图像上达到97.8%准确率与0.987 AUC，显著优于仅图像基线，并可在CPU上<2秒推理。
AI.motivation: 撒哈拉以南非洲乳腺癌死亡率高，延迟诊断源于影像专业人才短缺与临床数据碎片化；现有深度学习模型多仅依赖影像且基于西方人群训练，难以适用于非洲医疗场景。
AI.method: 构建混合跨模态注意力网络（HCMAN），采用基于Transformer的跨模态注意力机制，融合乳腺X线图像与结构化临床数据；使用本地采集数据集（4家埃塞俄比亚转诊医院、1024名患者、2560张图像，活检确诊作为金标准）进行开发与验证，并与仅图像基线对比。
AI.result: 准确率97.8%、敏感度97.2%、特异度98.3%、AUC 0.987，显著优于仅图像基线；对资源有限场景低质量图像更稳健，性能下降3.2%（仅图像模型为8.7%）；跨模态注意力分析显示对致密乳腺、年轻患者等模糊病例更依赖临床特征；轻量架构支持标准医院工作站部署，CPU推理<2秒。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为非洲公平可及的乳腺癌诊断提供了可持续、情境感知的AI解决方案，体现跨模态融合在资源受限环境中的实用价值。

title: What Words Keep of a Place: Zero-Shot Language Reasoning for Cross-View Geo-Localization
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026 Workshop Physical World AI: Geometry, Characteristics, and Multimodal Sensing
summary: Cross-view geo-localization is commonly solved as an image retrieval problem, matching a ground-level image against a database of satellite tiles through a jointly trained embedding. Such models are accurate, but they need large paired supervision and cannot show what evidence supports a match. In this paper, we study a different question: how much of this task can be solved through language alone? We prompt a multimodal large language model (MLLM) to describe each ground panorama and each satellite tile as structured text, and localize by comparing these descriptions. No component is trained. We evaluate on 9,826 VIGOR pairs from four U.S. cities, in three settings. First, the descriptions are faithful but not discriminative. They agree closely across the two views, yet ranking the full pool by description similarity almost never returns the correct tile (0.39% Recall@1). Second, we narrow the pool to ten neighboring tiles, as a coarse prior would do. The same descriptions now become useful: an MLLM judge that scores structural consistency doubles random ranking and matches a strong lexical baseline. It also states which fields of the two descriptions agree and which conflict, which an embedding distance cannot do, and which we see as a step toward interpretable localization. Third, we place the judge on a trained visual retriever. On the queries it ranks wrongly, reranking from images works, while reranking from our descriptions does not (23.5% against 10.7% Recall@1). Scene structure survives the conversion into language, while the fine appearance detail needed to separate nearby places does not. Code and prompts are publicly available at https://github.com/AyeshAbuLehyeh/GeoLingual.

AI.tldr: 本文研究"仅用语言"能在多大程度上解决跨视角地理定位：用MLLM把地面全景与卫星瓦片转成结构化文本，再比较文本描述完成匹配，全流程无需训练。在VIGOR 9826对数据、三种设定下评估发现：全局检索几乎失效，缩到10个近邻时文本判断有效并具可解释性，但放到已训练视觉检索器之上重排反而劣于图像重排，说明场景结构可语言化、精细外观细节不可。
AI.motivation: 现有跨视角地理定位多作为图像检索问题，通过联合训练的嵌入模型将地面图像与卫星瓦片库匹配。这类方法精度高，但依赖大规模成对监督，且无法说明匹配依据什么证据，缺乏可解释性。作者因此提出一个不同的问题：这项任务有多少可以仅靠语言完成。
AI.method: 不做任何训练。用多模态大模型（MLLM）分别将每张地面全景和每个卫星瓦片描述为结构化文本，通过对文本描述的比较进行定位。评估使用来自4座美国城市的9826对VIGOR数据，分三种设定：（1）在全量池中用描述相似度排序；（2）先用粗粒度先验把候选缩到10个相邻瓦片，再用MLLM评判器对结构一致性打分，并输出两份描述中哪些字段一致、哪些冲突；（3）把该评判器置于已训练的视觉检索器之上做重排。
AI.result: （1）全池排序时描述忠实但不具区分性：两视角描述高度一致，但按描述相似度排序几乎从不召回正确瓦片，Recall@1仅0.39%。（2）缩小到10个近邻后描述变得有用：MLLM评判器的结构一致性打分把随机排序翻倍，并可媲美强词法基线；同时能指出两描述间一致与冲突的字段，这是嵌入距离做不到的。（3）叠加在训练好的视觉检索器上时，对排序错误的查询，用图像重排有效，而用本文描述重排无效，Recall@1分别为23.5%与10.7%。
AI.conclusion: 场景结构能经受住向语言的转换，但区分邻近地点所需的精细外观细节无法保留。语言式描述可作为通向可解释定位的一步，适合在粗粒度候选范围内发挥作用，但不能替代视觉检索器在细粒度区分上的能力。代码与提示词已公开。

title: Localize Any Object in X-Ray Security Scans without Human Annotation
summary: Universal object localization in X-ray security inspection is critical for automated threat detection in safety-critical venues. However, unlike everyday RGB images that dominate web-scale visual data, X-ray scans exhibit distinct color patterns, ambiguous boundaries, and compositional structures caused by volumetric superposition. These gaps hinder the direct zero-shot transfer of dense perception foundation models trained on web-scale RGB data. Moreover, annotated X-ray data is scarce and requires expert labeling, limiting both the training of generalizable X-ray native models and the adaptation of RGB foundation models for X-ray data via fine-tuning. Given these challenges, the bright promise of highly generalizable perception models, enabled by data scaling laws in the RGB domain, remains largely out of reach for X-ray inspection. To this end, we introduce LAO-X, a self-supervised adaptation framework that Locates Any Object in X-ray scans using diverse synthesized image--annotation pairs with granularity-aware supervision. LAO-X first designs a saliency-guided X-ray object mining module to separate diverse object instances, which are then used for physics-guided synthesis in the absorbance domain. LAO-X further incorporates an occlusion-controlled curriculum strategy to fine-tune a Segment Anything Model 2 (SAM2) localizer, progressively adapting it to X-ray scans with increasing object counts and overlap levels. Experiments on six X-ray benchmarks show that LAO-X substantially improves category-agnostic localization, achieving 2\% to 23\% mAP gains over SAM2 and X-ray specific baselines in heavily cluttered scenarios, entirely without human-annotated labels.

AI.tldr: 提出LAO-X自监督适配框架，利用合成图像-标注对和粒度感知监督，将SAM2适配至X射线安检的通用目标定位，无需人工标注。
AI.motivation: X射线扫描具有与RGB图像显著不同的颜色模式、模糊边界和由体积叠加造成的复杂结构，导致在web-scale RGB数据上训练的密集感知基础模型难以直接零样本迁移；同时X射线标注数据稀缺且依赖专家标注，限制了原生模型训练与RGB基础模型的微调适配，使数据缩放定律带来的泛化优势难以在X射线领域实现。
AI.method: LAO-X首先设计显著性引导的X射线目标挖掘模块，分离多样目标实例；随后在吸光度域中进行物理引导合成，生成多样化的图像-标注对；再引入遮挡控制的课程策略，按目标数量和重叠程度递增的方式微调SAM2定位器，逐步适配X射线扫描。
AI.result: 在六个X射线基准上，LAO-X显著提升类别无关定位性能，在高杂乱场景下相较SAM2及X射线专用基线取得2%至23%的mAP提升，且完全不使用人工标注。
AI.conclusion: LAO-X通过自监督合成数据与渐进式课程微调，有效弥合了RGB基础模型与X射线安检感知之间的域差距，实现了无需人工标注的通用X射线目标定位。

title: Compositional Concept Erasure in Text-to-Image Diffusion Models via Hierarchically Grounded Semantic Surgery
summary: Removing copyrighted, unsafe, or user-specified concepts from a deployed text-to-image diffusion model is now a practical requirement. Weight-editing methods can suppress fixed targets, but they require per-target retraining and modify the model checkpoint. Training-free methods, on the other hand, are deployment-friendly, but they suffer from text-side routing failures on compositional prompts. In such prompts, the erase target may be invoked through a related class rather than its lexical name, and its modifiers may migrate onto preserved objects. This paper proposes Hierarchically Grounded Semantic Surgery (HGSS), a training-free framework for compositional concept erasure. The framework lifts both the routing signal and the edit operator used by text-side erasure. First, hierarchical span grounding resolves erase-target spans through lexical, taxonomic, and semantic evidence, while guarding against broad-hypernym and compound-head false positives. Second, dynamic attribute binding refines the text conditioning during early denoising via a counterfactual reference and a preserve-aware cross-attention objective, keeping surviving attribute-noun bindings intact. HGSS selectively removes the erase target without updating model weights or adding learned parameters. On SEE, HGSS cuts hierarchical evasion from 29.54 to 10.02 and roughly halves pairwise attribute leakage, achieving the best Neighbor E and AttrP scores among the reported erasure methods. On UnlearnCanvas, HGSS slightly improves the six-metric average over the matched Semantic Surgery baseline, reaching state-of-the-art.

AI.tldr: 本文提出免训练的组合式概念擦除框架 HGSS，通过层级跨度定位与动态属性绑定，解决文本端路由失败与属性泄漏问题。
AI.motivation: 已部署的文本到图像扩散模型需要移除受版权保护、不安全或用户指定的概念。权重编辑方法需逐目标重训练并修改模型检查点；免训练方法虽部署友好，但在组合式提示上存在文本端路由失败：擦除目标可能通过相关类别而非其词汇名称被调用，且其修饰词会迁移到保留对象上。
AI.method: HGSS 同时提升文本端擦除所使用的路由信号与编辑算子。其一，层级跨度定位（hierarchical span grounding）通过词汇、分类学与语义证据解析擦除目标跨度，并防范宽泛上位词与复合词中心语的假阳性。其二，动态属性绑定（dynamic attribute binding）在早期去噪阶段借助反事实参考与保留感知的交叉注意力目标来精炼文本条件，保持存活的属性—名词绑定不被破坏。整个过程不更新模型权重，也不引入可学习参数。
AI.result: 在 SEE 上，HGSS 将层级规避从 29.54 降至 10.02，并将成对属性泄漏大约减半，在所报告的擦除方法中取得最佳的 Neighbor E 与 AttrP 分数。在 UnlearnCanvas 上，HGSS 相对匹配的 Semantic Surgery 基线在六项指标平均值上略有提升，达到当前最佳水平。
AI.conclusion: HGSS 是一种免训练、无需更新权重或添加参数的组合式概念擦除框架，有效缓解文本端路由失败与属性迁移，在多个基准上取得领先或更优表现。

title: A doctrine-grounded visual question answering dataset for Tactical Combat Casualty Care
comment: 20 pages, 6 figures, 5 tables. Dataset: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23170287; code: https://github.com/Kamaleswaran-Lab/TC3-VQA
summary: Tactical Combat Casualty Care (TC3) requires responders to connect visual observations of injuries and interventions with established clinical guidance. Developing vision-language models to support this process requires supervision that links visible evidence to traceable doctrine. We present TC3-VQA, a dataset constructed from public instructional and field TC3 videos and authoritative TC3 documents. It contains 581 items spanning 11 concepts, with 1,860 questions covering intervention recognition, doctrine, clinical reasoning, procedural guidance, and refusal when visual information is insufficient. Doctrine-based answers preserve verbatim source passages and character offsets. Construction combines visual annotation, passage retrieval, entailment checks, and verification across model families. Equipment boxes, anatomical labels, temporal segments, and source metadata accompany the question-answer pairs. Automated audits and ratings by two physicians and two medical students characterize annotation quality, with human ratings available for 88 retained items. The dataset provides a resource for adapting vision-language models to TC3, studying the connection between visual evidence and clinical knowledge, and evaluating recognition, doctrine recall, and abstention.

AI.tldr: 论文提出TC3-VQA数据集，用于将战术战伤救治（TC3）视频中的视觉证据与权威救治条令相连接，以支撑视觉语言模型训练与评估。
AI.motivation: TC3要求响应者将伤情视觉观察与干预措施同既定临床指南相联系；开发支持该过程的视觉语言模型需要能够把可观察证据与可追溯条令关联起来的监督信号，而现有此类资源缺乏。
AI.method: 从公开的TC3教学与实战视频及权威TC3文档构建数据集：共581个条目、覆盖11个概念、1,860个问题，涵盖干预识别、条令、临床推理、操作指导以及视觉信息不足时的拒答；基于条令的答案保留原文片段及字符偏移；构建流程结合视觉标注、段落检索、蕴含检查以及跨模型族验证；问答对附带器械框、解剖标签、时序片段与来源元数据；通过自动化审计及两名医师与两名医学生的评分评估标注质量。
AI.result: 数据集包含581个条目、11个概念、1,860个问题，并为88个保留条目提供了人工评分；通过自动化审计和多名医学专家评分刻画了标注质量。
AI.conclusion: 该数据集为将视觉语言模型适配到TC3、研究视觉证据与临床知识之间的联系，以及评估识别、条令记忆与拒答能力提供了资源。

title: Tracking Is Not Permanence: What Video World Models Keep of a Hidden Object
summary: Video world models track objects they can see; we ask what they keep of objects they cannot. We hide an object from a frozen V-JEPA 2 predictor and compare its prediction for the hidden region with the encoder's representation of two worlds that differ only inside that region. The predictor's decision keeps a stationary object in part and one carried inside a container not at all, and loses a moving one within 0.3 s (0.5 s under V-JEPA's own tube mask; ViT-H keeps it to 1.1 s at pretraining's 90% masking ratio); in projection a trace remains, below the midpoint, at 14-60% of what a baseline copying the last view retains. The information is there: the encoder reads the object's presence at 1.00 and keeps a closed container's contents decodable for 3.5 s, while the predictor's output, read with the encoder's own probe, contains the ball in 2% of scenes once the box has been closed for half a second. On rendered scenes, permanence is missing on the predictor's side, and training installs it cheaply as a prior: three thousand predictor-only steps on synthetic containers take this belief from 0.05 to 1.00 against two matched controls. They also raise IntPhys-2019 from 84.2% to 93.3%, but so does a curriculum without containers, and which training habit the benchmark credits changes with its scoring rule. Continued training with tube masks produces 1.1-1.6 s of moving-object carry-over on manipulation and internet-style video, so the deficit is not intrinsic to latent prediction. VideoMAE keeps almost nothing, and Cosmos's next-token prediction keeps a stationary hidden object but not one carried inside a moving container.

AI.tldr: 该研究探查冻结的V-JEPA 2预测器对"看不见的物体"的保留程度，发现其在潜空间中仍存有微弱痕迹，但显式持久性（object permanence）严重缺失，且该缺陷可通过廉价的预测器专属训练作为先验被快速补齐。
AI.motivation: 视频世界模型能否追踪"看得见的物体"已有共识，但作者追问一个更根本的问题：当物体被遮挡而无法观测时，模型内部到底保留了这些物体的多少信息。这一"物体持久性"能力是衡量世界模型是否真正理解物理世界的关键指标，此前缺乏针对冻结预测器潜空间的系统量化。
AI.method: 以冻结的V-JEPA 2预测器为对象，将物体从可见区域隐藏，比较预测器对被遮挡区域的输出与编码器对"仅在该区域内不同"的两个世界的表征。设置静止物体、被容器携带的物体、运动物体三类情形，并引入tube mask、90%掩码比、ViT-H对照；使用编码器自身的探针（probe）读取预测器输出；另在渲染场景上验证，并通过3000步预测器专属训练（合成容器）与两个匹配对照实验检验"训练作为先验安装持久性"的假设，最后在IntPhys-2019及操作/网络风格视频上评估迁移效果。
AI.result: 预测器对静止物体仅部分保留，对被容器携带的物体几乎完全不保留，运动物体0.3秒内丢失（V-JEPA自身tube mask下0.5秒；ViT-H在90%掩码比下保留至1.1秒）；投影中仍残留低于中点、相当于复制上一视图基线14–60%的痕迹。编码器侧则以1.00的准确率读出物体存在，且闭合容器内容可解码3.5秒，而预测器输出用编码器探针读取时，盒子关闭半秒后仅2%场景包含球。渲染场景证实预测器侧缺乏持久性；3000步预测器专属训练可将其信念从0.05提升至1.00，并使IntPhys-2019从84.2%升至93.3%，但无容器的课程同样有效，且基准归因随评分规则变化。持续tube mask训练在操作与网络视频上产生1.1–1.6秒运动物体延续，说明缺陷非潜预测内在属性。VideoMAE几乎不保留，Cosmos的下一token预测保留静止隐藏物体但不保留被运动容器携带的物体。
AI.conclusion: 潜预测器中并非没有物体信息，而是缺乏显式的持久性表征，该缺陷可通过少量预测器专属训练廉价地作为先验补足，且缺陷并非潜预测范式固有；不同架构（VideoMAE、Cosmos）表现出各异的保留模式，且基准对训练习惯的归因受评分规则影响。

title: Identity-Conditioned Score Fusion for Open-Set Person Re-Identification
summary: Robust person re-identification often combines complementary cues such as face, gait, and body shape. While adaptive fusion typically targets query quality, model strength also varies across identities. We introduce identity-conditioned score fusion, a framework that tailors weights to each gallery identity without training. By contrasting intra-identity consistency against cross-identity impostors, it extracts identity-specific profiles that couple with query-conditioned adaptation via a parameter-free rule. This widens the separation between true and false matches while preserving score calibration. Evaluations on three clothes-changing person re-identification benchmarks show that our method consistently outperforms statistical, rank-based, and learned baselines, achieving up to an 8.8% absolute reduction in the false non-identification rate and demonstrating the value of identity-conditioned fusion in open-set person re-identification.

AI.tldr: 本文提出身份条件化分数融合框架，无需训练即可为每个底库身份定制融合权重，结合查询条件化自适应，提升开放集行人重识别性能。
AI.motivation: 现有自适应融合方法主要针对查询质量进行调节，但模型强度在不同身份之间也存在差异，这一身份维度的差异尚未被充分利用，限制了真伪匹配的区分能力。
AI.method: 提出身份条件化分数融合：通过对比身份内一致性（intra-identity consistency）与跨身份冒充者（cross-identity impostors），为每个底库身份提取身份特定融合剖面（profile），并以无参数规则与查询条件化自适应相耦合，在保持分数校准的同时扩大真伪匹配的分数间隔。
AI.result: 在三个换装行人重识别基准上，方法一致优于统计类、排序类和学习类基线，虚假未识别率（FNIR）最多实现 8.8% 的绝对下降。
AI.conclusion: 身份条件化融合在开放集行人重识别中具有重要价值，能够在不训练的前提下有效提升融合鲁棒性与匹配判别力。

title: SimCortex v2: Joint Cortical Surface Reconstruction with Near-Zero Collisions and Self-Intersections
summary: Reconstructing cortical WM and pial surfaces from structural magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) is a prerequisite for surface-based neuroanatomical analysis, yet remains challenging because the cortex is thin and tightly folded. Reconstruction methods can produce geometric artifacts such as mesh self-intersections and collisions between cortical surfaces, and although recent deep learning methods have reduced reconstruction time from hours to minutes, these artifacts persist. We propose SimCortex v2, a deep learning framework for simultaneous reconstruction of the left and right WM and pial surfaces from T1-weighted MRI. SimCortex v2 estimates topologically correct initial surfaces from a volumetric segmentation and refines all four jointly using multi-scale stationary velocity fields predicted by a ribbon-conditioned, U-Net-like network. We evaluated SimCortex v2 on 560 cases from 14 cohorts, thirteen of them unseen during training, spanning ages 6-89, healthy and clinical populations, and scanners from three vendors. SimCortex v2 matched the surface-distance accuracy of the strongest baseline (average symmetric surface distance 0.253 mm) while showing no detected inter-surface collision in 92.14% of cases and the lowest self-intersection fraction (0.044%) among learning-based methods, whereas every baseline produced at least one collision in every case. Source code, configuration files, pretrained weights, preprocessed data, and the exact evaluation splits are publicly released.

AI.tldr: SimCortex v2：从T1w MRI同时重建左右半球WM与pial表面的深度学习框架，利用多尺度平稳速度场联合精化四个表面，在大规模多队列评估中保持高精度并显著减少几何伪影。
AI.motivation: 皮层薄且折叠紧密，从结构MRI重建WM与pial表面易产生网格自相交及皮层表面间碰撞等几何伪影；深度学习方法虽将重建时间从数小时缩短至数分钟，但这些伪影依然存在。
AI.method: SimCortex v2：先由体积分割估计拓扑正确的初始表面，再通过ribbon-conditioned、类U-Net网络预测多尺度平稳速度场，对左右半球WM与pial共四个表面进行联合精化。
AI.result: 在14个队列共560例（13个训练未见队列，年龄6–89岁，含健康与临床人群，三家厂商扫描仪）上评估：表面距离精度与最强基线相当（平均对称表面距离0.253 mm），92.14%病例未检测到表面间碰撞，自相交比例最低（0.044%）；而所有基线在每例中至少产生一次碰撞。
AI.conclusion: SimCortex v2在保持与最强基线相当精度的同时有效抑制几何伪影，并公开源代码、配置、预训练权重、预处理数据与评估划分，利于可复现研究与临床应用。

title: GeoWM: Efficient Direct World Modeling in Explicit Geometry
summary: Modeling 3D scene geometry and its evolution over time is essential for autonomous driving and robotics. A common paradigm is to use world models to predict future images or latent representations of the environment and subsequently recover geometry from these predictions. However, this paradigm does not explicitly model geometric structure and typically relies on recursive rollouts to reach longer prediction horizons, leading to error accumulation and increasing computational cost. To address these limitations, we present GeoWM, a geometry world model that directly forecasts future scene geometry at specified future horizons without recursive rollout. The key idea is to leverage a geometry foundation model to transform observed RGB frames into a geometric history, which conditions a flow-matching transformer to predict the scene geometry at a specified future horizon. We further show that a lightweight camera-motion predictor can accurately estimate the future viewpoint, and that projecting the observed geometry into the predicted viewpoint provides an effective geometric prior for future geometry forecasting. Extensive experiments on four datasets spanning urban driving, aerial flight, and dynamic manipulation demonstrate that GeoWM outperforms the evaluated world models in forecasting depth, camera pose, and 3D scene geometry, while substantially reducing inference time at longer horizons.

AI.tldr: 提出GeoWM几何世界模型，直接预测指定未来时刻的场景几何，避免递归展开，在深度、相机位姿与3D几何预测上优于现有世界模型并显著降低长时域推理耗时。
AI.motivation: 自动驾驶与机器人需建模3D场景几何及其时序演化。现有范式（世界模型预测未来图像或隐表示再恢复几何）存在两个问题：未显式建模几何结构；依赖递归rollout达到长预测时域，导致误差累积与计算成本随horizon增加。
AI.method: 1) 直接预测指定未来horizon的场景几何，不做递归rollout；2) 用几何基础模型将观测RGB帧转为几何历史（geometric history）作为条件；3) 用flow-matching transformer基于该条件预测指定未来horizon的几何；4) 轻量相机运动预测器估计未来视点，并将观测几何投影到预测视点，作为未来几何预测的有效几何先验。
AI.result: 在覆盖城市驾驶、航拍飞行与动态操作的四组数据集上，GeoWM在深度、相机位姿和3D场景几何预测上优于所评估的世界模型，同时在更长预测horizon下大幅降低推理时间。
AI.conclusion: 显式几何建模结合非递归的指定horizon预测，可缓解误差累积与计算开销问题，为时空3D场景几何预测提供更准确高效的方案。

title: WildMatch: Weakly Supervised Image Matcher Adaptation for Wildlife Re-Identification
