We present MedCORE (Medical Criteria-Oriented Reasoning and Evidence), a structured diagnostic framework that operationalizes clinical reasoning within a vision-language architecture. For each input image, MedCORE decomposes the diagnostic process into clinically defined criteria, spatially localizes each criterion to diagnostically relevant image regions, encodes evidence through multi-scale representations that capture macro-structural and micro-textural pathological characteristics, and refines criterion representations using a Graph Attention Network that explicitly models inter-criteria dependencies. Criterion representations are further aligned with clinical text descriptors, reinforced through class-wise visual prototypes, and aggregated using uncertainty-calibrated weighting that proportionally discounts low-confidence diagnostic evidence. MedCORE is validated across three clinically heterogeneous imaging modalities, including dermoscopic lesion classification on ISIC 2018, breast ultrasound lesion characterization on BUSI, and diabetic retinopathy grading on IDRiD. Quantitatively, MedCORE achieves 89.2% accuracy, 85.7% macro-F1, and 96.4% AUC on ISIC 2018; 96.1% accuracy, 95.2% macro-F1, and 98.4% AUC on BUSI; and 84.3% accuracy, 80.2% macro-F1, and 92.8% AUC on IDRiD. These results demonstrate consistent improvements over strong CNN, transformer, biomedical vision-language, concept-based, and prototype-based baselines.

AI.tldr: MedCORE是一个将临床结构化推理融入视觉-语言架构的诊断框架，通过标准分解、空间定位、多尺度证据编码、图注意力建模标准间依赖、文本对齐与不确定性校准加权，在ISIC 2018、BUSI、IDRiD三个数据集上取得优于CNN、Transformer及概念/原型类基线的性能。
AI.motivation: 现有深度学习模型通常将图像特征直接映射到疾病标签，绕过了临床诊断中系统评估形态与纹理标准的结构化推理过程，导致诊断透明度不足，可能影响临床安全部署。作者希望将临床推理显式地操作化到视觉-语言模型中，提升可解释性与诊断可靠性。
AI.method: 提出MedCORE（医学标准导向推理与证据）框架，将诊断过程分解为临床定义的标准；对每个标准进行空间定位到诊断相关区域；通过多尺度表示编码宏观结构与微观纹理证据；用图注意力网络（GAT）显式建模标准间依赖以精炼表示；将标准表示与临床文本描述对齐，并以类别视觉原型强化；最后用不确定性校准加权聚合，按置信度折扣低置信证据。
AI.result: 在三种异质影像模态上验证：ISIC 2018皮肤镜病变分类达89.2%准确率、85.7% macro-F1、96.4% AUC；BUSI乳腺超声病变表征达96.1%准确率、95.2% macro-F1、98.4% AUC；IDRiD糖网分级达84.3%准确率、80.2% macro-F1、92.8% AUC，均稳定优于CNN、Transformer、生物医学视觉-语言、概念型与原型型强基线。
AI.conclusion: MedCORE通过将临床标准导向的结构化推理显式嵌入视觉-语言架构，在多种影像模态上实现一致性能提升，为诊断透明度与临床安全部署提供了可行路径。

title: Beyond Perturbation Magnitude: Direction-Dependent Responses in Multimodal Geometric Representations
comment: Submitted to IEEE Transactions on Multimedia (TMM). 12 pages, 6 figures, 3 tables
summary: Geometric alignment scores based on Gram determinants provide a compact way to model higher-order consistency among modalities, yet how such scores respond to modality degradation is poorly understood. This paper asks whether the response of a multimodal geometric score is determined primarily by the magnitude of the perturbation-induced displacement. Using frozen cohorts from MSR-VTT (N=878) and DiDeMo (N=980), we apply controlled video blur and audio noise and analyze the response in the relational geometry on which the score is defined. Displacement magnitude explains at most 15% of the out-of-sample variance in the absolute response, and magnitude-matched pairs respond systematically differently, so scalar magnitude does not organize the response. The closed-form first-order expansion of the Gramian volume yields the Directional Geometric Response (DGR): the projection of the displacement onto the local volume gradient, which jointly captures the clean operating point, displacement magnitude, and displacement direction. The absolute first-order DGR term explains the observed response with out-of-sample R^2 of 0.838-0.969, matched-magnitude ranking accuracies of 0.864-0.963, and response-sign accuracies of 0.909-0.989, whereas the tested direction-free alternatives remain weak or unstable under the corresponding evaluation protocols. A pre-specified gain-normalization candidate, V/(g_V+eps), fails its predictability and clean-order gates. DGR uses the observed degraded-state displacement and is therefore an explanatory quantity, not a deployment-time predictor: geometric response depends on where the representation operates, how far degradation moves the relational geometry, and in which direction it moves.

AI.tldr: 本文研究多模态几何一致性得分对模态退化的响应机制，提出方向性几何响应（DGR），证明响应主要由位移方向与局部体积梯度的投影决定，而非单纯的位移幅度。
AI.motivation: 基于Gram行列式的几何对齐得分可紧凑建模模态间高阶一致性，但此类得分如何响应模态退化尚不清楚。本文追问：该几何得分响应是否主要由扰动引起的位移幅度决定。
AI.method: 使用MSR-VTT（N=878）与DiDeMo（N=980）的冻结队列，施加受控视频模糊与音频噪声，分析得分所定义的关系几何响应。通过Gramian体积的闭式一阶展开导出DGR，即位移在局部体积梯度上的投影，同时纳入干净工作点、位移幅度与位移方向。并检验一个预设的增益归一化候选V/(g_V+eps)。
AI.result: 位移幅度最多解释样本外绝对响应方差的15%，幅度匹配对响应系统性不同，标量幅度无法组织响应。DGR一阶项样本外R²达0.838-0.969，幅度匹配排序准确率0.864-0.963，响应符号准确率0.909-0.989；方向无关的替代方案在同评估协议下较弱或不稳定。归一化候选V/(g_V+eps)未通过可预测性与干净顺序门槛。
AI.conclusion: 几何响应取决于表征所处的工作位置、退化使关系几何移动的距离，以及移动的方向。DGR使用观测到的退化态位移，属解释性量而非部署时预测器。

title: RSJEV: Discriminative Remote Sensing Scene Classification with Multimodal Large Language Models
summary: Remote sensing scene classification is a fundamental task in Earth observation and geospatial analysis. Existing approaches mainly follow three paradigms: task-specific visual classification, vision-language similarity matching, and autoregressive multimodal generation. However, visual classifiers rely on predefined label spaces, CLIP-based methods perform recognition through static image-text alignment, and multimodal large language models (MLLMs) introduce unnecessary token-level generation for classification tasks with explicit candidate categories. To address these limitations, we propose RSJEV, a one-pass multimodal decision framework for remote sensing scene classification. Unlike conventional MLLMs that formulate classification as autoregressive text generation, RSJEV reformulates scene classification as a candidate-conditioned multimodal discriminative decision process, where visual representations, task instructions, and candidate category semantics are jointly modeled. Specifically, we introduce a OnePass Decider that extracts multimodal decision states and directly estimates category probabilities within the candidate category space, eliminating autoregressive decoding while preserving vision-language interactions. Extensive experiments on three widely used remote sensing scene classification benchmarks, including UC Merced, AID, and NWPU-RESISC45, demonstrate that RSJEV achieves superior classification performance compared with representative CNN-, Transformer-, Mamba-, CLIP-, and MLLM-based methods. Moreover, RSJEV significantly reduces inference costs and achieves a better accuracy-efficiency trade-off with only a compact 0.8B-parameter model. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of state-conditioned multimodal decision making for efficient remote sensing image understanding. The code will be available at https://github.com/Dongtcs/RSJEV.

AI.tldr: 提出RSJEV单次多模态决策框架，将遥感场景分类重构为候选条件化多模态判别决策，用OnePass Decider直接输出类别概率，避免自回归解码，兼顾性能与效率。
AI.motivation: 现有三类遥感场景分类范式各有局限：视觉分类器依赖预定义标签空间；CLIP类方法依赖静态图文对齐；多模态大模型对已有明确候选类别的分类任务仍进行冗余的token级自回归生成，推理开销大。
AI.method: 将场景分类形式化为候选条件化多模态判别决策过程，联合建模视觉表征、任务指令与候选类别语义；设计OnePass Decider提取多模态决策状态，在候选类别空间内直接估计类别概率，取消自回归解码同时保留视觉-语言交互。
AI.result: 在UC Merced、AID、NWPU-RESISC45三个基准上优于代表性CNN、Transformer、Mamba、CLIP及MLLM方法；仅0.8B参数模型即显著降低推理成本，取得更优的精度-效率权衡。
AI.conclusion: 验证了状态条件化多模态决策在高效遥感图像理解中的有效性，为遥感场景分类提供了兼顾精度与效率的新范式。

title: Have I Seen Enough? Frozen Video-Language Models Encode Evidence Readiness
summary: Streaming video-language models must decide not only what to answer, but whether the evidence needed for the current question has arrived. Existing systems learn that decision as a separate trigger; we ask whether an unmodified model already computes it. We show that frozen VideoLLMs carry a linearly readable evidence-readiness signal, labelled from timestamped evidence rather than from model output. It decodes in all seven models of a shared byte-identical evaluation (AUROC 0.733-0.905 under the strictest not-ready sampling, where a fitted clock is near chance), and a probe fitted without any of a benchmark family's footage still reads that family. It is question-conditioned: on byte-identical windows, changing only the question reverses the readout on 66.1% of pairs, while every question-blind control is at chance by construction. The model can answer incorrectly and still encode readiness: AUROC remains 0.722 among wrong answers. Readiness also beats uncertainty estimators and their supervised combination on latency-matched answer selection, and tracks independent human judgments more closely than confidence. Released streaming triggers are also linear readouts, yet a trained trigger read on its own base model's activations is approximately orthogonal to readiness and decodes it far less accurately than a probe. We turn the readout into Readiness Gating, an answer-timing policy that improves accuracy by up to +9.75 pp at matched video duration with negligible computational overhead. How much it gains varies with the accuracy headroom the task makes available: across 26 configurations the gain tracks that headroom, and an intervention that moves it over identical pixels moves the gain with it.

AI.tldr: 冻结的VideoLLM内部已线性编码"证据就绪度"信号，该信号由带时间戳的证据标注、与问题条件相关、独立于答案正确性，可用于答案时机决策并提升准确率。
AI.motivation: 流式视频-语言模型不仅要决定回答什么，还要判断当前问题所需证据是否已到达。现有系统将这一决策学习为一个独立的触发机制（trigger），本文则追问：未经修改的模型本身是否已经计算出了这一信号。若其存在，则可避免额外的触发训练，并直接用于答案时机策略。
AI.method: 1) 用带时间戳的证据（而非模型输出）为"证据就绪度"（evidence-readiness）打标签；2) 在共享、逐字节一致的评测上对七个VideoLLM的冻结激活做线性探测；3) 检验问题条件性：在逐字节相同的窗口上仅改变问题；4) 对比就绪度与不确定性估计器及其监督式组合；5) 分析已发布流式触发器的线性可读性及其与就绪度的正交性；6) 将读出转化为Readiness Gating答案时机策略，并在26种配置及"同等像素下移动就绪度"的干预下检验增益与准确率余量的关系。
AI.result: 在七个模型中，就绪度信号均可线性解码（最严格的not-ready采样下AUROC 0.733–0.905，而拟合时钟接近随机）；在完全不含某基准家族素材情况下训练的探针仍能读出该家族。信号具有问题条件性：仅改变问题时66.1%的问题对读出反转，而所有问题盲控制按构造处于随机水平。模型可在答案错误时仍编码就绪度（错误答案中AUROC 0.722）。就绪度在延迟匹配的答案选择上优于不确定性估计器及其监督组合，且比置信度更贴近独立人类判断。已发布触发器虽亦为线性读出，但在其自身基座模型激活上近似正交于就绪度，解码精度远低于探针。Readiness Gating在同等视频时长下最高提升准确率+9.75个百分点，计算开销可忽略；26种配置中增益与任务提供的准确率余量同步变化，且同等像素上的就绪度干预会同步带动增益。
AI.conclusion: 未修改的冻结VideoLLM已内含线性可读、问题条件化的证据就绪度信号，可作为通用答案时机依据；Readiness Gating以极低开销显著提升表现，其增益取决于任务可提供的准确率余量。

title: Sparse2comm: Towards Robust Cooperative 3D Object Detection
summary: Cooperative perception improves autonomous driving by sharing complementary observations among vehicles and roadside infrastructure for 3D object detection. However, practical deployment is constrained by limited bandwidth and unreliable cooperation, where packet loss, transmission delay, and spatial misalignment jointly degrade the cooperative feature stream. Existing methods often reduce communication cost or compensate for one degradation type, leaving coupled disturbances insufficiently addressed. To address this problem, we propose Sparse2comm, a bandwidth-efficient and robust cooperative 3D object detection framework that treats unreliable cooperation as progressive restoration over degraded cooperative features. Sparse Feature Encoding first encodes communication as randomly mask-sampled foreground features transmitted by collaborating agents, from which the ego vehicle reconstructs dense semantic representations. This sparse-to-dense mechanism learns to infer missing object-centric content from sparse observations, enabling ultra-low-bandwidth communication and packet-loss recovery within the same representation. On the semantically restored features, Latency-Aware Alignment predicts motion flow to compensate delayed messages, and Self-Calibrating Fusion estimates residual spatial offsets in a self-supervised manner before adaptive cross-agent fusion. Sparse2comm therefore restores semantic completeness, temporal consistency, and spatial alignment in an ordered pipeline. Extensive experiments on DAIR-V2X, OpenV2V, and V2V4Real show that Sparse2comm maintains competitive clean accuracy and consistently improves robustness under individual and mixed real-world degradations. Compared with the selective feature communication baseline Where2comm, Sparse2comm improves mixed-setting AP@0.5/AP@0.7 by +20.15/+11.79, +12.66/+11.07, and +15.36/+12.61 on the three datasets, respectively.

AI.tldr: 提出 Sparse2comm 协同感知框架，将不可靠协同视为对退化协同特征的渐进式恢复，实现超低带宽与鲁棒 3D 检测。
AI.motivation: 协同感知可借助车路互补观测提升 3D 检测，但实际部署受带宽受限与协同不可靠制约：丢包、传输延迟与空间失配会共同退化协同特征流。现有方法多仅降低通信开销或只补偿单一退化类型，对耦合扰动处理不足。
AI.method: 框架按有序流水线恢复退化特征：1) Sparse Feature Encoding 将通信编码为随机掩码采样的前景特征，自车由此重建稠密语义表示，实现稀疏到稠密的超低带宽通信与丢包恢复；2) Latency-Aware Alignment 在语义恢复特征上预测运动流以补偿延迟消息；3) Self-Calibrating Fusion 以自监督方式估计残余空间偏移后进行自适应跨智能体融合。
AI.result: 在 DAIR-V2X、OpenV2V、V2V4Real 上，Sparse2comm 保持有竞争力的干净精度，并在单项及混合真实退化下持续提升鲁棒性。相比选择性特征通信基线 Where2comm，混合设置下 AP@0.5/AP@0.7 分别提升 +20.15/+11.79、+12.66/+11.07、+15.36/+12.61。
AI.conclusion: Sparse2comm 通过稀疏到稠密语义重建、延迟对齐与自校准融合，依次恢复语义完整性、时间一致性与空间对齐，兼顾带宽效率与对多重耦合退化的鲁棒性。

title: FedDermaSeg: Federated Learning for Dermatological Image Segmentation
summary: Skin cancer is a major global health concern, and early detection and accurate lesion delineation are important for effective diagnosis and treatment planning. Automated skin lesion analysis can assist dermatologists, with lesion segmentation serving as a fundamental step in computer-aided diagnostic systems. Conventional deep learning-based segmentation models typically rely on centralized training, where images and their corresponding segmentation masks are collected on a central server. Such data aggregation raises privacy concerns in medical applications and requires substantial centralized computational resources. To address these limitations, we investigate the feasibility of federated learning for privacy-preserving skin lesion segmentation. The training and validation sets of the ISIC 2018 Skin Lesion Segmentation Challenge dataset are used to simulate a distributed learning environment and develop a federated segmentation model. The resulting model is evaluated on the ISIC 2018 test set and the PH2 dataset to assess its performance and generalizability. Experimental results demonstrate that the federated model achieves performance comparable to centralized training while consistently improving upon the locally trained models. These findings demonstrate the potential of federated learning for collaborative skin lesion segmentation without requiring centralized aggregation of medical images.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了联邦学习在皮肤病变分割中的可行性，验证其在保护隐私的前提下可获得与集中式训练相当的性能，并优于单机本地训练。
AI.motivation: 皮肤癌早期检测与病变边界准确勾画对诊疗至关重要，病变分割是计算机辅助诊断的基础步骤。传统深度学习分割模型依赖集中式训练，需将图像与分割掩码汇聚至中心服务器，这在医学应用中引发隐私问题，且需要大量集中式计算资源。
AI.method: 采用 ISIC 2018 皮肤病变分割挑战赛的训练集与验证集模拟分布式学习环境，构建联邦分割模型，并在 ISIC 2018 测试集与 PH2 数据集上评估其性能与泛化能力。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，联邦模型性能与集中式训练相当，同时持续优于各本地单独训练的模型。
AI.conclusion: 联邦学习在无需集中汇聚医学图像的情况下具备协同皮肤病变分割的潜力，为隐私保护下的协作建模提供了可行路径。

title: LiDAR Resolution Recovery via Foundation-Model-Guided Diffusion
summary: High-beam-count LiDAR sensors are costly, yet many perception pipelines require dense angular sampling. Using a pretrained Stable Diffusion model as the backbone, we fine-tune a LiDAR-conditioned depth model with pseudo-depth targets from a 2D foundation model. During training, the LiDAR conditioning is randomly decimated at different beam budgets. We then investigate how much of a LiDAR scan can be recovered from heavily decimated input and characterize performance across the input beam budget. We evaluate against physically held-out real beams on nuScenes and report recovery separately from fit accuracy. Our model yields its largest advantage in very sparse regimes, achieving a $δ_{1.25}$ accuracy of $66.8$% from $4$-beam input where scattered interpolation reaches only $45.1$%. A class-stratified error breakdown further reveals that planar surfaces recover first while objects introducing depth discontinuities degrade earliest. Together, these results quantify the recovery/resolution trade-off for foundation-model-guided LiDAR enhancement.

AI.tldr: 以预训练Stable Diffusion为骨干、用2D基础模型伪深度微调LiDAR条件深度模型，随机抽稀LiDAR条件以研究稀疏预算下的扫描恢复能力；在nuScenes上用物理留出真实光束评估，4束输入下δ1.25达66.8%，显著优于散射插值45.1%。
AI.motivation: 高线束LiDAR成本高，但感知流水线常需密集角度采样，因此需探索能否从严重稀疏的LiDAR输入中恢复扫描密度，并量化恢复精度与分辨率（束预算）之间的权衡。
AI.method: 以预训练Stable Diffusion为骨干，构建LiDAR条件深度模型，并用2D基础模型生成的伪深度作为监督目标进行微调；训练时对LiDAR条件在不同束预算下随机抽稀（decimation），并在nuScenes上按物理留出的真实光束评估，将“恢复能力”与“拟合精度”分开报告。
AI.result: 在极稀疏区间优势最大：4束输入时δ1.25准确率为66.8%，而散射插值仅45.1%；按类别分层误差显示平面表面最先恢复，引入深度不连续性的物体最早退化。
AI.conclusion: 结果量化了基础模型引导的LiDAR增强中的“恢复/分辨率”权衡，表明该类方法在极端稀疏条件下具有明显优势，但其收益随物体深度不连续性增强而下降。

title: Forensic Reserve: Eliciting Latent Knowledge for Image Forgery Detection
summary: As generated images become increasingly realistic, reliable forgery detection is essential for maintaining trust in visual information. However, existing methods primarily rely on task-specific supervision to adapt vision foundation model representations, without fully exploiting internal forensic knowledge to guide detection. To address this limitation, we propose Reserve-Guided Elicitation (RGE), a framework that treats sparse, origin-sensitive internal components in pretrained models as a forensic reserve and translates their localization into structural constraints for lightweight adaptation. Specifically, we first use the Forensic Lens (F-lens) to decompose activations across layers and token groups into independent components and globally screen them by their response differences between real and generated images, identifying reserve sites and directions. Next, we map the selected directions back to hidden-state space to construct fixed reserve subspaces and insert Forensic Reserve Adapters (FRA) only at the identified sites. Finally, with the backbone parameters, previously fitted reference classifier, and subspace bases fixed, we train only the FRA coefficient maps to generate input-dependent residual updates constrained to the corresponding subspaces, strengthening existing forensic responses. Using only 500 labeled training images and a trainable parameter budget below 0.2% of the backbone, RGE achieves competitive performance across three detection benchmarks without target-benchmark adaptation. Furthermore, RGE consistently improves over the corresponding frozen detectors across eight encoders spanning self-supervised and vision-language pretraining, eliciting a latent forensic capacity broadly shared across pretrained vision models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Reserve-Guided Elicitation (RGE)框架，将预训练模型中稀疏、对来源敏感的内部组件视为“取证储备”，通过定位并施加结构化约束实现轻量适配，在极少样本与参数下取得优异生成图像伪造检测性能。
AI.motivation: 生成图像日益逼真，可靠伪造检测对维护视觉信息可信度至关重要。但现有方法主要依赖任务特定监督来适配视觉基础模型表征，未充分利用模型内部固有的取证知识来引导检测。
AI.method: 提出RGE框架：先用Forensic Lens (F-lens)将各层与token组的激活分解为独立组件，并依真实/生成图像间的响应差异全局筛选出储备位点与方向；再将选中方向映射回隐状态空间构建固定储备子空间，仅在识别位点插入Forensic Reserve Adapters (FRA)；冻结骨干参数、已拟合参考分类器与子空间基，仅训练FRA系数图，生成受子空间约束、输入相关的残差更新以增强既有取证响应。
AI.result: 仅用500张带标签训练图像、可训练参数低于骨干0.2%，在三个检测基准上无需目标基准适配即达竞争性性能；在涵盖自监督与视觉-语言预训练的八个编码器上，RGE均稳定优于对应的冻结检测器。
AI.conclusion: RGE能够激发预训练视觉模型中广泛共享的潜在取证能力，为生成图像伪造检测提供一种高效、可泛化的轻量适配范式。

title: Stable Scores, Unstable Answers: Frame Phase and Option Order in Video Multiple-Choice Evaluation
summary: Video-language models are ranked by multiple-choice accuracy on frames from a uniform grid. The grid has two parameters, a rate and a phase, and benchmarks report only the rate. The phase moves answers: two deployed samplers differing only by a half-step phase offset answer 23.6% of questions differently while scoring within a point, and across four releases from two families shifting only the phase changes roughly one answer in five after controlling option order. PHASEFUSION decodes three offset grids and averages the option posteriors. The grids are the polyphase components of the dense grid. Fusion matches a 32-frame single pass in accuracy within a prespecified margin (logit-scored) and cuts the answers a half-step shift of all three grids changes from 18.2% to 10.1%. Option order, which changes only the presentation, is flagged instead by a one-pass answer margin. Report the phase convention with the budget, or marginalize it.

AI.tldr: 视频语言模型在均匀网格帧上按多项选择准确率排名，但基准只报告采样率，忽略相位。相位偏移会使答案改变（半相位差的两个采样器有23.6%答案不同而总分相近）。PHASEFUSION解码三个偏移网格并平均选项后验，在预设误差范围内匹配32帧单次效果，将半相位变化率从18.2%降至10.1%。应将相位约定与预算同时报告，或对其边缘化。
AI.motivation: 现有视频语言模型基准仅报告帧采样率，而忽略相位这一参数。相位尽管不影响总分，却显著改变具体答案（半相位偏移导致23.6%问题答案不同），使得排名与结论不可比且不稳定，因此需要明确相位约定或对其进行边缘化。
AI.method: 提出PHASEFUSION：将均匀网格视为多相分解，解码三个相位偏移的网格，并对各网格的选项后验进行平均（融合）。同时用单次推理的答案margin来标记仅由选项顺序（呈现方式）引起的变化。
AI.result: 相位偏移在控制选项顺序后仍改变约五分之一的答案；两个仅差半相位、得分在1分以内的采样器有23.6%的答案不同。PHASEFUSION在预设误差范围内（logit评分）匹配32帧单次推理的准确率，并将半相位偏移导致答案改变的比例从18.2%降至10.1%。选项顺序的影响则可由单次答案margin标记。
AI.conclusion: 帧采样相位是影响视频语言模型基准答案分布的关键但被忽视的变量。应同时报告相位约定与采样预算，或通过PHASEFUSION等多相融合方式对相位进行边缘化，以保证评估的稳健性与可比性。

title: Selective Transfer of RL Updates for Visual Reasoning
summary: Model merging provides a training-free way to transfer reasoning capabilities from language models to vision-language models (VLMs), but endpoint-based transfer can conflate pre-existing model differences with changes acquired during reasoning post-training. We instead formulate capability transfer around the training-stage update, isolating the parameter changes induced by reinforcement learning (RL). Yet transferring this update in full remains suboptimal: we find that its components differ substantially in cross-model transferability, with dominant directions transferring more effectively than the complete update. Based on this finding, we introduce Selective-RL, which isolates the RL-stage update, retains its dominant matrix-wise directions with magnitude preservation, and transfers them to the language modules of a VLM. Across three model families and five visual-reasoning benchmarks, Selective-RL improves full-update interpolation in 12 of 15 comparisons, including an 8.55 percentage-point MathVision gain on the Qwen recipient. Matched controls show that update magnitude or arbitrary low rank alone does not reproduce these gains. These results highlight a distinction between what is acquired during post-training and what remains transferable across models, providing a training-stage perspective on cross-model capability transfer. Code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/selective-rl.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 Selective-RL：以训练阶段为切入，将 RL 后训练产生的参数更新从语言模型迁移到视觉语言模型（VLM），并只保留主导矩阵方向、保持幅度，从而在 15 项对比中 12 项优于全量更新插值。
AI.motivation: 现有基于端点的模型合并虽可免训练地迁移推理能力，但会把模型既有差异与推理后训练带来的变化混在一起，难以评估"后训练到底带来了什么、其中什么可迁移"。作者希望围绕训练阶段的更新（尤其是 RL 引起的参数变化）来定义能力迁移，以获得更干净的迁移信号。
AI.method: 先隔离 RL 后训练阶段的参数更新。观察到该更新的各成分跨模型可迁移性差异显著，主导方向比完整更新更易迁移。据此提出 Selective-RL：保留 RL 更新的矩阵级主导方向并保持其幅度，再迁移到 VLM 的语言模块中。
AI.result: 在 3 个模型家族、5 个视觉推理基准上，Selective-RL 在 15 项比较中的 12 项优于全量更新插值；在 Qwen 接收模型上 MathVision 提升 8.55 个百分点。匹配对照表明，仅靠更新幅度或任意低秩近似无法复现该增益。
AI.conclusion: 结果揭示了"后训练所习得的能力"与"跨模型仍然可迁移的能力"之间的区别，为跨模型能力迁移提供了训练阶段视角：选择性地迁移 RL 更新的主导方向比整体迁移更有效。

title: Knowing When to Trust a Prior: Reliability-Gated Cue Fusion for Video Gaze Prediction
summary: Video gaze prediction is led by gaze-trained models, yet gaze-free priors carry signal those models have not absorbed, if one knows when to trust them. We propose FocusGate, a gated ensemble of gaze-free priors whose members may abstain. A per-frame gate reads three shape statistics of a defocus map and selects the frames on which the estimator is above chance on average, so rejected frames reduce to the base exactly, while midrank normalisation lets an all-zero prior abstain at zero parameters. Gated fusion is significantly positive on film, sports and web video, whereas unconditional fusion is harmful on sports and null on web. Added to four supervised predictors, the NTIRE 2026 champion among them, FocusGate improves all sixteen model-domain cells in shuffled AUC, fifteen significantly, one domain pre-registered and scored once, while adding only 1% to the champion's latency. Alone, it surpasses TASED-Net and UNISAL in shuffled AUC on film with a 16-frame causal mean.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 FocusGate——一种带门控的免注视先验集成方法，通过逐帧门控决定是否信任免注视先验，从而在不依赖注视训练的前提下提升视频注视预测性能。
AI.motivation: 现有视频注视预测主要由注视训练模型主导，而免注视先验中蕴含这些模型尚未吸收的信号；但关键在于知道何时该信任这些先验，因此需要一种能够选择性采纳先验的机制。
AI.method: FocusGate 是一个成员可弃权的免注视先验门控集成。逐帧门控读取散焦图的三个形状统计量，仅在估计器平均表现高于随机水平的帧上加以选用，被拒绝的帧则精确退化为基线；同时采用中秩归一化，使全零先验能以零参数实现弃权。研究对比了门控融合与无条件融合，并将 FocusGate 加入四个有监督预测器（含 NTIRE 2026 冠军模型）。
AI.result: 门控融合在电影、体育和网络视频上均显著为正，而无条件融合在体育上有害、在网络上无效。加入四个有监督预测器后，FocusGate 在全部十六个模型-领域组合上提升 shuffled AUC，其中十五个显著，一个领域为预注册单次评分；仅增加冠军模型 1% 的延迟。单独使用时，在电影领域以 16 帧因果均值超越 TASED-Net 和 UNISAL 的 shuffled AUC。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，免注视先验在恰当门控下可有效补充有监督注视预测模型，FocusGate 以极低的额外开销带来一致且显著的性能提升，验证了"知道何时信任先验"这一核心思路的有效性。

title: PDB: Point-Based Deformation Blending for Facial Animation Retargeting
summary: Mesh-agnostic facial animation retargeting transfers expressions across meshes with different structures, but preserving facial motion without surface artifacts remains challenging. To address this, we present PDB, Point-Based Deformation Blending for facial animation retargeting. PDB predicts a compact set of deformed control points from a source neutral-expression pair and blending weights from the target neutral mesh. The weights are computed once per target and reused across frames, while the control points vary with each source expression. ReLU enforces non-negative weights and permits exact zeros, followed by row-wise normalization. The target mesh is reconstructed directly by multiplying the weights and control points, without a predefined cage, precomputed coordinates, a learned per-element deformation decoder, or a global reconstruction solve. Trained only with self-retargeting reconstruction supervision, PDB supports cross-identity transfer without paired cross-identity training expressions. Experiments demonstrate accurate retargeting, fast inference, and localized support in the learned weights. Joint evaluation of expression accuracy and local surface preservation shows reduced surface artifacts relative to the evaluated dense displacement method while retaining the intended motion. Perceptual evaluations further support expression fidelity and visual quality in both self- and cross-retargeting.

AI.tldr: 提出PDB（基于点的变形混合）方法，实现跨不同网格结构的面部动画重定向，无需预定义笼子或预计算坐标，兼顾表情精度与局部表面保真。
AI.motivation: 面部动画重定向需在不同结构网格间传递表情，但既要保留面部运动又避免表面伪影较为困难；现有方法依赖预定义笼形结构、预计算坐标或学习式逐元素变形解码器，限制较大。
AI.method: PDB从源中性-表情对预测一组紧凑的变形控制点，并从目标中性网格预测混合权重。权重对每个目标仅计算一次并在各帧复用，控制点随源表情变化。用ReLU约束权重非负并允许精确零值，随后按行归一化。目标网格通过权重与控制点相乘直接重建，无需预定义笼子、预计算坐标、学习式逐元素变形解码器或全局重建求解。训练仅用自重定向重建监督。
AI.result: 实验显示重定向准确、推理快速，学习到的权重具有局部支持性；在表情精度与局部表面保持的联合评估中，相较所评估的稠密位移方法减少了表面伪影，同时保留了预期运动；感知评估也支持自重定向与跨重定向下的表情保真度与视觉质量。
AI.conclusion: PDB以轻量、无需配对跨身份训练的方式实现网格无关的面部动画重定向，在准确性与表面质量间取得较好平衡，具备快速推理优势。

title: EC-RAG: Event Chain Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Long Video Understanding
comment: 12 pages, 7 figures, 7 tables, including supplementary material
summary: Current large video-language models (LVLMs) still face challenges when dealing with long videos, mainly because frames are often processed independently, making it difficult to capture temporal dependencies across events. Although retrieval-augmented approaches have been introduced to provide additional context, most of them operate at the frame or snippet level, which limits their ability to model how events evolve over time and relate to each other. In this paper, we propose Event Chain Retrieval-Augmented Generation (EC-RAG), a training-free framework that organizes video content into an explicit event chain before question answering. Instead of retrieving isolated frames or text segments, EC-RAG first partitions the video into semantically coherent segments, represents each segment using multi-modal signals, and then links them into a structured chain that preserves temporal order and captures inter-event relationships. Given a query, the system identifies relevant events within this chain and gathers supporting evidence from the associated modalities. Our approach offers several practical advantages: (i) event-level abstraction that better reflects how video content is naturally structured, enabling more reliable localization compared to frame-level retrieval; (ii) structured multi-modal fusion that aggregates speech, text, and visual cues at the event level, allowing complementary information to be more effectively utilized during reasoning; and (iii) plug-and-play compatibility with existing LVLM backbones, requiring no additional training or reliance on proprietary models. Experiments on Video-MME, MLVU, and LongVideoBench show that this event-centric design consistently outperforms frame-level retrieval baselines, highlighting the importance of modeling temporal structure for long-video understanding.

AI.tldr: 本文提出免训练框架EC-RAG，将视频组织为事件链进行检索增强生成，在长视频理解任务上超越帧级检索基线。
AI.motivation: 现有大型视频语言模型处理长视频时，帧通常被独立处理，难以捕捉跨事件的时间依赖；已有的检索增强方法多在帧或片段级别操作，限制了对事件演化与相互关系的建模能力。
AI.method: EC-RAG为免训练框架：先将视频划分为语义连贯的片段，用多模态信号表示每个片段，再按时间顺序链接为结构化事件链，保留事件间关系；给定查询时，在链中定位相关事件并从关联模态中收集支撑证据。
AI.result: 在Video-MME、MLVU和LongVideoBench上，该事件中心设计一致优于帧级检索基线。
AI.conclusion: 事件级抽象、结构化多模态融合与即插即用兼容性验证了对时间结构建模对长视频理解的重要性。

title: RenderBench: Benchmarking Render-to-Real Video Transfer with Reconstructed Digital Twins
summary: Modern video models can generate realistic videos from real appearance references and proxy renders that specify scene structure, viewpoint changes, and motion. Evaluating this render-to-real capability requires a real target video depicting the same scene evolution, paired with an editable, geometrically registered 3D replica. Such data has traditionally required substantial manual modeling, calibration, and animation effort. We introduce RenderBench, a benchmark of 12 reconstructed real-world scenes spanning large-scale indoor environments and egocentric viewpoints, with both static and dynamic settings. Our construction pipeline combines visual geometry, neural reconstruction, and assisted 3D authoring. Each scene is decomposed into static objects and dynamic actors, registered to the capture cameras, and accepted only after multi-view geometric and temporal validation. Each evaluation unit contains appearance reference images, a held-out real target video, an editable digital twin, a matched proxy render, and renderer-native scene annotations. We evaluate transfer models against paired real target videos, retain PAI-Bench-C-compatible structural projections, and use scene annotations to localize failures by object, visibility, articulation, and motion. The first release retains 12 of 14 registered samples (85.7%), comprising 1,496 paired real-proxy frames. All released scenes pass file-integrity and environment-edit audits, while proxy diagnostics yield a depth si-RMSE of 0.2170 and instance mIoU of 0.3673. RenderBench provides paired real observations and editable scene state for assessing both appearance fidelity and preservation of geometry and dynamics.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 RenderBench，一个包含12个重建真实场景的渲染到真实（render-to-real）生成评估基准，涵盖大规模室内与第一人称视角、静态与动态设置，每单元含外观参考、真实目标视频、可编辑数字孪生、匹配代理渲染及场景标注。
AI.motivation: 评估视频模型的 render-to-real 能力需要同时具备描述相同场景演化的真实目标视频与可编辑、几何配准的3D复制品。这类数据传统上依赖大量人工建模、标定与动画制作，成本高昂且缺乏标准化资源。
AI.method: 构建流程融合视觉几何、神经重建与辅助式3D创作：将每个场景分解为静态物体与动态主体，配准到采集相机，并须通过多视图几何与时序验证方可纳入。每个评测单元包含外观参考图像、留出的真实目标视频、可编辑数字孪生、匹配的代理渲染以及渲染器原生场景标注。
AI.result: 首个版本保留14个配准样本中的12个（85.7%），共1,496对真实-代理帧。所有发布场景通过文件完整性与环境编辑审计；代理诊断得到深度 si-RMSE 为 0.2170，实例 mIoU 为 0.3673。
AI.conclusion: RenderBench 提供配对的真实观测与可编辑场景状态，可用于评估外观保真度以及几何与动态的保持程度；同时通过保留 PAI-Bench-C 兼容的结构投影与场景标注，支持按物体、可见性、关节与运动维度定位失败。

title: SpaTime: Streaming Vision-Language Models for Spatio-temporal Reasoning
summary: Embodied agents must reason about 3D space while the video is still arriving, answering questions as soon as they have observed enough of the scene. VLMs that incorporate 3D geometric priors achieve strong spatial reasoning, but they operate offline, i.e., the full video must be available before they produce an answer. Streaming VLMs process frames causally and decide for themselves when to respond, yet they lack explicit 3D representations. We present SpaTime, a streaming VLM that fuses causal geometry tokens into the language model at every frame, using only the frames observed so far. To supervise when the model answers, we propose a response-time loss that maps per-frame response probabilities to a differentiable expected response time and penalizes the distance from the ground-truth frame. For evaluation, we construct StreamVSTI-Bench and StreamVSI-Bench, streaming adaptations of VSTI-Bench and VSI-Bench. On StreamVSTI-Bench, SpaTime reaches 49.2% overall accuracy and reduces the mean response-time error by 66% relative to the strongest streaming baseline.

AI.tldr: SpaTime是一种流式VLM，在每帧将因果几何token融合进语言模型，并用响应时间损失监督何时作答，在流式空间推理基准上取得49.2%准确率并将平均响应时间误差降低66%。
AI.motivation: 具身智能体需在视频流到达过程中进行3D空间推理，并在观察足够后立即作答。现有含3D几何先验的VLM空间推理强但只能离线运行；流式VLM可因果处理帧并自主决定何时响应，却缺乏显式3D表示。
AI.method: 提出SpaTime，一种流式VLM，在每帧仅用已观测帧，将因果几何token融合进语言模型；并提出响应时间损失，将逐帧响应概率映射为可微的期望响应时间，惩罚其与真值帧的距离。同时构建流式基准StreamVSTI-Bench与StreamVSI-Bench。
AI.result: 在StreamVSTI-Bench上，SpaTime总体准确率达49.2%，相对最强流式基线平均响应时间误差降低66%。
AI.conclusion: SpaTime将显式3D几何先验与流式处理结合，并通过可微响应时间损失实现自主且及时的回答，在流式空间推理任务上兼顾准确率与响应及时性。

title: Co-Evolving Paths and Flows via Path-Flow Alignment
summary: We study path-flow alignment as a unified training objective for flow matching. Instead of fixing the interpolation path and learning only the velocity field, we jointly train an endpoint-preserving path network and a flow network using the same alignment loss: the flow learns to match the path velocity, and the path learns to align its velocity to the current flow. Although every fixed learned path defines a valid flow-matching objective, the alignment loss alone is not a reliable criterion for path learning. We identify path overfitting, a failure mode in which the alignment loss decreases while sample quality worsens. We find that this failure is associated with low-entropy bottlenecks in the induced probability path, where the learned path routes samples through overly concentrated intermediate marginals. Motivated by this diagnosis, we introduce a stochastic path regularizer that hides part of the source information from the path network while preserving exact endpoints. The resulting regularization gives an explicit entropy floor for the stochastic training-path marginals and empirically suppresses the bottleneck in the learned sampler, making joint path-flow training effective. On ImageNet-256x256 with SiT backbones, our method consistently improves FID across model scales, extends to model-guidance training, and leaves the inference-time architecture and sampler unchanged. Code is available at https://github.com/lizeyu090312/traj_opt_paper

AI.tldr: 本文提出将路径-流对齐作为流匹配的统一训练目标，联合训练保持端点的路径网络与流网络，并针对路径过拟合问题引入随机路径正则化，在ImageNet-256×256上稳定提升FID。
AI.motivation: 传统流匹配固定插值路径、仅学习速度场，路径选择本身未被优化；作者希望让路径与流在同一对齐损失下联合学习，但发现单纯对齐损失并不能可靠指导路径学习，存在“路径过拟合”失效模式。
AI.method: 1) 统一训练目标：同步训练端点保持的路径网络与流网络，同一对齐损失下流匹配路径速度、路径对齐当前流；2) 诊断：路径过拟合源于诱导概率路径中的低熵瓶颈，即学习路径使中间边缘分布过度集中；3) 正则化：提出随机路径正则器，在保持精确端点的前提下对路径网络隐藏部分源信息，为随机训练路径边缘分布提供显式熵下界，抑制瓶颈。
AI.result: 在ImageNet-256×256与SiT主干上，方法在不同模型规模下一致提升FID，可扩展至model-guidance训练，且不改变推理期架构与采样器。
AI.conclusion: 路径-流联合训练的有效性依赖于对路径熵的显式正则；随机路径正则化通过设定熵下界消除低熵瓶颈，使联合路径-流训练真正有效，并可作为即插即用改进。

title: Post-Training Semantic Lifting for 3D Gaussian Splatting: Separating Detector, Lifting and Representation Error
summary: The same Gaussian of a 3D Gaussian Splatting model is seen from many views, and these views do not always agree on the class it belongs to. The Gaussian may be occluded in some of them, and the confidence of the detector is not the same from one view to another. The ground truth, on the other hand, is given as an annotated mesh, because two training runs do not produce the same Gaussians. In this work, we propose a post-training lifting method that works with one target class at a time and combines the information coming from all the views. Target and non-target evidence are accumulated simultaneously, weighted by the visibility of each Gaussian in each view. After that, the Gaussians are filtered with two thresholds: a main threshold $β$ selects the high-confidence seeds, and a lower one $γβ$ adds the connected components around them. For the evaluation, the labels are transferred from the Gaussians to the mesh vertices that are both visible and annotated. With this design, we can separate three sources of error: the 2D detector, the lifting and the transfer between representations. The thresholds and the transfer operator are chosen on seven Replica validation scenes, and the method is evaluated on ten held-out ScanNet++ scenes with the same values for every scene and class. The mean mIoU on the validation scenes was 0.93 with masks from the dataset annotations and 0.65 with YOLO masks, and on the ScanNet++ test scenes it was 0.80 and 0.54. Compared with thresholding the evidence per view, as a previous version of the method did, the fraction improves the test mIoU by 0.24 and makes it possible to use a single threshold for all the classes and scenes of both datasets. Finally, the error analysis shows that most of the remaining error comes from the detector.

AI.tldr: 提出一种后训练提升(lifting)方法，将3D高斯Splatting模型中同一高斯在多个视图下的检测证据按可见性加权累积，再用双阈值($\beta$与$\gamma\beta$)过滤高斯，并将标签从高斯转移到可见且已标注的网格顶点以评估，从而可分离2D检测器、提升过程和表示转移三类误差来源。
AI.motivation: 同一3D高斯在多个视图中被观测到，但各视图对其类别判定不一致：高斯可能被遮挡，检测器置信度也随视图变化；同时真值以标注网格给出，而两次训练产生的高斯并不相同，因此需要一个能融合所有视图信息、并与网格真值对齐的后处理提升方法。
AI.method: 1) 后训练提升方法，每次处理一个目标类别；2) 同时累积目标与非目标证据，按每个高斯在各视图中的可见性加权；3) 用双阈值过滤高斯：主阈值$\beta$选取高置信种子，较低阈值$\gamma\beta$补入其周围连通分量；4) 评估时将标签从高斯转移到既可见又被标注的网格顶点；5) 阈值与转移算子在Replica验证场景上选取，并在ScanNet++留出场景上以相同参数跨场景、跨类别评估。
AI.result: 验证场景平均mIoU：使用数据集标注掩码为0.93，使用YOLO掩码为0.65；ScanNet++测试场景分别为0.80和0.54。相比以往按视图对证据做阈值化的版本，该方法将测试mIoU提升0.24，并使得两个数据集所有类别与场景可共用单一阈值。误差分析表明剩余误差主要来自检测器。
AI.conclusion: 跨视图累积并按可见性加权的证据融合配合双阈值过滤，显著优于逐视图阈值化，且能以统一参数跨场景、跨类别泛化；误差分解显示主要瓶颈在2D检测器，而非提升或标签转移环节。

title: Data Leakage in Patch-Based Hyperspectral Image Classification: Quantifying the Impact of Spatial Overlap
comment: paper accepted for presentation at IEEE-WHISPERS
summary: Patch-based learning improves hyperspectral image (HSI) classification by exploiting local spectral-spatial information, but random train-test sampling from the same image can cause spatial patch overlap, leading to data leakage and optimistic performance estimates. This paper investigates same-class train-test spatial overlap in patch-based HSI classification using two measures: overlap percentage (OP), which quantifies the global amount of overlapped testing patch pixels, and average overlap ratio (AOR), which measures the local severity among affected testing patches. Experiments on the Pavia University dataset compare random and non-random spatial sampling using SVM, MLP, 2D-CNN, 3D-CNN, ViT, and MorpMamba. The results show that deep patch-based models achieve high accuracy under random sampling, with 3D-CNN reaching 96.17% Overall Accuracy (OA), but drop substantially under non-random spatial sampling, where 3D-CNN decreases to 55.20% and ViT and 2D-CNN drop by 40.71 and 38.81 percentage points (PP), respectively. Patch-size analysis further shows that increasing the patch size from 5x5 to 19x19 raises the random-sampling overlap percentage from 23.28% to 77.02%. These findings demonstrate that random patch-based evaluation can substantially inflate classification performance, especially for models that strongly exploit spatial context. The code associated with this paper is available at: https://github.com/mqalkhatib/Data_Leakage_in_HSI_Classification.

AI.tldr: 该论文揭示基于patch的高光谱图像分类中，随机训练-测试采样会导致同类别空间重叠，造成数据泄漏并高估性能；通过OP和AOR两种指标量化，实验证明深度模型在非随机采样下性能大幅下降。
AI.motivation: 基于patch的学习利用局部光谱-空间信息提升HSI分类性能，但若从同一图像中随机划分训练/测试样本，会产生空间patch重叠，导致数据泄漏与过于乐观的性能估计。作者旨在系统研究这一同类别训练-测试空间重叠问题的严重性及其对评测的影响。
AI.method: 提出两种度量：重叠百分比（OP）用于量化全局被重叠的测试patch像素比例；平均重叠比率（AOR）用于衡量受影响测试patch的局部重叠严重程度。在Pavia University数据集上，采用SVM、MLP、2D-CNN、3D-CNN、ViT与MorpMamba，对比随机与非随机空间采样的表现，并进行patch尺寸分析（5x5至19x19）。
AI.result: 随机采样下深度patch模型精度很高，3D-CNN达96.17% OA；非随机空间采样下性能显著下降，3D-CNN降至55.20%，ViT与2D-CNN分别下降40.71与38.81个百分点。patch尺寸从5x5增至19x19时，随机采样重叠百分比由23.28%升至77.02%。
AI.conclusion: 随机patch评测会显著抬高分类性能，尤其对强依赖空间上下文的模型影响更大，说明此类评测结果存在系统性偏差，应谨慎采用并优先考虑非随机空间划分策略。

title: Backend-Agnostic Sparse Attention for Fast High-Resolution Visual Generation
summary: Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) have achieved strong performance in image and video generation, but the quadratic complexity of full attention makes high-resolution generation computationally expensive. Window attention offers an efficient alternative, yet existing methods face a practical trade-off: partitioned window attention typically achieves computational efficiency consistent with its theoretical complexity. However, isolated windows block cross-window interaction, often introducing visible grid-like artifacts in the generated results. Fine-grained sliding-window attention effectively restores interactions across neighboring windows and improves visual quality. However, its irregular computation patterns create a substantial gap between theoretical and practical speedups and require specialized kernels tailored to each hardware backend. To tackle these challenges, we propose BASA, a backend-agnostic sparse attention, which brings the best of both worlds: visual quality and practical acceleration. Specifically, BASA replaces visual self-attention with shifted local-window attention. By introducing a structured window-shifting scheme across DiT blocks, we allow tokens divided by window boundaries in one layer to communicate in the following layers, thereby achieving global information exchange and eliminating window-induced visual artifacts. Notably, our design introduces no additional irregular operators or customized kernels, making it readily deployable on existing attention backends and closing the gap between theoretical sparsity and practical acceleration. Experiments demonstrate that BASA achieves measured speedups exceeding 90\% of the theoretical estimates on FLUX and delivers a 4.52$\times$ attention speedup on Wan while maintaining competitive generation quality.

AI.tldr: 本文提出BASA，一种后端无关的稀疏注意力机制，通过跨DiT块的结构化窗口移位方案，兼得视觉质量与实际加速。
AI.motivation: 扩散Transformer（DiTs）在全注意力下具有二次复杂度，导致高分辨率生成代价高昂。现有方案存在权衡：分区窗口注意力虽计算高效但阻断跨窗口交互，产生网格状伪影；细粒度滑动窗口注意力虽改善视觉质量，但计算不规则，理论加速与实际加速差距大且需针对硬件的专用内核。
AI.method: BASA用移位局部窗口注意力替代视觉自注意力，在DiT块间引入结构化窗口移位方案，使某层被窗口边界分隔的token在后续层中得以通信，实现全局信息交换并消除窗口伪影；设计不引入额外不规则算子或定制内核，可部署于现有注意力后端。
AI.result: 在FLUX上实现超过理论估计90%的实测加速，在Wan上实现4.52×注意力加速，同时保持有竞争力的生成质量。
AI.conclusion: BASA弥合了理论稀疏性与实际加速之间的差距，同时兼顾视觉质量与实际加速，具备后端无关、易于部署的优势。

title: CtrlCache: Accelerating Interactive Video World Models with Control-Aware Caching
summary: Interactive video world models need to generate each video chunk efficiently while responding faithfully to user controls. Many systems use chunk-wise autoregressive generation with few-step denoising, but each chunk still requires several costly denoising iterations. Training-free caching can reduce this cost, yet existing policies make reuse decisions primarily from model-internal denoising dynamics and do not explicitly account for control transitions. Actually, interactive generation explicitly exposes a signal they do not use: the controls for a chunk arrive before it is denoised, so a schedule derived from them costs no forward pass. To this end, we analyze adjacent chunks under different control regimes and find that structural similarity drops around action changes, while low-frequency structure remains more persistent than high-frequency detail. Motivated by these observations, we propose CtrlCache, a training-free control-aware caching framework that adapts computation to the current control sequence. Specifically, the action-aware scheduling and refresh policy detects action changes across and within chunks, and labels each chunk as initial, transition, turning, or steady state. At one selected interior denoising step, initial and transition chunks retain full computation, while turning and steady chunks reuse the transformer residual from the most recent fully computed step in the same chunk. To exploit the persistence of low-frequency structure during steady interaction, we further introduce a frequency-mixed history prior guidance that incorporates complementary information from the preceding clean latent without an additional DiT forward pass. Evaluated on Matrix-Game 2.0 and LingBot-World v1/v2, CtrlCache achieves 1.21x to 1.41x DiT-backbone speedups without model retraining while improving WBench Overall scores over original inference across all three models.

AI.tldr: 提出CtrlCache：一种免训练、控制感知的缓存框架，利用动作控制信号调度去噪计算，在交互式视频世界模型中实现1.21x-1.41x加速且提升生成质量。
AI.motivation: 交互式视频世界模型需高效生成视频块并忠实响应用户控制。分块自回归+少步去噪仍逐块多次迭代，成本高。现有免训练缓存仅依赖模型内部去噪动态做复用决策，未显式考虑控制变化；而交互生成中控制信号在去噪前到达，是可利用的免前向传播信号。
AI.method: 分析相邻块在不同控制状态下的相似性（动作变化处结构相似性下降，低频结构比高频细节更持久）。据此设计CtrlCache：（1）动作感知调度与刷新策略——跨块及块内检测动作变化，将块标为初始、过渡、转向、稳态四类；在选定内部去噪步，初始与过渡块保持全计算，转向与稳态块复用同块内最近全计算步的transformer残差。（2）频率混合历史先验引导——利用稳态交互中低频结构的持久性，从上一干净潜变量引入互补信息，无需额外DiT前向。
AI.result: 在Matrix-Game 2.0及LingBot-World v1/v2上评估，DiT主干加速1.21x-1.41x，无需重训练，且三个模型的WBench Overall分数均优于原始推理。
AI.conclusion: 显式利用控制信号作为免成本调度依据可有效指导缓存复用；控制感知缓存能在不重训练的情况下同时实现加速与质量提升，验证了控制变化处结构相似性下降、低频结构更持久的观察价值。

title: ALIVE: Interaction-Aligned Object Insertion for First-Frame-Guided Video Editing
summary: Current video editors can insert objects but often struggle to make them participate in interactions such as being picked up or manipulated. We introduce ALIVE, a framework that makes inserted objects "alive" through coherent interactions with the source video's contents, using an edited first frame and an instruction naming only the added object. We curate 35,800 editing pairs combining 3D-rendered, model-generated, and real-world videos with general editing pairs from ROSE. Each pair differs in the target object's presence while preserving the surrounding action, teaching editors coordinated object behavior and source preservation. We further train a vision-language model (VLM) to predict interaction guidance from the same inputs. We introduce the ALIVE-interaction benchmark to assess interaction fidelity, source preservation, and visual coherence using a unified VLM-based protocol, and evaluate on the general video object insertion benchmark. Without VLM guidance, ALIVE improves Overall over the strongest evaluated baseline by 43.9% and 4.4% on the two benchmarks, respectively. VLM-predicted guidance further improves the ALIVE-interaction score by 0.95 points without additional user inputs.

AI.tldr: ALIVE 提出一种让插入视频中的物体"活起来"的框架，通过与源视频内容的连贯交互（如被抓取、被操作），仅需一张编辑后的首帧和一条指明新增物体的指令即可实现。
AI.motivation: 现有视频编辑器能插入物体，但难以让插入物体参与交互（如被拿起、被操控），即物体是"静态"的、无法融入源视频的动作逻辑。
AI.method: 1) 构建 35,800 组编辑数据对，融合 3D 渲染、模型生成、真实世界视频及 ROSE 的通用编辑对，每对仅在目标物体是否存在上有差异而保持周围动作一致；2) 输入为编辑后首帧与仅命名新增物体的指令；3) 额外训练一个 VLM，从相同输入预测交互引导（interaction guidance）。
AI.result: 在 ALIVE-interaction 基准（评估交互保真度、源内容保持、视觉连贯性，采用统一 VLM 协议）与通用视频物体插入基准上：无 VLM 引导时，Overall 分别比最强基线提升 43.9% 和 4.4%；加入 VLM 预测引导后，ALIVE-interaction 得分再提升 0.95 分，且无需额外用户输入。
AI.conclusion: 通过在配对数据上学习协调的物体行为与源内容保持，并由 VLM 预测交互引导，ALIVE 可使插入物体与源视频实现连贯交互，显著优于现有基线，且不增加用户负担。

title: 4D-HOF: Hand-Object Flow Matching for Feed-Forward 4D Interaction Reconstruction
summary: Existing methods for 4D hand-object reconstruction often rely on costly per-sequence optimization, while generative approaches typically synthesize interactions from random noise, which can lead to unstable interaction prediction. We introduce 4D-HOF, a feed-forward framework that reconstructs 4D hand-object interactions from coarse but informative estimates produced by vision foundation models. Concretely, we learn a conditional flow matching model that transports foundation-model-derived hand-object states toward an interaction manifold, allowing the model to correct errors in translation, rotation, and alignment in a feed-forward manner. A key advantage of our generative formulation is that it naturally enables test-time guidance within the transport process. Rather than applying a separate post-hoc optimization after reconstruction, we directly steer the evolving generative states using physical interaction constraints and observed 2D evidence, allowing the reconstruction to be refined as part of the generative process itself. By training the generative model on diverse datasets, 4D-HOF generalizes robustly to challenging in-the-wild scenarios. Experiments on out-of-domain benchmarks show that 4D-HOF achieves state-of-the-art performance, producing more stable and accurate 4D hand-object reconstructions.

AI.tldr: 4D-HOF：前馈式4D手物重建框架，基于条件流匹配，将视觉基础模型估计传输至交互流形，实现测试时引导。
AI.motivation: 现有4D手物重建方法依赖昂贵的逐序列优化；生成式方法多从随机噪声合成交互，导致交互预测不稳定。需要一种前馈、稳定且能利用物理与2D观测约束的重建方案。
AI.method: 提出4D-HOF前馈框架：以视觉基础模型输出的粗糙但具信息量的手物状态为条件，学习条件流匹配模型，将状态传输至交互流形，前馈式纠正平移、旋转与对齐误差；并在传输过程中引入测试时引导，利用物理交互约束与观测2D证据直接引导生成状态演化，将细化嵌入生成过程。
AI.result: 在域外基准测试上达到SOTA性能，生成更稳定、更准确的4D手物重建。
AI.conclusion: 将生成式流匹配与测试时引导结合，可替代后处理优化，实现前馈、鲁棒且可泛化至野外场景的4D手物交互重建。

title: Building Rome from a Single Image
summary: Single-image scene generation aims to produce a complete 3D scene mesh from a single image, including surfaces the camera did not observe. While pretrained 3D object generators encode a strong shape prior, they are mainly designed for isolated objects in a fixed canonical volume and focus mostly on indoor scenes, since diverse 3D data for outdoor scenes are quite limited. In this work, we present a method that redesigns such an object-centric generator, e.g., Trellis 2, to work on both indoor and outdoor scenes while retaining its prior. We accomplish this by (a) partitioning the scene into adaptive chunks that scale relative to the distance to the camera; nearby chunks have a smaller size to keep the finer detail, while distant structures, e.g., buildings, are covered by large chunks; (b) making the generator capture explicit 2D-3D correspondence by lifting image features and making the model aware of the free space, observed surface, and unobserved region; (c) synthesizing around 4,000 outdoor scenes to broaden the training data, as existing scene datasets are largely indoor. Experiments on Tanks and Temples, ScanNet++, and in-the-wild images show that our method outperforms all baselines in geometric accuracy and perceptual quality across both indoor and outdoor scenes.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出将物体中心的3D生成器（如Trellis 2）改造成可同时处理室内外场景的单图场景生成方法，通过自适应分块、显式2D-3D对应建模和约4000个室外场景合成数据，在几何精度和感知质量上超越所有基线。
AI.motivation: 单图场景生成需从单张图像重建包括相机未观测区域的完整3D场景网格。现有预训练3D物体生成器虽具备强形状先验，但主要面向固定标准体积中的孤立物体，且受限于室外3D数据稀缺而聚焦室内场景，难以直接泛化到室外场景。
AI.method: (a) 将场景划分为随相机距离缩放的自适应分块，近处分块较小以保留细节，远处结构（如建筑）由大分块覆盖；(b) 使生成器捕捉显式2D-3D对应关系，通过提升图像特征并让模型感知自由空间、已观测表面与未观测区域；(c) 合成约4000个室外场景以扩充训练数据。
AI.result: 在Tanks and Temples、ScanNet++以及真实场景（in-the-wild）图像上的实验表明，该方法在室内外场景的几何精度和感知质量上均优于所有基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 通过重新设计物体中心生成器并结合自适应分块、2D-3D对应建模与室外数据合成，可在保留强形状先验的同时实现室内外通用的单图场景生成，效果优于现有基线。

title: World Models' Last Exam in Physics
summary: Video world models can produce visually convincing yet physically inconsistent sequences, raising concerns about their reliability for prediction and planning in embodied AI systems. Existing evaluations often rely on model-based judgments or reference videos, while direct physical tests largely focus on mechanics. We introduce World Models' Last Exam in Physics, a measurement-based benchmark for evaluating physical consistency in video world models. The benchmark comprises 40 controlled tasks spanning mechanics, optics, fluids, thermal and phase-change phenomena, electromagnetism, and surface tension. Each task pairs an initial image and a generation prompt with predefined physical criteria, enabling interpretable tests of observable physical relationships without requiring reference videos. Its evaluator combines task-observability screening with task-specific quantitative physical measurements. Experiments on eight video generation models across 1,280 videos reveal persistent physical inconsistencies and substantial variation across tasks, with the best model achieving an overall score of 57.76 out of 100. Evaluation on synthetic videos with known physical relationships provides evidence for the validity of the measurement module under controlled conditions. The evaluator also achieves higher agreement with human judgments than a direct vision-language model baseline in both within-task rankings and pairwise comparisons. By combining coverage across physical domains with scores grounded in measurable evidence and explicit measurement limitations, the benchmark provides an interpretable basis for diagnosing physical inconsistencies and tracking progress toward physically consistent video world models.

AI.tldr: 提出基于测量的"世界模型物理终极考试"基准，含40项跨力学、光学、流体、热学、电磁学与表面张力任务，通过任务可观测性筛选与任务专属定量物理测量评估视频世界模型的物理一致性。
AI.motivation: 视频世界模型能生成视觉逼真但物理不一致的序列，影响其在具身AI预测与规划中的可靠性。现有评估多依赖模型判断或参考视频，直接物理测试又多局限于力学，缺乏覆盖多物理域、无需参考视频的可解释测量方法。
AI.method: 构建包含40项受控任务的基准，覆盖力学、光学、流体、热学与相变、电磁学、表面张力；每项任务由初始图像、生成提示和预定义物理判据组成，无需参考视频即可检验可观测物理关系。评估器采用任务可观测性筛选与任务专属定量物理测量相结合的方式。
AI.result: 在8个视频生成模型的1,280段视频上实验，发现持续存在的物理不一致且任务间差异显著，最佳模型总分仅57.76/100。在物理关系已知的合成视频上验证了测量模块的有效性；评估器在同任务排名与成对比较中与人类判断的一致性均高于直接使用视觉语言模型的基线。
AI.conclusion: 该基准兼顾多物理域覆盖、基于可测证据的分数与明确的测量局限，为诊断物理不一致并追踪迈向物理一致视频世界模型的进展提供了可解释依据。

title: TEMPEST: Temporal Embeddings for Scalable Driver Identification via Angular Margin Learning
summary: Scalable driver identification requires embedding models that maintain discriminative performance as fleet size grows, yet existing triplet-loss formulations degrade rapidly with driver pool size and overfit to session-specific patterns under rigorous temporal evaluation. We introduce TEMPEST, a Temporal Convolutional Network embedding model trained with an additive angular margin (ArcFace) loss that enforces global class-level separation in a normalized angular space. TEMPEST maps 60-second multimodal driving windows to compact 96-dimensional embeddings, supporting truly dynamic enrollment without any retraining or classifier refitting. Under rigorous temporal evaluation on a 45-driver dataset, TEMPEST achieves 91.71% Rank-1 accuracy, outperforming the best classical model by 17.9 pp and the strongest triplet-loss baseline by 58.4 pp. TEMPEST degrades by only 4.3 pp when growing the subject pool from 10 to 45 drivers, compared to 22 pp and 32.5 pp for supervised and unsupervised triplet-loss baselines, and its cross-session advantage is corroborated on the public KIA Soul dataset, where it outperforms the best classical model by 7.3 pp within-session and 14.3 pp cross-session. With 720K parameters, a 2.80 MB footprint, and 50-epoch convergence, TEMPEST establishes a rigorous, reproducible baseline for scalable behavioral driver biometric identification.

AI.tldr: TEMPEST：基于时序卷积网络与ArcFace损失的驾驶行为嵌入模型，实现可扩展、无需重训的动态驾驶员识别。
AI.motivation: 可扩展的驾驶员识别要求嵌入模型在车队规模增长时保持判别性能，但现有三元组损失公式随驾驶员池扩大迅速退化，且在严格时序评估下易过拟合会话特定模式。
AI.method: 提出TEMPEST，一种时序卷积网络（TCN）嵌入模型，采用加性角度间隔（ArcFace）损失，在归一化角度空间中强制全局类别级分离；将60秒多模态驾驶窗口映射为紧凑的96维嵌入，支持无需重训练或分类器重拟合的动态注册（enrollment）。
AI.result: 在45名驾驶员数据集上严格时序评估：Rank-1准确率91.71%，较最佳经典模型高17.9个百分点，较最强三元组损失基线高58.4个百分点；受试池从10增至45时性能仅下降4.3个百分点（监督与非监督三元组基线分别下降22与32.5个百分点）。在公开KIA Soul数据集上，会话内高7.3个百分点、跨会话高14.3个百分点，优于最佳经典模型。模型720K参数、2.80 MB、50轮收敛。
AI.conclusion: TEMPEST为可扩展的行为驾驶员生物识别建立了严格、可复现的基线，兼顾高判别性能、可扩展性与部署效率。

title: Anchor Divergence for Semantic Geometry in Contrastive Learning
summary: This paper concerns how semantic context determines geometry in learned vector representations. Similarity is typically measured using cosine similarity, which provides a single fixed geometry. Semantic similarity, however, is inherently context dependent: two images may be similar because they depict the same object, share a visual style, or are relevant to the same clinical finding. We show that contrastive representations naturally encompass a family of geometries that can be specialized to particular semantic structure. The key idea is to use an interplay between contrastive learning, exponential families, and information geometry to establish a correspondence between probability distributions over "anchors" and Bregman geometries on the representation space. We use this correspondence to define "Anchor Divergences", a method for specifying context-specific semantic geometries on fixed representations. Under this correspondence, modeling the anchor distribution models the geometry itself. Experiments on retrieval show that anchor divergences provide an effective and efficient way to specify context-specific semantic similarity.

AI.tldr: 本文提出利用对比学习、指数族与信息几何之间的对应关系，建立"锚点"分布与表示空间上Bregman几何之间的映射，并由此定义"锚点散度"（Anchor Divergences），从而在固定表示上指定上下文相关的语义几何。
AI.motivation: 语义相似性本质上是上下文相关的：两张图像可能因为描绘同一物体、共享视觉风格或关联同一临床发现而相似。然而常用的余弦相似度只提供单一的固定几何，无法刻画这种多义性。作者希望找到一种方法，能在不重新训练表示的前提下，为特定语义结构定制几何。
AI.method: 核心思路是利用对比学习、指数族分布与信息几何三者之间的相互作用，建立"锚点"上概率分布与表示空间上Bregman几何之间的对应关系；基于该对应定义锚点散度（Anchor Divergences），通过建模锚点分布来建模几何本身，从而在固定表示上指定上下文相关的语义几何。
AI.result: 检索实验表明，锚点散度能够有效且高效地指定上下文相关的语义相似性。
AI.conclusion: 对比表示天然包含一族几何结构，其中每一个几何可针对特定语义结构进行特化；通过建模锚点分布即可灵活调控几何，为上下文相关的语义相似性提供了一种高效且有效的实现途径。

title: ROMA: LLM System for Real-World Object-Centric Multi-Sensory Active Perception
summary: Humans inherently understand the physical world through an active process. When sensory evidence is insufficient to infer physical properties, we naturally interact with the environment by deciding what information is missing, how to acquire it, and when sufficient evidence has been obtained. In stark contrast, existing multi-sensory robot systems mainly integrate sensory inputs rather than actively acquiring missing evidence through interactions. In this work, we introduce ROMA, an LLM-based system for Real-World Object-Centric Multi-Sensory Active Perception. ROMA integrates vision, audio, tactile, and force sensing into a reasoning-interaction-feedback loop. The model identifies missing evidence and determines the target objects, interactions, and modalities, while a physical interface executes the selected interactions and collects the multi-sensory feedback. To support this capability, we construct ROMI-2K, a large-scale real-world multi-sensory object interaction dataset covering nearly 2,000 objects and 6 atomic interactions with synchronized sensory feedback. Building on these data, we develop a two-stage training framework that aligns sensory modalities and equips the LLM to assess evidence sufficiency, select informative interactions, and reason over the multi-sensory feedback. We further characterize active perception as perception chains, where acquired evidence guides subsequent interactions and reasoning, and establish ROMA Bench to evaluate single-attribute, long-horizon multi-attribute, and intent-driven active perception. Experiments show that ROMA can actively acquire missing evidence and solve complex, long-chain multi-sensory perception tasks that existing methods struggle to handle, laying a strong perceptual foundation for active multi-sensory embodied agents.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 ROMA——一个基于 LLM 的真实世界物体中心多感官主动感知系统，融合视觉、音频、触觉与力觉，形成"推理—交互—反馈"闭环，并构建 ROMI-2K 数据集与 ROMA Bench 基准。
AI.motivation: 人类通过主动交互理解物理世界：当感官证据不足时会主动决定缺失何种信息、如何获取、何时停止；而现有多感官机器人系统仅被动整合感官输入，缺乏主动获取缺失证据的能力。
AI.method: ROMA 将视觉、音频、触觉、力觉接入推理—交互—反馈循环：由模型识别缺失证据并确定目标物体、交互方式与模态，物理接口执行交互并采集多感官反馈。配套构建 ROMI-2K 大规模真实多感官物体交互数据集（近 2000 个物体、6 种原子交互、同步感官反馈），并采用两阶段训练框架对齐感官模态，使 LLM 具备证据充分性评估、交互选择与多感官反馈推理能力。作者将主动感知刻画为"感知链"，即已获证据引导后续交互与推理。
AI.result: 实验表明 ROMA 能主动获取缺失证据，完成复杂长链多感官感知任务，而现有方法在这些任务上表现不佳；并通过 ROMA Bench 在单属性、长程多属性及意图驱动主动感知三类任务上进行评估。
AI.conclusion: ROMA 为主动式多感官具身智能体奠定了坚实的感知基础，证明了"主动取证"范式相较被动感官融合的优越性。

title: Should We Skip Diffusion?
summary: Diffusion models learn semantic representations while generating images. In the Decoupled Diffusion Transformer (DDT), a condition encoder provides features that guide a velocity decoder in denoising. To enable effective denoising at all noise levels, these features must capture both high-level abstract structures and low-level details. However, skip/residual connections in the encoder allow shallow features to bypass successive transformations, which may limit progressive abstraction, or at least make it difficult to disentangle different levels of abstraction. We propose DDT-RFE, which removes the residual connections around the Self-Attention and MLP operations in each encoder block while maintaining stable training. To retain the information that abstraction discards but that the decoder still needs, we fuse the input patch embedding with intermediate and final encoder features to form the encoder output. The decoder thus has access to information from multiple encoder depths, while each encoder block is able to learn more abstract representations. DDT-RFE achieves overall improvements over DDT across visual understanding tasks, including image classification, semantic segmentation, object discovery, and semantic correspondence, while using fewer encoder blocks. It also achieves a lower FID for image generation on ImageNet.

AI.tldr: 提出DDT-RFE，通过移除编码器块内自注意力与MLP的残差连接以增强渐进抽象，并融合浅层patch嵌入与中间/最终编码器特征供解码器使用，在多个视觉理解任务及ImageNet生成上优于DDT。
AI.motivation: 扩散模型在生成图像的同时学习语义表征。DDT中条件编码器为速度解码器提供引导去噪的特征，需同时包含高层抽象结构与低层细节。但编码器中的skip/residual连接使浅层特征绕过后续变换，可能限制渐进抽象，或至少难以解耦不同抽象层级。
AI.method: 提出DDT-RFE：移除每个编码器块中Self-Attention与MLP操作周围的残差连接，同时保持训练稳定；为保留抽象过程中丢弃但解码器仍需要的信息，将输入patch embedding与中间及最终编码器特征融合构成编码器输出。解码器因此可获取多个编码器深度的信息，而每个编码器块能学习更抽象的表征。
AI.result: 在图像分类、语义分割、目标发现与语义对应等视觉理解任务上，DDT-RFE整体优于DDT，且使用更少的编码器块；在ImageNet图像生成上取得更低的FID。
AI.conclusion: 去掉编码器内部残差并融合多深度特征，可在减少编码器块数的同时提升理解与生成性能，表明促进渐进抽象与保留多层级信息的解耦设计对扩散模型表征学习有效。

title: Smart Content Ingestion for Generative AI Workloads
summary: The evolution of machine learning has progressively changed where intelligence resides in an AI system. In conventional machine learning the task, data representation, labels and model architecture were tightly coupled, so data preparation was narrow, schema-bound and visible. Generative AI decouples the model from any single task: one foundation model serves open-ended downstream tasks, and the generality gained on the model side is matched by heterogeneity on the data side, because enterprise knowledge is authored in the formats people use (PDF, presentations, spreadsheets, scanned documents, forms, tables, diagrams and mixed-layout files) that carry textual, visual, geometric and structural information at once. A language model or retriever cannot reason reliably over information misrepresented at this interface, so content extraction becomes a lifecycle stage in its own right whose errors no downstream retriever or re-ranker can repair. This paper presents a production-ready content-extraction system that makes this stage explicit, configurable, and measurable. The system incorporates selective OCR routing, a scarcity-first curation engine with a reference-based extraction scorer that measures character, word, and table-structure accuracy, a deterministic structure-aware parent-child chunker, and a read-only retrieval evaluator that generates grounded questions from every page and reports Hit@k, mean reciprocal rank, and latency. On a 180-document corpus the best extractor scores 97.4 of 100 (character error rate 0.13%, table similarity 0.995) and the chunker reaches hit@1 of 68.6%, hit@10 of 92.8% and MRR 0.77 over 25,050 generated questions. We distil three design principles (structure before semantics, never mutate what you measure, budget your labels) and position measured content extraction as the perception layer of enterprise agentic systems.

AI.tldr: 论文提出一个可配置、可度量的生产级内容抽取系统，作为企业智能体系统的"感知层"，通过选择性OCR路由、基于参考的抽取评分、结构感知分块与只读检索评估等模块，在180篇文档语料上实现抽取97.4分、hit@10达92.8%。
AI.motivation: 生成式AI将模型与单一任务解耦，使模型侧获得通用性，但数据侧呈现高度异质性：企业知识以PDF、演示文稿、表格、扫描件、混合版面等人类原生格式撰写，同时承载文本、视觉、几何与结构信息。语言模型或检索器无法对在抽取接口处被误表征的信息进行可靠推理，且抽取阶段的错误无法被下游检索器或重排器修复。因此内容抽取应成为独立的生命周期阶段，但此前缺乏显式、可配置、可度量的系统化处理。
AI.method: 系统包含四个核心组件：（1）选择性OCR路由；（2）稀缺优先（scarcity-first）的策展引擎，配基于参考的抽取评分器，度量字符、词与表格结构准确率；（3）确定性的结构感知父子分块器；（4）只读检索评估器，从每一页生成有依据的问题并报告Hit@k、MRR与延迟。
AI.result: 在180篇文档语料上，最佳抽取器得分97.4/100（字符错误率0.13%，表格相似度0.995）；分块器在25,050个生成问题上达到hit@1为68.6%、hit@10为92.8%、MRR为0.77。
AI.conclusion: 论文提炼出三条设计原则——结构先于语义（structure before semantics）、绝不改动被测对象（never mutate what you measure）、精打细算标签预算（budget your labels）——并将可度量的内容抽取定位为企业智能体系统的感知层。

title: Sample-Optimal Estimation of the Fréchet Inception Distance
summary: The Fréchet Inception Distance (FID) is widely used to evaluate generative models, but its empirical plug-in estimator suffers from finite-sample bias [BSAG18, CF20]. We study the sample complexity $n$ of estimating FID to error $ε$ between $d$-dimensional Gaussians with bounded mean distance and covariances, when one distribution is known. Our contributions are threefold. (1) We establish tight finite-sample $Θ(\frac{d^2}{n})$ bias and $Θ(\frac{d}{n} + \frac {d^2} {n^2})$ variance bounds for the empirical plug-in estimator, establishing a $\gtrsim d^2$ sample complexity. (2) To debias the empirical plug-in estimator, we generalize the ${\rm FID}_\infty$ estimator of [CF20] to extrapolation methods of arbitrary order $k$. We further prove tight bias and variance bounds of $Θ(\frac{d^{k + 2}}{n^{k + 1}})$ and $Θ(\frac d n + \frac{d^2}{n^2})$ for any order-$k$ extrapolation under our framework. (3) We introduce Relative Taylor Debiasing (RTD), a new, computationally efficient FID estimation algorithm using debiasing techniques inspired by U-statistics. We show that RTD achieves an $O(\frac d {ε^2})$ sample complexity, and prove that this is optimal. We provide a complementary empirical evaluation of our new estimators. Our experiments on synthetic Gaussians validate the predicted residual bias and support the tightness of our bounds. On ImageNet with Inception embeddings, RTD achieves the lowest mean estimation error at the standard 50K sample budget, while our second-order variance-aware extrapolation estimator (VALE$_2$) uses only 10K samples to achieve accuracy comparable to FID$_\infty$ at 50K samples.

AI.tldr: 本文研究已知一个分布时，两个d维高斯分布间FID估计的样本复杂度，提出紧致的偏差与方差界，推广高阶外推估计器，并提出达到最优O(d/ε²)样本复杂度的RTD算法。
AI.motivation: FID广泛用于评估生成模型，但其经验plug-in估计器存在有限样本偏差，缺乏对其样本复杂度的严格理论刻画与高效去偏方法。
AI.method: 在均值距离与协方差有界、一个分布已知的设定下，分析d维高斯间FID的样本复杂度n；建立plug-in估计器的紧致偏差与方差界；将FID_∞推广为任意阶k的外推方法并给出偏差方差界；提出基于U统计量去偏思想的相对泰勒去偏（RTD）算法。
AI.result: 证明plug-in估计器偏差为Θ(d²/n)、方差为Θ(d/n+d²/n²)，样本复杂度约≳d²；任意阶k外推偏差为Θ(d^{k+2}/n^{k+1})、方差为Θ(d/n+d²/n²)；RTD达到O(d/ε²)样本复杂度并被证明为最优。合成高斯实验验证残余偏差与界的紧致性；ImageNet上RTD在50K样本下平均估计误差最低，VALE₂仅用10K样本即可达到FID_∞在50K样本的精度。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为FID估计提供了紧致的有限样本理论，涵盖plug-in偏差、高阶外推与最优去偏算法RTD，理论与实验均验证其有效性，显著提升FID估计的样本效率。

title: Energy-Conditioned Noise Schedule and Whitening for Spectral Diffusion
comment: 7 pages, 5 figures, 2 tables, Manuscript submitted for publication in Elsevier Pattern Recognition Letters
summary: This paper introduces an energy-adaptive noise scheduling and whitening strategy for transform-domain diffusion models. Existing spectral diffusion methods account for the non-uniform statistics of transform coefficients through coefficient scaling, normalization, or frequency prioritization, while the forward diffusion noise schedule remains largely independent of the underlying spectral-energy distribution. We investigate whether the temporal evolution of the forward diffusion process should also follow the spectral organization of natural images. The proposed formulation combines global spectral whitening with energy-conditioned noise allocation that jointly modulates the injected noise according to the energy of individual transform coefficients and an image-dependent energy path over diffusion time. The resulting forward process preserves Gaussian transitions with closed-form marginals and remains compatible with standard DDPM and DDIM procedures without modifying the diffusion architecture. Experiments on CIFAR-10 demonstrate the contribution of the proposed energy-conditioned noise schedule and spectral whitening, reducing Fréchet Inception Distance from 142.48 for a compact DCTdiff U-Net variant to 100.45.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种能量自适应噪声调度与白化策略，用全局谱白化与能量条件噪声分配联合调制前向扩散注入的噪声，在保持高斯转移闭式边缘与DDPM/DDIM兼容性的前提下，将CIFAR-10上DCTdiff U-Net变体的FID从142.48降至100.45。
AI.motivation: 现有谱域扩散方法仅通过系数缩放、归一化或频率优先来应对变换系数的非均匀统计特性，而前向扩散的噪声调度基本与底层谱能量分布无关。作者探究前向扩散过程的时间演化是否也应遵循自然图像的谱组织结构。
AI.method: 提出将全局谱白化与能量条件噪声分配相结合的公式化表述：一方面对变换域实施全局谱白化；另一方面依据各变换系数的能量以及随扩散时间变化的、依赖图像的能量路径，联合调制注入噪声，从而实现能量自适应的噪声调度。
AI.result: 所得前向过程保持高斯转移与闭式边缘分布，且无需修改扩散架构即可兼容标准DDPM与DDIM流程。在CIFAR-10上，DCTdiff U-Net紧凑变体的FID由142.48降至100.45，验证了能量条件噪声调度与谱白化的贡献。
AI.conclusion: 前向扩散噪声调度应与自然图像的谱能量组织相匹配，能量条件噪声分配与谱白化可有效提升变换域扩散模型的生成质量，且与现有采样流程无缝兼容。

title: RoboCap: A New Platform for Egocentric Robot Learning
summary: Despite its promise for scaling robot learning, egocentric manipulation data is still scarce today. Collection at scale requires vertically integrating ergonomic hardware with centimeter-precise 3D algorithms, at a precision that has not been publicly demonstrated. To address this gap, we introduce RoboCap, a 250\,g six-camera dual-IMU hat designed for in-the-wild egocentric data capture, and the Grounded API, a suite of device-agnostic 3D algorithms tuned for RoboCap. In this report, we demonstrate how hardware, calibration, and 3D algorithms interact to achieve state-of-the-art performance on the public benchmarks: our SLAM across diverse settings and rigs, our depth estimation on egocentric settings, and our hand tracking when adapted to third-party devices.

AI.tldr: 论文提出RoboCap硬件与Grounded API算法套件，用于大规模采集第一视角操作数据，并在SLAM、深度估计与手部跟踪基准上取得领先性能。
AI.motivation: 第一视角操作数据对机器人学习扩展具有潜力，但当前数据稀缺；规模化采集需要将符合人体工学的硬件与厘米级精度的3D算法垂直整合，而这种精度此前未公开实现。
AI.method: 提出RoboCap：重250克、六摄像头、双IMU的帽子式设备，用于野外第一视角数据采集；并提出Grounded API：设备无关、面向RoboCap调优的3D算法套件。报告展示硬件、标定与3D算法如何协同工作。
AI.result: 在公开基准上达到最先进性能：跨多样场景与设备的SLAM、第一视角深度估计，以及适配第三方设备后的手部跟踪。
AI.conclusion: 通过硬件、标定与3D算法的协同设计，可实现高精度、可扩展的第一视角操作数据采集，并验证其在多个3D感知任务上的有效性。

title: Monocular Navigation Relative to Unknown Spacecraft Using a Transformer-Aided Kalman Filter
summary: This work presents a novel learning-based pipeline for pose estimation of unknown spacecraft using only monocular images from a single servicer. The approach combines a transformer-based neural network with a Multi-State Constraint Kalman Filter (MSCKF) to estimate the pose (i.e., position and orientation of the target spacecraft relative to the camera) throughout rendezvous and proximity operations. Unlike existing vision-based methods that require prior knowledge of the target shape or inertia properties, rely on additional sensing modalities such as depth, lidar, or stereo, or only recover translation up to scale, the proposed pipeline generalizes to previously unseen spacecraft using a single monocular camera. The transformer network estimates the odometry, the change in pose between images up to scale, from SuperPoint features matched by LightGlue. The MSCKF uses these pseudo-measurements along with an orbit and attitude kinematics model to estimate the pose of the target. In particular, the relative orbit elements, the target's attitude with respect to the servicer's camera, and the associated angular velocity are estimated directly by the filter. Given the monocular approach and short distance to the target, the full observability of the range to the target is recovered via attitude maneuvers by the servicer. The method is trained and evaluated on a re-rendered high-resolution version of the SPE3R dataset, which includes synthetic images of 103 spacecraft. Eleven of these spacecraft are held out during training to evaluate the generalization to unseen targets. Monte Carlo simulations are then used to evaluate the navigation pipeline on rendered trajectories of the held out spacecraft. The results demonstrate that learned vision pipelines as a front-end for Kalman filters provide median errors of 3.7° in attitude and 2.2% of range in ROE when navigating about unknown targets.

AI.tldr: 提出一种仅用单目图像的未知航天器位姿估计学习流水线，结合Transformer网络与MSCKF，实现对未见目标的泛化，姿态中位误差3.7°、ROE距离误差2.2%。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉方法需目标形状/惯性先验知识，或依赖深度、激光雷达、立体视觉等额外传感器，或只能恢复尺度不确定的平移，难以适用于未知航天器的交会与近距离操作。
AI.method: 用SuperPoint特征并由LightGlue匹配，Transformer网络估计图像间尺度不确定的里程计（伪量测）；MSCKF融合该伪量测与轨道、姿态运动学模型，直接估计相对轨道要素、目标相对相机姿态及角速度；通过服务航天器姿态机动恢复距离全可观性。训练与评估使用SPE3R数据集的重渲染高分辨率版本（103个航天器，其中11个留出测试）。
AI.result: 蒙特卡洛仿真表明，导航未知目标时姿态中位误差为3.7°，ROE距离误差为2.2%。
AI.conclusion: 学习式视觉前端与卡尔曼滤波结合，可在单目、无先验条件下对未知航天器实现有效位姿估计与泛化。

title: ATLAS-AL: Adaptive Trust-Region for Latent Adversarial Searches via Active Learning
comment: 9 pages main body, plus 10 additional pages for references and appendix
summary: Security evaluation of learning-based systems requires more than just testing the system against a fixed collection of attacks. It requires adaptive mechanisms that can efficiently discover \textit{sets} of inputs that induce model failure. We introduce ATLAS (Adaptive Trust-Regions for Latent Adversarial Searches), which is a query-based framework that discovers adversarial input sets for black-box learning systems. ATLAS casts attack generation as an active learning level set estimation problem then combines calibrated approximations with a local-global sampling architecture to find regions of the input space that contain adversarial examples. Once discovered, ATLAS is designed to sample points within these adversarial regions to build adversarial sets that accurately represent the state of robustness of the target model. When applied on toy experiments, we find that ATLAS is able to recover more of the adversarial region under a limited query budget than does previous work. When applied to standard and adversarially trained MNIST, CIFAR, and ImageNet model targets, ATLAS produces better representative attacks than other query-based black-box attacks (NES, SignHunter, BayesOpt). ATLAS represents an automated red-teaming framework that can be used for both analyzing the robustness of learning-based systems under development and continuous auditing to see how the robustness of a system changes over time.

AI.tldr: ATLAS 是一个基于查询的黑盒对抗攻击框架，将攻击生成建模为主动学习的水平集估计问题，结合校准近似与局部-全局采样，在有限查询预算下发现并采样对抗区域，生成的对抗集比 NES、SignHunter、BayesOpt 更具代表性。
AI.motivation: 对基于学习的系统进行安全性评估，不能仅依赖固定攻击集合的测试，而需要能高效发现"引发模型失效的输入集合"的自适应机制。现有方法在有限查询预算下对对抗区域的刻画不足。
AI.method: ATLAS（Adaptive Trust-Regions for Latent Adversarial Searches）将攻击生成视为主动学习式的水平集估计问题，融合校准后的近似与局部-全局采样架构，定位包含对抗样本的输入空间区域；随后在这些对抗区域内采样，构建能准确反映目标模型鲁棒性状态的对抗集。该方法为黑盒、基于查询的框架。
AI.result: 在玩具实验中，ATLAS 在有限查询预算下恢复的对抗区域多于先前工作；在标准训练与对抗训练的 MNIST、CIFAR、ImageNet 目标模型上，ATLAS 生成的攻击比 NES、SignHunter、BayesOpt 等查询式黑盒攻击更具代表性。
AI.conclusion: ATLAS 构成一个自动化红队框架，既可用于分析开发中学习系统的鲁棒性，也可用于持续审计，以观察系统鲁棒性随时间的变化。

title: Learnable Spectral Activations
summary: Implicit neural representations (INRs) are shaped by the spectral structure induced by their input encodings and activation functions. Existing methods improve fitting primarily by modifying which frequencies are available to the network, through coordinate encodings or periodic nonlinearities. However, frequency access is not the only bottleneck: signals with localized or spatially varying structure require the network to efficiently compose frequencies into multi-harmonic internal responses. We introduce learnable spectral activations (LSA), which replace fixed neuron-level nonlinearities with a residual truncated Fourier series whose harmonic amplitudes are learned during training. LSA does not expand the asymptotic function class. Instead, it changes the factorization of the representation: linear weights select features while activation coefficients control spectral shaping, and the two are updated by separate gradients. Because the activation output is affine in the coefficients given fixed pre-activations, spectral tuning becomes a more direct subproblem compared to architectures where it is entangled with feature selection. Empirically, this factorization concentrates more target-signal energy in the leading eigenmodes of the neural tangent kernel, consistent with improved optimization behavior. Across audio, image, neural radiance field, and neural acoustic field tasks, LSA also improves reconstruction quality.

AI.tldr: 本文提出可学习频谱激活（LSA），用残差截断傅里叶级数替代固定神经元级非线性，通过将线性权重（特征选择）与激活系数（频谱整形）解耦，在不扩大渐近函数类的前提下改善隐式神经表示的拟合质量。
AI.motivation: 现有 INR 方法主要通过坐标编码或周期非线性来改变网络可用的频率，把频率可及性视为主要瓶颈。但本地化或空间变化的信号还要求网络能高效地把频率组合成多谐波内部响应，而现有方法没有直接解决这一组合问题。
AI.method: 用残差截断傅里叶级数作为神经元级激活函数，其各次谐波幅度在训练中学习。该设计不改变渐近函数类，而是改变表示分解方式：线性权重负责特征选择，激活系数负责频谱整形，二者由不同梯度分别更新；在固定预激活下，激活输出关于系数是仿射的，因此频谱调优成为更直接、与特征选择解耦的子问题。
AI.result: 在音频、图像、神经辐射场与神经声场任务上，LSA 均提升了重建质量；经验上，该分解使更多目标信号能量集中到神经正切核的主导特征模中，与优化行为的改善相一致。
AI.conclusion: 频率可及性并非唯一瓶颈，表示分解方式同样关键。将特征选择与频谱整形解耦，可在不扩大模型表达能力的前提下提高 INR 的频谱组织效率与拟合性能。

title: Decoupling What from Where: How Should a Small GUI Grounding Model Receive the Action Type?
comment: 18 pages, 4 figures, 12 tables. Code and per-example logs are available at https://github.com/aadcha/action-conditioned-gui-agent
summary: A GUI agent decides which action to take and where to take it; we ask how a small grounding model should receive the action type. Fine-tuning Qwen2-VL-2B with LoRA on Android in the Wild, we compare a flat baseline with five ways of supplying the type under matched data, compute, and decoding: an auxiliary loss, a hard-routed action word, an additive learned embedding, a prepended learned token, and the type written into the prompt. With five seeds, an episode-clustered bootstrap, and seed-level paired tests, the ranking on a mixed stream is clear: the auxiliary loss, the additive embedding, and the prompt word each gain five to seven hit@0.10 points over the baseline, while hard routing and the prepended token are not distinguishable from it. Much of that gain is protection from a preprocessing choice of ours rather than a spatial prior. Our serializer clamps the off-screen touch point AITW records for type events to the origin; that class degrades the baseline's click grounding, and removing it lifts the baseline by nearly seven points, after which no mechanism's hit rate beats it and the intervals exclude a two-point effect, though the auxiliary loss still shortens the average miss; on a stream of taps and swipes none helps. Whether this generalizes beyond one serialization is open. For deployment, the pipeline's margin over the baseline with predicted rather than gold types is not established (+0.016, 95% interval [-0.017, +0.052]), and a wrong type collapses every model conditioned at inference. The prepended token does not help at the shared learning rate, where its rows barely move from initialization; trained ten times faster it reaches the level of the other three, with a margin three seeds do not establish. We also document a silent failure: injecting conditioning through inputs_embeds makes Qwen2-VL fall back to 1-D positions for image tokens, costing nine points.

AI.tldr: 在AITW上用LoRA微调Qwen2-VL-2B，比较五种向小型GUI grounding模型注入动作类型的方式；只有辅助损失、加性嵌入和提示词在混合流上稳定优于基线，而提升主要源于对自身预处理缺陷（clamp到原点）的补偿，而非空间先验。
AI.motivation: GUI agent需先决定动作类型与落点，本文关注一个具体工程问题：小型grounding模型应以何种方式接收动作类型信息。作者希望在数据、算力与解码完全匹配的条件下，公平比较多种条件注入机制，并检验其增益是否来自真实的空间先验还是实验设置的伪影。
AI.method: 在Android in the Wild（AITW）上以LoRA微调Qwen2-VL-2B，对比六种设置：无类型的平坦基线、辅助损失、硬路由动作词、加性学习嵌入、前置学习token、以及写入prompt的类型词。评估采用5个随机种子、按episode聚类的bootstrap和种子级配对检验，分别在混合流、去除type事件后的流、以及tap+swipe流上测hit@0.10、平均miss等指标；另用预测类型替代gold类型模拟部署，并考察学习率与位置编码实现细节的影响。
AI.result: 混合流上，辅助损失、加性嵌入、prompt词各比基线提升约5–7个hit@0.10点，硬路由与前置token与基线无显著差异。移除被序列化器clamp到原点的type事件后，基线提升近7点，此时无任何机制的hit率显著超过基线（区间排除2点效应），仅辅助损失仍缩短平均miss；在纯tap+swipe流上均无增益。部署下用预测类型时相对基线的优势未确立（+0.016，95%区间[-0.017,+0.052]），错误类型会使所有条件模型失效。前置token在共享学习率下几乎不更新，学习率提高十倍后达到其余三种机制水平（3个种子不足以确立）。另记录一个静默失败：经inputs_embeds注入条件会使Qwen2-VL的图像token退回1-D位置编码，损失约9点。
AI.conclusion: 在所测序列化设置下，动作类型条件注入的收益主要来自对预处理缺陷的补偿，而非提供空间先验；没有机制在修正后的基线上稳健胜出，也没有机制在tap+swipe流上有效。结论是否可推广到其他序列化方式尚不确定；部署价值未确立，且对类型预测误差极其脆弱。作者提示条件注入的实现细节（嵌入通路、学习率）会显著影响结果，需谨慎报告。

title: MobileVISTA: Generative Data Augmentation for Pose Generalization in Mobile Manipulation
summary: Mobile manipulators such as humanoid robots are increasingly deployed in dynamic, unstructured environments to perform dexterous manipulation tasks.
