However, end-to-end manipulation policies trained to imitate demonstration data collected from a single robot pose are brittle: even centimeter-scale deviations in robot pose at deployment can drive ego-centric observations and end-effector trajectories out of the training distribution, leading to sharp drops in performance. We introduce MobileVISTA, a data generation framework that transforms demonstrations captured at canonical poses into diverse, pose-perturbed training data by jointly (1) augmenting egocentric visual observations and (2) retargeting actions to compensate for base pose changes. Unlike prior methods, which assume a camera rigidly mounted off the actuated chain or non-trivial articulated robot geometry largely out of frame, MobileVISTA targets compatibility with egocentric platforms (e.g., humanoids) where the camera is both influenced by and must observe the robot's kinematic chain as it moves. We study MobileVISTA in simulated tasks spanning humanoid and bimanual embodiments, and on a real Galaxea R1 Pro. We find policies trained on MobileVISTA-augmented data demonstrate improved robustness to previously out-of-distribution poses encountered at test time, without additional demonstration collection or a trained generative model. Additionally, we find MobileVISTA's benefit is largest on tested humanoids, where the camera rides the actuated chain and the robot fills much of the frame. Additional videos and appendix can be found on our website: https://mobilevista.github.io

AI.tldr: MobileVISTA：一种数据生成框架，通过联合增强自我中心视觉观测与重定向动作来补偿基座姿态变化，将单一姿态采集的演示转化为姿态扰动多样的训练数据，从而提升移动操作器（尤其是人形机器人）模仿策略对部署时姿态偏差的鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 移动操作器（如人形机器人）日益部署于动态非结构化环境执行灵巧操作。但仅从单一机器人姿态采集的演示数据训练出的端到端模仿策略非常脆弱：部署时即使厘米级的姿态偏差，也会使自我中心观测和末端执行器轨迹偏离训练分布，导致性能急剧下降。采集多姿态演示成本高，而现有增强方法假设相机刚性安装在驱动链之外、或机器人关节几何复杂且大部分在画面外，无法适用于相机随驱动链运动且机器人占据大部分画面的自我中心平台。
AI.method: 提出 MobileVISTA 数据生成框架，将标准姿态下采集的演示转化为多样化的姿态扰动训练数据，其核心是联合两项操作：(1) 增强自我中心视觉观测；(2) 重定向动作以补偿基座姿态变化。该方法专门针对自我中心平台设计，即相机既受机器人运动学链影响、又必须观测其运动的情形，无需额外采集演示，也无需训练生成模型。
AI.result: 在涵盖人形与双臂形态的仿真任务以及真实的 Galaxea R1 Pro 平台上对 MobileVISTA 进行了研究。结果显示，使用 MobileVISTA 增强数据训练的策略对测试时此前属于分布外的姿态表现出更强的鲁棒性。此外，MobileVISTA 的收益在测试的人形机器人上最大，这是因为相机随驱动链运动且机器人占据画面大部分区域。
AI.conclusion: MobileVISTA 通过联合视觉增强与动作重定向，有效缓解了自我中心移动操作平台因基座姿态偏差导致的分布外问题，无需额外演示采集或生成模型即可提升策略鲁棒性，且对相机随驱动链运动、机器人占据大部分画面的人形平台收益最为显著。

title: OpenSplatGraph: From Dense Semantic Maps to Structured Scene Graphs for Open-Vocabulary Robot Perception
summary: Dense 3D mapping with semantic understanding is essential for robotic perception in complex environments. Recent 3D Gaussian Splatting-based mapping approaches enable high-fidelity geometry and efficient open-vocabulary perception, but typically represent semantics as unstructured feature fields that limit object-centric reasoning. In contrast, 3D scene graphs explicitly model objects and their relationships for structured reasoning, but are commonly constructed from sparse geometric representations that do not fully exploit dense semantic maps. In this work, we present OpenSplatGraph, a unified framework that constructs persistent 3D scene graphs directly from an online Gaussian-based open-vocabulary semantic map. The proposed framework augments the dense semantic map with a reliability-aware semantic field that maintains lightweight observation statistics for confidence-aware, query-conditioned object extraction. Extracted object instances are associated with persistent graph nodes, allowing object attributes and relationships to be incrementally updated across observations and queries. By tightly coupling dense semantic mapping with persistent object-centric representations, our framework supports both language-guided object grounding and structured relational reasoning while preserving the geometric fidelity of Gaussian-based mapping. Comprehensive evaluations on standard 3D scene understanding benchmarks and real-world robotic experiments demonstrate that OpenSplatGraph achieves competitive performance for online open-vocabulary perception and downstream robotic tasks. Project page: https://csiro-robotics.github.io/OpenSplatGraph.

AI.tldr: 提出OpenSplatGraph统一框架，直接从在线高斯式开放词汇语义地图构建持久3D场景图，实现语言引导的目标定位与结构化关系推理。
AI.motivation: 稠密3D语义地图对复杂环境机器人感知至关重要。基于3D高斯泼溅的建图方法能提供高保真几何和高效开放词汇感知，但语义以非结构化特征场表示，限制目标级推理；而3D场景图虽显式建模目标与关系，却多基于稀疏几何表示，未充分利用稠密语义地图。
AI.method: 在稠密语义地图上引入可靠性感知语义场，维护轻量观测统计以支持置信度感知、查询条件下的目标提取；将提取的目标实例关联到持久图节点，使目标属性与关系可跨观测和查询增量更新；将稠密语义建图与持久目标级表示紧耦合。
AI.result: 在标准3D场景理解基准和真实机器人实验中，该方法在在线开放词汇感知与下游机器人任务上取得有竞争力的性能，同时保持高斯建图的几何保真度。
AI.conclusion: OpenSplatGraph通过耦合稠密语义建图与持久目标级表示，兼顾高保真几何、开放词汇目标定位与结构化关系推理，适用于在线机器人感知任务。

title: Two Vectors Replace In-Context Demos: Structured Task Adaptation via Embeddings
summary: In-context learning (ICL) adapts frozen large multimodal models (LMMs) to new tasks from a few demonstrations (demos), but re-encodes them at every query, where each demo image adds up to hundreds of visual tokens. Demo-free methods remove this cost with a compact task state. However, they add it at locations searched per task or at every decoder layer, where task parameters grow with depth. Moreover, inserted tokens or keys cannot change how the original prompt divides its attention within a layer. To address these issues, we propose Structured Task Adaptation via Embeddings (STAVE), which replaces demos with two task-specific vectors added to existing input embeddings. Specifically, a readout vector updates the answer-producing tokens and a context vector updates the other structural token groups. Both are trained with answer labels on prompts with and without demos. We justify these design choices theoretically using a first-order analysis of the loss and a margin bound. Extensive experiments on six LMMs and five large language models show that STAVE matches or outperforms state-of-the-art methods on multimodal tasks with far fewer task parameters and surpasses 15-shot ICL and prior task vectors on 18 text tasks, all at zero-shot inference cost.

AI.tldr: 提出STAVE方法，用两个任务特定的嵌入向量替代演示样本，实现免演示的上下文学习，性能优于SOTA且参数极少。
AI.motivation: 上下文学习（ICL）虽能让冻结的大型多模态模型适应新任务，但每次查询都需重新编码演示样本，每张演示图像增加数百个视觉token，开销巨大。免演示方法虽能降低此成本，但其任务状态要么在每个任务中搜索位置、要么存在于每个解码器层，导致任务参数随深度增长；且插入的token或key无法改变原始提示在层内的注意力分配方式。
AI.method: 提出STAVE（Structured Task Adaptation via Embeddings），用两个任务特定的向量替代演示样本并添加到现有输入嵌入中：一个readout向量更新生成答案的token，一个context向量更新其他结构性token组。两者均在含演示和无演示的提示上用答案标签进行训练。作者通过损失的一阶分析和margin界从理论上论证了这些设计选择。
AI.result: 在六个大型多模态模型和五个大型语言模型上进行的大量实验表明，STAVE在多模态任务上以远少于SOTA方法的任务参数达到匹配或更优的性能；在18个文本任务上超越15-shot ICL和先前的任务向量，且推理成本为零样本级别。
AI.conclusion: STAVE通过结构化嵌入实现高效的任务适应，在显著减少任务参数的同时达到或超越现有方法，兼顾性能与零样本推理成本。

title: Adversarially Trained Linear Transformers Are Optimal Robust In-Context Learners for Gaussian Mixtures
summary: Adversarial training is one of the most reliable defenses against adversarial attacks, but its high computational cost must generally be paid anew for each task. Robust foundation models offer a promising alternative: adversarially pretrain a model once and then transfer its robustness to downstream tasks through lightweight adaptation. However, a fundamental question remains open: can robustness acquired during pretraining transfer to unseen tasks without further adversarial training? In this study, we answer this question affirmatively. A single model adversarially pretrained at scale can achieve optimal robustness on new tasks without additional task-specific training. Specifically, we show that, for a family of Gaussian-mixture classification tasks, a sufficiently deep linear transformer adversarially trained across tasks can asymptotically attain the robust Bayes error on previously unseen tasks through in-context learning from clean demonstrations. By contrast, a standardly trained model cannot. We further analyze convergence under gradient flow, an accuracy--robustness trade-off, and demonstration complexity.

AI.tldr: 本文从理论与实证角度回答：在大规模对抗预训练后，模型的鲁棒性可通过上下文学习迁移到未见任务，无需任务特定的额外对抗训练。
AI.motivation: 对抗训练虽是最可靠的防御手段，但计算代价高，且通常需为每个任务重新付出。鲁棒基础模型提供替代思路：一次对抗预训练、轻量适配迁移鲁棒性。然而"预训练获得的鲁棒性能否在不额外对抗训练的情况下迁移到未见任务"这一根本问题尚无定论。
AI.method: 针对一族高斯混合分类任务，采用足够深的线性Transformer，在跨任务上进行对抗预训练；随后通过上下文学习（in-context learning）仅依赖干净示范（clean demonstrations）完成新任务推断，并借助梯度流（gradient flow）分析其收敛性，同时考察准确率—鲁棒性权衡与示范复杂度。
AI.result: 单一对抗预训练模型可在全新任务上渐近达到鲁棒贝叶斯误差（robust Bayes error），即实现最优鲁棒性，且无需任务特定训练；而标准（非对抗）训练的模型无法做到这一点。论文进一步给出梯度流下的收敛性分析，以及准确率—鲁棒性权衡与示范复杂度的刻画。
AI.conclusion: 对抗鲁棒性可以在预训练阶段获得并迁移到未见任务，无需额外对抗训练，从而为鲁棒基础模型范式提供了理论支持；同时揭示了收敛行为、权衡关系与示范需求等关键性质。

title: $α$Transfer: Coefficient Transfer for Efficient Model Merging
summary: Model merging offers a promising solution for combining multiple fine-tuned checkpoints into a single model through parameter arithmetic. However, finding optimal merging coefficients requires an extensive search that becomes prohibitively expensive as models scale in both size and number, due to high memory requirements and combinatorial growth in the search space. We show that, within the same model family, models exhibit highly congruent performance distributions over merging coefficients across different model sizes. This distributional similarity enables a practical paradigm we call \textit{$α$Transfer}: searching for optimal coefficients on a small proxy model, then directly transfer them to larger target models. We verify $α$Transfer across multiple merging methods, model families, and tasks. Experimental results demonstrate a 6$\times$ speedup and 70\% memory reduction on vision transformers, and a 20$\times$ speedup and 85\% memory reduction on large language models, while maintaining comparable performance. Our findings establish $α$Transfer as an efficient and generalizable approach to scaling model merging.

AI.tldr: 提出 αTransfer：在同族模型间，合并系数的最优解可从小的代理模型搜索后直接迁移到大的目标模型，显著降低搜索成本。
AI.motivation: 模型合并需通过参数算术将多个微调检查点整合为单一模型，但寻找最优合并系数需大量搜索；随着模型规模与数量增长，搜索空间组合爆炸且内存开销高，搜索成本变得不可承受。
AI.method: 观察到同一模型族内，不同规模模型在合并系数上的性能分布高度一致（分布相似性）。基于此提出 αTransfer：在小代理模型上搜索最优合并系数，再直接迁移至更大的目标模型，无需在大模型上重新搜索。
AI.result: 在多种合并方法、模型族与任务上验证：视觉 Transformer 上实现 6× 加速与 70% 内存降低；大语言模型上实现 20× 加速与 85% 内存降低，同时保持相当性能。
AI.conclusion: αTransfer 是一种高效且可泛化的模型合并扩展方法，为大规模模型合并提供了实用范式。

title: Label-Efficient Deep Learning for ECG Delineation: A Multi-Dataset Benchmark against Widely Used Delineation Tools
comment: 20 pages, 5 figures. First two authors contributed equally
summary: Electrocardiogram (ECG) delineation, the identification of waveform boundaries, is a foundational step that translates raw ECG signals into clinically interpretable measurements. Deep learning has advanced this task but remains dependent on costly expert annotations. Label-efficient strategies such as self-supervised pretraining and semi-supervised learning are expected to ease this burden, yet it remains unclear whether they yield reliable delineation and whether the deep models they produce outperform the delineation tools used in practice. We address this in two stages. First, comparing self-supervised objectives with supervised or semi-supervised fine-tuning across one internal and four external datasets, we find that pretraining helps but the objective matters, and that the value of semi-supervised fine-tuning depends on the pretraining objective. Second, we benchmark the selected deep learning model against widely used open-source (NeuroKit2, Prominence, ECGdeli) and commercial (CalECG) tools using three complementary metrics. The model ranks best on every metric and dataset, outperforming the strongest tool by a clear margin on the rhythm-diverse set (mIoU 71.3 vs. 54.8%; averaged point-wise sensitivity 92.6 vs. 76.4%), and degrades the least from sinus to arrhythmia. A rhythm-stratified and point-wise analysis further characterizes the distinctive behavior of each tool, yielding practical guidance for tool selection. These results provide systematic, multi-dataset evidence that self-supervised pretraining is effective for ECG delineation and enables a label-efficiently trained deep learning model to outperform widely used delineation tools by leveraging abundant unlabeled data. This supports adopting such models in diverse, real-world clinical settings.

AI.tldr: 该研究分两阶段：先系统比较自监督预训练与半监督微调在ECG波形边界分割（delineation）中的标签效率，再将筛选出的深度学习模型与主流开源及商业工具在多数据集上基准对比，证明其以少量标注即可超越现有工具。
AI.motivation: ECG delineation是临床可解释测量的基础步骤，深度学习虽有进展但依赖昂贵的专家标注。自监督预训练与半监督学习理论上能缓解标注负担，但其能否带来可靠的delineation、以及所训练模型能否超越实践中常用的工具，尚不明确。
AI.method: 分两阶段：1）在1个内部数据集与4个外部数据集上，比较不同自监督目标结合监督/半监督微调的效果，分析预训练目标与微调策略的相互作用；2）用三类互补指标，将选定的深度学习模型与开源工具（NeuroKit2、Prominence、ECGdeli）和商业工具（CalECG）进行基准对比，并做节律分层与逐点分析。
AI.result: 预训练有帮助但目标函数至关重要，半监督微调的价值取决于预训练目标。在基准对比中，该模型在所有指标和数据集上均排名最佳；在节律多样集合上明显优于最强工具（mIoU 71.3% vs 54.8%；平均逐点敏感度92.6% vs 76.4%），且从窦性心律到心律失常的性能退化最小。
AI.conclusion: 研究提供了跨多数据集的系统性证据：自监督预训练对ECG delineation有效，能利用大量无标注数据实现标签高效训练，并使深度学习模型超越广泛使用的delineation工具；节律分层与逐点分析刻画了各工具的行为特征，为工具选择提供实用指导，支持在多样真实临床场景中采用此类模型。

title: Visual Abstention in Unified Multimodal Models
comment: 25 pages, 6 figures, 13 tables. Project page: https://visual-abstention.github.io
summary: Unified multimodal models (UMMs) integrate understanding and generation, yet their generative behavior is rarely governed by what they understand about the task. We formalize visual abstention: when a requested visual transformation is impossible under the task's rules, the model should recognize that no valid solution exists, state this, and decline to generate. We introduce Draw-or-Decline (DoD), a benchmark of 1,050 feasible-infeasible request pairs across 7 task categories that jointly measures editing success and the refusal of infeasible requests. Evaluating 8 UMMs, we find that editing ability and abstention are distinct capabilities: even the strongest editor, at 68.4% editing accuracy, refuses only 0.4% of infeasible requests under ordinary instructions. Their reasoning shows why: the models rarely notice the conflict, and instead plan the edit as if the request were possible, often describing objects that are not in the image, or quietly change the request into one they can complete. Explicitly prompting these UMMs to report infeasibility increases textual refusals but reduces editing accuracy. We propose VisTA (Visual Transformation and Abstention), a training method that pairs feasible and infeasible examples so that a model judges feasibility before deciding whether to generate. We train VisTA-BAGEL to perform feasible edits and decline infeasible requests. Without any reminder, it refuses 93.0% of infeasible requests, up from 0.4% for the strongest editor, while falsely refusing only 0.8% of feasible ones. Unlike a reminder, this does not cost editing accuracy: VisTA-BAGEL completes 74.3% of feasible edits, more than any of the 8 evaluated UMMs.

AI.tldr: 该论文形式化"视觉拒答"能力，提出DoD基准衡量统一多模态模型对不可行编辑请求的拒绝能力，并给出VisTA训练方法，使模型先判断可行性再生成，大幅提升拒答率且不损失编辑精度。
AI.motivation: 统一多模态模型（UMM）整合了理解与生成，但其生成行为很少受"对任务的理解"所支配：当请求的视觉变换在任务规则下不可能时，模型往往不识别无解，而是照常规划编辑。现有研究缺乏对此类"应拒绝生成"能力的度量与训练手段。
AI.method: 1) 形式化"视觉拒答"（visual abstention）：识别并声明无有效解，拒绝生成。2) 提出DoD基准，含7个任务类别、1,050对"可行-不可行"请求配对，联合衡量编辑成功率与不可行请求拒绝率。3) 提出VisTA训练方法，将可行与不可行样本配对，使模型在决定是否生成前先进行可行性判断，并训练出VisTA-BAGEL模型。
AI.result: 评估8个UMM发现编辑能力与拒答能力相互独立：最强编辑器编辑准确率68.4%，但仅拒绝0.4%的不可行请求；推理显示模型很少察觉冲突，常把请求当作可行来规划，甚至描述图中不存在的物体，或暗中把请求替换为可完成的任务。显式提示可提高文本拒绝率但会降低编辑准确率。VisTA-BAGEL在无提示情况下拒绝93.0%的不可行请求（原为0.4%），对可行请求误拒仅0.8%；且完成74.3%的可行编辑，超过所评估的全部8个UMM。
AI.conclusion: 编辑能力与拒答能力是两种独立能力，显式提示存在"拒答—编辑精度"的权衡。VisTA通过配对可行/不可行样本的可行性前置判断训练，可在不牺牲编辑精度的前提下获得高拒答率与低误拒率，为统一多模态模型引入"知其不能而止"的能力。

title: OpenWAM: An Open Framework for Composable World-Action Models
comment: 18 pages, 5 figures, 14 tables. Project page: https://openwam.stanford.edu ; Code: https://github.com/OpenWAM/OpenWAM ; Code and project page released June 4, 2026. Equal contribution: Heng Yu, David D. Yuan, Juze Zhang
summary: World-action models (WAMs) couple future prediction with robot control, yet existing systems often vary the video backbone, interaction structure, supervision, and inference procedure simultaneously, making their design choices difficult to compare. We introduce OPENWAM, an open world-action modeling framework built around a common causal robot-video foundation and configurable video-action interaction. Starting from Wan2.2-5B, we perform causal robot-video pretraining on over 10,000 hours of video, then integrate an action expert through a shared Mixture-of-Transformers architecture that supports joint, video-then-action, action-then-video, and decoupled generation. OPENWAM achieves high success rates on four LIBERO suites and real-world bimanual tasks; robot-video training with causal adaptation improves VTA success on LIBERO-Long from 68.4% to 97.8%. The same configurable architecture naturally extends to inverse and forward dynamics, allowing us to study how counterfactual transitions improve independently trained dynamics models beyond demonstrations alone. When only the video predictor is adapted to a new task, a frozen local-context inverse dynamics model trained on counterfactual data and demonstrations achieves 84.0% mean success across four held-out LIBERO-90 tasks, compared with 47.0% for a full-context inverse model and 21.5% for a local-context model trained only on demonstrations. For forward dynamics, counterfactual supervision reduces RGB prediction error by 34.5% and raises outcome identification from 21.1% to 71.3% among 16 same-state outcomes. OPENWAM provides a common testbed for comparing WAM interaction designs and for studying dynamics learning from video data beyond successful demonstrations.

AI.tldr: OPENWAM 提出一个开放的世界-动作建模框架，以统一的因果机器人视频基础模型搭配可配置的视频-动作交互结构，系统比较多种交互与动力学学习设计。
AI.motivation: 现有世界-动作模型（WAMs）在视频骨干、交互结构、监督信号与推理流程上同时变化，导致设计选择难以归因和比较，缺乏统一测试平台。
AI.method: 以 Wan2.2-5B 为起点，在超过 10,000 小时视频上进行因果机器人视频预训练；通过共享 Mixture-of-Transformers 架构接入动作专家，支持联合、先视频后动作、先动作后视频与解耦四种生成方式；该架构可自然扩展到逆动力学与前向动力学，并引入反事实转移监督。
AI.result: 在四个 LIBERO 套件与真实双臂任务上取得高成功率；因果自适应的机器人视频训练将 LIBERO-Long 的 VTA 成功率从 68.4% 提升至 97.8%。逆动力学中，冻结的局部上下文模型结合反事实与示范数据在四个留出 LIBERO-90 任务上达 84.0% 平均成功率（全上下文 47.0%，仅示范局部 21.5%）。前向动力学中，反事实监督降低 34.5% RGB 预测误差，并将 16 个同状态结果识别率从 21.1% 提升至 71.3%。
AI.conclusion: OPENWAM 为比较 WAM 交互设计提供了通用测试平台，并展示了从超越成功示范的视频数据中学习动力学（逆/前向）的价值。

title: A Broader Look at Model Merging: Rethinking Implicit Regularization Induced by Task Arithmetic
summary: Model merging aims to build a multi-task model cheaply by combining the weights of individual task-specific models. To perform well across multiple tasks, most existing merging methods use an additional dataset to find the coefficients for the best linear combination of task-specific weight updates. However, we identify an implicit regularization in this standard practice: searching over coefficients restricts the candidate models to a subspace spanned by task-specific weight updates. In this work, we investigate whether this regularization is actually useful. Surprisingly, empirical results show that optimizing merged-model weights without this regularization significantly boosts the performance of common merging methods across multiple architectures, domains, and even in an extremely data-limited scenario where only one instance is available per class. Moreover, directly optimizing the pretrained model weights even outperforms some existing merging methods. Analysis shows that better multi-task weights exist outside the subspace and can be found using multiple methods. We study different strategies for using the additional dataset, discussing their practical use and implications for model merging. Overall, this work calls for revisiting the existing model-merging pipeline, motivating a broader exploration of the weight space and a reconsideration of the implicit regularization induced by task arithmetic.

AI.tldr: 本文发现模型合并中"搜索系数做任务向量线性组合"这一标准做法隐含正则化，该正则化把候选模型限制在任务权重更新张成的子空间内，并非有益；去掉该限制直接优化合并权重可显著提升性能。
AI.motivation: 现有模型合并方法为廉价构建多任务模型，通常借助一个额外数据集在全量任务向量上搜索最优线性组合系数。作者识别出这一常规做法中存在隐含正则化：系数搜索把候选模型约束在任务特定权重更新所张成的子空间内，因此需要考察这种正则化是否真的有用。
AI.method: 作者移除该子空间约束，改为在完整权重空间中直接优化合并模型权重（乃至直接优化预训练模型权重），并在多种架构、多个领域以及每类仅一个样本的极端数据受限场景下，与常见合并方法进行对比；同时分析子空间外是否存在更优多任务权重，并研究额外数据集的不同使用策略。
AI.result: 去掉隐含正则化后，常见合并方法的性能在多种架构和领域上显著提升，在每类仅一个实例的极端数据受限场景下同样有效；直接优化预训练模型权重甚至优于部分现有合并方法。分析表明子空间之外确实存在更优的多任务权重，且可用多种方法找到。
AI.conclusion: 该工作呼吁重新审视现有模型合并流程，激励对权重空间进行更广泛的探索，并重新思考任务算术所引入的隐含正则化；同时讨论了额外数据集不同使用方式的实用性及对模型合并的启示。

title: Optimization Encoders: Rethinking Second-Order Meta-Learning for Neural Fields
summary: Conditional neural fields represent signals continuously, but their effectiveness depends on how the conditional latent representations are inferred from observed data. In meta-learning, this encoding occurs through gradient updates induced by the decoder, tying representation learning directly to decoder design. We formalize this connection by interpreting latent optimization as an optimization encoder, unifying the roles of second-order differentiation, latent parameterization, and task supervision. This concept enables second-order meta-learning for end-to-end training of the encoding procedure alongside the decoder, and clarifies which learning pathway first-order approximations discard. Guided by this view, we introduce Attentive Latent Fields (MetaLF), an equivariant transformer-based neural field that contextualizes a latent pointcloud through self-attention. These interactions shape both field predictions and the updates that construct their representation, allowing local observations to inform coherent non-local structure. Disentangling the inner encoding objective from outer task supervision unifies reconstruction, classification, and segmentation within an end-to-end meta-learning framework, using reconstruction-only latent adaptation at test time. Controlled experiments on polynomial fields link latent coordination to lower effective rank and stronger alignment with the underlying function space. Across image and 3D shape reconstruction, MetaLF improves fidelity within three to five gradient updates, while supporting semantic prediction across images, shapes, and volumes. Together, these findings position the optimization encoder perspective as a unified basis for designing neural fields around how representations are constructed, coordinated, and used.

AI.tldr: 论文将元学习中的隐变量优化过程形式化为"优化编码器"，统一了二阶微分、隐参数化与任务监督的作用，并提出基于等变Transformer的Attentive Latent Fields（MetaLF），在图像与3D形状重建及语义预测上以少量梯度更新即取得更优表现。
AI.motivation: 条件神经场能连续表示信号，但其效果依赖如何从观测数据推断条件隐表示。在元学习中，这种编码由解码器诱导的梯度更新完成，使表示学习与解码器设计强绑定；但此前缺乏对二者关系的统一理解，也不清楚一阶近似究竟丢弃了哪条学习路径。
AI.method: 作者将隐变量优化解释为"优化编码器"，由此统一二阶微分、隐参数化与任务监督三种角色，支持对编码过程与解码器进行端到端二阶元学习训练。基于该视角提出MetaLF：一种等变Transformer神经场，通过自注意力对隐点云进行上下文化，使交互同时塑造场预测与构建表示的更新，并将内层编码目标与外层任务监督解耦，在测试时仅用重建做隐适应。
AI.result: 在多项式场上的对照实验表明，隐变量协调可带来更低的有效秩以及与底层函数空间更强的对齐。在图像与3D形状重建中，MetaLF在三至五次梯度更新内提升保真度，并支持跨图像、形状与体数据的语义预测。
AI.conclusion: "优化编码器"视角为神经场设计提供了统一基础，使研究者围绕表示如何被构建、协调与使用来设计神经场，并将重建、分类与分割统一于端到端元学习框架中。

title: Mu-DisCoCat: A Variational Pipeline for Compositional Generalization on Quantum Processors
summary: Achieving compositional concept generalization (CoCoGen), the ability to understand novel situations by recombining learned primitives, remains a fundamental challenge in artificial intelligence. Compositional semantic models such as Compositional Distributional Semantics (DisCoCat) offer solutions by generalising vectors to tensors, but suffer from scaling bottlenecks when learning the tensors. Mapping DisCoCat onto Variational Quantum Circuits (VQCs) resolves this limitation for text, yet the methodology has not been expanded to multimodal situations such as the ones involved in CoCoGen. This paper introduces Mu-DisCoCat: a multimodal variational quantum learning framework for DisCoCat that achieves CoCoGen. The framework first learns stable object representations from single-object image-text pairs, then fixes these and uses them to learn the relations between them in multi-object situations. In classical simulations, the model used Uhlmann state fidelity to compute the overlap between the multimodal circuit representations and achieved higher relational OOD accuracy than the evaluated CLIP baseline. Its deployment was evaluated using the destructive SWAP test across noisy quantum emulators, including a range of IBM fake backends, IQM FakeAphrodite, and the IBM Marrakesh quantum processor. Despite real-world device noise, the hardware-executed models maintained a strong positive correlation with simulated fidelities, reliably distinguishing unseen similar and dissimilar pairs. Our work establishes a framework for executing CoCoGen on VQCs, demonstrating a viable use case for near-term quantum hardware.

AI.tldr: Mu-DisCoCat:首个面向多模态组合概念泛化(CoCoGen)的多模态变分量子学习框架,将DisCoCat映射到变分量子电路,在噪声量子硬件上实现了对未见组合关系的可靠区分。
AI.motivation: 组合概念泛化(CoCoGen)——即通过重组已学基元来理解新情境的能力——仍是AI的根本挑战。组合分布语义模型(如DisCoCat)通过把向量推广为张量来应对,但在学习张量时存在扩展瓶颈。将其映射到变分量子电路(VQC)已在纯文本上缓解该瓶颈,但尚未扩展到CoCoGen所涉及的多模态场景。
AI.method: 提出Mu-DisCoCat多模态变分量子学习框架:先从句对(单物体图文对)中学习稳定的物体表示,随后将其固定,用于多物体情境中学习物体间的关系。经典模拟中使用Uhlmann态保真度计算多模态电路表示之间的重叠;实际部署时采用破坏性SWAP测试(destructive SWAP test),在含噪量子模拟器(多个IBM fake后端、IQM FakeAphrodite)及IBM Marrakesh量子处理器上评估。
AI.result: 经典模拟中,模型的关系型分布外(OOD)准确率高于所评估的CLIP基线。尽管存在真实器件噪声,硬件执行的模型与模拟保真度之间保持强正相关,能够可靠区分未见的相似与不相似配对。
AI.conclusion: 该工作建立了在VQC上执行CoCoGen的框架,展示了近期量子硬件的一个可行用例。

title: VLA-ACL: Action-Consistent Visual Token Pruning for Efficient Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models achieve strong robotic manipulation performance but incur high computational costs from processing long token sequences at every control step, limiting real-time deployment. Visual token pruning offers a direct solution, as visual patches dominate the input sequence and contain considerable redundancy. Existing approaches, however, either rely on indirect training-free heuristics, such as attention scores and motion thresholds, or require costly fine-tuning of the base VLA model. We introduce VLA-ACL (Action Consistency Learning), which learns a lightweight visual token pruning policy through action-level supervision while keeping the base VLA model entirely frozen. The training objective encourages actions produced from pruned visual contexts to remain consistent with the full-context teacher, with ground-truth actions as auxiliary supervision. This directly ties token selection to its effect on the downstream control output. Experiments on LIBERO and real-world manipulation tasks show that VLA-ACL prunes up to 87.5% of visual tokens while retaining competitive performance, reduces computation by up to 75%, and achieves a 1.5x inference speedup. These results establish a stronger performance-efficiency trade-off than existing frozen-VLA pruning methods and demonstrate the value of action-level supervision for visual token selection. Code is available at https://github.com/du-owen/VLA-ACL.

AI.tldr: VLA-ACL：在不微调基础VLA模型的前提下，通过动作级监督学习轻量视觉token剪枝策略，实现最高87.5%视觉token剪枝、75%计算量降低与1.5倍推理加速，同时保持竞争性操纵性能。
AI.motivation: VLA模型在每个控制步需处理长token序列，计算开销大、难以实时部署；视觉patch占输入序列主导且高度冗余。现有剪枝方法要么依赖注意力分数、运动阈值等间接的无训练启发式，要么需对基础VLA模型进行昂贵微调，均未将token选择与下游控制输出直接关联。
AI.method: 提出VLA-ACL（Action Consistency Learning）。保持基础VLA模型完全冻结，仅训练一个轻量级视觉token剪枝策略。训练目标要求剪枝后视觉上下文产生的动作与全上下文教师模型保持一致（动作一致性），并以真值动作作为辅助监督，从而将token选择直接绑定到其对控制输出的影响。
AI.result: 在LIBERO基准与真实世界操纵任务上：剪除最高87.5%视觉token仍保持竞争性性能，计算量降低最高75%，推理加速1.5倍。相比现有冻结VLA剪枝方法取得更优的性能-效率权衡。
AI.conclusion: 动作级监督对视觉token选择具有重要价值，VLA-ACL证明了在基础模型冻结条件下通过动作一致性学习可实现显著的性能-效率增益。代码已开源：https://github.com/du-owen/VLA-ACL。

title: How Many Independent Samples Does a Satellite Image Contain? Generalization Bounds for Spatially Dependent Data
summary: Machine learning classifiers for remote sensing imagery are typically evaluated as though every pixel were an independent sample. Spatial autocorrelation violates this assumption, since neighboring pixels carry redundant information which inflates sample sizes. How many independent samples does a satellite image actually contain? For an $n \times n$ image whose spatial correlation persists over a range of $r$ pixels, the effective sample size is $Θ(n^2/r^2)$, not $n^2$. We prove this as a finite-sample upper bound for classifiers on spatially correlated data, and show via a matching lower bound that the rate is tight, and no algorithm can do better. We extend the results to images with directional correlation and spatially varying correlation structure. Our result justifies spatial cross-validation since block holdout with separation proportional to the correlation range achieves optimal generalization guarantees, while random holdout can underestimate confidence interval widths by a factor proportional to $r$. We validate the theory on synthetic data and satellite image tiles from three sensors (Landsat 8, Sentinel-2, and Sentinel-1).

AI.tldr: 该论文证明：对空间相关的遥感图像，分类器有效样本量为 Θ(n²/r²)，而非 n²，并为空间交叉验证提供了理论依据。
AI.motivation: 遥感影像分类通常假设像素独立同分布，但空间自相关使相邻像素携带冗余信息，人为放大样本量、导致评估过于乐观。作者试图回答：一幅卫星影像究竟包含多少独立样本。
AI.method: 理论上，对相关范围（correlation range）为 r 像素的 n×n 图像，证明有效样本量为 Θ(n²/r²)，给出有限样本上界，并用匹配下界论证该速率是紧的、无算法可超越；进一步扩展到方向性相关和空间变化相关结构。在合成数据及 Landsat 8、Sentinel-2、Sentinel-1 三种传感器的卫星影像瓦片上验证理论。
AI.result: 有效样本量确为 Θ(n²/r²)；随机留出（random holdout）可将置信区间宽度低估约正比于 r 的因子；而分离度与相关范围成正比的块状留出（block holdout）可达最优泛化保证。
AI.conclusion: 研究为空间交叉验证的合理性提供了理论支撑，说明应按空间块而非随机划分数据，以正确评估遥感分类器的泛化性能。

title: WareFly-VLA: A Vision-Language-Action Framework for UAV Navigation and Human Tracking in Smart Warehouses
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have achieved impressive results in robotic manipulation and ground-mobile navigation, yet language-conditioned control of unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) in smart warehouses remains largely unexplored, hindered by the lack of benchmarks that jointly provide continuous low-level flight actions, fine-grained natural-language target descriptions, and realistic industrial environments. This paper introduces WareFly-VLA, a photorealistic UAV VLA framework and dataset for language-guided human search, localization, and tracking in warehouse environments. It contains 507 human-teleoperated flight episodes and 8,504 high-resolution RGB transitions collected in NVIDIA Isaac Sim, each paired with a human-written appearance description of the target worker and a synchronized four-degree-of-freedom control command. Two aerial tasks are covered: target approach and person following, under occlusion, long-range search, altitude variation, and clutter. A unified benchmark of four open-source VLA architectures (SmolVLA, GR00T N1.7, pi_0 and OpenVLA) is established under a leakage-free episode-level protocol at two control rates. The results show that language-conditioned aerial control in warehouses is far from solved: performance drops substantially under strict generalization settings, continuous action modeling consistently outperforms discrete action tokenization, only the forward channel is reliably learnable from a single frame, and current foundation-model interfaces transfer poorly from ground and humanoid embodiments to aerial platforms. The synchronized video, language, action, pose, and difficulty annotations further support world-model research. The dataset, baselines, and evaluation protocol are released to support language-grounded aerial autonomy in smart warehouses.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出WareFly-VLA，一个面向智能仓库中语言引导无人机搜人、定位与跟踪的光真实感VLA框架与数据集，包含507段人工遥操作飞行episode和8,504条高分辨率RGB转换，并建立了4种开源VLA架构的基准评测。
AI.motivation: VLA模型在机器人操作与地面移动导航上表现优异，但智能仓库中语言条件下的无人机控制几乎未被探索，主要障碍是缺乏同时具备连续低级飞行动作、细粒度自然语言目标描述和真实工业环境的基准。
AI.method: 基于NVIDIA Isaac Sim构建WareFly-VLA数据集：507段人工遥操作飞行episode、8,504条高分辨率RGB转换，每条配有目标工人的外观描述与同步四自由度控制指令；覆盖目标接近与人员跟随两类空中任务，涉及遮挡、远距离搜索、高度变化和杂乱环境。在无泄漏的episode级协议下、两种控制频率下，对SmolVLA、GR00T N1.7、pi_0和OpenVLA四种开源VLA架构进行统一基准评测。
AI.result: 仓库中语言条件的空中控制远未解决：严格泛化设置下性能大幅下降；连续动作建模持续优于离散动作token化；单帧输入下仅前向通道可可靠学习；现有基础模型接口从地面与人形本体向空中平台迁移效果差。
AI.conclusion: 同步的视频、语言、动作、位姿与难度标注支持世界模型研究；数据集、基线与评测协议已公开，以推动智能仓库中语言接地的空中自主性研究。

title: Less Is More: A Leakage-Controlled Study of Dermoscopic Preprocessing for Joint Skin Lesion Classification and Segmentation with YOLO26
summary: Handcrafted preprocessing is widely employed in automated dermoscopic analysis to suppress imaging artifacts and enhance lesion visibility. Nevertheless, its actual contribution to modern real-time models remains unclear, particularly when evaluation protocols do not adequately control correlations among images of the same lesion. This study presents a leakage-controlled, lesion-disjoint evaluation of dermoscopic preprocessing and augmentation for joint multi-class lesion classification and instance segmentation using a fixed nano-scale YOLO26 segmentation model (YOLO26n-seg). From HAM10000 (10,015 images), quality control yields 10,013 valid image-mask pairs from 7,468 unique lesions, partitioned into mutually exclusive sets by lesion identity. With the architecture, resolution, training budget, and evaluation protocol held fixed, we compare minimally processed images plus online augmentation against offline class balancing, DullRazor-CLAHE preprocessing, and raw-processed hybrid views, over three random seeds. On the lesion-disjoint test set, the raw baseline achieves a mask mAP$_{50:95}$ of $0.5636 \pm 0.0234$, a Dice score of $0.9356 \pm 0.0024$, and a macro-F1 score of $0.6917 \pm 0.0202$. Offline augmentation does not improve the mean performance, while the combined and hybrid strategies reduce both class-aware segmentation and classification accuracy. At only 2.69 million parameters, the model runs at approximately 50 frames per second. Under a leakage-controlled, lesion-disjoint protocol with all non-input factors held fixed, minimally processed dermoscopic images combined with standard online augmentation deliver a better accuracy-efficiency trade-off than increasingly complex deterministic preprocessing, which yields no consistent joint benefit across three seeds on HAM10000.

AI.tldr: 本文在病变不相交（lesion-disjoint）的防泄漏评估协议下，固定YOLO26n-seg模型与全部非输入因素，比较多种皮肤镜预处理/增广策略，发现最小化预处理+在线增广在精度与效率权衡上优于复杂确定性预处理，且后者无稳定联合提升。
AI.motivation: 手工预处理在皮肤镜自动化分析中被广泛用于抑制成像伪影、增强病变可见性，但其对现代实时模型的真实贡献不明；尤其在评估协议未能充分控制同一病变图像间相关性时（数据泄漏），结论可能被高估。
AI.method: 基于HAM10000（10,015张图像）经质量控制得到10,013个有效图像-掩码对、覆盖7,468个唯一病变，按病变身份划分互斥数据集；固定nano级YOLO26分割模型（YOLO26n-seg）、分辨率、训练预算与评估协议，在3个随机种子上对比：最小预处理+在线增广（基线）、离线类别平衡、DullRazor-CLAHE预处理、原始-处理混合视图；任务是多类病变联合分类与实例分割。
AI.result: 在病变不相交测试集上，原始基线取得mask mAP50:95 = 0.5636 ± 0.0234、Dice = 0.9356 ± 0.0024、macro-F1 = 0.6917 ± 0.0202；离线增广未提升平均性能，组合策略与混合视图同时降低类别感知分割与分类精度；模型仅2.69M参数，速度约50 FPS。
AI.conclusion: 在防泄漏、病变不相交且固定非输入因素的协议下，最小处理的皮肤镜图像配合标准在线增广，比日益复杂的确定性预处理具有更好的精度-效率权衡；后者在HAM10000上跨三个种子无一致的联合收益。

title: WorldSonus: Bringing Sound to Worlds
comment: 25 pages, 4 figures, 16 tables. Project page: https://noizai.github.io/WorldSonus/
summary: Recent advances in world models have enabled increasingly realistic visual synthesis. However, these generated environments remain largely silent. Bringing sound to world models poses three core challenges: real-time generation to keep pace with interactive video streams, interactive control to respond to mid-stream sound instructions, and spatially aligned stereo to reflect scene geometry and camera motion. To address these demands, we introduce WorldSonus, an interactive video-to-audio framework designed for real-time spatial sound synthesis in world models. For real-time generation, WorldSonus employs a streaming causal autoregressive diffusion architecture that synthesizes audio chunks at a low real-time factor (RTF) of 0.41. For interactive control, we incorporate an audio-centric captioning pipeline with chunk-indexed prompt scheduling, enabling dynamic manipulation of sound events during generation. For spatial alignment, we leverage high-quality stereo supervision curated from diverse stereo and ambisonic data. Extensive experiments demonstrate that while tailored for world models, WorldSonus generalizes effectively to open-domain video-to-audio benchmarks, matching or outperforming state-of-the-art bidirectional models in both acoustic quality and spatial alignment. Project page: https://noizai.github.io/WorldSonus/

AI.tldr: WorldSonus是一个面向世界模型的交互式视频到音频框架，实现实时、可交互、空间对齐的立体声合成。
AI.motivation: 世界模型生成的视觉环境日益逼真，但大多无声；为世界模型配声面临三大挑战：实时生成以匹配交互视频流、响应流中声音指令的交互控制、以及反映场景几何与相机运动的空间对齐立体声。
AI.method: 采用流式因果自回归扩散架构分块合成音频（RTF 0.41）；引入以音频为中心的描述生成管线与分块索引的提示调度实现动态控制；利用从立体声与环绕声（ambisonic）数据中整理的高质量立体声监督实现空间对齐。
AI.result: 实验表明WorldSonus在声学质量与空间对齐上匹配或超越最先进的双向模型，并有效泛化到开放域视频到音频基准。
AI.conclusion: WorldSonus为世界模型提供实时、可交互、空间对齐的立体声合成能力，同时具备良好的跨域泛化性能。

title: DepthWorld: 3D World Model for Robot Manipulation
comment: Accepted at the Conference on Robot Learning (CoRL) 2026. Project page: https://www.jaibardhan.com/depthworld. 32 pages including supplementary material, 15 figures, 7 tables
summary: World models offer a data-driven alternative to traditional simulators for robotics, with applications spanning policy evaluation, improvement, and planning. All of these uses depend on faithful 3D geometry, yet current video-based world models are trained on RGB alone and produce rollouts that look correct frame-by-frame but do not compose into a consistent 3D world. Closing this gap requires progress on two fronts: large-scale 3D supervision for manipulation, and an architecture that can absorb it without disturbing strong pretrained video priors. We introduce a calibration pipeline that combines learned stereo depth with a joint factor graph, pooling all episodes collected from the same physical robot to recover its shared kinematic parameters alongside per-scene extrinsics. Applied to the DROID dataset, this yields DROID-3D, a calibrated 3D dataset providing dense metric depth and recalibrated multi-view extrinsics (achieving <0.7 px reprojection error on 90% of episodes for external cameras). We then train DepthWorld, a Stable Video Diffusion-based world model that jointly predicts multi-view RGB and depth via spatial latent tiling, leaving the pretrained Variational Autoencoder (VAE) unchanged. Depth supervision improves RGB prediction itself by +1.48 dB PSNR over an identical RGB-only baseline at equal training budget, while simultaneously yielding accurate metric depth for downstream geometric reasoning.

AI.tldr: 该论文针对视频世界模型缺乏一致3D几何的问题，提出联合标定流程构建DROID-3D数据集，并训练多视图RGB-Depth世界模型DepthWorld。
AI.motivation: 传统机器人仿真器依赖人工建模，世界模型提供了数据驱动的替代方案，可用于策略评估、改进与规划。然而这些用途都依赖忠实的三维几何，而现有基于视频的世界模型仅用RGB训练，其推演虽然逐帧看起来正确，却无法组合成一致的三维世界。要弥合这一差距，需在两个方向取得进展：面向操作任务的大规模三维监督，以及能够吸收该监督而不破坏强预训练视频先验的架构。
AI.method: 1) 标定流程：将学习到的立体深度与联合因子图结合，把同一物理机器人采集的所有episode汇集起来，联合恢复共享的运动学参数与逐场景外参；应用于DROID数据集得到DROID-3D，提供稠密度量深度与重新标定的多视图外参。2) DepthWorld：基于Stable Video Diffusion的世界模型，通过空间隐变量分块（spatial latent tiling）联合预测多视图RGB与深度，同时保持预训练VAE不变。
AI.result: DROID-3D在90%的episode上达到外部相机重投影误差<0.7 px。DepthWorld在相同训练预算下，深度监督使RGB预测本身较相同RGB-only基线提升+1.48 dB PSNR，同时能输出准确的度量深度用于下游几何推理。
AI.conclusion: 通过大规模三维标定监督与不破坏预训练视频先验的多视图RGB-Depth架构，可同时提升RGB生成质量并提供可用的度量深度，为忠实三维几何的世界模型奠定基础。

title: Generalizable Robustness Testing of DNN-Based Robotic Navigation Systems via XAI-Guided Search
summary:
**Context:** Deep Neural Networks (DNNs) increasingly control Cyber-Physical Systems (CPSs), yet small input perturbations can cause unsafe system-level behavior. Existing approaches often optimize perturbations for individual images and evaluate them only in simulation, limiting their generalizability and practical validity.
  **Objectives:** This work aims to generate robustness tests that remain effective across operational observations and to evaluate whether the resulting failures transfer from simulation to a physical robot.
  **Methods:** We propose an explainability-guided multi-objective evolutionary approach that generates sparse perturbations over representative images selected through visual and behavioral clustering. Aggregated Integrated Gradients guide mutations toward influential image regions. We evaluate the approach on a DNN-controlled LeoRover in Gazebo, conduct an ablation study, and validate a stratified subset of perturbations on the physical robot.
  **Results:** The approach achieved a median success rate of 70.0%, compared with 53.85% for unguided search, and increased median hypervolume from 0.65 to 0.73. Multi-image optimization improved the success rate from 50.0% to 57.5%, while XAI guidance further increased it to 70.0%. In the sim-to-real evaluation, simulation achieved 0.95 precision and 0.67 recall, and simulated and physical failure times showed a significant positive correlation of 0.617.
  **Conclusion:** Combining multi-image optimization with explainability-guided search improves robustness testing for DNN-controlled robotic systems. Simulation effectively identifies and prioritizes transferable failures, but physical validation remains necessary because some real-world failures are not reproduced in simulation.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一种可解释性引导的多目标进化方法，用于生成跨多张图像有效的稀疏对抗扰动，并在仿真与真实机器人上验证DNN控制CPS的鲁棒性测试可迁移性。
AI.motivation: DNN日益用于控制信息物理系统（CPS），但微小输入扰动即可导致系统级不安全行为。现有方法多针对单张图像优化扰动，且仅在仿真中评估，泛化性与实际有效性受限。
AI.method: 提出可解释性引导的多目标进化方法：通过视觉与行为聚类筛选代表性图像，在其上生成稀疏扰动；利用聚合的Integrated Gradients引导变异方向，聚焦有影响力的图像区域。在Gazebo中由DNN控制的LeoRover上评估，开展消融实验，并对分层子集扰动在实体机器人上验证。
AI.result: 中位成功率达70.0%，优于无引导搜索的53.85%；中位超体积由0.65提升至0.73。多图像优化将成功率从50.0%提升至57.5%，XAI引导进一步提升至70.0%。仿真到现实评估中，仿真精度0.95、召回0.67，仿真与实体失效时间呈显著正相关（0.617）。
AI.conclusion: 多图像优化结合可解释性引导搜索可提升DNN控制机器人系统的鲁棒性测试效果。仿真能有效识别并优先排序可迁移失效，但部分真实失效无法在仿真中复现，因此实体验证仍属必要。

title: RMRRT: Riemannian Barrier Metric RRT for Inequality-Aware Steering on Equality Manifolds
summary: This paper presents a motion planning framework that unifies equality and inequality constraints within a single geometric formulation for sampling-based planning in high-dimensional robotic systems. In conventional sampling-based planners, equality constraints are typically enforced through projection, whereas inequality constraints are handled separately through binary validity checks such as collision testing, often leading to inefficient exploration. To address this limitation, we propose Riemannian Barrier Metric RRT (RMRRT), which constructs a unified local geometry for planning on equality-constrained manifolds. RMRRT first builds an ambient barrier metric from inequality-sensitive barrier terms and then induces a tangent-space metric via a (G)-orthogonal projection associated with the equality constraints. The resulting tangent-space metric is used consistently in both steering and nearest-neighbor selection, biasing exploration away from nearby inequality boundaries while preserving first-order equality consistency. In this work, the metric is instantiated from signed-distance-based geometric proxy inequalities to provide collision-informative tangent-space directions; hard feasibility is enforced separately through standard validity checks. Experimental results show that RMRRT achieves a 100% success rate across diverse constrained manipulation tasks in both simulation and real-world settings, while reducing planning time relative to representative constrained planning baselines. Ablation studies further demonstrate that the proposed metric improves exploration quality by reducing rejected samples and shortening path length. Experiment videos and source code are available at: https://rmrrt-anonymous.github.io

AI.tldr: 本文提出RMRRT，将等式与不等式约束统一到一个黎曼几何框架中，用于高维机器人采样规划。
AI.motivation: 传统采样规划中，等式约束靠投影、不等式约束靠二值有效性检查（如碰撞检测）分别处理，导致探索效率低。作者希望统一二者以提升探索质量。
AI.method: RMRRT先由不等式敏感障碍项构造环境空间障碍度量，再经与等式约束相关的G-正交投影诱导切空间度量；该度量一致用于steering和最近邻选择，使探索偏向远离不等式边界，同时保持一阶等式一致性。度量由基于signed distance的几何代理不等式实例化，硬可行性仍由标准有效性检查保证。
AI.result: 在仿真和真实环境的多种约束操作任务中达到100%成功率，并较代表性约束规划基线减少规划时间；消融实验表明该度量通过减少被拒样本和缩短路径长度提升探索质量。
AI.conclusion: 统一的黎曼障碍度量可有效整合等式与不等式约束，提升高维约束采样规划的成功率与效率，代码与视频已公开。

title: Geometric Coherence via Weighted Matching for 3D Heterogeneous Multi-Agent Reach-Avoid Games
comment: ICRA 2026 Workshop on Multi-Agent Robotic Systems: Real-World Collaboration and Interaction
summary: We study assignment quality in 3D heterogeneous multi-agent reach-avoid games and identify a recurring failure mode of cardinality-only matching in geometrically structured scenarios, which we term \emph{Geometric Sprawl}. In these cases, multiple maximum-cardinality assignments are available, but some induce spatially incoherent pairings and inefficient pursuit trajectories. Building on the evasion-space framework of Yan et al.~\cite{yan2022}, we introduce a cardinality-first weighted sequential matching method in which the Hamilton--Jacobi--Isaacs interception value $z_I(s,j)$ is used as a secondary assignment weight. Each sequential stage is solved with a min-cost max-flow backend, while the unweighted baseline uses the same solver with the weight term removed. We evaluate both methods on a deterministic 35-scenario benchmark (7 families & 5 initialization variants) under two regimes: a diagnostic stationary-unmatched setting and a hybrid saddle-point setting with goal-directed unmatched evaders. On this benchmark, the weighted method resolves 13 of 15 geometric stress-test instances that cause repeated timeouts for the unweighted baseline in the diagnostic regime, and under the hybrid regime improves mean captures from $3.20$ to $3.91$ (22\% increase) and mean interception height from $3.87$ to $5.36$ (40\% increase). We also report lower path tortuosity and lower angular-effort proxy values, suggesting smoother pursuit trajectories in this first-order simulation model. We release the simulator and benchmark suite at \href{https://github.com/Prajwal-Vijay/geometric-coherence-weighted-matching}{github.com/Prajwal-Vijay/geometric-coherence-weighted-matching} to support reproducible evaluation of assignment strategies for 3D reach-avoid games.

AI.tldr: 本文研究3D异构多智能体reach-avoid博弈中的任务分配质量，提出"几何蔓延(Geometric Sprawl)"失效模式，并设计一种基数优先的加权序贯匹配方法，以HJI截获值作为次级权重，在基准上显著优于仅基数的匹配基线。
AI.motivation: 在几何结构化场景中，仅以基数(cardinality)为目标的匹配存在反复出现的失效模式：虽存在多个最大基数分配，但部分分配产生空间上不连贯的配对，导致低效的追捕轨迹（作者称之为Geometric Sprawl）。需要一种兼顾分配基数与几何一致性的匹配方法。
AI.method: 基于Yan等人的evasion-space框架，提出基数优先的加权序贯匹配：以Hamilton-Jacobi-Isaacs截获值z_I(s,j)作为次级分配权重，每个序贯阶段用最小费用最大流(min-cost max-flow)求解；无权重基线使用相同求解器但去掉权重项。在确定性35场景基准（7个族×5种初始化变体）上评测，包含诊断性静止未匹配设定与混合鞍点（未匹配逃逸者具目标导向）设定。
AI.result: 在诊断设定下，加权方法解决了15个几何压力测试实例中的13个（这些实例使无权重基线反复超时）；在混合设定下，平均捕获数从3.20提升至3.91（+22%），平均截获高度从3.87提升至5.36（+40%）。同时路径曲折度与角度努力代理指标更低，表明该一阶仿真模型中追捕轨迹更平滑。
AI.conclusion: 以HJI截获值为权重的基数优先序贯匹配可有效缓解Geometric Sprawl，提升3D reach-avoid博弈的分配与追捕性能，并给出更平滑轨迹；作者开源仿真器与基准套件以支持可复现评测。

title: Does a Learned Corrector Beat a Simple Retreat? Evidence from a Frozen VLA
summary: Before deploying runtime recovery for a frozen vision-language-action (VLA) policy, one must establish that an intervention improves success beyond ordinary run-to-run variation and that its complexity adds value over a simple action. We evaluate these questions on frozen $π_{0.5}$ across four RoboTwin tasks. For each test seed, we pair rollouts with and without correction and include a same-seed base-policy re-run as a placebo. Seed-cluster intervals and prespecified comparison rules assess net gains against stochastic outcome changes. Across 3,888 paired episodes, the full pipeline raises success on beat_allowbreak block_allowbreak hammer by $+13.5$\,pp (95\% interval $[+9.4,+17.7]$), with no detectable gain on the other three tasks at the deployed weight. Among failed base episodes on the responsive task, $43.2\%$ succeed on a plain re-run, compared with $63.5\%$ after correction; many nominal rescues therefore reflect the base policy's own variability. A fixed-time trigger and scripted return to an earlier joint configuration produce a net gain with no detected difference from the learned pipeline across two rounds, although our prespecified equivalence criterion is not met consistently. Pausing and a constant-action control do not yield comparable gains. On this benchmark, the decision to intervene depends strongly on the task, and a paired placebo plus a simple retreat baseline are needed to establish what learned correction contributes.

AI.tldr: 在冻结π₀.₅的四个RoboTwin任务上以配对安慰剂设计评估运行时恢复：仅beat block hammer取得+13.5pp净增益，且简单脚本回退基线与学习式修正无可检测差异。
AI.motivation: 部署运行时恢复前需回答两个问题：干预带来的成功率提升是否超出普通运行间波动，以及学习式修正的复杂度是否比简单动作更有价值。需以处方规则区分净增益与随机结果变化。
AI.method: 在冻结π₀.₅、四个RoboTwin任务上，对每个测试种子配对"有/无修正"的rollout，并加入同种子基线重跑作为安慰剂；采用种子簇区间与预设比较规则，共3,888对e pisode。另设固定时间触发+脚本回退到早期关节配置、暂停、常量动作等对照，并进行两轮等价性检验。
AI.result: beat block hammer成功率提升+13.5pp（95%区间[+9.4,+17.7]），其余三任务在部署权重下无可检测增益。在响应任务的基线失败episode中，纯重跑成功率43.2%，修正后63.5%，表明许多名义救援源于基线自身波动。脚本回退获得净增益，两轮中与学习式管线无可检测差异，但预设等价性标准未持续满足；暂停与常量动作对照无同类增益。
AI.conclusion: 在该基准上是否干预强烈依赖任务；须结合配对安慰剂与简单回退基线，才能判定学习式修正的真实贡献。

title: SWAP: Stepwise Action Policy Routing for Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Robot manipulation systems using Vision-Language-Action (VLA) model backbones typically use just one VLA for task execution. However, individual VLAs do not perform well across different task states and environments. We introduce a framework for dynamically composing multiple VLA policies during execution: StepWise Action Policy Routing (SWAP). SWAP formulates policy routing as an offline reinforcement learning problem, learning a routing critic that selects the most appropriate policy at each decision step given the current observation. SWAP enables robots to select new policies to execute online rather than committing to a single policy for the duration of an episode. We evaluate SWAP on both real-world DROID manipulation tasks and LIBERO simulation experiments. SWAP improves over fixed-policy execution and routing baselines, giving absolute improvements in real-world task success up to 33% while reducing successful trajectory robot action step length by 28.3%.

AI.tldr: SWAP 提出将策略路由建模为离线强化学习问题，学习一个路由评论家，在每个决策步根据当前观测动态选择最合适的 VLA 策略，实现执行过程中的多策略在线切换，在真实与仿真任务上均优于固定策略与路由基线。
AI.motivation: 单一 VLA 主干难以在不同任务状态与环境中保持一致的良好表现，而现有系统通常在整个回合内固定使用一个 VLA，缺乏按步骤动态切换策略的能力。
AI.method: 提出 StepWise Action Policy Routing（SWAP）框架：将策略路由形式化为离线强化学习问题，学习一个 routing critic，在每一步决策时基于当前观测选择最合适的策略，使机器人能够在线切换到新策略，而非在整个回合中承诺使用单一策略。
AI.result: 在真实世界 DROID 操作任务与 LIBERO 仿真实验中评估：相比固定策略执行与路由基线，真实任务成功率绝对提升最高达 33%，成功轨迹的机器人动作步长减少 28.3%。
AI.conclusion: 逐步动态组合多个 VLA 策略优于单策略执行，可提升任务成功率并缩短成功轨迹的动作步长。

title: Physical Twins: Accelerating and Enabling Robot Learning with Phantom Platforms
summary: Improvements in human-robot physical interaction (pHRI) can have major implications for physical therapy, search and rescue, and telemedicine. However, a major challenge concerns human constraints and safety in human-robot physical experiments. Concerns about human studies also include repeatability, scalability, and participant diversity. To conduct such experiments, an IRB and willing human participants are required. In this work, we present an improved phantom device, a physical twin, that enables real-world RL-type testing for physically interactive algorithms. The new device not only replicates the ball-and-socket motion of the shoulder but also renders scapular and protraction/retraction motions. The experiments showcase the device's ability to render multiple 3D joint limits and demonstrate a Franka Panda arm sensing limits and interacting with the device as an arm for ADLs (activities of daily living) and pHRI tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种改进型"幻影"物理孪生装置，模拟肩关节多自由度运动，用于人机物理交互算法的真实世界强化学习测试。
AI.motivation: 人机物理交互（pHRI）在康复治疗、搜救和远程医疗中意义重大，但以真人为被试的实验受制于安全性、伦理审查（IRB）、可重复性、可扩展性及被试多样性等难题，亟需一种无需真人参与的替代测试平台。
AI.method: 设计并改进一种幻影装置（physical twin），既能复现肩部球窝运动，又能模拟肩胛骨运动及前伸/后缩运动，从而在真实物理环境中开展强化学习类测试。
AI.result: 实验表明该装置可渲染多种三维关节限位，并成功演示了Franka Panda机械臂感知关节限位、将装置视作手臂进行日常生活活动（ADLs）与pHRI任务交互。
AI.conclusion: 该物理孪生装置为pHRI算法提供了可重复、可扩展且规避伦理与安全风险的真实世界测试方案，有望替代或补充真人实验。

title: Learning Modular Policy for Multi-Floor Object Navigation:A Factorized Framework for Diagnostic Study
summary: Object-goal navigation (ObjectNav) in multi-floor scenarios presents a challenge due to sparse rewards caused by long-horizon decision-making. In this paper, we propose a diagnostic study based on a modular framework with an effective learnable policy to analyze failure factors in multi-floor scenarios. To achieve an effective policy for diagnosis, we design the hierarchical factorization policy that deconstructs a single global policy into an intra-floor exploration policy and an inter-floor switching policy. To providing an effective initialization for Reinforcement Learning (RL), the lightweight intra-floor policy is learned by distilling the exploration logic of Visual Language Models (VLMs). Under idealized assumptions, we show that the factorized policy is theoretically equivalent to a single global policy at the policy-representation level. Experiment results indicate that perception performance and stair climbing stability are the primary bottlenecks in multi-floor navigation.

AI.tldr: 本文针对多楼层ObjectNav中稀疏奖励与长时决策难题，提出基于模块化框架的诊断研究，设计分层因子化策略（楼层内探索+楼层间切换），通过VLM蒸馏初始化轻量探索策略，并在理想假设下证明其与单一全局策略在策略表示层面等价。实验表明感知性能与爬楼梯稳定性是多楼层导航的主要瓶颈。
AI.motivation: 多楼层场景下的目标导航（ObjectNav）由于长时决策导致奖励稀疏，训练困难且失败原因不明确，需要系统性的诊断以定位关键失败因素。
AI.method: 构建模块化框架并设计可学习策略：将单一全局策略分解为楼层内探索策略与楼层间切换策略的分层因子化策略；利用视觉语言模型（VLM）的探索逻辑蒸馏轻量级楼层内策略，为强化学习提供有效初始化；在理想假设下从理论层面证明该因子化策略与单一全局策略在策略表示层面等价。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，感知性能与爬楼梯稳定性是多楼层导航中的主要瓶颈。
AI.conclusion: 该诊断性研究通过分层因子化策略框架揭示了多楼层ObjectNav的关键失败因素，为后续提升感知能力与楼梯攀爬稳定性提供了明确方向。

title: ACG-WAM: World-Action Modeling via Action-Conditioned Geometric Latent Prediction
summary: World action models jointly learn visual predictionand robot actions, providing a way to use observations ofscene evolution for policy learning. Their video and actionlosses, however, provide no explicit target for the geometricconsequences of a demonstrated action sequence. Moreover,visual features taken after temporal attention can contain futureobservations, making them unsuitable as the sole current visualinput to an auxiliary predictor. We introduce ACG-WAMand its auxiliary objective, the Action-Conditioned GeometricJoint-Embedding Predictive Architecture (ACG-JEPA), whichpredicts geometric features at several horizons from the currentobservation and intervening actions, using the future slot of afrozen VGGT encoding of each current and future image pairas the target. We apply this supervision from the head and wristcameras to a shared visual embedding before temporal mixing,and remove the teacher and auxiliary modules at inference.On 50 RoboTwin 2.0 tasks, ACG-WAM achieves 93.46%success in clean scenes, with the best randomized success(92.68%) and mean across both settings (93.07%) among thecompared methods; across three tasks on a real robot, itachieves 85.00% success and 91.67% partial completion score,exceeding Motus by 10.00 and 9.17 percentage points, respec-tively. Code:https://github.com/RoboOpus/ACG-WAM.Website:https://RoboOpus.github.io/ACG-WAM.

AI.tldr: 提出 ACG-WAM 及其辅助目标 ACG-JEPA，通过预测多时间尺度的几何特征来监督世界动作模型，在 RoboTwin 2.0 和真实机器人任务上取得领先成功率。
AI.motivation: 世界动作模型仅依赖视频与动作损失，缺乏对示范动作序列几何后果的显式监督目标；同时，经过时间注意力后的视觉特征可能包含未来观测信息，不适合作为辅助预测器唯一的当前视觉输入。
AI.method: 引入 ACG-WAM 与辅助目标 ACG-JEPA：以冻结 VGGT 编码当前与未来图像对时产生的 future slot 作为目标，从当前观测与中间动作预测多个时间尺度的几何特征；在时间混合前对头相机与腕相机施加监督到共享视觉嵌入；推理时移除教师与辅助模块。
AI.result: 在 RoboTwin 2.0 的 50 个任务上干净场景成功率 93.46%，随机化成功率 92.68%，两种设置均值 93.07%，均为对比方法最优；真实机器人三个任务成功率 85.00%、部分完成分 91.67%，分别超过 Motus 10.00 与 9.17 个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 在共享视觉嵌入上引入动作条件化的多尺度几何预测监督，可有效提升世界动作模型的策略学习效果，且不增加推理开销。

title: ProactiveVLA: Augmenting Embodied Memory through Proactive Environment Exploration
summary: Rapid adaptation to a new environment requires a robot to acquire useful knowledge about local objects, states, and interactions from limited experience. Systems that combine a reasoning agent with a frozen vision-language-action model (VLA) can adapt through execution feedback and memory, making the choice of experience central to their effectiveness. Repeated practice of a target task may refine a familiar solution while leaving other interactions relevant to changed conditions untested. We introduce ProactiveVLA, which uses proactive environment exploration to acquire reusable knowledge for deployment-time adaptation. After completing an initial task, the agent allocates the remaining interaction budget to self-proposed goals covering object affordances, state-changing interactions, and compositions of interactions. It verifies execution outcomes and consolidates both task-directed and exploratory experience into memory that guides subsequent planning and control. ProactiveVLA outperforms the baselines under the same turn budget on LIBERO-Pro and RoboCasa365 Composite-Seen. On LIBERO-Pro Goal-T, with at most one VLA primitive invocation allowed during evaluation, ProactiveVLA completes 48% of instances, compared with 19% for the state-of-the-art task-refinement baseline.

AI.tldr: 提出 ProactiveVLA，通过主动环境探索获得可复用知识，在部署期实现快速适应，在有限交互预算下显著优于被动任务精炼基线。
AI.motivation: 机器人需在有限经验下快速掌握本地物体、状态与交互知识以适配新环境。现有"推理智能体+冻结 VLA"系统依赖执行反馈与记忆进行适配，因此经验选择至关重要；而反复练习目标任务虽能精炼已有解，却无法测试与变化条件相关的其他交互。
AI.method: ProactiveVLA 在完成初始任务后，将剩余交互预算分配给自主提出的目标，涵盖物体可供性、改变状态的交互以及交互组合；随后验证执行结果，并将任务导向经验与探索经验一并巩固到记忆中，用于指导后续的规划与控制。
AI.result: 在相同回合预算下，ProactiveVLA 在 LIBERO-Pro 与 RoboCasa365 Composite-Seen 上均优于基线。在 LIBERO-Pro Goal-T 上，评估期仅允许至多一次 VLA 原语调用时，ProactiveVLA 完成 48% 的实例，而最先进的任务精炼基线仅为 19%。
AI.conclusion: 主动探索所获取的可复用经验是提升冻结 VLA 系统部署期适应能力的关键，其效果显著优于传统的目标任务重复精炼策略。

title: LEAP: Making Privileged Geometry Supervision Effective for Visuomotor Learning
summary: Privileged 3D supervision uses additional geometric information during training to guide RGB-based visuomotor policy learning, without requiring geometric inputs at deployment. However, low reconstruction error does not ensure that visual representations capture geometry useful for control. We identify three limitations that weaken this supervision: proprioceptive shortcuts, dominant-view reliance, and reconstruction objectives dominated by task-irrelevant geometry. To address these limitations, we propose Latent Encoding with Aligned Privileged Geometry (LEAP). Our framework uses an auxiliary decoder to reconstruct point clouds within the manipulation workspace from visual features alone, while retaining proprioception for action prediction. Alongside full reconstruction, we introduce wrist-view dropout and partial reconstruction targets matched to the retained wrist, encouraging the encoder to capture complementary local geometry. The auxiliary decoder is removed at inference, leaving only RGB observations and robot state as policy inputs. Extensive experiments on RoboTwin, ManiSkill, and real-world tasks demonstrate consistent and substantial improvements over Diffusion Policy and ACT, with only a small increase in parameter count and no reduction in inference speed.

AI.tldr: 本文提出LEAP框架，通过辅助解码器从纯视觉特征重建操作工作空间内的点云，并引入腕部视角dropout与部分重建目标，缓解特权3D监督中的三类缺陷，从而学习更具几何控制价值的视觉表征。
AI.motivation: 特权3D监督在训练时引入额外几何信息指导基于RGB的视觉运动策略学习，且部署时不需要几何输入。但低重建误差并不能保证视觉表征捕获对控制有用的几何信息。作者指出削弱此类监督的三类局限：本体感受捷径（proprioceptive shortcuts）、主导视角依赖（dominant-view reliance）、以及重建目标被与任务无关的几何主导。
AI.method: 提出Latent Encoding with Aligned Privileged Geometry（LEAP）。使用辅助解码器，仅从视觉特征重建操作工作空间内的点云，同时将本体感受信息保留用于动作预测，以切断本体感受捷径。除完整重建外，引入腕部视角dropout（wrist-view dropout）与与保留腕部视角相匹配的部分重建目标，促使编码器捕获互补的局部几何信息。推理阶段移除辅助解码器，策略输入仅保留RGB观测与机器人状态。
AI.result: 在RoboTwin、ManiSkill以及真实世界任务上的大量实验表明，相较Diffusion Policy与ACT，LEAP取得一致且显著的性能提升，同时参数量仅小幅增加，推理速度没有下降。
AI.conclusion: LEAP通过对齐特权几何的潜表征学习，在不增加部署输入与推理开销的前提下有效提升了视觉运动策略的控制性能，验证了几何对齐视觉表征对操作任务的价值。

title: BRACE: Adapting Whole-Body References for Force and Terrain Aware Humanoid Motion Tracking
summary: Whole-body tracking has become the interface through which operators drive humanoid robots, yet the references it consumes are recorded on level ground and carrying nothing, so the tracker is aware of neither the forces the robot must exchange with objects nor the terrain it must stand on. Existing controllers address one side of this gap: force-capable policies command an end-effector force but prescribe no whole-body pose, while terrain-adaptive trackers treat loads as disturbances to reject rather than wrenches to command. We present BRACE, a whole-body tracker that exerts and compensates commanded hand forces from diverse poses while following a flat-ground reference on sloped terrain. Rather than leaving the tracker to absorb the load and the slope, BRACE folds both into the reference it follows: terrain conformance lifts footholds and root onto the local surface, and a wrench transformation resolves the hand displacement that produces a force jointly with the center-of-mass and center- of-pressure shifts it induces, bounded by teacher-specific arm-effort limits. Separate exertion and compensation teachers are distilled by DAgger into one flow-matching student that runs on proprioception alone, without a height map or measured wrench, so a teleoperator (even in remote locations) can supply a flat- ground trajectory and the robot resolves slope and load onboard. We extensive experiments on the Unitree-G1 to demonstrate the ability of BRACE to exert, compensate force and handle diverse terrain in simulation and real robot experiments.

AI.tldr: BRACE是一种全身跟踪器，能够从多种姿态施加并补偿指定的手部力，同时在斜坡地形上跟随平地参考轨迹，将地形顺应与力旋量变换折叠进参考中，并用DAgger蒸馏为单一flow-matching学生策略，仅依赖本体感觉运行。
AI.motivation: 全身跟踪是人形机器人操作的接口，但其参考轨迹通常在平地、空载条件下录制，跟踪器既不知道机器人需与物体交换的力，也不知道所需站立的地形。现有控制器只解决这一缺口的一侧：具备力能力的策略可命令末端执行器力但不规定全身姿态；地形自适应跟踪器则把负载当作需抑制的扰动而非需命令的力旋量。
AI.method: BRACE不把负载与坡度留给跟踪器被动吸收，而是将二者折叠进所跟随的参考中：地形顺应将落脚点与根节点抬升至局部表面；力旋量变换结合质心与压力中心偏移，解算出产生所需力的手部位移，并受教师特定的手臂努力限制约束。分别训练施加与补偿两类教师，通过DAgger蒸馏为单一flow-matching学生策略，仅依赖本体感觉运行，无需高度图或实测力旋量，因此遥操作者（即便在远端）只需提供平地轨迹，机器人即可在机解算坡度与负载。
AI.result: 在Unitree-G1上进行的大量实验表明，BRACE在仿真与真机实验中均能施加力、补偿力并处理多样地形。
AI.conclusion: BRACE将地形顺应与力旋量变换统一进跟踪参考，并通过教师蒸馏得到仅靠本体感觉的单一策略，实现了在斜坡地形上跟随平地参考、同时施加与补偿手部力的全身跟踪能力。

title: Behavioral Cloning Mystery
summary: Behavioral cloning (BC), despite its simplicity, exhibits many counterintuitive phenomena in the real world. For example, the performance of BC often keeps increasing as the model overfits more to the dataset, and fully closed-loop policies often completely fail without action chunking. Unfortunately, properly studying these anecdotal phenomena ("behavioral cloning mysteries") is challenging: in the real world, datasets and experiments are costly and not fully controllable; in simulation with synthetic data, these phenomena are often not easily observed partly due to the discrepancy between scripted policies and human demonstrations. In this work, we propose OCBench, a robotic manipulation benchmark with controllable scripted policies that have similar properties to human demonstrations. We show that, by mimicking key properties of human demonstrations, OCBench reproduces many anecdotal BC-related phenomena in controlled settings. With its GPU-accelerated environments and scripted policies, we demonstrate how OCBench enables scientific studies of previously reported BC-related phenomena by analyzing and refuting various hypotheses. Project page: https://seohong.me/projects/ocbench

AI.tldr: 本文提出 OCBench，一个带有可控脚本策略的机器人操作基准，用于在可控环境下复现并研究行为克隆（BC）中的诸多反直觉现象，并通过实验分析与反驳相关假设。
AI.motivation: 行为克隆在现实中存在许多反直觉现象，如性能随过拟合增加而持续提升、无动作分块的完全闭环策略常常彻底失败等。然而，系统研究这些"行为克隆之谜"十分困难：真实世界数据集与实验成本高且不可完全控制；而使用合成数据的仿真中，这些现象又因脚本策略与人类示范之间的差异而难以观察到。
AI.method: 作者提出 OCBench，一个机器人操作基准，配备可控的脚本策略，并使这些策略具备与人类示范相似的关键特性。通过模仿人类示范的关键属性，OCBench 在可控设置下复现了多种与 BC 相关的传闻现象。借助 GPU 加速环境和脚本策略，研究者能够对已报道的 BC 现象进行科学研究，分析与反驳各类假设。
AI.result: OCBench 成功在可控环境下复现了多个传闻中的 BC 相关现象，并支持对这些现象背后各种假设进行分析与反驳。
AI.conclusion: OCBench 为行为克隆反直觉现象的科学研究提供了可控、可复现的实验平台，使此前难以验证的假设得以系统检验。

title: Demo: Vision-Language Model-Guided Online Calibration of an Electromagnetic Digital Twin
summary: An electromagnetic (EM) digital twin gives mobile robots wireless situational awareness but depends on material conductivities that change with the environment. Online calibration faces initialization sensitivity and measurement travel costs. We demonstrate a vision-language model (VLM)-guided framework using a Unitree G1 robot and NVIDIA Sionna, with two VLM calls: material classification maps visible materials through ITU-R P.2040 to conductivity priors for Sionna's gradient descent on accumulated received signal strength (RSS) measurements; waypoint planning selects the next measurement location online using residual RSS calibration error and image coverage. In a real indoor scenario, the framework achieves a normalized mean absolute conductivity error of $1.74\times10^{-4}$ within 20 m of travel; random initialization never converges, while random waypoints require over twice the travel.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种由视觉语言模型（VLM）引导的电磁数字孪生在线校准框架，在真实室内场景中实现低误差、低行程的材质电导率标定。
AI.motivation: 电磁数字孪生可为移动机器人提供无线态势感知，但其依赖的材质电导率随环境变化。在线校准面临初始化敏感与测量行程成本高的问题。
AI.method: 基于 Unitree G1 机器人 与 NVIDIA Sionna，进行两次 VLM 调用：一是材质分类，将可见材质经 ITU-R P.2040 映射为电导率先验，供 Sionna 对累积 RSS 测量做梯度下降；二是航点规划，利用残差 RSS 校准误差与图像覆盖率在线选择下一测量位置。
AI.result: 在真实室内场景中，20 m 行程内实现归一化平均绝对电导率误差 1.74×10⁻⁴；随机初始化无法收敛，随机航点所需行程超过两倍。
AI.conclusion: VLM 引导的材质先验与航点规划可有效提升电磁数字孪生在线校准的收敛性与效率。

title: TeleHairing: A Teleoperation Baseline for Robotic Haircutting
summary: Robotic haircutting requires controlled tool motion near the head while simultaneously accounting for communication, visual feedback, tool actuation, and interruption handling. Existing studies still lack an operator-in-the-loop reference for analyzing these coupled behaviors before human trials or stronger autonomy. This paper presents TeleHairing, a closed-loop teleoperation architecture for mannequin-based robotic haircutting evaluation under local, relay, and remote deployment conditions. Logged timing shows that the main remote latency increase occurs before the robot-side control endpoint: overall timing reached 190.5~ms in remote mode, while robot-side command queue, control processing, and control-to-robot timing remained similar across modes. Trajectory analysis shows that the larger remote command-following error was dominated by the terminal withdrawal segment rather than accumulated uniformly over the path; excluding this segment reduced remote root-mean-square error (RMSE) from 45.1 mm to 9.6 mm. Detection-loss trials further show that rebase events resumed motion without a large target jump under the tested condition. These results clarify how deployment, execution, and interruption affect the robotic haircutting teleoperation loop, providing a quantitative reference for future autonomy, safety, and user-facing studies.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TeleHairing——面向假人剪发的闭环遥操作架构，在本地、中继与远程三种部署条件下评估时序、轨迹跟随与中断处理行为。
AI.motivation: 机器人剪发需在头部附近受控运动，同时兼顾通信、视觉反馈、工具驱动与中断处理；现有研究缺少"人在环"参考基准，难以为真人试验或更强自主性提供分析依据。
AI.method: 构建闭环遥操作架构，在假人上进行剪发评估；对比本地/中继/远程三种部署，记录分段时序日志，进行轨迹跟随误差分析，并开展检测丢失（detection-loss）触发重基准（rebase）的中断试验。
AI.result: 远程模式整体时序达190.5 ms，延迟增量主要发生在机器人侧控制端点之前，而机器人侧命令队列、控制处理与控制到机器人时序在各模式间相近；远程命令跟随误差主要由末端撤回段贡献，去除该段后RMSE由45.1 mm降至9.6 mm；检测丢失试验中重基准事件恢复了运动且未产生大幅目标跳变。
AI.conclusion: 结果厘清了部署方式、执行过程与中断对机器人剪发遥操作回路的影响，为未来自主性、安全性及面向用户的研究提供定量参考。

title: AIM: Adaptive Interaction Modeling Networks for Real-to-Sim Soft-Body Simulation
summary: Deformable-object manipulation is essential for robotic tasks such as folding laundry and handling food, where robots must control shape changes as well as object motion. Predictive soft-body simulation supports these tasks by anticipating deformation under external interactions. However, spatial neighborhoods can misrepresent deformation dependencies, introducing local errors that accumulate over successive predictions. Models fitted to individual scenes must also accommodate changes in object geometry and manipulation conditions. In this work, we propose AIM, an Adaptive Interaction Modeling framework that treats real-to-sim soft-body simulation as a local-global interaction modeling problem. AIM uses motion history and geometry to adapt particle relations over current spatial neighbors and retained connections, while geometry-conditioned global communication coordinates object-wide responses. A unified kinematic control-point interface represents different manipulation configurations, and multi-step autoregressive supervision trains the model on its own predicted trajectories. Experiments on PhysTwin and PGND demonstrate improved motion accuracy and visual fidelity, with a 20.0% reduction in future-prediction tracking error relative to PhysTwin and a 22.8% reduction in mean long-horizon particle error across six object categories relative to PGND. The framework further supports transfer across actions, object instances, and scenes, including zero-shot transfer from robot interactions to human manipulation without target-domain dynamics fitting.

AI.tldr: 提出AIM框架，将real-to-sim软体仿真建模为局部-全局交互问题，通过自适应粒子关系与几何条件全局通信提升可变形物体操作预测精度，支持跨动作、实例、场景及零样本迁移。
AI.motivation: 可变形物体操作（如叠衣、处理食物）需同时控制形状变化与物体运动，预测性软体仿真可支持此类任务。但现有方法存在两个问题：一是空间邻域难以准确表征形变依赖关系，导致局部误差在逐步预测中累积；二是针对单个场景拟合的模型难以适应物体几何与操作条件的变化。
AI.method: AIM将real-to-sim软体仿真视为局部-全局交互建模问题。利用运动历史与几何信息，在现有空间邻居和保留连接上自适应调整粒子关系；同时通过几何条件化的全局通信协调物体整体响应。采用统一的运动学控制点接口表示不同操作配置，并使用多步自回归监督，使模型在自身预测轨迹上训练。
AI.result: 在PhysTwin与PGND数据集上，运动精度与视觉保真度均有提升：相比PhysTwin，未来预测跟踪误差降低20.0%；在六个物体类别上，相比PGND长时域平均粒子误差降低22.8%。框架支持跨动作、跨物体实例、跨场景迁移，并实现从机器人交互到人类操作的零样本迁移，无需目标域动力学拟合。
AI.conclusion: AIM通过局部-全局交互建模有效缓解了软体仿真中局部误差累积与场景适应性问题，在预测精度与泛化迁移能力上均取得显著提升，为可变形物体操作提供了通用且可迁移的real-to-sim仿真框架。

title: Robust Nonprehensile Object Transport with Quadruped Robots
summary: In this paper, we present a robust nonprehensile object transportation framework for quadruped robots. An uncertainty-aware trajectory optimization method generates object motions with minimal closed-loop sensitivity to uncertain parameters. The resulting reference trajectory is tracked using a coupled convex model predictive controller that jointly predicts the CoM dynamics of the quadruped and the payload followed by a whole-body QP that enforces ground reaction constraints. The approach is evaluated through extensive simulations and real-world experiments under variations in the object's inertial parameters. Its performance is compared with fixed-orientation and straight-line trajectories as baseline. The results show that the optimized object motion reduces the sliding by approximately 50% compared with the fixed-orientation baseline and 30% compared with the straight-line baseline, while also achieving lower robot CoM tracking errors.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种面向四足机器人的鲁棒非抓取式物体运输框架，结合不确定性感知轨迹优化与耦合凸模型预测控制，通过仿真和实物实验在物体惯性参数变化下验证，滑动量相比固定姿态与直线基线分别降低约50%和30%。
AI.motivation: 非抓取式运输中物体惯性参数存在不确定性，传统轨迹易导致滑动；需要生成对参数不确定性低敏感的物体运动轨迹，并实现四足机器人与负载的协调控制。
AI.method: 采用不确定性感知轨迹优化生成对不确定参数具有最小闭环敏感度的物体运动；用耦合凸模型预测控制器同时预测四足机器人质心与负载动力学，并通过全身QP施加地面反作用约束来跟踪参考轨迹。
AI.result: 通过大量仿真与实机实验评估，在物体惯性参数变化条件下，优化轨迹使滑动量相比固定姿态基线降低约50%、相比直线基线降低约30%，同时机器人质心跟踪误差更低。
AI.conclusion: 将不确定性感知轨迹优化与耦合MPC+全身QP结合，可有效提升四足机器人非抓取式运输的鲁棒性与跟踪性能，显著抑制物体滑动。

title: Fluorescence-enhanced Whisker Array with Vision-based Deformation Analysis for Underwater Source Localization
summary: Deep-water biological observation is essential for understanding marine organisms and their interactions with the environment. However, conventional optical and acoustic approaches can introduce stimuli that alter animal behavior and bias biological observations. This paper proposes a fluorescence-enhanced whisker array sensing system that pinpoints underwater hydrodynamic sources through local optical readout rather than direct source imaging. Five spatially oriented whiskers, fabricated with nitinol cores and fluorescent urethane shells, are integrated with ultraviolet excitation and a monocular camera. Image enhancement and segmentation are applied to track the whisker deformation. A lightweight convolutional neural network captures temporal and cross-whisker features from 2 s sequences to estimate source localization. Pool experiments achieve a mean spatial localization error of 88 mm, with 73.5 mm in radius and $2.5^\circ$ in angle, across a test region of 600 mm with $\pm30^\circ$. Real-time localization of a moving thruster demonstrates the capability of the proposed method in dynamic scenarios, highlighting its potential for integration into underwater robots for hydrodynamic source detection, localization, and tracking in low-light environments.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种荧光增强式须阵列感知系统，通过局部光学读出而非直接成像来定位水下流体动力源，池实验平均空间定位误差为88 mm。
AI.motivation: 深海生物观测中，传统光学与声学方法会引入刺激，改变动物行为并导致观测偏差，因此需要一种非侵入式的流体动力源探测手段。
AI.method: 构建由五根空间取向须组成的阵列，须由镍钛合金芯与荧光聚氨酯外壳制成，配合紫外激发与单目相机；应用图像增强与分割跟踪须的形变；采用轻量级卷积神经网络从2 s序列中提取时间与跨须特征以估计源定位。
AI.result: 在600 mm、±30°的测试区域内，平均空间定位误差为88 mm，半径误差73.5 mm，角度误差2.5°；并实现对移动推进器的实时定位。
AI.conclusion: 该方法在动态场景中具备可行性，有望集成到水下机器人中，用于低光环境下流体动力源的探测、定位与跟踪。

title: Distribution-Transfer Safe-Horizon MPC under Mode Uncertainty
summary: Scenario-based MPC is an attractive strategy for chance-constrained motion planning that approximates uncertainty via a finite set of sampled scenarios. As a sampling-based method, scenario-based MPC is sensitive to distribution mismatch. We address this problem in the context of Safe-Horizon Model Predictive Control (SH-MPC) with obstacles governed by switching dynamic modes. From finite mode observations, we construct a confidence set for the unknown categorical mode law and derive a multiplicative domination bound that transfers a Safe-Horizon collision-risk certificate from a selected scenario-sampling distribution to every law in the confidence set. Wasserstein geometry is used to regularize probability reallocation among modes according to the similarity of their induced trajectory predictions, while a collision-risk surrogate biases sampling toward dangerous modes. The resulting certificate explicitly quantifies the additional tightening required under distribution mismatch and exposes the multiplicative conservatism that arises when several obstacle-wise transfer factors are combined

AI.tldr: 针对基于场景的MPC在分布失配下的安全性问题，本文在SH-MPC框架中为切换动态模式障碍构建置信集，利用乘性支配界与Wasserstein正则化，将安全-地平线碰撞风险证书从采样分布迁移到置信集内所有分布。
AI.motivation: 场景法MPC通过有限采样场景近似不确定性，是机会约束运动规划的有效策略，但其作为采样方法对分布失配高度敏感。在障碍具有切换动态模式的SH-MPC情境下，这一敏感性会威胁碰撞风险证书的有效性，因此需要一种能够应对未知模式律分布失配的鲁棒化方法。
AI.method: 从有限模式观测出发构建未知类别模式律的置信集；推导乘性支配界，将SH碰撞风险证书从选定的场景采样分布迁移至置信集内任意分布；采用Wasserstein几何按各模式诱导轨迹预测的相似度对模式间概率重分配进行正则化；引入碰撞风险替代指标使采样偏向危险模式。
AI.result: 所得证书显式量化了分布失配下所需的额外收紧量，并揭示了将多个障碍各自的迁移因子组合时产生的乘性保守性。
AI.conclusion: 该方法在保持场景法SH-MPC计算优势的同时，为模式律分布失配提供了可量化的安全保证，但多障碍迁移因子的逐项相乘会导致保守性显著累积，这是后续需要权衡与缓解的关键问题。

title: Embedded Bare-Metal Radar-Inertial Odometry
summary: Compact extraplanetary rovers and micro aerial vehicles require robust state estimation frameworks designed to operate under strict computational constraints in unforgiving environments. Typical solutions involving vision- or LiDAR-based sensing are computationally expensive and vulnerable to environments with perceptual degradation, making them poorly suited for resource-constrained platforms and austere conditions. Alternatively, Frequency Modulated Continuous Wave (FMCW) radar offers both robustness and computational efficiency by directly providing velocity measurements coupled with inherent resilience to perceptual degradation. These factors enable robust estimation, thereby reducing reliance on human operators for supervision to ensure platform safety in challenging environments. In this manuscript, we propose an embedded radar-inertial estimator tailored for low-compute platforms. All sensor drivers, data processing, and aided inertial navigation are performed on a single-core microcontroller, demonstrating its computational efficiency. Flight experiments show translational APE of $0.51-0.82\,\mathrm{m}$ and RPE of $<$3\,\% against motion capture, alongside closed-loop flight through an unmodified PX4 stack. The firmware and printed circuit board design are openly available on GitHub at \href{https://github.com/ntnu-arl/embedded_rio}{ntnu-arl/embedded\_rio} and \href{https://github.com/ntnu-arl/embedded_rio-pcb}{ntnu-arl/embedded\_rio-pcb} respectively.

AI.tldr: 提出面向低算力平台的嵌入式雷达-惯性状态估计器，全部运算在单核微控制器上完成，实测平移APE 0.51–0.82 m、RPE<3%，并实现PX4闭环飞行，硬件与固件开源。
AI.motivation: 小型行星探测车与微型飞行器需在严格计算约束和恶劣环境下运行，而视觉/激光方案计算开销大且易受感知退化影响，不适合资源受限平台；FMCW雷达兼具鲁棒性与计算效率，可直接提供速度测量，从而减少对人工监控的依赖。
AI.method: 设计并实现一个嵌入式雷达-惯性估计器，将传感器驱动、数据处理与辅助惯性导航全部部署于单核微控制器上。
AI.result: 飞行实验相对动作捕捉系统测得平移APE为0.51–0.82 m，RPE<3%；并在未修改的PX4栈上完成闭环飞行；固件与PCB设计已在GitHub开源。
AI.conclusion: 该工作验证了在单核微控制器上运行雷达-惯性状态估计框架的可行性，兼具计算效率与鲁棒性，适用于资源受限及感知退化环境下的平台。

title: Lego-Like Stiffness Configuration of Planar Compliant Modules for Task-Specific Flexible Interfaces
summary: Compliant mechanisms provide compact and intrinsic structural compliance for regulating physical interactions between mechanisms and environments. However, different tasks demand distinct stiffness characteristics, often requiring task-specific optimization and redesign due to limited geometric design space and inherent coupling among multiple stiffness components. This paper presents a Lego-like stiffness configuration approach using stackable planar compliant modules. Three complementary module geometries are introduced, with their stiffness characteristics further regulated through beam width, plate thickness, and module orientation. A unified stiffness model is established for quantitative analysis of individual and composed modules. Further, a two-stage optimization method is presented to achieve desired stiffness profiles, combining a genetic algorithm for configuration and sequential quadratic programming for parameter refinement. Experimental verification shows deviations below 6.5% for simulated stiffness. A flexible wrist is further developed as a representative implementation, exhibiting distinct compliant and dynamic responses under different stiffness characteristics. An optimized modular composition realizes prescribed stiffness values and maintains compliant obstacle interaction during high-speed motion at 1 m/s, with a maximum tested angular compliance of approximately $15^\circ$. The proposed framework provides a systematic approach for constructing flexible interfaces with task-specific stiffness characteristics.

AI.tldr: 提出一种乐高式刚度配置方法，利用可堆叠平面柔顺模块构建任务定制刚度接口，并通过两阶段优化实现目标刚度。
AI.motivation: 柔顺机构能提供紧凑的固有结构柔顺性以调节机构与环境间的物理交互，但不同任务需要不同刚度特性。由于几何设计空间有限且多刚度分量间存在固有耦合，往往需要针对任务进行专门优化与重新设计。
AI.method: 引入三种互补的模块几何构型，通过梁宽、板厚和模块朝向进一步调节刚度特性；建立统一刚度模型对单个及组合模块进行定量分析；提出两阶段优化方法，遗传算法负责构型配置，序列二次规划负责参数细化。
AI.result: 实验验证显示刚度仿真偏差低于6.5%。以柔性腕为代表性实现，在不同刚度特性下表现出不同的柔顺与动态响应；优化后的模块化组合实现预设刚度值，并在1 m/s高速运动中保持柔顺避障交互，最大测试角柔度约15°。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为构建具有任务定制刚度特性的柔性接口提供了系统化方法。

title: Towards Decentralized Formation of Minimum-Length Communication Networks Using Robot Swarms
comment: This work has been submitted to the IEEE for possible publication. Copyright may be transferred without notice, after which this version may no longer be accessible
summary: Multi-robot missions in infrastructure-denied environments frequently rely on reliable communication links between spatially separated locations. We propose a fully decentralized framework for constructing and dynamically maintaining communication networks without centralized topology planning or global positioning infrastructure. Driven strictly by local interactions, robots reconfigure local network topologies and adjust their physical positions to minimize overall network length while adhering to communication constraints. Formal analysis shows that our local reconfiguration operations guarantee continuous network connectivity, strictly decrease network length with every branch transfer, and bound worst-case performance to the shortest starlike tree. Embodied simulations and physical multi-robot experiments confirm that our approach forms networks near the length of centrally computed Euclidean Steiner trees. Additionally, the system dynamically adapts to moving targets and optimizes deployment by utilizing only necessary connectors, preserving excess robots for auxiliary tasks. This work enables autonomous swarms to self-organize adaptive ad hoc communication infrastructure in communication-denied environments, which could support applications varying from subterranean exploration to planetary missions.

AI.tldr: 提出一种完全去中心化的多机器人通信网络构建与动态维护框架，仅依赖局部交互实现网络拓扑重构与位置调整，在保证连通性前提下最小化网络总长度。
AI.motivation: 在无基础设施（无中心拓扑规划、无全局定位）的环境中，空间分离位置间的可靠通信链路是多机器人任务的关键瓶颈，需要机器人自主构建并动态维护通信网络。
