AI.method: 机器人严格基于局部交互，重配置局部网络拓扑并调整物理位置；通过形式化分析证明局部重配置操作的连通性保证、分支转移导致网络长度严格递减，以及最坏情况性能界为最短星形树；采用具身仿真与物理多机器人实验验证。
AI.result: 形成的网络长度接近集中式计算得到的欧几里得斯坦纳树；系统可动态适应移动目标，并仅使用必要的连接机器人优化部署，将多余机器人保留用于辅助任务。
AI.conclusion: 该工作使自主集群能够在通信拒止环境中自组织自适应自组网通信基础设施，可支持地下探索、行星任务等应用。

title: SharedKV-BT: Node-Local Typed Decisions for Behavior-Tree Agents
comment: 8 pages, 5 figures, 1 table. Last updated on October 5th, 2026
summary: Agent tasks require sequences of interdependent decisions. Autoregressive models support more flexible decision interfaces than conventional classifiers but incur the latency of token-by-token generation. Recent shared-prefix methods reduce this cost by reusing encoded context and scoring multiple decisions in parallel, but do not model decision dependencies or verify execution. We propose SharedKV-BT, where each active node of a behavior tree (BT) exposes stage-local fields and candidates, and Shared-KV scores the candidates in parallel and passes the selected decision to a separate execution system. We tested SharedKV-BT on robot manipulation, mobile navigation, and computer-use tasks. Across three tasks, SharedKV-BT made typed decisions 2.36-4.15 times faster than prompt-matched autoregressive decoding. On the manipulation task, node-local Shared-KV improved joint decision accuracy from 75% to 94% and closed-loop success from 0% to 60%. Fixed-score policy replay showed that stage gating prevented out-of-order actions and external postconditions prevented premature completion.

AI.tldr: 提出 SharedKV-BT：将行为树节点与 Shared-KV 并行打分结合，在保持自回归决策灵活性的同时消除逐 token 生成延迟，并在机器人操作、导航与计算机操作任务上验证提速与精度提升。
AI.motivation: Agent 任务需要序列化的相互依赖决策。自回归模型虽提供比传统分类器更灵活的决策接口，但逐 token 生成带来高延迟；现有 shared-prefix 方法通过复用编码上下文并并行打分多个决策来降低开销，却未建模决策依赖关系，也不对执行进行验证。
AI.method: SharedKV-BT：每个行为树（BT）活动节点暴露 stage-local 字段与候选集合，由 Shared-KV 并行打分候选，并将所选决策传递给独立执行系统；引入阶段门控（stage gating）防止乱序动作，外部后置条件（external postconditions）防止过早完成。
AI.result: 在机器人操作、移动导航与计算机操作三类任务中，typed 决策速度比 prompt-matched 自回归解码快 2.36–4.15 倍；操作任务上节点级 Shared-KV 将联合决策准确率从 75% 提升至 94%，闭环成功率从 0% 提升至 60%。固定分数策略回放显示阶段门控避免乱序动作，外部后置条件避免过早完成。
AI.conclusion: 将行为树的显式依赖结构与 Shared-KV 并行候选打分相结合，可在显著降低决策延迟的同时提升决策准确率与闭环执行成功率，并通过阶段门控与外部后置条件保证执行顺序与完成判定的正确性。

title: ScanSTL: Parallel Robustness Evaluation for Signal Temporal Logic
summary: Repeated evaluation and differentiation of Signal Temporal Logic (STL) robustness can become a computational bottleneck in robot planning and control. Sequential temporal recurrences limit parallelism, while dense masking increases memory requirements. We propose ScanSTL, which combines associative temporal aggregation with parallel scans and ordered block reductions. Eventually and Always use range extrema, while inclusive strong Until composes compact segment representations. A common range engine handles bounded and shifted intervals, including the guards required before delayed Until witnesses. Each exact temporal operator computes complete robustness traces with linear work and storage and logarithmic parallel depth on uniformly sampled finite signals. An open source JAX implementation supports automatic differentiation, batching, and compilation. We compare ScanSTL with STLCG and STLCG++ using CPU and GPU operator benchmarks and nine composed specifications. Across these nine specifications at 512 samples, ScanSTL achieves geometric mean speedups of 243 times for forward evaluation and 104 times for gradient computation over STLCG++ in JAX on the CPU. On an RTX~5090 GPU, ScanSTL evaluates unbounded Until over more than two million samples with median times below 0.1 ms for forward evaluation and 0.25 ms for gradient computation. Simulated escort and patrol experiments with a robot dog further demonstrate faster repair of violating plans and greater solver capacity in model predictive control.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 ScanSTL，将关联式时间聚合与并行扫描和有序块归约结合，实现 STL 鲁棒性的高效并行评估与可微计算。
AI.motivation: STL 鲁棒性的重复评估与求导在机器人规划与控制中常成为计算瓶颈：时序递推限制并行性，密集掩码增加内存开销。
AI.method: ScanSTL 采用关联式时间聚合 + 并行扫描 + 有序块归约；Eventually/Always 用区间极值，包含式强 Until 组合紧凑段表示；统一 range engine 处理有界与平移区间及延迟 Until 见证所需的守卫条件。所有精确时序算子以线性计算与存储、对数并行深度计算完整鲁棒性轨迹，并提供支持自动微分、批处理和编译的 JAX 开源实现。
AI.result: 在 CPU 与 GPU 算子基准及九个复合规约上对比 STLCG 与 STLCG++：512 采样下，JAX CPU 上前向评估几何平均加速 243 倍、梯度计算加速 104 倍（相对 STLCG++）；RTX 5090 GPU 上对超两百万采样的无界 Until，前向中位时间低于 0.1 ms，梯度低于 0.25 ms。机器狗护送与巡逻仿真进一步显示违规计划修复更快、MPC 求解容量更大。
AI.conclusion: ScanSTL 通过并行扫描式关联聚合显著提升 STL 鲁棒性评估与梯度计算效率，并改善机器人 MPC 与计划修复性能。

title: Expressiveness, Equivalence, and Uncertainty in Velocity Obstacles and Closest Point of Approach Metrics
summary: Time to Closest Point of Approach (TCPA), Distance to Closest Point of Approach (DCPA), and Velocity Obstacles (VOs), are widely used to assess and mitigate collision risk in autonomous navigation, yet their relationship and behavior under uncertainty remain largely unexplored. Assuming perfect state information, we establish a relationship between these representations over finite and infinite prediction horizons and derive conditions under which they provide equivalent characterizations of collision risk. Under bounded uncertainty, we extend the Closest Point of Approach (CPA) metrics and VO to convex relative-state sets. We show that in this setting, independently computed TCPA and DCPA bounds lose the joint relationship required for VO membership, while uncertainty-aware VOs preserve this relationship through a set-valued representation of collision-inducing velocities.

AI.tldr: 该论文建立了TCPA、DCPA与速度障碍（VO）之间的关系，并在不确定性条件下将其推广到凸相对状态集。
AI.motivation: TCPA、DCPA与VO广泛用于自主导航中的碰撞风险评估，但三者之间的关系及其在不确定性下的行为尚缺乏系统研究。
AI.method: 在完美状态信息假设下，针对有限与无限预测时域推导三者的关系及等价表征条件；在有界不确定性下，将CPA指标与VO扩展为凸相对状态集形式。
AI.result: 研究表明，在有界不确定性下独立计算的TCPA与DCPA边界会丧失VO隶属所需的联合关系，而不确定性感知的VO通过集值表示保持该关系。
AI.conclusion: VO的集值形式能更稳健地表征不确定性下的碰撞风险，独立CPA边界不足以支撑VO判断。

title: Toward Trustworthy Physical AI for Human Interaction
summary: Robots are entering human spaces faster than we can establish when they deserve trust. We propose a framework for trustworthy physical AI that integrates Safety, Behavioral Intelligibility, and Perceptual Alignment across embodiment, control, cognition, and design. Trustworthiness emerges from aligning physical capabilities, observable behavior, and expectations people form during interaction.

AI.tldr: 该文提出一个面向可信物理AI的框架，将安全性、行为可理解性与感知对齐统一到具身、控制、认知与设计四个层面，认为可信度源于物理能力、可观察行为与人际交互期望三者的对齐。
AI.motivation: 机器人进入人类空间的速度快于我们确立其可信标准的速度，缺乏系统化的可信物理AI判定框架。
AI.method: 提出整合安全性（Safety）、行为可理解性（Behavioral Intelligibility）与感知对齐（Perceptual Alignment）的框架，并贯穿具身（embodiment）、控制（control）、认知（cognition）与设计（design）四个层面进行组织。
AI.result: 该摘要为框架性/立场性论述，未给出实验数据或量化结果。
AI.conclusion: 可信度并非单一属性，而是源于物理能力、可观察行为与人在交互中形成的期望三者之间的对齐。

title: AeroBuoy: A Drone Deployable, 3D Printed, Autonomous Robotic Buoy for Environmental Inspection in Remote and Hazardous River Systems
comment: 7 pages. Accepted version. Published in the 2025 IEEE/RSJ International Conference on Intelligent Robots and Systems (IROS). Winner of the IROS 2025 Best Paper Award on Safety, Security, and Rescue Robotics in memory of Motohiro Kisoi. Reuben O'Brien and Angus Lynch contributed equally
summary: Monitoring of waterways such as remote and hazardous rivers and streams is important so as to assess the impact of external factors including construction runoff or climate change. Versatile, autonomous robotic boats can offer excellent environmental inspection and monitoring solutions for remote, dangerous, or access protected water bodies but they have several shortcomings in terms of maneuverability. This paper proposes an environmental inspection system consisting of an autonomous data collection buoy which is designed to be deployed to inaccessible river systems using a drone. The system can perform a drop off and pickup of the buoy depending on the requirements of a particular location and monitoring task. Utilising the natural flow of the river the buoy autonomously steers down, using GPS and magnetometers so as to maintain the desired trajectory. The buoy is capable of measuring water temperature but it can also be equipped with a range of sensors such as water oxygen meter, sonar for river bed inspection, or turbidity for water clarity. This paper describes the system design, presents an analysis of the self-righting capabilities of the buoy, and shows a full system demonstration at the Ōrewa River in Auckland, New Zealand.

AI.tldr: 论文提出一种由无人机投放、可自主回收的环境巡检浮标系统，利用河流自然水流和GPS/磁力计自主导航，实现偏远危险河流的水质监测，并在新西兰Ōrewa河完成全系统演示。
AI.motivation: 偏远、危险或受保护水域的河流监测对评估施工径流、气候变化等外部因素影响至关重要。通用自主机器船虽能提供环境巡检方案，但在机动性方面存在不足，难以部署到难以进入的河段。
AI.method: 设计一种可由无人机部署到不可达河流系统的自主数据采集浮标。依据具体位置和监测任务需求，实现浮标的投放与回收；利用河流自然水流，借助GPS和磁力计自主操控浮标下行以维持期望轨迹；浮标可测水温，并可搭载溶解氧仪、河床探测声呐、浊度计等传感器。
AI.result: 给出系统设计方案，分析浮标的自扶正能力，并在新西兰奥克兰Ōrewa河完成完整系统演示。
AI.conclusion: 该无人机部署的自主浮标系统可有效用于偏远、危险或受限水域的环境巡检与监测，具备多传感器扩展能力和自主导航与回收能力。

title: What the Elevation Map Cannot See: Semantic-Aware Locomotion and Execution-Aware Navigation for Humanoid Robot
summary: Navigation for humanoid robots is critical, yet large-scale evaluation on physical hardware is often impractical due to cost and safety concerns, making simulation benchmarks essential. Existing VLN benchmarks achieve physically executable navigation, but still assume (1) all hazards are observable from elevation maps; (2) realized motions closely match desired motions. In real environments, however, fallen bottles may be ambiguous in elevation maps, while phones and water spills may be difficult to differentiate; hazard avoidance by the locomotion policy can cause the robot's actual trajectory to deviate from the path intended by the VLN policy. Such command-execution mismatch can accumulate and lead the robot toward unintended locations. To expose these failure modes, we introduce a benchmark that models both elevation-subtle hazards and execution deviations, together with a closed-loop VLN + locomotion control framework that continuously realigns high-level navigation with the robot's actual state. We evaluate navigation in simulation and further validate the locomotion policy on a physical Unitree G1 humanoid robot. Results show that semantic input reduces contact with hazards poorly represented in elevation maps, while anti-deviation improves navigation success. These findings highlight the need to evaluate humanoid navigation jointly in terms of route completion and hazard avoidance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个面向人形机器人视觉语言导航（VLN）的新基准，同时建模"高程图难以表征的隐患"与"指令-执行偏差"，并给出闭环VLN+运动控制框架，仿真评估并在Unitree G1实体上验证运动策略，发现语义输入与抗偏差机制分别提升避障与导航成功率。
AI.motivation: 人形机器人导航的大规模真实硬件评测因成本与安全难以开展，仿真基准至关重要。现有VLN基准虽实现了物理可执行导航，但仍假设：(1) 所有危险均可由高程图观测；(2) 实际运动与期望运动高度一致。真实环境中，倒地瓶子在高程图中语义模糊，手机与水渍难以区分；运动策略为规避危险会导致实际轨迹偏离VLN策略意图路径，这类指令-执行偏差会累积并把机器人导向非预期位置。为暴露这些失效模式，作者提出新基准。
AI.method: 构建同时包含两类要素的基准：一类是高程图上表现细微/模糊的隐患（elevation-subtle hazards），另一类是执行偏差（execution deviations）。配套提出闭环的VLN+运动控制框架，持续将高层导航指令与机器人实际状态重新对齐（realign），以缓解累积偏差。
AI.result: 在仿真中进行导航评测，并在实体Unitree G1人形机器人上验证运动策略。结果表明：语义输入可减少与高程图难以表征的隐患的接触；抗偏差（anti-deviation）机制可提升导航成功率。这些发现凸显了需从路径完成度与避障两方面联合评估人形机器人导航。
AI.conclusion: 人形机器人导航评测不应只关注路径完成度，还应纳入避障维度；语义感知与闭环抗偏差对真实可部署导航至关重要。该基准与框架为暴露现有VLN基准的隐含假设失效提供了评测手段，并具备向真实硬件迁移的可行性。

title: An Autonomous, 3D Printed, Waterjet-Powered, Open-Source Robotic Trimaran for Environmental Inspection and Monitoring
comment: 8 pages. Accepted version. Published in the 2024 IEEE/RSJ International Conference on Intelligent Robots and Systems (IROS). Finalist for the IROS 2024 Best Application Paper Award
summary: Versatile, autonomous robotic boats can offer excellent environmental inspection and monitoring solutions for remote, dangerous, hard to reach, or access protected water bodies. This paper introduces such a platform in the form of an autonomous, cost-effective, waterjet-powered robotic trimaran. Motivated by the need for an efficient aquatic monitoring, particularly in Aotearoa - New Zealand's diverse environments, the trimaran provides an efficient, low-cost, and easy to replicate alternative to resource-intensive research vessels. The proposed platform, costs $600-1,500 USD to develop (depending on the sensing system configuration), weighs under 5 kg, and excels in bathymetry and water quality testing. The trimaran can reach speeds of up to 2 m/s offering obstacle avoidance of natural features, such as rocks. Utilizing off-the-shelf components and 3D printing technology, the proposed platform offers excellent reproducibility and robustness while operating in shallow waters with its jet propulsion system. The paper presents in detail the design characteristics, the sensing system employed, testing results focusing on bathymetry, and highlights the ability of vessel and the potential for future research and data collection.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种低成本、可自主航行的喷水推进三体无人船，用于偏远及受保护水域的环境监测，具备浅水测深与水质检测能力。
AI.motivation: 偏远、危险、难以抵达或受保护水体的环境巡检与监测需求突出，而传统科考船资源消耗大、成本高，亟需高效、低成本且易复制的替代方案，尤其是针对新西兰多样水域环境。
AI.method: 设计并开发一款喷水推进的自主三体无人船平台，采用现成商用组件与3D打印技术制造，配备可配置的传感系统，开展以测深为重点的测试，并考察其对岩石等自然障碍物的规避能力。
AI.result: 平台开发成本约600–1500美元（取决于传感配置），重量低于5 kg，最高航速可达2 m/s，能够规避岩石等自然障碍，依托喷水推进可在浅水环境中作业，在测深和水质检测方面表现优异，且具备良好的可复制性与鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 该三体无人船为高效水体监测提供了低成本、易复制的解决方案，展示了在浅水及复杂水域的应用潜力，并为后续研究与数据采集奠定基础。

title: RACER: Residual-Adaptive Closed-Loop Estimation for Sampling-Based Planning in Wheeled-Quadruped Racing
summary: We present RACER, a hierarchical control framework for wheel-based quadruped racing that combines an MPPI planner with a learned residual dynamics model and a low-level RL velocity tracker. The planner augments a nominal unicycle kinematic model with a neural residual term to capture the closed-loop tracking behavior of the RL policy. To train this residual model under limited real-world data, we propose Low-Rank Residual Adaptation (LoRRA), a two-stage approach that pre-trains on large-scale simulation data for broad coverage and then fine-tunes on a small real-world dataset with a low-rank constraint. In simulation, we empirically validate our engineering choices by showing (A) Residual dynamics improve the overall performance of our pipeline by capturing the tracking error of RL velocity tracker at high-speed cornering. (B) Residual dynamics trained with both source-domain and target-domain data gives racing performance significantly better than the residual dynamics trained with only target-domain data. (C) Low-rank constraint at target-domain adaptation gives higher success rates and higher performance than full-tune and from-scratch when domain gap in ground coefficient or joint gain increases.

AI.tldr: 提出RACER分层控制框架，结合MPPI规划器、学习残差动力学模型与底层RL速度跟踪器，用于轮式四足机器人竞速；并提出LoRRA两阶段低秩残差自适应方法。
AI.motivation: 轮式四足高速竞速中，标称单轮运动学模型无法刻画RL速度跟踪器的闭环跟踪行为，且真实世界数据有限，直接训练残差模型难以覆盖充分且易受域差距影响。
AI.method: RACER采用分层控制：MPPI规划器在标称单轮运动学模型上叠加神经残差项，以捕捉RL策略的闭环跟踪行为；底层为RL速度跟踪器。残差模型训练采用LoRRA两阶段方案：先在大规模仿真数据上预训练以获得广泛覆盖，再在少量真实数据上以低秩约束微调。
AI.result: 仿真实验验证：(A)残差动力学通过捕捉高速转弯时RL速度跟踪器的跟踪误差，提升整体流水线性能；(B)使用源域与目标域数据联合训练的残差动力学，竞速性能显著优于仅用目标域数据训练；(C)在地面系数或关节增益域差距增大时，目标域自适应中的低秩约束相比全量微调和从零训练，取得更高成功率和更高性能。
AI.conclusion: 结合残差动力学与低秩自适应可有效提升轮式四足高速竞速的控制性能与跨域鲁棒性，LoRRA在有限真实数据下优于全量微调与从零训练。

title: Entropy-Gated Belief Coordination for Decentralized Multi-Agent Search Under Intermittent Communication
summary: We study decentralized multi-agent target search where homogeneous agents communicate intermittently at Poisson-distributed times. Standard unconditional belief fusion wastes communication opportunities by synchronizing agents during high-entropy exploration, when diverse independent beliefs provide better coverage than a premature consensus. We introduce \emph{entropy-gated belief coordination}, in which agents skip fusion while their collective entropy ratio exceeds a threshold~\(θ\) and merge only during exploitation, consistent with the bifurcation structure of nonlinear opinion dynamics and the submodular structure of the per-step information gain objective. We further derive \(\Istep(α,β)\), the expected mutual information per observation step between two agents' binary sensors, as an interpretable, communication-free measure of sensor informativeness that motivates the gating design and guides system-level analysis. Experiments across 103{,}680 trials (nine grid sizes up to \(100{\times}100\), Poisson communication timing, four target movement patterns) show that the Entropy-Gated Trust-Decay Planner (\textsc{EG-TDP}), which adds a detection-probability planner switch in exploitation mode, achieves mean belief quality \(\bar{Q}=0.300\) (mean belief mass at the true target cell, averaged across all trials and steps), a \(58.9\%\) gain over arithmetic mean and a \(37.4\%\) gain over visit-weighted fusion. On representative configurations, EG-TDP also outperforms a joint-Bayesian reference that uses all agents'~observations at every step, despite operating under random intermittent contact only.

AI.tldr: 提出熵门控信念协调（EG-TDP），在间歇通信的多智能体目标搜索中，仅在利用阶段融合信念，避免高熵探索期的过早共识，显著提升信念质量。
AI.motivation: 标准无条件信念融合在智能体于泊松分布时刻间歇通信时，会在高熵探索阶段强制同步，浪费通信机会，因为此时各智能体独立的多样信念比过早共识更能提供有效覆盖。因此需要一种按探索/利用阶段自适应决定是否融合的机制。
AI.method: 引入熵门控信念协调：当集体熵比超过阈值θ时跳过融合，仅在利用阶段合并信念；该设计与非线性观点动力学的分岔结构和逐步信息增益目标的子模结构一致。同时推导 Istep(α,β)——两智能体二元传感器间每观测步的期望互信息，作为可解释、无需通信的传感器信息量度量，用于指导门控设计。EG-TDP在利用模式中加入检测概率规划器切换。
AI.result: 在103,680次试验（九种网格尺寸至100×100、泊松通信时序、四种目标移动模式）中，EG-TDP达到平均信念质量Q̄=0.300，较算术平均提升58.9%，较访问加权融合提升37.4%。在代表性配置上，尽管仅依赖随机间歇接触，EG-TDP仍优于每步使用全部智能体观测的联合贝叶斯参考方法。
AI.conclusion: 按熵门控延迟信念融合可有效利用通信资源，避免高熵探索期的过早共识；EG-TDP在间歇通信约束下取得优于无条件融合及联合贝叶斯参考的信念质量。

title: Dynamics Modeling of a Multi-UAV Slung Load System Using a Discrete-Link Cable Approach
comment: Presented at ICRA 2026 as an accepted paper
summary: A common assumption to simplify the problem of controlling a multi-UAV slung load system (MUSLS) is that the flexible cables can be modeled as massless rigid rods. In this work, we propose an alternative Euler-Newton derived dynamical model which uses a series of rigid links to model the flexible cables. The model is specifically designed to allow efficient simulation using Featherstone's articulated body algorithm. We perform real-world validation of this model on gentle, aggressive, and tension-engagement maneuvers and run a parameter sweep to determine the number of links, joint damping, and joint friction to achieve the greatest model fidelity. The model closely matches real-world flight data with mean load translation errors below 132 mm (5.5% of the cable length) and orientation errors below 11.4 degrees. We make the real-world flight data publicly available for the development of future cable models.

AI.tldr: 提出用多刚体链替代无质量刚性杆的Euler-Newton动力学模型，可高效仿真，并通过实飞数据验证其高保真度。
AI.motivation: 简化多无人机吊挂负载系统（MUSLS）控制问题时，常将柔性缆绳假设为无质量刚性杆，该假设忽略缆绳柔性与张力变化，影响模型精度。
AI.method: 基于Euler-Newton推导动力学模型，用一系列刚性连杆建模柔性缆绳，并专门设计以适配Featherstone关节体算法实现高效仿真；通过平缓、剧烈及张力介入机动开展实飞验证，并进行参数扫描确定连杆数、关节阻尼与关节摩擦。
AI.result: 模型与实飞数据高度吻合，负载平移误差均值低于132 mm（缆绳长度的5.5%），姿态误差低于11.4度。实飞数据已公开。
AI.conclusion: 多刚体链缆绳模型相比无质量刚性杆假设具有更高保真度，且可高效仿真，为后续缆绳模型研究提供了公开数据基础。

title: SURGE: Sonar-fUsed Reconstruction and localization via image-gated Graph Estimation
summary: Remotely operated vehicles (ROVs) are widely used to explore and inspect underwater environments such as caves, shipwrecks, and submerged infrastructure. These missions require accurate 3D understanding of the surrounding environment, which depends on both reliable vehicle localization and metric scene reconstruction. However, external positioning is often unavailable underwater, requiring small ROVs to rely primarily on onboard perception. Optic vision provides rich visual and geometric information but suffers from scale ambi- guity and trajectory drift, whereas 2D imaging sonar provides metric range but incomplete 3D geometry. Existing underwater reconstruction approaches typically address these limitations separately or assume known sensor poses, leaving localization and reconstruction disconnected. We present SURGE, a camera sonar framework that jointly estimates the ROV trajectory and target location by integrating visual and acoustic observations within a factor graph, then uses the recovered metric poses for sonar Gaussian splatting. Experiments on real underwater RGB sonar observations show that SURGE substantially improves localization consistency over conventional vision based pose estimation and produces a more compact, natively metric reconstruction than RGB Gaussian splatting baselines.

AI.tldr: SURGE是一个相机-声呐联合框架，在因子图中融合视觉与声学观测，联合估计ROV轨迹与目标位置，并利用恢复的度量位姿进行声呐高斯泼溅重建。
AI.motivation: 小型ROV在水下（洞穴、沉船、水下基础设施）执行探索与巡检任务时需要准确的三维环境理解，这依赖于可靠的载体定位与度量场景重建。但水下通常缺乏外部定位，只能依赖机载感知：光学视觉信息丰富却存在尺度模糊与轨迹漂移，二维成像声呐提供度量距离但三维几何不完整。已有水下重建方法往往分别处理这些局限或假设已知传感器位姿，导致定位与重建相互割裂。
AI.method: 提出SURGE相机-声呐框架：在因子图中融合视觉观测与声学观测，联合估计ROV轨迹与目标位置；随后利用恢复的度量位姿驱动声呐高斯泼溅（sonar Gaussian splatting）进行场景重建。
AI.result: 在真实水下RGB-声呐观测数据上的实验表明，相较于传统基于视觉的位姿估计，SURGE显著提升了定位一致性；相比RGB高斯泼溅基线，生成了更紧凑且原生具备度量尺度的重建结果。
AI.conclusion: 通过将视觉与声呐观测在因子图中联合优化，SURGE实现了定位与重建的耦合，缓解了光学尺度模糊/漂移与声呐几何不完整的互补性问题，为水下ROV提供了一致定位与度量重建的统一方案。

title: Risk-Sensitive Crowd Navigation with Adaptive Ellipsoidal Conformal Prediction
summary: Safe crowd navigation under distribution shift requires uncertainty representations that capture structured human-motion prediction errors and safety objectives that account for rare but consequential failures. Existing uncertainty-aware methods typically represent prediction errors using isotropic regions, which can be either overly conservative or poorly aligned with directional motion uncertainty. We introduce a risk-aware navigation framework that uses anisotropic conformal ellipsoids to translate structured prediction uncertainty into an episode-level conditional value-at-risk (CVaR) signal that regulates the Lagrangian safety penalty. In particular, adaptive ellipsoidal conformal prediction (AECP) captures directional prediction errors and adaptively calibrates uncertainty regions under distribution shift, while the resulting CVaR-regulated navigation policy is optimized using Lagrangian proximal policy optimization. We evaluate our proposed method under both in-distribution settings and out-of-distribution (OOD) settings involving shifts in pedestrian motion patterns. Compared with state-of-the-art baselines, our method maintains competitive in-distribution performance while improving success rates by 5.68-7.44 percentage points and reducing collision rates by 5.44-6.64 percentage points across OOD settings. We further deploy the trained policy without fine-tuning on a physical robot with onboard perception and CPU-only inference, showing that the full pipeline is feasible in physical crowd navigation.

AI.tldr: 提出风险感知人群导航框架，用各向异性共形椭球将结构化预测不确定性转化为CVaR信号来调节拉格朗日安全惩罚，在分布外场景下提升成功率并降低碰撞率。
AI.motivation: 分布偏移下的人群导航需要能刻画结构化人体运动预测误差的不确定性表示，以及能应对罕见但后果严重失效的安全目标。现有不确定性感知方法多用各向同性区域表示预测误差，容易过度保守或与方向性运动不确定性对齐不佳。
AI.method: 提出风险感知导航框架：采用自适应椭球共形预测（AECP）捕捉方向性预测误差，并在分布偏移下自适应校准不确定性区域；将结构化预测不确定性转化为回合级条件风险价值（CVaR）信号，用于调节拉格朗日安全惩罚；用拉格朗日近端策略优化（Lagrangian PPO）优化受CVaR调节的导航策略。
AI.result: 在分布内与涉及行人运动模式偏移的分布外（OOD）设置下评估。相比最先进基线，分布内性能保持竞争力，OOD设置下成功率提升5.68–7.44个百分点，碰撞率降低5.44–6.64个百分点。并将训练策略无微调部署到配备机载感知、仅CPU推理的物理机器人上，验证了全流程在真实人群导航中的可行性。
AI.conclusion: 各向异性共形椭球结合CVaR调节的拉格朗日安全约束能有效提升分布偏移下人群导航的安全性与成功率，且具备真实机器人部署可行性。

title: ProCut: Probabilistic Cutting Topology for Autonomous Electrosurgical Tissue Dissection
summary: Accurately modeling and tracking the deformation of soft tissue is critical for a wide range of interventional and surgical procedures. However, current methods struggle in scenarios involving topological changes, such as cutting and dissection, due to the inherent non-linearity and discontinuity introduced by explicit changes in connectivity. In this work, we present a novel, fully differentiable framework that enables robust estimation and modeling of topological changes during deformable tracking. Our method introduces a continuous, sigmoid-based formulation to smooth the otherwise discrete event of tissue cutting, making it amenable to gradient-based optimization within a differentiable Position-Based Dynamics (PBD) simulation. To account for uncertainty and improve robustness in the presence of noisy visual data, we incorporate Stein Variational Gradient Descent (SVGD) for particle-based probabilistic inference, generating multiple hypotheses for topological state estimation. Building on this foundation, we develop an autonomous dissection algorithm for thin-shell tissues that leverages topological updates to guide closed-loop cutting trajectory control. We evaluate our approach in both simulated and real-world electrosurgical environments, demonstrating significant improvements in topological estimation accuracy and dissection precision over existing methods. Our results highlight the potential of this framework to advance automation in soft-tissue surgical procedures by enabling reliable perception and control in the presence of complex structural changes.

AI.tldr: 提出一个全可微框架，通过sigmoid连续化组织切割事件并结合SVGD概率推断，实现可变形软组织追踪中的拓扑变化建模，并用于自主解剖切割控制。
AI.motivation: 软组织变形建模与追踪对介入及外科手术至关重要，但现有方法在涉及切割、剥离等拓扑变化时表现不佳，原因是连接关系改变带来的非线性与不连续性难以处理。
AI.method: 1) 引入连续sigmoid形式化公式，将离散的组织切割事件平滑化，使其可在可微的Position-Based Dynamics（PBD）仿真中进行基于梯度的优化；2) 采用Stein Variational Gradient Descent（SVGD）进行基于粒子的概率推断，生成多个拓扑状态假设以应对噪声视觉数据的不确定性、提升鲁棒性；3) 在此基础上提出面向薄壳组织的自主解剖算法，利用拓扑更新引导闭环切割轨迹控制。
AI.result: 在仿真和真实电外科环境中评估，拓扑估计精度与解剖精度均显著优于现有方法。
AI.conclusion: 该框架通过在复杂结构变化下实现可靠感知与控制，展现了推进软组织手术自动化的潜力。

title: ReDex: Repairing Sim-to-Real Dexterous Policies by Finger-Level Compliant Interaction
summary: Dexterous manipulation policies trained in simulation often fail to transfer to the real world because of errors in contact timing and force regulation. Yet these policies can retain useful multi-finger coordination for task progression. We propose ReDex, a framework for adapting a simulation-trained base policy to the real world by correcting local contact failures and incorporating tactile feedback. Starting from a proprioception-only base policy, ReDex allows a human operator to physically correct contact failures at selected fingers under compliant control during real-world rollouts, while the frozen base policy continues to control the remaining fingers. These rollouts combine base policy execution, human-corrected finger motion, and fingertip force observations. We reconstruct force-informed targets from these rollouts to train a standalone force-conditioned policy via behavior cloning. This design reduces human correction effort, enables learning of contact regulation from real-world interaction, and introduces force feedback into a proprioception-only policy without tactile simulation or complex full-hand teleoperation. We evaluate ReDex on two challenging, contact-rich dexterous manipulation tasks on real hardware. Compared with sim-to-real transferred base policies, ReDex increases Object Flipping success rate from 14\% to 86\% across two objects and average Screwdriver Rotation progress from 26.0% to 95.3% across three objects.

AI.tldr: ReDex：通过人手局部纠正接触失误并重构力反馈目标，将仿真训练的本体感知多指策略适配到真实世界，显著提升接触密集型灵巧操作成功率。
AI.motivation: 仿真训练的灵巧操作策略因接触时序与力调节误差而难以迁移到真实世界，但这些策略通常已具备可用的多指协调能力。直接使用纯本体感知策略在接触密集型任务中失败率很高，而全手遥操作或触觉仿真的成本高、复杂度大，因此需要一种低成本、聚焦局部接触失败的真实世界适配方法。
AI.method: ReDex 从仅使用本体感知的仿真基策略出发，在真实世界执行期间由人类操作员在柔顺控制下对选定手指的接触失败进行物理纠正，冻结的基策略继续控制其余手指。收集的轨迹包含基策略执行、人手纠正的手指运动与指尖力观测，随后从中重构出力条件目标，通过行为克隆训练一个独立的力条件策略，从而在不依赖触觉仿真与全手遥操作的条件下引入力反馈。
AI.result: 在真实硬件上的两个接触密集型灵巧操作任务中，与仿真到现实迁移的基策略相比，ReDex 将 Object Flipping 的成功率从 14% 提升至 86%（两种物体），并将 Screwdriver Rotation 的平均进度从 26.0% 提升至 95.3%（三种物体）。
AI.conclusion: ReDex 表明，仅针对局部接触失败进行人机协同纠正，并据此学习力条件策略，即可有效弥合接触时序与力调节层面的仿真到现实差距，同时把触觉反馈注入原本仅有本体感知的策略中，是一种高效、低负担的真实世界适配范式。

title: Task-Space Imitation Guidance for Efficient Reinforcement Learning
summary: We introduce Task-Space Imitation Guidance for Efficient Reinforcement Learning (TIGER), a reward-construction and pretraining framework for sparse-reward tabletop robotic manipulation. TIGER treats an action-chunked imitation policy not as an executable controller or action prior, but as a local task-space progress estimator: predicted action chunks are converted, using controller-aware action-to-motion mapping, into short-horizon end-effector references, and the RL agent receives dense progress rewards toward these references while the sparse environment reward remains the dominant objective. During pretraining, TIGER uses imitation-guided look-ahead signals to relax conservative value penalties for actions predicted to make task-space progress, reducing off-manifold exploration during early online RL. Across simulation and real-robot experiments, TIGER improves early sample efficiency and reduces measured safety violations while matching or improving final success rates relative to prior RL and IL-RL baselines on the evaluated tasks.

AI.tldr: TIGER 将动作分块模仿策略用作任务空间进度估计器，通过控制器感知的动作-运动映射生成末端参考，为 RL 提供稠密进度奖励，并在预训练中用模仿引导的前瞻信号放松保守值惩罚，从而提升稀疏奖励桌面机械臂操作中的早期样本效率与安全性。
AI.motivation: 面向稀疏奖励的桌面机器人操作任务，纯 RL 探索效率低、早期在线训练存在脱离流形的探索与安全风险；既有 IL-RL 方法多把模仿策略当作可执行控制器或动作先验，未充分利用其局部进度信息。
AI.method: 提出奖励构建与预训练框架 TIGER：(1) 将动作分块模仿策略视为局部任务空间进度估计器；(2) 通过控制器感知的动作-运动映射，把预测动作块转换为短时域末端执行器参考；(3) 以稀疏环境奖励为主导目标，同时施加朝向这些参考的稠密进度奖励；(4) 预训练阶段利用模仿引导的前瞻信号，对预测能带来任务空间进度的动作放松保守值惩罚。
AI.result: 在仿真与真实机器人实验中，相比现有 RL 与 IL-RL 基线，TIGER 在所评估任务上提升了早期样本效率，减少了实测安全违规次数，且最终成功率持平或更优。
AI.conclusion: 模仿策略的作用可从"执行器/动作先验"重新定位为"任务空间进度估计器"，据此构建稠密进度奖励与前瞻式值惩罚放松机制，可在保持稀疏奖励主导目标与最终性能的同时，显著改善早期学习效率与安全性。

title: Seeing the Invisible: Physics-Guided Visual Prompting for Temperature- and Radiation-Aware VLA Navigation
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have become a major paradigm for Vision-and-Language Navigation (VLN). However, in safety-critical facilities, invisible risks such as radiation or temperature spikes cannot be detected by an RGB camera, and handling each risk is expensive, requiring a new encoder, new data, and model retraining. We propose Physics-Guided Visual Prompting (PG-VP), a plug-and-play multimodal perception module that instead reuses what a frozen VLA model already does well: avoiding visible obstacles. Given a proximal radiation or thermal source, PG-VP performs a physics-guided risk assessment to determine the avoidance direction and overlays a corresponding virtual obstacle that moves across consecutive frames (Dynamic Visual Prompting). The navigation policy then naturally detours around this invisible hazard. The identical virtual obstacle is used regardless of hazard type, so the visual prompting pattern remains fixed as sensors are added. When no hazard is detected, nothing is rendered, and the policy behaves exactly as it would without PG-VP. We evaluate PG-VP on OmniNav using the val-unseen splits of R2R-CE and RxR-CE, where it guides the policy toward intended low-risk actions in 84.9% and 83.2% of cases, at a cost of 6.8 and 7.9 percentage points in navigation success rate. We further test it with distinct scenarios on a real robot in the presence of actual thermal and radiation sources, all without any retraining. The real test shows that PG-VP effectively avoids these invisible hazards, improving worst-10% average trajectory safety by 63.45% and 32.59% against thermal and radiation sources, respectively.

AI.tldr: PG-VP是一种即插即用的多模态感知模块，通过物理引导的风险评估生成动态视觉提示（虚拟障碍），复用冻结VLA模型已有的避障能力，使导航策略绕开辐射/高温等不可见风险，无需重训练。
AI.motivation: 在安全关键设施中，辐射、温度骤升等不可见风险无法被RGB相机检测；而针对每种风险传统方案需新增编码器、新数据和模型重训练，代价高昂。
AI.method: 给定近端辐射或热源，PG-VP进行物理引导的风险评估以确定规避方向，并叠加一个跨连续帧移动的对应虚拟障碍（动态视觉提示）；导航策略据此自然绕行该不可见危险。无论危险类型如何都使用同一虚拟障碍，故新增传感器时视觉提示模式保持固定；无危险时不渲染任何内容，策略行为与无PG-VP时完全一致。
AI.result: 在OmniNav上、R2R-CE与RxR-CE的val-unseen划分中，PG-VP分别以84.9%和83.2%的比例引导策略采取预期的低风险动作，代价是导航成功率下降6.8和7.9个百分点。在真实机器人上针对实际热源与辐射源的多种场景测试（无任何重训练），最差10%平均轨迹安全性分别提升63.45%（热源）和32.59%（辐射）。
AI.conclusion: PG-VP以固定虚拟障碍复用冻结VLA模型的可见障碍避让能力，实现即插即用、无需重训练的不可见风险管理，在仿真与真实机器人上均有效提升轨迹安全性，仅以适度成功率损失为代价。

title: BiGym 2.0: Benchmarking Learned and Agent-Developed Policies for Humanoid Household Manipulation
summary: Humanoid household manipulation requires the arms to act while the body balances, steps and changes posture. We present BiGym 2.0, an adaptation of BiGym for the Unitree G1 across 20 household tasks using a unified whole-body controller for demonstration and evaluation. The suite provides 60 native human virtual-reality demonstrations per task with synchronised multi-camera views and full-body execution records. We benchmark vision-language-action fine-tuning, imitation learning, demo-driven reinforcement learning, and cold-start coding agents given the interaction budget of online reinforcement learning. With the same onboard views, proprioception and whole-body controller for every method, vision-language-action fine-tuning has the highest nine-task mean, and agent-developed programs outperform every demo-driven reinforcement learning baseline on this mean and lead on bimanual reaching. Cross-workspace stacking remains open, $π_{0.5}$ stays low on pick-box, and multi-object transport is hard for imitation learning, demo-driven reinforcement learning and coding agents. All environments, human demonstrations, and evaluation traces are open-sourced at https://github.com/swirl-uk/BiGym2.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 BiGym 2.0，将 BiGym 适配到 Unitree G1 人形机器人，覆盖 20 项家务任务，采用统一全身控制器进行示教与评测，并提供每任务 60 条真人 VR 示教数据与多视角同步记录，系统基准了 VLA 微调、模仿学习、示教驱动强化学习和冷启动编码智能体四类方法。
AI.motivation: 人形家务操作要求机器人在保持平衡、迈步与变换姿态的同时完成手臂操作，现有基准多聚焦固定底座机械臂，缺乏面向全身控制的人形家务任务与统一评测协议，因此需要一套任务、示教与评测一体化的平台。
AI.method: 基于 BiGym 改造为 BiGym 2.0，面向 Unitree G1 构建 20 项家务任务；使用统一全身控制器完成示教采集与评测；每任务提供 60 条真人 VR 示教，含同步多相机视图与全身执行记录；在相同机载视觉、本体感受与全身控制器条件下，基准 VLA 微调、模仿学习、示教驱动强化学习，以及在在线强化学习交互预算下运行的冷启动编码智能体。
AI.result: 在九任务均值指标上，VLA 微调表现最高；智能体生成的程序在该均值上优于所有示教驱动强化学习基线，并在双臂抓取任务上领先。跨工作空间堆叠任务仍未解决，π0.5 在 pick-box 任务上得分偏低，多物体搬运对模仿学习、示教驱动强化学习与编码智能体均较困难。
AI.conclusion: BiGym 2.0 为 Unitree G1 提供了统一全身控制下的人形家务操作基准与真人示教资源，揭示了 VLA 微调与编码智能体在部分任务上的优势，同时指出跨工作空间堆叠、pick-box 与多物体搬运等仍为开放难题；全部环境、示教与评测轨迹已开源。

title: The Robot Is Not Its Description: GaugeBench for Representation Robustness in Morphology-Aware Policies
summary: A robot description does more than specify a physical mechanism: it also encodes arbitrary conventions, such as joint-axis direction, joint-angle zero, and the order and names of links and joints. Morphology-aware policies consume interfaces built from these descriptions, yet cross-embodiment evaluation typically changes the robot while keeping those conventions fixed. This leaves a simple question unanswered: does behavior survive when the robot stays fixed but its description changes? GaugeBench isolates this case by rewriting a fixed mechanism under physically equivalent conventions, verifying that its physics and policy interface are preserved, and then evaluating the same policy weights. The result is stark: three MetaMorph policies score 4030.6 on 80 familiar robots, but only 51.6 when those same robots are equivalently re-described, while 98 genuinely held-out robots score 1489.6. A new description can therefore be more damaging than a new robot. Tracing the failure reveals that axis reversal alone reproduces the collapse, joint-angle zero changes are nearly harmless, and reordering lies between them; moreover, changing joint-state and torque coordinates alone is sufficient to cause the failure, while changing description-derived features alone is not. The same phenomenon appears in ModuMorph and an unrelated PyBullet framework. Yet it is not irreversible: exact two-description transport restores the original controller, and training across equivalent axis conventions raises retained return under axis reversal from 3.6% to 80.6%. Together, these results separate mechanism robustness from representation robustness and show that cross-embodiment evaluation should test both.

AI.tldr: 机器人描述不仅指定物理机构，还编码关节轴方向、关节角零点及关节命名等任意约定。GaugeBench 在物理等价约定下改写固定机器人并保持策略接口不变，发现同一策略权重在等价重描述后性能从 4030.6 骤降至 51.6，说明“描述变化”可能比“换机器人”更具破坏性。
AI.motivation: 现有形态感知策略依赖由机器人描述构建的接口，而跨形态评测通常只更换机器人、却固定描述约定，因此无法回答一个关键问题：机器人不变、仅描述改变时，行为是否仍能保持。论文旨在将机构鲁棒性与表示鲁棒性区分开来。
AI.method: 提出 GaugeBench：对固定机构在物理等价约定下重写描述，验证物理与策略接口均被保留，再评测同一策略权重。系统分析轴反转、关节角零点变化、关节重排序的影响，并区分仅改变关节状态/力矩坐标与仅改变描述派生特征的作用；在 MetaMorph、ModuMorph 及无关 PyBullet 框架上复现，并尝试两种恢复手段。
AI.result: 三个 MetaMorph 策略在 80 个熟悉机器人上得分 4030.6，等价重描述后仅 51.6，而 98 个真正留出机器人得分 1489.6。仅轴反转即可复现崩溃，关节角零点变化几乎无害，重排序介于二者之间；仅改变关节状态与力矩坐标足以导致失败，仅改变描述派生特征则不会。该现象在 ModuMorph 与无关 PyBullet 框架中同样出现。精确的双描述迁移可恢复原控制器；跨等价轴约定训练可将轴反转下的保留回报从 3.6% 提升至 80.6%。
AI.conclusion: 策略的机构鲁棒性不等于表示鲁棒性；跨形态评测应同时测试二者。描述约定变化是可修复的，通过双描述迁移或跨等价约定训练可显著缓解性能崩溃。

title: Modeling Latent Disturbances for Robust Decision-Making in World Models
summary: In this paper, we study robust decision-making in the latent space of world models (WMs). Robust optimization is a mathematical framework where, given explicitly specified dynamics and physically meaningful disturbances, a robot can select actions that remain effective even under worst-case disturbances. However, applying this principle to the learned latent space of WMs introduces a fundamental challenge: because WMs have fully learned state spaces and dynamics inferred from high-dimensional observations, it is unclear how to define latent-space disturbances that faithfully represent uncertainty in the underlying system. Our key idea is to model a latent-space disturbance as a perturbation to the learned latent dynamics that induces pessimistic but plausible transitions. Specifically, we construct a set of plausible latent dynamics by combining a dynamics-aware similarity metric that captures plausible transitions with out-of-distribution detection that excludes implausible latent states. We calibrate this uncertainty set over latent dynamics using conformal prediction, ensuring that WM imaginations induced by the latent disturbance remain plausible without becoming overly pessimistic. We then jointly optimize robust robot actions and the worst-case latent disturbances through game-theoretic optimization. We leverage this latent-space robust optimization to robustify policy steering, considering two paradigms: latent safety filtering and sample-and-verify steering of a generative control policy. Our controlled simulation experiments show that our latent disturbance enables robust decision-making directly in WM latent spaces, and hardware experiments with a Franka manipulator show that modeling latent disturbances enables robust policy steering, reducing failures by 70% in safety filtering and 54% in sampling-based policy steering. Project website: https://junwon.me/LatentDisturbance/.

AI.tldr: 本文将鲁棒优化引入世界模型（WM）的潜空间，通过对学习到的潜动力学施加"悲观但合理"的扰动来构建不确定性集合，并用共形预测校准，实现潜空间鲁棒决策与策略引导。
AI.motivation: 鲁棒优化需要显式给定的动力学与具有物理意义的扰动，而世界模型的潜空间与动力学均是从高维观测中学习得到的，因此难以定义能够忠实反映底层系统不确定性的潜空间扰动，这一矛盾是将鲁棒优化应用于WM潜空间的核心障碍。
AI.method: 将潜空间扰动建模为对学习到的潜动力学的扰动，使其诱导出悲观但合理的状态转移；通过结合"动力学感知相似度度量"（刻画合理转移）与"分布外检测"（排除不合理潜状态）构造一组合理的潜动力学；使用共形预测对该不确定性集合进行校准，保证WM想象既合理又不过度悲观；再以博弈论优化联合求解鲁棒动作与最坏情况潜扰动，并将该潜空间鲁棒优化用于潜空间安全滤波与生成式控制策略的采样-验证引导两种策略引导范式。
AI.result: 受控仿真实验表明该潜扰动能够在WM潜空间中直接支持鲁棒决策；Franka机械臂硬件实验表明建模潜扰动可实现鲁棒策略引导，安全滤波失败率降低70%，采样式策略引导失败率降低54%。
AI.conclusion: 该工作提出了一种在WM潜空间中定义并校准扰动的可行框架，将鲁棒优化原则有效迁移到学习式世界模型中，并通过仿真与真机验证了其在策略引导与安全滤波上的显著鲁棒性收益。

title: Learning Grasp Targeting from Point Clouds for Log Pile Clearing on a Hydraulic Crane
summary: In mill yards, log loaders clear dense piles by a sequence of bundle grasps: hundreds of logs rest in contact, and each removal changes the pile available to the next grasp. A learned policy chooses where to place and orient the grapple from unsegmented point clouds and runs on a trailer-mounted hydraulic forestry crane. The policy classifies at which observed point to grasp and predicts depth and grapple orientation there. The same network outputs support behavior cloning (BC), reinforcement learning (RL), and deployment. BC learns from successful top-of-pile demonstrations; RL explores for improvements by fine-tuning the cloned policy (BC$\to$RL) or by training from scratch. In simulation, BC clears 98 of 100 piles of 200 logs, while BC$\to$RL improves load stability. Twelve field trials compare a geometric heuristic, RL from scratch, BC, and BC$\to$RL through complete grasp-transport-deposit cycles. BC and BC$\to$RL deposit 93.8% and 88.9% of pooled inventory, against 80.4% for the heuristic. BC$\to$RL deposits logs on 83.6% of its cycles, against 79.6% for the heuristic and 65.7% for BC, while its simulated stability gain does not carry over to the crane testbed. Trained entirely in simulation and run unchanged on the crane, the learned policies clear more than the hand-filtered heuristic while observing unfiltered clouds that still contain the storage rack's rails and poles.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于点云的抓取策略，可在模拟中训练、无需改动直接部署于真实林业起重机，通过BC与BC→RL实现料堆原木抓取，表现优于几何启发式策略。
AI.motivation: 原木场中密集堆叠的木材存在相互接触、每次抓取都改变料堆构型的复杂动态，传统方法难以在无分割、含干扰的点云上完成抓取规划，且手调启发式在真实场景中泛化与稳定性有限。
AI.method: 策略以未分割点云为输入，直接分类抓取点并回归抓取深度与抓斗朝向；同一网络同时支持行为克隆（BC）、强化学习（RL）及部署。BC从堆顶成功示范中学习；RL通过微调克隆策略（BC→RL）或从零训练来探索改进。系统运行于挂车式液压林业起重机。
AI.result: 仿真中BC成功清理100堆（每堆200根原木）中的98堆，BC→RL提升了负载稳定性。12次现场试验对比几何启发式、从零RL、BC与BC→RL：BC与BC→RL分别沉积93.8%和88.9%的总库存，高于启发式的80.4%；BC→RL的单次循环沉积率为83.6%，启发式为79.6%，BC为65.7%；但仿真中的稳定性增益未在真实起重机平台上复现。
AI.conclusion: 完全在仿真中训练、未经改动即部署于起重机的学习策略，在仍含存储架导轨与立柱等未过滤干扰物的点云上，清理效果优于手工筛选的启发式方法，验证了仿真到现实的可行性与BC→RL的有效性，同时揭示了仿真稳定性增益向真实平台迁移的局限。

title: Nine Trials to Recover: A Reproducible Benchmark for Repertoire-Free Soft-Robot Damage Adaptation
summary: We present a repertoire-free benchmark for soft-robot damage recovery under nine online trials. The protocol pairs damage masks within each morphology, retains a measured nominal fallback, and separates method development from evaluation on new bodies. A Gaussian-process expected-improvement (GP-EI) reference controller adapts actuator phases using three initialization probes and six feedback-selected rollouts. Across two disjoint 75-body cohorts, it outperforms random search, Sobol, CEM, and CMA-ES under equal budgets. GP-EI improves the worst-mask gain on 69/75 confirmation bodies and exceeds these four baselines by 0.235-0.310 mean worst-mask reward. A TuRBO-style local GP is the closest comparator; the paired confidence interval includes zero. Post-confirmation fixed-controller replay finds 5.06 voxel widths of mean recovery together with a 0.0031 increase in worst-mask p99 geometric edge strain; a strict no-added-demand deployment gate retains 48.7% of mean gain. In a frozen development stress test that physically removes 10% of occupied voxels, GP-EI improves 71/75 bodies and exceeds official BoTorch TuRBO by 0.356 mean worst-mask gain. Together, the replayable controllers, body-level inference, and frozen-cohort evaluation provide a reference for measuring the added value of learned damage priors and future adaptation methods.

AI.tldr: 该文提出一个无需预置动作库（repertoire-free）的软体机器人损伤恢复基准，包含九项在线试验、身体级推断与冻结队列评估；以GP-EI为参考控制器，在两个各75体的不相交队列上稳定优于随机搜索、Sobol、CEM与CMA-ES。
AI.motivation: 软体机器人损伤恢复研究缺乏统一、可复现且能公平比较"是否引入学习先验"的评测协议：现有工作常依赖预置动作库、混淆开发与评估、或在同一批身体上同时调参与验证，导致方法增益难以归因。
AI.method: 构建repertoire-free基准：九项在线试验；同一形态内配对损伤掩码，保留实测的名义回退（measured nominal fallback）；将方法开发与在新身体上的评估严格分离。参考控制器为高斯过程期望改进（GP-EI），用3次初始化探测与6次反馈选择的rollout自适应调整执行器相位。评测涵盖两个不相交的75体队列，在等预算下与随机搜索、Sobol、CEM、CMA-ES对比，并以TuRBO式局部GP作为最近比较对象；另设冻结开发压力测试（物理移除10%占用体素）与官方BoTorch TuRBO对照。
AI.result: 在确认队列上GP-EI在69/75个身体上改善了最差掩码增益，最差掩码平均奖励较四个基线高出0.235–0.310；TuRBO式局部GP为最接近的对比方法，其配对置信区间包含零。确认后固定控制器重放显示平均恢复5.06个体素宽度，同时最差掩码p99几何边缘应变增加0.0031；严格的"不增加需求"部署门槛仅保留48.7%的平均增益。冻结开发压力测试中GP-EI改善71/75个身体，最差掩码平均增益超过官方BoTorch TuRBO 0.356。
AI.conclusion: 可重放的控制器、身体级推断与冻结队列评估共同构成一套参考流程，用于量化学习型损伤先验及未来自适应方法的附加价值，并揭示恢复增益与几何边缘应变代价及部署门槛之间的权衡。

title: TacZero: Training-Free Peg Insertion Using a General-Purpose Vision-Language Model with Tactile Feedback
summary: Robots that autonomously determine their actions from language instructions and sensory observations could perform new contact-rich manipulation tasks without task-specific training or hand-designed rules. To perform these tasks, robots must infer how objects contact one another and move as a result, then select actions. For contact inference and action selection, prior approaches involve designing estimation models and tactile feedback control laws, or learning models for object-motion estimation, action-outcome prediction, and action selection from tactile data. Instead, we propose TacZero, which uses a pretrained general-purpose vision-language model (VLM) to interpret visual and tactile observations and select robot actions without additional tactile or manipulation training or task-specific rules for contact interpretation or action selection. TacZero provides the VLM with camera images, robot state, and three-axis tactile responses represented as numerical values or vectors overlaid on the images. From these observations and interaction history, the VLM generates commands specifying target end-effector positions and gripper opening or closing, which a low-level controller executes. In real-world cylindrical-peg insertion experiments, TacZero succeeded in 15 of 20 trials with numerical tactile input, compared with 10 of 20 without tactile input. This study provides a concrete starting point for further research on contact-rich manipulation using general-purpose VLMs and highlights challenges in pursuing this direction.

AI.tldr: 提出 TacZero，直接用预训练视觉-语言模型（VLM）解释视觉与触觉观测并输出机器人动作，无需额外的触觉或操作训练、也无需接触解释与动作选择的任务特定规则。在真实圆柱插孔任务中，带数值触觉输入成功 15/20，无触觉输入成功 10/20。
AI.motivation: 接触丰富的操作任务中，机器人需推断物体间接触及其导致的运动并据此选动作。先前方法要么依赖人工设计的估计模型与触觉反馈控制律，要么需从触觉数据学习物体运动估计、动作结果预测与动作选择模型，通常需要额外训练与任务特定设计，难以零样本泛化到新任务。
AI.method: TacZero 使用预训练通用 VLM 作为核心决策器，不做额外触觉或操作训练、不引入任务特定规则。输入包括相机图像、机器人状态以及以数值或向量形式叠加在图像上的三轴触觉响应；结合交互历史，VLM 生成指令，指定目标末端执行器位置与夹爪开合，由底层控制器执行。
AI.result: 在真实世界圆柱插孔实验中，TacZero 使用数值触觉输入时 20 次试验成功 15 次；不使用触觉输入时为 20 次成功 10 次，表明触觉信息对接触丰富操作决策有增益。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为使用通用 VLM 进行接触丰富操作研究提供了具体起点，并指出了该方向面临的挑战，说明无需任务特定训练或规则即可在一定程度上完成接触推断与动作选择。

title: Beyond Task Reward: A Controller-Restriction Protocol for Evaluating Embodiment-Dependent Competence
summary: Co-design methods optimize a robot's body and controller jointly and judge the result by one number, the task reward of the fully optimized pair. That number cannot separate morphologies whose competence depends on the controller to very different degrees. We evaluate a morphology by restricting its controller instead, recording the task competence it retains under an explicitly declared, low-complexity controller family, environment, task and search budget. On three EvoGym locomotion tasks, task reward explains only $39\%$, $33\%$ and $10\%$ of the variance in this quantity, and geometric descriptors do not predict it under run-grouped cross-validation. The measurement is reliable across optimizer restarts (ICC$(2,k) = 0.956$--$0.986$) but depends on the declared family: phasing the drive by actuator index instead of position ranks the same morphologies at Spearman $0.50$--$0.63$ and reverses reward-matched pairs. As a second search objective the axis improved competence at matched task reward in $3$ of $5$ paired runs, short of a pre-registered bar of $4$. Used after an ordinary reward-only search instead, to choose within its top task-reward band, it selected a different body in all $8$ runs offering a choice, at a cost of at most $0.10$ reward units, and in $6$ of $8$ that body also scored higher under a held-out family. Restricted-control competence is therefore a reportable property of a co-designed morphology, interpretable only with the controller family that defines it.

AI.tldr: 论文提出用"受限控制器能力"（在显式声明的低复杂度控制器族下保留的任务能力）作为协同设计形态的可报告属性，实验表明其与任务奖励相关性弱且依赖所声明的控制器族，但测量可靠。
AI.motivation: 传统协同设计方法以完全优化后的任务奖励单一数值评判身体-控制器结果，但该数值无法区分"能力依赖控制器程度差异很大"的不同形态，因此需要一种能揭示形态内在属性的评测方式。
AI.method: 将形态评估改为限制其控制器：在显式声明低复杂度控制器族、环境、任务与搜索预算下，记录其保留的任务能力（受限控制能力），在三个EvoGym运动任务上测试，并做信度（优化器重启ICC）、几何描述子预测、控制器族敏感性（按执行器索引相位vs位置）及作为第二搜索目标与奖励搜索后选择的应用实验。
AI.result: 任务奖励仅解释该量方差的39%、33%、10%；几何描述子在按运行分组交叉验证下无法预测；测量跨重启可靠（ICC(2,k)=0.956–0.986）但依赖所声明族（索引相位与位置排序Spearman 0.50–0.63并反转奖励匹配对）；作为第二目标在5次配对运行中3次改善（低于预设4次门槛）；在奖励搜索后于最高奖励带内选择，8次有选择余地的运行中均选出不同形态，代价≤0.10奖励单位，其中6/8在留出族下得分更高。
AI.conclusion: 受限控制能力是协同设计形态的一种可报告属性，但只有在与其定义所用的控制器族一同解释时才有意义。

title: OntoPlan: An Ontology-Grounded Scene Representation and Agentic Framework for Scalable Robot Task Planning
summary: Large language model (LLM)-based robot task planning is promising for open-ended instruction following, but degrades on long-horizon tasks in large environments. When spatial information is conveyed to the LLM through text, the model can fail to capture spatial context, and token cost grows with environment size. Generating action sequences directly with an LLM also makes it difficult to satisfy the current world state and action preconditions. We address this with an ontology-grounded scene representation that aligns objects, spaces, relations, and states in a shared symbolic vocabulary for spatial reasoning and task planning, and with OntoPlan, an agentic framework that interprets instructions, selectively retrieves task-relevant information, formalizes goals and constraints, and produces executable plans. Across 150 general tasks spanning five indoor environments and three scene scales, OntoPlan achieves 0.89 average task success, compared with 0.27 for the strongest baseline, while using 18.1k total tokens per task on average, about 5.6$\times$ fewer than the most efficient baseline. These advantages persist as scene scale increases, whereas prior methods degrade more sharply in success and remain far more costly in tokens. OntoPlan also responds appropriately to ambiguous or infeasible instructions by asking follow-up questions or reporting insufficient information rather than committing to invalid plans. Code available at https://github.com/namhyeongwoo/OntoPlan.

AI.tldr: 提出本体论场景表示与 OntoPlan 智能体框架，解决 LLM 机器人在大场景长时序任务中的空间上下文缺失、token 成本高及动作前置条件难满足问题，成功率0.89、token减少约5.6倍。
AI.motivation: 基于LLM的机器人任务规划在开放式指令上具潜力，但在大环境的长时序任务中性能退化。文本传递空间信息时LLM难以捕捉空间上下文，且token成本随环境规模增长；直接用LLM生成动作序列也难以满足当前世界状态与动作前置条件。
AI.method: 提出本体论支撑的场景表示（ontology-grounded scene representation），将物体、空间、关系和状态对齐到共享符号词汇表以支持空间推理与任务规划；并构建OntoPlan智能体框架，用于解析指令、选择性检索任务相关信息、形式化目标与约束并生成可执行规划。
AI.result: 在覆盖5个室内环境、3种场景尺度的150个通用任务上，OntoPlan平均任务成功率达0.89，最强基线仅0.27；平均每任务消耗18.1k token，比最高效基线少约5.6倍。随场景规模增大，优势持续，而现有方法成功率下降更明显且token成本远高。对模糊或不可行指令，能通过追问或报告信息不足来恰当响应。
AI.conclusion: 本体验证的符号化场景表示与选择性检索机制可显著提升LLM机器人在大规模长时序任务中的成功率与token效率，并具备处理模糊/不可行指令的鲁棒性；代码已开源。

title: Silicon Language: A Robot-Native Knowledge Exchange Framework for Heterogeneous Robots
summary: Reusing a capability across heterogeneous robots still requires substantial human adaptation and verification: transferring a skill often means re-engineering interfaces, retuning parameters, and re-validating safety. We introduce Silicon Language, a robot-native knowledge exchange framework that treats the robot as the active subject of its own capability evolution. In this framework, a robot that wants a capability encodes its own experience into knowledge packets, publishes them, retrieves peer packets, translates them for its own sensors and actuators, and reviews them through independent local trial. A receiver-side usability evaluation procedure lets each robot decide for itself whether an external packet is useful, and progressive blending with automatic rollback is designed to reduce the risk of negative transfer when adopting it. The system combines three infrastructure layers (edge agent, Silicon Transfer Protocol (STP), and knowledge hub) with a capability stack inspired by the human scholarly system. We report a 30-day proof-of-concept deployment at an above-ground simulated-mine laboratory in Yulin, with following trials on an outdoor sand road and an indoor factory floor. Two heterogeneous robots encoded and translated three capabilities across embodiments through operator-assisted file copies mediated by the Silicon Language translation layer; source-side trials of the dust-locked following behavior were recorded on Taurus. Project records indicate that per-capability adaptation time dropped from days to hours; we present these figures as descriptive deployment records rather than controlled measurements. The deployment provides initial evidence for cross-embodiment knowledge exchange; fleet-level autonomous evolution and controlled with/without-packet comparisons remain future work.

AI.tldr: 提出"Silicon Language"机器人原生知识交换框架，把机器人作为能力演化的主动主体：能力需求方将自身经验编码为知识包并发布/检索/翻译/本地试炼验证，配以接收端可用性评估与渐进式融合及自动回滚以降低负迁移风险。系统由边缘智能体、Silicon Transfer Protocol（STP）与知识枢纽三层基础设施及受人类学术体系启发的"能力栈"组成，在榆林模拟矿井、户外沙路与室内厂房完成30天概念验证部署，两台异构机器人跨本体编码翻译三项能力，单能力适配时间由数天降至数小时（描述性记录）。
AI.motivation: 异构机器人之间复用能力仍依赖大量人工适配与验证：技能迁移往往意味着重新改造接口、重新调参并重新做安全性验证，成本高、周期长。作者希望让机器人成为自身能力演化的主动主体，实现跨本体（cross-embodiment）的知识交换，从而把能力复用从"人工再工程"转向"机器人自主编码—发布—检索—翻译—验证"的闭环。
AI.method: 框架层面提出 Silicon Language：需求方机器人将自身经验编码为知识包（knowledge packets）并发布，检索同伴知识包，针对自身传感器与执行器进行翻译，再通过独立本地试验（independent local trial）进行审查；接收端设有可用性评估流程，由机器人自主判断外部知识包是否有用；采用渐进式融合（progressive blending）配合自动回滚（automatic rollback）以降低负迁移风险。系统架构上结合三层基础设施——边缘智能体（edge agent）、Silicon Transfer Protocol（STP）与知识枢纽（knowledge hub）——以及受人类学术体系启发的"能力栈"（capability stack）。验证方式为30天概念验证部署：榆林地上模拟矿井实验室，随后在户外沙路与室内工厂地面开展试验；两台异构机器人通过操作员辅助的文件拷贝、经由 Silicon Language 翻译层跨本体编码并翻译三项能力。
AI.result: 在 Taurus 上记录了源端"粉尘锁定跟随行为"（dust-locked following behavior）的试验结果。项目记录显示，单能力适配时间从数天降至数小时；作者明确将该数据定位为描述性部署记录（descriptive deployment records），而非受控实验测量，因此不构成严格性能结论。
AI.conclusion: 该部署为跨本体知识交换提供了初步证据（initial evidence），表明机器人原生知识包式的能力迁移在真实场景中可行。局限与未来工作包括：实现群体级（fleet-level）自主演化，以及开展有/无知识包（with/without-packet）的受控对比实验，以替代当前的描述性证据。

title: SMART: Zero-Shot Sim-to-Real Articulated Object Manipulation via Large-Scale Synthetic Pretraining
summary: The ability to interact with articulated objects is essential for embodied intelligent systems, but collecting large-scale real-world demonstrations for these interactions remains challenging due to the precise contact and constraint-following motions involved. Although simulation provides a promising alternative, existing synthetic data efforts cover limited articulated-object categories, while general-purpose synthesis pipelines lack explicit designs for part-level semantics and articulation constraints, hindering agentic task generation and scalable synthesis of high-quality articulated-manipulation demonstrations. To bridge this gap, we introduce SMART, a scalable system leveraging large-scale Synthesized Manipulation demonstrations for ARTiculated-object manipulation. At its core, we develop SMART-Sim, a simulation platform with articulation-aware design that enables effective task generation and efficient demonstration collection. Building on SMART-Sim, we apply agentic task generation and design a scalable distributed synthesis system, using them to synthesize SMART-Data, comprising over 1M demonstrations across 44 atomic task types, 5 robot setups, and 2,507 articulated objects. The vision-language-action (VLA) model pretrained on SMART-Data shows competitive performance on simulation benchmarks and achieves zero-shot sim-to-real transfer and scalable performance in real-world articulated-object manipulation tasks. This highlights the potential of synthetic demonstrations in providing effective and scalable supervision for improving VLA model performance in contact-rich articulated-object manipulation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SMART系统，通过仿真平台SMART-Sim与分布式合成流程生成超100万条铰接物体操作演示数据（SMART-Data），预训练VLA模型在仿真基准上具竞争力，并实现零样本仿真到现实迁移。
AI.motivation: 铰接物体交互对具身智能系统至关重要，但真实世界大规模演示数据采集困难，原因在于涉及精确接触与约束跟随运动。仿真虽为替代方案，但现有合成数据覆盖的铰接物体类别有限，且通用合成流程缺乏部件级语义与铰接约束的显式设计，阻碍了智能体任务生成与高质量铰接操作演示的可扩展合成。
AI.method: 提出SMART系统（面向铰接物体操作的大规模合成操作演示）。核心为SMART-Sim仿真平台，具备铰接感知设计，支持高效任务生成与演示采集；在其上应用智能体任务生成，并设计可扩展的分布式合成系统，用于合成SMART-Data数据集。
AI.result: 合成SMART-Data，包含超100万条演示，覆盖44种原子任务类型、5种机器人配置、2,507个铰接物体。基于SMART-Data预训练的VLA模型在仿真基准上表现具竞争力，并实现零样本sim-to-real迁移，在真实世界铰接物体操作任务中展现可扩展性能。
AI.conclusion: 合成演示能够为提升VLA模型在接触密集型铰接物体操作中的性能提供有效且可扩展的监督信号，凸显合成数据在该领域的潜力。

title: EigenDEXplore: Structured Exploration for Dexterous Manipulation with Human Priors
summary: Dexterous manipulation poses a challenging high-dimensional optimization problem, as useful behaviors require coordinated motion across many hand joints. In reinforcement learning (RL) and sampling-based trajectory optimization, exploration commonly relies on independent robot joint perturbations, making coordinated behaviors difficult to discover. Prior work reduces this search space for grasp learning using low-dimensional spaces of coordinated joint motions learned from human hand data, but this restricts the expressivity required for general manipulation. Some combine learned and joint-space actions to restore expressivity, but this increases dimensionality and introduces redundancy. We study these effects across diverse manipulation settings, varying action dimensionality, exploration strategy, and the source of human data. Our experiments suggest that human-motion priors are most effective when used to structure exploration rather than change the action representation. Motivated by this finding, we propose EigenDEXplore, which induces correlated exploration by adding perturbations along human-derived eigenvectors to independent joint-space noise, leaving the action space unchanged. Across multiple dexterous hands, EigenDEXplore consistently outperforms joint-space and learned action-space baselines in grasping, in-hand reorientation, and contact-rich manipulation. These gains span unstructured and reference-guided RL, trajectory optimization, and sim-to-real deployment, and are largest in settings with less reward shaping and curriculum design.

AI.tldr: 提出EigenDEXplore：在人手数据导出的特征向量方向上施加扰动，实现关节空间的相关性探索，不改动动作表示，在多种灵巧操作任务中优于关节空间与学习动作空间基线。
AI.motivation: 灵巧操作是高维优化问题，有效行为需要多关节协调运动。RL与采样轨迹优化通常依赖独立关节扰动，难以发现协调行为。既往方法用人类手部数据学习低维协调动作空间以缩小搜索空间，但限制表达力；也有方法混合学习动作与关节空间动作以恢复表达力，却提高维度并引入冗余。作者旨在研究人类运动先验应作用于探索结构还是动作表示。
AI.method: 在多样化操作设定中系统比较动作维度、探索策略与人类数据来源的影响。基于"人类运动先验更适合用于结构化探索而非改变动作表示"的发现，提出EigenDEXplore：保持原动作空间不变，在独立关节空间噪声之上，沿人类数据导出的特征向量方向添加扰动，从而诱导相关性探索。
AI.result: 在多种灵巧手上，EigenDEXplore在抓取、手内重定向和接触丰富操作中持续优于关节空间和时间动作空间基线。增益覆盖无结构RL、参考引导RL、轨迹优化以及sim-to-real部署，且在奖励塑形与课程设计较少的设定中增益最大。
AI.conclusion: 人类运动先验的有效用法是结构化探索而非改变动作表示；通过沿人类特征向量方向加噪即可在不增加动作空间维度的前提下实现协调探索，提升灵巧操作学习的泛化性与鲁棒性。

title: ExoBridge: Learning a Bare Hand to Hand-Worn Exoskeleton Mapping through Human Limb Coupling
summary: Human video offers a scalable source of experience for dexterous robot learning, but obtaining motion and tactile supervision while preserving bare hand interaction remains challenging. We present ExoBridge, a framework that leverages human limb coupling to learn a bridging function from bare hand video to the motion and tactile state of a sensorized exoskeleton. Our central idea is to use coordinated bimanual behavior to connect an uninstrumented visual source with a measured manipulation interface. During collection, one hand remains bare and provides visual observations, while the opposite hand wears the exoskeleton and supplies synchronized motion and tactile measurements. These paired demonstrations train a temporal visual model to predict fingertip contact, continuous tactile intensity, and relative encoder motion from bare hand video alone. The exoskeleton defines an intermediate state space whose motion coordinates are linked to a dexterous robot hand through existing calibration. Evaluation on 1,215 demonstrations across four manipulation tasks uses held out collection sessions and yields a pooled any contact AUROC of 0.916 and a Pearson correlation of 0.790 for tactile intensity. The learned bridge also predicts relative changes in exoskeleton configuration from bare hand video. These results demonstrate that human limb coupling can turn exoskeleton measurements into supervision for bare hand video, establishing a learned bridge between human visual demonstrations and a robot oriented manipulation interface.

AI.tldr: 提出 ExoBridge 框架，利用人体双手耦合，从裸手视频中学习预测外骨骼的运动与触觉状态，从而为灵巧机器人学习提供可扩展的人类示教监督。
AI.motivation: 人类视频是灵巧机器人学习的可扩展经验来源，但在保持裸手自然交互的同时获取运动与触觉监督信号十分困难。外骨骼虽能提供运动与触觉测量，却会阻碍裸手交互，二者难以兼得。
AI.method: 利用双手协同行为连接"无仪器的视觉源"与"有测量的操作接口"：采集时一只手保持裸露提供视觉观测，另一只手佩戴外骨骼提供同步的运动与触觉测量；用配对示教训练时序视觉模型，从裸手视频单独预测指尖接触、连续触觉强度与外骨骼编码器相对运动。外骨骼定义了中间状态空间，其运动坐标可通过已有标定与灵巧机器人手关联。
AI.result: 在四项操作任务、共 1,215 条示教上、使用留出的采集会话进行评估，获得汇总的 "任意接触" AUROC 为 0.916，触觉强度的 Pearson 相关系数为 0.790；所学桥接模型还能从裸手视频预测外骨骼构型的相对变化。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，人体肢体耦合可将外骨骼测量转化为裸手视频的监督信号，建立了人类视觉示教与面向机器人的操作接口之间的学习桥接。

title: ESP: Energy-Score Policy for One-Step Multimodal Action Generation
summary: Generative action models based on diffusion and flow matching have been increasingly adopted in vision-language-action (VLA) policies for their ability to capture diverse behaviors, including multiple valid action sequences under the same observation and instruction. Their iterative sampling procedures, however, require repeated network evaluations to generate each action chunk, increasing inference latency in closed-loop control. We propose ESP (Energy-Score Policy), a teacher-free approach that maps policy context and noise directly to an action chunk in a single network evaluation. ESP trains the action head with the energy score rather than mean squared error. Whereas squared-error regression targets the conditional mean, the energy score is strictly proper: its expected value is uniquely minimized by the target distribution. This provides a principled objective for learning multimodal action distributions without iterative sampling, with exact recovery at the population optimum when the model can represent the target distribution. Experiments on both simulation and real-world manipulation tasks demonstrate competitive task success with substantially lower action-generation latency than the flow matching baseline. These results support direct distributional learning as an efficient alternative to iterative generative robot policies.

AI.tldr: ESP（Energy-Score Policy）是一种无需教师模型、单次网络评估即可从策略上下文与噪声直接生成动作块的策略，用能量分数替代MSE训练动作头，在仿真与真实操作任务上取得与flow matching相当的成功率，同时显著降低动作生成延迟。
AI.motivation: 基于扩散和flow matching的生成式动作模型能刻画多模态行为（同一观测与指令下的多种有效动作序列），但迭代采样需反复进行网络评估，导致闭环控制中的推理延迟升高。
AI.method: 提出ESP，教师无关方法，将策略上下文与噪声通过单次网络评估直接映射为动作块；动作头以能量分数（energy score）而非均方误差作为训练目标。平方误差回归指向条件均值，而能量分数是严格proper的评分规则，其期望值在目标分布处唯一最小，因此在模型能表示目标分布时，总体最优处可精确恢复目标分布，无需迭代采样即可学习多模态动作分布。
AI.result: 在仿真和真实世界操作任务上，ESP取得有竞争力的任务成功率，且动作生成延迟显著低于flow matching基线。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持将直接分布学习作为迭代式生成机器人策略的高效替代方案。

title: Seeing Through the Displaced Frame: Privileged Noise Distillation for Vision-Force Precision Assembly
summary: Pose error in precision assembly can corrupt not only what a robot observes but also the coordinate frame in which it acts. On the FORGE benchmark, the official state-based policy succeeds in 97% to 99% of episodes with the true pose but only 32% to 60% at the benchmark's $σ=5$ mm pose-noise setting. The same estimated pose enters the observation and anchors the action frame, making the offset unidentifiable from proprioceptive state alone before contact. We supply this missing information during training in two ways. A privileged teacher observes the offset in simulation, while clean demonstrations can instead be relabelled into the displaced frame in closed form. The deployed student is trained with behaviour cloning followed by one DAgger round and receives only noisy state, a raw wrench window, and two RGB cameras at test time. On the unmodified FORGE tasks, the teacher-route student maintains 92% to 99% success across $σ=0$ to 5 mm, while six non-privileged baselines fall to 2% to 80%. A matched behaviour-cloning experiment isolates the source of this robustness. With the same student architecture, data budget, and training procedure, demonstrations generated without offset access yield only 31.5% success at $σ=5$ mm, whereas privileged and relabelled demonstrations reach 88.7% and 95.8%. Deployed zero-shot on a Franka, the student reaches 83.3% pooled success at $σ=5$ mm against 34.4% for the strongest state-based policy. Deployable sensing alone is insufficient. Robustness requires supervision that encodes compensation for the latent frame offset.Project page: https://drychang.github.io/displaced-frame/

AI.tldr: 在精密装配中，位姿误差不仅污染观测，还偏移了动作所在坐标系，导致状态本身无法辨识帧偏移。作者在训练阶段通过特权教师或闭式重标注注入偏移信息，训练出仅用噪声状态、力/力矩窗口和双RGB的student策略，在FORGE任务σ=0~5mm下保持92%~99%成功率，真机零样本达83.3%。
AI.motivation: 精密装配中，机器人既依赖位姿进行观测，又用它锚定动作坐标系。当位姿存在误差时，观测与动作帧被同一偏移污染，而这个偏移在接触前无法从本体感受状态中辨识出来，是"潜在帧偏移"问题。现有仅靠可部署传感的state-based策略在FORGE σ=5mm下成功率从97%~99%骤降到32%~60%，说明仅靠部署时可得信息不足以补偿。
AI.method: 提出两种在训练期提供缺失偏移信息的方式：(1) 特权教师：在仿真中直接观测偏移量；(2) 闭式重标注：将干净示教轨迹解析地变换到被偏移的坐标系中。部署的student在测试时仅接收带噪状态、原始力/力矩窗口和两个RGB相机，通过行为克隆加一轮DAgger训练。
AI.result: 在未修改的FORGE任务上，教师路线student在σ=0~5mm下成功率92%~99%，六个非特权基线降至2%~80%。匹配的行为克隆对照实验显示，相同架构、数据预算和训练流程下，无偏移访问的示教在σ=5mm仅31.5%，而特权示教与重标注示教分别达88.7%和95.8%。在Franka上零样本部署，σ=5mm时student汇总成功率83.3%，最强state-based策略仅34.4%。
AI.conclusion: 仅靠可部署传感不足以实现鲁棒性；鲁棒性需要能够编码对潜在帧偏移补偿的监督信号。通过特权信息或闭式重标注在训练期注入偏移知识，可显著提升对位姿噪声的鲁棒性，并在真机上实现零样本迁移。

title: CoRE: Learning Collaboration-Role Experts for Decentralized Collaborative Manipulation with One Policy
summary: Collaborative manipulation requires robots to perform complementary actions as interactions unfold. We study single-policy decentralized collaboration: every robot runs the same policy from its visual observations and proprioception, without task prompts, identity labels, or inter-robot messages. The challenge is to learn complementary team behaviors within shared parameters and select appropriate actions from each robot's local observations. We introduce CoRE, which learns Collaboration-Role Experts from pooled multi-task, multi-robot demonstrations. Fused appearance and geometry provide local interaction evidence. Query-conditioned cross-attention experts provide adaptable prediction paths, which a local router combines at each action-chunk position. During training, an action-expert alignment loss supervises expert selection using relative forced-route prediction errors against demonstrations under fixed inputs, without role labels. Across simulation benchmarks, CoRE achieves the highest average performance among evaluated decentralized methods. Physical experiments demonstrate effective collaboration across diverse manipulation tasks and robustness to partner delays and slowdowns. Project page: https://aus.bot/research/core/.

AI.tldr: CoRE：从多任务多机器人示范中学习协作角色专家，实现无提示、无标签、无通信的单策略去中心化协作操作。
AI.motivation: 协作操作要求机器人在交互过程中执行互补动作。本文研究单策略去中心化协作：每个机器人仅依赖视觉观测与本体感受运行同一策略，不使用任务提示、身份标签或机器人间通信。难点在于共享参数下学习互补团队行为，并依据各自局部观测选择合适动作。
AI.method: 提出 CoRE，从汇聚的多任务、多机器人示范中学习协作角色专家（Collaboration-Role Experts）。融合外观与几何特征提供局部交互证据；采用查询条件化的交叉注意力专家提供可适配的预测路径，由局部路由器在每个动作块（action-chunk）位置进行组合。训练时引入动作-专家对齐损失，在固定输入下依据相对强制路由预测误差监督专家选择，无需角色标签。
AI.result: 在仿真基准中，CoRE 在所评估的去中心化方法里取得最高平均性能。物理实验表明其能在多种操作任务中实现有效协作，并对伙伴延迟与减速具有鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: CoRE 通过角色专家与局部路由机制，在无标签、无通信条件下实现可泛化的去中心化协作操作，并展现出对伙伴行为扰动的鲁棒性。

title: StairVLA: Stage-Aware Hierarchical Action Generation for Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) models increasingly rely on diffusion- or flow-matching-based action heads to generate continuous robot actions. These action heads typically process the denoising trajectory in a largely uniform manner. However, we observe that the conditioning focus naturally shifts across denoising stages: early stages combine language instructions and visual observations to establish a coarse action trajectory, whereas later stages place greater emphasis on current visual observations for action alignment. Based on this insight, we introduce StairVLA, a stage-aware hierarchical action generation framework that uses partially denoised actions as a natural interface between coarse long-horizon action generation and local refinement. A high-level VLA performs early denoising to produce a reusable long-horizon partially denoised action trajectory, while a lightweight refiner operates at a higher frequency to refine local action chunks using the latest observations. This design amortizes expensive high-level VLA computation while preserving frequent closed-loop correction. On LIBERO, our GR00T-style instantiation improves average success from 96.5% to 97.8% while reducing amortized inference latency from 115.0 ms to 44.2 ms per action chunk. More broadly, across two VLA backbones, simulation benchmarks, and real-robot tasks, StairVLA consistently reduces inference cost while maintaining strong task performance.

AI.tldr: StairVLA提出阶段感知的分层动作生成框架：高层VLA仅执行早期去噪以生成可复用的长程部分去噪动作轨迹，轻量refiner以更高频率结合最新观测对局部动作块做细化，在保持任务性能的同时显著降低推理延迟。
AI.motivation: 扩散/流匹配动作头在去噪过程中通常采用统一处理方式，但作者观察到条件关注点随去噪阶段自然转移：早期阶段融合语言指令与视觉观测建立粗粒度动作轨迹，后期阶段更侧重当前视觉观测以实现动作对齐。这一阶段差异未被现有方法利用，且高层VLA计算昂贵、难以频繁闭环。
AI.method: 提出StairVLA，一种阶段感知的分层动作生成框架，以部分去噪动作为高层粗粒度长程生成与局部细化之间的天然接口。高层VLA执行早期去噪，产出可复用的长程部分去噪动作轨迹；轻量refiner以更高频率运行，利用最新观测对局部动作块进行细化。该设计摊销昂贵的高层VLA计算，同时保留频繁的闭环修正。
AI.result: 在LIBERO上，GR00T风格实例化将平均成功率从96.5%提升至97.8%，同时将每个动作块的摊销推理延迟从115.0 ms降至44.2 ms。跨两种VLA骨干、仿真基准及真实机器人任务，StairVLA一致地降低推理成本并保持强任务性能。
AI.conclusion: StairVLA通过显式建模去噪的阶段特性，实现了长程粗生成与高频局部细化的解耦，在多种骨干和任务上兼顾推理效率与任务成功率，为VLA动作头的高效闭环控制提供了通用方案。

title: Model-Based Geometry-Aware Generative Optimization for Constrained Locomotion Planning
summary: Constrained Locomotion Planning (CLP) for quadrupeds and humanoids, where robots must satisfy collision avoidance, contact consistency, kinematic feasibility, and support constraints, is challenging under high-dimensional dynamics and highly non-convex environments. Recent Model-Based Diffusion (MBD) approaches recast trajectory optimization as posterior sampling over trajectories, using known dynamics and Monte Carlo rollouts to analytically estimate the denoising score function without demonstration learning. While constrained variants further incorporate feasibility into model-based score rollouts and show promising performance, they are still limited by (1) lacking a task-modulated active constraint geometry that shapes the score direction and reverse stochasticity, and (2) using deterministic DDPM-style reverse transport without adaptive scheduling across different generative transports. Therefore, we introduce Model-Based Geometry-Aware Generative Optimization (2GO) for constrained locomotion, which turns active constraint geometry into executable denoising operators through normal- induced metric shaping, tangent-space stochastic filtering, and CFS-based retraction. 2GO further decouples generative transport from reverse stochasticity through an adaptive diffusion and flow-like schedule. Experiments on constrained quadruped and humanoid locomotion demonstrate strong performance in discrete foothold selection and continuous posture planning, with higher success rates, fewer violations, and improved execution compatibility.

AI.tldr: 提出2GO（Model-Based Geometry-Aware Generative Optimization），将主动约束几何转化为可执行的去噪算子，并解耦生成传输与反向随机性，用于四足与类人机器人的约束运动规划，取得更高成功率、更少约束违反与更好的执行兼容性。
AI.motivation: 四足与类人机器人的约束运动规划（CLP）需同时满足碰撞避免、接触一致性、运动学可行性与支撑约束，在高维动力学与强非凸环境中极具挑战。现有Model-Based Diffusion（MBD）将轨迹优化重构为轨迹后验采样，无需示教学习即可用已知动力学和蒙特卡洛滚动解析估计去噪得分函数；其约束变体虽引入可行性，但仍存在两点不足：(1) 缺乏任务调制的主动约束几何来塑造得分方向与反向随机性；(2) 采用确定性的DDPM式反向传输，未在不同生成传输间做自适应调度。
AI.method: 提出Model-Based Geometry-Aware Generative Optimization（2GO）。通过法向诱导的度量塑形（normal-induced metric shaping）、切空间随机滤波（tangent-space stochastic filtering）与基于CFS的retraction，将主动约束几何转化为可执行的去噪算子；同时通过自适应扩散与流式（flow-like）调度，将生成传输与反向随机性解耦。
AI.result: 在约束四足与类人运动任务上，于离散落足点选择与连续姿态规划中表现优异，成功率更高、约束违反更少、执行兼容性更好。
AI.conclusion: 2GO通过几何感知的去噪算子与自适应传输调度，有效提升了约束运动规划在离散与连续决策上的可行性与执行性能。

title: Multi-Robot Multi-Goal Motion Planning with Stochastic Skills
summary: As robots are increasingly deployed in groups and share workspaces to execute real-world tasks, planning their concurrent motions around complex manipulation skills becomes essential. These skills involve continuous physical execution and may exhibit stochastic behavior, resulting in variable execution times and uncertain continuous trajectories. Existing planners either limit execution to single-robot scenarios, rely on open-loop paths, or use post-hoc scheduling that prevents dynamic coordination. In this paper, we address this gap by integrating stochastic skills into sampling-based multi-robot planning by formulating the problem as a Markov Decision Process (MDP) over a multi-modal composite roadmap. For stochastic skills, solving the MDP yields a reactive policy that allows controllable robots to dynamically adapt their motions in response to other robots' execution of manipulation skills. By resolving skill uncertainty directly at planning time, this approach avoids the pessimism of conservative baselines and unlocks robust, dynamic multi-robot coordination. Code for the planners is available at https://www.vhartmann.com/stochastic-skills.

AI.tldr: 本文将随机操作技能集成到基于采样的多机器人规划中，通过在多模态复合路线图上构建MDP并在规划时消解技能不确定性，得到可动态协调的响应式策略。
AI.motivation: 机器人日益以群体形式共享工作空间执行真实任务，需要规划包含复杂操作技能的并发运动；这些技能具有连续物理执行与随机性，导致执行时间可变、连续轨迹不确定。现有规划器或限于单机器人、或依赖开环路径、或采用事后调度而无法动态协调，存在明显缺口。
AI.method: 将问题形式化为多模态复合路线图上的马尔可夫决策过程（MDP），把随机技能纳入基于采样的多机器人规划框架；对随机技能求解MDP，获得响应式策略，使可控机器人能够根据其他机器人执行操作技能的情况动态调整自身运动，从而在规划阶段直接处理技能不确定性。
AI.result: 求解MDP得到可动态适应的反应式策略，避免了保守基线方法的悲观性，实现了鲁棒且动态的多机器人协调；规划器代码已公开。
AI.conclusion: 在规划时消解技能不确定性，可突破单机器人、开环路径与事后调度的限制，为含随机技能的多机器人并发运动提供动态协调方案。

title: CUSP: CUSUM-Governed Survival Hazard Alarms at the Perception Onset for Off-Road Navigation
summary: Off-road navigation exposes a robot to potentially hazardous terrain en route. Although learning-based navigation uses safety supervision to choose which path to drive, it provides no runtime alarm when the robot following that path is heading into danger. Such an alarm must be learned from field logs, where human intervention preempts the failure and the failure itself is therefore never observed. The human judges driving unsafe early but typically intervenes only once failure is clearly near, so the intervention marks that judgment late. That earlier judgment is what a runtime alarm must detect, yet no prior intervention-supervised method has targeted it. To address this problem, we introduce CUSP (CUSUM-governed Survival model of the Perception onset), a model-agnostic runtime hazard alarm that learns this moment from intervention-terminated logs. "Cusp" is a word for the point at which one state is about to turn into another, and the moment we target is exactly such a cusp: the point at which safe driving turns unsafe in a human's judgment. We call this point the perception onset and annotate it separately from the intervention. A visual hazard head is trained on the annotated onset with a discrete-time survival objective so that driving with and without an onset both supervise the head, and a CUSUM accumulates the predicted onset risk into alarms. We evaluate CUSP at five unseen sites, two autonomous and three teleoperated, with 142 events and every method tuned to the same rate of ten false alarms per hour. CUSP detected 85 events compared to 26 for the best of nine adapted baselines, and the margin comes from hazards to which every signal in the navigation model is blind.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 CUSP，一种模型无关的运行时危险报警器，从“干预终止”的越野驾驶日志中学习人类“感知到危险”的时刻（perception onset），并用 CUSUM 将预测的 onset 风险累积为报警。
AI.motivation: 越野导航中，基于学习的导航虽用安全监督选择路径，但机器人在沿该路径驶向危险时没有运行时报警。此类报警必须从实地日志学习，而人类干预会抢先于失败发生，导致失败本身从未被观测；干预标记的是“危险临近”的晚期判断，而非更早的人类不安全判断，后者才是运行时报警应检测的目标。此前没有干预监督方法针对这一更早时刻。
AI.method: CUSP（CUSUM-governed Survival model of the Perception onset）：模型无关的运行时危险报警。将人类判断中“安全驾驶转为不安全”的时刻定义为 perception onset，并与 intervention 分开标注；用带离散时间生存目标的视觉危险头在 onset 标注上训练，使有和无 onset 的驾驶都能监督该头；再用 CUSUM 累积预测的 onset 风险生成报警。
AI.result: 在五个未见站点（两个自主、三个遥操作）评测，共 142 个事件，所有方法调到相同误报率（每小时 10 次）。CUSP 检测到 85 个事件，而九个适配基线中最优者仅 26 个；优势来源于导航模型中所有信号均“失明”的危险类型。
AI.conclusion: CUSP 表明：将报警目标定义为早于干预的 perception onset，并以生存目标训练、CUSUM 触发，可显著提升运行时危险检测能力，尤其在导航模型现有信号无法察觉的危险上表现突出。

title: Beyond Retargeting: Low-Latency and Robust Humanoid Whole-Body Teleoperation with Learned Atomic Motion Primitives
summary: Humanoid whole-body teleoperation translates human motion into stable robot behavior in real time. Existing systems typically rely on online motion retargeting to bridge human--robot morphological differences, but this process adds latency and can produce physically infeasible targets. Meanwhile, diverse, noisy, and partial human-motion observations often fall outside the training distribution, potentially causing unstable robot behavior. We propose a retargeting-free policy that maps raw human motion directly to robot joint commands in a single forward pass, eliminating online kinematic adaptation. To improve robustness, we learn a codebook of full-body motion primitives that projects out-of-distribution observations onto plausible motion prototypes and recovers full-body motion from partial inputs. Experiments on a Unitree~G1 in simulation and on hardware, using virtual reality, optical mocap, text-to-motion generation, and monocular video inputs, show that our method outperforms baselines in latency and robustness.

AI.tldr: 提出一种免重定向的人形机器人全身遥操作策略，将原始人体运动单次前向传播直接映射为机器人关节命令，并通过全身运动原语码本提升对分布外观测的鲁棒性，在仿真与真机上均优于基线。
AI.motivation: 现有类人全身遥操作依赖在线运动重定向来弥合人机形态差异，但这一过程引入延迟，且可能生成物理不可行的目标；同时，多样、含噪、部分缺失的人体运动观测常落在训练分布之外，导致机器人行为不稳定。
AI.method: 提出免重定向策略：将原始人体运动通过单次前向传播直接映射为机器人关节命令，消除在线运动学适配；并学习一个全身运动原语码本，将分布外观测投影到合理的运动原型上，同时从部分输入中恢复全身运动。
AI.result: 在 Unitree G1 上进行仿真与硬件实验，输入涵盖虚拟现实、光学动捕、文本生成运动以及单目视频，结果显示该方法在延迟与鲁棒性方面均优于基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 免重定向策略可有效降低遥操作延迟并提升鲁棒性，运动原语码本为处理分布外与部分观测提供了有效机制，具备在多类人体运动输入源上的通用性。

title: From Model to Prototype: Design and Motor-Flap Propulsion Control of a Twin-Wing Metamorphic UAV
summary: This paper presents the design and control strategy for MetaMorpher, a metamorphic Unmanned Aerial Vehicle (UAV), capable of both spinning-wing hover and fixed flying-wing cruise flight. Since control of the cruise configuration is comparatively well established in the literature, this paper focuses on control of the MetaMorpher in hover mode, building on the flight dynamics model and conceptual design validated in previous work. The control algorithm is implemented using one of two phase-synchronized strategies: motor propulsion, which pulses motor thrust in synchrony with the vehicle's rotation, or flap propulsion, a novel strategy that pulses the deflection of the wing-mounted elevons. We evaluate both strategies in simulation through different flight experiments. Simulation results confirm the mathematical model and show stable reference tracking, demonstrating flap propulsion as a lightweight, decoupled alternative for hover control. Experimental testing validated the vertical-dynamics propulsion model against the physical prototype, demonstrating very good steady-state agreement across different configurations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出变形无人机MetaMorpher的悬停控制策略，比较电机脉冲推进与升降副翼脉冲（flap propulsion）两种相位同步方案，仿真与样机实验验证了模型与稳定性。
AI.motivation: MetaMorpher兼具旋翼悬停与固定翼巡航能力，其巡航配置的控制已有成熟研究，而悬停模态的动力学与控制尚不完善，需要针对旋转状态下的控制手段进行设计与验证。
AI.method: 基于前作已验证的飞行动力学模型与概念设计，采用两种相位同步控制策略：一是与机体旋转同步脉冲调制电机推力（motor propulsion），二是脉冲调制翼面升降副翼偏转（flap propulsion）；通过多组飞行仿真实验对二者进行评估，并用物理样机验证垂直方向动力学推进模型。
AI.result: 仿真结果验证了数学模型的正确性，并实现了稳定的参考轨迹跟踪；实验表明flap propulsion可作为轻量、解耦的悬停控制替代方案；样机实验显示垂直动力学推进模型在不同构型下稳态吻合度良好。
AI.conclusion: 相位同步的升降副翼脉冲推进是可行且具优势的悬停控制方式，配合已验证的动力学模型，为MetaMorpher的全飞行包线控制提供了基础。

title: PACE: Stage-Consistent Long-Horizon Robot Manipulation via Progress-Aligned Context for Execution
summary: Demonstration-conditioned policies provide a natural interface for specifying robot behavior, yet long-horizon manipulation remains difficult when visually similar states recur across different stages or when demonstrations and executions proceed at different speeds. We identify the resulting failure mode as stage confusion and introduce Progress-Aligned Context for Execution (PACE), a stateful method that continually reinterprets a complete demonstration according to realized execution progress. PACE compresses the demonstration into ordered multimodal prompt tokens and uses training-only dual-edge attention supervision to expose its latent stage structure.
