During execution, an episode-local fast-weight memory causally encodes realized action-observation transitions and modulates prompt cross-attention, producing a progress-aligned context for a unified diffusion action expert without test-time stage labels or stage-specific policies. PACE improves success from 88.9% to 94.0% on LIBERO-Gen Goal Chain, from 79.1% to 83.3% on Spatial Combination, and from 33.3% to 73.3% on the two-step Block Routing tasks. Failure analysis further indicates that structured demonstration alignment and causal execution memory jointly mitigate stage confusion.

AI.tldr: PACE通过将完整演示压缩为有序多模态提示token，结合训练期的双边缘注意力监督和运行时快速权重记忆，实现演示条件策略的进度对齐，缓解长程操作中的阶段混淆问题。
AI.motivation: 演示条件策略是指定机器人行为的自然接口，但长程操作中当视觉相似状态在不同阶段重复出现，或演示与执行速度不一致时，策略难以准确判断当前所处阶段，作者将这一失败模式归纳为“阶段混淆”。
AI.method: PACE是一种有状态方法，持续根据已实现的执行进度重新解读完整演示。它将演示压缩为有序多模态提示token，并使用仅在训练时生效的双边缘注意力监督来暴露其潜在阶段结构；在执行阶段，通过episode局部的快速权重记忆因果地编码已实现的动作-观测转移，并调制提示的交叉注意力，从而为统一的扩散动作专家生成进度对齐的上下文，无需测试时的阶段标签或阶段专用策略。
AI.result: 在LIBERO-Gen Goal Chain上成功率从88.9%提升至94.0%，Spatial Combination从79.1%提升至83.3%，两步Block Routing任务从33.3%提升至73.3%。失败分析进一步表明，结构化演示对齐与因果执行记忆共同缓解了阶段混淆。
AI.conclusion: PACE通过结构化演示对齐与因果执行记忆的联合机制有效缓解阶段混淆，在多个长程操作基准上显著提升成功率，且无需测试时阶段标签或阶段特定策略，为演示条件的长程机器人操作提供了统一且实用的解决方案。

title: Adapting Vision-Language-Action Models to Unknown Visual Disruptions During Execution
summary: Visual disruptions can arise while a robot is executing a task, leaving a vision-language-action (VLA) policy to respond without knowing the disruption type or timing. We introduce Self-supervised Adaptation from Leftover Trajectories (SALT), which uses the leftover trajectory, the unexecuted part of the previous action chunk, as self-supervision for test-time adaptation. Because consecutive chunks overlap in time, the leftover provides a temporally aligned target for the current prediction over the same future control interval. At the onset of a visual shift, the leftover can retain a plan formed before the corruption, so updating the policy toward it anchors the adaptation across the shift (Transition Anchoring). SALT keeps the adapted policy and regenerates the current chunk, whose leftover becomes the target at the next replan, carrying the correction forward along the execution trajectory (Sequential Correction Propagation). Supervision comes entirely from the policy's own predictions, requiring no disruption annotations, expert actions, or target-domain demonstrations, and a lightweight adaptation gate calibrated only on nominal trajectories decides when updates begin. On LIBERO-10, SALT increases average success across five persistent visual corruptions from 43.9% to 53.2% with SmolVLA and from 58.7% to 66.0% with GR00T N1.7, while largely preserving nominal performance. On a real robot, it raises task progress averaged over digital and physical disruptions from 0.49 to 0.61.

AI.tldr: 提出 SALT，利用未执行完的"剩余轨迹"作为自监督信号实现 VLA 策略的测试时自适应，无需扰动标注、专家动作或目标域示范。
AI.motivation: 机器人在执行任务时常遭遇视觉扰动，而策略在响应时既不知道扰动类型也不知道其发生时刻，导致性能下降。现有测试时自适应方法通常依赖扰动标注、专家动作或目标域数据，难以在实际中获取。
AI.method: SALT 将上一动作块中未执行的部分（leftover trajectory）作为当前预测的自监督目标：由于相邻动作块在时间上重叠，剩余轨迹为同一未来控制区间提供了时间对齐的监督信号。机制包含两点：(1) Transition Anchoring——在视觉偏移发生时，剩余轨迹仍保留损坏前的规划，以其为更新目标可跨偏移锚定自适应；(2) Sequential Correction Propagation——保留自适应后的策略并重新生成当前块，其剩余部分成为下次重规划的目标，使修正沿执行轨迹传播。监督完全来自策略自身预测，并借助仅在名义轨迹上校准的轻量自适应门控决定何时启动更新。
AI.result: 在 LIBERO-10 上，针对五种持续视觉损坏，SALT 将 SmolVLA 的平均成功率从 43.9% 提升至 53.2%，将 GR00T N1.7 从 58.7% 提升至 66.0%，同时基本保持名义性能。在真实机器人上，数字与物理扰动下的平均任务进度从 0.49 提升至 0.61。
AI.conclusion: 利用动作块时间重叠产生的剩余轨迹作为自监督，可在无需任何外部标注或示范的条件下实现有效的测试时自适应，并兼顾名义性能，具有仿真与真机上的双重有效性。

title: Commit While Futures Agree: Consequence-Aware Adaptive Action Chunking for Robot Manipulation
summary: Action-chunking policies predict multi-step control sequences, but a fundamental question remains: how much of a predicted action chunk should be committed before replanning? Existing systems typically execute a fixed-length prefix, implicitly assuming that the same execution horizon remains trustworthy across states. Some adaptive methods estimate this horizon from the similarity or stability of predicted actions. However, different actions may lead to the same successful outcome, whereas similar actions can produce different futures, suggesting that commitment should be determined by agreement among imagined futures rather than by similarity in action space. To this end, we propose Consequence-Aware Adaptive Action Chunking (CA$^3$C), an inference-time framework built on a simple principle: commit while imagined futures agree, and replan when they diverge. Without modifying or retraining the base policy, CA$^3$C uses an action-conditioned world model to imagine the future consequences of multiple candidate action chunks under the same sampling noise. Using these imagined consequences, we formulate execution-horizon estimation as a Bayesian change-point inference problem and select the execution candidate through future consensus. Across multiple simulation benchmarks and real-world robot manipulation tasks, CA$^3$C consistently improves diverse action-chunking policies, achieving up to a 71.8% relative reduction in failure rate over the corresponding base policies.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 CA³C，一种基于"想象未来一致性"的自适应动作分块执行视野估计框架，将执行视野估计建模为贝叶斯变点推断问题，无需修改或重训练基础策略即可提升多种动作分块策略，失败率最高相对降低 71.8%。
AI.motivation: 动作分块策略会一次性预测多步控制序列，但"在重新规划前应执行多长前缀"这一核心问题尚无定论。现有系统通常执行固定长度的前缀，隐含假设同一执行视野在所有状态下都可信；部分自适应方法则依据预测动作的相似性或稳定性来估计视野。然而，不同的动作可能带来相同的成功结果，而相似的动作可能产生不同的未来，说明承诺长度应由"想象未来之间的一致性"决定，而非动作空间中的相似性。
AI.method: 提出 Consequence-Aware Adaptive Action Chunking（CA³C），一种推理时框架，遵循"想象未来一致时继续执行、分歧时重新规划"的原则。在不修改、不重训练基础策略的前提下，使用动作条件世界模型，在同一采样噪声下想象多个候选动作分块的未来后果；据此将执行视野估计形式化为贝叶斯变点推断问题，并通过未来共识来选择执行候选。
AI.result: 在多个仿真基准和真实世界机器人操作任务上，CA³C 一致地提升了多种动作分块策略的性能，相比对应的基础策略，失败率最高实现 71.8% 的相对降低。
AI.conclusion: 执行承诺长度应由想象未来的一致性而非动作空间相似性决定；基于世界模型想象与贝叶斯变点推断的自适应动作分块方法，可作为即插即用的推理时组件，显著提升现有动作分块策略的鲁棒性与成功率。

title: IronMan: Information-Constrained Video-Action Learning for Robot Manipulation
summary: Video Action Models (VAMs) couple visual dynamics modeling with action generation for robot manipulation. However, video representations are not naturally suited to action generation, as exposing the action policy to excessive visual detail can impair its generalization ability. Therefore, we introduce IronMan (Information-constRained videO-actioN learning for robot MANipulation), a robust video-action learning framework built on the information bottleneck principle. The core principle of this framework is to impose information constraints that suppress irrelevant visual information while preserving action-relevant dynamics cues. IronMan employs a dynamics-aware bottleneck that distills noisy, entangled one-step video features into compact world representations. Extensive simulation and real-world experiments demonstrate strong in-distribution (ID) performance and out-of-distribution (OOD) robustness while maintaining efficient inference. IronMan achieves success rates of 99.0% on LIBERO and 79.4% on RoboTwin clean2clean, outperforming all the evaluated baselines. Under OOD shifts, IronMan achieves a success rate of 79.1% on LIBERO-Plus, exceeding the strongest baseline by 10.4 percentage points. Project page: https://youngsoul0731.github.io/ironman-project-page/

AI.tldr: 提出IronMan框架，基于信息瓶颈原理约束视觉信息，在保留动作相关动态线索的同时抑制无关视觉细节，提升视频-动作学习的ID性能与OOD鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: VAM将视觉动态建模与动作生成耦合，但视频表示并不天然适合动作生成：过多视觉细节暴露给策略会损害泛化能力。
AI.method: IronMan（信息约束的视频-动作学习），基于信息瓶颈原理施加信息约束，采用动力学感知瓶颈（dynamics-aware bottleneck），将带噪、纠缠的单步视频特征蒸馏为紧凑的世界表示。
AI.result: LIBERO成功率99.0%，RoboTwin clean2clean 79.4%，均优于所有基线；OOD场景LIBERO-Plus成功率79.1%，超最强基线10.4个百分点，且保持高效推理。
AI.conclusion: 通过信息约束抑制无关视觉信息、保留动作相关动态线索，可有效提升机器人操作中视频-动作学习的ID性能与OOD鲁棒性。

title: Reactive Task-Oriented Robot-Human Handovers via Generative Hypothesis Selection
comment: Accepted to the Conference on Robot Learning (CoRL) 2026
summary: When humans hand each other objects, they incorporate both geometric and semantic information into this process. For example, passing a knife with the handle towards the recipient, rather than the blade, is both more ergonomic and safer. Recent state-of-the-art methods for task-oriented robot-human handovers have progressed from modeling object geometry to incorporating object affordances. However, they often forgo predicting the explicit, task-specific hand poses a human selects to utilize an object. Since many objects support multiple interaction modalities, e.g., a claw hammer used to strike or pull nails, this variability must be modeled to achieve robust task-oriented handovers. To tackle this, we propose a novel approach, GENESIS-Handover (GENErative HypotheSIS), which leverages VLM image generation to produce a variety of task-specific hand-object interaction hypotheses. These hypotheses are matched in real time to the observed human hand pose, enabling inference of the most suitable handover configuration. By leveraging VLMs as priors of plausible hand-object interactions, the method produces task-conditioned handover strategies for previously unseen object-task pairs. We evaluate the standalone interaction proposal module before deploying the full system on a mobile manipulator. In a user study with 12 participants across five task-object pairs, 83.3% perceived our method to have better task understanding than the previous state of the art.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 GENESIS-Handover 方法，利用 VLM 图像生成产生任务特定的手-物交互假设，并实时匹配观测手姿以推断最佳交接配置，实现面向任务的机器人-人物体交接。
AI.motivation: 人类交接物体时会同时融入几何与语义信息（如递刀时柄朝向对方），更符合人体工效且更安全。现有面向任务的交接方法虽从几何建模进步到融入可供性（affordance），但往往忽略了预测人类为使用某物体而选择的显式、任务特定手姿。由于许多物体支持多种交互方式（如羊角锤可敲击或拔钉），必须建模这种可变性才能实现鲁棒的面向任务交接。
AI.method: 提出 GENESIS-Handover（GENErative HypotheSIS）方法：借助 VLM 的图像生成能力，产生多种任务特定的手-物交互假设；将这些假设与实时观测到的人手姿态进行匹配，从而推断最合适的交接配置。该方法把 VLM 作为合理手-物交互的先验，为未见过的物体-任务组合生成任务条件下的交接策略。研究先评估独立的交互提议模块，再将完整系统部署到移动操作平台上。
AI.result: 在覆盖五组任务-物体组合、12 名参与者的用户研究中，83.3% 的参与者认为该方法比此前最先进方法具有更好的任务理解能力。
AI.conclusion: 通过将 VLM 作为手-物交互先验并生成多假设再进行实时匹配，GENESIS-Handover 能够对未见的物体-任务对产生任务条件下的交接策略，并在用户研究中显著优于现有最先进方法，证明了建模显式任务特定手姿对面向任务交接的重要性。

title: Vector Map Quality Metrics for Contextual Autonomous Driving Systems
summary: Ensuring safety in autonomous driving requires continuous map maintenance supported by reliable quality indicators. In this context, it is crucial to identify when and where map updates should be triggered, for instance through crowdsourced data, and under which conditions a new map compilation should be deployed. This paper focuses on effective metrics for assessing the quality of vector maps and guiding such decisions. We present a new metric called GOSPAM designed to measure map discrepancies in terms of location errors, existence, and completeness. Through detailed simulations on both point and polyline feature maps, we analyze its sensitivity to common map degradation such as bias, false positives, false negatives, and coordinate errors. The results demonstrate that GOSPAM offers a unified and interpretable measure that effectively captures various forms of map deviation, making it a strong candidate for map quality assessment in automotive applications.

AI.tldr: 本文提出GOSPAM指标，用于在自动驾驶地图维护中统一度量矢量地图在位置误差、存在性和完整性方面的偏差，并通过仿真验证其对常见地图退化的敏感性。
AI.motivation: 自动驾驶安全依赖持续的地图维护和可靠的质量指标，需要判断何时何地触发地图更新（如众包数据）以及何时部署新编译的地图，因此需要有效的矢量地图质量度量来支撑此类决策。
AI.method: 提出GOSPAM度量，从位置误差、存在性和完整性三方面衡量地图差异；在点要素与折线要素地图上进行详细仿真，分析其对偏置、假阳性、假阴性和坐标误差等常见地图退化的敏感性。
AI.result: GOSPAM提供统一且可解释的度量，能有效捕捉多种形式的地图偏差，是汽车应用中地图质量评估的有力候选。
AI.conclusion: GOSPAM可作为自动驾驶地图质量评估的有效指标，支持地图更新触发与新地图部署的决策。

title: Navigation with RF Cues: Embodied Perception Action under Multipath Uncertainty
summary: Smart factory inspection requires robots to reach connected equipment without a prior map or known target coordinates. Radio frequency (RF) signals from the target can provide directional cues to complement visual observations when occlusion or poor lighting limits target detection. However, multipath propagation can distort these cues, making it difficult to infer the target's true direction from instantaneous RF measurements. To enable navigation research under these conditions, we first construct a Habitat Sionna RT benchmark that uses detailed scene geometry and assigned material properties to generate aligned visual and RF observations in response to robot actions. Building on this benchmark, we propose an uncertainty aware multimodal navigation framework that jointly estimates target direction and its uncertainty from a history of RF, visual, and pose observations. These estimates inform action selection alongside visual context. Experiments in unseen scenes show relative improvements of 18.2% in success rate (SR) and 11.5% in success weighted by path length (SPL) over the strongest evaluated baseline.

AI.tldr: 该论文面向无先验地图与目标坐标的智能工厂巡检任务，构建Habitat Sionna RT多模态基准，并提出不确定性感知的多模态导航框架，联合估计目标方向及不确定性以指导动作选择，在未知场景中SR相对提升18.2%、SPL提升11.5%。
AI.motivation: 智能工厂巡检要求机器人在无先验地图、无已知目标坐标条件下抵达相连设备。RF信号可在视觉遮挡或低照度时提供方向线索，但多径传播会扭曲瞬时RF测量，使真实方向推断困难，且缺乏相应导航研究基准。
AI.method: 首先构建Habitat Sionna RT基准，利用精细场景几何与材质属性生成与机器人动作对齐的视觉、RF观测；在此基础上提出不确定性感知多模态导航框架，基于RF、视觉与位姿观测历史联合估计目标方向及其不确定性，并将估计结果与视觉上下文共同用于动作选择。
AI.result: 在未见场景实验中，相较最强评估基线，成功率（SR）相对提升18.2%，路径长度加权成功率（SPL）相对提升11.5%。
AI.conclusion: 该工作提供了面向RF-视觉多模态导航的可复现仿真基准，并验证了显式建模RF方向估计不确定性对提升无先验目标导航性能的有效性。

title: Reactive Exploration of Unknown Environments for Redundant Robots using Virtual Model Control
comment: 8 pages, 10 figures, This work has been submitted to the IEEE for possible publication. Copyright may be transferred without notice, after which this version may no longer be accessible
summary: The exploration of confined, occluded, and partially known spaces poses significant challenges in robotic manipulation. The overall pose of the robotic arm must be carefully controlled to respect tight geometric constraints while avoiding newly discovered obstacles. We address this problem by proposing an active exploration approach for redundant robotic arms with an eye-in-hand camera configuration. Our approach navigates and acquires information in real-time based on a novel scoring method that directly selects a target voxel from the unexplored space using the robot's current state and expected information gain. To move the robot safely toward the target voxel, we utilize Virtual Model Control, which guarantees compliance and enables whole-body reactive obstacle avoidance without the need for path replanning. Simulated and real-robot experiments in both confined and open environments demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach, achieving over $90\%$ mapping coverage across all tested environments in under $120$ seconds without colliding with obstacles.

AI.tldr: 提出一种面向冗余机械臂（眼在手相机）的主动探索方法，通过新型体素评分选择目标并借助虚拟模型控制实现安全运动，在受限与开放环境中达成>90%建图覆盖率且无碰撞。
AI.motivation: 受限、遮挡与部分已知空间中的机器人操作面临挑战：机械臂整体位姿需在满足狭窄几何约束的同时避开新发现的障碍物，传统先规划后执行的范式难以适应实时变化的未知环境。
AI.method: 1) 采用眼在手（eye-in-hand）相机配置的冗余机械臂；2) 提出新的评分方法，基于机器人当前状态与期望信息增益，直接从未探索空间中选择目标体素；3) 使用虚拟模型控制（Virtual Model Control）驱动机器人安全趋向目标体素，保证柔顺性并实现全身反应式避障，无需路径重规划。
AI.result: 在受限与开放环境的仿真及真机实验中，所有测试环境均实现超过90%的建图覆盖率，耗时在120秒以内，且未与障碍物发生碰撞。
AI.conclusion: 该主动探索框架结合体素级信息增益评分与虚拟模型控制，可在狭窄且动态暴露障碍的空间中实现高效、柔顺、无碰撞的自主探索，验证了其有效性与实时性。

title: Energy-Aware Path Following: Comparative Analysis of Reinforcement Learning and NMPC for Electric Vehicles
comment: 20 pages, 12 figures, currently submitted for review at the journal (Robotics and Autonomous Systems) https://www.sciencedirect.com/journal/robotics-and-autonomous-systems
summary: Path-following control strategies typically follow the bi-objective optimization dilemma: minimizing deviations from a reference path while maintaining smooth speed profiles. The latter objective is especially relevant for Electric Vehicles (EVs), since their limited driving range can be extended by recovering energy through regenerative braking, a feature that has not yet been sufficiently studied in the literature. In this work, we perform a comparative analysis of four controllers under one common Frenet frame-based kinematic vehicle model, utilizing a validated energy model (VT-CPEM) with explicit regenerative braking. Herein, we implement the following controllers: Nonlinear Model Predictive Control (NMPC), Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO), gain-scheduled Ackermann state-feedback baseline (PID-SF), and a Stanley geometric baseline. To satisfy real-time requirements, we implement the NMPC using JIT-compiled CasADi. Moreover, we train the PPO using traditional straight and S-curve tracks, after which we successfully transfer the unmodified policy to unseen tracks, including: an ISO 3888-1 lane-change, a chicane, randomly-generated parameterized-splines, and a $\pm3^\circ$ graded road. In addition, the policy transfers to a dynamic single-track vehicle model with linear tires, zero-shot with an acceptable initial performance, which was optimized after brief fine-tuning. Thereby, we demonstrate that our PPO is readily transferable to more comprehensive vehicle models. We conclude with a performance analysis of developed controllers and discuss ideas for future work.

AI.tldr: 本文在统一的Frenet坐标系运动学车辆模型下，结合含显式再生制动的VT-CPEM能量模型，对比分析了NMPC、PPO、增益调度Ackermann状态反馈（PID-SF）与Stanley几何控制器四种路径跟踪策略，并验证了PPO策略的跨赛道与跨车辆模型迁移能力。
AI.motivation: 路径跟踪控制通常面临双目标优化困境：既要最小化与参考路径的偏差，又要保持平滑的速度曲线。后者对电动汽车尤为关键，因为通过再生制动回收能量可延长其有限的续航里程，而现有文献对此研究尚不充分。
AI.method: 在统一的Frenet坐标系运动学车辆模型下，采用经验证的、含显式再生制动的VT-CPEM能量模型，实现并对比四种控制器：非线性模型预测控制（NMPC）、近端策略优化（PPO）、增益调度Ackermann状态反馈基线（PID-SF）以及Stanley几何基线。为满足实时性要求，NMPC采用JIT编译的CasADi实现；PPO在传统直线与S形弯道赛道上训练。
AI.result: 训练后的PPO策略无需修改即成功迁移至未见过的赛道，包括ISO 3888-1换道、chicane、随机生成的参数化样条以及±3°坡道。此外，该策略零样本迁移至带线性轮胎的动力学单轨车辆模型时仍具可接受的初始性能，经短暂微调后性能得到优化。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明PPO策略可便捷迁移至更复杂的车辆模型。文中最后对各类控制器的性能进行了分析，并讨论了未来工作方向。

title: AutodidactWAM: Cross-Modal Self-Distillation from Generated Video to Robot Actions
summary: World-action models (WAMs) such as Cosmos 3 jointly generate future video and robot actions from an observation and instruction. Adapting one such model with a lightweight LoRA fine-tune to a previously unseen robot, a Unitree G1 humanoid with five-fingered BrainCo hands, exposes a video-action asymmetry: the video renders plausible task executions, while the co-generated action is systematically mis-targeted. We evaluate closed-loop real-robot trials at three cumulative stages: pre-grasp, grasp, and pick-and-place. The native action succeeds only approximately 17%, 10%, and 7% of the time, respectively, and performs worse on held-out objects. We propose AutodidactWAM, a hand-pose estimator trained without teleoperation, followed by inverse kinematics, that runs on the model's generated video to recover action estimates. Paired with the native prediction, these recovered actions provide preferred targets for fine-tuning only the action-related layers, while the generated video is teacher-forced. We compare supervised relabeling with a rectified-flow adaptation of Diffusion-DPO. After one-time embodiment adaptation, self-distillation requires no additional task-specific teleoperation. The recovered-action gate reaches approximately 75%, 47%, and 42% pre-grasp, grasp, and pick-and-place success, compared with 17%, 10%, and 7% for the native action. A hybrid objective combining preference supervision, supervised target fitting, and Cartesian trajectory anchoring (DPO+SFT+DTW) performs best: on Oreo, the training object, it reaches 90% pre-grasp and 20% full-task success; on a held-out object, it reaches 80% and 30%. Plain Flow-DPO reaches 0% success despite 1.000 validation preference accuracy, indicating that the combination of training objectives, rather than the contrastive objective alone, drives the observed gains.

AI.tldr: 针对世界-动作模型(WAM)在迁移到新机器人本体时出现的"视频-动作不对称"问题，提出AutodidactWAM：用手部姿态估计+逆运动学从生成视频中恢复动作，仅微调动作相关层，无需额外遥操作数据即可显著提升成功率。
AI.motivation: WAM(如Cosmos 3)能从观测与指令联合生成未来视频与机器人动作，但用轻量LoRA微调迁移到未见过的机器人(Unitree G1人形机器人+BrainCo五指手)时存在视频-动作不对称：生成视频看起来任务执行合理，但协同生成的动作系统性偏离目标。原生动作在预抓取、抓取、抓放三阶段成功率仅约17%、10%、7%，在留出物体上更差。
AI.method: 提出AutodidactWAM：1) 训练一个无需遥操作数据的手部姿态估计器；2) 通过逆运动学在模型生成的视频上恢复动作估计，作为"恢复动作门"；3) 与原生预测配对，构成微调的首选目标；4) 冻结生成视频作为teacher forcing，仅微调动作相关层；5) 比较监督式重标注与Diffusion-DPO的rectified-flow变体；6) 最终采用混合目标DPO+SFT+DTW(偏好监督+监督目标拟合+笛卡尔轨迹锚定)。一次性完成本体适配后，自蒸馏不再需要任务特定遥操作。
AI.result: 恢复动作门在预抓取、抓取、抓放三阶段成功率约75%、47%、42%，远超原生动作的17%、10%、7%。混合目标DPO+SFT+DTW表现最佳：在训练物体Oreo上达到90%预抓取与20%全任务成功；在留出物体上达80%与30%。而纯Flow-DPO尽管验证偏好准确率达1.000，实际成功率却为0%，表明增益来自训练目标的组合而非单纯的对比目标。
AI.conclusion: 视频-动作不对称可通过从生成视频中自监督恢复动作来缓解；结合偏好监督、监督拟合与轨迹锚定的混合训练目标优于单一对比目标；纯对比目标(Flow-DPO)即使偏好准确率极高也可能完全无法转化为实际任务成功，说明需要多目标联合优化。

title: iGPC: Generative Motion Priors for Object-Aware Humanoid Interaction
summary: Humanoid robots operating in unstructured environments must combine robust whole-body control with the ability to perceive and physically interact with surrounding objects. While large-scale human motion data provides powerful priors for natural and versatile humanoid control, effectively transferring such priors to perception-driven object interaction remains challenging. To address this bottleneck, we propose a framework that extends the recently proposed Generative Pretrained Controller (GPC) from general human motion to full-body humanoid-environment interaction. First, we adapt GPC into interaction experts conditioned on scene affordance cues and privileged state information. These experts leverage the pretrained human motion prior while learning task-specific contact behaviors, including reaching toward objects, grasping environmental supports for stabilization, and pushing movable objects. Second, we introduce a perception-driven student that retains the pretrained GPC policy and distills interaction skills from the experts using onboard sensory observations. To bridge the gap between privileged expert observations and sensory inputs, we propose two complementary training objectives that enable effective adaptation of the pretrained motion prior during distillation. Notably, our experiments across multiple whole-body interaction tasks demonstrate that large-scale generative human motion priors provide an effective foundation for learning deployable policies for humanoid interactions in contact-rich real-world environments.

AI.tldr: 提出将生成式预训练控制器(GPC)从通用人体动作扩展到人形机器人全身环境交互的框架，先训练交互专家，再蒸馏出感知驱动的学生策略。
AI.motivation: 人形机器人在非结构化环境中需兼具鲁棒全身控制与感知、物理交互能力；大规模人体运动数据虽为自然人形控制提供强先验，但将此类先验有效迁移到感知驱动的物体交互仍具挑战。
AI.method: 1) 将GPC适配为交互专家，以场景可供性线索和特权状态信息为条件，在保留预训练人体动作先验的同时学习任务相关接触行为（伸向物体、抓握环境支撑以稳定、推动可移动物体）；2) 引入感知驱动的学生策略，保留预训练GPC策略，用机载传感观测从专家蒸馏交互技能；3) 提出两个互补训练目标，弥合特权专家观测与传感输入间的差距，实现蒸馏过程中预训练动作先验的有效适配。
AI.result: 在多个全身交互任务上的实验表明，大规模生成式人体动作先验为学习可在接触丰富的真实环境中部署的人形机器人交互策略提供了有效基础。
AI.conclusion: 大规模生成式人体动作先验可作为可部署人形机器人交互策略学习的有效基础，验证了"预训练人体动作先验+专家蒸馏"路线在接触丰富交互任务中的可行性。

title: Beyond Waypoint Regression: Query-Based Cost Learning over Reachable Ego Futures for End-to-End Driving
comment: Accepted in the 18th Asian Conference on Computer Vision (ACCV 2026)
summary: End-to-end planners based on waypoint regression achieve strong open-loop accuracy, but they primarily learn to mimic expert geometry and remain difficult to adapt to deployment-time safety constraints. We propose a query-based cost-learning framework that estimates bounded costs for dynamically reachable ego trajectory queries, rather than dense BEV cells or a small regressed trajectory set. Compact joint scene tokens capture coherent multimodal agent futures, while contingency-aware cost aggregation and cost-guided intra-cluster MPPI mixing convert the learned cost topology into feasible ego plans. On nuScenes, our method improves over prior cost-estimation planners such as ST-P3 and NMP, outperforms most regression baselines in collision rate, while remaining competitive in L2, and retaining an interpretable cost interface. On real-world driving logs, the proposed planner reduces collision rates compared with SparseDrive and Alpamayo without fine-tuning, while maintaining a diverse set of candidate trajectories.

AI.tldr: 提出基于查询的代价学习框架，为动态可达的自车轨迹查询估计有界代价，结合场景token与MPPI混合生成可行规划，在nuScenes和真实路测中降低碰撞率。
AI.motivation: 端到端路径点回归规划器虽开环精度高，但主要模仿专家几何，难以适应部署时的安全约束。既有代价估计方法多基于密集BEV栅格或少量回归轨迹，表达与适配能力受限。
AI.method: 以查询方式对动态可达的自车轨迹查询估计有界代价；用紧凑联合场景token建模连贯的多模态智能体未来；通过应急感知的代价聚合与代价引导的簇内MPPI混合，将学到的代价拓扑转化为可行自车规划。
AI.result: nuScenes上优于ST-P3、NMP等代价估计规划器，碰撞率优于多数回归基线且L2具竞争力，并保留可解释代价接口；真实驾驶日志上无需微调即较SparseDrive与Alpamayo降低碰撞率，同时保持候选轨迹多样性。
AI.conclusion: 该框架通过有界代价学习与MPPI混合实现了安全可适配的规划，兼顾碰撞率、L2精度与可解释性，并具备较好的跨域泛化潜力。

title: ViDAL: A Visual Dynamics-Grounded Action Latent Space for Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have become a central paradigm for robot policy learning, which predict actions in three forms: raw action chunks, discrete action tokens, or continuous action latents. However, existing action representations primarily model action trajectories, with limited consideration of the visual dynamics induced by these actions. We introduce ViDAL, a Visual Dynamics-grounded Action Latent Space that anchors continuous action latents in the future visual dynamics of the scene. Specifically, ViDAL learns action latent space by training an Action Variational Autoencoder (Action VAE) to reconstruct action chunks while aligning its latent with future scene dynamics. When integrated into downstream robot policies, the proposed Action VAE serves as a plug-in action interface compatible with multiple VLA architectures and enables optional future-video prediction as an additional capability. Empirically, ViDAL outperforms competitive baselines on LIBERO with 98.1% average success, improves a multi-task $π_{0.5}$ policy on RoboTwin 2.0 from 54.3% to 65.5% (Clean) and from 33.2% to 43.1% (Random) success rates over 50 dual-arm tasks, and yields 20.0% and 23.4% absolute success-rate gains on real-world single-arm Franka and dual-arm ARX robot platforms.

AI.tldr: ViDAL提出一种以未来视觉动态为锚点的连续动作潜空间，通过Action VAE在重建动作块的同时对齐场景未来视觉动态，作为可插拔动作接口提升多种VLA策略性能。
AI.motivation: 现有VLA模型的动作表示（动作块、离散动作token、连续动作潜变量）主要建模动作轨迹本身，较少考虑动作所引发的视觉动态，导致动作表示与场景演化脱节。
AI.method: 训练Action VAE重建动作块（action chunks），并将潜变量与未来场景动态对齐，从而学习视觉动态grounded的动作潜空间；该Action VAE可作插件式动作接口接入多种VLA架构，并支持可选的未来视频预测。
AI.result: LIBERO上平均成功率98.1%；RoboTwin 2.0的50项双臂任务中，多任务π0.5策略成功率由54.3%提升至65.5%（Clean）、由33.2%提升至43.1%（Random）；真实单臂Franka与双臂ARX平台分别获得20.0%和23.4%的绝对成功率提升。
AI.conclusion: 将连续动作潜变量锚定于未来视觉动态是一种有效且通用的动作表示方式，可作为插件接口兼容多种VLA架构，并在仿真与真实机器人任务上显著优于竞争基线。

title: Nested Power Models for Multirotor Propulsion: From Aerodynamic Drag to Electrical Losses
summary: Speed-only aerodynamic power models for multirotor propulsion cannot represent acceleration-dependent effects. This work develops a nested sequence of propulsion-power models that starts from aerodynamic power dissipation and progressively introduces a reversible kinetic-energy rate, torque-dependent electromechanical dissipation, and lumped speed-proportional dissipation. The models are identified using one subset of experiments and validated using the other on a motor-drive-propeller unit. Independent estimates of rotational inertia and aerodynamic drag complement predictive validation by assessing whether the models correctly attribute the measured power to reversible kinetic-energy exchange and irreversible dissipation and, within the latter, to aerodynamic and electromechanical losses. The results show that the reversible kinetic-energy rate is necessary but insufficient for accurate dynamic power prediction. Dissipation proportional to the squared motor torque provides the main additional improvement, while speed-proportional dissipation further prevents irreversible losses from being attributed to reversible kinetic-energy exchange. The resulting methodology provides a reusable and experimentally verifiable basis for developing and selecting dynamic propulsion-power models for multirotor systems.

AI.tldr: 该研究构建了从纯气动耗散到含可逆动能率、转矩相关机电耗散及速度比例耗散的嵌套式推进功率模型序列，并通过实验识别与验证表明：仅考虑速度的模型不足，可逆动能率必要但不充分，转矩平方耗散是主要改进项，速度比例耗散可防止不可逆损失被误归因。
AI.motivation: 现有多旋翼推进系统的"仅速度"气动功率模型无法表征与加速度相关的效应，因此需要发展能够刻画动态过程的推进功率模型，以提升动态功率预测精度并正确划分各类损失来源。
AI.method: 提出一个嵌套递进的推进功率模型序列，起点为气动功率耗散，依次引入可逆动能变化率、转矩相关的机电耗散、以及集总的速度比例耗散。模型参数用一组实验数据辨识，另一组实验数据用于验证，在电机-驱动-螺旋桨单元上进行。此外，独立估计转动惯量与气动阻力，用于判断模型是否将测量功率正确归因于可逆动能交换与不可逆耗散，并在不可逆耗散内部区分气动损失与机电损失。
AI.result: 可逆动能变化率对于准确的动态功率预测是必要的，但并不充分；与电机转矩平方成正比的耗散是主要的额外改进来源；速度比例耗散进一步避免不可逆损失被错误归因于可逆动能交换。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的方法论为多旋翼系统动态推进功率模型的开发与选择提供了可复用、可实验验证的基础，并支持对功率损失来源进行物理上正确的归因。

title: Compact Robot Policies Need Fine-Grained Visual Representations
summary: Multi-task manipulation policies differ in architecture, scale, and pretrained priors all at once, so published comparisons cannot attribute performance to any single component. We argue that most of it comes from the visual representation, and that parameter scale and generative priors are largely incidental. To test this, we build CoRP (Compressed Representation Policy), a deliberately compact policy (48.9M parameters, no vision-language model and no video-generative prior) that factorizes into a representation extractor and a flow-matching action generator. It reaches 97.0% on LIBERO and 75.78%/73.36% on RoboTwin 2.0 Clean/Randomized, matching systems 40.9-163.6x larger. Holding the action generator fixed, we then vary one extractor property at a time. Pretrained initialization is decisive: a random ViT-S/14 drops to 78.1% and an ImageNet ResNet-34 to 74.5% on LIBERO. Pretraining alone is not enough, as freezing the encoder costs 19.8 points. Compression matters as much: resampling each view to 48 tokens beats passing all patch tokens (97.0% vs 83.2%), and a variational information bottleneck over those tokens is worse than a hard token budget, cutting LIBERO-Goal from 95.8% to 33.0% by suppressing the instruction-dependent token selection the policy relies on. Language conditioning contributes only where the observation leaves the goal ambiguous (LIBERO-Goal: 9.2% to 95.8%), while on RoboTwin 2.0, where observations are unambiguous, removing it slightly improves success. Therefore, we argue that a compact policy works when its representation is pretrained, task-adapted, and compressed. Project page: https://corp-policy.github.io/

AI.tldr: 本文提出CoRP——一个仅48.9M参数、不含视觉语言模型和视频生成先验的紧凑多任务操作策略（表示提取器+流匹配动作生成器）。通过在LIBERO和RoboTwin 2.0上的受控消融实验，作者论证多任务操作策略的性能主要来源于视觉表示，而非参数规模或生成先验。
AI.motivation: 现有多任务操作策略在架构、规模和预训练先验上同时存在差异，导致已发表的对无法将性能归因于任何单一组件。作者主张性能差异主要来自视觉表示，参数规模与生成先验基本是偶然因素，因此需要构建一个刻意紧凑、可逐一控制变量的策略来验证这一假设。
AI.method: 构建CoRP（Compressed Representation Policy）：仅48.9M参数，无VLM、无视频生成先验，分解为表示提取器与流匹配动作生成器。在固定动作生成器的前提下，逐次改变一个提取器属性：预训练初始化（随机ViT-S/14、ImageNet ResNet-34对比）、编码器是否冻结、压缩方式（每视图重采样48个token vs 全部patch token vs 变分信息瓶颈）、语言条件的有无，分别在LIBERO（含LIBERO-Goal）和RoboTwin 2.0 Clean/Randomized上评估。
AI.result: CoRP在LIBERO达97.0%，RoboTwin 2.0 Clean/Randomized为75.78%/73.36%，与规模大40.9–163.6倍的系统相当。预训练初始化具决定性：随机ViT-S/14降至78.1%，ImageNet ResNet-34降至74.5%（LIBERO）。仅预训练不够，冻结编码器损失19.8个点。压缩同样关键：每视图重采样48 token（97.0%）优于全部patch token（83.2%）；变分信息瓶颈劣于硬token预算，将LIBERO-Goal从95.8%降至33.0%。语言条件仅在观测目标模糊时起作用（LIBERO-Goal：9.2%→95.8%），而在观测无歧义的RoboTwin 2.0上移除它反而略有提升。
AI.conclusion: 紧凑策略奏效的条件是：其表示同时具备预训练、任务自适应和压缩三个特性。视觉表示而非参数规模或生成先验是多任务操作策略性能的主要来源。

title: VOMMI: Collecting and Leveraging Portable Demonstrations for Mobile Manipulation
summary: Portable mobile-manipulation demonstrations can help alleviate data scarcity for embodied intelligence, but obtaining reliable, low-cost, and robot-free motion supervision from RGB observations remains challenging. Existing approaches often rely on teleoperation or specialized devices equipped with additional sensing hardware, while directly using estimated visual odometry (VO) trajectories can introduce inconsistencies due to accumulated drift and imperfect motion supervision. We present the Visual-Odometry-Conditioned Mobile Manipulation Interface (VOMMI), a portable demonstration collection and learning framework that connects portable RGB demonstrations to vision-language-action (VLA) post-training through offline trajectory reconstruction and online visual-motion conditioning. VOMMI synchronizes body and hand views to capture navigation context and local object interactions without requiring human-robot kinematic correspondence calibration. R2-VO refines offline demonstration trajectories using sparse geometric anchors and produces causal local-motion tokens over multiple prediction horizons for online policy conditioning. An action-group residual adapter incorporates these tokens only into the base branch. Experiments use a 500-trajectory portable for each task, with 75 trajectories held out for RGB-VO evaluation, and 200 robot demonstrations as references. Our policy, post-trained only on portable demonstrations, achieves 18.2% lower base-velocity error than a policy trained with robot-collected demonstrations, while maintaining comparable end-effector translation accuracy. Offline reconstruction reduces absolute trajectory errors for the body and hand streams by 24.6% on average relative to the best evaluated baseline for each stream. The complete system improves the mean success rate by 8.3 percentage points over OpenPI 0.5 across three real-robot tasks.

AI.tldr: VOMMI：一种便携式RGB演示采集与学习框架，通过离线轨迹重建与在线视觉-运动条件化，将便携演示接入VLA后训练，无需遥操作或专用硬件。
AI.motivation: 便携式移动操作演示可缓解具身智能的数据稀缺，但难以从RGB观测中获得可靠、低成本且无需机器人的运动监督；现有方法依赖遥操作或额外传感设备，直接用估计的视觉里程计（VO）轨迹会因累积漂移和运动监督不完善引入不一致。
AI.method: VOMMI同步身体视角与手部视角以捕捉导航上下文与局部物体交互，无需人-机器人运动学校准。R2-VO利用稀疏几何锚点精修离线演示轨迹，并在多个预测时域上产生因果局部运动token用于在线策略条件化；动作组残差适配器仅将token注入基础分支。
AI.result: 实验每任务使用500条便携轨迹（其中75条留作RGB-VO评估）及200条机器人演示作参考。仅用便携演示后训练的策略基础速度误差比机器人演示训练策略低18.2%，末端平移精度相当；离线重建使身体与手部流的绝对轨迹误差相对各自最佳基线平均降低24.6%；完整系统在三项真实机器人任务上平均成功率比OpenPI 0.5提升8.3个百分点。
AI.conclusion: VOMMI证明无需机器人遥操作或专用传感硬件，即可从便携RGB演示中获得可靠运动监督，并有效迁移至VLA策略后训练，在导航速度精度与真实任务成功率上优于对比方法。

title: UWB Meets Crazyflow: Simulating Degraded Feedback at Scale for Aerial Robotics
comment: Accepted to 1st Workshop on Robot Meets GNSS and Ranging for Seamless Autonomy @ ICRA 2026
summary: In this work, we introduce Crazyflow, an accurate, differentiable simulator built on JAX. By leveraging jit compilation via XLA, Crazyflow unifies physics and control into a single differentiable computation graph, enabling massive parallelization on accelerated hardware without sacrificing modeling accuracy. This architecture achieves order-of-magnitude speedups over existing baselines, capable of training deployable reinforcement learning agents in seconds. To highlight its highly modular design, we demonstrate how easily Crazyflow can be extended by integrating a complete, high-fidelity Ultra-Wideband (UWB) and Inertial Measurement Unit (IMU) simulation pipeline coupled with a full-state Extended Kalman Filter (EKF). This capability allows for massive parallel controller evaluation under realistic, degraded state feedback with minimal impact on GPU throughput. By combining speed, accuracy, and extensibility, Crazyflow serves as a foundational tool for the next generation of aerial robotics research.

AI.tldr: Crazyflow 是基于 JAX 的高精度可微无人机仿真器，将物理与控制统一到单一可微计算图，实现大规模并行与数量级加速，并可扩展到 UWB/IMU 仿真与 EKF 全状态估计。
AI.motivation: 现有仿真器在建模精度与计算速度之间难以兼顾，难以在可接受时间内大规模并行训练与评估可部署的强化学习控制器；同时扩展真实传感与状态估计（如 UWB/IMU、EKF）的仿真能力通常代价高、影响吞吐。
AI.method: 构建于 JAX 之上，利用 XLA 的 jit 编译，将物理仿真与控制整合进同一个可微计算图，从而在加速硬件上实现大规模并行且不牺牲建模精度；采用高度模块化设计，并集成完整的 UWB 与 IMU 高保真仿真管线以及全状态 EKF。
AI.result: 相比现有基线实现数量级加速，可在数秒内训练出可部署的强化学习智能体；支持在真实退化状态反馈下进行大规模并行控制器评估，且对 GPU 吞吐影响极小。
AI.conclusion: Crazyflow 兼具速度、精度与可扩展性，可作为下一代空中机器人研究的基础工具。

authors: A. H. T. E. De Silva
title: HexaGripper: A Single-Actuator, Winch-Deployed Gripper for Autonomous Aerial Parcel Collection
summary: Autonomous aerial parcel collection remains constrained by package-transfer operations that require manual loading, landing, or dedicated ground infrastructure. This letter presents HexaGripper, a single-actuator, winch-deployed six-plate gripper for autonomous collection of cuboid parcels. The proposed mechanism provides synchronized grasping with a wide capture region and tolerance to positional misalignment during pickup. The system integrates vision-based alignment, range sensing, winch deployment, and state-based control to enable autonomous collection while maintaining UAV separation from the pickup surface. Experimental evaluation covered static grasping, capture-workspace assessment, and end-to-end outdoor aerial collection. Static experiments achieved 100% pickup success (15/15 trials) across three parcel geometries, while workspace experiments achieved successful pickup at all 28 tested positions up to a 150 mm radial offset. End-to-end outdoor aerial collection achieved an 80% success rate (4/5 trials). These results demonstrate the feasibility of mechanically synchronized, winch-deployed grasping for landing-free autonomous aerial parcel collection.

AI.tldr: 提出单驱动、绞盘下放的六板夹爪HexaGripper，实现无需降落或地面设施的全自主空中取件，静态抓取成功率100%，端到端户外取件成功率80%。
AI.motivation: 现有自主空中取件受限于需人工装载、降落或专用地面基础设施的包裹交接方式，缺乏无需降落即可完成取件的方案，因此需要一种能容忍位置偏差、在保持无人机与取件表面分离的前提下完成自主取件的机构与系统。
AI.method: 设计单驱动器、绞盘下放的六板夹爪，实现机械同步抓取，具有宽捕获区域与位置偏差容忍度；系统集成视觉对准、测距传感、绞盘下放与基于状态的控制器，使无人机在保持与取件表面分离的情况下完成自主收集。
AI.result: 静态抓取实验在三种包裹几何形状下取得100%成功率（15/15次）；捕获工作空间实验在全部28个测试位置（径向偏差至150 mm）均成功抓取；端到端户外空中取件成功率为80%（4/5次）。
AI.conclusion: 结果验证了机械同步、绞盘下放式抓取用于免降落自主空中包裹收集的可行性。

title: Mitigating Concept Drift in QoS Prediction for Teleoperation of Autonomous Vehicles Using Historic Data
comment: 2025 IEEE International Conference on Systems, Man, and Cybernetics (SMC)
summary: Teleoperation serves as the fallback solution to autonomous driving but reliable functions of the teleoperation require a certain amount of mobile network resources, which cannot be guaranteed at all times. Therefore, predictive quality of service (pQoS) is introduced as a concept to increase the resilience of the teleoperation. In this paper, based on a data measurement campaign, we propose a prediction framework to prediction two important network KPIs of teleoperation: uplink data-rate and round-trip latency. Furthermore, we introduce a method to alleviate the performance degradation of machine-learning-based prediction models on previously unseen data due to concept drift by incorporating historic data into the prediction pipeline. Additionally, we introduce the metric of critical scenario detection to evaluate the prediction performance specifically for teleoperation.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一个预测框架，用于预测远程驾驶所需的上行数据速率与往返时延两个网络KPI，并通过引入历史数据缓解概念漂移导致的模型性能退化，同时提出"关键场景检测"指标以评估面向远程驾驶的预测性能。
AI.motivation: 远程驾驶是自动驾驶的兜底方案，但其可靠运行依赖一定量的移动网络资源，而该资源无法始终得到保证。因此需要引入预测性服务质量（pQoS）概念，以提升远程驾驶的韧性。
AI.method: 基于一次数据测量活动，构建预测框架，对远程驾驶的两个重要网络KPI——上行数据速率与往返时延——进行预测；并将历史数据纳入预测流程，以缓解基于机器学习的预测模型在未见数据上因概念漂移而产生的性能下降。
AI.result: 文中提出了远程驾驶场景下的关键场景检测指标，用于针对性地评估预测性能；并验证了引入历史数据可缓解概念漂移带来的性能退化。
AI.conclusion: 通过预测上行数据速率与往返时延，并借助历史数据应对概念漂移、辅以关键场景检测指标，所提框架有助于提升远程驾驶的韧性，为pQoS的实现提供支撑。

title: Sensor-Layout-Agnostic Navigation via Geometric Observation Canonicalization
summary: Existing visual navigation policies are inherently bound to fixed camera configurations, creating a fundamental barrier to zero-shot deployment across heterogeneous robot sensor layouts. To overcome this limitation, we present an embodiment-informed navigation policy capable of generalizing across diverse depth sensor configurations on a specific aerial platform. Instead of implicitly learning spatial alignments, our approach explicitly unprojects depth measurements from arbitrary depth sensor payloads, varying in sensor count, mounting extrinsics, and intrinsics, into a shared robot-centric frame, stitching them into a unified spherical range image and a binary validity mask. This mask allows the downstream policy to explicitly distinguish covered space from unobserved blind spots. Trained via reinforcement learning with aggressive camera randomization, our policy generalizes zero-shot to unseen layouts featuring up to seven cameras, scaling success rates from 78% to 95% as total spatial sensing coverage increases. Finally, real-world flight trials on a physical quadrotor, conducted in an obstacle-filled corridor and an outdoor forest, validate the policy's zero-shot transfer across camera configurations and its resilience to sudden online sensor dropouts.

AI.tldr: 提出一种"具身感知"的导航策略，将任意深度传感器布局显式投影到机器人中心坐标系并拼接成统一球面距离图像与有效性掩码，从而在特定空中平台上跨相机配置零样本泛化。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉导航策略与固定相机配置强绑定，难以在异构机器人传感器布局间零样本部署。
AI.method: 不同于隐式学习空间对齐，方法显式地将来自任意深度传感器载荷（传感器数量、安装外参、内参各异）的深度测量反投影到共享的机器人中心坐标系，拼接为统一的球面距离图像和二元有效性掩码，使下游策略能区分已覆盖空间与未观测盲区；采用强化学习并配合激进的相机随机化训练。
AI.result: 策略零样本泛化到最多七相机的前所未见布局，成功率随总空间感知覆盖率提升从78%升至95%；在物理四旋翼上的真实飞行试验（障碍密集走廊与户外森林）验证了跨相机配置的零样本迁移及对在线传感器突然失效（dropout）的鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 显式具身感知表示可有效解耦策略与具体传感器配置，实现异构深度传感器布局下的零样本导航与在线传感器失效鲁棒性。

title: Humanoid Horizon: Extending Task Horizon in Whole-Body Loco-Manipulation via Parallel Training, Dynamic Starting, and Reward Gating
comment: Videos and results are available at https://haozhuo-zhang.github.io/Humanoid-Horizon-project-page/
summary: Cluttered indoor environments, where large and heavy objects are scattered across diverse surfaces, require humanoid robots to sequentially navigate, grasp, transport, and accurately place each item at its target location within a single uninterrupted episode. This long-horizon, whole-body loco-manipulation task remains a significant challenge for current methods. Previous approaches often suffer from two main issues: easy-reward bias, where training overemphasizes early transport stages at the expense of later ones, and catastrophic forgetting, where focusing on later stages leads to a decline in earlier-stage performance. In this work, we introduce Humanoid Horizon, a unified policy framework designed to overcome these limitations through three interrelated mechanisms. The Parallel Training Strategy organizes $N$ scenes into $S$ concurrent stage streams governed by a shared policy, ensuring all transport stages receive continuous gradient updates and removing the bottleneck of sequential optimization. The Dynamic Starting Mechanism updates each environment's initial state with terminal states from upstream rollouts, gradually broadening transition coverage and enhancing robustness at stage boundaries. Reward Gating sets the reward to zero for the rest of the episode in later-stage streams when the immediately preceding object is displaced beyond a set threshold, so the shared policy learns not to disturb a just-placed object and earlier placements are preserved throughout the episode. Collectively, these strategies achieve per-stage success rates exceeding 80\% on the two-object LHM-Humanoid benchmark (350 training scenes, 66 held-out scenes). As the number of sequentially transported objects grows beyond two, success declines with the horizon, but the degradation is graceful relative to the sharp drop seen in all baselines.

AI.tldr: 提出Humanoid Horizon统一策略框架，通过并行训练、动态起始与奖励门控三项机制，解决长时程全身移动操作中的易奖励偏差与灾难性遗忘问题，在两物体基准上各阶段成功率超80%。
AI.motivation: 杂乱室内环境中，人形机器人需在单一不间断回合内依次完成导航、抓取、搬运与精准放置，属于长时程全身移动操作任务。现有方法存在两大问题：一是易奖励偏差，训练过度侧重搬运的早期阶段而忽视后期阶段；二是灾难性遗忘，聚焦后期阶段会导致早期阶段性能下降。
AI.method: 提出Humanoid Horizon统一策略框架，包含三个相互关联的机制：(1) 并行训练策略（Parallel Training Strategy），将N个场景组织为S个由共享策略控制的并发阶段流，使所有搬运阶段获得持续梯度更新，消除顺序优化的瓶颈；(2) 动态起始机制（Dynamic Starting Mechanism），用上游rollout的终止状态更新各环境的初始状态，逐步扩大状态转移覆盖范围，增强阶段边界处的鲁棒性；(3) 奖励门控（Reward Gating），当紧邻的前一物体被移动超过设定阈值时，将后续阶段流其余回合的奖励置零，使共享策略学会不干扰刚放置好的物体，从而在整个回合中保持先前放置成果。
AI.result: 在两物体LHM-Humanoid基准（350个训练场景、66个留出场景）上，各阶段成功率均超过80%。当顺序搬运物体数量超过两个时，成功率随任务时程增长而下降，但相较所有基线方法的急剧下降，其退化是平缓的（graceful degradation）。
AI.conclusion: 并行训练、动态起始与奖励门控的协同设计可有效缓解易奖励偏差与灾难性遗忘，实现长时程人形全身移动操作的高阶段成功率；面对更长任务时程仍具备较好的可扩展性与退化平缓性。

title: Communication-Free Obstacle Localization from Aggregate Wrench Measurements in Leader--Follower Cooperative Transport
comment: Submitted to the 2027 American Control Conference (ACC)
summary: We consider obstacle localization for a team of robots cooperatively transporting a rigid payload without explicit inter-robot communication. A leader robot directs the payload's motion, while follower robots assist and react to locally detected obstacles. The leader measures the followers' aggregate wrench, i.e., the combined force and torque they exert on the payload, but cannot directly distinguish their individual reactions. We design a follower control law that allows the leader to recover obstacle locations from these measurements. Each follower resists motion toward nearby obstacles, resulting in a piecewise-linear relationship between the payload's translational and angular velocity and the aggregate wrench. Changes between adjacent linear regions reveal an obstacle's bearing and distance and identify the responding follower. We give sufficient conditions for exact recovery at a fixed payload configuration and develop an adaptive probing procedure in which the leader applies translational and rotational inputs to the payload to obtain the required measurements. We demonstrate the performance of the proposed method in simulations.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了无机器人间显式通信条件下，多机器人协同搬运刚性负载时的障碍物定位问题：通过设计跟随者控制律，使领航者仅凭测量到的跟随者合力旋量即可恢复障碍物位置。
AI.motivation: 多机器人协同搬运中，跟随者通常能局部感知障碍物，但若不允许机器人间显式通信，领航者无法直接获知障碍物信息。因此需要一种机制，使领航者能通过间接测量（合力旋量）推断障碍物的方位与距离，从而在不增加通信负担的前提下实现协同避障。
AI.method: 领航机器人引导负载运动，跟随机器人协助并响应局部检测到的障碍物。每个跟随者抵抗向附近障碍物的运动，使得负载的平移速度与角速度相对于合力旋量呈分段线性关系。相邻线性区域之间的变化揭示了障碍物的方位（bearing）与距离，并可识别出作出响应的跟随者。作者给出了在固定负载位形下实现精确恢复的充分条件，并设计了自适应探测流程：领航者对负载施加平移与旋转输入以获取所需测量。
AI.result: 在固定负载位形下给出了精确恢复障碍物位置的充分条件；所提出的自适应探测流程能够通过平移和旋转输入获取必要测量；仿真验证了方法的性能。
AI.conclusion: 通过分段线性映射与自适应探测，领航者可在无显式机器人间通信的情况下，从合力旋量测量中恢复障碍物位置并识别响应的跟随者，仿真结果验证了该方法的有效性。

title: SC3BF: Shifted Collision Cone Control Barrier Function for Dynamic Obstacle Avoidance
comment: Submitted to the 2027 American Control Conference (ACC)
summary: The collision cone used by velocity-space control barrier functions is conservative: it rejects every relative velocity aimed into an obstacle, however slow. We propose the \emph{shifted collision-cone CBF} (SC3BF), which adds a state-dependent \emph{allowance} to the cone condition, so the robot may approach the obstacle at a rate that grows with distance and with its own speed. SC3BF is enforced by an ordinary quadratic program, and its safe set is forward invariant under bounded inputs without a minimum forward speed or a clearance margin. We prove that a nonzero allowance preserving safety always exists, and derive one in closed form. Against three velocity-space baselines on a kinematic bicycle among up to $100$ moving obstacles, SC3BF reaches the goal more often and modifies the nominal input less than half as much.

AI.tldr: 提出移位碰撞锥CBF（SC3BF），通过状态相关"allowance"放宽碰撞锥的保守性，用普通QP实现，保证前向不变性与安全性，仿真中比三个速度空间基线更常到达目标且输入修正减少超一半。
AI.motivation: 传统速度空间控制障碍函数所用的碰撞锥过于保守：只要相对速度指向障碍物即被拒绝，无论速度多慢，导致机器人在复杂动态环境中可达性差、控制修正过大。
AI.method: 在碰撞锥条件中引入状态相关的"allowance"项，使机器人可随距离和自身速度增大而提高接近速率；该约束以普通二次规划（QP）形式求解；理论证明存在保持安全性的非零allowance并给出闭式解，且安全集在有界输入下前向不变，无需最小前向速度或安全间隙。
AI.result: 在运动学自行车模型、最多100个移动障碍物场景下与三种速度空间基线对比，SC3BF到达目标的频率更高，且对名义输入的修正量不到基线的一半。
AI.conclusion: SC3BF在保持安全性的同时显著缓解了碰撞锥的保守性，提升动态环境中的任务成功率并降低控制代价，适用于无最小前向速度与间隙要求的场景。

title: Event-Driven Proactive Robot Assistance through Vision-Language Reasoning
summary: Assistance in collaborative manipulation is often initiated by user instructions, making high-level reasoning request-driven. In fluent human teamwork, however, partners often infer the next helpful step from the observed outcome of an action rather than waiting for instructions. Motivated by this, we investigate an event-driven formulation of proactive assistance, where human--object interaction outcomes initiate assistive reasoning without user-provided task specifications at inference time. To this end, we propose an event-driven framework that monitors workspace state changes with an event monitor and, upon event completion, extracts stabilized pre/post snapshots that characterize the resulting state transition. A frozen pretrained Vision-Language Model (VLM) then uses its semantic priors to infer the task context, decide whether assistance is appropriate, and, when needed, generate a sequence of assistive actions from the observed transition. To make outputs executable and verifiable, we restrict actions to a set of action primitives and reference objects via integer IDs.We evaluate the same framework across three distinct real world tabletop collaboration tasks without task-specific training or fine-tuning. The event-driven framework achieves performance comparable to variants given user instructions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种事件驱动的主动协助框架：通过事件监视器监测工作空间状态变化，在事件完成后提取稳定的前后快照，利用冻结的预训练VLM推断任务上下文并决定是否协助、生成动作序列，在三个真实桌面协作任务上无需任务特定训练即达到与给定用户指令变体相当的性能。
AI.motivation: 协作操作中的协助通常由用户指令触发，属于请求驱动的高层推理；而流畅的人类团队协作中，伙伴常通过观察动作结果推断下一步有帮助的行为，而非等待指令。因此作者希望研究事件驱动的主动协助形式，让"人-物交互结果"在推理阶段无需用户任务说明即可触发协助推理。
AI.method: 提出事件驱动框架：1）用事件监视器监测工作空间状态变化；2）事件完成后提取稳定的前/后快照，刻画状态转移；3）冻结的预训练VLM利用语义先验推断任务上下文、判断是否应协助，并在需要时从观测到的转移生成协助动作序列；4）为便于执行与验证，将动作限定为动作原语集合，并用整数ID引用物体。
AI.result: 在三个不同的真实桌面协作任务上评估同一框架，无需任务特定训练或微调；事件驱动框架的性能与给定用户指令的变体相当。
AI.conclusion: 表明基于人类-物体交互结果的主动协助是可行的，冻结VLM的语义先验足以在无任务说明条件下推断任务上下文并生成有效协助，且该框架具备跨任务泛化能力，性能可比于有指令的情形。

title: How Much Planning Is Enough? Reducing Search and Computation in World-Model Planning
summary: Visual world models enable goal-directed control through decision-time action search, but their deployment efficiency is often limited by conservatively large planning budgets. We show that competitive task performance can be achieved without agreement with the Full-budget action, that sufficient budgets vary across model--task pairs, and that iterative planners repeatedly encode solve-invariant context. To address these inefficiencies, we propose {SufficientPlan}, a simple deployment framework that requires no modification to pretrained world models or planner updates. Its {Paired Sequential Budget Certification (PSBC)} component uses paired closed-loop evidence to search for and certify a reduced model--task-specific budget within a predefined Full-performance tolerance. Its {Static-Context Reuse (SCR)} component caches observation and goal representations across search iterations while preserving candidate-dependent planning and selected actions. Experiments across multiple world-model backbones and visual-control tasks show that SufficientPlan substantially reduces search budgets and planning latency while maintaining competitive control performance.

AI.tldr: 提出 SufficientPlan 部署框架，通过配对序列预算认证（PSBC）与静态上下文复用（SCR）降低视觉世界模型决策时动作搜索的预算与延迟，无需修改预训练模型或规划器。
AI.motivation: 视觉世界模型通过决策时动作搜索实现目标导向控制，但部署效率受限于保守的过大规划预算；作者发现达到竞争性任务性能并不需要与全预算动作一致，且充足预算因模型-任务对而异，迭代规划器还会重复编码与求解无关的上下文。
AI.method: SufficientPlan 框架：1）Paired Sequential Budget Certification (PSBC)：利用配对闭环证据，在预设的 Full 性能容差内搜索并认证一个缩减的、模型-任务特定的预算；2）Static-Context Reuse (SCR)：在搜索迭代间缓存观测与目标表示，同时保留依赖候选的规划与所选动作；无需修改预训练世界模型或更新规划器。
AI.result: 在多种世界模型骨干与视觉控制任务上，SufficientPlan 在保持竞争性控制性能的同时，显著降低搜索预算与规划延迟。
AI.conclusion: 合理的规划预算可显著低于保守设置而不损失性能，且可通过认证与上下文复用高效实现，为世界模型的实际部署提供即插即用的加速方案。

title: From Legs to Wheels: Embodiment-Aware Human Motion Retargeting for Mobile-Base Humanoids
summary: Human video offers a scalable source of robot demonstrations, yet most human-to-humanoid retargeting methods assume a legged robot with human-like kinematics. This assumption does not hold for mobile-base humanoids equipped with a wheeled base, vertical lift, and two arms. Human walking must be expressed through base motion, while torso bending may require coordinated lift and arm motion. We address this mismatch with a task-conditioned framework that assigns reconstructed human motion to base, lift, and arm responsibilities before robot-specific realization. The allocator preserves the human-derived path, stabilizes heading, separates turn and translation when needed, retimes commands to satisfy base limits, and repairs lift and arm trajectories. A deployment adapter then converts the reference to 50 Hz commands using stationary-base detection, deadband and slew-rate filtering, time-consistent playback scaling, and separate linear and angular gains. We evaluate the resulting references with human-derived task-space comparisons, policy-free simulation replay, and a qualitative execution on a physical robot.

AI.tldr: 提出任务条件化的人类到移动底座人形机器人重定向框架，将重建人体运动分配给底座、升降与手臂，并经部署适配器生成50Hz指令，通过任务空间对比、无策略仿真回放与实机定性执行验证。
AI.motivation: 人类视频是可扩展的机器人示范来源，但多数人-人形重定向方法假设机器人具有类人腿式运动学。对于带轮式底座、垂直升降与双臂的移动底座人形机器人，该假设不成立：人类行走须由底座运动表达，躯干弯曲可能需升降与手臂协同。因此需要解决这一运动学不匹配问题。
AI.method: 方法为任务条件化重定向框架，在机器人特定实现前，将重建的人体运动分配给底座、升降与手臂的职责。分配器保持人类导出的路径、稳定航向、必要时分离转向与平移、重新计时指令以满足底座限制，并修复升降与手臂轨迹。随后部署适配器通过静止底座检测、死区与转换速率滤波、时间一致的回放缩放以及独立的线性与角增益，将参考转换为50Hz指令。
AI.result: 评估包括三方面：基于人类导出的任务空间比较、无策略仿真回放，以及在实体机器人上的定性执行。
AI.conclusion: 该任务条件化框架与部署适配器可弥合人类运动与移动底座人形机器人运动学之间的不匹配，实现从人类视频到实际机器人指令的重定向与部署，并通过任务空间对比、仿真回放与实机执行得到验证。

title: Post-Grasp Kinematic Repair for Robotic Insertion via Object-in-Gripper Reorientation
summary: A stable grasp does not guarantee kinematically feasible robotic insertion because the object-in-gripper transform may force the robot towards singularities or joint limits along the prescribed insertion path. We study post-grasp kinematic feasibility repair through object-in-gripper reorientation. Given an achieved grasp and a fixed insertion path, we seek a small reorientation that restores kinematic feasibility. Sequential IK can miss such candidates by following an unfavorable joint-space path, while the nonsmooth feasibility landscape makes the search computationally expensive. We evaluate candidates using a branch-aware IK graph that maximizes the minimum feasibility margin over the discretized insertion path and use a learned task-conditioned prior to improve query ordering. The selected reorientation is executed through tactile-based extrinsic manipulation. In UR5e simulations, the planner without learned ranking reduces mean reorientation over successful trials by 51.5% compared with grid-based sequential IK. Adding learned ranking reduces this planner's mean planning time by an additional 51.1%. Real-robot experiments validate the complete pipeline.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究抓取后的机器人插入运动学可行性修复问题：在不改变已获得抓取和固定插入路径的前提下，通过物体在夹爪中的小幅重定向，使机器人避开奇异位形与关节限位，从而恢复运动学可行的大幅插入操作。
AI.motivation: 稳定的抓取并不保证机器人插入操作在运动学上可行，因为物体-夹爪变换可能迫使机器人在给定插入路径上接近奇异位形或关节限位。作者希望在不重新抓取的前提下，通过抓取后的物体重定向修复这类不可行性。
AI.method: 论文使用分支感知的IK图对候选重定向进行评估，最大化离散化插入路径上的最小可行性裕度；同时引入任务条件学习的先验来改进候选查询排序；选定的重定向通过基于触觉的外在操作加以执行。
AI.result: 在UR5e仿真实验中，未使用学习排序的规划器相比基于网格的顺序IK，在成功试验中将平均重定向量减少51.5%；加入学习排序后，规划器的平均规划时间进一步减少51.1%。真实机器人实验验证了完整流程的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 抓取后物体重定向可以修复插入路径的运动学可行性，分支感知IK图结合学习排序能在保证成功率的同时降低重定向幅度和规划时间，并通过真实机器人实验得到验证。

title: MIM-VLA: Learning Physical Interaction Representations from Gripper Motor Feedback
comment: 9 pages, 7 figures. Jaeyoung Lee and Jiyeon Koo contributed equally
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) policies infer grasp actions primarily from visual observations and robot state, but do not explicitly represent the physical response observed after contact. We present MIM-VLA, a motor-feedback-based architecture that encodes recent gripper current, position, velocity, and signal validity as a 128-dimensional interaction token. A motor-only Motor Interaction Module (MIM) is pretrained with human-reviewed contact and interaction-phase labels and then conditions only the gripper-action pathway of SmolVLA; arm actions and the position-control interface remain unchanged. The same token supports the MEM selector VLM that compares candidate interactions and produces evidence-conditioned selections and explanations. We evaluate MIM-VLA in three real-world settings: comparing the interaction resistance of visually different objects, disambiguating visually similar real and replica objects through active probing, and gently grasping fragile objects, including held-out instances. Across 13 object pairs, MIM-VLA selects the higher-resistance object in 75.0% of trials, compared with 48.8% for the SmolVLA baseline. For the evaluated tasks, the approach uses motor feedback already available from the gripper and does not require an additional tactile array, force-torque sensor, calibrated force estimate, or direct current control.

AI.tldr: MIM-VLA 通过将夹爪电流、位置、速度等电机反馈编码为128维交互 token，仅用于条件化机械臂抓取动作通路，在真实场景中实现了抗阻比较、真伪辨别与脆弱物体轻柔抓取。
AI.motivation: 现有 VLA 策略主要依赖视觉观测与机器人状态推断抓取动作，未显式表征接触后的物理响应，导致在视觉不可区分或需力觉判断的任务中受限；且额外触觉阵列、力矩传感器或电流控制会带来硬件与标定成本。
AI.method: 构建 MIM-VLA：以夹爪电流、位置、速度与信号有效性构成128维交互 token；用人工审核的接触与交互阶段标签预训练纯电机的 Motor Interaction Module（MIM）；该模块仅条件化 SmolVLA 的夹爪动作通路，保持机械臂动作与位置控制接口不变；同一 token 还支持 MEM 选择器 VLM，对候选交互进行比较并输出证据条件化选择与解释。
AI.result: 在三个真实场景（视觉差异物体的交互阻力比较、视觉相似真品与复刻品的主动探测辨别、含未见实例的脆弱物体轻柔抓取）中，13 组物体对里 MIM-VLA 选择高阻力物体的比例为 75.0%，SmolVLA 基线为 48.8%。
AI.conclusion: 在评估任务中，该方法仅利用夹爪已有的电机反馈即可提升抓取的物理交互判断能力，无需额外触觉阵列、力矩传感器、标定力估计或直接电流控制。

title: Safe Multi-Robot Collaborative Transport Using Density Functions
summary: This paper presents a hierarchical density-based model predictive control framework for safe collaborative manipulation by multiple quadrupedal robots. The framework enables a team of robots to push a shared object to a desired pose using only the initial and goal poses, without requiring a precomputed reference trajectory. A centralized box-level MPC optimizes contact forces while enforcing a control-density constraint for goal convergence and obstacle avoidance. Each robot then solves its own distributed robot-level whole-body MPC, under a stated shared-information assumption, to track its moving contact location while accounting for static obstacles and the time-varying positions of neighboring robots. The approach is evaluated in MuJoCo using whole-body contact dynamics for two and three Unitree Go2 quadrupeds collaboratively pushing rigid objects through narrow passages. Comparisons with matched Control Barrier Function and RRT* based tracking baselines demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed density-based formulation for push-only, force- and torque-coupled manipulation tasks. Implementation videos are available at https://jaggu2606.github.io/go2-density-mpc-pushing/

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种分层、基于密度的模型预测控制框架，用于多四足机器人安全协同操作，仅需初始与目标位姿即可将共享物体推至目标位姿，无需预计算参考轨迹。
AI.motivation: 多四足机器人协同推动共享物体时，存在强力/力矩耦合、避障与目标收敛需求，且预计算参考轨迹困难或不可靠，需要一种无需参考轨迹、兼顾安全与收敛的分层控制方法。
AI.method: 采用两层架构：集中式箱体级MPC优化接触力，并施加控制密度约束以实现目标收敛与避障；在共享信息假设下，各机器人求解分布式机器人级全身MPC，跟踪移动接触位置，同时考虑静态障碍与邻居机器人的时变位置。
AI.result: 在MuJoCo中使用全身接触动力学，对两到三台Unitree Go2四足机器人协同推刚性物体穿越狭窄通道进行验证；与匹配的控制障碍函数（CBF）和RRT*跟踪基线相比，基于密度的形式在仅推、力与力矩耦合的操作任务中表现更有效。
AI.conclusion: 所提分层密度型MPC框架可实现多四足机器人的安全协同推物操作，无需预计算参考轨迹，并在仿真对比中优于CBF与RRT*基线。

title: ActTune: Action-Aware Precision and GPU Operating-Point Adaptation for Energy-Efficient Vision-Language-Action Inference
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) policies repeatedly invoke inference to control robots, making graphics processing unit (GPU) energy a recurring cost of task execution. Reducing energy per inference call, however, may not reduce energy per successful task if numerical errors increase failures or slower inference prolongs execution. We therefore target GPU energy per successful task while preserving task success and keeping the inference-latency increase within 10\%. Our approach builds on two observations: quantization sensitivity varies across action classes, model layers, and weights versus activations; and numerical precision changes the workload, shifting favorable GPU operating points. We introduce ActTune, an action-aware framework that connects layer-wise precision allocation with workload-dependent GPU operating-point selection over requested frequency--power-cap pairs. A lightweight decision tree learns its splits and leaf precision configurations directly from configuration action errors, then selects precision before each policy call. The controller forecasts the next workload and applies the selected GPU operating point asynchronously using a lookup table calibrated under a latency budget. A shared resident quantized weight bank enables configuration switching without weight reconstruction or additional policy evaluations. On LIBERO, a benchmark for lifelong robot learning, ActTune improves mean task success by up to 2.3\% relative to state of the art. Relative to the original BF16 implementations, it delivers up to $2.02\times$ faster inference and, with GPU operating-point adaptation, reduces energy per successful task by up to 76.8\%.

AI.tldr: ActTune：动作感知的VLA策略推理框架，通过层间精度分配与GPU工作点选择，在保持任务成功率的前提下将每成功任务GPU能耗最多降低76.8%。
AI.motivation: VLA策略需反复推理来控制机器人，GPU能耗是任务执行的持续性成本。但降低单次推理能耗未必降低"每成功任务"能耗——数值误差可能导致失败率上升，推理变慢也可能延长执行时间。
AI.method: 基于两点观察：量化敏感度在动作类别、模型层、权重与激活间存在差异；数值精度改变工作负载从而影响GPU有利工作点。提出ActTune：用轻量决策树从各配置的动作误差中学习分裂与叶节点精度配置，在每次策略调用前选择精度；控制器预测下一工作负载，并借助在延迟预算下校准的查找表异步设置GPU工作点（频率—功耗上限对）；共享常驻量化权重库支持无需权重重建或额外策略评估的配置切换。
AI.result: 在LIBERO持续机器人学习基准上，平均任务成功率相对SOTA最高提升2.3%；相对原始BF16实现，推理速度最高提升2.02倍，结合GPU工作点自适应后每成功任务能耗最多降低76.8%。
AI.conclusion: 面向每成功任务能耗而非单次推理能耗进行联合优化，可在成功率与延迟约束（延迟增幅≤10%）下显著提升VLA策略的能效。

title: Behavioral Safety Assessment towards Large-scale Deployment of Autonomous Vehicles, Part I: Methodology
summary: Autonomous vehicles (AVs) have significantly advanced in real-world deployment in recent years, yet safety continues to be a critical barrier to widespread adoption. Traditional functional safety approaches, which primarily verify the reliability, robustness, and adequacy of AV hardware and software systems from a vehicle-centric perspective, do not sufficiently address the AV's broader interactions and behavioral impact on the surrounding traffic environment. To overcome this limitation, we propose a paradigm shift toward behavioral safety, a comprehensive approach focused on evaluating AV responses and interactions within the traffic environment. To systematically assess behavioral safety, we introduce a third-party AV safety assessment framework comprising two complementary evaluation components: the Behavioral Competency Test and the Driving Intelligence Test. The Behavioral Competency Test evaluates the AV's reactive behaviors under controlled scenarios, ensuring basic behavioral competency. In contrast, the Driving Intelligence Test assesses the AV's interactive behaviors within naturalistic traffic conditions, quantifying the frequency of safety-critical events to deliver statistically meaningful safety metrics before large-scale deployment. In Part II of this study, an open-source Level 4 Automated Driving System (ADS) is tested to demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method.

AI.tldr: 提出"行为安全"范式转向，构建由行为胜任力测试与驾驶智能测试组成的第三方AV安全评估框架。
AI.motivation: 传统功能安全方法以车辆为中心，仅验证AV硬件与软件的可靠性、鲁棒性和充分性，无法充分刻画AV与周围交通环境的交互及其行为影响，安全仍是AV大规模部署的关键障碍。
AI.method: 提出面向行为安全的范式转向，并设计第三方AV安全评估框架，包含两个互补组件：（1）行为胜任力测试（Behavioral Competency Test），在受控场景下评估AV的反应性行为，确保基本行为胜任力；（2）驾驶智能测试（Driving Intelligence Test），在自然交通条件下评估AV的交互行为，量化安全关键事件频率。
AI.result: 行为胜任力测试可保证基本行为胜任力；驾驶智能测试可在大规模部署前给出具有统计意义的安全度量。本文为该框架第一部分，第二部分将针对开源L4级自动驾驶系统（ADS）开展测试以验证方法有效性。
AI.conclusion: 该研究倡导从功能安全转向行为安全，通过分层、互补的第三方评估框架系统化衡量AV在交通环境中的行为安全，为部署前提供统计有效的安全评价依据。

title: Behavioral Safety Assessment towards Large-scale Deployment of Autonomous Vehicles, Part II: Assessment Results
summary: Third-party evaluations of autonomous vehicle (AV) safety can play a vital role in improving public acceptance, building consumer confidence, and establishing effective safety standards. In Part I of this study, we propose a dedicated third-party testing initiative for systematically evaluating AV behavioral safety. In this paper, we validate our proposed framework using Autoware.Universe, an open-source Level 4 Automated Driving System (ADS), tested both in simulated environments and on the physical test track at the University of Michigan's Mcity Testing Facility. The results indicate that Autoware.Universe possesses 6 out of 14 behavioral competencies and exhibited a crash rate of 3.01x10^-3 crashes per mile, approximately 1,000 times higher than the average human driver crash rate. During the tests, we also uncovered a number of unknown unsafe scenarios for Autoware.Universe. These findings underscore the necessity of behavioral safety evaluations for improving AV safety performance prior to widespread public deployment.

AI.tldr: 本文验证了一套面向自动驾驶行为安全的第三方测试框架，使用开源L4自动驾驶系统Autoware.Universe，在仿真环境与Mcity实体测试场开展评估。结果显示其仅具备14项行为胜任力中的6项，碰撞率为3.01×10^-3次/英里，约为人类驾驶员平均碰撞率的1000倍，并暴露出若干未知不安全场景，凸显部署前行为安全评估的必要性。
AI.motivation: 第三方对自动驾驶汽车（AV）安全的评估对提升公众接受度、建立消费者信心以及制定有效安全标准具有关键作用。本文旨在验证作者在Part I中提出的第三方测试方案，以系统评估AV行为安全，推动AV在大规模公开部署前改善安全性能。
AI.method: 采用Part I提出的第三方测试框架，选取开源Level 4自动驾驶系统Autoware.Universe作为被测对象，分别在仿真环境和密歇根大学Mcity测试场的实体测试跑道上进行测试，围绕行为胜任力与碰撞率指标开展系统评估。
AI.result: Autoware.Universe在14项行为胜任力中仅通过6项；碰撞率为3.01×10^-3次/英里，约为人类驾驶员平均碰撞率的1000倍；测试过程中还发现若干此前未知的不安全场景。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果印证了行为安全评估的必要性：在广泛公开部署之前，必须通过此类第三方测试识别并改进AV的安全缺陷，以提升整体安全表现。

title: A Belief-State World Model for Catheter Navigation under Sparse Fluoroscopy: A Planar Proof of Concept
comment: Presented at the IEEE/RSJ International Conference on Intelligent Robots and Systems (IROS 2026) Workshop on Surgical Digital Twins (SurgTwin). 4 pages, 2 figures
summary: Endovascular catheter navigation relies on continuous fluoroscopy, exposing patients and clinical staff to ionizing radiation throughout the procedure. We investigate whether a physics-based world model can sustain the navigation task between deliberately sparse X-ray acquisitions, and whether the model can signal when its internal state estimate is no longer reliable. We formulate sparse-fluoroscopy navigation as a partially observable Markov decision process where a Cosserat rod simulator supplies transition dynamics, sparse noisy projections provide observations, and a particle filter maintains a belief over the device state, reduced in this implementation to a tip state with a geometric contact proxy. We evaluate this formulation in a deliberately simplified setting: a synthetic planar vessel phantom with a quasi-static rod model and simulated projections, without clinical or animal data. In this setting, the belief-state model tracks the simulated tip with a root mean square error of 1.30 mm while acquiring observations at one fifteenth of the continuous rate (0.97 mm at every frame, 1.51 mm at one thirtieth), reported 90 percent credible intervals achieve 0.92 empirical coverage, and the belief-derived contact risk estimate discriminates unsafe contact events with an AUROC of 0.68. These results constitute a proof of concept on a simplified simulation rather than a demonstration of clinical readiness; their purpose is to establish that calibrated belief, rather than point-estimate accuracy alone, is the essential property a sparse-imaging world model must deliver.

AI.tldr: 该论文将稀疏透视下的血管内导管导航建模为部分可观测马尔可夫决策过程（POMDP），用Cosserat杆模拟器提供动力学、粒子滤波维护信念状态，在简化合成平面血管体模中验证信念状态可稀疏观测下跟踪导管尖端并输出校准的不确定性。
AI.motivation: 血管内导管导航依赖连续X射线透视，使患者与医护人员全程暴露于电离辐射。核心问题是：能否用基于物理的世界模型在刻意稀疏的X射线采集之间维持导航任务，并在其内部状态估计不可靠时主动发出信号。作者强调稀疏成像世界模型的关键属性应是"校准的信念"而非单纯的点估计精度。
AI.method: 将稀疏透视导航形式化为POMDP：Cosserat杆模拟器提供转移动力学，稀疏含噪投影作为观测，粒子滤波维护器械状态信念；本实现将状态约简为尖端状态加几何接触代理。评估在刻意简化的合成平面血管体模中进行，采用准静态杆模型与模拟投影，不使用临床或动物数据。对比连续采集（每帧）与1/15、1/30稀疏采集频率。
AI.result: 信念状态模型在1/15连续帧率下跟踪模拟尖端的RMSE为1.30 mm（每帧为0.97 mm，1/30为1.51 mm）；报告的90%可信区间达到0.92的经验覆盖率（校准良好）；由信念导出的接触风险估计对不安全接触事件的区分AUROC为0.68。
AI.conclusion: 结果属于简化仿真上的概念验证，而非临床可用性证明。其意义在于确立：稀疏成像世界模型必须提供校准的信念（可靠的不确定性量化），而不仅是点估计精度，这样才能在稀疏采集间维持导航并在不可靠时发出告警。

title: No Need to Stop the Fleet: Localized Anomaly Isolation via Dead Zones in AGV Fleets
summary: Automated Guided Vehicle (AGV) fleets in production and logistics environments rely on a system-wide emergency stop to handle local anomalies such as malfunctions, hazards, or contaminated areas. While safe, this approach halts the entire fleet even when only a small area is affected, causing unnecessary downtime. This paper proposes dead zones --- a formally defined localized isolation approach that serves as an additional fail-operational mechanism for situations where a full system-wide halt is not strictly needed. Rather than shutting down the entire fleet, a dead zone isolates the anomalous area, allowing unaffected robots to continue operating normally. We introduce two operational strategies: basic dead zone handling, in which affected robots enter a dead zone and stop, and dead zone handling with escaping, in which robots that are sufficiently far from a dead zone reroute around it. For escaping on counterclockwise trajectories we prove collision-freedom with a bounded arrival delay for all escaping robots, provided a minimum pairwise separation is kept between robots. Experimental evaluation confirms the theoretical guarantees and characterizes the throughput tradeoffs between all three approaches: full emergency stop, basic dead zone handling, and dead zone handling with escaping.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"死区"（dead zones）——一种形式化定义的局部隔离机制，作为AGV车队在全系统急停之外的补充性失效运行（fail-operational）手段。死区仅隔离异常区域，使未受影响的机器人继续运行。作者给出两种策略：基础死区处理（受影响机器人进入死区停止）与带逃逸的死区处理（距离足够远的机器人绕行），并对逆时针轨迹上的逃逸证明了无碰撞性与有界到达延迟。实验验证了理论保证，并刻画了急停、基础死区、带逃逸死区三种方案的吞吐量权衡。
AI.motivation: AGV车队在生产与物流环境中依靠全系统急停来应对局部异常（故障、危险源或污染区域）。该方式虽安全，但即使仅小范围受影响也会导致整个车队停摆，造成不必要的停机。因此需要一种更细粒度的隔离机制，在无需全系统停机的场景下提供失效运行能力。
AI.method: 提出死区作为形式化定义的局部隔离方法。设计两种运行策略：(1) 基础死区处理，受影响机器人进入死区并停止；(2) 带逃逸的死区处理，距离死区足够远的机器人绕行。针对逆时针轨迹上的逃逸情形，在保持机器人间最小成对间距的前提下，证明逃逸机器人的无碰撞性与有界到达延迟。并通过实验进行验证与对比。
AI.result: 实验确认了理论保证（无碰撞与有界延迟）成立，并刻画了三种方案——全急停、基础死区处理、带逃逸死区处理——在吞吐量上的权衡关系。
AI.conclusion: 死区机制可作为全系统急停的补充，在局部异常时仅隔离受影响区域，使其他机器人继续工作，从而降低不必要的停机；带逃逸策略在保证安全与有界延迟的同时，为吞吐量提供更优的折中。

title: Pareto-Optimal Entropy-Regularized Trajectory Optimization
summary: Trajectory optimization (TO) under nonlinear dynamics, actuation limits and collision avoidance constraints is a fundamental problem in robotics, albeit especially challenging due to its highly non-convex nature. For this setting, Differential Dynamic Programming (DDP) is an efficient second-order shooting method, yet its local structure renders it vulnerable to suboptimal basins. Sampling-augmented variants mitigate this susceptibility through stochastic exploration, but often sample only around the few trajectories they retain for reoptimization, based solely on their cost which restricts exploration breadth. We introduce Pareto-Optimal Entropy-Regularized DDP (PER-DDP), an entropy-regularized population framework derived from the free-energy/relative-entropy inequality. Our method combines prior-guided sampling that shapes exploration around each retained trajectory, with expanded rollout evaluations that probe these sampling policies beyond the few retained candidates, and Pareto filtering for preserving task-constraint alternatives across iterations. This decouples sampling effort from the optimization population size and broadens exploration without sacrificing the second-order structure that makes DDP effective. Across multiple systems and hundreds of environments, PER-DDP achieves higher success rates than state-of-the-art sampling-augmented TO methods and finds reliable solutions in environments beyond the reach of all baselines.

AI.tldr: 提出PER-DDP：一种基于自由能/相对熵不等式的熵正则化种群框架，求解非凸轨迹优化问题，在多个系统上成功率优于先进采样增强TO方法。
AI.motivation: 非线性动力学、驱动受限与避碰约束下的轨迹优化高度非凸。DDP作为高效二阶打靶法易陷入次优盆地；现有采样增强变体仅在少数保留轨迹附近采样且仅按代价筛选，限制探索广度。
AI.method: PER-DDP从自由能/相对熵不等式推导出熵正则化种群框架，包含三部分：先验引导采样（在每条保留轨迹周围塑造探索）、扩展滚动评估（将采样策略评估扩展至少数保留候选之外）、Pareto筛选（跨迭代保留任务-约束权衡的多样解）。该方法将采样开销与优化种群规模解耦，在保持DDP二阶结构的同时扩大探索。
AI.result: 在多种系统和数百个环境中，PER-DDP成功率高于最先进的采样增强轨迹优化方法，并在所有基线均失败的环境中仍能找到可靠解。
AI.conclusion: 通过熵正则化种群机制解耦采样与种群规模，PER-DDP在维持DDP二阶高效性的同时显著拓宽探索，提升了非凸轨迹优化的成功率与鲁棒性。

title: Micro Neural Policies for Safe Real-Time Robotic Control
summary: In this paper, we investigate the synthesis of Micro Neural Policies (MNP) to enable safe and robust real-time robotic control on computationally constrained embedded devices. We demonstrate that integrating Evolution Strategy (ES) and Statistical Model Checking (SMC)-based verification for policy search can drastically reduce neural network size without compromising safety and robustness. We conduct a large-scale training and evaluation of MNP on Cartpole and Quadrotor control tasks, varying control frequencies and network architectures. After validating these policies in simulation, we evaluate their deployability through zero-shot transfer to physical systems. Our experiments show that MNP can successfully achieve safe sim-to-real transfer without sacrificing control performance. We then show that the policies' memory footprint, ranging from 0.5 to 7.5 kB, allows deployment on microcontrollers, where they achieve real-time inference latency with under 25 ns of jitter while leaving the chip idle for over 97% of the time for additional workloads. This makes them a highly practical solution for severely resource-constrained robotic systems.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出微型神经策略（MNP），结合进化策略与统计模型检验进行策略搜索，在保证安全与鲁棒性的同时大幅压缩神经网络规模，并成功实现从仿真到真实机器人系统的零样本迁移与微控制器实时部署。
AI.motivation: 在计算资源受限的嵌入式设备上实现安全、鲁棒的实时机器人控制十分困难：常规神经网络策略规模大、推理开销高，难以满足微控制器的内存与实时性约束，同时还要保证安全性。
AI.method: 将进化策略（ES）与基于统计模型检验（SMC）的验证相结合进行策略搜索，以在压缩网络规模的同时保障安全性；在Cartpole与四旋翼控制任务上开展大规模训练与评估，变化控制频率与网络架构；仿真验证后通过零样本迁移部署到物理系统进行评估。
AI.result: MNP在实现安全sim-to-real迁移的同时未牺牲控制性能；策略内存占用仅0.5–7.5 kB，可部署于微控制器，实时推理抖动低于25 ns，且芯片空闲时间超过97%以供其他工作负载使用。
AI.conclusion: MNP是一种面向极度资源受限机器人系统的高实用性方案，能够在嵌入式设备上兼顾安全性、鲁棒性、实时性与低资源开销。

title: Towards Efficient Robotic Manipulation Models with Self-Recursive Pruning
summary: Network pruning can reduce parameter redundancy in robotic policies. However, generic pruning criteria are tailored for image recognition tasks and commonly designed to preserve weight magnitude, local reconstruction, or language-model likelihood rather than closed-loop action behavior. Directly applying these pruning algorithms to robotic tasks yields unsatisfactory performance. In this paper, we propose Loss-Conditioned Activation-Moment (LCAM) pruning, a training-free method for unstructured pruning of pre-trained robotic manipulation policies. Specifically, we first rank connections using row-normalized weight contribution, activation moments measured on calibration demonstrations, and the sensitivity of output directions to the action-prediction loss. We further design a self-recursive coarse-to-fine procedure: importance is recalibrated after each nested coarse pruning stage, while held-out offline action distortion guides fine-grained budget allocation after a sparsity knee. Our algorithm is free from costly recovery training and simulator rollouts after pruning. Experiments on three LIBERO suites with competitive robotic policies, together with evaluations on OpenVLA, show that LCAM attains competitive performance across a broad range of pruning ratios. Notably, on LIBERO-Object with OpenVLA, our LCAM achieves 84.0% success at 50% unstructured pruning, retaining over 90% of the dense policy's success rate. Promising results on real-world robotic ping pong further demonstrate the effectiveness of our pruning algorithm.

AI.tldr: 本文提出LCAM剪枝方法，一种无需训练的机器人操作策略非结构化剪枝技术，在多个LIBERO套件和OpenVLA上取得优异性能。
AI.motivation: 机器人策略存在参数冗余，但通用剪枝准则针对图像识别任务设计，侧重权重幅度、局部重建或语言模型似然，而非闭环动作行为，直接应用于机器人任务性能不佳。
AI.method: 提出LCAM（Loss-Conditioned Activation-Moment）剪枝：1）利用行归一化权重贡献、校准演示上测量的激活矩以及输出方向对动作预测损失的敏感性来排序连接；2）设计自递归由粗到细流程，每个嵌套粗剪枝阶段后重新校准重要性，在稀疏度拐点后由留出的离线动作失真引导细粒度预算分配。该方法无需昂贵的恢复训练和仿真器回放。
AI.result: 在三个LIBERO套件及OpenVLA上评估，在广泛剪枝率范围内达到竞争性性能。在LIBERO-Object上使用OpenVLA时，50%非结构化剪枝下成功率达84.0%，保持了密集策略90%以上的成功率。真实世界乒乓球机器人实验也展示了有效性。
AI.conclusion: LCAM是一种免训练的非结构化剪枝方法，能够有效压缩机器人操作策略，在保持动作行为的同时实现高剪枝率下的竞争性性能。

title: One for All, All for One: Coordinated Multi-Agent Diffusion Steering via Stochastic Optimal Control
summary: Deep generative models often produce structured outputs composed of interacting components. Modelling these outputs with a single model requires learning both the component distributions and their interactions. We pursue a modular alternative: reuse independently trained component generators and learn only how to coordinate them to produce coherent structured outputs. Our framework, Coordinated Multi-Agent Diffusion Steering (CMDS), treats frozen pretrained diffusion models as reusable generative primitives and coordinates their reverse processes through a learned control. We formulate coordination as a stochastic optimal control problem, balancing an assembly-level reward that specifies the desired properties of the combined output against deviations from the pretrained dynamics. The learned control amortises this optimisation, allowing reuse across new task instances. Experiments show that CMDS can recover a known target distribution, satisfy different spatial constraints with the same trained control, and recover individual sources from degraded mixtures. Across multi-agent maze navigation, articulated robot planning, and text-conditioned human motion, CMDS turns frozen models into coordinated multi-agent generators.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CMDS框架，将多个独立预训练的扩散模型视为可复用的生成原语，通过学习控制信号协调它们的反向过程，以产生具有交互组件的结构化输出。
AI.motivation: 深度生成模型在生成由交互组件构成的结构化输出时，单一模型需同时学习组件分布及其交互关系，难度大且复用性差。作者希望采用模块化替代方案：复用已独立训练的组件生成器，仅学习如何协调它们。
AI.method: CMDS将协调问题建模为随机最优控制问题：以冻结的预训练扩散模型作为生成原语，通过学习的控制信号干预其反向过程；目标函数在指定组合输出所需性质的"装配级奖励"与偏离预训练动力学之间取得平衡，学习到的控制策略对该优化进行摊销，从而可复用于新任务实例。
AI.result: 实验表明CMDS能恢复已知的目标分布，用同一训练好的控制满足不同的空间约束，并从退化的混合信号中恢复单个源；在多智能体迷宫导航、铰接式机器人规划以及文本条件人体运动任务中，CMDS将冻结模型转化为协调的多智能体生成器。
AI.conclusion: 通过协调冻结的预训练扩散模型，CMDS提供了一种模块化的结构化生成方案，具备良好的复用性与跨任务泛化能力。

title: A Swarm-Coordinated Multi-Robot System for Early Stress Detection in Agricultural Rows Using Multimodal Leaf Sensing
summary: Early stress detection in crops is a necessity today to improve efficiency and reduce waste of time, money, and effort. However, most modern techniques, such as hyperspectral imaging and AI-based systems, are too costly and complex for medium and small-scale farmers to implement. This paper showcases CropSentry, a low-cost, ground-based multi-robot system that uses multimodal leaf sensing to continuously monitor crop health by tracking stress levels. The system comprises two autonomous bots that continuously detect leaf color and environmental data row by row. The observations are spatially mapped and sent over to the master bot, which uses color-coded row segments to generate a real-time web-based dashboard displaying crop health. After 63 observations were collected during the experiments, the results showed an overall crop health classification accuracy of 84.12%, with 82.60% for healthy plants, 88% for nutrient-deficient plants, and 80% for diseased plants. Also, 100% wireless communication success rate across 10 slave observations was achieved. Close-range leaf inspection across multiple bots can detect early stress in crops while remaining affordable, accessible, and scalable. It provides farmers with timely information to improve resource utilization and crop management.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CropSentry，一种低成本地面多机器人系统，通过多模态叶片感知持续监测作物健康并追踪胁迫水平。
AI.motivation: 早期胁迫检测对提升效率、减少时间、资金和人力浪费十分必要，但高光谱成像和AI系统等现有技术成本高、复杂度大，中小规模农户难以应用。
AI.method: 系统由两个自主机器人组成，逐行检测叶片颜色与环境数据；观测结果经空间映射后发送至主机器人，主机器人利用颜色编码的行段生成实时网页仪表盘以显示作物健康状态。
AI.result: 共收集63次观测，作物健康分类总体准确率为84.12%，其中健康植株82.60%，营养缺乏植株88%，患病植株80%；10次从机器人观测实现100%无线通信成功率。
AI.conclusion: 多机器人近距离叶片检测可在可负担、可及且可扩展的前提下发现作物早期胁迫，为农户提供及时信息，改善资源利用与作物管理。

title: Feeling Through the Load: Compliant Quadruped Locomotion under Payload Interactions
summary: Quadruped robots are increasingly expected to carry objects while moving through human environments. But what happens when a person interacts directly with the payload rather than with the robot? If the payload is unrestrained, the robot must distinguish intentional external interactions from ordinary payload motion, while still keeping the load balanced and maintaining stable locomotion. How can a quadruped infer and compliantly respond to such interactions using only onboard measurements? In this work, we develop a force-aware locomotion framework that treats payload interactions as commands that shape the motion of the combined robot-payload system. Our approach separates the learning of force-aware locomotion and force estimation on an unrestrained payload. We combine a compliant load-carrying policy with a causal force estimator, trained through estimator-in-the-loop data aggregation and finetuning, to predict interactions from onboard robot measurements.
