Our simulations and real-world experiments show that the resulting controller can maintain stable payload-carrying locomotion, yield compliantly to external interactions, and use the inferred force to support human-guided changes in the robot's trajectory.

AI.tldr: 提出力感知运动框架，将通过无约束负载与机器人交互视为指令，分离学习顺应负载搬运策略与因果力估计器，使四足机器人仅凭机载测量即可推断并顺应人类交互。
AI.motivation: 四足机器人日益需要在人类环境中搬物，但人类往往直接与负载而非机器人交互。当负载未被固定时，机器人必须区分有意的外部交互与负载本身的常规运动，同时保持负载平衡与稳定的运动。如何仅依靠机载测量推断并顺应这种交互，是本文要解决的问题。
AI.method: 将负载交互建模为塑造“机器人-负载”组合系统运动的指令。方法上把力感知运动学习与无约束负载上的力估计相分离，将顺应式负载搬运策略与因果力估计器相结合；通过估计器在环的数据聚合与微调进行训练，从机载机器人测量中预测交互力。
AI.result: 仿真与真实世界实验表明，所得控制器可维持稳定的载物运动、顺应外部交互，并利用推断出的力支持由人类引导的机器人轨迹改变。
AI.conclusion: 通过解耦顺应运动策略与因果力估计，并采用估计器在环数据聚合与微调，四足机器人仅用机载感知即可在无约束负载下兼顾稳定性、顺应性与人引导的轨迹调整。

title: RIWANav: Recursive World-Action Models with Self-Improvement for Urban Navigation
summary: Long-horizon urban navigation requires sequential local decisions whose errors can compound over time. Imitation learning (IL) rarely learns from failures, while physical trial-and-error reinforcement learning (RL) is costly. Action-conditioned world models can provide imagined feedback by predicting visual consequences for candidate actions. However, a frozen world model may become less reliable as the policy evolves. In this paper, we introduce RIWANAV, a post-training framework that casts the coupled adaptation of a world model and an action model (policy) as task-specific recursive self-improvement (RSI). Each cycle alternates two updates. The world model evaluates policy actions through imagined outcomes, providing comparative feedback for group-relative policy optimization (GRPO). The improved policy then constructs a grounded self-curriculum, selecting expert-consistent action-video pairs by behavioral novelty and prediction error. The refined world model supplies feedback for the next policy update, closing the recursive self-improvement loop. Experiments show that RIWANAV outperforms training baselines and prior methods, validating the proposed recursive self-improvement loop between the policy and world model. Real-world trials further demonstrate its practical applicability.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 RIWANAV 后训练框架，将世界模型与动作模型（策略）的耦合适配建模为任务特定的递归自我改进（RSI）。每个循环交替进行两次更新：世界模型通过想象结果评估策略动作，为 GRPO 提供群组相对反馈；改进后的策略再构建自课程，筛选与专家一致的动作-视频对。实验表明该方法优于训练基线和已有方法，实机试验验证了实用性。
AI.motivation: 长时程城市导航需要序列化局部决策，误差会随时间累积。模仿学习（IL）很难从失败中学习，而真机试错式强化学习（RL）代价高昂。动作条件世界模型虽可对候选动作预测视觉后果以提供想象反馈，但冻结的世界模型会随策略演化而逐渐失准，因此需要世界模型与策略的协同适配机制。
AI.method: 提出 RIWANAV 后训练框架，将世界模型与动作模型的耦合适配形式化为任务特定的递归自我改进循环。每个循环交替两步：(1) 世界模型通过对策略动作的想象结果进行评估，为群组相对策略优化（GRPO）提供比较性反馈；(2) 改进后的策略构建有依据的自课程，按行为新颖性和预测误差筛选与专家一致的动作-视频对，用以精炼世界模型，从而为下一次策略更新提供反馈，闭合 RSI 循环。
AI.result: 实验表明 RIWANAV 优于训练基线和先前方法，验证了策略与世界模型之间递归自我改进循环的有效性；真实世界试验进一步证明了其实际适用性。
AI.conclusion: 世界模型与策略的递归协同自我改进可有效缓解长时程导航中的误差累积问题，并具备从仿真到真实场景的迁移能力。

title: HygieneRoboBench: Benchmarking Hygiene-Aware Planning for Household Robots
summary: Contact with contaminated objects can spread hazards through a household robot's grippers, tools, and shared surfaces, while new contacts can make an existing plan unsafe. Existing benchmarks do not jointly assess how planners identify hygiene risks from contact history and plan safe continuations after new contact events. Planners must do so within time and resource limits while respecting user priorities. We introduce HygieneRoboBench, with 624 instances across 134 task families, to evaluate safe resolution of household tasks from a given execution history. Tasks capture contamination through two grippers and shared objects, treatment costs, and user priorities. We combine controlled history, profile, and event comparisons with independent plan evaluation. These assess safe resolution, cost efficiency under user priorities, and responses to contact events. Evaluation of LLM-based and symbolic planners shows that safely completing a task does not guarantee the lowest execution costs under the user's priorities. To address this problem, we introduce Hygiene-NSP. It combines LLM-based grounding, contact-history reconstruction, and CP-SAT to jointly plan hygiene treatment and task execution under user priorities. Hygiene-NSP achieves safe resolution and optimal safe resolution rates of 94.4% and 90.4%, respectively. Both rates are higher than those of the evaluated baseline planners on the full dataset. Project page: https://euron-zc.github.io/HygieneRoboBench/.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 HygieneRoboBench 基准与 Hygiene-NSP 方法，用于评估并求解家庭机器人在接触污染历史下的安全任务规划问题。
AI.motivation: 家庭机器人通过夹爪、工具和共用表面接触污染物会传播危害，新接触事件可能使既有计划变得不安全。现有基准无法联合评估规划器如何从接触历史中识别卫生风险，以及在新接触事件后规划安全后续动作的能力。规划器还须在时间和资源限制内、并在尊重用户优先级的前提下完成上述任务。
AI.method: 构建 HygieneRoboBench，包含 134 个任务族、624 个实例，基于给定执行历史评估家庭任务的安全求解。任务涵盖双夹爪与共用物体的污染传播、处理成本及用户优先级；采用受控的历史/画像/事件对比结合独立计划评估。提出 Hygiene-NSP，融合 LLM 接地、接触历史重建与 CP-SAT，在用户优先级下联合规划卫生处理与任务执行。
AI.result: 对 LLM 类与符号规划器的评估表明，安全完成任务并不保证在用户优先级下具有最低执行成本。Hygiene-NSP 的安全求解率与最优安全求解率分别达 94.4% 和 90.4%，在全数据集上均高于所评估的基线规划器。
AI.conclusion: 安全性与成本最优性在用户优先级下可分离，联合建模卫生处理与任务执行能同时提升安全求解率与最优安全求解率，Hygiene-NSP 优于现有基线。

title: Fast Non-Parametric Heteroscedastic Imitation Learning With Geometric Priors
summary: When learning probabilistic policies from human demonstrations, data-efficient learning and fast adaptations to new scenarios are key requirements. One popular way to achieve intuitive and reliable adaptations is through non-parametric, typically kernel-based, methods. However, existing solutions either fail to account for the geometry of manifolds common in robotics, limiting data efficiency, or, when geometry-aware, provide unreliable uncertainty estimates or require retraining to adapt. We propose a non-parametric approach leveraging geometric priors in scenarios of data scarcity and heteroscedastic uncertainties for probabilistic modeling. We utilize the method to formulate policies based on time or robot state, where non-separable diagonal kernels allow capturing uncertainty relations between degrees of freedom for same-sized in- and outputs. Fast updates, requiring less than 3 ms for a trajectory involving both position and orientation are possible through an optimized formulation. Our approach supports both manifold-valued input and manifold-valued output with large orientation changes. Using task parameterization, adaptation to different object poses is easily possible. We evaluate the approach on a set of toy examples and on real robot manipulation tasks both in autonomous execution and in shared control scenarios.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于几何先验的非参数概率建模方法，用于从人类演示中学习概率策略，在数据稀缺和异方差不确定性下实现高效学习与快速自适应，更新耗时低于3 ms。
AI.motivation: 从人类演示中学习概率策略时，数据高效性与对新场景的快速自适应是关键需求。基于核的非参数方法虽能实现直观可靠的适应，但现有方案要么忽略机器人中常见的流形几何结构而限制数据效率，要么虽具几何感知能力却提供不可靠的不确定性估计或需要重新训练才能适应。
AI.method: 提出一种利用几何先验的非参数概率建模方法，适用于数据稀缺与异方差不确定性场景。基于时间或机器人状态构建策略，采用不可分离对角核捕捉同尺寸输入输出各自由度之间的不确定性关系；通过优化公式实现快速更新（含位置与姿态的轨迹更新低于3 ms）；支持流形值输入与输出，可应对较大姿态变化；并结合任务参数化以适应不同物体位姿。
AI.result: 在多个玩具示例及真实机器人操作任务上进行了评估，涵盖自主执行与共享控制场景，验证了方法在数据效率和快速自适应方面的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 该方法通过引入流形几何先验与非参数概率建模，在保持快速更新与可靠不确定性估计的同时，实现了对演示数据的样本高效学习与对新场景的快速适应，适用于真实机器人操作任务。

title: Magnet-Aware Control of Legged Robots
summary: Autonomous robots can increase uptime and reduce human exposure in Big Science facilities, but strong magnetic fields needed for their operation corrupt sensors and induce pose-dependent mechanical wrenches that destabilize robots and challenge conventional reactive controllers. This paper presents a control framework for modeling, estimating, and dynamically compensating for spatially varying magnetic wrenches acting on legged robots to improve robustness in these fields. We introduce a custom physics plugin for the MuJoCo simulator to model magnetic forces on rigid-body elements, alongside an inverse field-estimation framework to infer the latent magnetic field directly from quadruped dynamic responses and any number of sensor readings. Furthermore, we develop a Magnet-Aware Model Predictive Control (MPC) and Whole-Body Control (WBC) architecture that predicts and counteracts magnetic perturbations during locomotion to increase the range of magnetic fields in which the robot can operate. The effectiveness of the framework is validated through both simulation and physical hardware experiments. We show our method increases the the maximum rejectable disturbances from magnetic field in the force space by a factor of 2.5 and and between 1.6-2 times in torque space compared to a non-compensated system. Within the proposed magnetic field, this constitutes an increase in the area in which the robot can operate by 29,34% of which 10,84% would have previously caused an immediate collapse to non-compensated controllers.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一套面向腿足机器人的磁场感知控制框架，通过在MuJoCo中建模磁力、估计 latent 磁场，并采用磁感知MPC与WBC进行动态补偿，使机器人在强磁场下的抗扰能力提升约2.5倍（力空间）、1.6–2倍（力矩空间），可运行区域增加29.34%。
AI.motivation: 大科学装置中自主机器人可提升运行时间并减少人员暴露，但强磁场会干扰传感器并产生随位姿变化的机械扰动力/力矩，导致机器人失稳，常规反应式控制器难以应对。
AI.method: 1) 为MuJoCo开发自定义物理插件，对刚体单元上的磁力进行仿真建模；2) 提出逆磁场估计框架，从四足机器人动态响应及任意数量传感器读数中推断 latent 磁场；3) 构建磁感知模型预测控制（MPC）与全身控制（WBC）架构，在运动中预测并抵消磁扰动。
AI.result: 仿真与硬件实验验证：相比非补偿系统，最大可抑制磁扰动在力空间提升2.5倍，在力矩空间提升1.6–2倍；在给定磁场内可运行面积增加29.34%，其中10.84%的区域在非补偿控制下会立即崩溃。
AI.conclusion: 该框架可有效建模、估计并动态补偿空间变化的磁扰动力矩，显著扩展腿足机器人在强磁场环境中的可运行范围与鲁棒性。

title: NMPP: Nonlinear Model Predictive Planning for Agile UAV Flight in Cluttered Environments
summary: Flying a quadrotor through a cluttered environment requires not only planning a collision-free reference trajectory based on perceived obstacles, but the reference also needs to be dynamically feasible and within the actuation limits of the vehicle, so that the controller can track it precisely. Existing methods either optimize a smooth polynomial inside a convex corridor, which limits agility, or treat obstacles as soft costs traded against tracking performance. We propose a Nonlinear Model Predictive Planning (NMPP) that imposes perceived obstacles as hard geometric constraints and hands a full-state reference to an obstacle-blind SE(3) controller. Our planner achieves a 58-67 % lower position RMSE than a linear Model Predictive Control trajectory planner and a 41-70 % lower RMSE than a polynomial trajectory planner. It also completes all forest flights with up to 9.5 m/s speed without collisions, and achieves 86 % flight success rate under a more aggressive speed profile where a state-of-the-art planner has only 26 % success rate. The real-world deployment showed reliable execution flying up to 5.5 m/s in an unknown cluttered environment.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出非线性模型预测规划（NMPP），将感知到的障碍物作为硬几何约束，并向忽略障碍的SE(3)控制器下发全状态参考轨迹，从而实现高敏捷、无碰撞的四旋翼飞行。
AI.motivation: 在杂乱环境中飞行四旋翼时，参考轨迹不仅要基于感知障碍物实现无碰撞，还必须动态可行且满足执行器限制，以便控制器精确跟踪。现有方法存在不足：或在凸走廊内优化光滑多项式，限制了敏捷性；或将障碍物视为软代价，与跟踪性能相互权衡。
AI.method: 提出非线性模型预测规划（NMPP）：将感知到的障碍物作为硬几何约束，并把全状态参考轨迹交给一个忽略障碍的SE(3)控制器进行跟踪。
AI.result: 相比线性模型预测控制轨迹规划器，位置RMSE降低58–67%；相比多项式轨迹规划器，RMSE降低41–70%。在森林飞行中以最高9.5 m/s速度完成全部飞行且无碰撞；在更激进的速�度剖面下达到86%飞行成功率，而最先进的规划器仅为26%。真实世界部署中，在未知杂乱环境下以最高5.5 m/s可靠执行飞行。
AI.conclusion: NMPP通过硬几何约束与全状态参考结合忽略障碍的SE(3)控制器，在仿真与真实环境中均显著提升轨迹跟踪精度、飞行速度与成功率，验证了该方法的有效性与实际部署能力。

title: EgoLAP: Learning from Egocentric Human Data through Language-Action Reasoning
summary: Egocentric human data offer a path to scaling robot learning beyond costly robot demonstrations, yet the embodiment gap makes raw human trajectories a poor supervisory target for control. Our key insight is that, although low-level actions are embodiment-specific, their underlying motion intent can capture task-relevant structure that transfers across humans and robots. We introduce EgoLAP, a VLA pre-training framework that jointly learns from human and robot trajectories through a shared language-based action chain-of-thought. EgoLAP expresses motion intent as structured, temporally abstracted language actions and pairs them with motion-level reasoning grounded in scene geometry, physics, and object affordances. Across extensive real-world and simulated experiments, EgoLAP transfers human experience to robot control more effectively than alternative action representations and reaches 80.1% mean real-world task progress, a 2.3x performance gain over alternative action representations. Motion-level reasoning also outperforms a composite reasoning format that combines subtask, object-box, and visual-trace reasoning.

AI.tldr: 提出EgoLAP，一个VLA预训练框架，通过共享的、基于语言的行动思维链联合学习人类与机器人轨迹，将动作表示为结构化、时间抽象的语言意图并配以运动级推理，从而有效跨具身迁移人类经验。
AI.motivation: 人类第一视角数据可助力机器人学习规模化，但人类与机器人的具身差异（embodiment gap）使原始人类轨迹难以直接作为控制监督信号。作者的关键洞察是：尽管低层动作与具身相关，其背后的运动意图具有可跨人类与机器人迁移的任务相关结构。
AI.method: EgoLAP通过共享的、基于语言的行动思维链（action chain-of-thought）联合学习人类和机器人轨迹。它将运动意图表达为结构化、时间抽象的语言动作，并将其与基于场景几何、物理和物体可供性的运动级推理配对。对比对象包括其他动作表示，以及由子任务、物体框和视觉轨迹推理组合而成的复合推理格式。
AI.result: 在大量真实世界与仿真实验中，EgoLAP比替代动作表示更有效地将人类经验迁移至机器人控制，达到80.1%的平均真实任务进度，较替代动作表示提升2.3倍。运动级推理也优于子任务、物体框与视觉轨迹推理相结合的复合格式。
AI.conclusion: 以语言行动思维链承载运动意图、并以运动级推理作为监督目标，是弥合具身差异、实现人类数据向机器人控制迁移的有效路径。

title: Towards an Extensible Benchmark for Spoken Dialogue with Social Robots
comment: Accepted to and presented at the IROS 2026 Workshop on Human-Robot Dialogue
summary: Language models provide a plug-and-play interface between humans and robots, but important challenges remain when speech, dialogue, fast interaction, and collaboration are required. We propose a benchmark for the community to use as a way to explore common spoken dialogue artifacts between robots and humans, including requests for clarification, interruptions, embodied signals (e.g., head nods or facial cues), and time constraints. We also explain our vision to extend the benchmark for other aspects of human-robot interaction that are important to the larger research community. To facilitate the benchmark, we further propose using \textit{Retico}, a real-time communication framework that fulfills important technical requirements to enable robots to have spoken dialogue capabilities.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个面向人机口语对话的基准，用于研究澄清请求、打断、具身信号和时间约束等交互现象，并提出用实时通信框架 Retico 支撑该基准。
AI.motivation: 语言模型可作为人类与机器人之间的即插即用接口，但在需要语音、对话、快速交互与协作的场景下仍存在重要挑战。
AI.method: 提出一个社区可用的基准，用于探索机器人与人之间常见的口语对话现象，包括澄清请求、打断、具身信号（如点头或面部线索）和时间约束；并阐述将该基准扩展到更广泛人机交互方面的设想。为实现该基准，进一步提出采用 Retico 这一实时通信框架，以满足机器人具备口语对话能力所需的重要技术要求。
AI.result: 摘要未给出具体实验或量化结果，主要贡献为基准的提出、扩展愿景以及 Retico 框架的引入。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为社区提供了一个研究人机口语对话的基准与实时通信支撑方案，并计划将其扩展到更广泛的人机交互议题。

title: PhoneBot: A Low-Cost Open Humanoid Robot Platform Reusing Smartphones
summary: The adoption of humanoid robots in education and research remains limited by high hardware costs, complex sensing systems, and substantial computational requirements. This paper presents PhoneBot, a low-cost, open-source humanoid robot platform that repurposes commodity smartphones as its primary sensing and computing unit. By using a smartphone's integrated inertial measurement unit (IMU), camera, wireless connectivity, and onboard processing capabilities, PhoneBot reduces hardware costs and simplifies the system architecture. The robot combines a modular lower-body structure driven by 13 low-cost actuators with a torso-mounted smartphone that supports perception, control computation, and user interaction. We describe the mechanical design, software architecture, and real-time communication framework that support stable locomotion and capabilities including vision-based human following, conversational interaction, filming, and mobile telepresence. Experimental evaluations demonstrate reliable walking, perception-driven interaction, and straightforward deployment using off-the-shelf consumer smartphones. With fully open-source hardware and software designs, PhoneBot provides an affordable, reproducible platform for education, research, and rapid prototyping. More details are available at https://phonebot.dev.

AI.tldr: PhoneBot：以智能手机作为感知与计算核心的低成本开源人形机器人平台，降低硬件与系统复杂度。
AI.motivation: 人形机器人在教育与研究中受限于高硬件成本、复杂感知系统与高算力需求，难以普及。
AI.method: 利用商用智能手机的IMU、摄像头、无线通信与板载算力作为主感知与计算单元；模块化下半身由13个低成本执行器驱动，躯干搭载手机负责感知、控制计算与人机交互；并设计机械结构、软件架构与实时通信框架以支持稳定行走。
AI.result: 实验验证了可靠行走、感知驱动的交互，以及使用现成消费级智能手机的便捷部署；支持视觉人跟随、对话交互、拍摄与移动临场等功能。
AI.conclusion: PhoneBot以全开源软硬件提供低成本、可复现的平台，适用于教育、研究与快速原型开发。

title: LBA-CBF: Rapidly Adaptive Safety Filters via Parallel Dynamics Inference
summary: Control barrier functions (CBFs) certify commands through an assumed dynamics model, so an abrupt, unmeasured regime change can undermine the certificate exactly when safety matters most. We present Look-Back Adaptive Control Barrier Functions (LBA-CBF), which rank a finite bank of candidate dynamics by recent prediction error over a short look-back window and enforce the high-order CBF condition against every model within a tolerance of the best, spanning best-fit adaptation to full-bank robust filtering. The dynamics may depend nonlinearly on the unknown parameters, and no switching model or continuously parameterized estimator is required. We prove that any feasible filtered input satisfies the true CBF condition whenever a safety-representative candidate is retained. In quadrotor simulation with abrupt wind reversals and an unknown payload, LBA-CBF is safe and reaches the goal from all random initial conditions, matching an oracle, while adaptive and robust baselines achieve 0-88% success. Banks of up to 250,000 models run inside the control loop, and Crazyflie 2.1 and F1TENTH experiments demonstrate adaptation to wind, payload release, and varying tire-road friction. Code, videos, and project details are available at: https://lla-control.github.io

AI.tldr: 提出Look-Back Adaptive Control Barrier Functions (LBA-CBF)，通过在短回看窗口内按预测误差对候选动力学银行排序，并对所有接近最优模型的候选强制执行高阶CBF条件，实现在无切换模型或连续参数估计器下的安全自适应控制。
AI.motivation: CBF依赖假设的动力学模型来认证控制指令，当发生突发的、不可测量的工况变化时，证书会在安全最关键的時刻失效。因此需要一种能在模型突变下仍保证安全性的方法。
AI.method: LBA-CBF维护一个有限候选动力学银行，依据短回看窗口内的近期预测误差对候选模型排序，并对所有在最优模型容差范围内的模型强制执行高阶CBF条件，从而在最佳拟合自适应与全银行鲁棒滤波之间连续插值。动力学可非线性依赖未知参数，且无需切换模型或连续参数化估计器。理论上证明：只要保留了一个具安全代表性的候选模型，任何可行滤波输入都满足真实CBF条件。
AI.result: 在四旋翼仿真中（突发风向反转与未知负载），LBA-CBF在所有随机初始条件下均安全并到达目标，性能匹配oracle；而自适应与鲁棒基线成功率仅0–88%。控制回路内可运行多达250,000个模型的银行。Crazyflie 2.1与F1TENTH实验验证了对风、负载释放及变化的轮胎-路面摩擦的自适应能力。
AI.conclusion: LBA-CBF在突发工况变化下提供了可靠的安全保证与强自适应能力，兼具理论保障与实机可行性，代码与项目详见 https://lla-control.github.io。

title: PEARS: Physical-Prior-Guided Efficient Adaptation via Failure Reasoning and Diffusion Steering for Tactile Manipulation
summary: Pretrained robotic policies can suffer substantial performance degradation under out-of-distribution (OOD) conditions encountered during deployment, motivating post-training through real-world interaction. However, reinforcement-learning (RL)-based post-training typically requires substantial environment interactions, a burden that is especially significant in manipulation, where each trial can be slow, costly, or destructive. Therefore, we present PEARS, a physics-prior-guided hybrid RL framework for sample-efficient online adaptation of pretrained policies with tactile feedback. After each episode, its physics-guided force reasoning (PFR) module uses physical priors encoded in a vision-language model (VLM) to diagnose failures from the visual outcome and tactile interaction history and update task-appropriate contact-force bounds. A high-frequency hybrid force-position controller then enforces these bounds during contact. Complementarily, tactile-conditioned diffusion steering reinforcement learning adjusts the latent noise of the frozen flow-matching policy to correct errors in free-space motion and contact timing without updating the base model. In simulation, PEARS improves success rates by 12.4-37.4 percentage points over the strongest per-task baselines. PEARS also reduces the number of interaction episodes required for a certain success threshold by up to 53.2% relative to the fastest baseline. In real-world experiments, PEARS achieves success rates of 95% on Whiteboard Erasing and 90% on Pipette Liquid Aspiration. These results show that combining the PFR module with policy steering can accelerate adaptation while reducing costly interactions. The project website is available at https://song-kun.github.io/pears.

AI.tldr: 提出PEARS，一种物理先验引导的混合强化学习框架，用于带触觉反馈的预训练策略在线自适应，实现样本高效的后训练。
AI.motivation: 预训练机器人策略在部署时遇到分布外（OOD）条件会出现显著性能退化，而基于强化学习的后训练通常需要大量环境交互，在操作任务中每次试验缓慢、昂贵甚至具有破坏性，因此亟需样本高效的自适应方法。
AI.method: PEARS包含两个互补模块：（1）物理引导力推理（PFR）模块，在每个回合后利用视觉语言模型中的物理先验，从视觉结果和触觉交互历史中诊断失败，并更新任务适配的接触力边界，由高频混合力-位置控制器在接触时强制执行；（2）触觉条件扩散引导强化学习，通过调整冻结流匹配策略的潜在噪声，在不更新基础模型的前提下纠正自由空间运动与接触时机误差。
AI.result: 仿真中，PEARS相比最强的逐任务基线将成功率提升12.4–37.4个百分点，并将达到特定成功率阈值所需交互回合数相对最快基线减少最多53.2%。真实实验中，在白板擦除任务成功率达95%，移液管吸液任务达90%。
AI.conclusion: 将物理引导力推理模块与策略引导相结合，可加速自适应过程并减少昂贵的交互次数，验证了物理先验与触觉反馈在预训练策略在线后训练中的有效性。

title: QF3: Fast Flow RL with Filtered Q-Gradients
summary: Flow policies have become a standard policy class for learning robot behaviors from demonstrations, but reinforcement learning is still critical for improving pre-trained flow policies or learning them from scratch through interaction. We introduce QF3 (Fast Flow RL with Filtered Q-Gradients), an online off-policy RL algorithm that trains a flow policy with flow matching plus the critic's action gradient, backpropagated through a one-step prediction of the flow's output. To keep updates where the critic and this prediction are reliable, QF3 applies the critic gradient only to action dimensions that stay near the replay action. To our knowledge, QF3 is the first off-policy flow RL method to train humanoid locomotion policies from scratch and transfer them zero-shot to hardware. Paired with a high-throughput off-policy training recipe, it trains humanoid locomotion and motion-tracking policies with a 10x wall-clock speedup over FPO++, a recent on-policy flow RL method. We further apply QF3 to fine-tune pretrained flow-based manipulation policies on both ABC-Sim and Robomimic tasks. These results suggest that QF3 can both learn robot policies from scratch and refine those acquired from demonstrations. Website: https://qf3-rl.github.io/

AI.tldr: QF3 是一种在线离策略强化学习算法，通过流匹配结合经过滤的评论家动作梯度来训练流策略，实现从零训练人形机器人运动策略并零样本迁移到硬件，同时具备 10 倍训练加速。
AI.motivation: 流策略已成为从演示中学习机器人行为的标准策略类别，但强化学习对于改进预训练流策略或通过交互从零学习仍然至关重要。现有流强化学习方法（如 FPO++）多为在线策略方法，训练效率较低，难以支持人形机器人从零训练与真机迁移。
AI.method: QF3 提出在线离策略流强化学习算法，将流匹配损失与评论家的动作梯度结合，梯度通过流输出的一步预测进行反向传播；仅在动作维度上应用评论家梯度，且限定在靠近回放动作的范围内，以保证评论家与一步预测的可靠性。方法配合高吞吐量的离策略训练方案。
AI.result: QF3 是首个能够从零训练人形机器人运动策略并零样本迁移到硬件的离策略流强化学习方法；相比近期的在线策略流强化学习方法 FPO++，在训练人形运动与动作跟踪策略时实现了约 10 倍的墙钟时间加速。此外，QF3 还成功用于在 ABC-Sim 与 Robomimic 任务上微调预训练的基于流的操作策略。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明 QF3 既能从零学习机器人策略，也能改进从演示中获得的策略，兼具高效性与通用性。

title: Sim-to-Real Transfer of Vision-Language Navigation in Continuous Environments Using an Ackermann-Steered Mobile Robot
summary: Vision-Language Navigation (VLN) enables robots to navigate through environments using natural language instructions, making human-robot interaction intuitive. Traditional VLN models often rely on navigation graphs, 360-degree views, and perfect localization which pose significant challenges when adapting these models to real-world settings. This work addresses these limitations by performing a simulation-to-real domain shift of a VLN approach that operates in continuous environments without requiring navigation graphs or panoramic views. The proposed system integrates vision-language models that align visual inputs and linguistic instructions within a shared embedding space, facilitating natural language-driven navigation. We employ a Cross-Modal Attention (CMA) based architecture trained on an existing dataset in a simulated environment and fine-tune it using real-world data collected from a custom-built Ackermann-steered robot equipped with a camera and a LiDAR sensor. By utilising linear photometric adjustments and fine-tuning on a limited number of episodes, our model successfully adapts to real-world environments, achieving effective navigation while running offline on dedicated hardware. Experimental results, evaluated using Success weighted by Path Length (SPL) and Normalized Dynamic Time Warping (nDTW) metrics, demonstrate the robustness and adaptability of our approach. Keywords: Vision-Language Navigation, Cross-Modal Attention, Natural Language Instructions, Sim-to-Real Transfer, Autonomous Navigation, Ackermann-steering.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种无需导航图与全景视图的连续环境视觉语言导航（VLN）方法，通过跨模态注意力架构在仿真数据上训练，并利用线性光度调整与少量真实数据微调，实现Ackermann转向机器人上的仿真到现实迁移，在SPL和nDTW指标上取得有效导航表现。
AI.motivation: 传统VLN模型依赖导航图、360度全景视图和完美定位，难以适配真实世界场景，存在显著的仿真到现实部署障碍。
AI.method: 采用跨模态注意力（CMA）架构，将视觉输入与语言指令对齐到共享嵌入空间；在现有仿真数据集上训练，并用自研Ackermann转向机器人（配备相机和LiDAR）采集的真实数据进行微调，结合线性光度调整和少量episode微调，模型可离线运行于专用硬件。
AI.result: 实验采用SPL（Success weighted by Path Length）和nDTW（Normalized Dynamic Time Warping）指标评估，结果表明该方法具有鲁棒性和适应性，能成功适应真实环境并实现有效导航。
AI.conclusion: 通过仿真到现实的域迁移与少量真实数据微调，可在不依赖导航图、全景视图和完美定位的条件下实现有效的自然语言驱动机器人导航，具备实际部署潜力。

title: Preserving Unstable Modes Through Inverse Dynamics in JEPA World Models
summary: Robotic systems often exhibit unstable modes, along which small perturbations and disturbances can cause unbounded growth unless corrected through feedback. Controlling such systems from high-dimensional visual observations requires representations that preserve these modes. Joint-embedding predictive architectures (JEPAs) provide a natural framework for learning such representations and their dynamics from visual data. However, we demonstrate that next step prediction combined with anti-collapse regularization does not guarantee that controllable unstable modes are preserved: the training loss can be minimized while these modes are collapsed, making stabilization from the learned representation impossible. To address this, we augment world-model training with an action reconstruction objective (i.e., an inverse dynamics loss) that encourages control-aware representations, namely, visual representations that preserve crucial features for control. We prove that exact action reconstruction makes the encoder injective on the finite-horizon reachable subspace. Thus, the encoder cannot discard any state direction reachable by an action sequence within $H$ steps. Moreover, we show that, as $H$ grows, the dominant eigenspace of the finite-horizon controllability Gramian converges to the controllable unstable subspace. We establish our theoretical results for linear systems and demonstrate empirically that our findings extend to nonlinear visual control tasks (CartPole, Walker2D, and PointMaze), highlighting the benefits of control-aware representation learning.

AI.tldr: 该论文指出JEPA式世界模型的下一帧预测与反坍缩正则无法保证保留可控不稳定模态，提出加入动作重建（逆动力学）损失以学习控制感知表征，并给出理论证明与视觉控制任务实验验证。
AI.motivation: 机器人系统常存在不稳定模态，微小扰动会无界增长，需反馈控制。从高维视觉观测控制这类系统，要求表征保留这些不稳定模态；而现有JEPA类世界模型训练目标可能在不稳定模态被坍缩的情况下仍然达到最小损失，导致无法从学到的表征中实现稳定化。
AI.method: 在世界模型训练中引入动作重建目标（逆动力学损失），促使表征保留对控制关键的特征。理论上针对线性系统证明：精确动作重建使编码器在有限时域可达子空间上为单射，故不会丢弃H步内可由动作序列到达的状态方向；并证明随时域H增大，有限时域可控性Gramian的主特征空间收敛到可控不稳定子空间。在CartPole、Walker2D、PointMaze等非线性视觉控制任务上做实证验证。
AI.result: 证明了精确动作重建使编码器在有限时域可达子空间上单射，保证不丢弃H步内可达的状态方向；有限时域可控性Gramian主特征空间随H增大收敛至可控不稳定子空间。实验显示该理论结论可推广到非线性视觉控制任务（CartPole、Walker2D、PointMaze），验证了控制感知表征学习的收益。
AI.conclusion: 仅靠下一步预测与反坍缩正则不足以保证保留可控不稳定模态；加入逆动力学（动作重建）损失可学习控制感知表征，在理论上保证可达子空间不被坍缩，并在视觉控制任务上取得更好效果。

title: Revisiting Temporal Regularization for Smooth Control in Deep Reinforcement Learning
summary: Deep Reinforcement Learning policies can produce nonsmooth action oscillations that hinder deployment on physical robots. Existing architectural and penalty-based approaches seek spatial smoothness by directly reducing sensitivity to changes in state inputs, but their broad constraints can degrade task performance as stronger smoothing is pursued. Temporal regularization instead constrains action differences along observed transitions, but has been considered unable to provide the spatial smoothness needed under observation noise. We revisit this assumption by proving that the temporal penalty bounds the expected action differences between current states sharing a next state, revealing a spatial effect that empirically extends to spatial smoothness. Building on this finding, we propose Conditioning for Action using only Temporal Smoothness (CATS), which combines a temporal penalty with linear ramp-up. We highlight temporal regularization's ability to provide spatial smoothness while better preserving task performance than explicit spatial regularization. Through linear ramp-up, CATS allows the policy to learn rewarding behavior before progressively smoothing its actions, improving return preservation and both temporal and spatial smoothness. Experiments in both simulation and the real world show that CATS substantially reduces action oscillation without degrading task performance, with little computational overhead.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CATS方法，结合时间平滑惩罚与线性渐增权重，证明时间惩罚能界定下一状态相同的当前状态间的动作差异，从而带来空间平滑效果，在仿真与真实机器人上显著减少动作振荡且不损失任务性能。
AI.motivation: 深度强化学习策略会产生不平滑的动作振荡，阻碍其在物理机器人上的部署。现有的架构和惩罚类方法通过直接降低对状态输入变化的敏感性来追求空间平滑，但约束过强时会损害任务性能；时间正则化仅约束观测转移上的动作差异，通常被认为无法在观测噪声下提供所需的空间平滑性。
AI.method: 作者重新审视上述假设，证明时间惩罚可以界定具有相同下一状态的当前状态之间的期望动作差异，揭示出一种可经验性扩展到空间平滑的空间效应。基于此提出CATS（Conditioning for Action using only Temporal Smoothness），将时间惩罚与线性渐增（linear ramp-up）结合，使策略先学习有回报的行为，再逐步平滑其动作。
AI.result: 在仿真和真实世界实验中，CATS显著减少了动作振荡，同时不降低任务性能，且计算开销很小。相比显式空间正则化，时间正则化在提供空间平滑的同时更好地保持了任务性能，线性渐增进一步改善了回报保持以及时间与空间平滑性。
AI.conclusion: 时间正则化能够提供空间平滑性并优于显式空间正则化，CATS通过线性渐增在平滑动作与保持回报之间取得良好平衡，为物理机器人部署提供了低开销且有效的解决方案。

title: VeriFine: Scaling Verification for Self-Improvement in Embodied Reasoning
summary: Self-improving policies continually expose new failure patterns, changing what their judges must be able to verify. However, current fixed judges constrain both optimization feedback and the discovery of useful training examples, limiting further self-improvement. This challenge is even more acute in embodied reasoning, where reliable evaluation must account for spatial grounding, causal reasoning, and safety-aware decision-making. We introduce VeriFine, an agent harness framework that scales verification through the co-evolution of the policy, training curriculum, and judge. The Policy Improvement Loop uses a rubric judge to diagnose recurring failures, construct an adaptive curriculum, and optimize the policy. When progress plateaus and verification becomes a bottleneck, the Judge Improvement Loop selectively queries human guidance on informative failure cases and refines the judge through coactive calibration, in which humans and agents resolve disagreements and converge toward the objective rubric of physical reasoning. The revised judge then guides the next stage of data selection and policy optimization. Experiments on driving and robot navigation tasks demonstrate continuous self-improvement in both policy and judge capability across reinforcement and supervised fine-tuning. These results show how scaling verification supports continuous self-improvement as policy failure patterns evolve.

AI.tldr: VeriFine是一个智能体框架，通过策略、训练课程与评判器的协同进化来扩展验证能力，实现具身推理任务中策略与评判器的持续自我提升。
AI.motivation: 自我改进的策略不断暴露新的失败模式，从而改变评判器必须验证的内容。然而，当前固定不变的评判器同时限制了优化反馈和有用训练样本的发现，阻碍了进一步的自我改进。这一问题在具身推理中更为突出，因为可靠评估必须兼顾空间定位、因果推理与安全感知决策。
AI.method: 提出VeriFine框架，包含两个循环：策略改进循环（Policy Improvement Loop）使用评分标准评判器诊断反复出现的失败、构建自适应课程并优化策略；当进展停滞、验证成为瓶颈时，评判器改进循环（Judge Improvement Loop）有选择地就高信息量的失败案例查询人类指导，并通过协同主动校准（coactive calibration）改进评判器，使人类与智能体消解分歧、趋近物理推理的客观评分标准，随后由修订后的评判器指导下一阶段的数据选择与策略优化。
AI.result: 在驾驶与机器人导航任务上的实验表明，在强化学习和监督微调下，策略与评判器能力均实现持续自我改进。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，扩展验证能力能够支持策略失败模式不断演化过程中的持续自我改进。

title: Zero-Shot Visualization: Exploring Text Corpora with User-Prompted Axes
summary: We study the application of large language models (LLMs) to the visual exploration of textual corpora. We introduce zero-shot visualization (ZSV), a task in which users specify concepts in natural language and documents are mapped onto the corresponding concept axes for visualization. Building a ZSV system of practical value is non-trivial, as it requires choices at the intersection of feature functions, efficient implementation tradeoffs, and pre/post-processing decisions affecting visualization quality. To that end, we establish a benchmark that compares methods spanning embedding similarity, direct semantic judgments, and conditional likelihood estimation in this setting. Across multiple datasets and use cases we evaluate the properties of different scoring methods and design choices in terms of semantic faithfulness, score fidelity, and computational cost. Our results identify that scoring based on next-token probabilities offers the strongest practical trade-off among the evaluated methods. We further apply this approach to unlabeled corpora to examine its behavior in realistic exploratory settings. These experiments highlight additional design considerations, including the use of graded axes together with binary relevance filtering, and reveal a compositional sentiment bias in off-topic documents. Based on these findings, we provide practical guidelines for constructing end-to-end ZSV baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"零样本可视化（ZSV）"任务：用户用自然语言指定概念，文档被映射到对应概念轴上以实现文本语料的视觉探索。作者构建基准，比较嵌入相似度、直接语义判断与条件似然估计三类打分方法，发现基于下一词概率的打分在语义忠实度、分数保真度与计算成本间取得最佳权衡，并给出端到端ZSV基线的实践指南。
AI.motivation: 现有文本语料可视化通常依赖预定义或人工标注维度，难以用自然语言灵活指定概念。将LLM用于ZSV虽具潜力，但系统构建涉及特征函数选择、高效实现权衡及影响可视化质量的前后处理决策，缺乏系统性的评测与设计指导。
AI.method: 构建ZSV基准，对三类打分方法（嵌入相似度、直接语义判断、条件似然估计）在多个数据集与用例上进行对比，从语义忠实度、分数保真度和计算成本三方面评估方法与设计选择；并将最优方法应用于无标注语料以考察真实探索场景中的行为。
AI.result: 基于下一词概率（next-token probabilities）的打分方法在所评估方法中提供最强的实用权衡。无标注语料实验进一步揭示：应结合分级轴（graded axes）与二元相关性过滤；同时发现离题文档中存在组合式情感偏差（compositional sentiment bias）。
AI.conclusion: 研究为构建端到端ZSV基线提供了实践指南，明确了打分方法选择、分级轴与二元过滤结合等关键设计考量，并提示需注意离题文档的情感偏差问题。

title: Capacity, Responsiveness and Alignment: What Makes a Latent Structure Actionable
summary: Localizing latent structures in the activation space of language models (LMs) is central to understanding and controlling their behavior. Yet, localized structures can differ substantially in their causal influence, raising the question of what makes a structure actionable. We tackle this question by casting causal influence as a product of three factors and showing empirically that they act as interpretable, distinct constraints: capacity, measuring the sensitivity of the model's output to movement along the structure, responsiveness, capturing how promotable the concept is given the current context, and alignment, reflecting how well the structure aligns with the context-specific representation of the concept. Across 4 LM families and 50 concepts, we observe that causal effectiveness requires all factors to be high; low capacity and responsiveness reduce it by 84% and 95%, respectively, while low alignment can reverse it, suppressing concept expression. Moreover, we find that causality is context-dependent rather than an intrinsic property of the structure, with causally effective directions forming a low-dimensional subspace that varies across contexts. By restricting the training of linear probes to this subspace, we introduce causal probes that achieve 17%-118% improvement in steering across models, with only 3% reduction in concept detection.

AI.tldr: 本文提出因果影响力可分解为能力（capacity）、响应性（responsiveness）与对齐度（alignment）三因素之积，实证表明三者均为可解释的独立约束，且因果性是上下文依赖的而非结构内在属性；据此提出因果探针（causal probes），在提升调控效果的同时保持检测性能。
AI.motivation: 定位语言模型激活空间中的潜在结构对理解与控制模型行为至关重要，但不同局部结构的因果影响力差异显著。作者旨在回答"什么样的结构具有可操作性"这一核心问题，即揭示决定因果影响力的因素及其性质。
AI.method: 将因果影响力建模为三个因素的乘积：能力（输出对沿该结构移动的敏感度）、响应性（在给定上下文中概念可被激发的程度）、对齐度（结构与上下文特定概念表征的一致程度）。在4个LM家族、50个概念上进行实证验证，并观察到因果有效方向构成随上下文变化的低维子空间，进而将线性探针的训练限制在该子空间内，提出因果探针。
AI.result: 因果有效性需三因素均高：低能力与低响应性分别使因果有效性下降84%和95%，低对齐度则可反转效果、抑制概念表达。因果性呈上下文依赖，有效方向形成跨上下文变化的低维子空间。因果探针在跨模型调控上取得17%–118%的提升，概念检测仅下降3%。
AI.conclusion: 因果影响力并非结构的内在属性，而是能力、响应性、对齐度三因素在特定上下文下的乘积结果，三者构成可解释且彼此独立的约束。将探针训练约束于上下文相关的低维因果子空间，可在保持检测精度的同时显著增强调控能力，为理解与控制LM行为提供了新的分析框架与工具。

title: Tree Navigation Without LLM Summaries: A Matched-Cost Study of Hierarchical Retrieval for Long-Document QA
summary: Retrieval-augmented generation grounds language models in external context, but for long documents flat top-$k$ retrieval can cluster on a single region and miss complementary evidence. RAPTOR-style summary trees address this by recursively clustering chunks and using a language model to summarize each cluster at indexing time, then ranking summary nodes alongside raw chunks at query time. We show the main benefit of summary trees in long-document QA can come from navigation rather than the generated summary content. We introduce NavTree, a leaves-only retriever that builds a deterministic balanced segment tree over chunks (zero language-model calls at indexing) and uses the tree purely as a navigation scaffold: a hybrid lexical-and-dense frontier walk, anchored on top retrieved leaves, descends from the root and emits only leaf chunks to the reader. On a matched-cost evaluation against flat retrievers and an extractive re-implementation of RAPTOR, NavTree is the strongest matched-cost hierarchical retriever in our evaluated grid and ties the strongest flat baseline. On long-document multi-hop QA, it is the only hierarchical method that significantly beats BM25 on a class-vs-class basis, corroborated by a reader-free retrieval-recall check. A matched-reader replication of the published abstractive RAPTOR variant, given strong cluster summaries, still loses to NavTree at every multi-chunk budget, at zero indexing cost. The ranking carries across stronger and open-weight readers, a stronger encoder, and a full factorial that isolates leaves-only emission as the structural lever.

AI.tldr: NavTree 是一种仅检索叶节点的层次化检索器，用确定性平衡段树作为导航骨架（索引阶段零语言模型调用），在长文档问答中与最强扁平基线持平，并显著优于 BM25 及 RAPTOR 式摘要树方法。
AI.motivation: 长文档检索中，扁平 top-k 检索易聚集于单一区域而遗漏互补证据；RAPTOR 式摘要树虽通过递归聚类与语言模型摘要缓解该问题，但其收益来源（摘要内容 vs. 树结构导航）尚不明确，且索引成本高。本文旨在验证摘要树的主要收益来自"导航"而非"生成摘要内容"。
AI.method: 提出 NavTree：在 chunk 上构建确定性平衡段树，索引阶段不做任何语言模型调用；仅在查询时把树用作导航脚手架，采用词法与稠密混合的前沿游走（frontier walk），以 top 检索到的叶子为锚点自根节点向下搜索，最终仅向读者输出叶子 chunk（leaves-only emission）。
AI.result: 在匹配成本评估中，NavTree 是所评估网格内最强的匹配成本层次化检索器，并与最强扁平基线持平；在长文档多跳问答中，是唯一在类对类基础上显著超过 BM25 的层次化方法，并经无读者检索召回检验佐证。匹配读者条件下复现的抽象式 RAPTOR 变体（即使给定强聚类摘要）在多 chunk 预算下均不敌 NavTree，且 NavTree 索引成本为零。该排序在更强与开放权重读者、更强编码器及全因子实验中稳健成立。
AI.conclusion: 摘要树在长文档问答中的主要收益源于树结构的导航能力，而非语言模型生成的摘要内容；仅叶节点输出的结构设计是带来优势的关键杠杆。

title: Component and Dimension Sparsity in Transformer Refusal Mechanisms
summary: Activation steering manipulates large language model behavior by intervening on internal activations, but the mechanistic basis of these interventions remains poorly understood. We decompose refusal steering into component-level interventions across four open-weight models, identifying the sparse subsets of attention and MLP components whose steering suffices to reproduce the full behavioral effect. We find that refusal directions concentrate in sparse component mechanisms comprising 28--48\% of upstream components, retaining 88--101\% of steering effectiveness. Within these mechanisms, effective steering further concentrates in approximately 50\% of residual stream dimensions, retaining 85--98\% of the component-mechanism baseline, consistent with a privileged basis structure. Sparsity thus operates at two levels: which components are steered, and which dimensions within those components carry the signal. Together these findings show that refusal is not diffusely encoded across a transformer but assembled by a structured, identifiable mechanism, providing a foundation for mechanistic understanding of how refusal behaviors are represented and steered. To facilitate reproducibility, we release all code and raw experimental results in https://github.com/wang-research-lab/Refusal_Mechanisms.

AI.tldr: 该论文将拒绝行为的激活引导分解为组件级干预，发现拒绝方向集中于稀疏的注意力与MLP组件及其部分残差维度，呈现两级稀疏结构。
AI.motivation: 激活引导能操控大模型行为，但其机制基础尚不清晰，缺乏对干预在组件与维度层面如何发挥作用的解释。作者希望揭示拒绝行为在transformer中是否弥散编码，还是由结构化、可识别的机制组装而成。
AI.method: 在四个开放权重模型上，将拒绝引导分解为组件级干预，识别足以复现完整行为效果的稀疏注意力与MLP子集；并在这些组件内进一步定位承载引导信号的残差流维度。
AI.result: 拒绝方向集中于占上游组件28--48%的稀疏机制，保留88--101%的引导效果；在这些机制内，有效引导进一步集中于约50%的残差流维度，保留85--98%的组件机制基线效果，符合特权基结构。
AI.conclusion: 拒绝并非弥散编码于transformer中，而是由结构化、可识别的机制组装；稀疏性体现在两个层面——被引导的组件以及组件内承载信号的维度。这为理解拒绝行为的表征与引导提供了机制基础，并公开代码与原始实验结果以促进可复现性。

title: Stabilizing language models under continual learning via condition-anchored distillation
summary: Continual adaptation of language models can change their output distribution on prompts learned earlier, while retaining every old prompt-answer pair may be undesirable or impossible. We study condition-anchored generative distillation (CAGD): retain a small set of old prompts, use a frozen previous model to reconstruct completions and generation states, and match its predictive distributions while learning the next task. The formulation separates three roles that ordinary replay conflates: conditions select the behavior to protect, teacher generations locate relevant states, and soft targets specify how predictions may change. For autoregressive language generation, teacher-rollout distillation admits an exact chain-rule decomposition of sequence divergence. For masked-diffusion language modeling, our implementation directly controls local denoising drift on teacher-generated completions. In continual adaptation of a 219M masked diffusion language model, CAGD reduces four-task final held-out loss from 2.927 to 1.114 in one task order and from 2.168 to 0.891 in exact reverse. The same soft targets lower final average loss by 0.055 over hard replay when teacher-generated support is held identical. The direction persists on fresh facts and natural instructions across SMDM and Qwen3. On GSM8K, Qwen adaptation preserves answer-format compliance, but exact-match retention is seed-mixed at 0.6B and worsens at 1.7B. These results support condition-anchored functional preservation as a common design principle across the tested language-generation objectives.

AI.tldr: 本文研究"条件锚定生成式蒸馏"（CAGD）：仅保留少量旧提示词，用冻结的旧模型重建生成状态与软分布，并在学习新任务时匹配其预测分布，以在持续适配中实现功能性保留。
AI.motivation: 语言模型的持续适配会改变其在早期提示词上的输出分布，而保留全部旧提示-答案对既不可取也不可行。已有回放（replay）方法混淆了"条件选择行为、教师生成定位状态、软目标规定预测可变化程度"三种角色，需要更清晰的解耦框架。
AI.method: 提出条件锚定生成式蒸馏（CAGD）：1) 保留一小批旧提示作为条件，确定要保护的行为；2) 用冻结的上一模型生成补全，定位相关生成状态；3) 匹配教师的预测分布作为软目标。对自回归生成，教师 rollout 蒸馏给出序列散度的精确链式法则分解；对掩码扩散语言模型，实现直接控制教师生成补全上的局部去噪漂移。在 219M 掩码扩散模型上进行四任务持续适配，并按正向与完全逆序两种任务顺序评估。
AI.result: 四任务最终留出损失从 2.927 降至 1.114（一种顺序），逆序从 2.168 降至 0.891。在教师生成支撑集完全一致时，软目标相比硬回放使最终平均损失再降低 0.055。该方向在新事实与自然指令上、跨 SMDM 与 Qwen3 均一致。GSM8K 上 Qwen 适配保持了答案格式合规，但精确匹配保留在 0.6B 时随随机种子波动，在 1.7B 时变差。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，条件锚定的功能性保留可作为所测试各类语言生成目标的通用设计原则，但其收益在推理密集型任务（如 GSM8K 精确匹配）上并不稳定。

title: EMODE: Dynamic Para-Semantic Experts for Emotion-Aware Speech Language Modeling
summary: Large speech language models have demonstrated strong capabilities in unified cross-modal understanding and generation, yet paralinguistic cues, especially emotion, remain difficult to preserve. Existing systems typically rely on entangled acoustic representations, which allow the underlying language model to depend excessively on recovered lexical content instead of grounding its behavior in acoustic-prosodic evidence. We address this limitation with EMODE, an emotion-aware speech language model built around \textbf{Dynamic Para-Semantic Experts (DPSE)}. DPSE decomposes continuous speech features into semantic and paralinguistic pathways, routes them dynamically, and fuses them before integration into the language model. To turn this structural decomposition into functional specialization, EMODE is trained with a three-stage curriculum consisting of semantic warm-up, paralinguistic activation, and joint refinement, guided by Orthogonal Expert Guidance (OEG), Semantic-to-Acoustic Alignment (SAA), and Gating Diversity Regularization (GDR). Experiments on SER test, empathetic response evaluation, and the newly constructed bilingual MEPA benchmark show that EMODE improves the balance between lexical fidelity and emotional sensitivity, strengthens affect-grounded response generation, and exposes the value of explicit para-semantic factorization for robust cross-corpus emotion understanding.

AI.tldr: 提出EMODE情感感知语音语言模型，通过动态副语义专家（DPSE）将语音特征分解为语义与副语言两条路径并动态路由融合，配合三阶段课程训练与三项正则化约束，在情感识别、共情回复及双语MEPA基准上提升了词法保真与情感敏感度的平衡。
AI.motivation: 现有统一跨模态语音语言模型难以保留副语言线索（尤其是情感），因其依赖纠缠的声学表示，导致语言模型过度依赖恢复出的词法内容，而非以声学-韵律证据为依据进行建模。
AI.method: EMODE以Dynamic Para-Semantic Experts（DPSE）为核心：将连续语音特征解耦为语义路径与副语言路径，进行动态路由并在融入语言模型前融合。训练采用三阶段课程：语义预热、副语言激活、联合精调，并分别由正交专家引导（OEG）、语义到声学对齐（SAA）与门控多样性正则（GDR）指导。
AI.result: 在SER测试、共情回复评估以及新构建的双语MEPA基准上，EMODE改善了词法保真与情感敏感度之间的平衡，增强了以情感为依据的回复生成能力，并验证了显式副语义因子分解对鲁棒跨语料情感理解的价值。
AI.conclusion: 显式地将语音中的语义与副语言信息因子分解，并结合动态专家路由与课程式训练，是提升语音语言模型情感理解与共情生成的有效途径。

title: Verdicts Without Annotated Evidence: Rejection Sampling or Label-Only Post-Training for Evidence Recovery?
summary: In many review workflows the verdict is the only thing retained. The passages behind it are not marked, because that annotation costs far more than recording the decision. We measure how much of that evidence a small language model can recover when it is post-trained on the verdicts alone, with no human evidence labels at any stage. On ContractNLI the human evidence spans are held out until evaluation. Matching the recorded verdict and agreeing with those spans are not the same thing: across six systems the two scores are only weakly related and rank the systems differently, so accuracy is a poor guide when the citations have to be reviewable. Label-only training on the bare verdict reaches accuracy 0.896 and span F1 0.564. Rejection sampling, which keeps a generated trace only when its verdict matches the record and then picks one by an automatic source-grounding score, reaches 0.797 and 0.556, against 0.747 and 0.493 before training. Verbatim citation rises from 0.597 to 0.729 under label-only training and to 0.701 under rejection sampling. One seed on one corpus cannot say which method is better, but both improve the evidence without anyone annotating it.

AI.tldr: 本文研究在仅使用判决标签（无人工证据标注）对小型语言模型进行后训练时，其在推理时能恢复多少支撑判决的证据文本；并提出用自动源依据评分筛选推理链的拒绝采样方法，以在不需人工标注的情况下提升证据质量。
AI.motivation: 在许多审阅工作流中，仅保留最终判决，判决背后的证据段落因标注成本过高而未被标注，导致证据不可追溯、判决难以复核；作者因此探究：仅凭判决标签后训练的小模型能否恢复这些被省略的证据。
AI.method: 以 ContractNLI 为测试语料，人工证据片段在评估前完全留出。对小型语言模型进行仅标签训练（仅用判决、无任何人工证据标注）。引入拒绝采样：保留判决与记录一致的生成推理链，再用自动源依据评分从中选出一条。评估指标包括准确率、证据片段 F1 与逐字引用率。
AI.result: 匹配判决与匹配证据片段并非同一件事：六个系统的两项得分仅弱相关，且排序不同，说明在需要可复核引用时准确率是糟糕的指导。仅标签训练达到准确率 0.896、片段 F1 0.564；拒绝采样为 0.797 与 0.556（训练前为 0.747 与 0.493）。逐字引用率在仅标签训练下从 0.597 升至 0.729，在拒绝采样下升至 0.701。
AI.conclusion: 单一语料上的单次随机种子无法判定哪种方法更优，但两种方法都能在无人标注证据的情况下改善证据质量，表明判决级监督也能部分恢复可复核的支撑证据。

title: WavePrune: One period is often enough for RoPE
summary: Rotary Position Embedding (RoPE) encodes token positions by rotating each two-dimensional channel of the query and key vectors at a channel-specific frequency, making the attention logits invariant to a common shift of positions. However, this rotation is periodic, and it leads to position aliasing where relative positions separated by a full rotation period become hard to tell apart. To address this, we propose WavePrune, which restricts each channel to its first rotation period. We show that it removes the distractions in attention maps created by position aliasing and improves overall long-context performance. Specifically, WavePrune raises the HELMET score on four of five models we test without any extra tuning (e.g., 35.7 -> 40.0 on Qwen3-8B). When pretraining models from scratch, WavePrune also achieves lower validation loss at extrapolated lengths than pretraining without it. Because WavePrune restricts each channel to a sliding window, it induces a fine-grained sparsity that our hardware-aligned CUDA kernels exploit for 1.15x prefill and 1.24x decoding speedups over FlashAttention-2 at 32K context. Together, these results show that RoPE's periodic structure, widely regarded as essential, is largely redundant beyond the first rotation period.

AI.tldr: WavePrune通过将RoPE每个通道限制在首个旋转周期内，消除位置混叠，提升长上下文性能与推理速度。
AI.motivation: RoPE通过以通道特定频率旋转query和key向量的二维通道来编码位置，使注意力logits对位置的共同平移保持不变。但这种旋转是周期性的，会产生位置混叠：相距一个完整旋转周期的相对位置难以区分。作者希望消除这种混叠带来的注意力图干扰。
AI.method: 提出WavePrune，将每个通道限制在其首个旋转周期内。由于该限制使通道形成一个滑动窗口，从而产生细粒度稀疏性，作者据此设计了与硬件对齐的CUDA kernel加以利用。
AI.result: 在测试的五个模型中的四个上无需额外调优即提升HELMET分数（如Qwen3-8B从35.7提升至40.0）；从头预训练时在外推长度上获得更低验证损失；在32K上下文下相比FlashAttention-2实现1.15倍prefill和1.24倍decoding加速。
AI.conclusion: RoPE的周期性结构被广泛认为必不可少，但结果表明其在首个旋转周期之外很大程度上是冗余的。

title: Calibrated Answers About Randomized Trials From a 4-Billion-Parameter Open Model: A Registered Test and a License-Clean Release
comment: 20 pages, 2 figures, 13 tables. Code, results files and the paper's sources: https://github.com/johann-e-li/fiorillo. Model: https://doi.org/10.57967/hf/10722. Registration: https://osf.io/kaxmn/
summary: Fiorillo v0.5 is an open model that answers typed questions with a probability for each answer. Its main specialist reads a randomized trial's article, cut to 6,144 tokens, and answers whether an intervention significantly increased, significantly decreased or did not significantly change an outcome against a comparator (Evidence Inference 2.0, EI). It is Qwen3-4B-Base with low-rank adapters and a decision head, fine-tuned for EI only on the 1,431 of 2,657 training articles whose own license allows reuse. Four criteria registered on the Open Science Framework before this version's test predictions decided its release, the second bar judged on EI's test split, whose labels are public. On that split (1,218 prompts in 333 articles), the expected calibration error was 0.0168 against a limit of 0.05; log loss was below the prior's by 0.8603 (95 percent interval 0.8104 to 0.9078) and below that of Gemma 4 31B-it, reading the same input, by 0.1829 (0.1164 to 0.2598); and macro-F1 was 0.9248 against 0.8668, so all four criteria passed. Training the same recipe on clean articles alone cost 0.0123 in accuracy (0.0034 to 0.0207; descriptive). With no article, macro-F1 fell to 0.4384; the title alone raised it by 0.0939 (0.0655 to 0.1234), which a title stating the result or recall of the trial could explain; exchanging intervention and comparator reversed 0.6652 of its direction answers. Run as released, the files matched the evaluated predictions within limits set in advance. The release is under the Apache License 2.0 (digital object identifier 10.57967/hf/10722).

AI.tldr: Fiorillo v0.5 是一个开放模型，针对循证推断（EI）任务判断干预相对对照的效应方向，在 EI 测试集上四项预设标准全部通过，已按 Apache 2.0 许可发布。
AI.motivation: 面向随机对照试验文献的自动化证据提取需求，提供一个可开放复现、可核查的模型，并以预先注册的标准约束其发布，避免事后挑选指标。
AI.method: 以 Qwen3-4B-Base 为底座，加入低秩适配器与决策头，输入文章截断至 6,144 tokens，输出三分类（显著增加/显著减少/无显著变化）及其概率。仅在 2,657 篇训练文章中许可允许复用的 1,431 篇上微调；四项标准在预测前注册于 Open Science Framework，第二项标准在标签公开的 EI 测试集上评判。
AI.result: EI 测试集（333 篇文章、1,218 条提示）：期望校准误差 0.0168（限值 0.05）；对数损失比先验低 0.8603（95% 区间 0.8104–0.9078），比同输入的 Gemma 4 31B-it 低 0.1829（0.1164–0.2598）；宏平均 F1 为 0.9248（对照 0.8668），四项标准全部通过。消融：仅用干净文章训练损失 0.0123 准确率（0.0034–0.0207，描述性）；无文章时宏 F1 降至 0.4384，仅给标题提升 0.0939（0.0655–0.1234）；互换干预与对照导致 0.6652 的方向答案反转。按发布版本运行，输出文件与受评预测在预先设定的界限内一致。
AI.conclusion: 模型在预先注册的四项标准上均达标，开放权重以 Apache 2.0 发布（DOI 10.57967/hf/10722），并为输入成分与方向敏感性提供了消融证据。

title: Investigating Model Compression for Neural Machine Translation in the Biomedical Domain
summary: Large-scale pretrained transformer models have achieved state-of-the-art performance across diverse machine translation tasks, including multilingual settings. Knowledge distillation has emerged as a sustainable approach for model compression, transferring knowledge from large teacher models to smaller, more efficient student models. Similarly, quantization, which reduces the numerical precision of model weights and activations (e.g., from 32-bit to 8-bit representations) is widely used to accelerate inference, enabling models to run several times faster during deployment. However, both techniques face limitations when applied to specialized domain data, particularly under low-resource conditions. In knowledge distillation, the effectiveness of transfer is often constrained by the scarcity of domain-specific parallel data, while quantization can lead to performance degradation as bit precision decreases. In this work, we investigate the combined application of knowledge distillation and quantization for French-to-English biomedical translation, a domain characterized by specialized terminology and limited parallel resources. We develop and compare multiple fine-tuning strategies to adapt compressed student models to this challenging setting. Our experiments demonstrate that a collaboratively distilled and quantized student model achieves a 69% reduction in size, a 98.21% increase in inference speed, and a 98.46% reduction in CO2 emissions compared to the original baseline all without sacrificing translation quality. These results indicate that jointly optimized compression techniques can yield efficient, high-performance models suitable for translation service providers operating under resource constraints.

AI.tldr: 本文联合使用知识蒸馏与量化压缩法英生物医学翻译模型，学生模型体积缩减69%、推理速度提升98.21%、CO2排放降低98.46%，且翻译质量无损。
AI.motivation: 大模型翻译性能优异但部署成本高。知识蒸馏与量化虽为可持续压缩手段，但在专业领域、低资源条件下受限：蒸馏受领域平行语料稀缺制约，量化随位宽降低导致性能退化。作者希望探索二者联合应用于术语专业、平行资源稀缺的法英生物医学翻译场景。
AI.method: 面向法英生物医学翻译，联合应用知识蒸馏与量化，开发并比较多种微调策略，将压缩后的学生模型适配到该领域；即以协同蒸馏与量化的方式构建学生模型，并与原始基线进行对比评估（体积、推理速度、CO2排放、翻译质量）。
AI.result: 协同蒸馏并量化的学生模型相比原始基线：模型体积减少69%，推理速度提升98.21%，CO2排放减少98.46%，且翻译质量未出现下降。
AI.conclusion: 联合优化的压缩技术可产出高效且高性能的模型，适用于资源受限条件下的翻译服务提供商，为低资源专业领域模型的可持续部署提供了可行路径。

title: Turnslide: Scalable Multi-Turn Data Synthesis by Walking a Finite-State Machine
comment: Accepted at the SLM-Agents Workshop, NeurIPS 2026 (non-archival)
summary: Small language models are inexpensive to serve and can run on private infrastructure, but base models are often not good enough at multi-turn tool calling, and fine-tuning them needs per-API data that rarely exists. Existing synthesis methods are too expensive for high-scale fine-tuning, as they often require mock operational environments for different domains and multiple LLM calls per generated conversation turn. We introduce a fully automated, lightweight synthesis framework that models each API as a finite-state machine, representing the system as abstract states that determine when each tool may be called, producing state-valid sequences of tools; sequences are translated into complete examples with a single LLM call. Rather than optimize diversity, we set a target distribution over the number of turns, the tool sequence and task complexity. We measure data quality by fine-tuning SLMs on generated trajectories, showing that our FSM-based generation significantly improves downstream accuracy over an unmutated baseline and, against existing works, reaches 70.7% full accuracy over 63.4% and 53.7% with 3.6-6.6$\times$ fewer tokens.

AI.tldr: 提出一种轻量级全自动数据合成框架，将每个API建模为有限状态机（FSM），用一条LLM调用把状态合法的工具序列转成完整训练样本，并按目标分布控制轮数、工具序列与任务复杂度，从而低成本地微调小语言模型的多轮工具调用能力。
AI.motivation: 小语言模型（SLM）部署便宜且可本地运行，但基座模型在多轮工具调用上表现不足；微调又依赖按API划分、现实中稀缺的数据。现有合成方法成本过高：需要为不同领域搭建模拟运行环境，且每个对话轮次都要多次调用LLM，难以支撑大规模微调。
AI.method: 将每个API建模为有限状态机，用抽象状态表示“何时允许调用哪个工具”，据此生成状态合法的工具序列；再用单次LLM调用将序列翻译为完整示例。不追求多样性优化，而是设定轮数、工具序列与任务复杂度的目标分布。通过在下游任务上微调SLM来评估数据质量。
AI.result: 基于FSM的生成相比未变异（unmutated）基线显著提升下游准确率；与现有工作相比，完整准确率达70.7%，高于63.4%和53.7%，且token消耗减少3.6–6.6倍。
AI.conclusion: 以FSM抽象替代模拟环境和多轮LLM调用，可在极低token成本下生成高状态合法性的多轮工具调用数据，有效提升SLM的工具调用准确率，是一种面向高规模微调的高效合成范式。

title: JudgeMoE: Distributional Aggregation for LLM-as-a-Judge
summary: When an LLM judge scores an output, its score distribution retains uncertainty and disagreement information that is lost after scalar compression. We introduce JudgeMoE, a lightweight aggregator that assigns example-specific weights to cached judge score distributions and fuses them before computing a final score. A protocol study shows that score-range choice is unstable across judge--dataset settings and that soft scoring usually outperforms hard decoding. On the original 10-cell benchmark, JudgeMoE improves mean Spearman over uniform log pooling by $+0.079$. Applying the same configuration to six additional cells yields a $+0.0393$ mean gain over the strongest local single judge across 16 cells, with positive differences in 12/16 cells and a one-sided Wilcoxon signed-rank $p=0.0091$. Validation-based analyses further show that the preferred aggregation method depends on the task and judge pool.

AI.tldr: 提出JudgeMoE——一种轻量级聚合器，对缓存的多评审LLM评分分布赋予样本特定权重并融合后再计算最终分数，在多个基准格上稳定提升排序相关性。
AI.motivation: LLM评审打分经标量压缩后，会丢失评分分布中的不确定性与分歧信息；且评分区间选择在不同评审-数据集设置下不稳定，需要更稳健的聚合方式。
AI.method: JudgeMoE：对缓存的各评审评分分布进行样本级加权融合，聚合后再得出最终分数；同时开展协议研究，比较评分区间选择与软/硬解码的影响。
AI.result: 原始10格基准上，较均匀对数池化平均Spearman提升+0.079；同一配置扩展至6个额外格，在16格上相对最强单一局部评审平均增益+0.0393，12/16格为正，单侧Wilcoxon符号秩检验p=0.0091。
AI.conclusion: 保留并样本自适应地融合评分分布优于标量压缩；但最优聚合方法依赖任务与评审池，需按验证集选择。

title: CroissantMiner: Automated Extraction and Validation of Croissant Metadata for ML Datasets
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026 (Track on Evaluations and Datasets). Website: https://berkearda.github.io/croissantminer/
summary: Croissant has emerged as a standard for machine-readable dataset metadata, yet populating its fields remains labor-intensive and requires careful reading of accompanying dataset documentation. We present the first benchmark enabling end-to-end evaluation of metadata extraction aligned with a community-standard schema. The benchmark comprises 602 papers, including 102 with human-validated gold annotations and 500 with LLM-generated silver annotations, covering the full Croissant schema with both core and Responsible AI (RAI) fields. Using this benchmark, we evaluate a range of extraction systems spanning frontier models, open-weight models, and agentic architectures, under a two-tier evaluation framework that combines rule-based scoring with an LLM judge selected via human audit. We find that single-pass extraction consistently outperforms the four agentic architectures we evaluate: across backbones, these decomposed variants achieve lower accuracy than a single full-context pass. The largest gap appears on long-form RAI fields, which require synthesizing and interpreting information scattered across a paper rather than copying it from a single location, a setting where current systems remain far from reliable. We release the benchmark, evaluation code, judge audit, a live demo, and a leaderboard open to new systems.

AI.tldr: 首个面向 Croissant 社区标准 schema 的端到端数据集元数据抽取基准，含 602 篇论文（102 篇人工金标、500 篇 LLM 银标），覆盖核心与 RAI 字段；采用规则打分+人工审计选定的 LLM 评判的双层评估。结果显示单次全上下文抽取一致优于四种智能体架构，长文本 RAI 字段差距最大，仍是难点。
AI.motivation: Croissant 已成为机器可读数据集元数据的事实标准，但其字段填充仍高度依赖人工、耗时且需仔细阅读数据集文档，且此前缺乏与社区标准 schema 对齐的端到端评估基准。
AI.method: 构建包含 602 篇论文的基准（102 篇人工验证金标 + 500 篇 LLM 生成银标），覆盖完整 Croissant schema 的核心字段与 Responsible AI 字段；在双层评估框架下（规则打分 + 经人工审计选定的 LLM 评判）评测多类抽取系统，包括前沿模型、开放权重模型及四种智能体架构。
AI.result: 单次全上下文抽取在各骨干模型上均稳定优于四种智能体（分解式）架构；差距在长文本 RAI 字段上最大，此类字段需跨论文综合与解读分散信息，而非单点复制，现有系统可靠性仍远不足。
AI.conclusion: 该工作提出并开源了首个 Croissant 元数据抽取基准及评估代码、评判审计、在线演示与排行榜，表明分解式智能体架构未必带来收益，长文本 RAI 字段抽取是未来关键改进方向。

title: Identifying Introspection From the Inside
comment: Published at COLM 2026. Project page: https://iii.baulab.info
summary: Large language models make claims about themselves that are both consequential and increasingly difficult to verify from behavior alone. How can we distinguish plausible confabulations from genuine introspection? In this paper, we identify mechanistic signatures of faithful self-report in a controlled setting. Using low-rank adapters, we train models to make decisions on behalf of fictitious characters, according to latent linear preference functions. We find sustained fine-tuning on an implicit decision task can lead to the emergence of accurate self-reporting of models' learned preferences, even without explicit self-report supervision. We ask two research questions about this emergent phenomenon. First: is the emergence of accurate self-reporting accompanied by a measurable structural change in the model? Weight ablations and frozen-layer experiments together indicate that preference representations shift to earlier layers over training, consistent with the hypothesis that faithful self-report requires preferences to be located where pre-existing verbalization mechanisms can access them. Second: can these structural differences distinguish faithful models from unfaithful ones? Using attribution patching, we find that faithful models exhibit significantly higher attribution similarity between the decision-making and self-report tasks -- a mechanistic signature of faithful self-report that does not require us to understand the content of the report itself. Previous work on self-report has observed behaviorally that models can be faithful or unfaithful; our work proposes that, at least in our restricted setting, it is possible to distinguish between the two patterns of computation by examining the structure of the networks themselves.

AI.tldr: 本文在受控设定下研究大模型自我报告的忠实性，发现真实自我报告伴随偏好表征向网络浅层迁移，且忠实与不忠实模型可通过归因相似度这一机制特征加以区分。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型对自身所做的陈述具有重要影响，但仅凭行为难以验证其真伪，因此需要区分看似合理的虚构（confabulation）与真正的内省（introspection），并从机制层面寻找忠实自我报告的判定依据。
AI.method: 使用低秩适配器（LoRA）训练模型，使其依据隐式线性偏好函数为虚构角色做决策；随后通过权重消融、冻结层实验考察偏好表征所在层的变化，并使用归因修补（attribution patching）比较决策任务与自我报告任务之间的归因相似度。
AI.result: 在隐式决策任务上持续微调可无需显式自我报告监督即涌现出对所学偏好的准确自我报告；训练过程中偏好表征向更早的层迁移；忠实模型在决策与自我报告任务间的归因相似度显著更高，可作为忠实自我报告的机制特征。
AI.conclusion: 在本文的受限设定下，忠实与不忠实的自我报告对应着不同的计算结构，可以通过网络自身的结构（而非报告内容）加以区分，为自我报告研究提供了机制层面的判据。

title: TIDE 2.0: an open, model-agnostic engine for keyed de-identification of clinical notes
summary: Clinical notes capture most of what is documented about a patient's care, but they cannot be used for research until protected health information (PHI) is removed. De-identification is often treated as a detection problem. Detection alone is not sufficient: redaction strips clinical content along with identifiers, date blanking destroys the temporal intervals needed for longitudinal analysis, and assigning a fresh random surrogate at each occurrence breaks links between a patient's notes. We present TIDE 2.0, an MIT-licensed engine with two separable stages: an interchangeable recognizer and a keyed anonymizer. Both run on hardware the institution owns. Surrogates are generated cryptographically with no stored linkage table. Dates shift by a per-patient, interval-preserving offset; each value receives the same surrogate across all occurrences under a given key; and a release produced under a new key cannot be linked to earlier releases. We also release TIDE2-Sentry, a recognizer distilled from a large language model. On two gold-annotated corpora from two institutions, the default configuration reached span-level recall of 0.88 in-domain and 0.77 on the second institution's corpus, at precision 0.88 and 0.87. We report recall and precision per category alongside these aggregates. The engine is open source, and the recognizer is available under a gated research-use agreement, so institutions can run, inspect and extend both within their own environments.

AI.tldr: TIDE 2.0 是一个可在本地部署的开源去标识化引擎，将识别与加密匿名化分离，采用密钥化、无链接表的替代值生成与保留时间间隔的日期偏移，并发布基于大模型蒸馏的识别器 TIDE2-Sentry，在两个机构语料上取得较高召回与精确率。
AI.motivation: 临床文本是患者诊疗记录的主要载体，但含受保护健康信息（PHI）而无法直接用于研究。现有做法把去标识化当作纯检测问题，仅做检测并不充分：遮盖会连同临床内容一并删除，日期置空破坏了纵向分析所需的时间间隔，而为每次出现分配新的随机替代值会切断同一患者不同记录之间的关联。
AI.method: 提出 TIDE 2.0，MIT 许可，包含两个可分离阶段：可替换的识别器与带密钥的匿名化器，均运行在机构自有硬件上。替代值以密码学方式生成且不存储链接表；日期按患者施加保留时间间隔的偏移；在同一密钥下，同一取值在所有出现处获得相同替代值；换用新密钥生成的发布版本与先前版本不可关联。同时发布 TIDE2-Sentry 识别器，由大语言模型蒸馏得到。
AI.result: 在两个机构提供的两份金标注语料上，默认配置在域内达到 span 级召回 0.88，在第二家机构语料上为 0.77，对应精确率分别为 0.88 和 0.87；并进一步报告了各实体类别的召回与精确率。
AI.conclusion: 该引擎开源，识别器以受限研究用途协议提供，使机构能够在自身环境中运行、审查并扩展两者；在保证隐私的同时兼顾临床内容保留、纵向时间结构与跨记录关联。

title: Kurate: Scalable Scientific Quality Analysis
summary: Scientific search systems can find papers that are relevant to a question, but they generally do not assess the quality of the evidence that those papers provide. We present Kurate, a system that uses large language models (LLMs) to assess the quality of published studies. Kurate uses both the paper and its related documents (e.g., the study's trial registration and protocol), and links each of its judgments to the passage of text on which that judgment is based. We applied Kurate to a corpus of 4,347 papers (3,913 of which report randomized trials) and scored each paper on 8 dimensions of study design and reporting: specifically, statistical power, causal identification, preregistration, selective reporting, measurement validity, analysis prespecification, reporting transparency, and conflict of interest and funding. Across the corpus, we found that papers most often exhibited issues with statistical power, selective reporting, and analysis prespecification, although average quality differed between clinical areas. When compared against expert annotations of 60 held-out clinical-trial documents, the information Kurate extracted matched the expert label in 221/242 protocol scorepoints and 294/370 results-publication scorepoints, with AC1 0.94 and 0.81, respectively. Using a well-reputed, high quality clinical trial as a worked example, we show how a single paper's overall grade breaks down into separate judgments, with each linked to specific evidence from the trial's registration, protocol, and published report. Together, these results show that large-scale quality assessment of this kind is feasible, and that it can be used to address meta-scientific research questions.

AI.tldr: Kurate 是一个利用大语言模型对已发表研究进行证据质量评估的系统，结合论文及其相关文档并给出可溯源文本证据，在4347篇论文上按8个维度打分，与专家标注吻合度较高，证明大规模质量评估可行。
AI.motivation: 现有科学检索系统只能找到与问题相关的论文，却一般无法评估这些论文所提供证据的质量，因此需要一个可大规模、可溯源的研究质量评估系统。
AI.method: Kurate 使用大语言模型，同时利用论文本身及其相关文档（如试验注册信息和研究方案），并将每一项判断链接到其所依据的文本段落；作者将该系统应用于包含4347篇论文（其中3913篇报告随机试验）的语料库，按8个研究设计与报告维度打分：统计功效、因果识别、预注册、选择性报告、测量效度、分析预设定、报告透明度、利益冲突与资金。
AI.result: 语料库中最常见的问题集中在统计功效、选择性报告和分析预设定，但不同临床领域的平均质量存在差异；在与60份留出临床试验文档的专家标注对比中，Kurate 提取的信息在方案评分点上匹配221/242，在结果发表评分点上匹配294/370，AC1分别为0.94和0.81；以一个高质量临床试验为示例，展示了单篇论文的总评如何拆解为可溯源的细化判断。
AI.conclusion: 这些结果表明，此类大规模质量评估是可行的，并且可用于回答元科学研究问题。

title: Who Wrote It Is Not Enough: Detecting Who Contributed the Insight
summary: As LLMs increasingly assist scientific writing and peer review, detecting who wrote the text is no longer sufficient: we need to determine who contributed the underlying insight. We introduce Insight Provenance, the task of identifying whether a review insight originates from a human, an LLM, or their hybrid contribution. We construct InsightProv-v0 from 4,057 scientific papers and 12,660 human reviews, simulating different levels of LLM involvement with GPT-4o, Gemini, and DeepSeek and annotating provenance at the sentence level. We show that strong performance on raw data can be misleading, as models exploit linguistic and textual-authorship shortcuts that degrade substantially under progressively debiased evaluation. We therefore propose a two-stage adversarial framework that suppresses shortcut signals while preserving provenance-relevant information. Beyond detection, extensive analyses reveal what makes intellectual authorship identifiable: paper grounding and neighboring review context provide complementary provenance signals, while human, hybrid, and AI insights systematically differ in their information sources and failure modes. Most strikingly, AI insights predominantly remain close to generic or paper-provided information, whereas human insights more often introduce external knowledge and independent judgment. These findings suggest that while wording can be rewritten by an LLM, the provenance of an idea leaves a deeper and more persistent signal.

AI.tldr: 提出"洞察溯源"任务，判定评审洞察来自人类、LLM还是混合贡献，构建InsightProv-v0数据集并提出两阶段对抗框架。
AI.motivation: LLM日益参与科学写作与同行评审，仅判定"谁写了文本"已不足够，需要判定"谁贡献了背后的洞察"，即思想来源的归属问题。
AI.method: 基于4,057篇科学论文与12,660条人类评审构建InsightProv-v0，用GPT-4o、Gemini、DeepSeek模拟不同LLM参与程度，进行句子级溯源标注；发现原始数据上的强性能可能源于语言与文本作者身份捷径，故提出两阶段对抗框架，在抑制捷径信号的同时保留溯源相关信息。
AI.result: 原始数据上的高性能会随评估去偏而显著退化，说明模型依赖捷径；去偏评估后，论文依据与邻近评审上下文提供互补的溯源信号；人类、混合与AI洞察在信息来源与失败模式上系统不同，AI洞察多贴近通用或论文已有信息，人类洞察更常引入外部知识与独立判断。
AI.conclusion: 措辞可被LLM改写，但思想的来源留下更深、更持久的信号；洞察溯源是可行且重要的新任务。

title: AccentCL: Robust Accent Classification with Incremental Expansion
comment: Published in Proceedings of IEEE Spoken Language Technology Workshop (SLT) 2026
summary: Accent classifiers are typically trained with a fixed label inventory and cannot accommodate new accent categories as new data becomes available. Moreover, accented speech corpora often exhibit substantial class imbalance and/or domain shift due to differences in recording conditions across corpora. We present AccentCL, a class-incremental learning framework for English accent classification that is robust to class imbalance and cross-corpus domain shift. AccentCL extracts multi-layer representations from a frozen Whisper-Large-v3 encoder, optimized with an imbalance-aware cross-entropy loss to reduce bias toward the majority accent classes and a domain mean alignment loss that minimizes distributional mean shift across training corpora. The label space is then expanded via replay-based continual learning, using the frozen base model for knowledge retention and an old-to-new margin loss to reduce overprediction on newly added classes. On a five-class accent classification task, AccentCL achieves 77.1% balanced accuracy and a 76.9% macro-averaged F1 score. We further evaluate the model's ability to incrementally incorporate two new accent categories: Spanish-accented and Chinese-accented English. When adding Spanish-accented English to the pretrained model, AccentCL attains an F1 of 83.3% on the new class while retaining 77.3% balanced accuracy on the base classes. When subsequently adding Chinese-accented English, it achieves 61.8% F1 on the new class while preserving 77.6% balanced accuracy on the previously learned classes. These results show that AccentCL enables robust regional accent classification while allowing new accent categories to be added without full retraining.

AI.tldr: AccentCL 是一个面向英语口音分类的类增量学习框架，通过冻结 Whisper-Large-v3 编码器提取多层表示，结合不平衡感知损失与域均值对齐损失，并用回放式持续学习扩展标签空间，在五类口音任务上达到 77.1% 平衡准确率与 76.9% 宏平均 F1，并能增量加入西班牙口音与中文口音英语类别而无需全量重训。
AI.motivation: 现有口音分类器通常基于固定标签集合训练，无法在新数据出现时纳入新的口音类别；同时口音语音语料常存在严重类别不平衡，且因各语料录制条件差异而带来跨语料域偏移问题。因此需要一种对类别不平衡与跨语料域偏移均具鲁棒性、且支持类别增量扩展的口音分类方法。
AI.method: AccentCL 从冻结的 Whisper-Large-v3 编码器中提取多层表示，采用不平衡感知交叉熵损失以降低对多数口音类别的偏置，并引入域均值对齐损失以减小各训练语料间的分布均值偏移。随后通过基于回放的持续学习扩展标签空间，利用冻结基座模型保持知识，并使用旧到新边界损失（old-to-new margin loss）抑制对新加入类别的过度预测。
AI.result: 在五类口音分类任务上，AccentCL 取得 77.1% 平衡准确率与 76.9% 宏平均 F1。增量加入西班牙口音英语时，新类 F1 为 83.3%，基类平衡准确率保持 77.3%；继续加入中文口音英语时，新类 F1 为 61.8%，已学类别平衡准确率保持 77.6%。
AI.conclusion: AccentCL 在保持对口音类别不平衡与跨语料域偏移鲁棒的同时，实现了无需全量重训即可增量添加新口音类别的区域口音分类能力。

title: Closing Ambient Clinical Documentation Gaps with Automated Provider Queries
summary: Provider queries are clarifying requests sent by clinical documentation specialists to physicians to close gaps in the clinical note and ensure accurate billing. Prior work automates note drafting, ICD-10 coding, and order extraction assuming a complete transcript, leaving these gaps unaddressed. We study whether an LLM can automate the query loop, termed DAU (Draft, Ask, Update), across those three tasks. An audit of 3,000 real visits identifies the sources of missing documentation, from which we build five transcript-degradation benchmarks on public data. Analyzing 21k clarification turns on real conversations, we find useful-question predictors are task-specific: oracle confidence dominates, but note completeness needs only simple recall questions while ICD-10 coding needs harder, multi-option ones. About 9% of turns hurt performance, driven by redundant questions and non-answers that still trigger a rewrite. Deployment depends on learning "when not" as much as "what to" ask.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出DAU（Draft-Ask-Update）流程，探索LLM能否在临床笔记三个任务中自动化"提供者查询"回路，并揭示提问策略具有任务特异性。
AI.motivation: 临床文档专家需向医生发送澄清查询以弥补临床笔记的信息缺口并保证计费准确。已有工作假设转录完整，自动化了笔记草拟、ICD-10编码和医嘱抽取，但未处理这些缺口，因此需要研究LLM能否自动完成查询回路。
AI.method: 审计3,000次真实就诊，识别缺失文档来源；基于此在公开数据上构建五个转录退化基准；对真实对话中的2.1万个澄清轮次进行分析，考察有用问题的预测因素。
AI.result: 有用问题的预测因素具有任务特异性：oracle置信度占主导，但笔记完整性只需简单回忆型问题，而ICD-10编码需要更难的多选项问题。约9%的轮次损害性能，原因是冗余问题和仍触发重写的非回答。
AI.conclusion: 部署DAU流程的关键不仅在于学会"该问什么"，同样在于学会"何时不该问"。

title: Not What a Child Expressed: Auditing the Sign-to-Text Safety Interface in Child-Facing AI
comment: 5 pages, 1 figure. Accepted as a poster at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Child Safety in AI (non-archival)
summary: Automatic sign language translation (SLT) has entered consumer products, turning American Sign Language into English text for dictation, messaging, and queries put to a conversational assistant. Child-facing AI and platform trust-and-safety tooling decide on text, using filters on minor accounts and grooming classifiers that score chat messages. A signing child who uses SLT therefore reaches these safeguards through a translation. We found no publicly documented system in which the two have been jointly evaluated, and the leading deployed SLT model was neither trained nor formally evaluated on signers under 18. Errors that alter negation, participant roles, secrecy, urgency or help-seeking could change a safety decision without disturbing fluency. This paper proposes a Deaf-informed pre-deployment audit of that boundary, with a failure taxonomy, a sanitised scenario schema, four comparison conditions, and four outcome measures. Auslan is the planned first case study.

AI.tldr: 自动手语翻译（SLT）已进入消费级产品，但面向儿童的安全审核机制（未成年人账户过滤、诱拐/诱导分类器）仅在英文文本上运作。签署儿童通过SLT的译文触达这些保护机制，而两者从未被联合评估，主流商用SLT模型也未在18岁以下签署者上训练或正式评测。本文提出一套"聋人知情"的部署前审计框架，用于考察这一交界面。
AI.motivation: SLT与信任安全（trust-and-safety）工具链各自发展，形成未被审视的接口：译文是儿童与安全系统之间唯一的媒介，且翻译中出现的否定、参与者角色、保密性、紧迫性或求助意向的偏差可能改变安全判定，却依然表现为流畅自然的文本，因而难以被察觉。现有文献中缺少对二者联合评估的公开记录，也缺少面向未成年签署者的训练与验证，构成合规与伦理风险。
AI.method: 提出聋人知情（Deaf-informed）的部署前审计方法，包含四项构件：（1）失效分类法（failure taxonomy），覆盖否定、参与者角色、保密性、紧迫性、求助意向等语义维度；（2）脱敏场景模式（sanitised scenario schema），用于构造可复现的儿童签署情境；（3）四种对照条件（four comparison conditions），用于隔离翻译环节对安全判定的影响；（4）四项结果度量（four outcome measures）。计划以澳大利亚手语（Auslan）作为首个案例研究。
AI.result: 论文为立场/方法类研究，摘要中未报告实证结果。已陈述的发现性结论为：未发现任何公开记录的系统对SLT与儿童安全工具链进行过联合评估；主流已部署的SLT模型既未在18岁以下签署者数据上训练，也未对其开展正式评测。
AI.conclusion: SLT与儿童安全审核的交界面存在评估空白，应以聋人知情的部署前审计作为必要的评估环节；作者以Auslan为首个案例研究推进该框架，并呼吁将翻译质量之外的语义安全维度纳入SLT评测与部署流程。

title: Quality-Aware Self-Correcting Speech Translation on an Edge Device
comment: 7 pages, 2 figures, 4 tables. Full paper submitted to the Convergence 2026 proceedings; poster presented at Convergence 2026, University of Surrey. Code: https://github.com/juebae/speech-translation_edge_device
summary: We present a fully offline speech-to-speech translation pipeline that runs on a Jetson Nano (4 GB) and corrects its own weak translations without retraining. A Whisper-tiny ASR feeds an Opus-MT translator; multilingual BERT cosine similarity acts as a Quality Estimation (QE) gate, triggering a secondary-pass correction when confidence falls below a pre-defined threshold $τ$. We compare three correction methods: QE reranking (M1), Minimum Bayes-Risk decoding (M2), and constrained beam search (M3). On 1,012 FLORES-200 sentences (English-Spanish), M2 at $τ=0.90$ produces statistically significant improvements over greedy decoding on BLEU (+0.67, p<0.001), ChrF (+0.51, p<0.001), and COMET (+0.0020 at N=3, p=0.002); M1 yields no significant gains, and M3 is significantly worse than baseline (p>0.99). Our central finding is that QE functions effectively as a gate but poorly as a ranker: removing the QE model from candidate selection (M1$\to$M2) does not hurt quality and frees 680 MB from the critical path. Using a gain-to-edit ratio adapted from the post-editing-effort literature, we further show that smaller candidate pools (N=3) yield more surgical corrections with better semantic adequacy, while larger pools (N=10) maximise lexical reward. We release the system and demonstrate live translation across six language pairs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个在Jetson Nano(4GB)上完全离线运行、无需重训练即可自我纠正弱翻译的语音到语音翻译流水线：Whisper-tiny ASR + Opus-MT + 多语言BERT余弦相似度作为质量估计(QE)门控，触发二遍纠正。对比三种纠正方法(QE重排M1、MBR解码M2、约束束搜索M3)，在FLORES-200英西1,012句上，M2在τ=0.90时对BLEU、ChrF、COMET均显著优于贪心解码，M1无显著增益，M3显著更差。核心发现是QE适合作门控但不适合作排序器。
AI.motivation: 在资源受限的边缘设备(如Jetson Nano 4GB)上实现离线语音翻译，需在不重训练、不依赖云端的前提下提升低质量翻译的输出质量，并节省内存开销。
AI.method: Whisper-tiny做ASR，Opus-MT做翻译；用多语言BERT余弦相似度作为QE门控，当置信度低于阈值τ时触发二遍纠正。比较三种纠正策略：M1(QE重排)、M2(Minimum Bayes-Risk解码)、M3(约束束搜索)。并引入改编自后编辑努力文献的"增益-编辑比"(gain-to-edit ratio)分析候选池大小(N=3与N=10)的影响。
AI.result: 在FLORES-200英西1,012句上，M2在τ=0.90相对贪心解码取得显著提升：BLEU +0.67 (p<0.001)、ChrF +0.51 (p<0.001)、COMET +0.0020 (N=3, p=0.002)。M1无显著增益；M3显著差于基线(p>0.99)。去除QE模型进行候选选择(M1→M2)不损害质量，并可从关键路径释放680 MB。较小候选池(N=3)产生更精准的纠正和更好的语义充分性，较大池(N=10)最大化词汇奖励。
AI.conclusion: QE作为门控有效但作为排序器效果差；M2(MBR解码)在低资源离线场景下是最佳纠正方案，且能节省内存。系统已开源，并展示六种语言对的实时翻译。

title: HouseholdBench: Evaluating Large Language Models as Predictors of Household Economic Behavior
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have the potential to meet a key goal in economics: a quantitative model of household decision making, across a variety of settings. Yet existing evaluations cover few surveys and outcomes, and do not study how households adjust to changing economic conditions. We introduce a new evaluation, HouseholdBench, which unites 6 U.S. household surveys and 32 prediction tasks spanning numeric, categorical and probabilistic outcomes, related to consumption, income, labor, expectations, and housing. Using past behavior, demographics and macroeconomic conditions, the tasks test whether LLMs predict behavior, including how households adjust to changes in various policies. We evaluate 13 proprietary and open-weight LLMs against a no-change baseline and a gradient-boosted tree model. Most LLMs outperform the no-change baseline, including for policy response tasks -- with the best model lowering error for numeric outcomes by 12.2%. Across most tasks, gradient-boosted trees rank first; leading proprietary LLMs approach their performance, but open-weight models lag. LLMs exhibit systematic over- and underprediction across different tasks. We identify methods that enable a 4 billion parameter open-weight model to match proprietary models' performance: fine-tuning and aggregating 16 predictions per observation. Improvements generalize to policy-response tasks, which are excluded from fine-tuning. We release our datasets, code, and leaderboard on our website: https://jn-huang.github.io/householdbench

AI.tldr: 本文提出 HouseholdBench 评测基准，整合 6 项美国家庭调查与 32 个预测任务，检验 13 个大语言模型能否预测家庭消费、收入、劳动、预期和住房行为及其对政策变化的调整，并与无变化基线和梯度提升树对比。
AI.motivation: 经济学希望用大语言模型（LLM）构建跨情境的家庭决策定量模型，但已有评测覆盖的调查与结果过少，且未研究家庭如何随经济条件变化进行调整，因此缺乏系统、可比的评估工具。
AI.method: 构建 HouseholdBench：联合 6 项美国住户调查、32 个预测任务，涵盖数值、分类、概率型结果，涉及消费、收入、劳动、预期与住房；以过往行为、人口统计特征和宏观经济条件为输入，测试 LLM 能否预测行为及对各类政策变化的反应。评测 13 个闭源与开源权重 LLM，对照无变化基线和梯度提升树模型；并提出微调与对每个观测聚合 16 次预测的方法提升小模型性能。
AI.result: 多数 LLM 优于无变化基线，且在政策响应任务上同样如此，最佳模型将数值型结果的误差降低 12.2%；多数任务中梯度提升树排名第一，领先的闭源 LLM 接近其表现，而开源权重模型落后；LLM 在不同任务上存在系统性高估与低估；微调加 16 次预测聚合可使 4B 参数开源模型达到闭源模型水平，且该改进能泛化到未参与微调的政策响应任务。
AI.conclusion: LLM 已具备一定的家庭行为预测能力并可部分刻画政策响应，但传统树模型仍具竞争力；通过微调与预测聚合可显著缩小开源与闭源模型差距，且改进具有跨任务泛化性。作者公开数据集、代码与排行榜以推动后续研究。

title: Large Language Model Orchestration under Heterogeneous Preferences via Explicit Persona Inference
summary: LLM orchestration investigates how an orchestrator coordinates a group of autonomous agents to achieve common goals or maximize collective welfare. The agents are typically heterogeneous, each holding a private preference that it pursues but does not reveal. Inferring such hidden preferences from behavior has been a subject of long-standing research in game theory and multi-agent systems. The core challenge lies in maintaining a belief over every agent's preference and updating it from the agents' observed actions. Existing LLM orchestrators carry that belief as prompt text with no explicit update rule. This lets early errors persist and propagate rather than be corrected. We therefore propose \textbf{HARP} (Heterogeneous-preference Agent oRchestration via Preference inference), a novel framework that moves the belief out of the prompt. Specifically, HARP maintains one numeric posterior per agent over a finite set of candidate preferences and updates it in closed form by Bayes' rule.
