The language model supplies only actions and per-candidate likelihoods, so estimation is decoupled from its reasoning. We prove that HARP attains the same $\tilde O(\sqrt K)$ Bayesian regret as explicit joint inference when the factorization is exact. Furthermore, HARP\textsuperscript{+} augments planning with a bonus for actions that distinguish the candidates, so inference continues even when the optimal action is uninformative. Empirical results on three substrates, ranging from payoffs the preferences fully determine, through payoffs that depend on more than them, to scales where explicit joint inference is infeasible, demonstrate that HARP\textsuperscript{+} is the strongest non-oracle method across the class our theory identifies.

AI.tldr: 提出HARP框架，将LLM编排器的偏好信念从提示文本中剥离，改为对每个智能体在候选偏好集上维护数值后验并用贝叶斯闭式更新，理论上达到与显式联合推断相同的贝叶斯悔界，并通过HARP⁺加入区分性动作奖励以维持推断。
AI.motivation: LLM编排需协调异质且隐藏私有偏好的自主智能体，核心难点在于维持并更新对各智能体偏好的信念。现有LLM编排器仅把信念以提示文本形式携带，缺乏显式更新规则，导致早期错误持续并传播而无法被纠正。
AI.method: HARP将信念移出提示：为每个智能体在有限候选偏好集上维护数值后验，用贝叶斯规则进行闭式更新；语言模型仅提供动作与各候选的似然，从而将估计与模型推理解耦。在因子化精确时证明其达到与显式联合推断相同的Õ(√K)贝叶斯悔界。HARP⁺进一步在规划中加入对能区分候选的动作的奖励，使最优动作无信息时推断仍能继续。
AI.result: 在三种基底上验证：从偏好完全决定收益，到收益依赖偏好之外的因素，再到显式联合推断不可行的规模。结果显示HARP⁺在其理论刻画的该类方法中是最强的非oracle方法。
AI.conclusion: 将偏好信念从提示文本中解耦为可显式贝叶斯更新的数值后验，能避免早期错误累积，并在理论上保持与联合推断相当的悔界；辅以区分性动作奖励可保证持续推断，实证上优于同类非oracle方法。

title: Recurrent Looped Transformer
summary: State tracking requires an update at every input, but the depth a Transformer applies to each token is fixed regardless of sequence length. We introduce the Recurrent Looped Transformer (RLT), which splits its layers between a parallel causal encoder and a recurrent decoder. At each token, the decoder merges the encoder output with the previous token's final decoder state, so the computation path grows with sequence length at a fixed per-token cost. On six algorithmic tasks, we compare five splits of eight layers with an eight-layer Transformer over three seeds. Trained on at most 40 bits, two RLT splits generalize parity to 256 bits with 100% accuracy in every seed, while the Transformer stays at chance. On swap-based $S_5$ permutation tracking at eight times the training length, RLT reaches 97% final-state accuracy versus under 1% for the Transformer, and accuracy increases with decoder depth. On modular arithmetic beyond the training lengths, RLT reaches up to 93% versus 33% for the Transformer. Ablations show that these gains depend on the feedback: removing it drops parity and swap-based $S_5$ to chance at every split. Updating the feedback once per four-token chunk lets known tokens in a chunk run in parallel and keeps 64-bit parity at 99%, while permutation tracking depends on per-token feedback: chunking lowers length-64 swap-based $S_5$ from 100% to 20%.

AI.tldr: 提出循环回环 Transformer（RLT），将层拆分为并行因果编码器与循环解码器，使计算路径随序列长度增长而单 token 成本固定，在算法任务上显著优于标准 Transformer。
AI.motivation: 状态跟踪需要对每个输入进行更新，但标准 Transformer 对每个 token 施加的深度固定、与序列长度无关，难以处理随长度增长的状态更新需求。作者希望以固定单 token 成本换取随序列长度增长的计算路径。
AI.method: RLT 将八层拆分为并行因果编码器与循环解码器；解码器在每个 token 处将编码器输出与上一 token 的最终解码状态合并，形成递归反馈。实验在六个算法任务上，比较五种层拆分方案与八层 Transformer（三个随机种子）；训练长度最多 40 位。解码器深度可变，并通过消融检验反馈作用，以及将反馈改为每四 token 块更新一次（块内并行）。
AI.result: 泛化奇偶校验：两种 RLT 拆分在 256 位上达到 100% 准确率（所有种子），Transformer 为随机水平。基于交换的 S_5 排列跟踪在训练长度 8 倍时，RLT 最终状态准确率 97%，Transformer 低于 1%，且准确率随解码器深度提升。模算术超出训练长度时 RLT 最高 93%，Transformer 为 33%。消融显示增益依赖反馈：去除反馈后奇偶校验与 S_5 在各拆分均降至随机水平。每四 token 块更新反馈可保持 64 位奇偶校验 99%，但排列跟踪依赖逐 token 反馈：分块使长度 64 的 S_5 从 100% 降至 20%。
AI.conclusion: 循环反馈是 RLT 长序列泛化能力的关键；逐 token 反馈对排列跟踪等重要状态跟踪任务尤为必要，而分块反馈可兼顾部分任务的并行效率。

title: Monte Carlo Estimation for KV Cache Eviction
summary: Most KV-cache eviction methods ask, in effect, which memory appeared important while reading the prompt? We instead ask, which memory will matter while answering? Since decoding queries are unavailable at eviction time, prior future-aware methods rely on pseudo-responses or synthetic future-query estimates. We cast fixed-budget future-aware eviction as distributional estimation over plausible model-conditional query trajectories and introduce LORE-KV (Lookahead Output-perturbation with Reliability-weighted Ensembles for Key-Value caches), a training-free method that samples short autoregressive continuations from the frozen target model and uses their response-side query states to estimate prompt-token utility. Tokens are scored by projected leave-one-out attention-output deletion cost and aggregated across sampled futures with optional trajectory weighting. The temporary continuations are discarded before final decoding, requiring no auxiliary model or training. Ablations isolate the mechanism: at B=128, a single response-side continuation recovers about 89% of the gain over the prompt-window control, while additional futures provide smaller improvements. At B=128, LORE-KV raises the LongBench average on Qwen2.5-14B from 45.49 to 48.24 (+2.75) and the 16K RULER average on Mistral-7B from 45.20 to 51.05 (+5.85). Gains diminish at larger cache budgets and coexist with task-level regressions. LORE-KV incurs 1.46-2.77x AnDPro's per-sample wall-clock time as a one-time compression overhead across six dense and hybrid-attention backbones.

AI.tldr: 提出 LORE-KV：一种免训练的未来感知 KV 缓存淘汰方法，通过采样短自回归续写并以响应侧查询状态估计提示 token 效用，在固定预算下提升长上下文性能。
AI.motivation: 现有 KV-cache 淘汰方法基于"阅读提示时哪些记忆看起来重要"来评估，但真正关键的是"回答时哪些记忆会起作用"。由于淘汰时无法获得解码查询，已有未来感知方法依赖伪响应或合成未来查询估计，存在偏差与额外开销。
AI.method: 将固定预算的未来感知淘汰建模为"模型条件查询轨迹分布上的分布估计"问题；LORE-KV 无需训练或辅助模型，从冻结目标模型采样短自回归续写，用其响应侧查询状态估计提示 token 效用；token 打分采用投影式留一法注意力输出删除代价，并在多个采样未来上聚合，可选轨迹加权；临时续写在最终解码前丢弃。
AI.result: B=128 时，单条响应侧续写可恢复相对提示窗口基线约 89% 的增益，增加未来样本收益递减。B=128 下，Qwen2.5-14B 的 LongBench 平均分从 45.49 提升至 48.24（+2.75）；Mistral-7B 的 16K RULER 平均分从 45.20 提升至 51.05（+5.85）。更大缓存预算下增益减弱，且存在任务级回退。相比 AnDPro，跨六个稠密与混合注意力骨干网络，一次性压缩开销为每样本 1.46–2.77 倍墙钟时间。
AI.conclusion: 未来感知的 KV 淘汰可通过响应侧续写分布估计有效实现，无需训练或辅助模型；单次续写即可捕获主要收益，但方法存在预算增大后收益递减与任务级回退的局限，并带来额外的压缩时间开销。

title: DLoop: Looped Speculative Decoding
summary: Speculative decoding accelerates autoregressive generation in large language models. In each drafting stage, a lightweight draft model proposes tokens that the target model subsequently verifies. With increasingly capable draft models, we find that the target model frequently accepts all tokens produced in a drafting stage. A verification nevertheless follows each drafting stage, resulting in unnecessary target-model forward passes even when drafting could have continued. Adaptive draft length methods decide during decoding how many draft tokens precede a verification, but they raise the speedup only for autoregressive draft models. For a parallel draft model, drafting further requires target-model hidden states for draft tokens that have not been verified. We propose DLoop, a looped form of speculative decoding that adaptively performs multiple drafting stages before verification. DLoop continues drafting while the draft model remains confident and verifies all accumulated draft tokens together. Loop-aware training keeps the draft model reliable in the additional drafting stages by exposing it to its own hidden states for unverified draft tokens. By spending additional draft-model forward passes, DLoop reduces the number of target-model forward passes required for verification. Across diverse speculative decoding methods including EAGLE-3, DFlash, Domino, DSpark, and multi-token prediction modules, DLoop improves the wall-clock speedup by 5 to 41 percent while preserving lossless decoding. Code will be available at https://github.com/naver-ai/DLoop.

AI.tldr: DLoop 提出一种循环式投机解码方法，在验证前自适应进行多轮草稿生成，通过循环感知训练提升草稿模型可靠性，从而减少目标模型前向次数，在多种投机解码方法上实现 5–41% 的墙钟加速且保持无损解码。
AI.motivation: 现有投机解码中，草稿模型能力增强后，目标模型常一次性接受某轮全部草稿 token，但每轮仍必须进行一次验证，导致即使可以继续草稿也产生多余的目标模型前向。自适应草稿长度方法虽可决定验证前的草稿 token 数，但仅对自回归草稿模型有加速效果；对并行草稿模型而言，继续草稿需要尚未验证草稿 token 的目标模型隐藏状态，因此难以直接应用。
AI.method: 提出 DLoop，一种循环式投机解码：在验证前自适应执行多轮草稿阶段，当草稿模型保持置信时持续草稿，并将累积的草稿 token 一并交给目标模型验证。为使草稿模型在额外草稿阶段仍可靠，采用循环感知训练，让草稿模型接触其自身针对未验证草稿 token 产生的隐藏状态。
AI.result: 在包括 EAGLE-3、DFlash、Domino、DSpark 以及多 token 预测模块在内的多种投机解码方法上，DLoop 将墙钟加速提升 5% 至 41%，同时保持无损解码。
AI.conclusion: DLoop 通过以额外的草稿模型前向换取更少的目标模型验证前向，有效缓解了每轮草稿后强制验证带来的开销，是一种可广泛兼容现有并行草稿类投机解码方法的通用加速框架。

title: Detecting LLM-Assisted Vietnamese Writing via Keystrokes under Behavioral Manipulation
comment: 9 pages, 2 figures. Thanh Dong and An Ngo contributted equally. Accepted at the 2026 IEEE International Conference on Tools with Artificial Intelligence (ICTAI 2026)
summary: We study the robustness of keystroke dynamics for detecting large language model (LLM)-assisted writing. We introduce a Vietnamese keystroke dataset capturing realistic writing modes, including bona fide composition, transcription, and paraphrasing. We also define a behaviorally grounded threat model in which users deliberately alter typing patterns. To implement the threat model, we create behaviorally manipulated variants of the data designed to evade keystroke-based detection. We evaluate four keystroke modeling approaches: temporal and rhythmic representations, and sequential representations modeled with a one-dimensional convolutional neural network (1D-CNN) and TypeNet, under user-independent and context-independent settings. The results show that sequential models outperform feature-based approaches in most cases and that keystroke signals encode discriminative information about the writing process. However, detection is not uniformly robust: transcription is reliably identified, while paraphrasing and adversarially manipulated samples are frequently misclassified as bona fide when not explicitly modeled. To address this, we incorporate adversarial training using behaviorally manipulated data, which substantially improves separability and robustness. These results suggest that keystroke-based detection depends critically on exposure to diverse writing behaviors, and that strong performance under limited conditions does not generalize to realistic or adversarial settings without targeted modeling.

AI.tldr: 本文研究击键动力学对检测大语言模型（LLM）辅助写作的鲁棒性，构建越南语击键数据集并定义行为化威胁模型，比较多种击键建模方法，发现序列模型更优、转录易检测但改写与对抗样本易被误判，通过对抗训练可显著提升鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 随着LLM辅助写作的普及，需要判别文本是否由LLM协助完成。击键动力学可反映真实写作过程，但其在现实写作模式变化及用户刻意规避行为下的鲁棒性尚不明确，尤其在非英语场景下缺乏研究。
AI.method: 构建越南语击键数据集，涵盖真实写作、转录与改写三种写作模式；定义行为化威胁模型，即用户刻意改变打字模式，并据此生成行为操纵的对抗变体。评估四类击键建模方法：时序与节奏特征表示、基于1D-CNN的序列表示、TypeNet，在用户独立与上下文独立设置下进行测试，并引入针对行为操纵数据的对抗训练。
AI.result: 序列模型在大多数情况下优于基于特征的方法，表明击键信号包含写作过程的判别信息。但检测鲁棒性不均衡：转录可被可靠识别，而改写与对抗操纵样本在未显式建模时频繁被误判为真实写作。引入对抗训练后，可分性与鲁棒性显著提升。
AI.conclusion: 击键检测效果关键依赖于对多样化写作行为的覆盖；在有限条件下取得的高性能若无针对性建模，难以泛化到真实或对抗场景，对抗训练是提升鲁棒性的有效手段。

title: Readout Stability in Prefill-Only Decision Models:Zero-Label Prediction and Inference-Time Compute Allocation
summary: Prefill-only decision models inspired by the Jev model score every candidate in a menu during a single forward pass and never decode, which makes one call one to two orders of magnitude cheaper than a same-scale generative language model. We show that this read-out structure comes with a testable property. When an intervention changes only the candidate menu and leaves the input text fixed, the post-intervention accuracy is already determined by the cached first-pass distribution. The estimator restricts the pass-1 probabilities to the menu, renormalizes, and reads off the argmax; it uses no labels and no second forward pass. Across seven model families, ten datasets and two task types, menu-only interventions are predicted to within 4.2 points, and for one family the prediction is exact. A probability-level variant of the same estimator errs by 21.0 points, so the property lives in the ranking rather than in the probabilities and is not recovered by calibration. Same-scale generative language models do not share the property. On those models the same estimator errs by 1.6 to 15.8 points and degrades as the model grows. The property turns inference-time compute into a decision that can be made before deployment. Uniform extra passes buy calibration but almost no accuracy; at matched cost a confidence cascade outperforms every scheme that re-asks the same model, and curating the menu beats enlarging the model, with a 0.8B model on a curated 5-candidate menu reaching 95.4% on CLINC150 against 80.0% for a 4B model on the full 150-label menu.Code and data are available at https://github.com/rlisml/jev-cascade.

AI.tldr: 仅预填充（prefill-only）决策模型在单次前向传播中对候选菜单打分且不解码，成本比同规模生成式语言模型低1–2个数量级；本文证明该读出结构具有可检验性质：当干预只改变候选菜单、输入文本固定时，干预后准确率已由缓存的首次前向分布确定。
AI.motivation: 生成式语言模型推理成本高（需解码），而仅预填充决策模型一次前向即可完成打分，成本极低。作者希望揭示这种"读出结构"是否带来可利用的、可检验的性质，从而把推理期算力转化为部署前即可做出的决策，指导模型/菜单设计。
AI.method: 提出一种无标签、无第二次前向的估计器：将首次前向（pass-1）概率限制在候选菜单上并重新归一化，取argmax作为预测；同时构造概率级变体（直接使用校准后的概率）。在7个模型族、10个数据集、2类任务上做纯菜单干预实验，并与同规模生成式语言模型对比；再比较均匀额外前向、置信度级联、菜单精选与模型放大等方案。
AI.result: 纯菜单干预的预测误差在4.2个百分点以内，其中一个模型族完全精确；概率级变体误差达21.0个百分点，说明该性质存在于排序而非概率中，且不能通过校准恢复。同规模生成式语言模型不具备该性质，误差1.6–15.8个百分点且随模型增大而恶化。均匀额外前向只提升校准、几乎不提升准确率；等成本下置信度级联优于所有"重复问同一模型"方案；0.8B模型在精选5候选菜单上CLINC150达95.4%，而4B模型在全部150标签菜单上仅80.0%。
AI.conclusion: 仅预填充决策模型的菜单变换结果可由缓存的首次前向排序预先确定，该性质稳定、可检验且与概率校准无关，为推理期算力分配、模型与菜单选择提供了部署前决策依据：精选菜单优于放大模型，置信度级联在等成本下最优。

title: Does Steering Break Your Model? A Multi-Dimensional Evaluation Suite for LLM Steering Methods
summary: Activation steering provides a lightweight and flexible way to control large language model (LLM) behavior. However, effective steering requires more than inducing the intended behavior: it should also limit unintended changes and remain robust across inputs and training data. Existing evaluations cover these dimensions only in fragments. As a result, the trade-offs between efficacy and side effects have not been systematically characterized. We introduce SteerScope, a two-axis, multi-dimensional evaluation suite that jointly characterizes steering outcomes and method properties through 15 metrics. We score target efficacy and side effects on language quality, task capabilities, and safety and reliability, and further assess generalization and data dependence through steering-specific metrics for sample efficiency and sample sensitivity. Rather than comparing methods at a single operating point, we characterize the trade-offs between efficacy and side effects. Under matched models, tasks, and evaluation protocols, we benchmark 23 methods spanning 4 families, including prompting, LoRA, and SFT as baseline methods, and release the suite as an extensible codebase. We find that current activation steering methods do not yet surpass the Prompt Steering baseline in their overall balance between steering efficacy and side effects: across both model scales, no evaluated activation steering method achieves higher efficacy without incurring greater composite side effects. We further uncover a consistent coupling between steering efficacy and side effects. Under OOD prompts, target efficacy is often preserved, whereas side effects tend to become more pronounced, particularly through declines in instruction relevance and fluency. Methods also exhibit sharply different sample-efficiency profiles.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 SteerScope——一个双轴、多维（15项指标）的激活引导评估套件，用于联合刻画引导效果与方法属性，并系统揭示效果与副作用之间的权衡关系。
AI.motivation: 激活引导（activation steering）虽为控制LLM行为提供了轻量灵活的手段，但有效引导不应只关注"达成目标行为"，还须限制非预期改变，并在输入与训练数据上保持稳健。现有评测仅碎片化地覆盖这些维度，导致效果与副作用之间的权衡未被系统刻画。
AI.method: 提出 SteerScope：双轴、多维评测套件，含15项指标。第一轴评估引导结果，包括目标效果，以及在语言质量、任务能力、安全与可靠性上的副作用；第二轴评估方法属性，通过引导专用指标衡量泛化性与数据依赖性（样本效率、样本敏感性）。不做单点比较，而刻画效果—副作用权衡。在模型、任务、评测协议对齐下，对覆盖4大类共23种方法（含prompting、LoRA、SFT作为基线）进行基准测试，并开源可扩展代码库。
AI.result: 当前激活引导方法在效果与副作用的整体平衡上尚未超越 Prompt Steering 基线：在两个模型规模下，没有一种激活引导方法能在不带来更大复合副作用的情况下取得更高效果。发现效果与副作用之间存在一致的耦合关系。在分布外（OOD）提示下，目标效果往往得以保持，但副作用更明显，尤其表现为指令相关性与流畅度下降。各方法的样本效率曲线差异显著。
AI.conclusion: 激活引导领域需要一个统一、多维且可扩展的评测框架，SteerScope填补了这一空白；其结果显示该领域仍存在明显瓶颈——方法难以在提升效果的同时抑制副作用，且对OOD输入与训练数据较为敏感，为后续方法设计指明了以权衡优化为核心的方向。

title: SanSi: A Looped Typed Decision Model for System 1.5 Thinking
comment: 43 pages, 15 figures, 42 tables. Project page: https://minnesotanlp.github.io/Sansi/
summary: Typed decision models answer a declared question without generating text: a decision head returns a probability for each of the declared options in a single forward pass. A single pass is fast, intuitive System 1 thinking. We study what lies between one pass and generated reasoning: looping, in which the same layers are recursively applied several times before one typed readout. Each loop lets the model revise its hidden state before it commits to an answer, without generating a token; we call this System 1.5 thinking. We propose SanSi, which turns a pre-trained looped language model into a typed decision model. The option probabilities are read after every loop, and every loop is trained with a proper scoring rule, so that one model serves every budget from one loop to eight in a single run. On 10,027 test decisions from 59 sources, SanSi reaches 72.0% accuracy: 13.5 points above a non-looped model of the same shape trained with the same recipe, 5.3 points above a newer non-looped model of its size, and 1.8 points below one with three times the parameters. On two depth-controlled tasks, loops extend the solvable depth beyond the depths seen in training, where the larger single-pass model fails. Used as the judge for policy optimization with reinforcement learning, without gold answers, SanSi raises the generator's F1 by 7.7 points.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出SanSi，将预训练循环语言模型转化为类型化决策模型，在单次运行中支持1到8次循环的任意推理预算，在59个来源的10027个测试决策上达到72.0%准确率，并可无金答案地作为策略优化评判器提升生成器F1达7.7点。
AI.motivation: 类型化决策模型通过单次前向传播直接输出各选项概率，速度快但缺乏迭代修正能力，类似直觉式的"系统1"思考；而生成式推理虽更强但需生成token、开销大。作者希望研究介于二者之间的中间形态——在不生成token的前提下，通过循环复用同一批层来反复修正隐状态，即所谓"系统1.5"思考。
AI.method: 提出SanSi，把预训练循环语言模型改造为类型化决策模型。每一次循环后都读取选项概率，并对每次循环使用恰当的评分规则（proper scoring rule）进行训练，从而使单一模型在单次运行中即可服务于从1次到8次循环的任意预算。
AI.result: 在来自59个来源的10027个测试决策上，SanSi达到72.0%准确率：比同结构、同配方但非循环的模型高13.5点，比同尺寸的更新非循环模型高5.3点，仅比参数量为其三倍的模型低1.8点。在两个深度受控任务上，循环将可解深度扩展到训练中未见的深度，而更大的单次传播模型在此失败。作为强化学习策略优化的评判器时，在无金答案条件下，SanSi将生成器F1提升7.7点。
AI.conclusion: 循环式"系统1.5"思考可在不生成token的情况下显著增强决策性能，且单一循环模型可覆盖多种计算预算；其能力还可外推到训练未见深度，并能作为无金答案的RL评判器有效提升生成器表现。

title: From Evidence to Action: How Tool-Using Agents Fail
summary: Tool-using agents make consequential changes to external state, yet correct outcomes do not guarantee that their actions were supported by evidence established beforehand. We study where this evidence-to-action chain breaks as agents move from deciding whether to act to executing single actions and dependent workflows. Across ten model-harness configurations, strong static action assessment can coexist with much weaker interactive execution. Failures often begin before execution: agents stop with incomplete investigation or act before required evidence is established. Once required evidence is obtained, single-action execution is usually reliable, while multi-action workflows additionally expose unresolved prerequisites and incomplete execution. For this analysis, we introduce SafeActBench, comprising 656 cases across six operational domains and five protocols that progress from static action judgment and investigated non-action to single- and multi-action workflows. A provenance-bound Evidence Ledger and deterministic trajectory evaluator track what information was established, when actions occurred, and whether downstream dependencies were satisfied. These results show that failures arise not only from missing information, but also from how agents use established evidence when deciding and executing actions.

AI.tldr: 论文研究工具使用智能体从"证据"到"行动"链条的断裂问题，提出SafeActBench基准（656案例、6领域、5协议）及证据账本与轨迹评估器，发现失败常发生在执行前的调查不足或证据未备即行动，单动作执行可靠但多动作工作流易暴露未解决前置条件。
AI.motivation: 工具使用智能体会改变外部状态，但正确结果并不保证其行动有事先建立的证据支撑，因此需要研究证据到行动链条在何处断裂。
AI.method: 在十种模型-框架配置下，考察智能体从"是否行动"判断到单动作执行、再到依赖式多动作工作流的过渡；提出SafeActBench，含6个运营领域、656个案例、5种协议，从静态行动判断、调查后不行动，递进到单动作与多动作工作流；采用来源绑定的证据账本（Evidence Ledger）与确定性轨迹评估器，追踪信息何时建立、行动何时发生、下游依赖是否满足。
AI.result: 强静态行动评估可与弱交互执行并存；失败常始于执行前——调查不完整即停止，或所需证据未建立即行动；一旦证据齐备，单动作执行通常可靠，而多动作工作流额外暴露未解决的前置条件和执行不完整。
AI.conclusion: 失败不仅源于信息缺失，也源于智能体在决定与执行行动时如何使用已建立的证据。

title: No Transformer Beats Six Covariates: Long-Horizon Prediction of Depressive Symptoms from Childhood Essays
summary: Natural language processing (NLP) models can detect depression-related language in text written near the time symptoms are measured, but whether pretrained transformers can predict depressive symptoms from text written twelve years earlier is largely untested. In the National Child Development Study, a British birth cohort, we predict probable depressive symptoms at age 23 from essays the same people wrote at age 11. Our baseline, a logistic regression on six childhood covariates, outperforms every text model that sees only the essay: seven fine-tuned transformers, a bag-of-words model, frozen embeddings and four zero-shot large language models. Its area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC-ROC) is 0.737 against 0.670 for the best transformer on the primary seed, and no added text score detectably raises the baseline's AUC-ROC. None of the five domain-pretrained transformers detectably beats its general-domain control after Bonferroni correction. For long-horizon prediction, the baseline remains the model to beat.

AI.tldr: 在1958年英国出生队列中，用11岁作文预测23岁抑郁症状，六项童年协变量的逻辑回归基线（AUC-ROC 0.737）优于所有仅看文本的模型，包括七个微调Transformer、词袋、冻结嵌入和四个零样本大语言模型。
AI.motivation: NLP模型能在症状测量前后不久的文本中识别抑郁相关语言，但预训练Transformer能否从早十二年写成的文本预测抑郁症状基本未经检验，本文旨在检验这一长时程预测能力。
AI.method: 基于英国出生队列国家儿童发展研究（National Child Development Study），以同一批人11岁所写作文预测其23岁可能的抑郁症状。比较对象包括：逻辑回归基线（使用六项童年协变量）、七个微调Transformer、词袋模型、冻结嵌入、四个零样本大语言模型，以及五个领域预训练Transformer与其通用领域对照。采用AUC-ROC评价，并使用Bonferroni校正进行显著性检验。
AI.result: 基线AUC-ROC为0.737，主种子下最佳Transformer为0.670，基线优于所有仅看文本的模型；加入文本得分未能可检测地提升基线AUC-ROC；五个领域预训练Transformer经Bonferroni校正后均无可检测地优于其通用领域对照。
AI.conclusion: 对于长时程预测，简单协变量基线仍是难以超越的模型，预训练Transformer在从早期文本预测远期抑郁症状方面未见优势。

title: Reading, Not Manipulating: Leveraging Router Logits for Multimodal Safety in MoE Vision-Language Models
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) face compositional safety risks where harmful intent emerges from the interaction between visual and textual inputs. As mixture-of-experts (MoE) VLMs become increasingly common, recent work has explored various safety interventions, including prompting, supervised fine-tuning, and routing-based expert steering. However, these methods show inconsistent improvements across models and evaluation distributions, and the intervention into model behavior or internal states introduce safety-utility tradeoffs by over-refusal. Rather than manipulating internal states to steer model behavior, we instead ask whether routing states can serve as diagnostic signals for multimodal safety. We find that router logits indeed provide highly predictive signals of whether a multimodal input is safe or not. Motivated by this observation, we introduce a lightweight router-logit safety detector that reads out routing signals during prompt prefill and identifies unsafe requests before generation, without modifying model parameters or expert routing. Across Qwen3-VL and Kimi-VL, the proposed detector substantially reduces safety errors on the HoliSafe benchmark and resoundingly generalizes to out-of-distribution safety benchmarks featuring different safety patterns, including MISHard and MM-SafetyBench. The success of the proposed router-logit detector also suggests a broader perspective on model internals: rather than focusing only on manipulating internal components to steer behavior, simply reading naturally emerging signals and linking them to an external safety mechanism can provide a simple, effective, and non-intrusive complement to existing safety interventions.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出利用MoE视觉语言模型的路由器logits作为诊断信号，构建轻量级安全检测器，在生成前识别多模态不安全请求，无需修改模型参数或专家路由，在分布内外安全基准上均显著优于现有干预方法。
AI.motivation: 视觉语言模型存在组合式安全风险：有害意图源于视觉与文本输入的交互。现有安全干预（提示、监督微调、基于路由的专家引导）在不同模型与评估分布上改进不一致，且对模型行为或内部状态的干预会因过度拒答而带来安全-可用性权衡。
AI.method: 不操纵内部状态去引导行为，而是探究路由状态能否作为多模态安全的诊断信号。发现路由器logits对输入是否安全具有高度预测性，据此设计轻量级router-logit安全检测器：在prompt prefill阶段读取路由信号，在生成前识别不安全请求，不修改模型参数、不改变专家路由。
AI.result: 在Qwen3-VL与Kimi-VL上，该检测器在HoliSafe基准上大幅降低安全错误，并稳健泛化到具有不同安全模式的分布外基准，包括MISHard与MM-SafetyBench。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明可读取模型自然涌现的内部信号并接入外部安全机制，从而为现有安全干预提供简单、有效且非侵入式的补充，而非仅局限于操纵内部组件来引导行为。

title: APEX: Speculate smarter, not deeper
summary: Speculative decoding reduces large language model inference latency by drafting multiple tokens before target-model verification, but its effectiveness depends on both the proposal mechanism and draft depth. Fixed configurations cannot respond to changes in predictability, repetition, and acceptance during generation, so deeper drafting can increase wasted computation without proportional speedup. We introduce APEX, a learned controller that balances decoding speed and draft-token waste through request-level expert selection and block-level depth adaptation. APEX-Router selects among EAGLE-3, n-gram, and draft-model speculation for each request, while APEX-Depth adjusts draft length at each verification block using causal decoding signals and recent verifier feedback. APEX models accepted draft length as censored survival feedback, learning position-wise rejection hazards, block execution costs, and an action utility that balances throughput, accepted progress, and wasted tokens. This allows the controller to adapt speculation while retaining the target model's verification procedure. We integrate APEX into vLLM and evaluate it with Qwen3-8B across six workloads, achieving up to 5.24X speedup over autoregressive decoding. Across the aggregate evaluation, APEX-S achieves 4.27X speedup, while APEX-B achieves 3.27X speedup with a 41.0% relative reduction in wasted-token percentage compared with fixed n-gram speculation at k=16, providing distinct operating points for balancing acceleration and draft-token utilization.

AI.tldr: APEX是一种学习型控制器，通过请求级专家选择与块级草稿深度自适应，在投机解码中平衡加速与草稿浪费。集成于vLLM后，Qwen3-8B在六个工作负载上最高达5.24倍加速。
AI.motivation: 投机解码的效果依赖提议机制与草稿深度，但固定配置无法应对生成过程中可预测性、重复性和接受率的变化，导致更深草稿增加无效计算而无相应加速，因此需要自适应控制。
AI.method: APEX包含APEX-Router与APEX-Depth：前者在请求级从EAGLE-3、n-gram和草稿模型投机中选择；后者在每个验证块用因果解码信号与近期验证反馈调整草稿长度。方法将接受草稿长度建模为删失生存反馈，学习逐位置拒绝风险、块执行成本及平衡吞吐、已接受进度与浪费token的动作效用，同时保留目标模型的验证流程。
AI.result: 集成到vLLM后用Qwen3-8B在六个工作负载上评测，相比自回归解码最高加速5.24倍；整体评测中APEX-S达4.27倍加速，APEX-B达3.27倍加速，且相对k=16的固定n-gram投机将浪费token百分比降低41.0%。
AI.conclusion: APEX能自适应投机过程并提供不同工作点，在加速与草稿token利用率之间灵活权衡。

title: One Step at a Time: Trading LLM Autonomy for Process Predictability
summary: Organizations automating operational processes need more than a correct outcome: they need to predict how a process will run, know which one actually ran, and inspect it step by step. When an agent is the executor that predictability is normally lost: the prescribed procedure goes into the system prompt, and only a final answer comes back. We deliver the procedure step by step over the Model Context Protocol (MCP) instead: a server releases one step at a time, the agent executes it, and each step returns a structured step_output. This trades autonomy for predictability, and two properties then follow by construction, independent of the executor. The execution path is prescribed before the run, so the process is predictable in advance rather than reconstructed afterwards; and the completed step records form a machine-readable execution log that downstream tooling can audit and optimize step by step. Evaluating 15,475 trials across 13 SOP-Bench domains and four open-weight executors from frontier (Kimi K2.5) to lightweight (Ministral 3 8B), we find step-level delivery makes the executed process predictable and inspectable for every executor, and additionally raises accuracy when the executor is small. Across all four, process adherence rises significantly (76-95% to 95-99%) and ungrounded answers (correct outputs produced without executing the SOP) near-vanish, falling from 2.1-4.5% to 0.2-0.3% of trials (all 95% CIs exclude zero); under prompt-based delivery, 31-49% of correct answers on know_your_business bypass the SOP entirely, even for the frontier executor. Accuracy is where the executor's capability enters: the lightweight executor gains +6.5pp grounded accuracy because supplying the process externally removes a reconstruction burden it cannot carry, while capable ones trade a small raw-accuracy decrement for a predictable, auditable process.

AI.tldr: 论文提出通过MCP逐步下发SOP的"step-level delivery"机制，以牺牲自主性换取流程可预测性与可审计性：15,475次试验显示流程遵循度显著提升（76–95%→95–99%），无依据回答近乎消失，轻量执行器准确率提升6.5pp。
AI.motivation: 组织自动化运行流程时不仅需要正确结果，还需要事前预测流程走向、确认实际执行路径，并能逐步审查。而现有以agent为执行者的方式（将流程写入system prompt、仅返回最终答案）会丧失可预测性。
AI.method: 通过Model Context Protocol（MCP）逐步下发流程：服务器一次只释放一个步骤，agent执行该步骤，每步返回结构化step_output。该方法在不依赖具体执行器的前提下，由构造上保证流程路径在运行前即已规定（事前可预测，而非事后重建），且完整步骤记录构成机器可读的执行日志，供下游工具逐步审计与优化。评估覆盖13个SOP-Bench域、4个开放权重执行器（从Kimi K2.5到Ministral 3 8B），共15,475次试验。
AI.result: step-level delivery使各执行器的执行流程均可预测、可审查；四个执行器的流程遵循度显著上升（76–95%→95–99%），无依据回答（未执行SOP却产生正确输出）从2.1–4.5%降至0.2–0.3%（所有95%置信区间不含零）。在prompt-based delivery下，know_your_business任务中31–49%的正确回答完全绕过SOP，即便前沿执行器也不例外。轻量执行器因外部提供流程而减少重建负担，获得+6.5pp的有依据准确率提升；能力强的执行器则以小幅原始准确率下降换取可预测、可审计的流程。
AI.conclusion: 逐步下发流程将可预测性与可审查性扩展到所有执行器，并在执行器能力较弱时额外提升准确率。执行器能力只影响准确率维度，而可预测与可审计性由机制本身构造性地保证。

title: Nucleus Speculative Decoding: Plausibility-Aware Verification Beyond Exact Distribution
summary: Speculative decoding accelerates autoregressive generation by using a lightweight draft model to propose multiple tokens that are verified by a target model in parallel. However, the standard acceptance rule focuses on exact distribution correction and rejects tokens that remain highly plausible under the target model when the draft model assigns excess probability. This conservative verification limits the number of draft tokens retained after each verification forward pass. We introduce Nucleus Speculative Decoding (NSD), a relaxed verification method that incorporates target-model plausibility into speculative decoding. NSD accepts a draft token if it satisfies the standard acceptance rule or belongs to the target model's nucleus. We theoretically characterize the distributional deviation introduced by our method and show that the single-step error is exactly determined by the draft model's excess probability within the target nucleus. We further derive sequence-level fidelity bounds that quantify how local deviations accumulate over autoregressive decoding. Experiments across multiple target models and proposal mechanisms demonstrate that NSD consistently improves speculative decoding efficiency while maintaining competitive task performance. Our method achieves throughput speedups of up to $5.16\times$ over autoregressive decoding and up to $3.15\times$ over standard speculative decoding. These improvements coincide with longer accepted lengths, allowing more output tokens to share the cost of each target verification pass. Analysis shows that plausibility-aware verification provides an effective approach for relaxed verification and speculative decoding efficiency. Our code is available at https://github.com/EIT-NLP/Nucleus-Speculative-Decoding.

AI.tldr: 提出 Nucleus Speculative Decoding（NSD），将目标模型"核"（nucleus）内的合理性纳入验证规则，放宽标准投机解码的严格接受准则，从而提升接受长度与吞吐，最多较自回归解码加速 5.16×。
AI.motivation: 标准投机解码的验证规则以严格分布校正为目标，当草稿模型对某 token 赋予超额概率时，即便该 token 在目标模型下仍然高度合理也会被拒绝，验证过于保守，导致每次验证前向能保留的草稿 token 数量受限，效率提升受阻。
AI.method: 提出 NSD：草稿 token 若满足标准接受规则，或落入目标模型的 nucleus（核采样候选集）内，即被接受。理论上刻画该方法引入的分布偏差，证明单步误差恰由草稿模型在目标核内的超额概率决定，并推导序列级保真度上界以量化局部偏差在自回归解码中的累积。
AI.result: 在多种目标模型与提议机制上，NSD 持续提升投机解码效率并保持有竞争力的任务性能：相较自回归解码加速最高 5.16×，相较标准投机解码最高 3.15×，同时接受长度更长，使更多输出 token 分摊单次目标验证的开销。
AI.conclusion: 合理性感知验证（plausibility-aware verification）是一种有效的宽松验证途径，可在可控分布偏差下显著提升投机解码效率。

title: OMIT the Action: Measuring Framing-Invariant Omission Bias under Philosophical Disagreement
summary: As LLMs increasingly assist in moral reasoning, omission bias, the tendency to prefer inaction even when equivalent framings reverse substantive outcomes, poses a significant risk of skewed decision-making. Yet omission bias remains underexplored in LLM evaluation, with the few existing studies limited in scale and focused largely on utilitarian-deontological conflicts. To address this gap, we introduce OMIT, a benchmark consisting of 218 paired-frame scenarios across 10 conflict types, constructed by leveraging disagreement patterns from an LLM-based, five-perspective philosophical persona panel (utilitarianism, deontology, virtue ethics, care ethics, and contractualism). Evaluating eight LLMs, we find that omission bias is pervasive but inversely correlates with model size within families. We further evaluate four inference-time interventions and find that interventions encouraging models to consider moral principles before committing to a yes/no answer reduce omission bias and increase frame-consistent responses, although lower omission bias rates can also coincide with shifts toward action-biased responses. Ultimately, this work contributes not only the OMIT benchmark, but also a methodology for using diverse philosophical disagreement signals to evaluate framing-sensitive inaction preferences and the distributional effects of mitigation attempts in LLMs under complex moral conflicts.

AI.tldr: 本文提出OMIT基准（218对框架情景，覆盖10类道德冲突），评估8个LLM的遗漏偏差，发现该偏差普遍存在且与模型规模负相关，并验证了推理时干预的缓解效果及副作用。
AI.motivation: LLM日益参与道德推理，而遗漏偏差（偏好不作为，即便等价框架会反转实质结果）可能导致决策偏斜。现有LLM评测对此研究不足，规模有限且多聚焦功利论-义务论冲突。
AI.method: 构建OMIT基准：利用基于LLM的五视角哲学人格小组（功利主义、义务论、德性伦理、关怀伦理、契约论）的分歧模式，构建218个配对框架情景，覆盖10类冲突；评估8个LLM的遗漏偏差；并评测4种推理时干预。
AI.result: 遗漏偏差普遍存在，但在模型家族内与模型规模呈负相关；鼓励模型在给出是/否答案前先考虑道德原则的干预可降低遗漏偏差、提升框架一致性回应，但较低的遗漏偏差率也可能伴随向行动偏向的转变。
AI.conclusion: 本文贡献了OMIT基准，并提出利用多元哲学分歧信号评估框架敏感的不作为偏好及缓解手段分布效应的方法论。

title: Dynamic Positional Attention Modulation for Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning of Large Language Models
summary: Parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) has become a standard approach for adapting large language models to downstream tasks. However, most existing PEFT methods rely on uniform and static adaptations, without accounting for the structured heterogeneity of attention across dimensions, heads, layers, and input tokens. In practice, attention representations exhibit non-uniform behavior, and positional encoding mechanisms such as rotary positional embeddings (RoPE) induce dimension-dependent positional structure, making uniform adaptation suboptimal. In this work, we propose DyPAM (Dynamic Positional Attention Modulation), a PEFT method that adapts how positional information contributes to attention by operating directly on the query and key representations. DyPAM combines input-conditioned, dimension-wise modulation with head-wise and layer-wise structural modulation, performing fine-grained adaptation of positional attention aligned with the RoPE-induced structure without modifying the pretrained backbone. Extensive experiments on mathematical and commonsense reasoning benchmarks across multiple backbone models demonstrate that DyPAM consistently outperforms existing strong PEFT baselines.

AI.tldr: 提出DyPAM，一种作用于query和key表示的参数高效微调方法，通过输入条件化、维度级调制结合头级与层级结构调制，实现对位置注意力的细粒度自适应，在数学与常识推理基准上稳定超越现有强基线。
AI.motivation: 现有PEFT方法多采用统一且静态的自适应方式，忽略了注意力在维度、头、层及输入token上的结构化异质性；且RoPE等位置编码会引入维度相关的位置结构，使均匀自适应成为次优选择。
AI.method: DyPAM直接在query和key表示上操作，调节位置信息对注意力的贡献；将输入条件化的维度级调制与头级、层级的结构化调制相结合，在不修改预训练主干的前提下，对与RoPE结构对齐的位置注意力进行细粒度自适应。
AI.result: 在多个主干模型上，于数学推理与常识推理基准开展的大量实验表明，DyPAM持续优于现有强PEFT基线。
AI.conclusion: 针对注意力结构化异质性与RoPE维度相关位置结构的细粒度调制，是一种有效且不改变预训练主干的PEFT思路，可带来一致性能提升。

title: ReFold: Training-Free Reversible Inter-Turn Context Folding for Long-Horizon Agents
summary: Long-horizon LLM agents act on an append-only interaction history that is re-sent to the model at every step, so the context and its cost grow with steps until the sessions exceed the context window. Existing methods manage the context through context requirement prediction, relying on additional model calls, heuristic rules, or trained policies. However, these predictive approaches introduce runtime overhead, invalidate prefix caches, and permanently discard content with no guarantee of recovery. To overcome these limitations, we introduce ReFold: a training-free rendering layer that preserves the underlying interaction history while compressing only the model's rendered context. It removes two kinds of inter-turn redundancy without an auxiliary predictor: content an earlier turn already displayed, replaced by a stub, and turns the agent itself reports finished, folded into a one-line note. Both operators use chunked rendering, rewriting the cached prefix once every few steps rather than at every step. Every removal is strictly reversible, a wrong removal costs one restore from the history rather than permanent content loss. Because it operates at the rendering layer, ReFold is plug-and-play across standard ReAct-style harnesses. Evaluations across five long-horizon benchmarks and two frontier LLMs demonstrate that ReFold reduces token consumption by up to 2.5x and halves the KV-cache memory per session without degrading task success rates. Under capped context budgets, it avoids up to 92% of forced compactions. Under concurrent serving workloads, it reduces request queuing delays by up to 100%, accelerating inference by up to 1.7x, while cutting inference costs by up to 3.4x.

AI.tldr: ReFold 是一种无需训练的渲染层，通过去重已显示内容和折叠已完成轮次来压缩模型上下文，同时保留完整交互历史，实现可逆、低开销的上下文管理。
AI.motivation: 长程 LLM 智能体每步都会重发不断增长的交互历史，导致上下文及其开销随步数增加，最终超出上下文窗口。现有基于上下文需求预测的方法依赖额外模型调用、启发式规则或训练策略，带来运行时开销、破坏前缀缓存，且永久丢弃内容无法恢复。
AI.method: ReFold 作为无需训练的渲染层，保留底层交互历史，仅压缩模型渲染出的上下文。它无需辅助预测器即可去除两类跨轮冗余：一是早前轮次已展示的内容，用占位符替代；二是智能体自身报告已完成的轮次，折叠为一行注释。两种算子均采用分块渲染，每隔数步重写一次缓存前缀而非每步重写。每次移除严格可逆，误删只需从历史恢复而非永久丢失。由于工作在渲染层，可即插即用于标准 ReAct 风格框架。
AI.result: 在五个长程基准和两个前沿 LLM 上评估，ReFold 将 token 消耗最多降低 2.5 倍，每会话 KV 缓存内存减半，且不降低任务成功率。在受限上下文预算下，避免最多 92% 的强制压缩；在并发服务负载下，请求排队延迟最多降低 100%，推理加速最多 1.7 倍，推理成本最多降低 3.4 倍。
AI.conclusion: ReFold 通过可逆的渲染层压缩，在不损失任务成功率的前提下显著降低长程智能体的上下文开销、缓存内存与推理成本，并提升并发服务效率，是一种即插即用的高效上下文管理方案。

title: Rethinking Faithfulness in LLMs: A Pairwise Context-Sensitive Perspective
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are expected to answer questions faithfully based on the provided context, abstaining when the context information is insufficient to answer the questions. Existing faithfulness evaluations typically assess each question-context instance in isolation; however, such instance-level evaluation fails to capture a fundamental requirement of faithful behavior: the ability to adapt model responses to changes in available contexts. In particular, a model should provide correct answers when sufficient evidence is present and abstain when it is not. In this work, we propose a Pairwise Faithfulness Benchmark (PFaithBench) that evaluates whether a model can switch between answering and abstaining for the same question under supporting versus non-supporting contexts. Our evaluations across thirty-nine models with seven model families demonstrate that faithfulness fundamentally involves a trade-off between answering and abstaining, and that most current models exhibit a strong bias toward answering, with most faithfulness errors arising from over-answering, i.e., models tend to fabricate a response even when the provided context is insufficient. We further conduct a series of studies on faithfulness training under different data constructions. Our results show that training outcomes are highly sensitive to the specific composition of answering and abstaining data. Constructing answering and abstaining data from mismatched sources can cause models to rely on dataset-specific shortcuts rather than actual context sufficiency. Moreover, increasing answer-supervised data improves answering performance but exacerbates over-answering, while increasing abstaining data reduces hallucination but leads to over-abstention. The code and data are released at https://github.com/tmlr-group/PFaithBench.

AI.tldr: 提出配对忠实性基准PFaithBench，评估模型能否在同一问题下随上下文是否支持而在"作答"与"弃答"间切换，揭示忠实性本质是作答-弃答权衡。
AI.motivation: 现有忠实性评估多为孤立地考察每个"问题-上下文"实例，无法反映忠实行为的核心要求：模型应随可用上下文变化自适应地作答或弃答（证据充分时给出正确答案，不足时弃答）。
AI.method: 构建Pairwise Faithfulness Benchmark（PFaithBench），对同一问题在支持性与非支持性上下文下成对评估模型的作答/弃答切换能力；在7个模型家族共39个模型上评测，并开展不同数据构造下的忠实性训练研究。
AI.result: 忠实性本质上存在作答与弃答的权衡，多数现有模型强烈偏向作答，多数忠实性错误源于过度作答（上下文不足时仍编造答案）。训练结果对作答/弃答数据的组成高度敏感：用来源不匹配的数据构造会诱导模型依赖数据集特定捷径而非真实上下文充分性；增加答案监督数据提升作答性能但加剧过度作答，增加弃答数据减少幻觉却导致过度弃答。
AI.conclusion: 忠实性应被视为作答与弃答间的权衡能力，需通过配对式基准与合理的数据构成来评估和训练，以避免过度作答或过度弃答。

title: ARIA: Audio-Driven Melody-Tone Relation Modeling for Cantonese Lyric Authoring
comment: Accepted for publication in Findings of EMNLP 2026. 24 pages, including references and appendices. Author-prepared version
summary: Cantonese lyric writing requires close alignment between lexical tones and melodic pitch. Existing melody-guided lyric generation methods typically rely on symbolic melody to generate lyrics. However, in real songwriting scenarios, melodies are often expressed as raw singing audio or hummed recordings, where pitch is implicit, noisy, and unstructured, making these methods difficult to apply directly. To address this limitation, we propose ARIA, a two-stage audio-driven melody-tone relation modeling framework for Cantonese lyric authoring that generates Cantonese lyrics from singing recordings with provided character-level timestamps. Specifically, we first design a Tri-Stream Relation-Aware Tone Estimator (TRATE) to predict 0243 sequences from timestamped singing audio by modeling multi-stream acoustic cues and relational tonal structure. We then propose a Decoupled Retrieval-Augmented Tone-Conditioned Lyric Generator (DRA-TCLG) to generate fluent lyrics conditioned on predicted tonal plans with retrieval-enhanced lexical guidance. Moreover, we construct a large-scale aligned audio-Jyutping-0243 dataset from real Cantonese singing recordings to support this new task. Experimental results demonstrate that ARIA achieves strong performance in both 0243 prediction and tone-consistent lyric generation, validating the effectiveness of the proposed framework.

AI.tldr: 提出ARIA，一个两阶段音频驱动旋律-声调关系建模框架，直接从带时间戳的演唱录音生成粤语歌词（先预测0243声调序列，再生成歌词）。
AI.motivation: 粤语歌词创作要求字调与旋律音高紧密对齐。现有旋律引导歌词生成方法依赖符号化旋律，但真实创作场景中旋律常以原始演唱音频或哼唱录音呈现，音高隐含、含噪且无结构，导致现有方法难以直接应用。
AI.method: 1) 设计三流关系感知声调估计器（TRATE），通过建模多流声学线索与关系化声调结构，从带时间戳的演唱音频预测0243序列；2) 提出解耦检索增强的声调条件歌词生成器（DRA-TCLG），以预测的声调方案为条件，结合检索增强的词汇引导生成流畅歌词；3) 从真实粤语演唱录音构建大规模对齐的audio-Jyutping-0243数据集以支撑该新任务。
AI.result: 实验表明，ARIA在0243声调预测和声调一致的歌词生成两方面均取得强劲性能，验证了框架的有效性。
AI.conclusion: ARIA证明可通过两阶段建模解决音频驱动粤语歌词创作问题，为从演唱/哼唱音频直接生成声调一致歌词提供了可行方案，并配套开源对齐数据集推动该新任务研究。

title: Pseudowords as probes: Large Language Models show little of the sublexical sensitivity that governs human pseudoword processing
summary: Systematicity, the probabilistic mapping of form to meaning, permeates language at all levels, and sublexical cues have been shown to govern human pseudoword processing. Yet whether LLMs exhibit comparable sensitivity to these cues remains unclear. We tested five LLMs on two Italian two-alternative forced-choice pseudoword experiments and compared their responses with a human behavioural baseline. LLMs aligned more reliably with humans when real-word options provided a lexical familiarity cue than in the pseudoword-only condition, where they fell substantially below fastText, a character-n-gram model. In addition, the sublexical cosine-similarity cue that reliably drove human--fastText agreement did not consistently transfer to human--LLM alignment, and reasoning-token expenditure bore no consistent relation to human processing difficulty. These findings suggest that LLMs do not necessarily share the sublexical cues that govern human pseudoword processing; we discuss tokenization and training-data coverage as candidate explanations.

AI.tldr: 本文比较了五个大语言模型与人类在意大利语假词二选一任务中的表现，发现LLM仅在存在真实词熟悉度线索时才可靠对齐人类，而在纯假词条件下低于fastText，且亚词汇余弦相似度线索与推理量均无法稳定解释人类加工，提示LLM未必共享支配人类假词加工的亚词汇线索。
AI.motivation: 系统性（形式到意义的概率映射）贯穿语言各层级，亚词汇线索已被证明支配人类假词加工，但LLM是否具备类似敏感性尚不明确。研究旨在检验LLM与人类在假词加工上的对齐程度，并识别其背后的线索机制。
AI.method: 测试五个LLM，在两个意大利语二选一强制选择假词实验上运行，并与人类行为基线对比；同时纳入字符n-gram模型fastText作为参照，考察亚词汇余弦相似度线索的作用，并分析推理token消耗与人类加工难度的关系。
AI.result: LLM在真实词选项提供词汇熟悉度线索时与人类对齐更可靠；在纯假词条件下显著低于fastText。能够可靠驱动人类—fastText一致的亚词汇余弦相似度线索并未稳定迁移到人类—LLM对齐上；推理token消耗与人类加工难度无一致关系。
AI.conclusion: LLM未必共享支配人类假词加工的亚词汇线索。作者讨论了分词（tokenization）与训练数据覆盖度作为候选解释。

title: Leveraging a four-quadrant approach for evaluating Redpine Science
summary: Redpine Science gives models and agents a single access point to a wide range of peer-reviewed literature, queried directly through the Model Context Protocol (MCP) and an API. This report evaluates Redpine Science on two levels: the relevance of the retrieved chunks, and a model's answer when it has access to Redpine Science compared to web search. Both public and expert-validated benchmarks are used. Public benchmarks are a widely accepted way to test model development and are comparable across labs, but risk saturation and memorization. To address this, we complement them with an expert-validated question set. In total, this report presents four evaluations. On ScholarQABench SciFact, the public answer-quality benchmark reported here, an agent with Redpine Science answers 94.4% of claims correctly against 87.6% with no retrieval. On the expert-validated question set, an agent with Redpine Science states 80.1% of the required claims against 70.2% for an agent restricted to web search. On the 668 queries of a public retrieval benchmark whose gold paper Redpine holds, stripped of any model reasoning, Redpine Science places the correct source paper in its top ten results for 83.1% of queries (Recall@10), against 79.3% for the benchmark's creator. A blinded expert relevance panel places Redpine Science's Precision@5 at 75.2% against 39.8% for the PubMed search tool. We release the expert-validated question set and instructions to reproduce every headline result above, at https://github.com/redpine-ai/benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 该报告从检索相关性和模型答案质量两个层面评估 Redpine Science，结合公开基准与专家验证问题集，共四项评估，均显示其优于对照基线。
AI.motivation: 公开基准虽被广泛接受且跨实验室可比，但存在饱和与记忆化风险，因此需补充专家验证问题集以获得更可靠的评估。
AI.method: Redpine Science 通过 MCP 与 API 提供统一的同行评审文献检索入口；评估分两层面（检索片段相关性、模型在 Redpine Science 与网页搜索对照下的答案质量），使用公开基准与专家验证问题集，共四项评估，含盲审专家相关性小组。
AI.result: ScholarQABench SciFact：使用 Redpine Science 的 agent 正确回答 94.4% 断言，无检索为 87.6%；专家验证集：使用 Redpine Science 的 agent 陈述 80.1% 必需断言，仅限网页搜索为 70.2%；公开检索基准 668 条查询（剔除模型推理）：Recall@10 为 83.1%，基准创建者为 79.3%；盲审专家小组：Precision@5 为 75.2%，PubMed 检索工具为 39.8%。
AI.conclusion: Redpine Science 在答案质量与检索相关性上均优于无检索、网页搜索、基准创建者及 PubMed 工具等对照，并公开发布专家验证问题集与复现说明。

title: Hybrid Latent Attention for Looped Language Models
summary: Looped language models apply the same stack of layers T times to each token, which deepens the model without adding parameters but multiplies its key-value (KV) cache by T. The larger cache limits how many sequences a GPU can decode at once and slows each decoding step, which reads the whole cache. We propose Hybrid Latent Attention (HLA), which keeps exact keys and values within a sliding window of W recent tokens and stores each older token as a compact latent that the query of each loop reads directly, without reconstructing keys and values. We uptrain HLA on Ouro looped models (T=4) with 1.4B and 2.6B parameters, keeping the pretrained weights frozen and training only the added parameters to reproduce the original attention. The cache shrinks by 10.7x per token, fitting 4.0-8.8x as many concurrent sequences per GPU, and decoding throughput improves by 2.5x at 1K-token contexts and by up to 7.4x at 16K. HLA retains over 97% of the original accuracy on math, knowledge and reasoning benchmarks, and 96-100% on long-context retrieval up to 16K tokens. After supervised fine-tuning, it performs on par with the fine-tuned original model on competition-level math.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出混合潜在注意力（HLA），用于循环语言模型（looped LM），在几乎不损失精度的前提下大幅压缩KV缓存并提升解码吞吐。
AI.motivation: 循环语言模型对每token重复应用同一层栈T次，可在不增加参数的情况下加深模型，但会使KV缓存增大T倍：显存占用限制GPU可并发解码的序列数，且每步解码需读取整个缓存，导致速度下降。因此需要一种能压缩缓存同时保持模型能力的方法。
AI.method: HLA对最近W个token保留精确的key和value，对更早的token则存储为紧凑的潜在表示（latent），并让每一循环的query直接读取该潜在表示，而无需重建key和value。作者在Ouro循环模型（T=4，1.4B与2.6B参数）上对HLA进行uptrain：冻结预训练权重，仅训练新增参数，以复现原始注意力行为。
AI.result: 每token缓存缩小10.7倍，单GPU可容纳的并发序列数提升4.0-8.8倍；解码吞吐在1K上下文提升2.5倍，16K上下文最高提升7.4倍。数学、知识与推理基准保留原模型97%以上精度，最长16K token的长上下文检索保持96-100%；经监督微调后，在竞赛级数学任务上与微调后的原模型表现相当。
AI.conclusion: HLA通过将历史token压缩为可直接被query读取的潜在表示，有效解决了循环语言模型KV缓存随循环次数膨胀的问题，在显著降低缓存与提升吞吐的同时基本保持精度，是一种面向循环LM的高效注意力方案。

title: Structured but Silent: Probing Capability Requirements in LLM Hidden States
summary: Reliable tool use requires more than triggering a mechanism or matching a query to an API description. Before selecting a specific tool, an agent must first infer the capability requirements implied by the user query. In this paper, we investigate whether these query-side capability requirements are linearly decodable from LLM hidden representations prior to generation, and how this hidden-state accessibility compares with explicit verbal classification. We introduce TACIT, a framework that decomposes external requirements along three fundamental axes: Source, Transformation, and World Effect, defining eight structurally distinct capability classes. Using 1,600 balanced training queries from benchmarks, synthetic examples, and new domain scenarios, we train linear probes on pre-generation hidden states from four open-weight LLM families. Our empirical results demonstrate that fine-grained capability structures are linearly decodable with high accuracy across all models. Crucially, however, we expose a representation-to-verbalization gap: these same models are significantly less reliable when asked to explicitly classify the same queries in natural language. This disconnect indicates that information about required external capabilities is linearly accessible in LLM hidden representations but not reliably expressed, a phenomenon we define as "structured but silent."

AI.tldr: 该论文研究LLM能否在生成前从隐藏表示中线性解码用户查询所隐含的工具能力需求，并提出TACIT框架将外部需求分解为Source、Transformation、World Effect三个维度、八类能力结构；结果显示隐藏状态可高精度线性解码，但显式语言分类可靠性显著更低，形成"结构化但沉默"现象。
AI.motivation: 可靠的工具使用不仅依赖触发机制或查询与API描述的匹配，还需在选择具体工具前推断用户查询所隐含的能力需求。论文关注这些查询侧能力需求是否在生成前已可从LLM隐藏表示中线性解码，以及与显式语言分类相比的差异。
AI.method: 提出TACIT框架，从Source、Transformation、World Effect三个基本轴分解外部需求，定义八种结构不同的能力类别；使用来自基准、合成示例和新领域场景的1,600条平衡训练查询，在四个开放权重LLM家族的生成前隐藏状态上训练线性探针。
AI.result: 实验表明，细粒度能力结构在所有模型上均可高精度线性解码；但相同模型在自然语言中显式分类同一批查询时可靠性显著更低，暴露出表示到语言化的差距。
AI.conclusion: 所需外部能力的信息在线性上可从LLM隐藏表示中获取，但不能被可靠表达，作者将这一现象定义为"structured but silent"（结构化但沉默）。

title: The Labeling Problem in Hallucination Detection Benchmarks: An Empirical Evaluation
comment: 27 pages. Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Evaluations & Datasets Track. Data: https://doi.org/10.7910/DVN/PCHISZ. Code: https://github.com/jova486/LPHB
summary: In recent years, several methods for detecting when large language models (LLMs) hallucinate have been developed. These methods are often benchmarked with open-domain question answering (QA) datasets containing questions and corresponding short reference answers. First, an LLM is used to generate answers to questions within the QA dataset. Then, some automated labeling strategy is used to label these answers as hallucinated or not by comparing them with the reference answers in the dataset. This evaluation setting creates a methodological ambiguity between two criteria: reference faithfulness (whether the answer is fully supported by the reference) and factual correctness (whether the answer is free from contradictions and factually false specific claims). In practice, automated labelers may apply the former criterion even when the intended target is the latter. We study this potential criterion mismatch using 900 human-labeled question-answer pairs spanning three commonly used QA datasets and three generator models, with labels targeting answer-level factual correctness. We evaluate lexical similarity metrics, a reference-entailment NLI baseline, and seven LLM judges under controlled prompt variants as automated labelers. Our experiments reveal substantial disagreement both among automated labeling strategies and between these labels and human annotations. Many strategies also exhibit strong directional error biases, and for most judge-generator pairs, replacing a faithfulness-oriented prompt with a factual-correctness prompt improves agreement with human annotations and reduces false-positive dominance, indicating that automated hallucination labels depend strongly on how the target criterion is specified. Label-source choice should therefore be considered a fundamental part of benchmark design and made explicit, validated, and matched with the benchmark goal.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究LLM幻觉检测基准中的"标准错配"问题：自动标注常将"参考忠实性"当作"事实正确性"使用，导致标注与人类判断严重不一致。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM幻觉检测方法多以开放域QA数据集基准测试，先用LLM生成答案，再通过将答案与数据集参考答案比对来自动标注"是否幻觉"。这一流程在"参考忠实性"（答案是否完全由参考支持）与"事实正确性"（答案是否无矛盾、无虚假具体断言）两个标准之间产生方法学歧义，而自动标注器常常用前者替代后者。论文旨在量化并检验这种标准错配。
AI.method: 使用900个人工标注的问答对，覆盖3个常用QA数据集和3个生成模型，标签以答案级事实正确性为目标。以词汇相似度指标、参考蕴含NLI基线及7个LLM评判者作为自动标注器，并在受控的提示变体下评估其与人类标注的一致性。同时分析各策略的方向性错误偏差及提示措辞切换的影响。
AI.result: 实验显示自动标注策略之间以及与人类标注之间均存在显著不一致；许多策略有强烈的方向性错误偏差；对多数评判者-生成器组合，将面向忠实性的提示替换为面向事实正确性的提示可提升与人类标注的一致性，并降低假阳性占主导的现象，说明自动幻觉标签高度依赖目标标准的表述方式。
AI.conclusion: 自动幻觉标注强烈依赖于目标标准的界定方式，因此标签来源的选择应被视为基准设计的根本组成部分，需明确声明、加以验证，并与基准目标相匹配。

title: Are Language Models Script-Aware?
summary: Language models frequently generate outputs in unintended languages or scripts, a phenomenon known as off-target generation. While existing research has focused on language selection, the dimension of script knowledge remains understudied: before any linguistic understanding can occur, users must recognize the graphic symbols in a model's response. We investigate whether Small and Large Language Models (SLMs and LLMs) possess script knowledge by testing them on multi-scriptic languages. Through two complementary experiments, we evaluate whether models (1) adapt their output script to match the input, and (2) follow explicit instructions to generate text in a specified script. The models we tested demonstrate substantial script knowledge: they all achieve a near-perfect Latin script fidelity (more than 98%) and follow script instructions with high frequency. Nevertheless, we notice differences between LLMs and SLMs, with higher scores for LLMs including for non-standard script combinations.

AI.tldr: 研究考察小/大语言模型在多文字（multi-scriptic）语言中的"文字知识"，通过两个实验测试模型是否能随输入切换书写文字、以及是否遵循指定文字生成的指令。
AI.motivation: 模型常出现"偏离目标生成"（off-target generation），即在非预期语言或文字中输出。既有研究多集中于语言选择，而文字（script）知识这一维度被忽视：用户必须先能识别模型回复中的图形符号，才谈得上语言理解。
AI.method: 在多文字语言上测试SLM与LLM，设计两个互补实验：(1) 模型输出文字是否自动适配输入文字；(2) 模型是否遵循显式指令，以指定文字生成文本。
AI.result: 所有被测模型均表现出相当程度的文字知识：拉丁文字保真度接近完美（>98%），且高频遵循文字指令。LLM整体优于SLM，在非标准文字组合上也得分更高。
AI.conclusion: 语言模型具备显著的文字层面知识，可作为缓解off-target generation的基础；但LLM与SLM之间存在差距，且非标准文字组合仍是薄弱环节。

title: Language Carries the Expert's Impression: Instrument-Anchored LLM Judges Transfer Counseling-Quality Assessment and Beat In-Domain Training
summary: Automatic assessment of communication quality in dyadic counseling conversations is bottlenecked by data: expert-rated corpora are small and expensive to grow. We study cross-domain transfer of expert overall-impression prediction across three German corpora of simulated counseling (two general-practice medical, one school-related parent-teacher; $n=195$ expert-rated sessions, one corpus after scale equating). Training on the other domains beats training in-domain: leave-one-domain-out transfer reaches nested Spearman $ρ= 0.54$ against $\le 0.48$ within the target domain, a paired session-level gap of $+0.15$ that holds at $+0.12$ when the training-set sizes are matched, so it is not simply data volume. The decisive features are session-level construct scores from small open-weight LLMs reading the two-speaker transcript, with the constructs largely derived from the experts' rating instruments: the instrument-derived battery lifts a single judge from $0.32$ to $0.41$ over generic dialogue qualities, judges from three model families ensemble to $0.51$ language-only, and a nonverbal-dyadic block adds $+0.03$ more, not separable from noise at this sample size. We also price the recording setup: one corpus lost its per-speaker audio, 16% of its diarised segments carry the wrong speaker, and repair is worth $+0.07$ there. At practically attainable corpus sizes, the expert's overall impression is carried by what is said, and by other communication programs' data more than by one's own.

AI.tldr: 在三个德语模拟咨询语料上进行留一域迁移实验，跨域训练预测专家总体印象优于域内训练（嵌套Spearman ρ=0.54 vs ≤0.48），关键特征为小规模开源LLM基于专家评分工具构造的会话级建构分数。
AI.motivation: 二元咨询对话中沟通质量的自动评估受限于数据：由专家评分的语料规模小、扩充成本高，因此需要验证能否借助其他领域的数据实现跨域迁移，并厘清哪些特征真正承载专家的总体印象判断。
AI.method: 使用三个德语模拟咨询语料（两个全科医疗、一个学校相关的家长—教师场景），共195个专家评分会话（其中一个语料经量表等值化处理）。采用留一域（leave-one-domain-out）迁移设置，与域内训练对比，并进行训练集规模匹配以排除数据量影响。特征以小规模开源LLM阅读双说话人转写文本产生的会话级建构分数为主，建构源自专家评分工具；比较通用对话质量特征、工具衍生特征组、三模型家族集成，以及非言语二元特征的增量贡献；同时评估录音设置（双人分离音频缺失、说话人标注错误）及其修复的收益。
AI.result: 跨域迁移达到嵌套Spearman ρ=0.54，高于目标域内训练的≤0.48，会话级配对差距为+0.15，训练集规模匹配后仍保持+0.12，说明并非单纯数据量所致。工具衍生的建构特征组使单评审从0.32提升至0.41（相较通用对话质量特征）；三个模型家族的评审集成在纯语言条件下达到0.51；非言语二元特征模块再增加+0.03，在此样本量下与噪声不可区分。录音设置方面：一个语料丢失逐说话人音频，16%的双人分离片段说话人标注错误，修复在该语料带来+0.07的提升。
AI.conclusion: 在实际可获得的语料规模下，专家的总体印象主要由"说了什么"承载，且相比自身领域的数据，其他沟通类项目的语料对预测贡献更大。因此跨域迁移是缓解专家评分数据稀缺的有效路径，而录音/说话人分离质量对评估性能具有不可忽视的实际影响。

title: DirectSpeech2LLM: A Simple End-to-End Framework to Mitigate Prompt Overfitting in Speech-LLMs
summary: Speech-LLMs often exhibit prompt overfitting, where models solely trained on automatic speech recognition (ASR) instruction fail to generalize to new instructions such as speech translation and continue to behave primarily as ASR system. We propose DirectSpeech2LLM, a simple end-to-end framework that preserves the instruction-following ability of the LLM on unseen tasks when conditioned on speech. It computes distance-based CTC loss over the frozen LLM embedding matrix and uses greedy CTC labels to derive geometrically and temporally aligned speech embeddings respectively as an input to the LLM. Trained solely on 960 hours of LibriSpeech ASR data, DirectSpeech2LLM outperforms the cascaded system on ASR (seen task) and generalizes zero-shot to speech translation and emotion recognition (two unseen tasks), closely matching the cascaded system upper bound on these two new instructions despite seeing neither during training. We also find that geometric alignment strength plays a smaller role than previously assumed, as our modified CTC loss is shown to provide sufficient implicit geometric grounding without requiring an explicit regression loss. Results are consistent across two LLM families and scale with both more training data and model capacity.

AI.tldr: 提出 DirectSpeech2LLM，端到端框架通过在冻结 LLM 词嵌入上计算距离型 CTC 损失并生成几何/时间对齐的语音嵌入，使模型仅在 LibriSpeech ASR 数据上训练即可保持指令跟随能力，零样本泛化到语音翻译与情感识别。
AI.motivation: Speech-LLM 常出现提示过拟合（prompt overfitting）：仅用 ASR 指令训练的模型会退化为纯 ASR 系统，无法泛化到语音翻译等新指令。作者希望保留 LLM 在语音条件下的指令跟随能力。
AI.method: DirectSpeech2LLM：在冻结 LLM 的词嵌入矩阵上计算距离型 CTC 损失（distance-based CTC loss）；利用贪婪 CTC 标签导出分别具有几何对齐与时间对齐的语音嵌入，作为 LLM 的输入。仅用 960 小时 LibriSpeech ASR 数据训练。
AI.result: 在已见任务 ASR 上优于级联系统；在两个未见任务（语音翻译、情感识别）上零样本泛化，性能接近级联系统上界（尽管训练时未见这些任务）。几何对齐强度作用比以往假设更小——改进的 CTC 损失已提供足够的隐式几何接地，无需显式回归损失。结果在两类 LLM 家族上一致，并随训练数据量与模型容量提升而增强。
AI.conclusion: 基于 CTC 的对齐设计可实现端到端语音-LLM 的指令泛化；隐式几何接地足以替代显式回归损失；方法具有良好的家族一致性与可扩展性。

title: SAGE: Semantic Anchor-Guided Evolution for Grounded Medical QA Data Synthesis
summary: Developing reliable models for clinical tasks, such as Medical Question Answering (QA), is severely constrained by the limited availability of high-quality, expert-annotated training data. This challenge is exacerbated by stringent privacy requirements and the impracticality of utilizing large open-source corpora or proprietary cloud APIs within resource-limited clinical settings. To address these obstacles, we introduce SAGE (\textit{Semantic Anchor-Guided Evolution}), a novel data synthesis framework that enables small, locally deployed models to generate high-quality medical training data. SAGE leverages lightweight, publicly available taxonomies such as MeSH as semantic anchors, imposing a structured prior to effectively guide and ground the data generation process. At its core, SAGE iteratively interleaves atomic (individual concept-based) and associative (relation-based) synthesis, bootstrapping training data from minimal seeds. This approach eliminates the need for large collections of medical documents or reliance on external APIs, providing a practical solution for on-premises data creation. Extensive experiments across multiple medical question-answering benchmarks demonstrate that models fine-tuned with SAGE-synthesized data consistently outperform those trained using self-derived or conventional document-based paradigms, highlighting tangible improvements in data efficiency and resource utilization for medical LLM development. Code is available at https://github.com/DIaacKr/SAGE.

AI.tldr: SAGE：以MeSH等语义锚点引导本地小模型迭代合成医学QA训练数据，无需大规模文档或云端API，显著提升数据效率与资源利用率。
AI.motivation: 临床任务（如医学问答）模型训练受限于高质量专家标注数据稀缺；同时隐私要求严格，且资源受限的临床环境难以使用大规模开源语料或专有云API。因此需要一种可在本地部署、低成本生成高质量医学训练数据的方案。
AI.method: 提出SAGE（语义锚点引导进化）数据合成框架：利用MeSH等轻量公开分类体系作为语义锚点，施加结构化先验以引导和接地生成过程；核心为迭代交替进行原子式（基于单个概念）与关联式（基于关系）合成，从极少量种子数据自举式扩展训练集，不依赖大规模医学文档或外部API。
AI.result: 在多个医学问答基准上，使用SAGE合成数据微调的模型一致优于采用自生成数据或传统基于文档范式训练的模型，在数据效率与资源利用方面均有明显提升。
AI.conclusion: SAGE为资源受限的临床场景提供了可行的本地化数据创建方案，证明借助语义锚点与结构化先验可让小模型高效生成高质量医学训练数据，推动医学LLM的实用化开发。

title: Penalty-Framed No-Valid-Option MCQA: Analyzing LLM Abstention under Invalid Choices
comment: Accepted to AACL-IJCNLP 2026 Main Conference (Short Paper)
summary: Multiple-choice question answering (MCQA) is commonly used to evaluate large language models under the assumption that one of the provided options is correct, typically using answer-selection accuracy. However, in real deployments, users or retrieval systems may provide invalid option sets in which none of the listed choices is correct, and selecting one of them may incur downstream cost. We study this setting as penalty-framed no-valid-option MCQA. Using the mathematics subset of MMLU-Pro, we remove the labeled correct option, allow models to either choose a remaining option or output ABSTAIN, and penalize invalid forced-choice responses. We further introduce correct-conditioned analysis, evaluating abstention only on instances that the model originally answered correctly. Experiments show that high MCQA accuracy does not fully guarantee abstention reliability: even under explicit no-valid-option-aware instructions and penalty-based scoring, models still produce invalid forced-choice responses for a subset of originally correct instances. These results show that penalty-framed no-valid-option MCQA reveals an aspect of model reliability not captured by standard answer-selection accuracy.

AI.tldr: 本文研究"惩罚框架下的无正确答案多选题"（penalty-framed no-valid-option MCQA），发现在移除正确答案后，即使有明确指令与惩罚评分，模型仍会对原本答对的题目做出无效的强制选择，说明高MCQA准确率并不能保证弃答可靠性。
AI.motivation: 标准MCQA评测假设选项中必有一个正确答案，并使用答案选择准确率衡量模型。但实际部署中用户或检索系统可能提供无效选项集（无一正确），此时模型若强行选择会带来下游代价。因此需要研究这一被忽视的可靠性维度。
AI.method: 使用MMLU-Pro的数学子集，移除被标注的正确选项，允许模型选择剩余选项或输出ABSTAIN，并对无效的强制选择作答施加惩罚；同时提出"正确条件化分析"（correct-conditioned analysis），仅在模型原本答对的实例上评估弃答表现。
AI.result: 实验表明，高MCQA准确率并不能完全保证弃答可靠性：即使在明确告知无正确答案的指令和惩罚式评分下，模型仍会在一部分原本答对的实例上产生无效的强制选择。
AI.conclusion: 惩罚框架下的无正确答案MCQA揭示了标准答案选择准确率无法捕捉的模型可靠性侧面，提示评测应纳入弃答能力这一维度。

title: Making COMET Comparable Across Scripts: Diagnosis and Correction of Tokeniser-Induced Script Bias in Indic MT Evaluation
comment: 18 pages, 2 figures. Camera-ready version, accepted at WMT 2026. Code and data: https://github.com/John-salvin/script-bias-comet-normalisation
summary: COMET reports translation quality as a single number, and that number is routinely compared across target languages written in different scripts. Such a comparison assumes Script Invariance: the score should not depend on the writing system that carries the target. We test it on IndicMT Eval by re-encoding the target into Latin script, which changes orthographic form while holding content and human ratings fixed. Script identity then accounts for 22.9% of native-script COMET variance, and agreement with annotators falls in all five languages studied. We trace the effect to the tokeniser and measure it with three label-free diagnostics. The bias is two faults, not one. Scores from different scripts occupy incompatible ranges, and within a single script the metric orders translations less accurately. No order-preserving transform of the score can repair the second fault. The first is removed exactly by COMET-QN, which maps the score distribution of each (language, script) pair onto a shared reference. Pooled agreement with annotators rises from 0.300 to 0.399, which is what makes scores from different scripts safe to place on one axis, and every within-language ordering is provably preserved. A regressor over parity features recovers a further 17.1% of the lost sensitivity. The remainder belongs to the encoder, and no post-processing can reach it. We therefore recommend publishing the normalised score, the three diagnostics, and the identity of the tokeniser they were computed against, so that a reader can tell how much of a score reflects translation quality and how much reflects the writing system.

AI.tldr: 本文检验 COMET 跨文字系统比较所隐含的"文字不变性"假设，发现文字身份可解释原生文字 COMET 方差的 22.9%，并将其归因于分词器，提出 COMET-QN 归一化方法修复其中一种偏差。
AI.motivation: COMET 以单一分数报告翻译质量，并被常规地跨不同文字系统的目标语言比较。这种比较隐含"文字不变性"假设：分数不应依赖承载目标的书写系统。作者旨在检验该假设是否成立。
AI.method: 在 IndicMT Eval 上，将目标端重新编码为拉丁字母，保持内容与人工评分不变，仅改变正字法形式；用三种无标签诊断指标追踪效应来源，定位到分词器；提出 COMET-QN，将每个（语言，文字）配对的分数分布映射到共享参考；并用基于 parity 特征的回归器进一步恢复灵敏度。
AI.result: 文字身份占原生文字 COMET 方差的 22.9%，五个研究语言中与标注者的一致性均下降。偏差包含两种缺陷：不同文字的分数区间互不兼容，且单一文字内排序准确性也更差。任何保序变换都无法修复第二种缺陷；COMET-QN 可精确消除第一种，使合并后与标注者的一致性从 0.300 升至 0.399，且语言内排序可证明保持不变。parity 特征回归器额外恢复 17.1% 的损失灵敏度，其余部分归因于编码器，后处理无法触及。
AI.conclusion: 建议发布归一化分数、三种诊断指标及其所依赖的分词器身份，以便读者判断分数中有多少反映翻译质量、多少反映书写系统。

title: STRUCTURALCOST: A controlled reading time dataset for modeling human sentence processing difficulty
summary: We introduce STRUCTURALCOST, a self-paced reading dataset of 475 participants and 40,800 observations isolating the processing cost of long-distance subject-verb dependency resolution. We replicate a low-powered psycholinguistic finding at NLP scale, namely that human reading times at the main verb increase with dependency length, driven by syntactic embedding beyond linear distance. Different language models -- spanning n-gram models, SSMs, and transformers -- partially mirror this graded difficulty profile, yet underestimate the integration cost humans incur, with a gap that persists across architectures and model sizes. This suggests these models capture the predictive component of human processing but not the full integration cost that working memory imposes. STRUCTURALCOST provides data needed to drive progress toward evaluating the cognitive plausibility of language models.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出STRUCTURALCOST数据集，用于隔离长距离主谓依存解析的加工成本，并发现语言模型仅部分反映人类的整合成本。
AI.motivation: 验证低统计功效的心理语言学发现：主谓依存长度增加会提升主句动词处的人类阅读时间，且其驱动因素超出线性距离，而现有语言模型是否具备类似认知特性尚无大规模数据支撑。
AI.method: 构建自定速阅读数据集STRUCTURALCOST，涵盖475名被试、40,800个观测，专门隔离长距离主谓依存解析成本；随后在n-gram模型、状态空间模型（SSMs）和Transformer等不同架构与规模的语言模型上对比其阅读时间预测模式。
AI.result: 在NLP规模上复现了主句动词阅读时间随依存长度增加的效应，并由句法嵌套而非仅线性距离驱动；不同语言模型部分呈现该渐进难度曲线，但普遍低估人类的整合成本，且该差距跨架构与模型规模持续存在。
AI.conclusion: 语言模型捕捉了人类加工的预测成分，但未完整体现工作记忆带来的整合成本；STRUCTURALCOST为评估语言模型的认知合理性提供了数据基础。

title: Memory Depth and Reconstructed Context Width: A Controlled Evaluation of Hierarchical Retrieval
comment: 4 pages, 1 figure. Accepted at the PALM Workshop at NeurIPS 2026
summary: Long-term conversational memory is becoming an integral component of modern LLM systems. Proposed architectures group records by topics and events, construct hierarchies and graphs, and connect facts through causal and temporal relations. We experimentally study the interaction between two memory parameters: structural depth and the width of context supplied to the answer model. Using EverMemBench, we evaluate depths D1-D4, core budgets of 1,024/2,048/4,096 tokens, and additional Production and Oracle conditions up to the full archive. Increasing width from 1K to 4K improves Accuracy by 10.11-17.98 percentage points, whereas increasing depth provides no monotonic gain. Beyond 8-16K, Production performance reaches a plateau while tokens per correct answer continue to increase; Oracle preserves quality on full archives of 68-71K tokens. These results motivate further investigation of large, coherent context blocks instead of progressively deeper memory structures.

AI.tldr: 本文实验研究长期对话记忆系统中结构深度与上下文宽度两个记忆参数的交互作用，发现宽度增加显著提升准确率，而深度增加无单调增益。
AI.motivation: 长期对话记忆已成为现代LLM系统的重要组件，现有架构通过按主题和事件分组记录、构建层次与图结构、以因果和时间关系连接事实来实现记忆。然而，结构深度与上下文宽度这两个记忆参数之间的交互作用尚缺乏实验研究，本文旨在填补这一空白。
AI.method: 使用EverMemBench进行评测，考察深度D1-D4、核心预算1,024/2,048/4,096 token，以及额外的Production与Oracle条件（最多至完整档案），系统比较结构深度与上下文宽度对性能的影响。
AI.result: 上下文宽度从1K增至4K使Accuracy提升10.11-17.98个百分点；深度增加未带来单调增益。超过8-16K后，Production性能达到平台期，但每正确回答的token消耗持续增加；Oracle在68-71K token的完整档案上仍保持质量。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持进一步探索大型、连贯的上下文块，而非逐步加深记忆结构。

title: Language Unalignability: Why Some Concepts Resist Cross-Cultural Benchmark Evaluation
comment: Position paper. 32 pages (10 pages main text), 6 figures, 12 tables
summary: Current evaluation of multilingual Large Language Models (LLMs) rests on an implicit Translation-Isomorphism Assumption (TIA): that semantic structures across languages are congruent and mutually mappable without loss of information. We argue that this assumption is not merely violated in practice, but ill-posed in principle for a typologically identifiable class of concepts, including pragmatic markers, honorifics, and diachronically stratified terms. We formalize this failure using a usage-cloud framework, representing concepts as point sets of contextualized embeddings. We define $α$-unalignability as the impossibility of any mapping that simultaneously preserves lexical faithfulness (centroid correspondence) and structural faithfulness (local neighborhood topology). We provide three layers of evidence. Behaviorally, we show that FLORES-200 translation failures are predicted by language family and resource class but not by script, and that LOBSTER reasoning scores vary by family. Mechanistically, we report a Representation-Intervention Gap (RIG) in a nine-model case study on Yami: the models' activations encode a regularity along which Yami groups with other low-resource and Austronesian languages, yet interventions on language-specific neurons show no demonstrated advantage over random masks: the regularity is visible but not usable by this intervention. Finally, we operationalize these findings into a multidimensional diagnostic profile: Cycle-Consistency, Pragmatic-Load Disagreement, Manifold-Curvature Mismatch, and RIG. We argue that collapsing cultural competence into a single scalar incentivizes "probabilistic flattening," and that recognizing the unalignable class is a precondition for AI that respects, rather than erases, cultural divergence. This suggests that multilingual alignment is not a single well-defined objective, but a set of mutually incompatible projections.

AI.tldr: 本文质疑多语言LLM评测中隐含的"翻译同构假设"（TIA），指出对语用标记、敬语、历时分层词等类型学概念，跨语言语义映射在原理上就不可无损对齐，并用使用云框架形式化"α-不可对齐性"，给出行为、机制和诊断三层证据。
AI.motivation: 现有多语言LLM评测默认跨语言语义结构同构且可无损互映射，即翻译同构假设（TIA）。作者认为该假设对某些类型学可识别的概念类别不仅实践中被违反，而且在原理上就是病态的，因此需要重新审视多语言对齐作为单一目标的合理性。
AI.method: 提出使用云（usage-cloud）框架，将概念表示为上下文化嵌入的点集；定义α-不可对齐性为无法同时保持词汇忠实性（质心对应）与结构忠实性（局部邻域拓扑）的映射。证据分三层：行为层分析FLORES-200翻译失败与LOBSTER推理得分随语系和资源类别的变化；机制层在Yami九模型案例中报告"表示-干预缺口"（RIG）；诊断层构建包含循环一致性、语用负荷分歧、流形曲率失配与RIG的多维诊断画像。
AI.result: FLORES-200翻译失败可由语系和资源类别预测，而非文字系统；LOBSTER推理得分随语系变化。Yami案例中模型的激活确实编码了使Yami与其他低资源及南岛语系语言聚类的规律，但对语言特异神经元的干预相较随机掩码并无优势，说明该规律可见却不可用。诊断画像将上述现象操作化为可测量指标。
AI.conclusion: 将文化能力压缩为单一标量会激励"概率性扁平化"；识别不可对齐类是以尊重而非抹除文化差异为前提的AI的先决条件。多语言对齐并非单一良定义目标，而是一组互不兼容的投影。

title: Foresight-over-Graph: Reasoning Beyond Local Horizons for Knowledge Base Question Answering
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated strong capabilities in question answering, yet they still frequently suffer from hallucinations on knowledge-intensive tasks. Knowledge graphs (KGs) provide LLMs with structured, interpretable, and updatable factual grounding, making them a promising external knowledge source for reliable reasoning. However, existing LLM-guided graph reasoning methods typically rely on hop-wise greedy or beam-style pruning during evidence retrieval. Such local decision processes are inherently myopic: evidence that appears weak near the source may become crucial only after deeper graph context is explored, causing answer-critical branches to be discarded prematurely and making the reasoning chain difficult to recover. To address this limitation, we propose Foresight-over-Graph (FoG), a foresight-aware evidence retrieval framework for knowledge base question answering (KBQA). FoG iteratively constructs a question-relevant evidence subgraph and uses far-to-near feedback to guide path exploration, and maintains a compact memory subgraph to support continued exploration. Extensive experiments on widely used KBQA benchmarks demonstrate that FoG achieves state-of-the-art performance, with a particularly large improvement of 16.58% in Hit on CWQ, while also reducing LLM calls and token usage. Our code is available at https://github.com/yhong7/FoG .

AI.tldr: 提出FoG框架，用远到近反馈引导KBQA证据检索，避免局部贪心剪枝的短视问题，在CWQ上Hit提升16.58%，并减少LLM调用与token消耗。
AI.motivation: LLM在知识密集型任务中易产生幻觉，知识图谱可提供结构化、可解释、可更新的事实依据。但现有LLM引导的图推理方法在证据检索时多采用逐跳贪心或束搜索剪枝，属于局部决策，具有短视性：靠近起点看似弱的证据，只有在探索更深层图上下文后才显现关键性，导致关键分支被过早丢弃且推理链难以恢复。
AI.method: 提出Foresight-over-Graph（FoG），一种面向知识库问答（KBQA）的前瞻感知证据检索框架。FoG迭代构建与问题相关的证据子图，利用远到近（far-to-near）反馈引导路径探索，并维护紧凑的记忆子图以支持持续探索。
AI.result: 在广泛使用的KBQA基准上达到SOTA性能，CWQ上Hit提升尤为显著，达16.58%，同时减少LLM调用次数与token使用量。代码开源：https://github.com/yhong7/FoG。
AI.conclusion: FoG通过远到近反馈的前瞻式证据检索，缓解了局部剪枝的短视问题，在提升KBQA准确率的同时降低了LLM调用与token开销，兼具性能与效率优势。

title: Knowing When Not to Answer: Cross-Domain and Multi-Turn Generalization of Latent Underspecification Signals
summary: Large language models routinely answer questions that cannot be answered from the information given, and in dialogue they answer before enough has been said. Unanswerability is linearly decodable from hidden states, but it is unclear which of its forms share a representation and whether the signal is useful in dialogue. We contribute a turn-labeled multi-turn benchmark (423 conversations, 1,661 labeled turn-states) and an evaluation harness with a simulated user who answers clarifying questions, and use them with six datasets and six open-weight LLMs to test how far probes for unanswerability carry. Probes transfer robustly between datasets that share a ground of unanswerability: missing information in math (AUROC 0.77-0.97) and in a passage (SQuAD 2.0<->MuSiQue, 0.77-0.90). Probes for epistemic "known-unknowns" transfer poorly to math, but this separation weakens under lexical controls and changes with layer and coordinate system, so it remains unresolved. Single-turn probes fail zero-shot to detect when a conversation becomes answerable; in-structure probes recover it, but no better than a bag-of-words classifier. A gate on the calibrated probe, with no model fine-tuning, fires on underspecified turns far more precisely than chance, and its end-task success comes within 0.08 of a gate given the true labels. Yet across four models it does not reliably beat vanilla generation or prompted consolidation. The remaining gap lies mostly in how models use a clarification, not in detection.

AI.tldr: 该研究构建了多轮对话的可回答性基准与评估框架，发现不可回答性探针在同源数据集间迁移稳健，但跨类型迁移差；单轮探针零样本无法检测对话转为可回答的时刻；基于校准探针的门控精度高，但未稳定优于普通生成或提示式整合，主要瓶颈在于模型如何使用澄清信息。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型常对信息不足的问题强行作答，且在对话中过早回答；虽然不可回答性可从隐藏状态线性解码，但其不同形式是否共享表征、该信号在多轮对话中是否有用尚不明确。
AI.method: 贡献一个轮次标注的多轮基准（423 段对话、1,661 个标注轮次状态）与带模拟用户（可回答澄清问题）的评估框架；在 6 个数据集和 6 个开源权重 LLM 上测试不可回答性探针的迁移能力，并对比单轮探针、in-structure 探针、词袋分类器及校准探针门控。
AI.result: 同源不可回答性数据集间迁移稳健：数学缺失信息（AUROC 0.77-0.97）、段落缺失信息（SQuAD 2.0↔MuSiQue，0.77-0.90）；"已知的未知" epistemic 探针向数学迁移差，但该分离在词法控制下减弱并随层与坐标系变化，尚未定论。单轮探针零样本检测对话转为可回答失败，in-structure 探针可恢复但不优于词袋。校准探针门控远超随机精度，端任务成功率距真值标签门控仅差 0.08，但未稳定胜过普通生成或提示式整合。
AI.conclusion: 不可回答性表征在同源形式间具有可迁移性，但跨类型共享仍不确定；检测并非主要瓶颈，剩余差距主要在于模型如何利用澄清信息来作答，基于探针的门控尚不能可靠超越基线。

title: Rethinking Cross-Tokenizer On-Policy Distillation: From Alignment Coverage to Supervision Reliability
summary: On-Policy Distillation (OPD) trains a student on its own generations using teacher feedback. With different tokenizers, comparing teacher and student predictions requires alignment at both sequence and vocabulary levels. In this paper, we examine whether expanding this alignment coverage improves learning. Across three heterogeneous teacher--student pairs on mathematical reasoning and code generation, strict 1:1 groups already cover most student-generated tokens despite substantial vocabulary mismatch. On responses sampled from the students before distillation, the shared vocabulary retains nearly all teacher and student probability mass at strictly aligned positions on average. Restricting reverse KL to a student-selected top-16 subset of the shared vocabulary at each strict position achieves accuracy comparable to full shared-vocabulary OPD, outperforming the evaluated cross-tokenizer baselines. Adding mean squared error supervision on span log-probabilities in mismatch groups gives complete supervision coverage, yet reduces accuracy. At checkpoints from training with only the strict loss, the span gradients show weak or negative directional agreement with the strict gradients and grow in magnitude relative to them. These diagnostics may help explain the accuracy drop from adding span supervision. Our findings motivate a shift from maximizing alignment coverage to prioritizing supervision reliability: compact supervision at strict positions can be more effective than broader coverage that introduces weakly aligned or conflicting training signals.

AI.tldr: 本文研究跨分词器在线策略蒸馏（OPD）中师生对齐覆盖范围对学习效果的影响，发现严格1:1对齐位置已覆盖大部分概率质量，扩大对齐覆盖（加入span监督）反而降低准确率，主张从"最大化对齐覆盖"转向"优先监督可靠性"。
AI.motivation: 跨分词器的OPD需要通过序列级和词表级对齐才能比较师生预测。直观想法是扩大对齐覆盖范围能带来更多监督信号、提升学习效果，但这一假设是否成立尚不明确。作者希望检验"扩大对齐覆盖是否真的有益于学习"。
AI.method: 在数学推理与代码生成任务上，使用三组异构师生配对进行实验：(1) 分析严格1:1对齐组对生成token的覆盖情况及共享词表内的概率质量；(2) 将反向KL限制在学生选出的top-16共享词表子集上；(3) 对mismatch组施加span对数概率的MSE监督以实现完全监督覆盖；(4) 通过span梯度与strict梯度的方向一致性诊断分析性能变化原因。
AI.result: 尽管词表差异显著，严格1:1组已覆盖大多数学生生成token；严格对齐位置上共享词表平均保留了几乎所有师生概率质量。限制为top-16共享词表子集的OPD准确率与全共享词表OPD相当，且优于所评估的跨分词器基线。加入span对数概率MSE监督虽实现完全覆盖，却降低了准确率；在仅用strict损失的检查点上，span梯度与strict梯度方向一致性弱或为负，且相对幅度增大，可解释该准确率下降。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果支持从"最大化对齐覆盖"转向"优先监督可靠性"：严格位置上的紧凑监督可能比引入弱对齐或冲突训练信号的更广覆盖更有效。

title: Agentic AutoRAG: RAG Pipeline Optimization through Reasoning-Driven Agents
comment: Accepted at the Second Workshop for REsearch on Agent Language Models (REALM) at EMNLP 2026 and at the Machine Learning for Systems Workshop at NeurIPS 2026. 9 pages plus references and appendix (16 pages total), 4 figures, 6 tables. Code: https://github.com/Agentic-Systems-Lab/Agentic-AutoRAG
summary: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) is a widely used approach for grounding large language models (LLMs) in external knowledge. However, configuring a pipeline is an expensive hyperparameter optimization problem over many interacting choices, from chunking and embedding model to reranking and generation. Existing optimizers, from greedy search to Bayesian optimization, reduce each trial to an aggregate score and search without modeling why a configuration performed as it did, even though the retrieved chunks already provide evidence about whether each failure occurred during retrieval or after it. We introduce Agentic AutoRAG, an LLM-agent optimizer for multi-objective RAG hyperparameter optimization with retrieval-versus-generation failure attribution.
