It proposes configurations scored on a frozen exam from the corpus: after each trial a Diagnoser attributes each failed question to retrieval or generation, and a Proposer, grounded in a knowledge base of model rankings and pricing, selects the next configuration, weighing accuracy against cost to trace a Pareto frontier. On three multi-hop QA benchmarks it reaches higher LLM-judge accuracy than every baseline we compare, and within its first 10 trials it matches or beats the statistical baselines' full 30-trial judge accuracy. In its cost-aware mode on a real-world healthcare corpus it reaches a median exam accuracy of 77%, above the strongest baseline's 71.5%, at about 58% of that baseline's cost per query, and it matches that 71.5% at about 22% of the cost.

AI.tldr: 提出 Agentic AutoRAG，一种基于 LLM 智能体的 RAG 超参数优化器，通过检索/生成失败归因实现多目标优化。
AI.motivation: RAG 流水线的配置涉及分块、嵌入模型、重排、生成等多个相互影响的超参数，是昂贵的优化问题。现有优化器（贪心搜索、贝叶斯优化）只把每次试验压缩为聚合得分，不建模失败原因，尽管检索到的文本块已提供失败发生在检索还是生成阶段的证据。
AI.method: Agentic AutoRAG 采用 LLM 智能体进行多目标 RAG 超参数优化，并引入检索对生成的失败归因机制。它在语料库的冻结考试集上评估候选配置：每次试验后，Diagnoser 将每个失败问题归因于检索或生成；Proposer 基于模型排名与定价知识库，在准确率与成本之间权衡，选择下一配置以逼近 Pareto 前沿。
AI.result: 在三个多跳问答基准上，其 LLM 评判准确率高于所有对比基线，且在前 10 次试验内即达到或超过统计基线完整 30 次试验的评判准确率。在真实医疗语料库的成本感知模式下，中位考试准确率达 77%，高于最强基线的 71.5%，每查询成本约为该基线的 58%；在约 22% 成本下即可匹配其 71.5% 的准确率。
AI.conclusion: Agentic AutoRAG 通过失败归因与成本感知的多目标搜索，在更少试验和更低成本下实现更高 RAG 准确率，验证了将优化过程与检索/生成失败证据结合的有效性。

title: UNREAL: Unifying Retrieval and Long-Context with a Single Model
summary: Long-context inference and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) handle evidence selection at vastly different scales, from a single long prompt to an entire corpus. We ask whether a single model-internal mechanism can select evidence across this range. We introduce UNifying REtrieval And Long-Context with a Single Model (UNREAL), a model-native evidence selection framework to span corpus retrieval and long-context inference. UNREAL encodes chunks and derives retrieval queries directly from the frozen LLM's internal representations. It adds fewer than 500K trainable parameters and leaves the backbone unchanged. On a 3B-token, 21M-chunk Wikipedia index, all four dense and hybrid UNREAL backbones outperform state-of-the-art retriever-reranker systems. The best model raises recall from 49.1% to 73.2% on HotpotQA, from 31.7% to 60.1% on 2WikiMultiHopQA, and from 8.8% to 14.4% on MuSiQue. Applied to long-context tasks, the same selection mechanism removes distractors before generation, raising NoLiMa accuracy from 1.0% to 24.83% at its maximum context length of 128K tokens, and LV-Eval's F1 score from 49.97% to 54.66% at 256K. UNREAL also reduces FLOPs and time-to-first-token relative to full-context inference from roughly 32K tokens onward, with larger gains as context grows. Together, these results establish model-internal evidence selection as a common foundation for corpus retrieval and evidence-sparse long-context inference.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 UNREAL，一种模型内部证据选择框架，用冻结 LLM 的隐表示统一实现语料检索与长上下文推理，仅增加 <500K 可训练参数。
AI.motivation: 长上下文推理与 RAG 在证据选择尺度上差异巨大（从单条长提示到整个语料库），核心问题是：是否存在统一的模型内部机制能跨尺度完成证据选择。
AI.method: UNREAL 直接从冻结 LLM 的内部表示编码 chunk 并生成检索 query，主干模型不变，仅添加少于 500K 的可训练参数；同一选择机制既用于语料检索，也在生成前移除长上下文中的干扰项。
AI.result: 在 3B token、21M chunk 的 Wikipedia 索引上，四类 dense 与 hybrid 骨干均超越 SOTA retriever-reranker：HotpotQA recall 49.1%→73.2%，2WikiMultiHopQA 31.7%→60.1%，MuSiQue 8.8%→14.4%；长上下文任务中 NoLiMa 在 128K 下 1.0%→24.83%，LV-Eval F1 在 256K 下 49.97%→54.66%；约 32K token 起降低 FLOPs 与首 token 时延，且上下文越长收益越大。
AI.conclusion: 模型内部证据选择可作为语料检索与证据稀疏长上下文推理的共同基础。

title: Language-model ratings of depression reflect the rater more than the patient
summary: Depression has no diagnostic blood test. Language models promise tireless, consistent assessment, but can accurate raters disagree about individuals? We pre-registered 880 language-model raters, crossing 11 open models with prompting and scoring choices, and applied them to 189 interviews against the eight-item Patient Health Questionnaire. Model choice explained 30.0% of summed-symptom score variance, stable participant differences 10.5%. Two randomly drawn raters with area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC) >= 0.70 disagreed on screening decisions for 40% of participants, on average. Average over-rating governed how many were flagged, yet equal-capacity raters chose differently for about one participant in five. A locked analysis of 86 new interviews reproduced the main pre-registered findings. Exploratory recalibration with 40 labelled participants raised accuracy from about 60% to 75% and halved disagreement, leaving one participant in five decided differently. Calibration repaired much of the rater dependence without securing agreement about individuals.

AI.tldr: 880个语言模型评分者用于PHQ-8抑郁筛查，模型选择解释30.0%分数方差，个体差异仅10.5%；同等AUC≥0.70的两名评分者对40%参与者的筛查决策不一致，重校准提升准确率但个体分歧仍约20%。
AI.motivation: 抑郁缺乏诊断性血液检测。语言模型被期待提供不知疲倦、稳定一致的评估，但即便准确的评分者对同一个体是否仍会不同，这一问题尚未澄清。
AI.method: 预注册880个语言模型评分者，交叉11个开放模型与提示和评分选择，对189份访谈按八项患者健康问卷（PHQ-8）评分；并进行86份新访谈的锁定验证分析和40名标注参与者的探索性重校准。
AI.result: 模型选择解释汇总症状分数方差的30.0%，稳定的参与者差异占10.5%。两名随机抽取且AUC≥0.70的评分者平均对40%参与者的筛查决策不一致。平均过度评分决定被标记人数，但同等能力评分者约每五人中有一人判断不同。锁定分析复现主要预注册结果；重校准使准确率从约60%升至75%，分歧减半，仍有约五分之一参与者被不同判定。
AI.conclusion: 重校准修复了大部分评分者依赖性，但未确保对个体的判定一致；语言模型评估的准确性提升不等于个体层面筛查决策的可靠性。

title: Wiki-Talkie: Multilingual Benchmarking of Persona-Based Agents on Real-World Discussions
summary: LLMs are increasingly deployed as autonomous agents in social environments, making it critical to study their ability to faithfully simulate human interactions. Central to this is grounding agents in realistic user personas, yet existing datasets rely on fictional personas and are limited to a handful of languages, lacking the empirical grounding necessary to evaluate behavioral fidelity across diverse populations. We introduce Wiki-Talkie, a multilingual dataset of real-world conversations from Wikipedia Talk pages across five languages spanning two language families: Germanic (German, English) and Romance (Spanish, French, Italian), paired with personas derived from real user communities and encompassing sociodemographic attributes, self-descriptions, and behaviorally grounded interaction traits. Using Wiki-Talkie, we evaluate agent interactional behavior on a next-turn generation task across various persona conditioning strategies. Our evaluation assesses whether agents collectively reproduce the distributional behavioral patterns observed in human discussions. Results show that user's comment history exemplifying interaction behavior consistently outperforms explicit persona information. In addition, models systematically underproduce negative or extreme sentiments, while over producing references and suggestions, revealing biases toward agreeableness and positivity. Crucially, these patterns hold robustly across languages, with small cross-lingual differences.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Wiki-Talkie，一个覆盖五种语言（德、英、西、法、意）的真实用户对话与人格数据集，用于评估 LLM 智能体模拟人类交互行为的能力。
AI.motivation: LLM 被越来越多地部署为社交环境中的自主智能体，因此需要研究其能否忠实模拟人类交互。而现有数据集依赖虚构人格、语言覆盖极少，缺乏跨人群评估行为保真度所需的实证基础。
AI.method: 构建 Wiki-Talkie：采集维基百科讨论页真实对话，涵盖日耳曼语族（德语、英语）与罗曼语族（西班牙语、法语、意大利语），并配以源自真实用户社区的人格信息，包括社会人口属性、自我描述和行为层面的交互特征。基于该数据集，在下一轮对话生成任务上评估多种人格条件化策略，检验智能体是否在群体层面复现人类讨论中的分布性行为模式。
AI.result: 用户的评论历史（体现交互行为）始终优于显式人格信息；模型系统性地少产生负面或极端情绪，而过多产生引用与建议，表现出趋同与正向偏置；这些模式在各语言间稳健成立，跨语言差异较小。
AI.conclusion: 行为示例比显式人格描述更能有效条件化智能体交互行为；LLM 存在系统性的情感与行为偏置，且该偏置跨语言一致，提示需以真实、多语言数据为基础评估并改进智能体的行为保真度。

title: How High Is 0.6? Floors, Ceilings, and Headroom in Interpretability Probing
summary: Probes are the workhorse of interpretability. If a model's hidden states predict a variable, the model is said to represent it. But a probe score has no fixed meaning. An $R^2$ of 0.6 may only reflect what the input already gives away, and the same score can mean different things on different data. We propose reading every probe score against two reference points: a floor, what a declared set of simple inputs already predicts, and a ceiling, what the full input can predict. The gap between them, the headroom, is the range in which a probe can show that a model computes something beyond the simple inputs. We prove that headroom vanishes in two ways: the target stops depending on a hidden variable the model must infer, or the input stops revealing it. We test this on transformers trained for in-context meta-analysis, which must infer the hidden heterogeneity between studies to weight them correctly, and where both reference points are known. Under distribution shift, probe scores fall and prediction error rises $12$--$15\times$, yet the model recovers a similar share of the headroom, indicating that the data lost information, not the representation. We then analyze the real models. The single-cell foundation model scGPT encodes biological variability only partially. We also revisit four influential LLM probing studies, which claim that models represent geography, the state of an Othello board, truth, and the demographics of their users. Against a floor computed from the input text alone, some of these claims hold, while others are largely explained by the text itself.

AI.tldr: 本文提出用"地板-天花板-余量(headroom)"框架重新解读探针(probe)分数:地板是简单输入已能预测的部分,天花板是完整输入能预测的部分,两者之间的余量才是模型真正"计算"出隐藏变量的空间。作者证明余量在两种情况下消失(目标不再依赖需推断的隐藏变量,或输入不再揭示该变量),并在上下文元分析Transformer、scGPT及四项LLM探针研究中验证该框架。
AI.motivation: 探针分数缺乏固定含义:一个$R^2=0.6$可能仅反映输入本身已提供的信息,且同一分数在不同数据上含义不同。现有解读无法区分"模型表示了某变量"与"输入文本已泄露该变量",导致对表征能力的过度解读。
AI.method: 提出对照两个参照点解读探针分数:地板(floor,由声明的简单输入集合已能预测的部分)与天花板(ceiling,完整输入能预测的部分),二者之差即余量(headroom),表示模型超越简单输入的计算空间。理论上证明余量在两种情形下消失:目标不再依赖模型必须推断的隐藏变量,或输入不再揭示该变量。实验一:训练用于上下文元分析的Transformer(需推断研究间隐藏异质性以正确加权),两参照点已知,施加分布偏移。实验二:分析真实模型scGPT(单细胞基础模型)。实验三:重审四项有影响力的LLM探针研究(地理、Othello棋盘状态、真值、用户人口统计学)。
AI.result: 在分布偏移下,探针分数下降且预测误差上升12–15倍,但模型仍恢复了相近比例的余量,说明是数据丢失了信息而非表征退化。scGPT仅部分编码生物变异性。对四项LLM探针研究,以仅由输入文本计算的地板为基准,部分主张成立,而另一些在很大程度上被文本本身所解释。
AI.conclusion: 探针分数应相对地板与天花板解读,余量才反映模型是否真正计算了超出简单输入的隐藏变量。该框架为探针结果提供了可比较的规范基准,并可区分"数据信息丢失"与"表征能力不足",有助于校正对模型表征能力的过度声明。

title: Latent space bias directions in LLMs capture confidence, not fairness
summary: Activation steering has gained popularity as a lightweight inference-time debiasing technique for large language models. However, prior work reports that steering vectors generalise poorly, with unintended effects on model performance and limited transfer to new datasets. Our work analyses what the debiasing direction used for activation steering actually encodes, in order to shed light on its inconsistent performance. We study the linear debiasing direction obtained by contrasting the activations of anti-biased and biased prompts, and evaluate it as a steering intervention across bias and general knowledge benchmarks. We find that this direction is dominated by model confidence, pointing from regions of high to low-probability tokens in activation space rather than encoding a meaningful representation of model bias. Steering along it does reduce measured bias, but this is a consequence of reducing model confidence: on QA benchmarks we find that this steering drives the model to abstain from answering, with a side effect of improving fairness metrics. Our experiments show that model confidence is the dominant separating factor between biased and anti-biased prompts in hidden space, indicating that isolating a linear representation of bias which is disentangled from model confidence is difficult and steering-based debiasing results should be interpreted with care. In short, steering appears to reduce bias, not by correcting the model's underlying preferences, but by making it less confident, even on tasks unrelated to bias.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了激活引导（activation steering）所用去偏方向的实际编码内容，发现该方向主要由模型置信度主导，而非有意义的偏见表征；引导虽降低偏见指标，实为降低置信度、导致模型弃答的副作用。
AI.motivation: 激活引导作为轻量级推理时去偏技术被广泛使用，但已有工作报告引导向量泛化性差，会对模型性能产生意外影响且难以迁移到新数据集。作者希望弄清去偏方向究竟编码了什么，以解释其不稳定的表现。
AI.method: 通过对比抗偏见提示与有偏见提示的激活，得到线性去偏方向，并将其作为引导干预，在偏见基准和通用知识基准上评估。
AI.result: 该方向由模型置信度主导，在激活空间中从高概率token区域指向低概率token区域，而非编码有意义的偏见表征。沿此方向引导确实降低测量到的偏见，但这是降低模型置信度的结果：在QA基准上引导使模型倾向于弃答，从而附带改善了公平性指标。
AI.conclusion: 模型置信度是隐空间中区分有偏见与抗偏见提示的主导因素，说明难以分离出与置信度解耦的线性偏见表征；基于引导的去偏结果应被谨慎解读——引导看似降低偏见，并非纠正模型内在偏好，而是使其变得不自信，甚至在与偏见无关的任务上也是如此。

title: Incidental information contaminates patient notes and disrupts clinical reasoning in large language models
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly relied upon to support ambient documentation and clinical reasoning. Here we examine the impact of a failure mode shared between these two applications by assessing their sensitivity to information incidental to the patient encounter. In 576 patient-clinician dialogues, we found that frontier models inserted small-talk exchanges into 35% of notes, while mean quality scores changed by at most 0.20 points on five-point scales. In 3.7% of frontier notes, models misattributed the asides or used them clinically. In 57 mock recorded consultations, background speech from a separate patient encounter at -10 dB leaked into 48.2% of transcripts, with contamination detected in 5.3% of downstream notes generated by four open-weight models. We propose a dual encoding hypothesis of clinical reasoning and distraction in LLMs, with preliminary evidence that LLM components associated with disruption by incidental information also support clinical reasoning. These findings support evaluating resistance to incidental information before clinical use, with safeguards that prevent contamination while preserving clinical reasoning.

AI.tldr: 该研究评估了LLM在临床应用中（环境记录与临床推理）对"患者就诊过程附带信息"的敏感性这一失败模式：前沿模型在35%的笔记中插入闲聊内容，3.7%误归属或临床误用旁白；在-10 dB背景语音下，48.2%转录文本发生泄漏污染，四个开放权重模型的5.3%下游笔记受污染。作者提出临床推理与干扰的"双编码假设"，并建议临床使用前评估模型对附带信息的抵抗能力。
AI.motivation: LLM日益被用于支持环境文档记录（ambient documentation）和临床推理，但这两类应用共享一个潜在失败模式：对就诊过程附带信息（如闲聊、背景语音）的敏感性。作者旨在检验该失败模式的影响，以评估临床使用前的安全性。
AI.method: 1）分析576段患者-临床医生对话，考察前沿模型是否将闲聊（small-talk）插入笔记及其对质量评分的影响，并统计误归属/临床误用旁白的比例；2）使用57段模拟录音咨询，在-10 dB条件下引入来自另一患者就诊的背景语音，测量转录文本泄漏率及四个开放权重模型生成的下游笔记污染率；3）基于上述证据提出"临床推理与干扰的双编码假设"并进行初步验证。
AI.result: 前沿模型在35%的笔记中插入了闲聊交换；五分量表上的平均质量评分变化至多0.20分；3.7%的前沿笔记中模型误归属旁白或将其用于临床。在57段模拟录音中，-10 dB下48.2%的转录文本出现背景语音泄漏，四个开放权重模型生成的下游笔记中有5.3%检出污染。初步证据显示，与受到附带信息干扰相关的LLM组件同时也支持临床推理。
AI.conclusion: LLM对就诊过程附带信息高度敏感，且这种敏感性与其临床推理能力可能由共同组件支持（双编码假设）。因此应在临床使用前评估模型对附带信息的抵抗能力，并部署既能防止污染又能保留临床推理能力的防护措施。

title: Generative AI translations in high-stakes emergency messaging
summary: Emergency messaging such as extreme-weather reports and earthquake instructions can involve high stakes, to the extent that translation errors can lead to tragic consequences. The use of machine translation or generative artificial intelligence might therefore not be recommended. On the other hand, time savings in the initial translation can allow greater investments of resources in revision and authorization processes, as well as a wider range of target languages. An experiment with generative AI translations of an earthquake instruction text from English into Chinese and Spanish shows that use of discourse-specific prompts can considerably improve understandability and actionability, although the translations may still not be trusted by translators. Human revision is still required, not only to detect errors but also because of the ethical need for someone to take responsibility for any errors or delays in such messaging.

AI.tldr: 紧急信息（如极端天气、地震指令）翻译错误可能致命。实验表明，针对特定语篇的提示词可显著提升生成式AI译文的可理解性与可操作性，但译者仍不信任这些译文。人工修订依然必要，不仅为纠错，更出于伦理责任归属的需要。
AI.motivation: 紧急信息翻译涉及高风险，误译可能导致悲剧后果，因此通常不建议使用机器翻译或生成式AI；但若能在初译阶段节省时间，就可将更多资源投入修订与授权流程，并能覆盖更多目标语言。作者由此探讨生成式AI在此类场景中的可用性及边界。
AI.method: 以一份英文地震指令文本为对象，进行生成式AI翻译实验，目标语言为中文和西班牙语，对比使用"语篇特定提示词"（discourse-specific prompts）对译文质量的影响。
AI.result: 使用语篇特定提示词可显著提升译文的可理解性（understandability）与可操作性（actionability）；但译者对这些译文仍可能不予信任。
AI.conclusion: 人工修订仍然必要：一是用于发现错误，二是出于伦理要求——必须有人对紧急信息中的错误或延误承担责任。生成式AI可作为节省初译时间的辅助手段，但不能替代人工把关。

title: InterCorrect: Intersection-Aware Correction of Demographic Model Merging for Fair ASR
summary: Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR) systems often show uneven performance across demographic groups, and errors can be especially difficult to address for speakers belonging to multiple demographic groups. This work studies demographic-aware model merging for fair Speech-LLM-based ASR. Starting from a SLAM-ASR-based model, we fine-tune only the connector on demographic-specific subsets and merge the resulting subgroup-adapted connectors into a global model. We then identify critical cross-axis demographic pairs using subgroup WER and task-vector conflict, and apply intersection-specific correction vectors to the global merged model. Experiments on Fair-Speech show that global demographic merging improves overall WER over the base model, while intersection correction provides additional gains for several merging strategies. In particular, TIES with WER-based correction achieves the best overall WER, reducing it from 7.38\% to 5.13\%. Subgroup and disparity analyses further show that the proposed approach improves performance across demographic axes, while highlighting that lower average WER does not always imply reduced subgroup disparity.

AI.tldr: 本文提出面向公平语音大模型ASR的人口统计学感知模型合并方法：仅微调connector，合并子群适配connector，并对关键交叉轴人口统计学对施加专门修正向量，在Fair-Speech上把整体WER从7.38%降至5.13%。
AI.motivation: ASR系统在不同人口统计学群体上性能不均衡，而同时属于多个人口统计学群体的说话人（交叉轴子群）的错误更难处理；现有公平性方法多针对单一属性轴，缺乏对交叉子群的系统优化。
AI.method: 基于SLAM-ASR模型，仅微调connector，在人口统计学特定子集上得到子群适配connector并合并为全局模型；利用子群WER与task-vector冲突识别关键交叉轴人口统计学对，再对全局合并模型施加交叉子群专用修正向量（correction vectors），结合TIES等合并策略与基于WER的修正。
AI.result: 在Fair-Speech上，全局人口统计学合并相比基座模型改善整体WER，交叉修正对多种合并策略带来额外增益；其中TIES配合基于WER的修正取得最佳整体WER，由7.38%降至5.13%；子群与差异分析显示方法在各人口统计学轴上均有提升。
AI.conclusion: 人口统计学感知的connector合并与交叉子群修正可有效降低ASR整体WER并改善多轴子群性能，但更低的平均WER并不总意味着子群差异缩小，说明公平性评估需同时关注整体性能与子群差异指标。

title: Towards In-Parameter Memory Augmentation for Large Language Models
summary: Recently Large Language Models (LLMs) and LLM-based agents increasingly need to incorporate knowledge acquired after pretraining, e.g., domain facts, user preferences, documents, and interaction experience. In-context learning (ICL) and ICL-based agent harness remain flexible, but they consume context capacity and incur repeated discretized encoding cost that grows with context length. \textbf{In-parameter memory} offers a complementary substrate: reusable memory information is represented in model parameters, adapters, or other parameter-like objects that are composed into the forward pass at inference time. This survey focuses on methods that augment LLMs with such parametric memory at deployment: a memory-bearing parameter object is plugged into the forward pass during inference, whether it is acquired before or during deployment. We organize the landscape with two orthogonal axes: \textbf{Parameter Placement}, which includes Embedding, Attention, FFN layers, or Hybrid when two or more layers are used; and \textbf{Parameter Acquisition Time}, which distinguishes methods whose memory object is acquired during deployment (online) from those acquired before it (offline). We clarify boundaries, conduct comparisons, and discuss open directions in interference, safety, co-design with ICL, and recursive self-improvement.

AI.tldr: 该综述聚焦于"参数内记忆"（in-parameter memory），系统梳理了在推理时将携带记忆的参数对象（参数、适配器或类似对象）注入前向传播、以增强LLM部署后知识获取能力的方法，并以"参数放置位置"和"参数获取时机"两个正交维度构建分类体系。
AI.motivation: LLM及基于LLM的智能体日益需要纳入预训练之后获得的知识，如领域事实、用户偏好、文档和交互经验。上下文学习（ICL）及其智能体框架虽灵活，但会占用上下文容量，并带来随上下文长度增长的重复离散化编码开销，因而需要一种互补的记忆载体。
AI.method: 采用综述（survey）形式，聚焦于在部署阶段以参数化记忆增强LLM的方法：即在推理前向传播中插入携带记忆的参数对象，无论其获取于部署前还是部署中。提出两个正交分类轴：（1）参数放置位置，包括Embedding、Attention、FFN层，以及使用两层及以上时的Hybrid；（2）参数获取时机，区分在线（部署期间获取）与离线（部署前获取）两类方法。在此基础上厘清边界并进行对比分析。
AI.result: 构建了参数内记忆方法的二维分类框架，明确了Embedding、Attention、FFN、Hybrid四类放置方式与在线、离线两种获取时机的组合谱系，并对现有方法进行了边界界定与比较，同时讨论了与ICL的协同设计等开放问题。
AI.conclusion: 参数内记忆为ICL提供了互补的记忆基质，通过将可复用记忆编码于参数并在推理时组合进前向传播，缓解了上下文容量与重复编码开销问题；未来开放方向包括记忆干扰、安全性、与ICL的协同设计，以及递归自我改进。

title: Evidence-Bound Reasoning: Neuro-Semantic Verification of Biomedical AI in Glioblastoma Radiogenomics
summary: Background: Biomedical AI can generate plausible explanations without reliably verifying whether each statement is supported by patient-specific evidence. We developed a neuro-semantic verification framework that converts radiomic measurements into addressable evidence records and machine-checkable claims. Methods: UPenn-GBM radiomics were aligned with de novo CaPTk extraction from standardized MRI and expert-validated segmentations in an independent multicenter cohort. The shared space comprised 1,728 features from T1, T1GD, T2, and FLAIR MRI across three tumor regions. Reference-defined semantic states were derived from 611 UPenn cases. We evaluated cross-cohort transportability, model-linked provenance, deterministic verification, controlled predictive degradation, and an LLM claim-extraction pilot; MGMT prediction served only as a transport stress test. Results: Median semantic-state agreement was 0.786 (weighted kappa 0.709), ranging from 0.918 for morphologic to 0.252 for intensity features. The external evidence ledger contained 1,655 model-linked records for 331 patients. The verifier achieved 100% exact-set accuracy in a 6,620-claim corruption benchmark. In a 24-case pilot, GPT-5.6 Sol reproduced 72/72 prespecified atomic claims, and the frozen verifier recovered 24/24 expected conditions. During controlled degradation, ROC AUC declined from 0.899 to 0.500 while verification accuracy remained 1.000. External MGMT discrimination was weak (ROC AUC 0.543). Conclusions: Verifiability can be engineered and evaluated independently of predictive performance. LLMs may structure explanations, while final evidence-consistency checking remains deterministic.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出神经语义验证框架，将影像组学测量转化为可寻址证据记录与可机器校验的声明，使解释的可验证性可与预测性能解耦独立工程化与评估。
AI.motivation: 生物医学AI能生成看似合理的解释，却无法可靠核验每条陈述是否有患者特异性证据支持，即解释的"可验证性"缺失。
AI.method: 将UPenn-GBM影像组学与独立多中心队列中经标准化MRI与专家校验分割的de novo CaPTk提取结果对齐；共享特征空间包含T1、T1GD、T2、FLAIR四种序列、三个肿瘤区域的1,728个特征；基于611例UPenn病例导出参照定义的语义状态。评估内容包括跨队列可迁移性、模型关联溯源、确定性验证、受控预测退化以及LLM声明抽取试点；MGMT预测仅作为迁移压力测试。
AI.result: 语义状态一致度中位数0.786（加权kappa 0.709），形态学特征达0.918，强度特征仅0.252。外部证据账本包含331名患者的1,655条模型关联记录。在6,620条声明的损坏基准上，验证器达到100%精确集合准确率。24例试点中，GPT-5.6 Sol复现72/72条预设原子声明，冻结验证器恢复24/24预期条件。受控退化下ROC AUC由0.899降至0.500，而验证准确率保持1.000。外部MGMT判别较弱（ROC AUC 0.543）。
AI.conclusion: 可验证性可独立于预测性能进行工程化与评估；LLM可用于组织解释结构，但最终证据一致性核查应由确定性方法完成。

title: Same-Number Citation Swaps: Stress-Testing Jev as a Financial Evidence Judge
comment: counterfactual citation perturbation, evidence attribution verification, financial document question answering, Jev, LLM-as-a-judge, probabilistic source verification, tabular numerical reasoning
summary: Financial reports repeat values across periods, metrics and accounting lines, allowing an LLM-generated calculation to be numerically correct while citing the wrong financial role. We evaluate what probabilistic evidence verification adds beyond number matching using Jev as a source-support verifier for GPT-4.1-mini calculation traces. A signed-number-at-pointer baseline explains most recovery over exact quotation checks. To isolate the remaining role-recognition problem, we hold operands and arithmetic fixed, move citations between same-number cells, and retain controls that express equivalent facts. These contrasts reveal both wrong-role citations that pass and valid alternative citations that are withheld. Explicit column labels improve selected wrong-role decisions while also lowering support for some equivalent evidence. A constructed follow-up on 36 new source pages, labeled by a non-author reviewer, extends this evaluation and exposes the same tradeoff between detecting role errors and retaining valid citations. The contribution is a controlled evaluation that identifies what a probabilistic financial verifier distinguishes when numerical matching is held fixed. For LLM-based financial assistants, it makes numerical correctness, cited-role support and acceptance outcomes separately assessable.

AI.tldr: 该论文通过控制实验评估概率型验证器Jev在数值匹配固定时能否识别“引用角色错误”，发现符号数-指针基线已能解释大部分恢复效果，而显式列标签在改善部分错误角色判别的同时会降低对等价证据的支持，揭示了检测角色错误与保留有效引用之间的权衡。
AI.motivation: 财务报告中数值在多个期间、指标和会计科目间重复，导致LLM生成的计算可能数值正确但引用了错误的财务角色。仅做数值匹配无法发现此类错误，因此需要评估概率证据验证在数值匹配之外究竟能提供什么额外价值。
AI.method: 使用Jev作为GPT-4.1-mini计算轨迹的source-support验证器；建立符号数-指针（signed-number-at-pointer）基线并与精确引用检查对比；固定操作数与算术，将引用在同数值单元格间移动，保留表达等价事实的对照项以隔离角色识别问题；并构造包含36个新源页面、由非作者评审者标注的后续实验进行扩展评估。
AI.result: 符号数-指针基线解释了相对于精确引用检查的大部分恢复效果；对照实验既揭示了通过检验的错误角色引用，也发现了被错误扣留的有效替代引用；显式列标签改善了部分错误角色判断，但同时降低了对某些等价证据的支持；后续实验复现了检测角色错误与保留有效引用之间的相同权衡。
AI.conclusion: 该工作提供了一个受控评估，明确了在数值匹配固定时概率型财务验证器能够区分什么；对基于LLM的财务助手而言，它使数值正确性、引用角色支持度与接受结果变得可分别评估。

title: Agreement Is Not Validity: Cross-Model LLM Consensus in Diagnosing Student Failure Modes in K-12 Math Tutoring Dialogue
comment: Submitted to LAK27 as a short paper. Currently under review
summary: In K-12 mathematics tutoring, student-tutor dialogue provides rich evidence of learners' problem-solving processes and sources of difficulty. Learning analytics research increasingly relies on large language models (LLMs) to extract such information from dialogue for a variety of downstream tasks, including knowledge tracing, behavioral modeling, and diagnosis of student reasoning errors. However, the validity of these model-generated interpretations remains insufficiently understood. In this exploratory study, we examine the validity of LLM classifications of five student failure modes in mathematics tutoring dialogue using an operational diagnostic codebook: uncertainty, misattribution, operator selection, conceptual gap, and procedural slip. Across models, human-LLM agreement was moderate (kappa = .524-.597), while cross-model agreement was substantially higher (kappa = .755-.781; alpha = .769). These findings show that cross-model agreement can create a misleading appearance of correctness, challenging the assumption that consensus among LLMs constitutes evidence of valid learner interpretation. For learning analytics, the implication is clear: scalable labeling is useful only if the inferred constructs are valid, and model consensus cannot substitute for independent evidence of that validity.

AI.tldr: 本研究检验大语言模型对K-12数学辅导对话中学生五类失败模式分类的效度，发现人机一致性仅为中等（kappa=.524-.597），而模型间一致性显著偏高（kappa=.755-.781），表明模型共识可能造成"正确性"的假象，不能替代独立的效度证据。
AI.motivation: 学习分析领域日益依赖大语言模型从辅导对话中提取学习者问题解决过程与困难来源的信息，用于知识追踪、行为建模和推理错误诊断等下游任务。然而，这类模型生成解释的效度尚未得到充分理解，尤其是模型间共识是否等同于有效解读这一假设有待检验。
AI.method: 采用探索性研究设计，基于可操作的诊断编码手册，对数学辅导对话中学生的五类失败模式进行分类：不确定性（uncertainty）、错误归因（misattribution）、算子选择（operator selection）、概念缺口（conceptual gap）和程序性失误（procedural slip）。通过计算模型与人类标注者之间的一致性以及不同模型之间的一致性（kappa与Krippendorff's alpha）来评估效度。
AI.result: 跨模型的人机一致性处于中等水平（kappa = .524–.597）；而模型间一致性显著更高（kappa = .755–.781；alpha = .769）。
AI.conclusion: 模型间的高一致性可能制造出"正确性"的误导性表象，挑战了"大语言模型共识即有效学习者解读证据"的假设。对学习分析而言，可扩展的标注只有在所推断构念具备效度时才有价值，模型共识无法替代对该效度的独立证据。

title: When Forgetting is not Catastrophic: On the Mechanics of Spurious Forgetting
summary: Knowledge that a language model appears to forget during finetuning often remains stored and can be recovered, a phenomenon called spurious forgetting. Finetuning on new facts can even produce forgetting that undoes itself: recall of the old facts collapses, recovers as training continues on new facts alone, and only then erodes for good. We seek to understand when such forgetting is not catastrophic. A minimal associative memory reproduces these dynamics with three ingredients: keys with shared structure, concentrated new values, and normalization in the network. Finetuning moves all old representations along a common direction, hiding the old facts while preserving their relative geometry; normalization withdraws this shift once the new facts are learned, whereas fact-specific changes accumulate and cause the erosion. Moreover, subtracting the common shift eliminates the collapse in a Transformer trained on synthetic data, and removing a single direction from each weight update restores old facts in a pretrained language model. Forgetting thus combines a shared, reversible loss of access with a slow erosion of individual facts, and only the second is catastrophic. Which one dominates depends on whether the new data move old memories together or apart.

AI.tldr: 本文研究语言模型微调中的"伪遗忘"现象：旧知识往往未被真正抹除，而是因表示被整体平移而暂时不可访问；其间歇性崩溃-恢复-侵蚀的动力学可由一个含共享结构键、集中新值和归一化的最小联想记忆模型复现。
AI.motivation: 微调新事实时，旧事实的召回会经历"崩溃—恢复—永久侵蚀"的非单调过程（遗忘自我逆转）。作者希望厘清何种遗忘并非灾难性遗忘，并解释该动力学产生的条件与机制。
AI.method: 构建一个最小联想记忆模型，包含三个关键要素：具有共享结构的键（keys with shared structure）、集中的新值（concentrated new values）、以及网络中的归一化（normalization）。并在合成数据上训练的 Transformer 以及预训练语言模型中进行验证：减去共同位移、从每次权重更新中移除单一方向。
AI.result: 模型成功复现了崩溃—恢复—侵蚀的动力学：微调将所有旧表示沿共同方向平移，遮蔽旧事实但保留其相对几何；归一化在新事实学好后撤回该位移，而事实特异性变化累积则导致侵蚀。实验上，减去共同位移可消除合成数据 Transformer 的崩溃，从每次权重更新中移除单一方向可恢复预训练语言模型的旧事实。
AI.conclusion: 遗忘由两部分组成——共享且可逆的访问丧失与个体事实的缓慢侵蚀，仅后者是灾难性的。二者孰主导取决于新数据是使旧记忆同向移动还是分散移动。

title: Holdout Best-of-N: Unbiased Evaluation and Its Cost
summary: Reusing the scores that select a Best-of-$N$ winner can overstate its expected reward. We study evaluation from a fixed matrix of $K$ independent scores per candidate for a policy that selects using $J$ fresh scores. A single estimator based only on this matrix is exactly unbiased for expected judge reward under every independent, stable collection of candidate-specific score laws if and only if $J<K$, for every pool size $M\ge N\ge2$. At $J=K-1$, the selector deepens as $K$ grows. For independent Gaussian scores with common variance and fixed $M\ge N\ge2$, the unbiased minimax risk in this regime is of order $σ^2/\sqrt K$, attained by Holdout; allowing bias improves the rate to $σ^2/K$. For two candidates, we derive the minimum-variance unbiased estimator at known variance and the sharp asymptotic unbiased minimax constant $1/(π\sqrt2)$, which Holdout attains without knowing the variance. The cyclic average over subsets and ties can be computed in $O(MK\log M)$ operations. At fixed selector depth, cyclic evaluation of bounded scores has $O(K^{-1})$ risk uniformly in pool size. The impossibility result concerns the fixed matrix: one additional fresh winner score permits unbiased evaluation of the all-$K$ policy.

AI.tldr: 本文研究Best-of-N选择器复用同一评分矩阵导致的期望奖励高估问题，刻画了仅凭该矩阵构造无偏估计量的充要条件，并给出Holdout与cyclic平均等方法的风险率与最优性结论。
AI.motivation: 用选定Best-of-N获胜者的那批评分来评估该策略，会高估其期望奖励（即所谓"赢家诅咒"式的乐观偏差）。作者希望在仅有一个固定评分矩阵（每个候选K个独立分数）的约束下，建立严格的评估理论：明确何时可以得到期望judge奖励的无偏估计，并量化最优（极小极大）风险。
AI.method: 设定：候选池大小固定为M，用J个新鲜分数进行选择；评估只能使用同一K列评分矩阵。证明单一估计量在任意独立、稳定的候选特定分数分布族下对期望judge奖励完全无偏，当且仅当J<K（对所有M≥N≥2成立）；J=K−1时选择器随K增大而"加深"。对独立同方差高斯分数、固定M≥N≥2，推导该机制下无偏极小极大风险阶为σ²/√K（Holdout达到），允许偏差时可改善到σ²/K。两候选情形下给出已知方差时的最小方差无偏估计量与尖锐渐近无偏极小极大常数1/(π√2)，并说明Holdout在未知方差下也能达到该常数。还给出对子集与并列情形的cyclic平均算法，复杂度O(MK log M)；证明固定选择器深度下，有界分数的cyclic评估风险为O(K⁻¹)且关于池大小一致。
AI.result: 主要结论：(1) 无偏可行性充要条件为J<K，若想无偏评估使用全部K个分数的策略，需要额外一个"新鲜"获胜者分数；(2) 高斯同方差、固定池大小下，无偏极小极大风险为σ²/√K，Holdout最优，允许偏差可达σ²/K；(3) 两候选已知方差时有最小方差无偏估计量，渐近无偏极小极大常数为1/(π√2)，Holdout在未知方差下同样达到；(4) cyclic平均可在O(MK log M)内计算，固定选择器深度下具有O(K⁻¹)的一致风险。
AI.conclusion: 该工作给出了Best-of-N策略评估的严谨统计基础：指出复用同一评分矩阵的选择偏差本质上是信息论层面的不可能性（J=K时无偏估计不存在），并给出最优估计方法（Holdout、cyclic average）及其风险率与常数；同时表明适度偏差可换取更快的风险收敛率。

title: Denoising Hierarchical Representations: Joint Continuous Diffusion for Language Modeling
summary: Diffusion Language Models (DLMs) hold the promise of order-agnostic, parallel text generation. Recently, continuous diffusion and flow matching models have seen substantial gains, driven by carefully crafted token representations and diffusion/flow spaces. In this work, we introduce Hierarchical Continuous Diffusion Language Models (H-CDLMs), a simple framework that further improves continuous DLMs with minimal compute and parameter overhead. Drawing on the discrete DLM and continuous image diffusion literature on joint diffusion, we diffuse multiple modalities in parallel. These modalities represent tokens at different semantic granularities: in our instantiation, the tokens themselves and coarser clusters obtained by clustering pretrained token embeddings. We propose a general setup that allows per-modality samplers and schedules to enhance the interplay between modalities. Applied to CoBit, this yields H-CoBit, which delivers large empirical gains across benchmarks. At dataset entropy, H-CoBit improves MAUVE and reaches a generative perplexity (GenPPL) of 49.4 on LM1B and 50.4 on OWT, improving on the baseline by 24.2 and 20.7 points and surpassing even discrete DLMs of comparable size. On GSM8K, it reaches 27.4% accuracy, outperforming prior continuous diffusion and flow-based models. We further apply H-CDLM to the flow matching model FLM, obtaining consistent gains with H-FLM and demonstrating that the framework generalizes across continuous generative paradigms. Our code will be made publicly available at https://github.com/matol-16/HCDLM.git .

AI.tldr: 本文提出 H-CDLM 框架，通过在多个语义粒度上并行扩散，以极小的计算与参数开销显著提升连续扩散语言模型的生成质量。
AI.motivation: 连续扩散与流匹配语言模型近期取得显著进展，但其性能受限于 token 表示和扩散/流空间的设计。作者希望在不显著增加计算与参数的前提下，进一步利用多粒度信息提升连续扩散语言模型的建模能力。
AI.method: 受离散扩散语言模型与图像扩散中联合扩散思想的启发，H-CDLM 并行扩散多个模态，这些模态对应不同语义粒度的 token 表示：一是 token 本身，二是通过对预训练 token embedding 聚类得到的粗粒度簇。框架支持为每个模态配置独立的采样器与噪声调度，以增强模态间交互。将该方法应用于 CoBit 得到 H-CoBit，并进一步应用于流匹配模型 FLM 得到 H-FLM。
AI.result: 在数据集熵设置下，H-CoBit 在 LM1B 上 GenPPL 达 49.4、OWT 上达 50.4，较基线分别提升 24.2 与 20.7 个点，且优于同规模离散扩散语言模型；MAUVE 亦有提升。GSM8K 上准确率达 27.4%，超过先前连续扩散与流基模型。H-FLM 取得一致增益。
AI.conclusion: H-CDLM 是一种简单且通用的框架，能以极小开销提升连续扩散语言模型，并可推广至流匹配等不同连续生成范式。

title: The Missing Minimal Pair: Stereotype Evaluation in LLMs
summary:
A common approach to measuring bias in Large Language Models is to compare the log-likelihoods of two contrastive stereotype sentences. We argue that such single-pair comparisons are often unreliable: simply rewriting the same stereotype with an alternative attribute can yield logically inconsistent preferences. To address this, we propose a dual minimal pair setup that introduces two axes of comparison for robust stereotype evaluation. First, we present a data-augmentation framework that fills critical gaps in existing stereotype datasets by generating paraphrases and alternate attributes. We apply our framework on a set of English, Russian, Spanish and Chinese stereotypes. Second, we introduce two evaluation metrics tailored to the dual minimal pair setup. One of these metrics provides a new perspective on bias by modeling the mutual information (MI) between social groups and stereotyped attributes. This MI-based metric is better suited for aggregation and enables more robust comparisons of stereotype strength across different languages and models.
  Our code is available at https://github.com/stepanat/missing-minimal-pair/.

AI.tldr: 论文指出单对比句对大模型偏见评测不可靠，提出“双重最小对比对”框架（含数据增强与两项新指标）以提升跨语言、跨模型的偏见评测稳健性。
AI.motivation: 传统偏见度量依赖两句对比刻板印象句的对数似然比较，但同一刻板印象仅替换属性即可产生逻辑不一致的偏好，说明单对比较不稳定、结论易受表述影响。作者希望建立更稳健的刻板印象评测方法，并弥补现有数据集的不足。
AI.method: 1）数据增强框架：为英文、俄文、西班牙文、中文刻板印象生成同义改写（paraphrases）与替代属性（alternate attributes），填补现有数据集缺口；2）双重最小对比对（dual minimal pair）设置：引入两条比较轴，使评测不再依赖单一对比；3）两项适配该设置的评价指标，其中一项通过建模社会群体与刻板属性之间的互信息（MI）来刻画偏见。
AI.result: 单对比较会因改写而产生逻辑不一致的偏好；所提双重最小对比对框架与指标可缓解该问题，其中基于互信息的指标更适合聚合，并在不同语言与模型之间提供更稳健的刻板印象强度比较。
AI.conclusion: 刻板印象偏见评测应从单对对数似然比较转向双重最小对比对与互信息驱动的度量，以提升可靠性、可聚合性及跨语言/跨模型可比性；代码已公开。

title: AdvSim2Real : Training Web Agents Against Adaptive Prompt Injection in a Web World Model
summary: Web agents complete user requests by reading and acting on pages that third parties write, so an instruction planted on a page can redirect the agent away from the user's goal. The agent cannot simply ignore the page, because the page also holds the values and controls the task requires. Current defenses fine-tune the agent on injections fixed before training, and attackers that adapt to the trained model bypass them. Adversarial training lets the attacker adapt but keeps the tasks fixed, so a task stops teaching once the agent solves it. We introduce AdvSim2Real, which co-evolves a task curriculum, an injection adversary, and the agent inside a frozen web world model. The curriculum is rewarded for tasks the agent solves about half of the time, and the adversary only for a success flip, an injection that turns a judged success into a failure. Training in the simulator makes a 4B agent both more capable and more robust: its completion rises with and without attacks, holds against a frontier-model adversary it never trained against, and its capability gain carries over to a real browser. On 150 web tasks, AdvSim2Real raises completion under this unseen adversary by 33.6\% relative to the base agent.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 AdvSim2Real，通过在冻结的网页世界模型中协同进化任务课程、注入攻击者和智能体，使 4B 网页智能体在模拟器中同时提升任务能力与抗注入鲁棒性，并在未见过的前沿模型攻击者和真实浏览器上验证了迁移效果。
AI.motivation: 网页智能体需读取并操作第三方撰写的页面来完成任务，但页面中植入的指令会将其引离用户目标；而智能体又无法忽略页面，因为任务所需的值和控制都存在于页面中。现有防御基于训练前固定的注入样本进行微调，攻击者一旦适应训练后的模型即可绕过；对抗训练虽允许攻击者适应，却固定任务，导致任务在智能体学会后便失去训练价值。
AI.method: 提出 AdvSim2Real，在冻结的网页世界模型内协同进化三部分：任务课程（向智能体成功率约一半的任务给予奖励，保持适度难度）、注入攻击者（仅在成功翻转——即把被判定为成功的注入变成失败——时获得奖励）、以及智能体自身。
AI.result: 在模拟器中训练使 4B 智能体能力与鲁棒性同时提升：无论有无攻击，任务完成率均上升；对训练中从未见过的前沿模型攻击者保持鲁棒；能力增益可迁移至真实浏览器。在 150 个网页任务上，面对该未见攻击者，AdvSim2Real 相较基线智能体将完成率相对提升 33.6%。
AI.conclusion: 通过在冻结世界模型中进行课程、攻击者与智能体的协同进化，可在无真实环境交互成本的前提下同时提升网页智能体的任务能力和对自适应提示注入攻击的鲁棒性，且该增益能泛化到未见攻击者与真实浏览器环境。

title: IdeaAnchor: Teaching LLMs to Turn Literature into Research Ideas
summary: Scientific research often begins by synthesizing ideas from a set of related papers to identify gaps and formulate new directions. However, training language models to perform this form of literature-grounded ideation remains challenging, as existing approaches based on prompting or feedback lack structured supervision for how papers should be synthesized. We introduce IdeaAnchor, a paradigm for training LLMs to perform research ideation using structured specifications as privileged signals. Each IdeaAnchor instance encodes how each input paper should be synthesized into a successful idea, including their functional roles, relationships, and target synthesis criteria. We build this paradigm by mining instances from published papers, capturing how real ideas emerge from prior literature. We then train models via demonstration, self-distillation, and reinforcement learning, and further enhance generation with retrieval at inference time. Experiments show consistent improvements in ideation quality. Our analysis reveals a functional decomposition: anchor-based training strengthens creative synthesis, retrieval enhances detail elaboration, and combining both yields the best performance.

AI.tldr: 提出IdeaAnchor范式，用结构化规格作为特权信号训练LLM进行文献驱动的科研构思，实验显示构思质量持续提升。
AI.motivation: 科研构思需要综合多篇相关论文以发现空白、形成新方向，但现有基于提示或反馈的方法缺乏"论文应如何被综合"的结构化监督，导致训练语言模型进行文献驱动构思仍然困难。
AI.method: 构建IdeaAnchor范式：每个实例编码各输入论文应如何被综合为成功想法，包括功能角色、关系与目标综合准则；通过从已发表论文中挖掘实例来捕获真实想法如何从既有文献中产生；采用示范学习、自蒸馏与强化学习训练模型，并在推理阶段引入检索增强生成。
AI.result: 实验表明构思质量获得一致提升。分析揭示功能分解规律：基于anchor的训练强化创造性综合，检索增强细节展开，二者结合取得最佳性能。
AI.conclusion: 结构化规格监督为文献驱动的研究构思提供了有效训练信号，且训练与检索在创造性与细节层面互补，联合使用效果最优。

title: When Does External Guidance Help LLM Reasoning? A Bias-Variance Theory of Guidance-Augmented GRPO
summary: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has become the dominant paradigm for eliciting multi-step reasoning in large language models, and a recent wave of methods (LUFFY, ExPO, PAPO, TAPO) further augments RL with \emph{external guidance} - expert traces, self-explanations, or retrieved thought patterns. Although each method reports empirical gains, none provides convergence rates, bias bounds, or an optimal weighting rule for the guidance signal. We close this gap with \emph{Guidance-Augmented GRPO} (GA-GRPO), a unified theoretical framework that casts external guidance as a stochastic guidance operator G re-writing the question distribution, and analyses the resulting policy-gradient estimator as a biased on-policy estimator whose bias is bounded by the total-variation guidance divergence delta\_G between the guidance-augmented sampling distribution and the policy's own distribution. The framework subsumes vanilla GRPO, LUFFY, ExPO, PAPO, and TAPO as special cases obtained by particular choices of G. Under smoothness and bounded-divergence assumptions we prove that GA-GRPO converges at rate O(1/sqrt(T)) to an O(delta sqrt(T))-neighbourhood of the GRPO stationary point, derive the closed-form MSE-optimal guidance weight lambda-star(T, delta, sigma\_0 squared) = sigma\_0 squared / (sigma\_0 squared + R\_max squared delta squared T), and prove a matching minimax lower bound showing the Omega(delta squared T) bias term is unavoidable. Experiments on Qwen2.5-Math-7B-Base across nine math and OOD benchmarks confirm that optimal-weight GA-GRPO matches or surpasses TAPO, LUFFY, ExPO, and vanilla GRPO while requiring 31\% fewer GPU-hours, and eight analysis experiments validate each theoretical prediction.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Guidance-Augmented GRPO（GA-GRPO），将外部引导统一建模为随机引导算子G，首次为RLVR中的引导增强方法给出收敛率、偏差界和最优引导权重。
AI.motivation: LUFFY、ExPO、PAPO、TAPO等引导增强RLVR方法虽报告经验收益，但缺乏收敛率、偏差界与最优引导权重的理论保障。
AI.method: 将外部引导（专家轨迹、自解释、检索思维模式）建模为随机引导算子G，重写问题分布；把策略梯度估计器分析为有偏on-policy估计器，偏差受引导分布与策略分布间全变差散度delta_G约束；在光滑性与有界散度假设下进行收敛与下界分析，并推导MSE最优权重。
AI.result: GA-GRPO以O(1/sqrt(T))收敛至GRPO稳定点的O(delta sqrt(T))邻域；闭式最优权重lambda-star = sigma_0^2 / (sigma_0^2 + R_max^2 delta^2 T)；匹配的极小极大下界表明Omega(delta^2 T)偏差项不可避免。在Qwen2.5-Math-7B-Base的九个数学与OOD基准上，最优权重GA-GRPO匹配或超越TAPO、LUFFY、ExPO与vanilla GRPO，GPU耗时减少31%，八项分析实验验证各理论预测。
AI.conclusion: GA-GRPO为引导增强RLVR提供了统一理论框架，将vanilla GRPO及LUFFY、ExPO、PAPO、TAPO纳入特例，理论上刻画了引导偏差与收敛的权衡，并给出可操作的最优权重规则。

title: AegisFlow: A Multi-Agent Agentic AI Framework for Autonomous Remediation and Self-Healing in Fragile Data Ecosystems
summary: Traditional data pipelines are notoriously brittle, often failing due to upstream schema drift, API contract changes, or website DOM modifications. Present observability tools only raise alerts but for human engineers, resulting in a high Mean Time to Repair (MTTR) and operational fatigue. In this paper we propose AegisFlow (Agentic Engine for Intelligent Self-healing and Graph-driven Operations for Workload remediation), a novel agentic framework that closes the loop between detection and resolution. AegisFlow uses a Watchdog agent to collect runtime telemetry and has a Repair agent to automatically create, test and deploy code patches based on Large Language Models (LLMs). The framework presents the non-intrusive execution model called Parallel Shadow Patching, a non-intrusive execution model based on the Monitor, Analyze, Plan, Execute, Knowledge (MAPE-K) loop to generate and verify patches in digital twin environments. Through experimental testing, we have evaluated AegisFlow across five common failure scenarios, and see 98.1 percent improvement in MTTR (from an average of 170 minutes per patch to 3.2 minutes) and a patch success rate of 92 percent . In particular, the system is successful in dealing with changes in the JSON schema (96 percent ) and punctuation drift (98 percent ), and is least successful in Shadow DOM cases (85 percent ). AegisFlow frees up about 98 percent of data engineering on-call time from firefighting and reallocates it towards innovation. The framework is deployment agnostic consisting of a system that can be deployed in a plugin fashion into an existing pipeline orchestration system with minimal uplift to the existing system.

AI.tldr: 提出AegisFlow代理式自愈框架，通过Watchdog与Repair代理及数字孪生环境下的并行影子补丁技术，实现数据管道故障的自动检测与修复，MTTR降低98.1%，补丁成功率92%。
AI.motivation: 传统数据管道极为脆弱，常因上游模式漂移、API契约变更或网页DOM改动而失败；现有可观测性工具仅向人工工程师告警，导致平均修复时间（MTTR）高、运维疲劳严重，检测与解决之间缺乏闭环。
AI.method: AegisFlow由Watchdog代理采集运行时遥测数据，Repair代理基于大语言模型自动创建、测试并部署代码补丁；框架采用基于MAPE-K循环的非侵入式执行模型——并行影子补丁（Parallel Shadow Patching），在数字孪生环境中生成与验证补丁，并以插件方式部署到现有管道编排系统中。
AI.result: 在五类常见故障场景中，MTTR从平均每补丁170分钟降至3.2分钟，改善98.1%，补丁成功率92%；其中JSON模式变更场景成功率96%、标点漂移98%、Shadow DOM场景最低为85%；约98%的数据工程待命时间从救火转向创新工作。
AI.conclusion: AegisFlow通过代理式闭环修复显著降低数据管道运维成本与MTTR，且部署无关、可插件化集成，对现有系统改动极小。

title: Mask-Guided KV Cache Eviction in Block Diffusion Language Models
summary: Block diffusion language models keep a large key-value (KV) cache throughout generation and attend to it at every denoising step, limiting both memory capacity and generation speed. Reducing these costs requires deciding which past tokens to use for denoising the current block (selection) and which to keep in memory for future blocks (eviction). We propose MaskAhead, a training-free method that solves both tasks with a single mask-query-based ranking mechanism. Current-block masks guide selection, while probes of upcoming masked blocks guide eviction. Both rank KV entries by their estimated contribution to the attention output. Our quantized variant, Q-MaskAhead, computes selection and attention directly from low-bit KV, largely preserving the selected entries. Experiments on Fast-dLLM-v2, DreamReasoner, and LLaDA2.0-mini cover long-generation reasoning, long-prompt question answering, and needle-in-a-haystack retrieval. On long-prompt QA, MaskAhead reduces KV memory by $9.5\times$ on average with a 1.2-point mean F1 loss relative to dense inference. Q-MaskAhead increases the reduction to $20.1\times$ with a 2.3-point mean F1 loss. In a batch-32 systems profile, MaskAhead achieves $1.23\times$ end-to-end and $1.68\times$ decode-stage speedups over dense inference.

AI.tldr: 提出MaskAhead，一种基于掩码查询排序的无训练方法，同时解决块扩散语言模型中KV缓存的选留与逐出问题，并给出量化变体Q-MaskAhead，实现显著内存压缩与推理加速。
AI.motivation: 块扩散语言模型在生成过程中维护庞大的KV缓存，并在每次去噪步骤中对全部缓存做注意力，导致显存容量和生成速度受限。要降低开销，需要决定两类问题：当前块去噪时使用哪些历史token（selection），以及未来块应保留哪些KV条目（eviction）。
AI.method: 提出MaskAhead，一种免训练方法，用统一的基于mask-query的排序机制同时完成selection与eviction：当前块的mask用于引导selection，对后续被掩码块的探测（probe）用于引导eviction；两者均按KV条目对注意力输出的估计贡献进行排序。量化变体Q-MaskAhead直接从低位KV计算selection与注意力，基本保持所选条目的效果。
AI.result: 在Fast-dLLM-v2、DreamReasoner与LLaDA2.0-mini上验证，覆盖长生成推理、长提示问答与大海捞针检索。长提示问答任务中，MaskAhead相比稠密推理平均减少KV内存9.5倍，平均F1仅下降1.2个点；Q-MaskAhead将压缩提升至20.1倍，平均F1下降2.3个点。在batch-32系统测试中，MaskAhead相比稠密推理取得1.23倍端到端与1.68倍解码阶段加速。
AI.conclusion: MaskAhead以单一掩码查询排序机制统一了块扩散语言模型中的KV selection与eviction，在免训练前提下大幅降低KV内存占用并提升推理速度，量化版本进一步扩大压缩比，验证了该类方法在长上下文与长生成场景中的有效性。

title: Beyond Refusal Patterns: Safe-Role Internalization for Robust and Generalizable LLM Safety Alignment
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) have achieved remarkable capabilities but remain vulnerable to jailbreak attacks that elicit harmful or unsafe outputs. Existing safety alignment approaches, including Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) and Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF), often require substantial attack-specific supervision and computational resources, while remaining susceptible to shallow safety alignment and over-refusal. To address these challenges, we introduce SSRFT(Supervised Safe-Role Fine-Tuning), the first framework that reformulates safety alignment as the internalization of a predefined safe role. SSRFT constructs a Safe-Role Question-Answer (SRQA) dataset from psychometric questions, limited jailbreak prompts, and a safe-role description. Role-consistent responses are synthesized, validated, and expanded into diverse scenarios, enabling models to internalize safety-oriented values and principles rather than explicit refusal patterns. Experiments across multiple Base and Instruct models show that SSRFT achieves more robust and generalizable safety alignment than standard SFT. SSRFT shows substantially greater robustness to prefilling attacks and better generalization to unseen jailbreak domains, while reducing over-refusal on benign queries and preserving the model's general capabilities. These results establish safe-role internalization as an effective alternative to refusal-centric safety alignment. Warning: This paper contains examples of harmful and toxic language.

AI.tldr: 提出 SSRFT 框架，将安全对齐重塑为"安全角色"内化，通过 SRQA 数据集实现比标准 SFT 更鲁棒、更泛化的安全对齐，同时降低过度拒答。
AI.motivation: 现有安全对齐方法（SFT、RLHF）依赖大量攻击专属监督与计算资源，且存在浅层安全对齐与过度拒答问题，亟需更高效、更鲁棒的对齐范式。
AI.method: SSRFT 构建 Safe-Role Question-Answer（SRQA）数据集，来源包括心理测量学问题、少量越狱提示和安全角色描述；合成、验证并扩展角色一致的回答到多样场景，使模型内化安全导向的价值观与原则，而非显式的拒答模式。
AI.result: 在多种 Base 与 Instruct 模型上，SSRFT 的安全对齐比标准 SFT 更鲁棒、更可泛化；对 prefilling 攻击抵抗力显著更强，对未见越狱领域泛化更好，同时减少对良性查询的过度拒答并保留通用能力。
AI.conclusion: 安全角色内化可作为以拒答为中心的安全对齐的有效替代方案。

title: Learning to Simulate Individuals from Macro Social Signals
summary: Large language models are increasingly used to simulate how individuals respond to new situations, yet the behavioral reasoning behind these responses is either inherited from pretraining or learned from individual-level annotations, which offer limited behavioral diversity and little supervision of the reasoning itself. We propose to learn behavioral reasoning from prediction markets, whose price trajectories record how populations respond to real-world events at scale. We introduce macro2mind, which trains a language model with GRPO using market signals. A social behavioral decomposition makes behavioral reasoning an explicit step of forecasting: the model infers representative groups of market participants, predicts how each interprets the news and updates its beliefs, reasons about their interactions, and aggregates these responses into a price. A hindsight-regret curriculum with difficulty-aware sampling focuses training on transitions where hindsight-identified groups substantially improve the forecast while prioritizing examples that remain learnable for the current policy. The learned reasoning applies to user simulation without further training. On SWM-Bench, macro2mind achieves state-of-the-art directional accuracy and correlation on Polymarket. Trained on market data, it transfers zero-shot to four user-simulation benchmarks (Humanual, OvertonBench, PRISM, and CAD) and has competitive performance among zero-shot methods. Used as a data generator, macro2mind also raises a downstream simulator's accuracy on unseen users by 15.5 points, outperforming data generated by its backbone by 13.2 points.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 macro2mind，利用预测市场价格轨迹作为监督信号，通过 GRPO 训练语言模型学习可迁移的行为推理，在 SWM-Bench 上取得最优方向准确率与相关性，并零样本迁移至四个用户模拟基准。
AI.motivation: 现有 LLM 用于模拟个体对新情境的响应时，其行为推理要么继承自预训练，要么依赖个体级标注学习；后者行为多样性有限，且对推理过程本身缺乏监督。预测市场价格轨迹大规模记录了群体如何响应真实事件，可作为行为推理的天然监督来源。
AI.method: 提出 macro2mind，用 GRPO 结合市场信号训练语言模型。核心是社会行为分解：将行为推理显式化为预测步骤——推断有代表性的市场参与者群体，预测各类群体如何解读新闻并更新信念，推理群体间交互，并聚合为价格。训练采用 hindsight-regret 课程与难度感知采样，聚焦于"后验识别的群体能显著改善预测"的转变，并优先选择对当前策略仍可学习的样本。
AI.result: 在 SWM-Bench 的 Polymarket 上，macro2mind 取得最优的方向准确率与相关性。仅用市场数据训练，即可零样本迁移到 Humanual、OvertonBench、PRISM、CAD 四个用户模拟基准，在零样本方法中具备竞争力。作为数据生成器，它使下游模拟器在未见用户上的准确率提升 15.5 个百分点，比其骨干模型生成的数据高出 13.2 个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 预测市场信号可作为行为推理的有效监督，所学的分解式推理无需再训练即可用于用户模拟，并具备跨基准零样本迁移与数据生成能力。

title: A theory of platonic representations in language models
summary: Representations of translated sentences are similar in the inner layers of multilingual language models -- an observation connected to the platonic representation hypothesis, yet unexplained theoretically. We provide an explanation based on the assumption that data have a hidden hierarchical structure whose abstract levels are shared across languages while surface levels are modality- or language-specific. Concretely, we generate synthetic languages from probabilistic context-free grammars sharing upper-level but not lower-level production rules. In this setting the Bayes-optimal next-token predictor is belief propagation (BP); encoding its messages in successive layers yields analytical predictions that agree well with transformers trained on the same data. The framework explains why cross-lingual similarity peaks in middle layers, coexists with language-specific structure, and strengthens with language proximity, model quality and data exposure. It distinguishes similarity (shared neighborhood geometry) from alignment (shared coordinates), showing that the latter occurs when code-switched data, i.e. mixed-language sentences, are abundant enough. It further predicts that subtracting from each layer the component linearly predictable from the preceding one increases cross-lingual similarity, which we confirm in pretrained LLMs.

AI.tldr: 该文通过构建共享上层产生式规则的概率上下文无关文法合成语言，证明贝叶斯最优下一词预测器等价于信念传播（BP），其逐层消息编码可解释多语言模型中间层跨语言相似性现象。
AI.motivation: 多语言模型内层对翻译句子的表征高度相似，这一现象与柏拉图表征假说相关，但缺乏理论解释。作者希望给出一个可分析的生成模型框架，阐明跨语言相似性的来源与边界。
AI.method: 假设数据具有隐藏层级结构：抽象层跨语言共享，表层为特定语言或模态特有。据此用概率上下文无关文法生成合成语言，上层规则共享、下层规则不共享；在此设定下，贝叶斯最优下一词预测器即为信念传播，将其消息映射到逐层表征，得到与同数据训练的Transformer相符的解析预测。
AI.result: 该框架成功解释：跨语言相似性在中间层达到峰值，且与语言特有结构并存；相似性随语言亲缘度、模型质量和数据暴露量增强。并区分相似性（共享邻域几何）与对齐（共享坐标），显示后者需代码混用数据足够丰富时才出现。进一步预测：从每层减去可被前一层线性预测的成分会提升跨语言相似性，并在预训练LLM上得到验证。
AI.conclusion: 跨语言表征相似性可由共享抽象层级与信念传播式逐层推断自然导出，为柏拉图表征假说提供了可检验的理论解释，并给出相似性/对齐的区分与可操作的表征修正方法。

title: CLM-as-a-Judge: Evaluating an Open Contrastive Decision Model on Public Judge Benchmarks
summary: An open contrastive decision model is near chance as a judge on the hard public benchmarks: Contrastive-LM/CLM-v0.1-8B scores between 0.351 (best- of-four, chance 0.250) and 0.593 (pairwise, chance 0.500), is statistically indistinguishable from coin flipping on RM-Bench and JudgeBench, and answers every HaluEval item with one constant label, matching the trivial always-first baseline at 0.581. Judges with the same parameter count score far higher everywhere: a reward model reaches 0.764 to 0.976 and a generative judge 0.611 to 0.778, and every gap to CLM is significant after Benjamini-Hochberg correction. Two properties do work. Raw confidences are overconfident by up to +0.401, yet one pooled temperature fit on held-out calibration items repairs expected calibration error to at most 0.062, and the repaired confidence ranks the model's own errors above chance on three of six benchmarks. The decision order-flip rate is 0.0002 against 0.2188 for the generative judge, and the length-preference shift is -0.023 against -0.217. The confidence-gated cascade, however, escalates between 0.923 and 1.000 of items to the strong judge at the preregistered 0.97 retention bar: calibrated confidence about a near-chance judge has almost nothing to keep. The design: five public preference benchmarks and one hallucination benchmark with real labels, scored under a preregistration frozen before any test item was seen, against generative, reward-model, and trivial baselines, with per-item predictions released.

AI.tldr: 该论文评测了一个开放对比决策模型（CLM-v0.1-8B）作为评判者的能力，结果发现其在多个公开基准上接近随机猜测水平，显著低于同类参数规模的奖励模型与生成式评判者；但模型的原始置信度经校准后可具备一定诊断价值，且几乎不存在顺序与长度偏好偏差。
AI.motivation: 检验"开放对比决策模型"能否作为可靠的自动评判者（judge / LLM-as-a-judge），并在与生成式评判者、奖励模型及平凡基线（如always-first）的对照中，厘清其真实性能边界与可用属性，为级联式评测系统提供经验证据。
AI.method: 在五个公开偏好基准与一个真实标签的幻觉基准上进行评测；采用在任何测试样本被接触前冻结的预注册方案；对照基线为生成式评判者、奖励模型与平凡基线；报告逐项预测；使用Benjamini-Hochberg校正进行显著性检验；通过留出校准集拟合单一温度参数来修复置信度校准；并考察顺序翻转率、长度偏好偏移以及置信门控级联策略。
AI.result: CLM在困难公开基准上接近随机：得分为0.351（四选一，随机0.250）至0.593（成对，随机0.500）；在RM-Bench与JudgeBench上与掷硬币无统计差异；在HaluEval上对所有项目输出同一恒定标签，与平凡always-first基线0.581持平。同参数规模的奖励模型达0.764–0.976，生成式评判者达0.611–0.778，且所有与CLM的差距在BH校正后均显著。原始置信度过高最多达+0.401，但池化温度校准将期望校准误差修复至至多0.062，且修复后置信度在六个基准中的三个上能以高于随机的水平排序自身错误。顺序翻转率为0.0002（生成式评判者为0.2188），长度偏好偏移为-0.023（生成式评判者为-0.217）。置信门控级联在预注册的0.97保留阈值下，将0.923–1.000的项目升级至强评判者。
AI.conclusion: 该开放对比决策模型作为独立评判者几乎不具备判别能力，其校准后的置信度对近乎随机的评判者而言也几乎没有可保留的信息，导致级联策略几乎全部升级；但其极低的顺序与长度偏好偏差表明模型具有一定稳定性。整体而言，这类模型目前不适合作为可靠评测者，置信度校准的价值受限于底层判别能力本身。

title: Learning Scientific Exploration from Human Research Decision Trajectories
summary: A key challenge in building AI systems for scientific research is enabling $\textit{scientific exploration}$: the systematic process of investigating unknown phenomena or ideas to gain new knowledge through sequences of research decisions and actions. Yet this process is largely missing from existing scientific corpora; for example, research papers primarily record final outcomes rather than the trajectories that produced them. In this work, we introduce $\textbf{ResearchTrails}$, a dataset of $\textbf{human research trajectories constructed from Git repositories}$, where $\textbf{commit histories}$ serve as proxies for research exploration. We develop an automated and scalable pipeline that extracts structured research trajectories from repository commits, capturing successive changes to methods, experiments, and ablations. We characterize the resulting dataset and show that these trajectories contain meaningful signals about intermediate research decisions beyond what final papers reveal. We further demonstrate utilities of ResearchTrails in multiple use cases, including retrieving human research experience as external skills at test time and training models on research trajectories to improve generalization to new research decisions. Our results suggest a path toward AI systems that learn not only from the products of science, but from the evolving process of discovery itself.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了 ResearchTrails，一个从 Git 仓库提交历史中自动提取的人类科研探索轨迹数据集，用以弥补现有科学语料仅记录最终成果、缺失探索过程的不足，并验证了其在经验检索与模型训练上的实用价值。
AI.motivation: 构建面向科学研究的 AI 系统需要支持"科学探索"，即在未知现象或想法上通过一系列研究决策与行动系统性地获取新知识。但现有科学语料几乎不包含这一过程：论文通常只记录最终结果，而非产生结果的探索轨迹。因此作者希望构建能反映研究探索过程的数据资源。
AI.method: 作者构建了 ResearchTrails 数据集，以 Git 仓库的提交历史（commit histories）作为研究探索的代理，并开发了一套自动化、可扩展的流水线，从仓库提交中抽取结构化的研究轨迹，捕捉方法、实验与消融实验的逐次变化。随后对数据集进行刻画，并设计多个用例进行验证，包括在测试时将人类研究经验作为外部技能检索，以及在研究轨迹上训练模型以提升对新研究决策的泛化能力。
AI.result: 数据集刻画显示，这些轨迹包含了关于中间研究决策的有意义信号，且这些信号超出了最终论文所揭示的内容。多个用例表明 ResearchTrails 具有实用价值：既可用于检索人类研究经验作为推理时的外部技能，也可用于训练模型以更好地泛化到新的研究决策。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果表明，AI 系统不仅可以从科学的"产物"中学习，还可以从发现过程本身这一不断演化的轨迹中学习，为构建真正支持科学探索的 AI 系统提供了一条可行路径。

title: Minimal Witness Reinforcement Learning
summary: ``What are the irreducible conditions that are sufficient to produce an outcome?'' is one of the most common questions that recur across computation and science. Its answers, the minimal sufficient witnesses, are what we mean by explanations, mechanisms and reasons. These problems usually ask for multiple minimal witnesses, yet standard RL methods may reveal only one solution or redundant ones. We formalize this problem as minimal-witness identification and introduce Minimal-Witness Reinforcement Learning (MWRL). MWRL takes the union of the sets certified by successful proposals sampled from the policy and credits each proposal for the coverage the group union would lose without that proposal. This credit assignment, derived directly from the problem definition, unifies the demands for minimality and recovery of alternatives from a single black-box verifier bit. Under this principle, we derive a value iteration planner that recovers the entire family of witnesses and a policy gradient method that can scale to large language models. Across different experimental settings, MWRL recovers most minimal witnesses, while other methods return redundant supersets or a single witness. By making witness families learnable from verifier feedback, MWRL expands the scope of reinforcement learning beyond single-solution optimization. Our code is available at https://github.com/TSUITUENYUE/MWRL.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"最小见证识别"问题与MWRL方法，通过集合覆盖式信用分配从单一验证器反馈中学习整个最小见证族。
AI.motivation: "产生某个结果的最小充分条件"是计算与科学中的常见问题，其答案即最小充分见证（可理解为解释、机制、原因）。这类问题通常需要多个最小见证，但标准强化学习往往只找到一个解或返回冗余解，缺乏获得全部最小见证的机制。
AI.method: 作者将问题形式化为"最小见证识别"，并提出最小见证强化学习（MWRL）。MWRL取策略采样到的成功提案所认证集合的并集，并按"若去掉某提案该并集覆盖会损失多少"给予信用。该信用分配直接由问题定义导出，用一个黑盒验证器比特同时满足最小性与替代方案恢复两个需求。在此原则下推导出可恢复整个见证族的值迭代规划器，以及可扩展到大语言模型的策略梯度方法。
AI.result: 在不同实验设置下，MWRL能恢复大部分最小见证，而对比方法只能返回冗余超集或单一见证。
AI.conclusion: MWRL使见证族可从验证器反馈中学习，将强化学习的适用范围扩展到单解优化之外。

title: Structuring MoE Expert Selection for Agentic Reinforcement Learning
summary: Long-horizon LLM agents are frequently implemented using sparse mixture-of-experts (MoE) models, yet the co-design of agentic behavior and MoE structures remains underexplored. In this work, we comprehensively study the connections between agentic post-training and MoE expert selection. In off-the-shelf MoE models, we observe expert selection exhibits a specialized structure that naturally aligns with agentic trajectories. Specifically, expert routing overlaps more between turns where the agent performs semantically similar operations (e.g., READ, UPDATE) than between turns with differing operations. However, standard RL algorithms ignore this specialization, allowing the MoE routing to go uncontrolled during training, which empirically limit task performance and inference efficiency. To address this, we introduce a hierarchical routing control framework for agentic tasks. We explicitly encourage turn-level expert selections to align with agentic operations while regularizing token-level expert selections to maintain local consistency. To resolve stability issues that arise during post-training with the proposed methods, we further introduce an entropy-gated control mechanism. Overall, our routing control framework achieves over 10-point improvements in success rate on all evaluated benchmarks. These results demonstrate that agentic trajectory structure provides an effective signal for optimizing MoE capacity during RL post-training.

AI.tldr: 本文研究智能体后训练与MoE专家选择的关系，发现专家路由与智能体操作语义对齐，提出分层路由控制框架并取得超10个点成功率提升。
AI.motivation: 长时程LLM智能体常基于稀疏MoE模型实现，但智能体行为与MoE结构的协同设计尚缺乏研究。现成MoE模型的专家选择呈现与智能体轨迹自然对齐的专门化结构，而标准RL算法忽略这种专门化，导致训练中MoE路由失控，实证上限制了任务性能与推理效率。
AI.method: 提出面向智能体任务的分层路由控制框架：在turn层面明确鼓励专家选择与智能体操作（如READ、UPDATE）对齐，同时在token层面正则化专家选择以保持局部一致性；针对后训练中的稳定性问题，进一步引入熵门控控制机制。
AI.result: 路由控制框架在所有评估基准上取得超过10个点的成功率提升；实验表明智能体轨迹结构为RL后训练中优化MoE容量提供了有效信号。
AI.conclusion: 智能体轨迹结构与MoE专家路由存在自然对齐关系，通过分层路由控制与熵门控机制可有效利用该结构信号，显著提升智能体任务性能，验证了智能体行为与MoE结构协同设计的价值。

title: Stepped MoE: Segment-Level Routing with Configurable Inference Complexity
comment: Apple Foundation Models, 15 Pages, Edge LLMs
summary: Training large language models (LLMs) is resource-intensive, and adapting them for diverse deployment scenarios with varying computational constraints remains challenging. While elastic architectures enable flexible model deployment and sparsely activated models allow input-adaptive computation, existing approaches treat these dimensions independently. Moreover, models catered towards on-device edge inference need to conform to the memory and compute limitations of the serving devices. In this paper, we introduce a unified framework that combines elastic structures with sparsely gated architectures to create models that adapt simultaneously to both deployment constraints and task requirements. Our approach employs a model backbone that conditions on both the context and target efficiency specifications, enabling fine-grained control over the accuracy-efficiency trade-off at inference time. The model learns to activate task-relevant parameters within elastically-nested sub-networks, allowing a single model to span multiple capacity points while maintaining input-adaptive routing. Through experiments we demonstrate that we can create a model that allows the flexibility to use 1,2,3,4 billion parameters while being more accurate than their dense counter-parts (2-5\% on knowledge-intensive benchmarks) and at par with their static versions while delivering similar latency metrics as dense models. Overall, we save on device disk space by sharing the model parameters, allow flexibility of serving based on DRAM and compute available while delivering more accurate results.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一种统一框架，将弹性结构与稀疏门控架构结合，使单一模型能同时适配部署约束和任务需求，在1–4B参数间灵活伸缩。
AI.motivation: LLM训练资源消耗大，面向不同算力约束的部署场景适配困难。弹性架构支持灵活部署，稀疏激活模型支持输入自适应计算，但现有方法将这两个维度独立处理；且面向端侧推理的模型需满足服务设备的内存与算力限制。
AI.method: 构建以上下文和目标效率规格为条件的模型骨干，实现推理时对精度-效率权衡的细粒度控制；模型在弹性嵌套子网络内学习激活任务相关参数，使单模型覆盖多个容量点，同时保持输入自适应路由。
AI.result: 单一模型可在1、2、3、4B参数间灵活切换，在知识密集型基准上比稠密对应模型高2–5%，与静态版本持平，延迟与稠密模型相近。
AI.conclusion: 通过共享模型参数节省设备磁盘空间，可依据DRAM和可用算力灵活服务，并给出更准确的结果。

title: AlignQuant: Tile-Aligned Mixed-Precision Quantization for Efficient LLM Generation
summary: Fine-grained mixed-precision quantization promises efficient large language model inference, but local precision choices can conflict with regular GPU storage and computation units. This precision-boundary mismatch limits the translation of compression into practical acceleration. We introduce AlignQuant, a post-training quantization method that uses GPU-compatible two-dimensional weight tiles as the common unit of precision allocation, compact storage, and execution. This shared partition lets precision follow sensitivity within output channels. Joint prefill/decode calibration scores precision reductions using projection-output perturbations weighted by language-model loss gradients under quantized activations. Phase-normalized scores prioritize higher precision for tiles important to either phase under a model-wide weight-storage budget. Each tile stores one selected representation, while phase-specialized kernels reuse the packed model and expand lower-bit weights for INT8 computation with 8-bit activations. Across four LLMs spanning 3B to 14B parameters, AlignQuant achieves up to $2.50\times$ generation speedup over BF16 while preserving model quality. Evaluations further cover three GPUs and contexts up to 64K tokens. These results show that local precision flexibility and regular GPU execution can coexist through a shared tile unit. The implementation is available at https://github.com/HanzhiZhang-Ulrica/AlignQuant.

AI.tldr: AlignQuant提出以GPU兼容的二维权重分块作为精度分配、紧凑存储与执行的统一单元，实现细粒度混合精度后训练量化，在3B–14B的四个LLM上最高获2.50倍生成加速并保持模型质量。
AI.motivation: 细粒度混合精度量化有望提升LLM推理效率，但局部精度选择与GPU规则的存储/计算单元存在冲突，导致精度边界不匹配，压缩难以转化为实际加速。
AI.method: 采用GPU兼容的二维权重tile作为精度分配、紧凑存储和执行的共同单元；校准中联合prefill/decode，以量化激活下投影输出扰动配合语言模型损失梯度打分；相位归一化打分在全局权重存储预算下为对任一相位重要的tile分配更高精度；每个tile存储单一选定表示，相位专用kernel复用打包模型并将低位权重展开为INT8计算，激活为8-bit。
AI.result: 在3B至14B参数的四个LLM上，相比BF16最高取得2.50倍生成加速，同时保持模型质量；评估覆盖三种GPU及最长64K token上下文。
AI.conclusion: 通过共享tile单元，局部精度灵活性与规则GPU执行可以共存。

title: Auditable Claims about AI Agents
summary: Organizations make claims about their AI agents: a person approves every external email, every action is logged, an evaluation shows the agent is safe to deploy. Article 12 of the EU AI Act requires high-risk systems to allow the automatic recording of events but does not say which records settle a given claim. The position is one sentence: to be checked, a claim about an agent must first name its policy, its scope, the records that would settle it, and who writes them. Adapting the preconditions of an assurance engagement, we call a claim auditable when these elements and a decision rule are fixed before any verdict and the records are obtainable. This extends the Policy Checkability dimension of our Auditable Agents framework from single actions to claims. Agents add three conditions: coverage by an independent record, authorization bound to each action's arguments, and completeness beyond integrity. Under an explicit model, we prove that support is impossible without each wherever its hypotheses hold. A claim-check table applies the method to six common claims, anchored in current NIST, IETF, and OWASP drafts. A worked case follows one claim through five evidence states. We close with a practice box and steps for operators, buyers, auditors, and standard setters.

AI.tldr: 提出"可审计声明"框架：对AI agent的声明进行核查前，须先固定其策略、范围、可用于裁决的记录及记录撰写者，并将"策略可核查性"维度从单一动作扩展到声明层面。
AI.motivation: 组织对AI agent作出各类声明（如每封外部邮件均经人工批准、每个动作均有日志、评估显示可安全部署），但EU AI Act第12条仅要求高风险系统支持事件自动记录，未规定哪些记录能裁决特定声明，导致声明难以被实际核查。
AI.method: 借用鉴证业务（assurance engagement）的前提条件，定义声明"可审计"的条件：在任何裁决作出前固定上述要素及裁决规则，且记录可获取；针对agent额外提出三项条件——独立记录覆盖、授权与每个动作参数绑定、超出完整性的完备性；在显式模型下证明缺一不可。方法具体化为声明-核查表，应用于六类常见声明，并以一个案例贯穿五种证据状态。
AI.result: 在显式模型下证明：在假设成立之处，缺少独立记录覆盖、参数绑定授权或完备性任一条件，声明支持均不可能；声明-核查表对六类常见声明给出应用示例，并与现行NIST、IETF、OWASP草案相衔接；案例展示了单一声明在五种证据状态下的演进。
AI.conclusion: 提出可操作的实践框与步骤，面向运营方、采购方、审计方与标准制定者，推动AI agent声明的可核查性制度化。

title: In With the Old: Enhancing 'Classical' Document Automation with Generative AI
comment: 10 pages. AI for Access to Justice Workshop at ICAIL 2025
summary: Software-based legal assistance systems have leveraged many different forms of knowledge representation and reasoning. This article explores how document automation services rooted in expert system style and other symbolic approaches can usefully enhance and be enhanced by current generative AI approaches. We discuss the possible benefits and challenges, and report on preliminary experiments in using large language models to identify and fix issues in texts written by laypeople.

AI.tldr: 该文探讨基于专家系统等符号方法的文档自动化服务与当前生成式AI如何相互增强，分析其潜在收益与挑战，并报告使用大语言模型识别与修正非专业人士所撰法律文本问题的初步实验。
AI.motivation: 软件法律辅助系统已采用多种知识表示与推理形式，符号方法与生成式AI各有优劣，亟需明确二者结合的价值与可行路径。
AI.method: 以专家系统风格及其他符号方法为基础的文档自动化服务为出发点，概念性分析其与生成式AI结合的收益与挑战；并开展初步实验，利用大语言模型识别与修正外行撰写的法律文本中的问题。
AI.result: 报告了使用大语言模型识别并修正非专业人士法律文本问题的初步实验结果。
AI.conclusion: 符号式文档自动化与生成式AI可以相互增强，具有提升法律辅助服务质量的潜力，但仍面临相应挑战，需进一步研究。

title: On Open-Ended Information Seeking for Information Elicitation Agents
summary: Information elicitation is an open-ended information-seeking problem in which an interaction can unfold in many potentially valuable directions, requiring an elicitor to continually determine which information to pursue as new information emerges. In agentic elicitation, these decisions may be delegated to a foundation model, yet how model choice shapes the resulting information-seeking behavior remains understudied. We study how judgments about information value vary across LLMs and how these differences shape sequential information seeking. We first examine these judgments across 11 LLMs spanning multiple model families and parameter scales, using a shared set of information and elicitation objectives. We then develop a controlled elicitation simulation in which different models encounter the same information space and use the same selection rule, isolating these judgments from question generation and respondent behavior. Using this setting, we characterize the breadth-depth behavior that emerges from model-specific information-seeking preferences over the course of elicitation. We further examine how interaction history changes the evaluation and subsequent selection of prospective information. We test the robustness and boundaries of these findings through sensitivity analyses and ablations over the opportunities available to the elicitor, the response labels used to operationalize information-seeking preferences, the presence of interaction history, and whether redundancy is explicitly relevant to the assessment. The project code, data, and trajectory files are available at https://github.com/infosenselab/open-elicitation.

AI.tldr: 研究11个大模型在信息价值判断上的差异，并通过受控模拟揭示这些差异如何塑造顺序式信息寻求的广度-深度行为。
AI.motivation: 信息获取是开放式信息寻求问题，交互可能向多个有价值方向发展，需要持续判断应追寻哪些信息。在智能体信息获取中，决策可委托给基础模型，但模型选择如何影响信息寻求行为仍缺乏研究。
AI.method: 首先在共享信息集与获取目标下，考察11个大模型（跨多模型家族、多参数规模）的信息价值判断；随后构建受控获取模拟，让不同模型面对同一信息空间并使用相同选择规则，将判断与问题生成、受访者行为分离；再刻画模型特异信息寻求偏好所导致的广度-深度行为，并考察交互历史如何改变对候选信息的评估与后续选择；最后通过敏感性分析与消融实验检验机会数量、响应标签、交互历史、冗余相关性等边界条件。
AI.result: 不同LLM在信息价值判断上存在系统性差异，并在受控模拟中表现为不同的广度-深度信息寻求行为；交互历史会改变对候选信息的评估与选择；上述发现对机会可用性、响应标签操作化方式、交互历史存在与否以及冗余相关性等条件具有一定稳健性与边界。
AI.conclusion: 模型选择会系统影响智能体信息获取的展开方式，研究为理解与设计基于基础模型的信息获取系统提供了受控证据，并公开了代码、数据与轨迹文件以便复现。

title: LOGIC: An LLM Benchmark for Intent-Grounded Change Impact in Aerospace Electrical Systems
summary: Aerospace electrical-design revisions can contain multiple genuine changes, although an engineering request may authorize only a subset. Propagating every detected difference can therefore produce overly broad impact reports. We present LOGIC, a controlled benchmark and evaluation framework in which locally deployable language models ground a request in a deterministic candidate-change inventory before selected changes are propagated through a typed electrical traceability graph. This separation permits candidate-selection errors to be distinguished from downstream propagation errors. LOGIC contains 168 scenarios, including 144 selection and 24 abstention cases. We evaluate three 7--8B models against intent-agnostic, lexical, and structured-evidence methods, with an oracle-root upper bound. On 96 explicitly anchored selection cases, gate-only structured evidence achieves candidate F1 of 1.0000, compared with 0.9677 for token-lexical matching. On 12 relational-paraphrase cases, token-lexical F1 is 0.1772 and gate-only F1 is 0.0000, compared with 0.5000--0.6400 for the large language models. Model grounding degrades as candidate inventories grow from 4 to 64 changes, while affected-element and typed-path accuracy remain comparatively stable when frozen selections are replayed over graphs of approximately 1K to 100K nodes. Strict evidence gating suppresses false positives but can remove correct semantic selections. An exploratory evidence-empty abstention policy raises strict abstention accuracy to 0.6667 for all three models and reduces unsafe-report rates to 0.1667, while decreasing answerable-case coverage by 16.0--27.1 percentage points. Four of six conflicting requests remain unsafe for each model. These findings support combining literal evidence and language-model reasoning with engineering review when intent cannot be established reliably.

AI.tldr: 提出 LOGIC 基准与评估框架，将请求级候选变更选择与图传播解耦，系统评测本地可部署语言模型在电气设计变更传播中的表现与失效模式。
AI.motivation: 航天电气设计修订常包含多项真实变更，而工程请求可能仅授权其中一部分；若无差别传播所有检测到的差异，会产生范围过大的影响报告。因此需要区分“候选变更选择错误”与“下游传播错误”，并明确语言模型在此类任务中的可靠性边界。
AI.method: LOGIC 包含 168 个场景（144 个选择案例、24 个弃权案例）。方法首先让本地部署语言模型在确定性候选变更清单上定位请求，再通过类型化电气可追溯图传播被选中的变更，从而分离选择错误与传播错误。评测三类 7–8B 模型，对比意图无关、词法匹配、结构化证据方法，并设置 oracle-root 上界。场景类型包含显式锚定、关系改写、证据缺失弃权等，候选规模从 4 到 64，图为约 1K 至 100K 节点。
AI.result: 显式锚定的 96 个案例中，仅门控结构化证据的候选 F1 达 1.0000，词法匹配为 0.9677；12 个关系改写案例中，词法 F1 为 0.1772、仅门控为 0.0000，大模型为 0.5000–0.6400。候选清单从 4 增至 64 时模型 grounding 性能下降，而受影响元素与类型化路径准确率在冻结选择重放于约 1K–100K 节点图上相对稳定。严格证据门控抑制假阳性但会剔除正确的语义选择。探索性证据为空弃权策略将三模型严格弃权准确率提升至 0.6667，将不安全报告率降至 0.1667，但可答案案例覆盖率下降 16.0–27.1 个百分点；六个冲突请求中每模型仍有四个不安全。
AI.conclusion: 应结合字面证据与语言模型推理，并在意图无法可靠确立时引入工程复核；单一证据门控或纯语义推理均不足以保证安全。

title: Stateless Language Agents: Scaling Long-Horizon Automated Research
summary: Automated research systems increasingly run LLM agents over long horizons, but more inference does not by itself produce more progress: agents replay growing histories, duplicate one another's work, or stop experimenting while token consumption continues. Yet most evaluations use short budgets or benchmarks that saturate early, leaving these failure modes untested. We trace these failures to two choices: where research state lives and who decides what to try next. We introduce Stateless Language Agents (SLAs), built on the principle of stateful search with stateless agents: no agent carries its conversation across invocations; instead, the harness owns the research state (candidate solutions and measured outcomes) and reconstructs a fresh and role-specific context for every invocation. What each agent sees becomes an explicit design choice rather than a history that grows with the run. We implement this principle in the SLA framework, where a stateless Advisor reads harness-summarized evidence across search directions and assigns concrete experiments to parallel Workers. We evaluate SLA against three recent frameworks on software engineering, kernel optimization, and algorithm design at budgets of up to one billion tokens. SLA achieves the best final result on every task and reaches the strongest kernel baseline's final performance with over 84% fewer tokens. Ablations from shared checkpoints show that focused contexts and explicit assignments each contribute to SLA's progress, with effects that can compound over full runs, while the Advisor consumes less than 0.6% of tokens. These results argue for SLAs, which keep durable research state out of agent conversations, and show that short evaluation horizons can misjudge research systems and their components.

AI.tldr: 提出无状态语言智能体（SLAs）范式：由框架持有研究状态，每次调用为智能体重建全新、角色专属上下文，避免长程搜索中历史膨胀、重复劳动与无效实验。在软件工程、内核优化与算法设计任务上，最高10亿token预算下均取得最优结果，达到最强内核基线性能时token消耗减少84%以上。
AI.motivation: 自动化研究系统让LLM智能体进行长程搜索，但增加推理量并不等于进展：智能体会重放不断增长的历史、重复他人工作，或在token持续消耗时停止实验。多数评测使用短预算或过早饱和的基准，无法暴露这些失效模式。作者将失效归因于两个设计选择：研究状态存放在哪里，以及由谁决定下一步尝试什么。
AI.method: 提出"有状态搜索 + 无状态智能体"原则：智能体不跨调用携带对话，由harness持有研究状态（候选解与测量结果），并为每次调用重建全新、角色专属的上下文。在SLA框架中实现：无状态Advisor读取harness汇总的跨搜索方向证据并分配具体实验，多个并行Worker执行实验。
AI.result: 在软件工程、内核优化、算法设计三类任务、最高10亿token预算下，SLA在每个任务上均取得最佳最终结果，并以减少84%以上的token达到最强内核基线的最终性能。来自共享检查点的消融实验表明，聚焦上下文与显式任务分配各自均有贡献，且效果可在完整运行中累积放大；Advisor仅消耗不到0.6%的token。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持采用SLAs，将持久研究状态置于智能体对话之外；并表明短评测周期可能误判研究系统及其组件的真实能力。

title: Loud and Clear: Dynamic Activation Steering for Improving Speech Intelligibility in Noisy Environments
summary: Speech becomes less intelligible in noisy environments, and humans naturally adapt their voice to compensate. Inspired by this behavior, we investigate whether a text-to-speech (TTS) model can be guided to produce more intelligible speech using activation steering, without retraining. We focus on two characteristics of the Lombard effect: increased vocal effort and hyper-articulation. We introduce a prompt-relative steering mechanism that prevents steering effects from accumulating during generation while allowing their strength to be adjusted dynamically. Across seen and unseen speakers and multiple languages, our method produces systematic changes in Lombard-related acoustic features, preserves speaker similarity (89-95%), and reduces WER under background noise by 7-22% at 1 dB SNR. These results show that pretrained TTS models can be dynamically controlled to generate more intelligible speech without retraining.

AI.tldr: 提出一种prompt-relative激活引导机制，无需重训练即可控制预训练TTS模型生成更具可懂度的语音，模拟Lombard效应。
AI.motivation: 语音在噪声环境中可懂度下降，人类会自然调整发声（Lombard效应）来补偿。研究者希望探索能否借鉴该行为，在不重训练的前提下引导TTS模型生成更可懂的语音。
AI.method: 聚焦Lombard效应的两个特征——增加发声力度与超清晰发音；提出prompt-relative steering机制，避免引导效应在生成过程中累积，同时支持动态调整引导强度；在已见与未见说话人及多语言上验证。
AI.result: 方法系统性地改变了Lombard相关声学特征，保持89-95%的说话人相似度，并在1 dB SNR背景噪声下将WER降低7-22%。
AI.conclusion: 预训练TTS模型可被动态控制，在无需重训练的情况下生成更具可懂度的语音。

title: Where Rules End and Judges Begin: Measuring the Judgment Boundary in Multi-Agent Systems Security
summary: LLM-based multi-agent systems (MAS) engage tools, share memory, and delegate tasks, often encountering adversarial content. Current defenses for MAS are typically evaluated in isolation, focusing on one attack type at a time, which can lead to costly and hard-to-audit outcomes. This study organizes defenses into five principles, implementing them as DEFER1 (DEterministic-First Enforcement with Residual judgment), which includes a cascade of 28 checks that blocks what it can and refers the rest to a panel of four judges. In independent testing across four domains, attack success rates drop from about 30.0% to approximately 3.0%, with 78% of blocked attacks handled by deterministic checks. Only a quarter of proposals reach the judges in the security-operations domain, illustrating that the rules provide security for attacks violating clear policies, while judges manage those that only misrepresent intent. Both systems have weaknesses, such as a risk-score approval gate that inaccurately approves most attack proposals but few legitimate ones, highlighting the challenges in assessing threats accurately.

AI.tldr: 本文提出将LLM多智能体系统(MAS)的防御组织为五项原则，并实现为DEFER1（确定性优先执行+残余判断），通过28项检查级联与四评审小组组合，将攻击成功率从约30%降至约3%，并指出风险评分审批门等部件存在误判弱点。
AI.motivation: LLM驱动的多智能体系统会调用工具、共享记忆、委派任务，因而容易接触对抗性内容。现有MAS防御通常在孤立条件下评估，一次只针对一种攻击类型，导致成本高且难以审计，缺乏统一、可组合的防御框架。
AI.method: 将防御归纳为五项原则，并实现为DEFER1（确定性优先执行与残余判断）：采用28项检查的级联结构，先由确定性检查尽可能拦截，无法判定者转交给由四个评审组成的评审小组进行判断。
AI.result: 在四个领域的独立测试中，攻击成功率由约30.0%降至约3.0%；被拦截攻击中有78%由确定性检查处理。在安全运营领域，仅四分之一的提案会到达评审环节。确定性规则负责拦截明显违反政策的攻击，评审负责处理仅曲解意图的攻击。两类机制均存在弱点，例如风险评分审批门会错误批准大多数攻击提案，却只批准少数合法提案。
AI.conclusion: 分层防御（确定性检查+评审判断）能显著降低MAS的攻击成功率，并可审计、可组合；但威胁评估仍具挑战，某些组件（如风险评分审批门）的判断准确性不足，说明防御组件需要更精细的校准与评估。

title: Improving Synthetic Data Generation for Argument Mining via Adversarial Reinforcement Learning
summary: Argument Mining (AM) is fundamentally constrained by the scarcity of high-quality structure-annotated datasets. While LLMs have shown promise in synthetic data generation, producing synthetic AM data that is both structurally accurate and sufficiently diverse remains a challenging problem. To address this problem, we revisit synthetic data generation for AM from a new perspective and propose a novel adversarial reinforcement learning framework for data synthesis.
