AI.tldr: DBRAG：面向多表问答的检索增强生成框架，通过离线表索引检索候选表、用查询相关行增强摘要、LLM重排序，再由程序辅助推理器选表并执行操作，在Spider、GeoQuery、ATIS上提升表检索与多表问答效果。
AI.motivation: 现有基于程序辅助工具的表分析方法多局限于单表场景，或假设相关表已给定；而实际中用户常对整个数据库提出复杂探索查询，相关信息可能分布在多个关系中，因此需要面向多表问答的方法。
AI.method: DBRAG包含四个环节：(1)用离线表索引检索候选表；(2)用查询相关的行增强候选表的摘要；(3)用LLM对候选表重排序；(4)程序辅助推理器选择所需表并在其完整内容上执行操作，从而保持初始提示上下文紧凑。
AI.result: 在Spider、GeoQuery和ATIS数据集上的实验表明，表检索和多表问答性能均有提升。
AI.conclusion: DBRAG验证了检索增强生成框架在多表问答上的有效性，能够在大规模数据库场景下同时提升表检索质量与问答准确性，并有效控制提示上下文规模。

title: Token-Budgeted Escalation for Financial Document QA: Cost Is Predictable, Benefit Is the Bottleneck
comment: 6 pages, 3 figures, 6 tables. Code and aggregate artifacts: https://github.com/junru-zhu/token-budgeted-escalation-financial-qa
summary: Retrieval-augmented generation systems can route difficult queries to deeper context, but batch deployments must allocate a shared token budget across calls whose costs vary by query. We formulate selective escalation as finite-batch allocation for financial document question answering. Each of 150 FinanceBench questions first receives a top-1 retrieval answer. Predictors estimate the adjudication-quality gain and token cost of an optional top-5 call, and the allocator prioritizes calls by predicted gain per token. At the nominal 10% budget, gain-per-token allocation improves adjudication quality over gain-only ranking by 0.034 (95% document-bootstrap CI [0.001, 0.072]) while using 46.6% fewer total tokens than one-pass top-5 retrieval. Additional-call cost is accurately predictable (R-squared 0.93), whereas beneficial escalation remains difficult to rank (AUROC 0.60). These results show that heterogeneous cost is actionable under tight constraints, while progress across the full budget frontier depends on stronger query-specific benefit estimates.

AI.tldr: 本文将金融文档问答中的选择性升级（selective escalation）形式化为有限批次token预算分配问题：对150个FinanceBench问题，先用预测器估计可选top-5调用的裁决质量增益与token成本，再按"每token预测增益"优先分配调用；在10%名义预算下，该策略相比仅按增益排序提升裁决质量0.034，同时比一次性top-5检索少用46.6% token。
AI.motivation: 检索增强生成系统可将困难查询路由到更深上下文，但批次部署需在成本因查询而异的多次调用间共享固定token预算。现有做法缺乏对"是否升级、升级哪些查询"的成本-收益联合权衡机制，因此需要将选择性升级建模为受限预算下的资源分配问题。
AI.method: 在150个FinanceBench问题上，先对每个问题执行top-1检索得到答案；训练预测器估计可选top-5调用的两项属性——裁决质量增益（benefit）与token成本（cost）；分配器依据"预测增益/预测token"对候选调用排序，在共享token预算约束下优先执行高性价比调用，并与仅按增益排序、一次性top-5检索等基线对比。
AI.result: 在10%名义预算下，gain-per-token分配使裁决质量较gain-only排序提升0.034（95% document-bootstrap CI [0.001, 0.072]），同时总token消耗较one-pass top-5检索减少46.6%。附加调用的token成本可被高精度预测（R²=0.93），但"是否有益升级"难以排序（AUROC=0.60）。
AI.conclusion: 异质成本在紧约束下是可利用的有效信号，按性价比分配优于仅按收益排序；但要在完整预算前沿上取得进一步进展，关键瓶颈在于更准确的查询级收益估计，而非成本预测。

title: Contrastive Learning for Aspect Representation towards Explainable Recommendation
comment: 8 pages. Published in WI-IAT 2025. Best Student Paper Award
summary: In this work, we propose a novel recommendation model, CLARER (Contrastive Learning for Aspect Representation towards Explainable Recommendation) that integrates aspect features learned from textual reviews with rating information to improve the accuracy and explainability of recommendations. Our proposed framework learns user and item representations by combining rating-based features and aspect-based features from reviews. Specifically, rating-based features are learned through a multi-layer perceptron (MLP) model, while aspect-specific review representations are learned using a transformer encoder to capture the semantic information and contrastive learning to better distinguish user preferences. To provide explanations, we train a transformer decoder, using the final representations of users and items from both rating and aspect-based features as context. Experimental results in three benchmark data sets demonstrate that our model achieves superior performance compared to baseline methods in both recommendation (accuracy) and explanation generation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 CLARER 模型，将评论中的方面特征与评分信息融合，以提升推荐准确性与可解释性。
AI.motivation: 提升推荐系统的准确性与可解释性，弥补单纯评分信息在语义与偏好区分上的不足。
AI.method: 融合基于评分的特征与基于评论的方面特征来学习用户和物品表示：评分特征通过多层感知机学习，方面级评论表示使用 Transformer 编码器并结合对比学习；解释生成使用 Transformer 解码器，以用户和物品在评分与方面特征上的最终表示为上下文。
AI.result: 在三个基准数据集上的实验结果表明，该模型在推荐准确性与解释生成方面均优于基线方法。
AI.conclusion: CLARER 通过融合评分与方面特征，并引入对比学习，可同时提升推荐精度与可解释性。

title: From Delivery to Stateful Exploration: Rethinking the Index for Agentic Search
summary: Recent advances in agentic search have given large language model (LLM) agents finer control over corpus exploration. However, search interfaces often return matching passages even when feedback about the candidate set would suffice for the next decision, coupling candidate refinement with source-text exposure. We propose IndexAct, an interface for Index-Native Corpus Interaction that separates candidate-set refinement from text inspection. Agents construct and manipulate persistent candidate sets through lexical conditions and set operations over an inverted index, receiving reusable state references and statistics such as candidate counts rather than matching passages. This feedback guides further refinement, while separately requested passages provide new clues or evidence that can inform subsequent operations on retained candidate sets. Experiments on five benchmarks spanning agentic search and multi-hop question answering show that IndexAct outperforms the evaluated baselines on each benchmark. On BrowseComp-Plus, it also achieves higher evidence coverage with a smaller average live context than terminal-based corpus interfaces, and maintains answer accuracy as the corpus expands. Further analyses suggest that informative refinement feedback and state reuse support continued evidence discovery, while shorter contexts or fewer search steps alone do not ensure better performance.

AI.tldr: 提出 IndexAct——一种"索引原生语料交互"接口，将候选集细化与源文本检视解耦；智能体通过倒排索引上的词法条件与集合操作构建、操作持久化候选集，只接收可复用的状态引用与候选数量等统计反馈，需要时才单独请求段落。在五个基准上均优于对比基线。
AI.motivation: 现有智能体搜索中，搜索接口常直接返回匹配段落，即便"关于候选集的反馈"已足够支持下一步决策，这使候选集细化与源文本暴露被耦合在一起，带来不必要的上下文消耗与信息干扰。
AI.method: 设计 IndexAct 接口，实现候选集细化与文本检视的分离：智能体在倒排索引上通过词法条件（lexical conditions）与集合运算（set operations）构造并维护持久化候选集；接口返回可复用的状态引用及候选数量等统计信息而非匹配段落，用于指导后续细化；仅在需要新线索或证据时单独请求段落，并可对保留的候选集继续操作。
AI.result: 在涵盖智能体搜索与多跳问答的五个基准上，IndexAct 均优于所评估的基线；在 BrowseComp-Plus 上，相比基于终端的语料接口，以更小的平均活跃上下文（average live context）取得更高的证据覆盖率，并在语料规模扩大时保持答案准确率。进一步分析表明，信息丰富的细化反馈与状态复用支撑了持续的证据发现，而单纯缩短上下文或减少搜索步数并不能保证性能提升。
AI.conclusion: 将候选集细化与文本检视分离、以统计反馈和可复用状态而非匹配段落驱动后续决策，是一种有效的智能体搜索接口范式；性能收益来源于细化反馈的信息量与状态复用能力，而非仅依赖上下文压缩或步数削减。

title: Adapting Generative Recommenders for Multi-Turn Interaction
summary: Generative recommenders decode items from a user's interaction history, but offer no way for users to correct a recommendation that misses their current intent. Adding conversation is natural since items and words share same output space, yet training the model to converse may overwrite the history-to-item mapping it relies on. We introduce INTEGER (**INTE**ractive **GE**nerative **R**ecommendation), which extends generative recommendation to multi-turn interaction with a learned routing token that lets the model decide when to recommend, history re-anchoring that conditions each item on both past behavior and the dialogue, and behavioral replay with instruction-data rehearsal that prevents forgetting during adaptation. Users can thus give feedback on recommendations within the dialogue, while recommendations stay grounded in behavioral history and accuracy is not traded for fluency. On Amazon Beauty and Toys, INTEGER matches or exceeds the strongest baselines in accuracy with competitive conversation quality, improving Hit@10 by 13.3% on Amazon Beauty, and significantly outperforms the generative recommender it starts from. Our analyses show that INTEGER learns behaviors that naive adaptation fails to acquire, recommending once the user's intent is clear and staying attentive to behavioral history at the moment of recommendation. INTEGER also learns an intent-agnostic replacement over the item space, which suppresses rejected items but points to attribute-aware feedback as the next step.

AI.tldr: INTEGER将生成式推荐扩展为多轮交互框架，通过路由token、历史重锚定和行为回放，使用户可在对话中纠正推荐且不牺牲精度。
AI.motivation: 生成式推荐器从用户交互历史解码物品，但用户无法纠正偏离当前意图的推荐。引入对话是自然的（物品与词语共享同一输出空间），但训练模型对话可能覆盖其所依赖的历史到物品的映射。
AI.method: 提出INTEGER（交互式生成推荐），包含三部分：(1) 学习的路由token，让模型决定何时进行推荐；(2) 历史重锚定，将每个物品条件于过往行为和对话；(3) 行为回放结合指令数据排练，防止适配过程中的遗忘。
AI.result: 在Amazon Beauty和Toys数据集上，INTEGER在精度上达到或超过最强基线，并具备有竞争力的对话质量，Amazon Beauty上Hit@10提升13.3%，显著优于其初始生成式推荐器。
AI.conclusion: 分析表明INTEGER习得了朴素适配无法获得的行为：在用户意图明确时推荐，并在推荐时保持对行为历史的关注；模型还学到了意图无关的物品空间替换，能抑制被拒绝的物品，但指向了属性感知反馈作为下一步方向。

title: Behavior-Mining, Generative Conversations, and Collaborative Advisory: the Future of Travel and Tourism Recommender Systems
summary: Since the early adoption of e-commerce, travel and tourism has been a lab for the design of recommender systems: tools that help travelers choose destinations, flights, accommodations, and combine them into itineraries. Data-driven recommendation techniques, ranging from case-based reasoning to reinforcement learning, have been adapted to travelers' needs. The research community has produced multifaceted prototypes of travel and tourism recommender systems (TTRSs), which are context-dependent, multistakeholder-oriented, and more recently, addressing sustainability issues, such as overtourism. Despite this enduring work, TTRSs are not widespread yet. We argue that three limitations can explain this: outdated and sparse data sets used to train and validate TTRSs, algorithms that prioritize prediction accuracy over domain-specific dimensions such as novelty and contextual relevance, and a failure to address the specific needs of travelers. Targeted incremental research could address these limitations, but a disruptive factor has meanwhile entered the ecosystem of tourism information and commercialization platforms: generative artificial intelligence. According to market research, GenAI applications are becoming the primary entry point for travelers planning their trips. This forces research to rethink how TTRSs should be designed and which core techniques should be integrated. We claim that future TTRSs, in addition to offering personalized information filtering, should become more flexible advisors that support decision making, integrating multiple data types and AI techniques, from data mining to natural language processing. Moreover, they must transparently balance the conflicting goals of travelers, service suppliers, platform owners, and local communities. We then outline research targets for building more effective TTRSs, fruitfully combining old and new recommendation techniques.

AI.tldr: 本文是一篇立场/展望型论文，指出旅游推荐系统（TTRS）虽有长期研究积累却仍未普及，归因于数据陈旧稀疏、算法过度追求预测精度、忽视旅客具体需求三大局限；生成式AI的兴起进一步迫使研究重构TTRS设计，未来系统应成为支持决策的灵活顾问，融合多类数据与AI技术，并透明地平衡旅客、供应商、平台与本地社区之间冲突的目标。
AI.motivation: 旅游电商长期是推荐系统的试验场，学界已产出情境依赖、多利益相关者导向并兼顾可持续性（如过度旅游）的多种TTRS原型，但TTRS至今未广泛应用。作者希望解释这一"研究丰富但落地不足"的落差，并应对生成式AI作为旅客行程规划主要入口这一颠覆性变化，重新思考TTRS的设计思路与核心技术。
AI.method: 采用立场论证与问题诊断的方法：首先归纳TTRS未普及的三个原因（训练与验证数据集过时且稀疏；算法以预测精度优先、忽视新颖性与情境相关性等领域维度；未能满足旅客的具体需求），进而分析生成式AI对旅游信息与商业化平台生态的冲击，随后提出未来TTRS的定位与设计主张，并勾画研究目标。
AI.result: 论文未报告实证实验结果，而是提出论断：仅靠针对性的增量研究已不足以解决问题，生成式AI的介入要求研究重新设计TTRS并整合核心技法；未来的TTRS除提供个性化信息过滤外，还应成为更灵活的顾问以支持决策，整合从数据挖掘到自然语言处理的多类数据与AI技术，并透明地权衡旅客、服务供应商、平台所有者与本地社区等相互冲突的目标。
AI.conclusion: 作者呼吁将新旧推荐技术有机结合，围绕提出的研究目标构建更有效的TTRS，即在生成式AI时代把旅游推荐系统从单纯的排序/过滤工具升级为可解释、多目标平衡、支持决策的顾问型系统。

title: Aligning Performance with Contribution: Towards Contribution-Aware Fair Recommendation
summary: Existing research on user fairness in recommender systems has developed diverse objectives. However, it has paid limited attention to a distinct distributive perspective: whether users' contributions to model learning should be reflected in the recommendation benefits they receive. We argue that, in addition to existing fairness protections, a fair system may account for the alignment between users' estimated contributions and the recommendation performance they receive. Such alignment can incentivize sustained and informative engagement, thereby supporting a sustainable recommendation ecosystem. To this end, we propose Contribution-Performance Fairness, a novel fairness perspective which requires recommendation performance to be aligned with estimated contribution across user groups and to remain equitable among users with comparable contributions within a same group. To instantiate this perspective, we introduce the Contribution-Performance Fair Recommender (CPFR), a framework applicable to different backbone recommenders. CPFR constructs ordered user groups from a training-dependent contribution considering interaction volume, loss alignment, and optimization intensity, and jointly optimizes recommendation accuracy with the two fairness requirements. A game-theoretic analysis shows that such alignment can strengthen contribution incentives and improve system-level recommendation accuracy under voluntary contribution. Experiments on three datasets and three backbone models demonstrate that CPFR achieves a strong accuracy--fairness trade-off under the proposed operational metric.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"贡献-性能公平性"(Contribution-Performance Fairness)新视角，要求推荐性能与用户对模型学习的估计贡献对齐，并给出CPFR框架实现该目标。
AI.motivation: 现有推荐系统用户公平性研究虽目标多样，但忽视了分配视角：用户对模型学习的贡献是否应体现在其获得的推荐收益中。作者认为贡献与性能的对齐可激励用户持续且信息量高的参与，从而支撑可持续的推荐生态。
AI.method: 提出CPFR框架，可适配不同骨干推荐模型。其基于训练相关贡献构建有序用户组，贡献考虑交互量、损失对齐与优化强度三个维度；随后联合优化推荐准确率与两项公平性要求：(1)跨用户组性能与贡献对齐；(2)同组内贡献相近用户间性能均衡。
AI.result: 博弈论分析表明该对齐机制能强化贡献激励，并在自愿贡献下提升系统级推荐准确率；在三个数据集与三种骨干模型上的实验显示，CPFR在提出的操作化指标下取得良好的准确率-公平性权衡。
AI.conclusion: 将推荐收益与用户贡献对齐是一种可行且有益的公平性视角，CPFR在不显著牺牲准确率的前提下实现贡献-性能公平，有助于构建可持续推荐生态系统。

title: Seeing the Context: Enhancing Recommender Systems with Image-Derived Contextual Signals
comment: Accepted at the CARS workshop, RecSys 2026. 8 pages, 2 figures
summary: Contextual information, capturing the circumstances of a user-item interaction, is central to recommender systems. Prior work draws context from location, time, or reviews, but not images; multimodal recommender systems mainly use images to enrich item or user representations, not identify situational context. We propose a new representation of context derived from images, spanning physical, social, and modal categories learned via a vision-language model. We introduce ICE-Fuse, a pipeline for evaluating this representation that fuses these categories and integrates them into a context-aware recommender system, using TripAdvisor data and Review-aware Graph Contrastive Learning as the recommendation algorithm. Image context does not outperform established signals standalone, but improves them combined, indicating complementary information. Semantic analysis shows image- and review-derived context capture distinct aspects of the interaction, positioning images as complementary context.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出从图像中提取情境上下文（物理、社会、模态三类），并构建ICE-Fuse流程将其融合进上下文感知推荐系统，验证图像上下文与评论等信号互补。
AI.motivation: 现有推荐系统的上下文主要来自位置、时间或评论，多模态推荐虽用图像，但仅用于丰富物品/用户表征，未用于识别情境上下文，因此图像作为上下文信号的价值尚未被挖掘。
AI.method: 提出基于图像的上下文新表征，通过视觉-语言模型学习物理、社会、模态三类上下文；设计ICE-Fuse流程，将各类别融合并集成到上下文感知推荐系统中，在TripAdvisor数据上以Review-aware Graph Contrastive Learning作为推荐算法进行评测。
AI.result: 图像上下文单独使用时未超过现有成熟信号，但与现有信号结合后能带来提升，表明其包含互补信息；语义分析显示图像与评论所导出的上下文捕捉了交互的不同方面。
AI.conclusion: 图像可作为互补的情境上下文来源，与评论等信号协同提升推荐效果，为多模态情境感知推荐提供了新的表征与融合路径。

title: The Right Memory in the Wrong Context: Verifying Retrieval Admissibility in Long-Term Agent Memory
comment: 26 pages. Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop "Who Verifies the Agents? Toward Reliable Agent Development". Code: https://github.com/ziwang11112/right-memory-wrong-context
summary: Long-term-memory agents can retrieve relevant information that is inadmissible for the current request because it belongs to another principal, violates policy, or reflects an incompatible lifecycle state. Recall and final-answer accuracy do not reveal this: a route can appear safe by missing required evidence, while a correct answer may follow inadmissible prompt exposure. We introduce a retrieval-admissibility verification framework that assigns each memory-query pair one of three statuses (admissible, inadmissible, or unresolved), compares routes at matched required-evidence recall with bounds for unresolved cases, and tracks memory IDs through prompt exposure while linking exposure to target-level disclosure. We evaluate its stages on separate, non-pooled populations. A post-hoc top-20 reanalysis of frozen rankings from two public long-term-memory benchmarks, RHELM and MemOps, covers 3,767 queries. All released anchors lie within trusted query namespaces; with within-namespace scores unchanged, off-namespace filtering cannot lower their ranks. Top-20 anchor recall increases from 0.432 to 0.533, 80% recall feasibility from 0.237 to 0.311, and exact similarity evaluations decrease by 98.3%. In a frozen 72-case development diagnostic, a released-metadata reference preserves required evidence, whereas neither text-only verifier detects violations under the 1% required-anchor false-denial limit. Across 1,523 paired benchmark-native cases, namespace routing is associated with judged-accuracy gains of 0.053-0.068 across three readers; recall also changes, so this comparison is observational. In 16 controlled exposure scenarios, only one of four reader-specific 95% confidence intervals excludes zero for relevant-inadmissible literal disclosure (+0.156, 95% CI [0.031, 0.312]). Results motivate separate verification of candidate support, admissibility, prompt exposure, and answer disclosure.

AI.tldr: 提出检索可采纳性验证框架，将记忆-查询对分为可采纳、不可采纳、未决三种状态，在同证据召回下比较路由，并追踪记忆ID的提示暴露与目标级披露；在RHELM和MemOps上验证，命名空间外过滤不降低排名且提升锚点召回。
AI.motivation: 长期记忆型智能体可能检索到对当前请求不可采纳的信息，例如属于其他主体、违反策略或处于不兼容的生命周期状态。现有的召回率与最终答案准确率无法揭示这一问题：路由可能因遗漏必需证据而看似安全，而正确答案也可能来自不可采纳的提示暴露。
AI.method: 提出检索可采纳性验证框架：为每个记忆-查询对分配可采纳、不可采纳或未决三种状态；在匹配必需证据召回率的条件下比较各路由，并为未决情形给出界限；追踪记忆ID在提示暴露过程中的流转，并将暴露与目标级披露关联。各阶段评估在相互独立、非合并的总体上进行。对RHELM与MemOps两个公开长期记忆基准的冻结排名做事后Top-20重分析，并设置冻结的72例开发诊断，以及1523对基准原生案例和16个受控暴露场景。
AI.result: RHELM与MemOps共覆盖3767个查询，所有已发布锚点均位于受信查询命名空间内，命名空间内得分不变时，命名空间外过滤无法降低其排名；Top-20锚点召回率从0.432升至0.533，80%召回可行性从0.237升至0.311，精确相似度评估减少98.3%。在72例冻结诊断中，已发布元数据参考可保留必需证据，而两种纯文本验证器在1%必需锚点误拒限下均无法检出违规。在1523对配对案例中，命名空间路由与三个阅读器的判定准确率提升0.053-0.068相关，但该比较为观察性。16个受控暴露场景中，四种阅读器的95%置信区间仅一个排除零（相关不可采纳字面披露+0.156，95% CI [0.031, 0.312]）。
AI.conclusion: 召回率与答案准确率不足以刻画记忆检索的安全性，应分别验证候选支撑、可采纳性、提示暴露与答案披露。

title: ShanLiangRen: A Nutrition Agent for Personalized Daily Meal Planning
summary: Dietary nutrition planning plays an important role in chronic disease management and maintaining a healthy body. In applications, it must simultaneously satisfy personalized constraints and reasonable multidimensional nutritional goals. These two aspects often conflict, and user constraints evolve with feedback, resulting in a substantial gap between generic guidelines and executable plans. To bridge this gap, we first propose the personalized fully quantified multiobjective dietary planning problem (MDP). To tackle MDP, we develop a nutrition agent, ShanLiangRen. The system first transforms dietary specifications, nutrient data, user attributes and natural language requirements into an individualized constrained planning instance. It then employs an exact retrieval-augmented generation method to shrink the feasible candidate set from a large scale ingredient and recipe space. Finally, it adopts a refinement guided by Pareto principles, where an LLM iteratively revises candidate plans under deterministic nutrition computation and feedback from constraint verification. The system outputs fully quantified meal plans with explicit ingredients and portion sizes, together with reports on nutrition compliance that show constraint satisfaction and nutrient interval attainment. We have released the system online as a WeChat Program, ShanLiangRen. A demo video is available at https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=652OtY5VlGA.

AI.tldr: 本文提出个性化全量化多目标膳食规划问题（MDP），并开发营养智能体"闪亮仁"（ShanLiangRen），通过约束化建模、精确检索增强生成缩小候选空间，以及帕累托原则引导的LLM迭代精修，输出全量化膳食方案与营养合规报告。
AI.motivation: 膳食营养规划在慢性病管理与健康维持中至关重要，但应用中需同时满足个性化约束与多维度营养目标，二者常相冲突；且用户约束会随反馈演变，导致通用膳食指南与可执行方案之间存在显著鸿沟。
AI.method: 首先形式化提出个性化全量化多目标膳食规划问题（MDP）；据此构建营养智能体ShanLiangRen：将膳食规格、营养数据、用户属性与自然语言需求转化为个体化约束规划实例；采用精确检索增强生成方法从大规模食材与食谱空间中缩减可行候选集；最后采用帕累托原则引导的精修，由LLM在确定性营养计算与约束校验反馈下迭代修订候选方案。
AI.result: 系统输出包含明确食材与份量的全量化餐食方案，并附带营养合规报告，展示约束满足情况与营养素区间达成度；系统已作为微信小程序"闪亮仁"在线发布，并提供演示视频。
AI.conclusion: 该工作通过问题形式化与智能体系统的结合，弥合了通用营养指南与可执行个性化膳食方案之间的差距，实现了约束满足与多维营养目标兼顾的可落地膳食规划。

title: Confidence-Ordering Reversal under Contextual Priors in Neural Decoding
summary: Contextual priors improve neural-to-language decoding by reshaping candidate scores. However, confidence is read from the same reshaped scores, so the errors a prior leaves behind can become more confident with no change in accuracy to reveal it. We study how a prior shapes confidence in speech retrieval on MEG-MASC and MOUS using local decoding scores, a contextual prior combined by additive shallow fusion, and the fused top-two margin as confidence. Among initially incorrect predictions, we find a confidence-ordering reversal: a larger margin makes a repair more likely when the correct candidate starts near the top of the local ranking, but less likely when it starts lower. On MEG-MASC, pooled correctness AUROC is 0.87, yet AUROC separating repairs from residual errors falls from 0.70 at initial ranks 2-3 to 0.39 at ranks 21-50. Errors starting beyond rank 20, inside the reversed region, make up 46.6% of all post-fusion errors. We propose a score-level account: a repair must first close the correct candidate's initial deficit, limiting its final margin, whereas a residual error can build a large margin between two incorrect candidates. A causal intervention that changes only the fusion weight moves the reversal to deeper ranks as predicted. Under a word-level LM prior, it keeps moving after accuracy gain peaks, so a weight chosen for accuracy does not settle confidence. Reading local and prior scores separately improves selective decoding: the decoder answers on 74.5% of windows instead of 56.7%, while 92% of output sets still contain the correct candidate. Confidence after contextual fusion should retain the local and contextual evidence behind each prediction, not just the fused scores. Project website: https://confidencereversal.github.io/; Code: https://github.com/AmadeusFake/NeuDecodingConfReversal

AI.tldr: 本文研究上下文先验在神经到语言解码中对置信度的影响，发现并解释了一种"置信度排序反转"现象：融合后的大边际对初始排名靠后的正确候选修复反而更不利，并据此提出分离读取局部与先验分数的选择性解码方法。
AI.motivation: 上下文先验通过重塑候选分数来提升神经到语言的解码准确率，但置信度是从同一套被重塑的分数中读取的。因此先验留下的错误可能在没有准确率变化可揭示的情况下变得更为"自信"，即置信度校准被破坏而准确率指标无法察觉。作者希望揭示这一隐患并加以解决。
AI.method: 在MEG-MASC和MOUS数据集上进行语音检索研究，使用局部解码分数、通过加性浅融合（additive shallow fusion）结合上下文先验，并以融合后top-two边际作为置信度。分析初始错误预测中边际大小与修复概率的关系，并做因果干预实验（仅改变融合权重）验证预测；此外测试分离读取局部与先验分数的选择性解码策略。
AI.result: 在初始错误预测中发现置信度排序反转：当正确候选初始接近局部排名顶部时，较大边际更可能导致修复；当正确候选初始排名较低时，较大边际反而更不利。MEG-MASC上pooled correctness AUROC为0.87，但区分修复与残留错误的AUROC从初始排名2-3时的0.70降至排名21-50时的0.39。排名20之后的错误（位于反转区）占融合后全部错误的46.6%。因果干预实验表明改变融合权重可使反转按预测移向更深排名；在词级LM先验下，反转在准确率增益达到峰值后仍继续移动。分离读取局部与先验分数使解码器在74.5%的窗口上作答（相比56.7%），且92%的输出集合仍包含正确候选。
AI.conclusion: 上下文融合后的置信度应保留每个预测背后的局部与上下文证据，而非仅依赖融合后的分数。置信度排序反转的机制可解释为：修复须先弥补正确候选的初始劣势，从而限制其最终边际；而残留错误则可在两个错误候选间建立大边际。选择融合权重以适应准确率并不能同时保证置信度可靠。

title: Extending Music Annotation Schemas: Zero-Shot Prediction or Few-Shot Adaptation?
comment: 5 pages, 3 figures. Submitted to IEEE ICASSP 2027; under review
summary:
Automatic music annotation is typically tackled under the assumption of a fixed annotation schema. In practice, commercial music catalogs often need to accommodate new musical attributes as needs evolve. Given that expert music annotation is expensive, it is not evident which methodological approach is most effective at accommodating new attributes and backfilling existing tracks; audio-language models promise zero-shot prediction, but at what annotation budget does supervised adaptation become more compelling?
  We propose a benchmark based on the MGPHot popular music annotation dataset for simulating music schema extension across different annotation budgets. We investigate zero-shot prediction with audio-language models, learning new attributes from pretrained representations, and adapting models trained on existing annotations. Our results suggest that supervised adaptation is more effective than zero-shot prediction even with small annotation budgets, while frozen representation reuse remains the most effective approach for modest budgets without the tuning required by deeper adaptation.

AI.tldr: 论文提出一个基于MGPHot数据集的基准，用于模拟音乐标注模式扩展，比较零样本预测、预训练表征复用与有监督适配在不同标注预算下的效果。
AI.motivation: 商业音乐目录常需随时间演进纳入新的音乐属性，而专家标注成本高昂，因此需要明确在扩展新属性并回填已有曲目时，何种方法最有效，以及零样本预测在多大标注预算下会被有监督适配超越。
AI.method: 构建基于MGPHot流行音乐标注数据集的基准，模拟音乐模式扩展并设定不同标注预算；比较三类方法：音频-语言模型的零样本预测、从预训练表征学习新属性、以及对已有标注训练的模型进行适配。
AI.result: 即使在较小标注预算下，有监督适配也比零样本预测更有效；而对于中等预算，冻结表征复用是最有效的方法，且无需深度适配所需的调优。
AI.conclusion: 在音乐标注模式扩展场景中，零样本预测并非始终占优；有监督适配在低预算时已具优势，而冻结表征复用在中预算下兼顾效果与效率，是实用选择。

title: AdaLoop: Adaptive-Depth Latent Reasoning for Audio Language Models
summary: Large audio language models answer questions about speech, sound, and music, yet their accuracy drops sharply on tasks that need fine-grained acoustic analysis. Judging which of two speakers has the higher pitch demands iterative signal-level reasoning that a content question does not. Current models spend the same computational depth on both. We introduce AdaLoop, a lightweight recurrent module that learns how many latent refinement steps a given audio--question pair requires. A shared transformer block iterates over the audio representation, guided by the question, while a learned halting mechanism exits the loop once the representation is ready. AdaLoop adds fewer than 3\% of the base model's parameters and plugs into any audio encoder--language model pair without modifying either component. Evaluated on three architecturally distinct models across MMSU, MMAU-Pro, and MMAR, AdaLoop raises the average accuracy by 2.9 to 3.8 points, with the largest gains on perception-heavy subtasks where the model learns to apply deeper reasoning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 AdaLoop，一种轻量级循环模块，可根据音频-问题对的难度自适应决定潜在精炼步数，在几乎不增加参数的情况下提升音频语言模型的细粒度声学推理能力。
AI.motivation: 大型音频语言模型在回答语音、声音和音乐相关问题时表现良好，但在需要细粒度声学分析的任务上准确率大幅下降。例如判断两位说话者中谁的音调更高，需要迭代式的信号级推理，而内容型问题则不需要。然而现有模型对两类问题投入相同的计算深度，缺乏自适应计算能力。
AI.method: AdaLoop 是一个轻量级循环模块，通过学习决定给定音频-问题对所需的潜在精炼步数。具体而言，一个共享的 transformer 块在问题的引导下对音频表示进行迭代精炼，同时一个学习得到的停止机制（halting mechanism）在表示准备就绪后退出循环。该模块仅增加不到基座模型 3% 的参数，并可插入任意音频编码器-语言模型组合，无需修改任一组件。
AI.result: 在 MMSU、MMAU-Pro 和 MMAR 三个基准上，对三个架构上各不相同的模型进行评估，AdaLoop 将平均准确率提升 2.9 至 3.8 个百分点，且在感知密集型子任务上提升最大，表明模型学会了应用更深入的推理。
AI.conclusion: AdaLoop 通过自适应循环精炼机制，以极小的参数开销有效提升了音频语言模型在细粒度声学分析任务上的推理能力，且具有良好的通用性和即插即用特性。

title: Where Does the Audio Jailbreak Live? A Controlled Frequency-Depth Audit of AdvWave-P on Qwen2-Audio
summary: We audit frequency and decoder-depth claims for AdvWave-P, an additive audio jailbreak, on Qwen2-Audio. The protocol masks frequency components of the perturbation in the short-time Fourier transform (STFT) domain and measures attack success and audio-span representations. On 520 AdvBench prompts, the primary judge labels 76.7% of adversarial inputs as jailbreaks. A condition-blind, single-annotator validation yields a Rogan-Gladen sensitivity estimate of 0.87 for this condition (about 0.83-0.95 with validation-rate uncertainty); this correction is not applied to masked conditions. The apparent frequency ranking depends on the partition: energy share alone predicts the standard eight-band ranking (Spearman's rho = 0.95), and equal-Hz and equal-energy partitions show that masking any tested band can sharply reduce attack success. At a finer 16-band equal-energy resolution, however, masking the narrow 7520-7960 Hz band leaves ASR at 0.10, which remains unresolved without a matched control. Matched-energy scattered-removal tests show that contiguous removal is more damaging in lower bands, while both forms approach the floor in upper bands. Global rescaling leaves ASR near baseline but tests amplitude sensitivity rather than frequency location. In a re-optimization pilot (n = 20), tested single- and two-band supports reach ASRs of 0.00, 0.25, and 0.40, while random supports covering about half the STFT bins reach a mean of 0.86. In a prompt- and energy-adjusted model, audio-span divergence is associated with band necessity, with the coefficient rising from +0.63 at the projector output to +0.93 at layer 30 (contrast +0.293, 95% CI [0.11, 0.51]). This association is not a causal localization, and single-layer patching does not establish a causal layer. The results support partition-aware auditing of frequency claims, leaving the fine-resolution top-band result and broader generality open.

AI.tldr: 该文对音频越狱攻击AdvWave-P在Qwen2-Audio上的频率与解码深度主张进行审计，发现攻击成功率（ASR）的频率排序高度依赖频带划分方式，细粒度下最高频带掩蔽结果尚未解决，音频表征散度与频带必要性存在关联但非因果定位。
AI.motivation: 先前关于加性音频越狱攻击的频率与解码深度主张缺乏严格的划分敏感性检验，作者希望验证AdvWave-P的频率排序是否稳健、ASR估计是否受标注偏差影响，以及音频表征散度能否作为频带必要性的证据。
AI.method: 在STFT域对扰动频率分量进行掩蔽，测量攻击成功率与音频跨度表征；用520条AdvBench提示评测，主评判给出76.7%越狱率；用条件盲、单标注者验证结合Rogan-Gladen估计灵敏度（约0.87）；比较等能量、等Hz、标准八频带及16频带划分；做匹配能量的散布移除对照；进行重优化试验（n=20）；并用提示与能量调整模型分析音频跨度散度与频带必要性的关联。
AI.result: 主评判将76.7%对抗输入标为越狱；Rogan-Gladen灵敏度估计为0.87（约0.83–0.95）；能量占比可预测标准八频带排序（Spearman rho=0.95），掩蔽任一测试频带均可显著降低ASR；16频带等能量下掩蔽7520–7960 Hz窄带后ASR仍为0.10，缺少匹配对照；等能量散布移除在低频带更具破坏性，高频带两形式均趋近下限；全局缩放后ASR接近基线；重优化试验中单带与双带支持ASR为0.00、0.25、0.40，随机支持覆盖约半数STFT bins时均值0.86；音频跨度散度与频带必要性关联系数从投影器输出的+0.63升至第30层的+0.93（对比+0.293，95% CI [0.11, 0.51]）。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持对频率主张进行划分感知的审计；细分辨率下最高频带结果及更广泛泛化性仍待解决；音频跨度散度与频带必要性的关联不构成因果定位，单层修补不能确立因果层。

title: ImpactMat: Continuous Material Estimation for Inverse Impact Sound Rendering
summary: Impact sound rendering synthesizes the sound produced when a 3D object is struck, but practical renderers often rely on fixed material presets such as wood, plastic, or steel. These presets limit the range of impact sounds a renderer can express, while manually adjusting the underlying material parameters remains difficult without expertise in material acoustics. We therefore study inverse impact sound rendering: predicting material parameters from a reference impact sound so that a simulator can recreate a similar material response. To support this task, we introduce ImpactMat, a dataset and benchmark of single and blended material impact sounds paired with ground-truth material parameters. We further propose a feed-forward model that predicts these parameters from one or more recordings, using blended materials to learn smooth transitions between material types. Experiments show that our method outperforms competitive baselines and enables re-rendering from real recordings without manual parameter tuning. The project page is available https://material-from-impact.github.io/material-from-impact/.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究逆向冲击声渲染任务：从参考冲击声预测材质参数，使仿真器重现相似的材质响应；提出ImpactMat数据集与基准（含单一及混合材质冲击声与真值参数），并给出前馈模型，性能优于基线且可实现真实录音重渲染。
AI.motivation: 实用渲染器多依赖木材、塑料、钢等固定材质预设，限制了可表达的冲击声范围；人工调节底层材质参数又需要材质声学专业知识，门槛高。因此需要从声音反推材质参数的方法。
AI.method: 定义逆向冲击声渲染任务：由参考冲击声预测材质参数。构建ImpactMat数据集与基准，包含单一材质与混合材质的冲击声及其对应真值材质参数。提出前馈模型，从一段或多段录音预测参数，并利用混合材质学习材质类型间的平滑过渡。
AI.result: 实验表明所提方法优于竞争基线，并能对真实录音进行重渲染，无需人工参数调优。
AI.conclusion: 该工作建立了逆向冲击声渲染的任务设定与评测基准，验证了从冲击声直接预测材质参数的可行性，为摆脱固定材质预设、实现真实录音驱动的材质声渲染提供了途径。项目主页：https://material-from-impact.github.io/material-from-impact/。

title: Neural Representations, Natural Connections: What Transfers From Human Speech Foundation Models to Animal Vocalizations?
summary: Speech-pretrained models have shown promise in animal bioacoustics, but the factors governing their cross-species transfer remain poorly understood. We evaluate 15 frozen encoders spanning monolingual and multilingual speech, speaker verification, animal bioacoustics, and general audio on caller identification across four species and call-type classification across three. Differences between the strongest speech- and animal-pretrained representations range from $-0.027$ to $+0.119$ UAR; speech is significantly better in three of seven settings ($p<0.01$) and not significantly different in the remaining four. Controlled comparisons show no systematic advantage from increased language coverage or animal-domain pretraining, while frozen speaker-verification embeddings transfer poorly. The results also show that transfer is strongly layer-dependent: raw-waveform models peak early, whereas patch-spectrogram models peak deeper.

AI.tldr: 该论文系统评估了15个冻结编码器在跨物种生物声学任务上的迁移表现，发现语音预训练表征与动物域预训练表征性能相当，且迁移效果强烈依赖于网络层深度。
AI.motivation: 语音预训练模型在动物生物声学中展现出潜力，但其跨物种迁移的决定因素尚不清楚，作者希望厘清语言覆盖度、动物域预训练等因素对迁移性能的影响。
AI.method: 评估15个冻结编码器，涵盖单语/多语语音、说话人验证、动物生物声学及通用音频，在4个物种的鸣叫者识别与3个物种的叫声类型分类任务上测试，并进行受控比较与逐层分析。
AI.result: 最强的语音与动物预训练表征差距在-0.027至+0.119 UAR之间；语音在7个设置中的3个显著更优(p<0.01)，其余4个无显著差异。语言覆盖度增加或动物域预训练无系统性优势，冻结说话人验证嵌入迁移效果差，迁移强烈依赖层深度：原始波形模型峰值靠前，patch-spectrogram模型峰值更深。
AI.conclusion: 跨物种迁移不依赖语言覆盖度或动物域预训练，冻结的通用语音表征可与动物域表征媲美，且迁移性能的关键在于选择合适的网络层。

title: Exposing and Mitigating Neural Codec Vulnerabilities in Audio Deepfake Detection
summary: Existing audio deepfake detection (ADD) datasets and detectors are primarily built for vocoder-based synthesis, evaluated against traditional post-hoc perturbations such as MP3/AAC compression or additive noise, applied independently of generation. However, recent speech synthesizers, particularly ALM-based systems, use neural audio codecs both for compression and as the resynthesis reconstructing waveforms from generated tokens, producing artifacts distinct from post-hoc compression. Neural codecs thus play a dual role: some are designed for pure compression under low-bandwidth communication, while others serve as resynthesis components. Despite this dual role, robustness to codec-based compression, unlike post-hoc compression, remains largely unexplored. We expose this gap, showing that state-of-the-art (SOTA) ADD models degrade drastically on codec-compressed speech; in particular, systems trained on Codec Resynthesized data as a proxy for codec-based generation prove most vulnerable, with legitimately compressed bona fide speech often misclassified as fake. To investigate this, we construct the Audio Neural Codec-Spoof dataset by applying seven neural codec algorithms to existing ADD benchmarks, isolating codec-induced resynthesis artifacts as a controlled proxy for codec-based generation. As baseline mitigation, we propose PCL-NET (Pairwise Consistency Learned Network), fine-tuning a pretrained XLS-R (300M) encoder with a pairwise consistency objective that minimizes the representation distance between an utterance's uncompressed and codec-compressed versions, disentangling codec artifacts from the real-versus-fake decision. As a result, PCL-NET reduces average EER under neural codec compression from 28.67% to 12.77%, while preserving competitive CoSG-based deepfake detection performance. We will also make the dataset publicly available on Hugging Face upon acceptance.

AI.tldr: 该论文揭示了现有音频深伪检测(ADD)模型对神经音频编解码器压缩的鲁棒性严重不足，构建了Audio Neural Codec-Spoof数据集，并提出PCL-NET方法，将神经编解码压缩下的平均EER从28.67%降至12.77%。
AI.motivation: 现有ADD数据集与检测器主要针对基于声码器的合成，并以MP3/AAC压缩或加性噪声等独立于生成过程的传统后处理扰动作为评测对象。但近期语音合成器（尤其是ALM类系统）将神经音频编解码器同时用于压缩与重合成，由此产生的伪影与传统后处理压缩截然不同。神经编解码器因此具有双重角色：既可作为低带宽通信的纯压缩组件，也可作为重合成模块。然而，针对编解码器压缩（而非后处理压缩）的鲁棒性研究仍是空白。作者正是要暴露并填补这一缺口。
AI.method: 作者构建了Audio Neural Codec-Spoof数据集，将七种神经编解码算法应用于现有ADD基准，从而把编解码器引发的重合成伪影隔离为受控代理。作为基线缓解方案，提出PCL-NET（Pairwise Consistency Learned Network）：在预训练XLS-R（300M）编码器上进行微调，采用成对一致性目标，最小化同一话语未压缩版本与编解码压缩版本之间的表征距离，从而将编解码伪影与真伪判别解耦。
AI.result: 实验显示，SOTA ADD模型在编解码压缩语音上性能急剧下降；特别是以Codec Resynthesized数据作为编解码生成代理训练的系统最为脆弱，常将合法压缩的真实语音误判为伪造。PCL-NET将神经编解码压缩下的平均EER从28.67%降至12.77%，同时保持具有竞争力的CoSG类深伪检测性能。
AI.conclusion: 神经编解码压缩是ADD领域此前被忽视的鲁棒性缺口，且其伪影不同于后处理压缩。通过成对一致性学习可有效缓解该问题，兼顾压缩鲁棒性与检测性能。数据集将在论文接收后于Hugging Face公开。

title: Adapting a Latent Audio Diffusion Model to Historical Guqin Recordings: A Listening-Driven Case Study
summary: We report a small-data case study in adapting a pretrained latent audio diffusion model to the guqin, the seven-string Chinese zither, aiming at an "AI radio" that plays guqin-style music without end. From a library of historical recordings we curate 412 solo performances (42.5 h, 61 performers) and split them by composition. We fine-tune a rank-16 DoRA adapter on Stable Audio 3 Medium using its continuous latents, masking weighted towards continuation, captions that combine researched notes on each piece with mood tags and an automatically estimated pentatonic mode, and random-length crops, stopping when held-out loss stops improving. Seven blind listening studies by one expert listener guided every decision. The final adapter was rated highest for continuing unseen pieces (3.9/5, against 3.4 for the best earlier adapter) and 4.6/5 for generating from free-written scene descriptions. Negative results are equally informative: a from-scratch autoregressive model over the same latents produced no recognisable timbre, a signal-level friction-noise measure correlated with the listener's complaints in the wrong direction, and a pentatonic-fit measure tracked ratings overall but barely within a group of candidates. Chaining continuations for long playback exposed a silent tail on every generated clip and a loudness feedback loop, both with simple fixes. With one listener and at most ten clips per condition, no paired difference is statistically significant; we present an exploratory record of what helped, what did not, and why.

AI.tldr: 本文将预训练潜在音频扩散模型（Stable Audio 3 Medium）通过 rank-16 DoRA 适配器微调至古琴领域，基于 412 段独奏录音构建小数据案例研究，目标是实现"永续演奏古琴风格音乐"的 AI 电台，并系统记录了正向与负向实验发现。
AI.motivation: 希望构建一个可无限连续播放古琴风格音乐的"AI 电台"，同时探索在数据稀缺条件下将通用预训练音频扩散模型适配至特定传统乐器领域的可行性，并如实呈现哪些方法有效、哪些无效。
AI.method: 从历史录音中整理 412 段独奏（42.5 小时、61 位演奏者），按曲目划分数据；在 Stable Audio 3 Medium 的连续潜空间上微调 rank-16 DoRA 适配器，采用偏向续写的加权掩码、融合曲目考据注释与情绪标签及自动估计五声音阶调式的文本描述、随机长度裁剪，并在验证损失不再改善时停止。全程由单一专家听众通过七次盲听研究指导决策。另设负向对照：从零训练的潜空间自回归模型、信号级摩擦噪声指标、五声音阶契合度指标。
AI.result: 最终适配器在续写未见曲目上得分 3.9/5（最优早期适配器为 3.4），在自由场景描述生成上得 4.6/5。负向结果包括：从零训练的自回归模型无法产生可辨识音色；信号级摩擦噪声指标与听众抱怨呈反向相关；五声音阶契合度指标在整体上与评分一致，但在候选组内几乎无区分度。长时播放的续写链接暴露了每段生成音频的静音尾部和响度反馈回路，均有简单修复方案。受限于单一听众与每条件至多十条样本，任何配对差异均不具统计显著性，故作为探索性记录呈现。
AI.conclusion: 该工作表明在极小数据与单听众条件下，基于预训练潜在扩散模型的 DoRA 微调可有效适配古琴风格生成，且诚实的负向结果与工程细节同样具有参考价值；但由于样本规模限制，结论属探索性，尚不具备统计显著性。

title: SkillFormer: Skill-Decomposed Adaptation for Audio Language Models
summary: Audio language models must handle dozens of distinct skills, from pitch comparison and speaker counting to musical tempo estimation and emotion recognition. Joint training on all skills at once causes interference: gains on one skill often come at the cost of another. We propose \textbf{SkillFormer}, which decomposes audio understanding into skill-specific low-rank adapters and composes them at inference time through a learned router. The router examines the question to decide which adapters to activate and how much weight each should carry, so that a pitch query engages different parameters than a genre classification query. An alternating training schedule updates each adapter on its own skill cluster before jointly calibrating the router, preventing the gradient conflicts that arise in standard multi-task optimization. SkillFormer adds fewer than 4\% of the base model's parameters and requires no changes to the audio encoder or language backbone. Evaluated on three architecturally distinct models across MMSU, MMAU-Pro, and MMAR, it raises the average accuracy by 2.5 to 4.1 points, with balanced gains across perception, reasoning, and semantic subcategories.

AI.tldr: 提出SkillFormer，将音频理解分解为技能专用的低秩适配器，并用学习到的路由器在推理时按问题动态组合，缓解多技能联合训练的相互干扰。
AI.motivation: 音频语言模型需处理音高比较、说话人计数、节奏估计、情感识别等数十种技能，直接联合训练会产生技能间干扰：某一技能的提升常以牺牲另一技能为代价，标准多任务优化中存在梯度冲突。
AI.method: SkillFormer为每个技能配置低秩适配器（LoRA式），通过一个路由器分析问题内容，决定激活哪些适配器及其权重，使不同查询调用不同参数；训练采用交替式调度，先在各自技能簇上更新单个适配器，再联合校准路由器；仅增加不到4%的基座参数，且不修改音频编码器与语言主干。
AI.result: 在MMSU、MMAU-Pro和MMAR三个基准、三种架构不同的模型上进行评估，平均准确率提升2.5至4.1个百分点，且在感知、推理和语义各子类别上增益均衡。
AI.conclusion: 通过技能解耦的适配器加动态路由，可在低参数开销和不改动主干的前提下有效缓解多任务干扰，实现跨模型、跨基准的稳定且均衡的性能提升。

title: Pronunciation-Oriented Reinforcement Learning for Japanese Text-to-Speech with Kana-Domain ASR Rewards
summary: Character error rate (CER) computed by automatic speech recognition (ASR) is widely used as an intelligibility reward for reinforcement learning (RL) post-training of text-to-speech (TTS) systems. For Japanese, however, orthographic CER introduces a representation mismatch for pronunciation-oriented optimization: distinct kanji readings may collapse to the same orthographic representation, while equivalent pronunciations may admit different orthographic forms. We instead compute CER in the kana domain using a kana-transcribing ASR model and reference readings (Kana-CER). Under matched group relative policy optimization (GRPO) conditions, Kana-CER reduces target-kanji reading error by approximately 26% relative to the orthographic CER reward, while maintaining comparable orthographic CER and similar speaker similarity and objective speech quality. It also reaches its best validation performance in substantially fewer optimization steps (4k vs. 18k). We further observe severe output elongation under unregularized Kana-CER optimization, which is substantially suppressed by KL regularization.

AI.tldr: 针对日语TTS强化学习后训练，提出用假名域ASR计算字错率（Kana-CER）替代正字法CER，降低目标汉字读音错误约26%，且收敛更快（4k vs 18k步），但需KL正则抑制输出拖长。
AI.motivation: 自动语音识别（ASR）计算的字错率（CER）被广泛用作TTS强化学习后训练的清晰度奖励，但日语中正字法CER存在表征失配：不同汉字读音可能对应相同正字法形式，而相同读音也可能有多种正字法写法，导致奖励信号与"发音导向"的优化目标不一致。
AI.method: 改用假名域计算CER：使用输出假名的ASR模型，并参照假名读音作为参考文本，得到Kana-CER。在匹配的组相对策略优化（GRPO）条件下，与正字法CER奖励进行对比实验，并考察KL正则对训练稳定性的影响。
AI.result: 在匹配GRPO条件下，Kana-CER相比正字法CER奖励将目标汉字读音错误相对降低约26%，同时正字法CER相当，说话人相似度与客观语音质量也相近；验证性能最优所需优化步数显著更少（4k vs 18k）。此外，无正则的Kana-CER优化会出现严重输出拖长，KL正则可大幅抑制该现象。
AI.conclusion: 面向发音优化的日语TTS后训练应采用假名域的Kana-CER奖励，以缓解正字法表征失配，在提升读音准确性的同时加快收敛；同时必须配合KL正则以避免输出拖长等退化行为。

title: Hiding Tool Latency in On-Device Cascaded Voice Agent through Speculative Execution
summary: Tool-augmented speech assistants typically serialize automatic speech recognition, large language model inference, and external tool execution. As a result, tool latency is incurred only after the user has finished speaking and the LLM has identified the required tool calls. We present speculative tool execution for on-device cascaded voice agents, which predicts tool requests from partial ASR hypotheses and initiates tool execution while speech is still being received, thereby reducing end-to-end response latency. Our approach introduces a Predictor module that anticipates tool calls during speech recognition, executes them speculatively, and caches the results. The cached outputs are then injected into the LLM prompt, enabling faster responses. Additionally, to mitigate errors caused by user self-corrections during speech, we employ a rule-based validation mechanism that selectively injects only valid cached results. As a final safeguard, the LLM retains the ability to issue tool calls directly, ensuring that the latency of our framework is upper-bounded by the baseline serial execution pipeline in the worst case. We evaluate our method using live measurements from a fully implemented Android voice assistant. Our approach reduces the median time-to-first-audio from 5.79,s to 4.60,s and decreases the standard deviation from 3.49,s to 2.81,s, resulting in more predictable response latency.

AI.tldr: 提出面向端侧级联语音助手的推测性工具执行方法，通过从部分ASR假设预测工具调用并提前执行、缓存、注入LLM提示，降低端到端响应延迟。
AI.motivation: 传统级联语音助手（ASR→LLM→工具执行）串行执行，工具延迟只能在用户说完且LLM识别出工具调用后才产生，导致响应延迟高。为降低端到端延迟，需要将工具执行提前到语音接收过程中。
AI.method: 引入Predictor模块，在语音识别过程中基于部分ASR假设预测工具请求，进行推测性执行并缓存结果；将缓存输出注入LLM提示以加速响应；针对用户自我纠正，采用基于规则的选择性验证机制，仅注入有效缓存结果；LLM保留直接发起工具调用的能力作为兜底，使最坏情况下延迟不超过基线串行流水线。在完整实现的Android语音助手上进行实测评估。
AI.result: 首次音频响应中位延迟从5.79s降至4.60s，标准差从3.49s降至2.81s，响应延迟更可预测。
AI.conclusion: 通过推测性工具执行与缓存注入，可在端侧级联语音助手中显著降低并稳定端到端响应延迟，且规则验证与LLM兜底保证了鲁棒性与延迟上界。

title: HiPLEX: Hierarchical Policy Factorization for Full Duplex Speech Language Models
summary: As human--AI interactions become more conversational, full-duplex speech language models capable of natural real-time dialogue are growing in importance. Beyond generating appropriate responses, these models must coordinate turn-taking, backchanneling, and floor management in real time. Reinforcement learning (RL) provides a way to refine these behaviors through direct feedback on interaction outcomes. However, existing RL methods either apply timing feedback to a token policy or optimize semantic content, leaving the joint improvement of timing and content unresolved. We introduce HiPLEX, an RL framework that factorizes a pretrained full-duplex text policy into a control policy that decides when to emit content and a conditional content policy that decides what to emit. The first factor selects among 'pad', 'epad', and 'con'. The second selects a token only when 'con' is chosen. This hierarchy describes conditional actions within each frame and uses the model's existing text head. We route timing advantages to the token-group factor through event-causal masks derived from generated speech episodes, and route an LLM-judge semantic advantage to the conditional content factor. Across three Moshi seeds on Full-Duplex-Bench v1, HiPLEX reduces takeover rates during natural user pauses and backchannel opportunities, and shortens post-interruption response latency relative to GRPO, while maintaining comparable judged interruption-response quality. On Moshi and PersonaPlex, HiPLEX better matches pooled human turn-timing and backchannel-rate marginals than GRPO.

AI.tldr: 提出 HiPLEX 强化学习框架，将全双工文本策略分解为"何时说"的控制策略与"说什么"的条件内容策略，联合优化时序与语义，改善轮次管理与打断响应。
AI.motivation: 随着人机交互日益对话化，具备自然实时对话能力的全双工语音语言模型愈发重要。此类模型不仅需生成合适回复，还须实时协调轮次转换、反馈应答与话轮管理。强化学习可通过交互结果反馈来优化这些行为，但现有 RL 方法要么仅将时序反馈施加于 token 策略，要么只优化语义内容，未能解决时序与内容的联合优化问题。
AI.method: HiPLEX 将预训练全双工文本策略分解为两个因子：控制策略决定何时发出内容，条件内容策略决定发出什么。控制因子在 'pad'、'epad' 和 'con' 中做选择；仅当选择 'con' 时，内容因子才选出一个 token。该层次结构描述每帧内的条件动作，并复用模型已有的文本 head。方法通过由生成语音片段导出的事件因果掩码，将时序优势路由至 token 组因子；并将 LLM 评判的语义优势路由至条件内容因子。
AI.result: 在 Full-Duplex-Bench v1 上，跨三个 Moshi 随机种子，HiPLEX 相比 GRPO 降低了用户自然停顿与反馈应答机会期间的接管率，缩短了打断后的响应延迟，同时保持可比的打断响应质量（由评判模型评估）。在 Moshi 与 PersonaPlex 上，HiPLEX 比 GRPO 更贴近汇总的人类轮次时序与反馈应答率边际分布。
AI.conclusion: HiPLEX 通过因子化控制与内容策略并分别路由时序与语义优势，实现了全双工语音对话中时序与内容的联合优化，在接管率、响应延迟及人类时序分布匹配上优于 GRPO。

title: Feature Encoding in VAE-based Audio Decoders: Effects of Input, Depth and Distribution
comment: This manuscript has been accepted for publishing in IEEE Transactions on Audio, Speech and Language Processing (TASLP)
summary: Neural audio synthesis models like the Realtime Audio Variational autoEncoder (RAVE) achieve impressive genera tion quality, yet how their internal representations encode musical features remains poorly understood. We present a systematic layer-wise and cross-layer cluster analysis of RAVE decoder activations across three models trained on different musical domains, tested with four stimulus types. We then evaluate architectural generalization with a general purpose EnCodec model. For RAVE, we find that synthetic stimuli are encoded well across models and audio features (pitch |\r{ho}|=0.45, 5.1x the null, BPM |\r{ho}| = 0.76, 8.6x the null). These results are reduced but still substantively apparent when using natural audio (mean across features |\r{ho}|=0.25, 2.8x the null). Natural audio sees a stronger encoding when nonlinear probes are used (mean across features R2=0.56, 18x the null, +0.152 nonlinear gain over the linear probe R2). Encoding strength varies throughout the layers of the decoder and an increased ability to joint-encode in the middle layers is seen across all audio features (\b{eta}2 all negative, p < 0.05). The general purpose EnCodec decoder also sees similar strong synthetic responses across audio features, similar nonlinear gains for natural audio joint encoding and similar depth profiles. We find the best cross-layer cluster improves the strength (r = 0.65, p = 0.006) and prevalence (r = 0.75, p = 0.001) of BPM encoding when compared against the best whole layers within the same section, with no effect for joint encoding. These findings advance the interpretability of neural audio models and inform targeted control strategies for neural synthesis.

AI.tldr: 本文对RAVE与EnCodec神经音频合成模型的解码器激活进行了系统的逐层与跨层聚类分析，考察其内部表征对音高、BPM等音乐特征的编码方式，并揭示层间联合编码规律与跨层聚类的优势。
AI.motivation: 神经音频合成模型（如RAVE）生成质量出色，但其内部表征如何编码音乐特征仍缺乏理解，限制了模型可解释性与可控生成能力。
AI.method: 对三个不同音乐领域训练的RAVE解码器激活进行逐层和跨层聚类分析，使用四类刺激测试；引入通用EnCodec模型评估架构泛化性；对比线性与非线性探针，并分析各层编码强度与联合编码能力。
AI.result: 合成刺激编码良好（音高|ρ|=0.45，5.1倍零假设；BPM|ρ|=0.76，8.6倍）；自然音频编码减弱但仍显著（平均|ρ|=0.25，2.8倍）。非线性探针显著提升自然音频编码（平均R²=0.56，18倍，较线性提升0.152）。编码强度随层变化，中间层联合编码能力增强（β2均为负，p<0.05）。EnCodec表现出相似趋势。最优跨层聚类提升BPM编码强度（r=0.65，p=0.006）与普遍性（r=0.75，p=0.001），对联合编码无影响。
AI.conclusion: 研究推进了神经音频模型的可解释性，揭示了解码器层级化与联合编码结构，为神经合成的定向控制策略提供了依据。

title: Exploiting Acoustic and Content-Oriented Speaker Verification Attacks Against Multilingual Voice Anonymization
comment: Accepted in IEEE Spoken Language Technology (SLT) 2026
summary: Attacker ASV systems for voice anonymization have been studied primarily in English, leaving their behavior in multilingual settings largely unexplored. Conventional ASV has shown that both acoustic and contextual information are important for multilingual speaker verification. Inspired by this, we investigate whether the same holds for attacker ASV on anonymized speech. We evaluate both acoustic- and content-oriented attackers on multilingual anonymized speech and construct a multilingual voice-converted dataset to improve cross-lingual generalization. Our results show that attacker effectiveness depends on the linguistic utility of the anonymized speech. Overall, acoustic-oriented attackers achieve better performance. However, when linguistic information is well preserved, the performance gap between content- and acoustic-oriented attackers narrows compared with conditions involving stronger speech distortion. The multilingual voice-converted dataset further improves performance and partially reduces the cross-lingual gap. These findings highlight the need for more comprehensive attacker modeling and evaluation protocols that consider both privacy and utility, rather than relying on a attacker strategy\footnote{Full code and pretrained models and MultiVC Dataset link are available at: https://github.com/monkeyDarefeen/DAST

AI.tldr: 本文研究多语言匿名语音下攻击者ASV的表现，比较声学导向与内容导向攻击者，并构建多语言语音转换数据集以提升跨语言泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 现有攻击者ASV系统主要在英语场景下研究，其多语言环境下的行为尚不清楚；受传统ASV中声学与上下文信息对多语言说话人验证重要性的启发，作者探究匿名语音攻击者ASV是否存在类似规律。
AI.method: 在多语言匿名语音上评估声学导向与内容导向攻击者，并构建多语言语音转换数据集以改善跨语言泛化。
AI.result: 攻击者效果取决于匿名语音的语言可用性；总体上声学导向攻击者表现更好，但当语言信息保留良好时，内容导向与声学导向攻击者的性能差距相较于语音失真更强的条件会缩小；多语言语音转换数据集进一步提升性能并部分缩小跨语言差距。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果说明需要更全面的攻击者建模与评测协议，同时考虑隐私与可用性，而非依赖单一攻击者策略。

title: Geometric Representations for Transformed Pattern Matching in Music
comment: 35 pages, 8 tables, 15 figures. Draft of first chapter of book currently in preparation for publication by Springer
summary: We review the notion of representing music using point sets and argue that such representations are better adapted than sequential representations for matching patterns in unvoiced, polyphonic music, such as keyboard music. Musical transformations such as transposition, inversion, diminution, augmentation and retrograde can be modelled by geometric transformations in pitch-time representations that combine translation with scaling parallel to and reflection in the time axis. We identify eight types of geometric pitch-time representation that use chromatic pitch, morphetic pitch, morph or chroma to represent pitch and either onset time or midtime to represent time. We illustrate how these types of representation allow us to characterise different types of musical transformation. For example, by using midtime instead of onset time, we can precisely characterise certain retrograde relationships; and by using morph and chroma pitch representations we can characterise transformations involving octave displacements and duplications. We present the concept of a transformation class and consider the three specific classes, $F_{\mathrm{2STR}}$, $F_{\mathrm{2STRMod7}}$ and $F_{\mathrm{2STRMod12}}$. We introduce the notion of an inter-pattern transformation graph for a set of patterns, $S$, and a transformation class, $F$. Each vertex in such a graph represents a pattern in $S$ and there is an edge in the graph from pattern $P_1$ to pattern $P_2$ if and only if $P_1$ can be mapped onto $P_2$ by a transformation in $F$. We show, with the aid of such graphs, that the musical relationships between the occurrences of the HAYDN theme in Ravel's Menuet sur le nom d'Haydn can be precisely described in terms of transformations in $F_{\mathrm{2STR}}$, $F_{\mathrm{2STRMod7}}$ and $F_{\mathrm{2STRMod12}}$ within the pitch-time representations considered.

AI.tldr: 本文综述了用点集表示音乐的方法，认为其比序列表示更适合匹配无词复调音乐中的模式；提出八种几何化的音高—时间表示，用变换类与"模式间变换图"刻画音乐变换，并以拉威尔《海顿之名小步舞曲》中HAYDN主题的occurrences为例验证。
AI.motivation: 序列表示不适合无词复调音乐（如键盘音乐）中的模式匹配；需要一种能自然刻画移调、倒影、减值、增值、逆行等音乐变换的表示框架。
AI.method: 采用点集（几何）表示，将音高—时间表示中的音乐变换建模为音高/时间两方向上的平移、缩放与反射的组合；按音高（chromatic pitch、morphetic pitch、morph、chroma）与时间（onset time、midtime）组合出八种表示类型；定义"变换类"及三个具体类F_2STR、F_2STRMod7、F_2STRMod12，并引入模式间变换图（顶点为模式，边表示存在F中变换映射）。
AI.result: 八种表示类型可刻画不同变换：用midtime代替onset time可精确刻画某些逆行关系；用morph与chroma音高表示可刻画涉及八度移位与重复的变换。变换图显示，拉威尔《Menuet sur le nom d'Haydn》中HAYDN主题各occurrences之间的关系可在F_2STR、F_2STRMod7、F_2STRMod12框架内精确描述。
AI.conclusion: 点集/几何音高—时间表示为复调音乐的变换与模式匹配提供了统一的刻画工具，变换类与模式间变换图能精确表达实际音乐作品中的主题关系。

title: Restore, Separate, Restore: A Modular Framework for Music Source Restoration
summary: Music Source Restoration (MSR) seeks to recover original, unprocessed instrument stems from mixed, mastered, and possibly degraded recordings. Unlike conventional source separation, which treats the mixture as a linear sum of clean sources, MSR must additionally invert nonlinear production effects, such as equalization and compression, and transmission-related degradations, such as codec artifacts. We propose a three-stage framework built around this distinction: (1) a mixture restoration model that addresses degradation before separation, (2) a single model that separates the restored mixture into eight target stems (vocals, guitars, keyboards, synthesizers, bass, drums, percussion, and orchestra), and (3) stem-specific restoration experts fine-tuned on the separator's own residual artifacts. Each stage improves restoration quality over the previous one on the MSR Challenge test set. We release code and models to support future research in MSR at https://github.com/theMoro/music_source_restoration.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出音乐源修复（MSR）任务，区别于传统源分离，需同时逆转非线性制作效果与传输退化，并设计三阶段框架：先修复混合信号、再分离为八种乐器、最后用专家模型修复分离残留伪影。
AI.motivation: 传统源分离假设混合为干净源的线性叠加，忽略均衡、压缩等非线性制作效果及编解码等传输退化，无法恢复原始未处理的乐器音轨，因此需要重新定义并解决MSR问题。
AI.method: 提出三阶段框架：(1)混合修复模型，在分离前处理退化；(2)单一分离模型，将修复后的混合信号分离为八个目标音轨（人声、吉他、键盘、合成器、贝斯、鼓、打击乐、管弦乐）；(3)音轨专属修复专家，基于分离器自身残留伪影进行微调。
AI.result: 在MSR Challenge测试集上，每个阶段相较前一阶段均提升了修复质量，验证了渐进式框架的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 通过明确MSR与源分离的区别并提出三阶段渐进框架，显著提升了修复质量；同时开源代码与模型以推动MSR后续研究。

title: Sobolev Norms in Neural Embeddings Measure Audio Morphing Regularity
summary: Morphing has recently gained renewed interest with the emergence of generative models, particularly in audio and image generation. In musical sound synthesis, morphing can generate intermediate sounds between two targets, helping musicians and sound engineers explore new sounds with interesting perceptual properties. As morphing is inherently defined in perceptual terms, evaluating this task is challenging. In this work, we introduce Sobolev Distances to Ideal Morphing (SDIM), a novel objective metric to quantify the regularity of audio morphing trajectories in perceptually relevant audio embedding spaces. Leveraging a physics-based sound synthesizer, we evaluate the discriminative power of SDIM on controlled morphing trajectories with varying degrees of regularity and compare it with that of existing audio morphing metrics. Results show that, contrary to state-of-the-art metrics, the proposed metric reliably discriminates desirable trajectories from adversarial ones.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 SDIM，一种在感知相关音频嵌入空间中量化音频变形轨迹规则性的客观指标，并验证其判别能力优于现有指标。
AI.motivation: 音频变形（morphing）在音乐声音合成中可生成两个目标之间的中间声音，帮助音乐人和声音工程师探索具有有趣感知特性的新声音。但变形本质上是感知层面的定义，因此该任务评估困难，缺乏可靠的客观评价指标。
AI.method: 提出 Sobolev Distances to Ideal Morphing（SDIM）指标，在感知相关的音频嵌入空间中以 Sobolev 距离度量变形轨迹与理想变形的偏差，从而量化轨迹的规则性。借助基于物理的声音合成器，构造具有不同规则性程度的受控变形轨迹，用于评估 SDIM 的判别能力，并与现有音频变形指标进行比较。
AI.result: 实验表明，与当前最先进的指标不同，SDIM 能够可靠地区分理想（期望）轨迹与对抗性（不良）轨迹。
AI.conclusion: SDIM 为音频变形提供了一种有效的客观评价手段，弥补了该任务在感知层面难以评估的不足。

title: Memory Prediction Excess: A Probabilistic Quantity for Predictive Gain and Memory Length in Stochastic Processes
summary: A central question in the prediction of stochastic processes is the extent to which past information can improve the probability of correctly predicting the next state. We introduce the Memory Prediction Excess (MPE) to address this question quantitatively. The MPE measures the average improvement in prediction accuracy obtained by using the entire observed history relative to using only the static marginal distribution, in discrete-time finite-state processes. It is defined as the difference between the expected optimal conditional prediction accuracy and the optimal static prediction accuracy. Its basic properties are examined: the MPE is always non-negative; it admits an upper bound depending on the static accuracy, attained if and only if the future is almost surely a deterministic function of the past; and degenerate cases in which the MPE vanishes are characterized. A normalized version, taking values in the unit interval, is introduced as a dimensionless measure of predictive efficiency. A lower bound is derived by comparing predictions based on histories of different lengths, showing that the expected optimal prediction accuracy is monotone with respect to the history length. The framework is extended to finite-length histories, where the finite-history MPE (FH-MPE) measures the predictive gain attainable when only the most recent observations are retained. This leads to the notion of a minimal memory length required to achieve the same predictive performance as the full history. For finite-order Markov chains, this minimal memory length is shown to be bounded by the Markov order. The MPE and its variants are formulated in terms of conditional probabilities and prediction accuracies, offering a probabilistic perspective on the predictive utility of memory that is complementary to classical information-theoretic approaches.

AI.tldr: 本文提出记忆预测增益（MPE），量化历史信息带来的预测准确率提升，并研究其性质、归一化形式及有限记忆扩展。
AI.motivation: 核心问题是：过去信息能在多大程度上提升对下一状态预测的准确性。经典信息论方法（如熵、互信息）刻画的是不确定性/信息量，而非直接刻画预测准确率，需要一个以预测准确率为基础的互补度量。
AI.method: 在离散时间有限状态过程上定义MPE，即期望最优条件预测准确率与最优静态（仅用边缘分布）预测准确率之差；分析其非负性、上界（由静态准确率决定，达到当且仅当未来几乎必然是过去的确定性函数）及退化条件；引入取值于单位区间的归一化版本；通过比较不同历史长度的预测导出下界，证明期望最优预测准确率关于历史长度单调；扩展为有限历史MPE（FH-MPE），度量仅保留最近观测时的预测增益，并提出达到全历史预测性能所需的最小记忆长度；对有限阶马尔可夫链，证明最小记忆长度受马尔可夫阶数界定。
AI.result: MPE恒非负；存在依赖静态准确率的上界，等号成立当且仅当未来几乎必然是过去的确定性函数；刻画了MPE消失的退化情形；归一化版本落在[0,1]内；期望最优预测准确率随历史长度单调不减，从而给出下界；有限阶马尔可夫链的最小记忆长度不超过其马尔可夫阶数。
AI.conclusion: MPE及其变体以条件概率和预测准确率为语言，为记忆的预测效用提供了概率视角，与经典信息论方法互补。

title: Low-Rank and Structured Sparse Tensor Decomposition for Anomaly Detection in Multivariate Functional Data
summary: Multivariate functional data arise in many modern manufacturing systems, where multiple sensors record densely sampled process trajectories. Monitoring such data is challenging because nominal variation is strongly correlated across samples, sensors, and time, while faults may appear either as isolated deviations or as structured departures concentrated within a limited number of sensor-specific temporal trajectories. We propose two unsupervised sparse tensor decomposition methods that preserve this multimode structure. Entrywise Sparse CP Decomposition (ES-CP) uses an entrywise \(\ell_1\) penalty to identify localized anomalies, whereas Fiberwise Sparse-Group Lasso CP Decomposition (FG-Lasso) combines entrywise and fiberwise penalties to detect both localized deviations and anomalies concentrated within temporal fibers. Both methods represent nominal process behavior through a low-rank CP decomposition and are estimated using alternating optimization with closed-form sparse-component updates. Two simulation studies evaluate performance under different fault structures, signal severities, noise levels, and missing observations. FG-Lasso attains or ties the highest macro F$_1$ score in almost all settings in the first study and achieves the highest macro F$_1$ score. In a multichannel forging-process case study, FG-Lasso and ES-CP obtain macro F$_1$ scores of 0.85 and 0.82, respectively, compared with 0.69 or lower for TRPCA and PCA-based anomaly detectors. The results demonstrate that explicitly matching the sparse penalty to the anticipated fault structure improves both anomaly detection and fault localization in high-dimensional functional processes.

AI.tldr: 本文提出两种无监督稀疏张量分解方法（ES-CP与FG-Lasso），通过将稀疏惩罚结构与多变量函数数据的故障模式相匹配，实现高维制造过程异常检测与故障定位。
AI.motivation: 多变量函数数据中，标称变异在样本、传感器和时间间强相关，故障既可能表现为孤立偏差，也可能集中于特定传感器的时间纤维中，传统方法难以同时保留这种多模态结构并进行准确定位。
AI.method: 提出Entrywise Sparse CP分解（ES-CP），使用逐元素ℓ1惩罚识别局部异常；提出Fiberwise Sparse-Group Lasso CP分解（FG-Lasso），结合逐元素与纤维级惩罚，同时检测局部偏差和集中于时间纤维的异常。两方法均以低秩CP分解表征标称过程，并采用交替优化与闭式稀疏分量更新进行估计。
AI.result: 两项仿真研究在不同故障结构、信号强度、噪声水平和缺失观测下评估性能。FG-Lasso在首项研究几乎所有设定中取得或并列最高宏F1分数，并在第二项研究取得最高宏F1。在多通道锻造工艺案例中，FG-Lasso与ES-CP的宏F1分别为0.85和0.82，显著优于TRPCA与PCA类检测器（≤0.69）。
AI.conclusion: 显式地将稀疏惩罚结构与预期故障结构相匹配，可同时提升高维函数过程异常检测与故障定位的性能。

title: Data Fusion for Errors-in-Variables
summary: We study errors-in-variables problems in which a target study contains only a single error-prone surrogate of an unobserved exposure, while an external source study provides repeated surrogate measurements from a different population. The measurement error distribution is allowed to depend on the observed error-free variables, and the error-free variable distribution itself may differ between studies. We introduce a conditional transportability assumption that enables the use of external repeated measurements under source-target heterogeneity. Together with additional replicate-error conditions, it identifies the target conditional measurement-error distribution. Building on this identification result, we develop a data-fusion estimator for a broad class of target functionals. The estimator combines conditional deconvolution, flexible nuisance estimation, and orthogonal correction that reduces first-order sensitivity to nuisance estimation. For the proposed estimator, we develop a unified spectral theory covering both diffuse-spectrum and finite atomic-spectrum target functionals, derive a general asymptotic expansion, and establish consistency and target-specific convergence-rate bounds. The resulting convergence-rate bounds depend jointly on the spectral properties of the measurement error, the latent exposure, and the target functional. For finite atomic-spectrum targets, we further establish joint Gaussian and bootstrap limits, yielding inference for smooth moment transformations under an additional centering condition. In the reported simulations, Fuse-EIV has small bias for the primary exposure-related coefficient. Applications to the National Health and Nutrition Examination Survey illustrate how accounting for population heterogeneity and error heteroscedasticity can change empirical conclusions.

AI.tldr: 本文研究变量误差问题：目标研究中仅有一个易出错替代变量，外部研究提供来自不同总体的重复替代测量；引入条件可迁移性假设以在源-目标异质性下识别目标的测量误差分布，并提出数据融合估计量Fuse-EIV，建立统一谱理论与渐近理论。
AI.motivation: 目标研究常只有单一易出错的暴露替代变量，传统变量误差方法需要重复测量或已知误差分布，而外部重复测量来自不同总体，其误差分布可依赖无误差协变量、且无误差变量分布本身在两项研究间可能不同，因此需要新的识别与估计框架。
AI.method: 提出条件可迁移性假设，配合额外重复误差条件识别目标的给定协变量测量误差分布；在此基础上构造数据融合估计量（Fuse-EIV），结合条件反卷积、灵活冗余参数估计与正交校正以降低对冗余参数的一阶敏感性；建立统一谱理论，覆盖弥漫谱与有限原子谱目标泛函，给出一般渐近展开、相合性及目标特定收敛速率界。
AI.result: 收敛速率界联合依赖测量误差、潜在暴露与目标泛函的谱性质；对有限原子谱目标进一步建立联合高斯与自助极限，在附加中心化条件下可实现光滑矩变换的推断；模拟中Fuse-EIV对主要暴露相关系数偏差较小；NHANES应用表明考虑总体异质性与误差异方差性会改变经验结论。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为源-目标异质下的变量误差问题提供了可识别的数据融合估计与统一谱渐近理论，兼顾弥漫谱与原子谱目标，并在实证中显示考虑异质性与异方差误差会影响推断结论。

title: sHAIL-Causal: A Sequential Staircase Procedure for Invariant Causal Predictor Discovery
comment: 17 pages, 2 figures, 2 tables. Introduces the general sHAIL learning framework and its causal specialization
summary: We introduce sHAIL-Causal, the causal specialization of the Saturated Hierarchical Atomic Incremental Learning (sHAIL) paradigm: a sequential staircase procedure that ascends a nested hierarchy of hypothesis classes H_0 < H_1 < ... < H_K once a saturation signal indicates that mastery of the current stage has plateaued. Where general sHAIL leaves the saturation criterion open, sHAIL-Causal instantiates it with a joint criterion of goodness-of-fit saturation and cross-environment invariance, replacing the complexity control of Structural Risk Minimization. We show, theoretically and by simulation, that complexity-only staircases are seduced by confounded predictors that lower empirical risk without reflecting stable causal structure, whereas an invariance-gated staircase provably halts at the true causal predictor set under a per-variable Richness condition. We show that naive greedy search fails to recover the causal set even under Richness, trace the failure to non-monotonicity of the invariance statistic along single-variable paths, and validate a fix combining bounded-exhaustive block-seeding with a calibrated acceptance threshold. We then extend the guarantee to environments arriving sequentially, yielding a confidence guarantee that stays valid at every arrival, which one-shot exhaustive search cannot offer without repeating its full combinatorial search. We close by formalizing the intervention of a wise teacher who lifts a saturated learner off a plateau of boredom.

AI.tldr: 提出 sHAIL-Causal，将 sHAIL 的饱和判据实例化为"拟合优度饱和+跨环境不变性"，以不变性门控替代结构风险最小化的复杂度控制，理论上保证阶梯停在真实因果预测集，并扩展到序贯到达环境与"教师干预"。
AI.motivation: 一般 sHAIL 的饱和准则未定义，仅靠复杂度控制的"阶梯"易被混杂预测器诱惑：这类预测器降低经验风险却不反映稳定因果结构。因此需要一个能识别因果结构、而非仅控制复杂度的饱和/升级判据，并需处理贪婪搜索失效、序贯环境到达、以及学习停滞（boredom plateau）等问题。
AI.method: 1) 定义嵌套假设类阶梯 H_0<H_1<...<H_K，按饱和信号逐级上升；2) 用"拟合优度饱和 + 跨环境不变性"的联合判据实例化饱和准则，替代 SRM 的复杂度控制；3) 理论证明 + 仿真对比复杂度型与不变性门控型阶梯；4) 分析贪婪单变量搜索的非单调不变性统计量失败模式，提出"有界穷举块播种 + 校准接受阈值"的修复；5) 将保证扩展到序贯到达环境，给出每一步到达都有效的置信保证；6) 形式化"智慧教师"对饱和学习者的干预。
AI.result: 复杂度型阶梯会被混杂预测器诱导；不变性门控阶梯在逐变量 Richness 条件下可证明停在真实因果预测集；朴素贪婪搜索即使满足 Richness 也失败，原因是不变性统计量沿单变量路径非单调；所提修复方案得到验证；序贯环境中获得每一步都有效的置信保证，而一次性穷举搜索若不重复完整组合搜索无法提供该保证。
AI.conclusion: 以不变性门控替代复杂度控制，是实现因果化递增学习阶梯的关键；它提供可证明的因果恢复保证、序贯有效性保证，并通过教师干预突破饱和停滞，构成一个从理论到修复方案的完整因果学习框架。

title: Learning Decision-Stump Thresholds in Context: Dynamics of Softmax Attention
summary: Estimating a decision threshold requires locating observations near an unknown boundary. We study how gradient-based pretraining learns this statistical rule in a two-parameter softmax-attention model with a fixed feature and inequality direction. Pretraining uses labeled contexts and their true thresholds; a fresh threshold must be inferred from context alone. Under a large-resolution initialization, constant-step gradient descent on $m$ tasks with $n$ examples each produces a frozen estimator with error $\widetilde O((m\wedge n)^{-1}+N^{-1})$ for each fixed interior threshold and every fresh-context size $N$. The two terms separate finite-pretraining accuracy from fresh-context localization. The mechanism is coordinated parameter divergence: population training calibrates the relative label and feature scores, then increases the attention scale as $t^{1/4}$, giving population threshold error $O(t^{-1/4})$. To transfer this mechanism to a fixed finite corpus, we control gradient errors relative to the shrinking directions of progress at successive parameter scales. This certifies a growing training interval without requiring long-time tracking of the population trajectory. We also identify the boundary limitation of the one-head model and explain statistically what a reflected symmetrization could achieve.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究基于梯度的预训练如何在两参数 softmax-attention 模型中学习“估计决策阈值”这一统计规则，刻画了有限预训练精度与新鲜上下文定位的误差分解，并给出机制解释与有限语料下的训练区间认证。
AI.motivation: 估计决策阈值需要定位靠近未知边界的观测点，这是一类基本统计规则。作者希望理解梯度预训练究竟如何学会该规则，以及在预训练后从上下文单独推断新阈值时的误差如何随预训练规模与新鲜上下文规模变化，同时厘清单头模型的边界与对称化可能带来的改进。
AI.method: 构建带固定特征与固定不等式方向的两参数 softmax-attention 模型；预训练使用带标签上下文及其真实阈值，新阈值需仅凭上下文推断。采用大分辨率初始化下的常数步长梯度下降，在 m 个任务、每个 n 个样本上训练。分析总体训练下的参数协调发散机制（相对标签与特征分数校准后使注意力尺度按 t^{1/4} 增长），并通过控制连续参数尺度下相对于收缩方向（进展方向）的梯度误差，将机制迁移到固定有限语料，认证增长的训练区间，无需长时间跟踪总体轨迹。
AI.result: 在固定内部阈值与任意新鲜上下文规模 N 下，得到冻结估计器的误差为 Õ((m∧n)^{-1}+N^{-1})；两项分别对应有限预训练精度与新鲜上下文定位。总体训练下阈值误差达 O(t^{-1/4})。此外识别出单头模型的边界局限，并从统计角度解释了反射对称化可能实现的效果。
AI.conclusion: 梯度预训练通过协调的参数发散学习阈值估计规则：先校准相对标签与特征分数，再放大注意力尺度以实现阈值定位。误差可清晰分解为预训练项与上下文定位项。通过控制收缩方向上的梯度误差，可将总体机制转移到有限语料并认证增长训练区间；单头模型存在边界限制，反射对称化有望在统计上改善该限制。

title: A Query Is Not a Commitment: Learning to Correct Expert Answers in Online Deferral
summary: An inaccurate expert can still provide useful information after correction. We study online learning to defer in which the learner chooses an expert and fixes a correction function before purchasing its answer, then applies that function to the answer received. The difficulty is that observed losses reflect both expert quality and an unfinished correction: early errors can discourage queries that would be valuable after learning. We propose ORUCB, which pools shared and expert-specific polynomial responses. A bound on cumulative response-learning error calibrates confidence-weighted risk regression and exploration, allowing the router to account for this error when deciding which answers to buy. Under bounded residuals and disagreements, a fixed feasible model of optimal responses, and linear models of free and optimal queried risk, the calibrated algorithm achieves high-probability pseudo-regret $O(\sqrt T\log(T+1))$ over $T$ rounds for fixed problem parameters. The guarantee permits singular answer distributions and misspecified shared responses; optimality is relative to the bounded response class. On four test streams, the selected cubic policy has lower fee-inclusive cost than seven baselines that deploy answers unchanged. Comparisons with a common correction learner examine routing, while six-price comparisons measure cost and query rates.

AI.tldr: 研究"在线学习延迟"(online learning to defer)：学习器在购买专家答案前先选定一个纠正函数，并将其应用于所获答案。论文提出ORUCB算法，联合共享与专家特定的多项式响应，在累积响应学习误差界下校准置信加权风险回归与探索，从而在购买决策时考虑纠正误差。在固定参数下实现 $O(\sqrt T\log(T+1))$ 的高概率伪遗憾，允许奇异答案分布与错误设定的共享响应。实验表明所选三次策略在四类测试流上费用含成本低于七种基线。
AI.motivation: 不准确的专家在纠正后仍能提供有用信息，因此学习器可与专家"延迟"协作：先购买答案再纠正。核心困难在于观测到的损失同时反映专家质量与尚未完成的纠正过程，早期误差会抑制那些在纠正学习后才显现价值的查询，导致探索-利用矛盾加剧。
AI.method: 提出ORUCB算法，将共享响应与专家特定响应以多项式形式联合池化。通过对累积响应学习误差给出界，据此校准置信加权的风险回归与探索，使路由(router)在决定购买哪些答案时显式考虑纠正误差。理论分析在有界残差与分歧、存在固定的最优响应可行模型、以及空闲与最优查询风险的线性模型假设下进行。
AI.result: 在固定问题参数下实现高概率伪遗憾 $O(\sqrt T\log(T+1))$。该保证允许奇异答案分布和错误设定的共享响应，最优性是相对于有界响应类而言的。在四个测试流上，所选三次策略的费用含成本低于七种"直接采用答案不做纠正"的基线；并与一种常见纠正学习器比较路由行为，通过六种价格比较衡量成本与查询率。
AI.conclusion: 在答案需纠正的延迟场景中，显式建模并校准纠正误差可使路由决策更优；ORUCB兼顾共享与专家特定响应，获得近最优遗憾界，并在实验中降低成本、改善查询效率，优于不纠正的基线方法。

title: How Inefficient Is Natural Gradient Descent? From Exact Optimality to Θ( \sqrt{ \log d } ) Divergence
summary: Natural gradient descent (NGD) underlies common methods in ML. For dually flat families, idealized NGD on the forward Kullback--Leibler objective follows the mixture geodesic which is often longer than the shortest Fisher--Rao path. We quantify this overhead by the inefficiency ratio \(R \ge 1\), the Fisher length of the mixture geodesic divided by the Fisher--Rao distance, and bound its supremum over endpoint pairs as a function of the parameter dimension \(d\). A tensor criterion identifies the regime (I) families, with \(R=1\) everywhere: exactly those with quadratic potential or dimension one, such as fixed-covariance Gaussians. For non-quadratic families, we prove two further regimes: (II) bounded third-order skewness plus finite Fisher--Rao diameter yields a dimension-independent bound; and (III) for products of scale families---including Gaussian covariances and Gamma rates---\(R\) grows as \(Θ(\sqrt{\log d})\), unbounded in \(d\). Under a per-step Fisher-chord budget, \(R\) translates to a practical computational cost: NGD requires asymptotically at least \(R\) times as many steps as an optimizer following the Fisher--Rao geodesic. Experiments confirm all three regimes: \(R=1\) to machine precision for quadratic-potential families (I), the categorical bound \(π/(2\sqrt{2})\) is approached but not attained (II), and sampled scale-product \(R\) grows with \(d\), reaching \(R \approx 1.5\) for long, high-dimensional moves (III).

AI.tldr: 本文研究自然梯度下降（NGD）在前向KL目标下沿混合测地线运动，其Fisher长度相对Fisher–Rao最短路径存在冗余，定义低效率比R并刻画其关于维度d的三种regime。
AI.motivation: 对偶平坦族中，理想化NGD沿混合测地线更新，而混合测地线通常比最短的Fisher–Rao路径更长，这一冗余此前缺乏定量的维度依赖刻画，且不清楚其对实际优化步数的影响。
AI.method: 将冗余量化为低效率比R：混合测地线的Fisher长度除以Fisher–Rao距离，并求其在端点对上的上确界关于参数维数d的界；通过张量判据划分regime（I）R≡1（二次势或一维，如固定协方差高斯）；对非二次族证明regime（II）有界三阶偏度加有限Fisher–Rao直径给出与维度无关的界，以及regime（III）尺度族乘积（高斯协方差、Gamma速率等）下R以Θ(√log d)增长。进一步在每步Fisher弦预算下将R转译为计算代价。
AI.result: 在每步Fisher弦预算下，NGD所需步数渐近至少是沿Fisher–Rao测地线优化器的R倍。实验验证三种regime：二次势族（I）中R=1达机器精度；（II）中类别界π/(2√2)被逼近但未达到；（III）中采样尺度乘积的R随d增长，长距离高维移动时达到约1.5。
AI.conclusion: NGD沿混合测地线的路径冗余可由R统一量化并具有明确的维度依赖regime结构，该冗余直接对应实际优化步数的乘性代价，为判断何时NGD相对Fisher–Rao测地线优化低效提供了理论判据。

title: Assumption-lean logistic regression with missing covariates
summary:
Missing covariates are frequently encountered in supervised learning problems, and classical methods for estimation using such data use carefully chosen imputation schemes for missing data, or likelihood approximations that lead to nonconvex $M$-estimation problems. These methods and their relatives are suitable for scenarios in which the covariate distribution is known, and more broadly, have enjoyed tremendous success in linear models. But even in basic nonlinear problems such as logistic regression in moderate dimensions, such methods can experience drastic failure modes when the covariate distribution is unknown.
  Motivated by the need for reliable alternatives, we consider the problem of parameter estimation in logistic regression with missing covariates. Crucially, we operate in the assumption-lean setting where the covariate distribution is unknown (but bounded). We design a stochastic approximation method that is based on $Z$-estimation with a novel monotone operator, and establish that our algorithm is computationally efficient and achieves provable signal recovery at parametric rates under the hypothesis that covariates are missing completely at random. Our theory sharply characterizes the $\ell_2^2$ risk of the estimator in terms of the missingness profile, accommodating heterogeneous observation probabilities. Importantly, it shows that our method always outperforms the de facto ``complete-case'' estimator that ignores observations with any missing data. Even in the setting with homogeneous missingness (in which each covariate is observed independently with probability $q$), our bounds exhibit intricate and nonstandard dependence on $q$ that can yield significant improvements over using only complete cases. We complement our upper bounds with new information-theoretic lower bounds that show that this intricate dependence on $q$ is fundamental in a minimax sense.

AI.tldr: 本文研究协变量缺失下的逻辑回归参数估计，在协变量分布未知但有限的假设精简框架下，提出基于单调算子的Z-估计随机近似方法，实现计算高效且达到参数速率，并给出尖锐的风险刻画与极小极大下界。
AI.motivation: 经典缺失协变量处理方法（如插补或似然近似）依赖已知的协变量分布，在非线性模型（如中等维度逻辑回归）且协变量分布未知时会出现严重失效模式，因此需要可靠的替代方法。
AI.method: 在协变量分布未知（但有界）的假设精简设定下，针对缺失协变量的逻辑回归，设计一种基于Z-估计的随机近似方法，采用新颖的单调算子，在协变量完全随机缺失（MCAR）假设下进行分析。
AI.result: 算法计算高效并在参数速率下实现可证明的信号恢复；理论以缺失模式（容许异质观测概率）刻画ℓ2^2风险，证明其始终优于完全案例估计量；在齐次缺失情形下风险对q呈现复杂非标准依赖，可带来显著提升；并给出新的信息论下界，证明这种依赖在极小极大意义下是本质的。
AI.conclusion: 所提Z-估计随机近似方法在协变量分布未知的假设精简设定下，对缺失协变量逻辑回归提供了可靠、计算高效且具有最优速率保证的估计方案，其风险依赖于缺失模式的复杂结构，并由极小极大下界佐证其必要性。

title: HyperNSDE: Personalized Neural SDEs for Joint Static-Longitudinal Clinical Data Generation
summary: Synthetic patient data generation is a promising solution to the dual challenge of data scarcity and privacy constraints in healthcare machine learning. Realistic synthesis of patient-level clinical data requires jointly modeling heterogeneous static covariates, irregularly sampled longitudinal trajectories, and informative observation times - three tightly coupled components in practice yet rarely addressed together. We propose HyperNSDE, a continuous-time generative model that conditions a latent Neural SDE on static patient representations through a hypernetwork, allowing baseline characteristics to shape trajectory evolution beyond the initial condition without requiring a trajectory encoder, while stochastic latent dynamics capture realistic variability in generated paths. Observation times are modeled jointly through a latent-state-dependent intensity process, and training on irregular stochastic paths is stabilized via a deterministic-stochastic path decomposition with a non-adversarial signature-kernel objective. Experiments on simulated and real clinical datasets show improved observation-time fidelity and competitive performance, while matched-grid analyses reveal that forecasting and correlation metrics are affected by observation-grid regularity and trajectory smoothness.

AI.tldr: 提出 HyperNSDE，一种连续时间生成模型，通过超网络使静态患者表征条件化潜在 Neural SDE，联合建模静态协变量、不规则纵向轨迹与观测时间，实现逼真的患者级临床数据合成。
AI.motivation: 医疗机器学习面临数据稀缺与隐私限制的双重挑战，合成患者数据是潜在解决方案。但真实的患者级临床数据合成需同时建模三个紧密耦合的组件：异质静态协变量、不规则采样的纵向轨迹，以及信息性观测时间；现有方法很少将三者联合处理。
AI.method: HyperNSDE 为连续时间生成模型：用超网络将静态患者表征条件化到潜在 Neural SDE，使基线特征不仅作为初始条件、还能塑造轨迹演化，且无需轨迹编码器；以随机潜在动力学刻画生成路径的真实变异。观测时间通过依赖潜在状态强度的过程联合建模；训练时采用确定性-随机路径分解结合非对抗的签名核（signature-kernel）目标，以稳定不规则随机路径上的训练。
AI.result: 在模拟数据与真实临床数据集上，方法在观测时间保真度上有所提升且整体性能具有竞争力；匹配网格分析表明，预测与相关性指标受观测网格规律性和轨迹平滑度的影响。
AI.conclusion: HyperNSDE 首次将静态协变量、不规则纵向轨迹与信息性观测时间在连续时间框架下联合建模，验证了超网络条件化 Neural SDE 与联合强度过程的有效性；同时提示评估时应关注观测网格规律性与轨迹平滑度对指标的干扰。

title: Bayesian Optimization on Function Spaces via Sparse RKHS Manifolds
summary: Bayesian Optimization (BO) has become an established methodology for minimizing black-box functions of a vector input. Often, however, this parameter vector arises from the discretization of an inherently functional relationship. Several recent articles have considered the Functional Bayesian Optimization (FBO) setting, in which the variable to be optimized is not a member of a finite dimensional vector space, but rather an infinite dimensional function space. In this work, we propose $L^0$ Manifold Optimization (L0MO), a simple approach to FBO which searches the subset of a Reproducing Kernel Hilbert Space (RKHS) consisting of functions with a sparse representation in the kernel functions, optimizing both the kernel locations and their coefficients. We discuss in detail the relationship between our method and existing ones, providing a unifying lens through which to view prior works. To assess our method against the state of the art, we conduct an extensive computational study, and along the way develop a novel set of benchmark test functions which port standard finite-dimensional ones to the infinite dimensional domain. Our experiments demonstrate that, on balance, the proposed method achieves superior performance across a wide range of test benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出L0MO，一种面向函数型贝叶斯优化的方法，在RKHS中搜索具有核函数稀疏表示的函数子集，同时优化核位置与系数，并在新构建的无穷维基准上验证其性能优势。
AI.motivation: 传统贝叶斯优化处理有限维向量输入，但许多实际问题的参数向量源自内在函数关系的离散化，因此优化对象本质上是无穷维函数空间中的元素。已有函数型贝叶斯优化（FBO）工作缺乏统一视角，且基准测试不充分，亟需新的方法与评估体系。
AI.method: 提出L0 Manifold Optimization（L0MO），搜索再生核希尔伯特空间（RKHS）中由核函数稀疏表示构成的函数子集，联合优化核的位置与对应系数；同时详细讨论该方法与已有工作的关系，提供统一的分析视角，并构建将标准有限维测试函数推广至无穷维域的新型基准函数集。
AI.result: 通过大规模计算实验，在多种测试基准上，所提方法总体取得了优于当前最先进方法的性能，验证了L0MO在函数型贝叶斯优化任务中的有效性。
AI.conclusion: L0MO为函数型贝叶斯优化提供了一种简洁而有效的方案，其统一视角有助于理解既有方法，新基准亦推动了该方向的评估标准化；实验表明该方法在广泛基准上具备综合性能优势。

title: Two-Sample Testing for Random Graphs without Vertex Correspondence
