summary: Two populations of graphs often have to be compared without any correspondence between their vertices, for instance when networks come from different communities, or when a graph generative model is evaluated against held-out graphs. We study how many graphs such an unaligned two-sample test needs, and which graph statistics can detect which differences. For an Erdős--Rényi null and a planted two-block difference that leaves every expected degree unchanged, we show that $m\asymp t^{-3}$ graphs per group are necessary and sufficient when the per-graph signal-to-noise ratio is $t<1$. Signed triangle counts attain this rate, and the lower bound holds for every graph size. With aligned vertices $m\asymp t^{-1}$ graphs suffice, so misalignment costs a factor of order $t^{-2}$. When the triangle signal cancels, the rate becomes $t^{-4}$ and $4$-cycles are needed. Statistics built from trees have exactly the same expectation under both hypotheses, and tests based on finitely many of them have asymptotically no power. In the graphon limit, this class includes degree distributions and message-passing graph neural network features. For a non-constant null, a generic difference is visible at first order, and a simple motif test attains the aligned order of sample size, suggesting that misalignment is costly mainly for differences that are invisible at low orders. We also give an exactly valid test for one or two graphs per group, at a cost in power. In our simulations, the fitted exponents are close to the predicted ones, and degree-based and random-GNN evaluation metrics stay at their level in a setting where signed triangles need about $65$ graphs.

AI.tldr: 研究无顶点对应（未对齐）两样本图检验所需样本量：ER零假设下植入双块差异时，每组需 m≍t^{-3} 张图（有符号三角形可达），对齐仅需 m≍t^{-1}，未对齐代价约为 t^{-2} 因子。
AI.motivation: 实际场景中常需比较两个无顶点对应的图总体（不同社区网络、生成模型对留出图的评估），但缺少对未对齐两样本检验样本复杂度与可用统计量的系统理论刻画。
AI.method: 以 Erdős–Rényi 为零假设、构造保持所有期望度不变的双块植入差异；分析未对齐与对齐条件下的检验样本量下界与上界，考察有符号三角形、4-环、树类统计量（含 graphon 极限下的度分布与消息传递 GNN 特征）、motif 检验等，并给出每组一至两张图的精确有效检验。
AI.result: 每图信噪比 t<1 时，未对齐必要且充分样本量为 m≍t^{-3}，有符号三角形计数达到该率且下界对任意图规模成立；对齐时 m≍t^{-1}，未对齐代价约 t^{-2}。三角形信号抵消时率变为 t^{-4}，需用 4-环。树类统计量在两假设下期望完全相同，有限个此类统计量的检验渐近无功效；非恒定零假设下一般差异一阶可见，简单 motif 检验可达对齐阶。仿真拟合指数接近理论值，度数类与随机 GNN 指标在需约 65 张图的情形下保持原水平。
AI.conclusion: 未对齐两样本图检验的样本复杂度由低阶信号决定：对齐有益但对低阶不可见差异代价高；树类统计量（含度分布与消息传递 GNN 特征）在 graphon 极限下无渐近功效，而有符号三角形等低阶 motif 是最优检测统计量。

title: Is $\sqrt{d}$ Separation Necessary for Gradient EM to Learn Gaussian Mixtures in High Dimensions?
summary: Learning Gaussian mixture models (GMMs) using the Expectation-Maximization (EM) algorithm and its gradient-based variants is a fundamental problem in machine learning. It is known that randomly initialized (gradient) EM fails to learn multi-component GMMs in the exact-parameterized setting, where the number of components matches that of the ground-truth GMM. Recently, global convergence of gradient EM has been established in the over-parameterized setting, where more components are used, provided that the ground-truth components are well separated. In particular, the minimum separation between ground-truth components is required to scale as $Ω(\sqrt{d})$, where $d$ is the dimension. In this paper, we show that this dimensional dependence is unavoidable in high-dimensional settings. Specifically, we consider a hybrid EM algorithm that uses standard EM updates for the mixing weights and gradient EM updates for the component means. For any $ε> 0$, we prove that when the dimension is sufficiently large, in the worst case a separation of order $Ω(d^{0.5-ε})$ is insufficient to guarantee global convergence of population gradient EM in sub-exponential time under random initialization, even in the over-parameterized regime. Our result establishes an almost optimal worst-case lower bound on the ground-truth separation required for learning Gaussian mixtures via gradient EM in high dimensions.

AI.tldr: 本文证明高维下梯度EM学习高斯混合模型所需的真值分量分离度存在Ω(d^{0.5−ε})的近乎最优的最坏情况下界，说明Ω(√d)的维度依赖不可避免。
AI.motivation: 已有工作证明过参数化且真值分量充分分离（分离度需为Ω(√d)）时梯度EM可全局收敛，但该维度依赖是否为本质必要的尚不清楚。本文旨在刻画高维下分离度要求的不可避免性，给出最坏情况下的下界。
AI.method: 考虑混合权重用标准EM更新、分量均值用梯度EM更新的混合EM算法。设维度充分大，对任意ε>0，证明在随机初始化下，即使处于过参数化情形，最坏情况下分离度为Ω(d^{0.5−ε})仍不足以在次指数时间内保证总体梯度EM的全局收敛。
AI.result: 建立了高维下通过梯度EM学习高斯混合所需真值分离度的近乎最优最坏情况下界：Ω(d^{0.5−ε})的分离度在最坏情况下无法保证全局收敛，与已有上界Ω(√d)对齐，表明维度依赖不可避免。
AI.conclusion: 证明了高维情形下Ω(√d)量级的分离度要求是不可避免的，给出了基于梯度EM学习高斯混合的近乎最优最坏情况分离度下界。

title: Explicit Asymptotic Bounds for Sequential Calibration Beyond $T^{2/3}$
summary:
Probability forecasts are calibrated when predicted probabilities match empirical outcome frequencies: among events assigned a probability $p$, we'd hope that the fraction of positive outcomes is close to $p$. We study the problem of sequential forecasting of binary outcomes. The classical $O(T^{2/3})$ bound on expected cumulative $\ell_1$-calibration error established by Foster and Vohra stood for over two decades until Dagan et al. reduced the exponent $2/3$ by an unspecified constant.
  We establish a new two-phase recursive labeling strategy for the sign-preservation-with-reuse game that yields the bound $O(n^αt^β)$ for all choices of space and time. We then sharpen the reduction from upper bounds on sign preservation to calibration by modifying the equivalence of Dagan et al. to use only $O(\log T)$ instances of the sign-preservation-with-reuse game. This lets us establish an explicit bound of $O(T^{0.662942288})$, the first explicit exponent below $2/3$ for sequential calibration, by combining both improvements and choosing explicit feasible parameters.

AI.tldr: 本文研究二元结果的序列校准问题，通过提出两阶段递归标注策略改进符号保持博弈界，并优化归约，首次给出了显式低于2/3的校准误差上界 O(T^{0.662942288})。
AI.motivation: 序列概率预测的校准误差长期停留在 Foster-Vohra 的 O(T^{2/3}) 上界；Dagan 等人虽降低指数但未给出明确常数，缺少显式且可量化改进的界。
AI.method: 1) 针对 sign-preservation-with-reuse 博弈提出两阶段递归标注策略，得到对所有时空选择成立的 O(n^α t^β) 界；2) 改进 Dagan 等人的归约，仅用 O(log T) 个博弈实例将符号保持上界转化为校准上界；3) 结合二者并选取显式可行参数。
AI.result: 得到显式上界 O(T^{0.662942288})，为序列校准中首个指数明确低于 2/3 的结果。
AI.conclusion: 通过新博弈策略与更高效归约的组合，显式改进了序列校准的累积 ℓ1 校准误差上界，突破了经典的 2/3 指数。

title: Uniform Discrete Diffusion Models are Minimax Optimal for Estimating Distributions with Small Effective Support Size
summary: Discrete diffusion models have emerged as a practically successful framework for generative modeling on discrete product spaces, yet their statistical generalization properties remain poorly understood. Discrete real-world data such as text or biological sequences often concentrate on a small fraction of the astronomically large ambient space because of semantic or physical constraints, but existing bounds fail to capture this distributional structure and instead scale with the size of the ambient space, giving rise to almost vacuous error bounds. We address this gap for uniform discrete diffusion, one of the two dominant discrete diffusion paradigms alongside masking diffusion, by deriving statistical guarantees governed by the effective support size $s_n(P_0)$, a sample-size-dependent measure of distributional complexity. Given $n$ independent and identically distributed (i.i.d.) samples from an unknown data distribution $P_0$ on $[K]^d$, we show that, with appropriate choices of network size and hyperparameters, the expected total variation (TV) loss scales as $O(\sqrt{s_n(P_0)/n})$, while the expected Kullback--Leibler (KL) divergence is bounded by $O(\frac{1}{n}s_n(P_0)\log(eK^d/s_n(P_0))\log n)$. Furthermore, we show that the TV rate is minimax optimal and that the KL rate is minimax optimal up to a factor of $\log n$. Together, these upper and lower bounds show that uniform discrete diffusion successfully avoids the curse of dimensionality for distributions with small effective support size: the TV error rate depends on the ambient state-space size only through $s_n(P_0)$, while the corresponding KL rate incurs only an additional logarithmic dependence on the ambient state-space size.

AI.tldr: 该论文为均匀离散扩散模型建立了统计泛化理论：在K类离散空间[K]^d上，给定n个i.i.d.样本，当网络规模和超参数选择恰当时，期望TV损失以O(√(s_n(P_0)/n))收敛，期望KL散度以O((1/n)s_n(P_0)log(eK^d/s_n(P_0))log n)收敛，其中s_n(P_0)为有效支撑大小；证明TV率为极小极大最优，KL率在log n因子内最优，从而说明均匀离散扩散对有效支撑较小的分布避免了维数灾难。
AI.motivation: 离散扩散模型在离散积空间生成建模中应用广泛，但其统计泛化性质尚不清楚。真实离散数据（如文本、生物序列）因语义或物理约束往往集中于天文级巨大环境空间中的极小部分，而现有泛化界未能刻画这种分布结构，误差界随环境空间规模增长，导致近乎空洞的结论。论文旨在填补这一空白，为两种主流离散扩散范式之一的均匀离散扩散提供统计保证。
AI.method: 针对[K]^d上的未知数据分布P_0，利用n个独立同分布样本，引入样本量相关的分布复杂度度量——有效支撑大小s_n(P_0)，并在适当的网络规模与超参数设置下，对均匀离散扩散的期望TV损失与期望KL散度进行理论分析。随后通过构造匹配的下界，对TV率与KL率分别进行极小极大最优性分析。
AI.result: 期望TV损失的上界为O(√(s_n(P_0)/n))；期望KL散度的上界为O((1/n)s_n(P_0)log(eK^d/s_n(P_0))log n)。下界分析表明TV率是极小极大最优的，KL率在相差log n因子的意义下也是极小极大最优的。
AI.conclusion: 均匀离散扩散能有效避免维数灾难：对于有效支撑大小较小的分布，TV误差率仅通过s_n(P_0)依赖环境状态空间规模，KL率对环境状态空间规模仅增加对数级依赖。这些上下界共同刻画了离散扩散的统计泛化行为，为理解其在高维离散数据上的成功提供了理论支撑。

title: Stability of Measure-to-Measure Transformers on Sub-Gaussian Data
summary: Transformers have exhibited impressive empirical success across various domains, but their theoretical foundations remain less developed. This work constitutes a mathematical study of the measure-to-measure operators defined by transformers. We show that transformers map sub-Gaussian inputs to sub-Gaussian outputs; this ensures that taking arbitrary-length compositions of the softmax operator is well-defined. We then show that transformers are Hölder continuous with respect to the 1-Wasserstein distance on appropriate spaces of sub-Gaussian inputs. This allows us to establish estimates on the error propagation along a transformer between a sub-Gaussian input and its empirical approximation. We also study a mean-field analog of the cross-attention mechanism, which is an operator from a pair of probability measures to a single probability measure. We show that cross-attention exhibits different Hölder regularity and sample-complexity in its two input arguments. Last, we apply our results to deduce approximation guarantees for measure-to-measure transformers. Together, these results provide a firm stability and finite-sample theory for transformers on sub-Gaussian data.

AI.tldr: 本文建立Transformer作为测度到测度算子的数学理论：证明其将次高斯输入映射为次高斯输出、关于1-Wasserstein距离具有Hölder连续性，并给出误差传播估计、交叉注意力的平均场分析及测度到测度Transformer的逼近保证。
AI.motivation: Transformer在实践中取得广泛成功，但其理论基础相对薄弱。作者希望为Transformer在次高斯数据上的稳定性与有限样本性质建立严格的理论框架。
AI.method: 将Transformer形式化为测度到测度算子；证明次高斯性在softmax算子下的封闭性以保证任意长度复合良定义；证明算子关于次高斯输入空间上1-Wasserstein距离的Hölder连续性；据此推导次高斯输入与其经验近似之间沿Transformer的误差传播估计；研究交叉注意力机制的平均场版本（从一对概率测度到单个概率测度的算子），刻画其在两个输入参数上的Hölder正则性与样本复杂度差异；最后将结果应用于测度到测度Transformer的逼近保证。
AI.result: Transformer将次高斯输入映射为次高斯输出，保证任意长度softmax复合良定义；Transformer在1-Wasserstein距离下Hölder连续；得到误差传播估计；交叉注意力在其两个输入参数上呈现不同的Hölder正则性与样本复杂度；并推出测度到测度Transformer的逼近保证。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为次高斯数据上的Transformer提供了坚实的稳定性与有限样本理论。

title: Nash Social Welfare for Multi Armed Bandits: Trajectory-wise Expected and High Probability Regret
summary: We study fair multi-armed bandits under the Nash Social Welfare (NSW) objective, which measures performance via the geometric mean of accumulated rewards. Existing work defines Nash regret as $\mathrm{NR}_T = μ^\star - (\prod_{t=1}^T \mathbb{E}μ_{I_t})^{1/T}$, where $μ_{I_t}$ is the mean reward of the recommended arm $I_t$ and $T$ is the horizon. Since it applies the geometric mean to per-round marginal expectations, it ignores the joint distribution of rewards across rounds, leaving the NSW fairness motivation unaddressed at the trajectory level. We propose \emph{trajectory-wise Nash regret} $\widetilde{\mathrm{NR}}_T = μ^\star - \mathbb{E}[(\prod_{t=1}^T μ_{I_t})^{1/T}]$, which computes the geometric mean over complete sample paths before taking expectations, capturing NSW fairness more faithfully. By Jensen's inequality, $\widetilde{\mathrm{NR}}_T \geq \mathrm{NR}_T$, making it a strictly stronger metric. We also introduce \emph{high probability Nash regret} $\widehat{\mathrm{NR}}_T = μ^\star - (\prod_t μ_{I_t})^{1/T}$, giving the first high probability regret bounds in fair bandits. Our two-phase algorithm, Round Robin Nash Confidence Bound (\texttt{RR-NCB}), combines round robin exploration with a Nash confidence bound index policy. We show $\widetilde{\mathrm{NR}}_T \leq \widetilde{\mathcal{O}}(\sqrt{k\log T/T})$ and, with probability $1-δ$, $\widehat{\mathrm{NR}}_T \leq \widetilde{\mathcal{O}}(\sqrt{k\log(kT/δ)/T})$, matching the optimal $\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}(\sqrt{k/T})$ rate despite the stronger metrics. Optimality follows from a lower bound via AM-GM and standard $k$-armed bandit minimax arguments. Simulations validate our theory.

AI.tldr: 本文针对Nash社会福祉（NSW）目标的公平多臂老虎机问题，提出轨迹级Nash遗憾和高概率Nash遗憾两个更强指标，设计RR-NCB算法，证明其达到最优速率，并通过仿真验证。
AI.motivation: 现有Nash遗憾将几何平均作用于每轮边际期望，忽略了跨轮奖励的联合分布，未在轨迹层面体现NSW公平性动机。
AI.method: 提出轨迹级Nash遗憾，在取期望前先对完整样本路径计算几何平均；提出高概率Nash遗憾；设计两阶段算法RR-NCB，结合轮转探索与Nash置信界索引策略。
AI.result: 证明轨迹级Nash遗憾上界为Õ(√(k log T / T))；以概率1-δ，高概率Nash遗憾上界为Õ(√(k log(kT/δ)/T))，均匹配最优Õ(√(k/T))速率；通过AM-GM及k臂老虎机极小极大论证给出下界；仿真验证理论。
AI.conclusion: 在更强的轨迹级与高概率Nash遗憾指标下，RR-NCB仍达到最优速率，为公平老虎机提供更faithful的公平度量与首个高概率遗憾界。

title: High-dimensional online calibration from harmonic weights
summary:
We study the online calibration of multidimensional forecasts over an arbitrary convex set $Y\subseteq\mathbb{R}^d$ relative to an arbitrary error norm $\|\cdot\|_{L}$. For forecasting $d$ binary outcomes simultaneously ($Y=[0,1]^d$), we give the first algorithm that achieves $\varepsilon$-calibration in a number of rounds that is polynomial in $d$ for every fixed accuracy. It requires $d^{O(1/\varepsilon)}$ rounds, exponentially improving the dimension dependence of previous bounds. For multi-class forecasting ($Y=Δ_d$), we obtain the same $d^{O(1/\varepsilon)}$ rate, improving the $d^{\widetilde{O}(1/\varepsilon^2)}$ bounds of Peng and Fishelson et al.
  Our algorithm is simple: on each round, it outputs a harmonically weighted distribution over harmonically smoothed past outcomes. The same algorithm works for every forecast set and norm. More generally, it achieves $\varepsilon$-calibration after $\exp(O(γ(Y,L)/\varepsilon))$ rounds, where $γ(Y,L)$ is a geometric parameter defined by a matrix discrepancy problem. The harmonic weights are motivated by the fact that the discrete Hilbert transform matrix achieves the optimal discrepancy up to a universal constant, simultaneously for every $L$. This optimality result may be of independent interest.

AI.tldr: 本文研究任意凸集与任意误差范数下多维预测的在线校准问题，提出首个对固定精度达到 d^{O(1/ε)} 轮数的算法，显著改进了二分类与多分类预测的维数依赖，并给出基于矩阵差异的几何量刻画。
AI.motivation: 多维在线校准中，已有算法在维数 d 上的依赖过高（如多分类的 d^{Õ(1/ε²)}），甚至随精度要求增长过快。作者希望在任意凸预测集与任意误差范数的一般框架下，找到维数依赖更优的校准算法，并理解其背后的几何机理。
AI.method: 算法非常简洁：每轮输出对历史上"调和平滑"过的结果做调和加权分布。该算法对任意预测集 Y 和任意范数 L 通用。理论上，它将轮数刻画为 exp(O(γ(Y,L)/ε))，其中 γ(Y,L) 是由矩阵差异问题定义的几何参数。调和权重的动机来自离散 Hilbert 变换矩阵对任意 L 同时达到最优差异（相差一个普适常数）。
AI.result: 对同时预测 d 个二值结果（Y=[0,1]^d），给出首个在固定精度下轮数关于 d 为多项式（d^{O(1/ε)}）的 ε-校准算法，指数级改进此前维数依赖；对多分类（Y=Δ_d）取得相同 d^{O(1/ε)} 速率，优于此前的 d^{Õ(1/ε²)}；一般情形下达到 exp(O(γ(Y,L)/ε)) 轮，并证明离散 Hilbert 变换矩阵在任意 L 下差异最优（至常数）。
AI.conclusion: 该工作统一且简化了多维在线校准，通过调和加权与矩阵差异几何量，将维数依赖由指数级降至 d^{O(1/ε)}，其中 Hilbert 变换矩阵的最优差异结果具有独立价值。

title: Trustworthy Method Comparison with AI Judges: Estimation and Design under Order, Batch, and Aggregation Effects
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used as judges for automated AI evaluation. A common practice is to randomize prompt sequences and average the resulting scores, but its statistical validity remains unclear. We show that LLM evaluation mechanisms can be approximated by a class of Markov generalized linear mixed models (GLMMs), supported by out-of-sample predictions across three major commercial LLMs. Using a first-order Markov GLMM, we study leaderboard ranking and group comparison. For leaderboard ranking, randomize-and-average selection is consistent under a mild separation condition, and a Williams square design can improve efficiency when item qualities are close. For group comparison, naive averaging can yield inconsistent conclusions about differences in group-level quality because of the response model's nonlinearity. Empirical results further support the validity of the proposed model-based inference beyond the first-order theory, including settings with higher-order sequence memory. We illustrate the approach in an application where AI judges compare two graphical model estimation methods.

AI.tldr: 本文以马尔可夫广义线性混合模型（GLMM）刻画LLM评分机制，分析随机化平均策略在排行榜排名与组间比较中的统计有效性，并给出基于模型的推断方法。
AI.motivation: LLM作为自动化评估裁判时，常通过随机化提示顺序并取平均分来降低位置偏差，但该做法缺乏统计理论支撑，其一致性等性质尚不明确。
AI.method: 将LLM评估机制近似为一类马尔可夫广义线性混合模型，并用三家主流商业LLM的样本外预测加以验证；采用一阶马尔可夫GLMM分析排行榜排名与组间比较，讨论随机化平均选择的一致性条件、Williams方阵设计的效率，以及非线性导致的朴素平均偏误；并在含高阶序列记忆等设定下进行实证检验。
AI.result: 排行榜排名中，随机化平均选择在温和分离条件下具有一致性，且当项目质量接近时Williams方阵设计可提升效率；组间比较中，由于响应模型的非线性，朴素平均可能得出关于组级质量差异的不一致结论；实证结果支持所提基于模型的推断在一阶理论之外（含高阶记忆情形）的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 随机化平均策略的统计有效性依赖于模型设定与条件，基于马尔可夫GLMM的模型化推断为LLM裁判评估提供了更可靠的理论与实用框架，并可用于AI裁判比较图模型估计方法等应用。

title: Stochastic Gradient Descent Ascent is Suboptimal for Nonconvex-PL Min-Max Games
summary: How far can stochastic gradient descent ascent (SGDA) go by tuning its timescale ratio and step sizes in nonconvex min-max games? We answer this question for nonconvex-PL (NC-PL) games by establishing the first tight complexity of two-timescale SGDA with a fixed timescale ratio and non-increasing step sizes. For $\ell$-smooth games with an inner $μ$-PL inequality, we prove a complexity lower bound $Ω(κ^2\ell\varepsilon^{-2}+κ^4\ellσ^2\varepsilon^{-4})$, where $κ=\ell/μ$ is the condition number, $σ^2$ is the gradient variance, and $\varepsilon$ measures the outer gradient norm. This matches existing SGDA upper bounds and establishes a complexity separation from Smoothed-AGDA (Yang et al., 22'). In addition, we show that SGDA can fail to find a stationary point when its timescale ratio is as small as $o(κ^2)$. Our negative results highlight the fundamental limitation of SGDA in NC-PL games, and justify the development of alternative methods.

AI.tldr: 本文建立了非凸-PL（NC-PL）极小极大博弈中两时间尺度SGDA的首个紧复杂度下界，并揭示了其相对于Smoothed-AGDA的复杂度分离与失效条件。
AI.motivation: 探究随机梯度下降上升（SGDA）通过调节时间尺度比与步长在非凸极小极大博弈中究竟能达到何种性能极限，特别是其在NC-PL博弈中的复杂度是否紧致，以及是否劣于其他算法。
AI.method: 针对ℓ-光滑且满足内层μ-PL不等式的博弈，对采用固定时间尺度比和非增步长的两时间尺度SGDA进行复杂度下界分析，并通过构造性论证给出失效情形。
AI.result: 证明了复杂度下界Ω(κ²ℓε⁻²+κ⁴ℓσ²ε⁻⁴)，其中κ=ℓ/μ为条件数，σ²为梯度方差，ε度量外层梯度范数；该下界与已有SGDA上界匹配，建立了与Smoothed-AGDA的复杂度分离；并证明当时间尺度比小至o(κ²)时SGDA可能无法找到稳定点。
AI.conclusion: 上述负面结果凸显了SGDA在NC-PL博弈中的根本性局限，为其替代算法的开发提供了理论依据。

title: ProximalFM: Amortized Proximal Causal Inference under Hidden Confounding
summary: Standard causal identification methods often assume no unmeasured confounding and can fail when relevant confounders are unobserved. Proximal causal inference instead uses proxy variables to identify effects under hidden confounding. However, nonparametric proximal estimation can be challenging in practice: recovering causal estimands such as the conditional average treatment effect (CATE) requires solving an ill-posed integral equation that is data-hungry, hyperparameter-sensitive, and optimization-unstable. Bayesian inference for such models provides a desirable alternative, mitigating these difficulties by regularizing through the prior. However, computing a posterior is itself challenging, as a typical likelihood function will include latent variables. Following the recent success of tabular foundation models in backdoor, instrumental variable, and frontdoor settings, we propose that prior-data fitted networks (PFNs) are uniquely suited to resolve this bottleneck. Indeed, by training on synthetic data sampled from compliant structural causal models with access to oracle counterfactuals, we simplify the task substantially, amortizing the implied Bayesian operator inversion into a single transformer forward pass. Compared to prior literature that focuses primarily on point estimation, our model, ProximalFM, explicitly targets the Bayesian posterior distribution of the CATE. One unique aspect of this problem is that we need to provide Monte Carlo estimates of the oracle CATEs, leading to a novel variation of PFNs that accounts for the added stochastic error. Across a diverse suite of proximal regimes, ProximalFM achieves consistently strong CATE-estimation performance without dataset-specific tuning, with its largest advantage when latent confounding is substantial and the proxies are weakly informative; it also provides fast inference through a single amortized forward pass.

AI.tldr: 提出ProximalFM，将PFN应用于近端因果推断，把病态积分方程求逆摊销为单次Transformer前向传播，直接输出CATE的贝叶斯后验分布。
AI.motivation: 标准因果识别依赖无未测混杂假设，存在隐混杂时失效；近端因果推断可用代理变量在隐混杂下识别效应，但非参数近端估计需求解病态积分方程，存在数据需求大、超参敏感、优化不稳定等问题。贝叶斯推断可通过先验正则缓解，但含潜变量的后验计算本身困难。
AI.method: 受表格基础模型在backdoor、工具变量、frontdoor等场景成功的启发，提出用先验数据拟合网络（PFN）解决瓶颈：从满足条件的结构因果模型合成数据采样，并利用oracle反事实，将隐含的贝叶斯算子求逆摊销进一次Transformer前向传播。模型ProximalFM显式建模CATE的贝叶斯后验分布；针对需提供oracle CATE的蒙特卡洛估计所引入的额外随机误差，设计了PFN的新变体。
AI.result: 在多种近端设定下，ProximalFM无需数据集特定调参即可稳定取得强CATE估计性能；当隐混杂较强且代理变量信息较弱时优势最大；同时通过单次摊销前向传播实现快速推断。
AI.conclusion: ProximalFM表明PFN可有效摊销近端因果推断中的贝叶斯后验计算，兼顾估计精度与推断效率，尤其在强隐混杂与弱代理信息场景中具有明显优势。

title: Anytime-valid simulation-based hypothesis testing
summary: For a given data distribution $(X_t)_{t \in \mathbb{N}} \sim Q$ i.i.d., we investigate the hypothesis testing problem: $H_0: Q = P_0$ vs. $H_1: Q = P_1$, for two different model probability distributions $P_0$ and $P_1$. In contrast to the standard setting, where analytic densities $p_0$ and $p_1$ are given, here, we consider the density-free setting, where we only have access to i.i.d. simulations $(Z^0_t)_{t \in \mathbb{N}} \sim P_0$ and $(Z^1_t)_{t \in \mathbb{N}} \sim P_1$. For this simulation-based hypothesis testing setting, we construct an e-test martingale, resulting in a sequential test with anytime-valid type-I error guarantees, approximate growth optimality, geometrically decaying type-II error bounds, and asymptotic power one. Most ingredients used in our constructions are variants of well known concepts. The value of this paper lies in the compact presentation of an effective, anytime-valid solution for the density-free simulation-based sequential hypothesis testing case.

AI.tldr: 本文研究无密度（density-free）情形下的假设检验问题：仅能获得来自 $P_0$ 与 $P_1$ 的独立同分布模拟样本，而无解析密度 $p_0,p_1$。作者构造了基于模拟的 e-test 鞅，从而得到一个具有随时有效（anytime-valid）第一类错误保证、近似增长最优性、几何衰减的第二类错误界以及渐近功效为 1 的序贯检验。
AI.motivation: 标准假设检验通常假设解析密度 $p_0$、$p_1$ 已知。但在许多实际问题中，模型分布只能通过模拟器访问（如复杂生成模型、仿真系统），无法写出显式密度。这种"无密度 + 基于模拟"的序贯检验设定缺乏紧凑且有效的解决方案，因此本文旨在填补这一空白。
AI.method: 在仅能访问 i.i.d. 模拟样本 $(Z^0_t)\sim P_0$、$(Z^1_t)\sim P_1$ 的设定下，作者构造了一个 e-test 鞅（e-test martingale）。其构造主要基于若干已知概念的变体，将这些组件紧凑地组合为适用于无密度模拟情形的鞅型检验统计量，进而导出序贯检验流程。
AI.result: 所构造的序贯检验具备以下性质：（1）随时有效的第一类错误控制（anytime-valid type-I error）；（2）近似增长最优性（approximate growth optimality）；（3）几何衰减的第二类错误界（geometrically decaying type-II error bounds）；（4）渐近功效为 1（asymptotic power one）。
AI.conclusion: 本文的价值在于以紧凑的方式，为"无密度、基于模拟的序贯假设检验"这一设定提供了一个有效且具有 anytime-valid 保证的解决方案，其构造主要依托于对若干已知概念（如 e-test 鞅）的变体与组合。

title: Two-Sample Testing via Generative Processes
summary: Deciding whether two samples come from the same distribution is a classical problem in statistics, and generative transport offers a new way to approach it. We build a stochastic interpolant directly between the two samples and observe that, for a symmetric schedule, its law is invariant under the time reflection $t \mapsto 1-t$ whenever the two distributions coincide. We therefore test whether the marginals at times t and 1-t agree by computing their Jensen--Shannon divergence. Both marginals are explicit mixtures over all cross-pairs of observations, so nothing is learned, and permutation calibration gives an exact finite-sample level. For Gaussian noise, this divergence equals a time integral that pairs the reflection defects of the velocity field and of the score, so the test compares transport dynamics rather than endpoints alone. With a narrow-plus-broad noise design, the test attains the minimax separation rate n^{-2s/(4s+d)} over bounded, compactly supported densities whose difference has Sobolev smoothness s > 3d/4, with no lower bound on the densities. Fusing a dyadic grid of noise scales through their permutation ranks, without sample splitting, preserves exact level and adapts to unknown s at an iterated-logarithmic cost. Empirically, the test matches or outperforms state-of-the-art kernel two-sample tests.

AI.tldr: 提出基于生成式传输的随机插值两样本检验：在样本间构造随机插值，利用对称调度下两分布相同时律对时间反射 t↦1−t 不变的性质，用 t 与 1−t 边缘分布的 Jensen–Shannon 散度作为检验统计量，无学习、置换校准给出精确有限样本水平，并达到极小极大分离率。
AI.motivation: 判断两个样本是否来自同一分布是统计学的经典问题，而生成式传输（generative transport）为该问题提供了新途径。已有核两样本检验等方法存在对光滑性未知、密度可能有下界假设、样本利用效率等局限，作者希望借助传输动力学而非仅比较端点来构造检验，并获得最优分离率与自适应能力。
AI.method: 直接在两样本间构造随机插值（stochastic interpolant）；对对称调度，当两分布重合时其律在时间反射 t↦1−t 下不变，故通过计算时刻 t 与 1−t 边缘分布的 Jensen–Shannon 散度来检验二者是否一致。两边缘分布为所有跨对观测的显式混合，无需学习任何参数；采用置换校准获得精确有限样本水平。对高斯噪声，该散度等于一个时间积分，将速度场与得分（score）的反射缺陷配对，从而比较传输动力学。进一步采用"窄+宽"噪声设计，并通过置换秩融合一组二进网格噪声尺度，无需样本切分。
AI.result: 在差函数具有 Sobolev 光滑度 s>3d/4、密度有界且紧支撑、且对密度无下界要求的条件下，"窄+宽"噪声设计使检验达到极小极大分离率 n^{−2s/(4s+d)}。融合二进网格噪声尺度的置换秩方法在无需样本切分的情况下保持精确水平，并以迭代对数代价自适应未知的 s。实验上，该检验与当前最优的核两样本检验相比表现持平或更优。
AI.conclusion: 该工作将生成式传输引入两样本检验，利用反射对称性给出无需学习、可精确校准的检验统计量，并在宽松的密度假设下达到极小极大最优分离率，兼具对未知光滑度的自适应性与良好的实证性能，为传输动力学视角下的分布比较提供了理论与实用框架。

title: High-Dimensional Statistical Inference for Sparse Support Vector Machines
summary: Using a replica-symmetric high-dimensional characterization, we develop an inferential framework for sparse support vector machines when the sample size and number of features grow proportionally. The main challenge is the nonsmooth hinge loss, which prevents direct application of debiasing arguments developed for smooth classification losses. We overcome this difficulty by representing the $L_1$-penalized support vector machine (SVM) as a linear program and identifying the hinge-loss subgradient through its dual variables. This yields a computationally accessible debiased estimator whose coordinates are asymptotically Gaussian under the proportional asymptotic regime. The resulting distributional characterization provides confidence intervals and hypothesis tests for individual features and enables false-discovery-rate-controlled variable selection. Extensive simulations examine calibration, power, and variable-selection performance under a range of covariance structures, including strongly correlated designs. An analysis of high-dimensional breast cancer gene-expression data illustrates how the proposed inference can distinguish statistically significant features from variables selected by the original sparse SVM.

AI.tldr: 针对稀疏支持向量机在样本量与特征数成比例增长的高维场景，本文提出一种基于副本对称高维刻画与去偏的推断框架，实现渐近高斯推断、置信区间、假设检验及错误发现率控制的变量选择。
AI.motivation: 现有针对光滑分类损失的去偏推断方法无法直接应用于铰链损失，因其非光滑性导致传统去偏论证失效；而稀疏SVM在高维比例渐近下的统计推断（如显著性检验、置信区间、错误发现率控制）缺乏可用工具。
AI.method: 采用副本对称（replica-symmetric）高维刻画建立推断框架。关键技巧是将 $L_1$ 罚支持向量机表示为线性规划，并借助其对偶变量识别铰链损失次梯度，从而构造计算上可行的去偏估计量，使其坐标在比例渐近体制下渐近服从高斯分布。
AI.result: 所得到的分布刻画支持单特征置信区间与假设检验，并实现错误发现率（FDR）控制的变量选择。大量仿真在不同协方差结构（含强相关设计）下考察了校准、检验功效与变量选择表现；高维乳腺癌基因表达数据分析显示，所提推断能够区分统计显著特征与原始稀疏SVM所选择的变量。
AI.conclusion: 通过线性规划重构与对偶次梯度识别，可有效突破铰链损失非光滑性障碍，在比例渐近下获得渐近高斯的去偏推断，为高维稀疏SVM提供具有理论保证与实证支持的统计推断工具。

title: One-Shot Private Confidence Regions via Resampling
summary: We propose a simple framework for constructing differentially private confidence regions \textit{in one shot}, i.e., by adding noise only to the final resampling quantile instead of privatizing the estimator computed on each resample. The cost of privacy of our procedure is only logarithmic in the number of resamples $B$ under with-replacement ($m$-out-of-$n$) sampling and independent of $B$ under without replacement sampling (subsampling), avoiding the $\sqrt{B}$ factor that arises in previous works. We provide nonasymptotic Gaussian Differential Privacy (GDP) and utility guarantees for both subsampling and $m$-out-of-$n$ resampling, covering mean-like estimators with small global sensitivity as well as estimators admitting efficiently computable smooth sensitivity bounds, including quantiles and degenerate U-statistics. This allows us to also obtain private confidence regions for degenerate U-statistics where the private error is much smaller than the non-private error. In all, we provide a toolbox for widely applicable DP uncertainty quantification procedures under popular resampling strategies while avoiding the computational and privacy costs of privatizing many intermediate resample statistics.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一次性构造差分隐私置信区域的框架：仅对最终重采样分位数加噪，避免对每个重采样估计量分别加噪，隐私代价在m-out-of-n下为对数级、在无放回子采样下与B无关，规避了既有工作的√B因子。
AI.motivation: 既有差分隐私不确定性量化方法需对每个重采样统计量分别加噪，导致隐私预算随重采样次数B以√B增长，同时计算开销大。作者希望以更低的隐私与计算代价获得有效的DP置信区域。
AI.method: 提出"一次性"（one-shot）框架：保留经典重采样过程，仅在最终重采样分位数上注入噪声。分别针对无放回子采样（subsampling）和m-out-of-n有放回重采样两种策略，构造非渐近高斯差分隐私（GDP）与效用保证；覆盖全局敏感度较小的均值类估计量，以及具有可高效计算光滑敏感度界（smooth sensitivity）的估计量，如分位数和退化U统计量。
AI.result: 隐私代价在m-out-of-n有放回采样下仅为log B量级，在无放回子采样下与B无关，消除了先前工作中的√B因子；给出两种重采样策略下的非渐近GDP与效用界；并可对退化U统计量构造私有置信区域，其私有误差远小于非私有误差。
AI.conclusion: 该工作提供了一套广泛适用的DP不确定性量化工具箱，适用于常见重采样策略，同时避免了分别私有化大量中间重采样统计量所带来的计算与隐私成本。

title: Information-Dense Synthesis for Molecular Discovery
summary: Machine learning can accelerate molecular discovery by designing molecules and planning experiments. However, many scientific challenges demand molecules with very rare properties, and in this sparse setting, existing algorithms offer little gain over random guessing. We propose a method to efficiently search large regions of molecular space using algorithmically controlled stochastic synthesis. Rather than design, make and test individual molecules, we design and make complex mixtures, test them as a pool, then deconvolute the molecule-activity map. We optimize synthesis to encode maximal information. Theoretically, this approach can reduce the number of experiments required to find the optimal molecule among $d$ candidates from $\mathcal{O}(d)$ to $\mathcal{O}(\log d)$ or $\mathcal{O}(1)$. In simulation, on estimated protein fitness landscapes, it finds active molecules with an order of magnitude fewer experiments than existing Bayesian optimization methods.

AI.tldr: 提出通过算法控制的随机合成构建复杂混合物并整体测试，再解卷积分子-活性映射的方法，将稀有性质分子搜索实验次数从 O(d) 降至 O(log d) 或 O(1)。
AI.motivation: 许多科学挑战需要具有极稀有性质的分子，而在这种稀疏设定下，现有算法相比随机猜测几乎没有增益。
AI.method: 利用算法控制的随机合成高效搜索大范围分子空间；不逐个设计、制造和测试分子，而是设计并合成复杂混合物，将其作为池进行测试，再解卷积分子-活性映射；并优化合成以编码最大信息量。
AI.result: 理论上可将从 d 个候选分子中找到最优分子所需实验次数从 O(d) 降至 O(log d) 或 O(1)；在模拟的蛋白质适应度景观上，相比现有贝叶斯优化方法，找到活性分子所需实验次数少一个数量级。
AI.conclusion: 基于算法控制随机合成与混合物池测试的搜索策略，能显著提升稀有性质分子的发现效率，优于现有贝叶斯优化方法。

title: Feature Information Dynamics in Diffusion
comment: Accepted as poster at NeurIPS 2026. 28 pages, including references, appendices, and checklist
summary: Diffusion models generate data through a continuum of denoising problems, and are widely observed to reveal coarse structure before fine detail. Yet, this intuition is mostly empirical and qualitative. We introduce feature information dynamics, an information-theoretic framework for localizing when a feature is generated during diffusion. Using the I-MMSE identity, we connect the rate of feature mutual information change to a gap between optimal unconditional and feature-conditional denoising losses, yielding practical estimators for feature information density. We further develop a chained decomposition that separates shared from incremental information in a feature hierarchy. We use this framework first to quantitatively confirm spectral autoregression in pixel diffusion, and then to extend the analysis beyond frequency: under a class $\to$ mask $\to$ Canny conditioning chain, the per-feature information densities differ across pixel, SDVAE, VAVAE, and RAE, exposing fundamental differences between these representations and suggesting that ordered generation could be beneficial for training diffusion models. Our code is available at https://github.com/AI4Science-WestlakeU/feature-information-dynamics.

AI.tldr: 本文提出特征信息动力学（feature information dynamics），一个基于信息论的框架，用于定位扩散模型中某一特征在何时被生成。
AI.motivation: 扩散模型生成数据时呈现"先粗后细"的现象，但这一直觉多为经验性、定性描述，缺乏定量的时机定位工具。
AI.method: 利用I-MMSE恒等式，将特征互信息的变化率与最优无条件和特征条件去噪损失之间的差距联系起来，得到特征信息密度的实用估计量；并构建链式分解，将特征层级中的共享信息与增量信息分离。
AI.result: 定量验证了像素扩散中的谱自回归现象；在 class→mask→Canny 条件链下，pixel、SDVAE、VAVAE、RAE 各表示的特征信息密度存在差异，揭示了这些表示之间的本质区别。
AI.conclusion: 该框架将"粗到细"的生成直觉定量化，并表明有序生成可能有利于扩散模型的训练。

title: Steering Diffusion Models to Rare Events with Sequential Monte Carlo
comment: A previous version of this work was presented at the NeurIPS 2026: AI for Stochastic Dynamics workshop
summary: Diffusion models are increasingly used as surrogates for expensive simulators in weather prediction, molecular dynamics, and materials design. In these models, computing the probability $p_0[E]$ of an event $E$ is difficult, especially when the event of interest is rare. A stable estimate using Monte Carlo becomes computationally intractable, requiring a growing sample size $\propto\!1/p_0[E]$ to compensate for an increasing rarity. In this paper, we present Diffusion Importance Sampling of Rare Events or DireSMC, a sequential Monte Carlo scheme that guides a population of weighted samples towards the rare event, giving access not only to samples but also to a calibrated estimate of its probability. We set up our guidance using an analytical relaxation of the event set, allowing the method to easily extend to a wide range of user-defined rare events. We validate our method on a toy problem with analytical solutions and on a score-based climate emulator, where we obtain accurate rare-event probabilities on a range of rarities from $10^{-3}$ to $10^{-5}$, achieving net speed-ups of $9\times$ to $1413\times$ over Monte Carlo.

AI.tldr: 提出 DireSMC，一种面向扩散模型的序列蒙特卡洛重要性采样方法，用于高效估计罕见事件概率。
AI.motivation: 扩散模型被广泛用作昂贵模拟器（天气预测、分子动力学、材料设计）的代理模型，但估计事件概率 p0[E] 困难，罕见事件下蒙特卡洛所需样本量 ∝1/p0[E]，计算上不可行。
AI.method: DireSMC 是一种序列蒙特卡洛方案，引导一组加权样本向罕见事件区域演化；通过对事件集合的解析松弛构建引导机制，从而可灵活扩展到多种用户自定义的罕见事件，并同时输出样本及其概率的校准估计。
AI.result: 在具有解析解的玩具问题以及基于分数的气候模拟器上进行了验证，在 10^-3 至 10^-5 的罕见度范围内获得准确的罕见事件概率估计，相较标准蒙特卡洛实现 9× 至 1413× 的净加速。
AI.conclusion: DireSMC 能有效缓解罕见事件采样中的样本量瓶颈，为扩散模型代理的稀有事件概率估计提供准确且高效的解决方案。

title: Near-Optimal Sample Complexity for Recursive Entropic Risk Reinforcement Learning with a Generative Model
summary: In this paper, we study the sample complexities of value and policy learning in finite discounted Markov decision processes (MDPs) under recursive entropic risk preferences with risk parameter \(β\neq 0\), assuming access to a generative model of the MDP. We provide a refined analysis of model-based risk-sensitive Q-value iteration (MB-RS-QVI), a plug-in model-based method introduced in prior work, and derive \((\varepsilon,δ)\)-PAC guarantees for both learning the optimal \(Q\)-value function and an \(\varepsilon\)-optimal policy. Our bounds improve the exponential dependence on the effective horizon \(1/(1-γ)\) compared with the best existing guarantees for this setting. In particular, they match the existing lower bounds in their exponential dependence on \(|β|/(1-γ)\), as well as in \(S\), \(A\), \(\varepsilon\), and \(|β|\), up to logarithmic factors. Consequently, our analysis removes the exponential gap between the previously known upper and lower bounds, leaving only a polynomial gap in the effective horizon.

AI.tldr: 本文研究有限折扣MDP中递归熵风险偏好下价值与策略学习的样本复杂度，通过改进基于模型的Q值迭代分析，提升了有效视界的指数依赖，缩小了上下界差距。
AI.motivation: 在递归熵风险偏好（风险参数β≠0）的有限折扣MDP中，价值与策略学习的样本复杂度此前存在指数级上下界差距，需要更紧的分析。
AI.method: 在可访问MDP生成模型的假设下，对基于模型的熵风险敏感Q值迭代（MB-RS-QVI）进行精细化分析，推导学习最优Q值函数和ε-最优策略的(ε,δ)-PAC保证。
AI.result: 所得界在有效视界1/(1-γ)上的指数依赖较现有最优保证有所改进；在|β|/(1-γ)的指数依赖以及S、A、ε、|β|上（至多对数因子）匹配已有下界。
AI.conclusion: 该分析消除了此前上下界之间的指数差距，仅在有效视界上遗留多项式差距。

title: The Premise Is the Problem: Exchangeability Failure in Self-Monitored Test-Time Adaptation
summary: Modern forecasting models are often updated after deployment so they can respond to changing data. These updates can also make predictions worse, so practical systems need a reliable monitor that can detect harmful changes and trigger protection. A natural design is to monitor the same prediction errors that guide the updates. This paper asks whether the statistical guarantee behind such a monitor remains valid when monitoring and adaptation use the same feedback. We study this question in multi-step time-series forecasting. We show that overlapping targets and dependence in forecast errors can break a key assumption required by the guarantee. The monitor may then raise alarms even when no harmful change has occurred, and its response can further damage prediction quality. We also find that adaptation can hide sustained changes from its own monitor, while the original frozen model retains a clearer signal. These results expose a basic failure mode in self-monitored adaptation. They show why reliable deployment requires checking the monitor's assumptions, comparing adaptation with the frozen model under realistic feedback, and limiting the effect of every protective response.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了自监测自适应（监测与更新共用同一预测误差反馈）中统计保证的有效性，指出重叠目标与误差依赖会破坏监测器的关键假设，导致误报、损害预测质量，并使自适应掩盖持续变化。
AI.motivation: 现代预测模型常在部署后更新以适应数据变化，但更新也可能使预测变差，因此需要可靠的监测器来检测有害变化并触发保护。自然的设计是让监测器监测那些驱动更新的同一预测误差。本文追问：当监测与自适应使用同一反馈时，该监测器的统计保证是否仍然成立。
AI.method: 在多步时间序列预测场景下，分析监测与自适应共用同一误差反馈时的统计假设。通过理论分析揭示重叠目标（overlapping targets）与预测误差中的依赖（dependence）如何破坏监测器保证所依赖的关键假设。
AI.result: 重叠目标与误差依赖会使监测器在并未发生有害变化时也触发告警，其响应还会进一步损害预测质量；同时，自适应会把持续变化从自身监测器中隐藏，而原始的冻结模型反而保留更清晰的信号。
AI.conclusion: 这些结果揭示了自监测自适应的一个基本失效模式。可靠的部署需要：检验监测器的假设、在真实反馈下将自适应模型与冻结模型进行对比、并限制每次保护性响应的影响。

title: Conditional Flow Matching for Transport Between Markov Processes
summary: Motivated by sequence-to-sequence transport in the context time-series domain adaptation, we study the problem of transportation between trajectories of Markov processes. Given a limited number of trajectories from source distribution and the target distribution, we formulate a flow matching based algorithm which learns a transport map from the source to target trajectory distribution, while preserving the Markov structure. We show that this is consistent in the population limit and derive finite-sample error bounds under mixing time assumptions, following the analysis of classical statistical problems including regression (Nagaraj et al., 2020), principal component analysis (Kumar and Sarkar, 2023), and matrix concentration (Neeman et al., 2024) in the Markov setting. We complement that with a lower-bound construction showing that a mixing-time dependent sample complexity is unavoidable even with regular Gaussian conditional transitions. We evaluate on synthetic and real-world data. For image retrieval from electroencephalography (EEG) on THINGS-EEG2 (Gifford et al., 2022), the task is to identify the viewed image from EEG signals captured from human subjects, which suffers from high inter subject variability. We augment the ENIGMA decoder (Kneeland et al., 2026) with a conditional flow before its subject-specific temporal map. This improves mean top-5 retrieval accuracy from 43.87% to 49.05%, an 11.82% relative improvement.

AI.tldr: 本文研究马尔可夫过程轨迹间的传输问题，提出基于流匹配的算法学习从源到目标轨迹分布的传输映射，同时保持马尔可夫结构，给出有限样本误差界与下界，并在EEG图像检索任务上取得提升。
AI.motivation: 受时间序列领域自适应中序列到序列传输的启发，需要在仅有有限源与目标轨迹样本的条件下，实现轨迹分布的传输并保持马尔可夫性质。
AI.method: 提出基于流匹配（flow matching）的算法，学习源到目标轨迹分布的传输映射并保持马尔可夫结构；在混合时间假设下进行理论分析，推导有限样本误差界，并构造下界；在EEG图像检索中，将条件流插入ENIGMA解码器的被试特异时序映射之前。
AI.result: 理论上证明了总体极限下的一致性，给出混合时间依赖的有限样本误差界，并构造下界说明混合时间依赖的样本复杂度不可避免；实验上，在THINGS-EEG2上的平均top-5检索准确率从43.87%提升至49.05%，相对提升11.82%。
AI.conclusion: 该流匹配方法在理论与实验上均有效，能够保持马尔可夫结构并提升跨被试轨迹传输任务的性能。

title: Active Feature Acquisition for Cost-Efficient Temporal Prediction with Reduced Participant Burden
summary: Accurate forecasting of pathological outcomes is a central problem in psychology. To do so, psychologists often collect intensive longitudinal data. However, in such studies, the desire to acquire a large number of variables for the sake of accurate prediction is often counteracted by the need to minimize participant burden. Acquiring more variables per occasion can yield better predictions, but having too many acquisitions increase the risk of non-response and attrition. Longitudinal Active Feature Acquisition (LAFA) is a principled approach to resolve this conundrum. Instead of requiring responses to every item at every acquisition occasion, LAFA produces a policy that seeks to optimally select dynamic subsets of items to be acquired at each timepoint while preserving our ability to forecast a specific outcome. However, existing LAFA methods are mostly based on Neural Networks (NN) that are difficult to interpret in practice. In this work, we introduce a tree distillation method for learning an interpretable policy from NN-based LAFA networks. We validated our method through both a simulation and an empirical EMA dataset on forecasting daily alcohol consumption. In both cases, we find that we can meaningfully reduce the number of items acquired at each occasion with minimal loss in accuracy. Networks (NN) that are difficult to interpret in practice. In this work, we introduce a tree distillation method for learning an interpretable policy from NN-based LAFA networks. We validated our method through both a simulation and an empirical EMA dataset on forecasting daily alcohol consumption. In both cases, we find that we can meaningfully reduce the number of items acquired at each occasion with minimal loss in accuracy.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种树蒸馏方法，从基于神经网络的纵向主动特征获取（LAFA）模型中学习可解释策略，在预测每日饮酒量的仿真与实证EMA数据上，以极小精度损失显著减少每次采集的条目数。
AI.motivation: 心理学预测常依赖密集纵向数据，但增加每次采集的变量数会加重被试负担，导致无应答与流失。需在预测精度与采集负担间取得平衡，而现有LAFA方法多基于难以解释的神经网络。
AI.method: 采用树蒸馏（tree distillation）方法，从NN-based LAFA网络中学得可解释的采集策略，使其能在每个时间点动态选择最优条目子集。
AI.result: 通过仿真实验与预测每日酒精摄入的实证EMA数据集验证，两种情境下均能在精度损失最小的前提下有效减少每次采集的条目数。
AI.conclusion: 树蒸馏可将NN-based LAFA转化为可解释策略，在保持预测性能的同时降低被试负担，为心理学纵向研究提供了兼具精度与可解释性的主动特征获取方案。

title: Structure, Not Belief: Correlated Thompson Sampling from LLM-Derived Covariance in Combinatorial Semi-Bandits
comment: 15 pages. Accepted (poster) at DynaFront 2026: Dynamics at the Frontiers of Optimization, Sampling, and Games, NeurIPS 2026 Workshop
summary: Combinatorial Thompson sampling (CTS) draws independent posterior samples for every arm, so its exploration dynamics ignore any relation among arms. We study a minimal change to those dynamics: an LLM is queried once for a partition of the arms, the partition becomes a positive-definite correlation matrix $Σ$ through an RBF kernel on cluster ranks, and the per-round posterior sample is drawn with covariance $Σ$ while the Beta posteriors are updated from real rewards only, so the LLM shapes how the sampler moves, not what it believes. We give a self-contained Bayesian regret bound for the idealized Gaussian sampler whose information gain splits into a $K\log T$ term from the $K$-cluster structure and a ridge term that grows to $d\log T$: the $\sqrt{d/K}$ improvement over independent sampling is a finite-horizon transient, exact only as the within-cluster correlation tends to one. The correlated sampler reduces regret by 19% over CTS on 16 synthetic Bernoulli families at $T=2{,}500$ (6-7% at $T=25{,}000$ with data-adaptive kernels) and by 41% on the Microsoft MIND-small news benchmark ($d=200$ real articles), while pseudo-observation warm starts give nothing. An LLM-free ablation with a simulated oracle of controlled quality shows that on unstructured instances the gain is a property of the kernel shape (a random partition, or a plain tempering of the sampling noise, reproduces it), while belief injection at matched oracle quality never helps.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一种对组合Thompson采样(CTS)的最小改动:用LLM一次性给出臂的分区,经RBF核映射为聚类秩上的正定相关矩阵Σ,每轮后验采样以Σ为协方差,但Beta后验仍仅由真实奖励更新,即LLM只影响采样器的移动方式而非其信念。作者给出理想化高斯采样器的Bayesian regret界,并在合成与真实数据上验证了LLM引导相关结构的收益。
AI.motivation: CTS为每个臂独立采样后验,忽略了臂与臂之间的关系,导致探索动态无法利用结构信息。作者希望以最小改动引入臂间相关性,并借助LLM提供的先验结构来指导探索,同时避免LLM的"幻觉"直接污染信念更新。
AI.method: 查询LLM一次以获得臂的分区;通过RBF核作用于聚类秩构造正定相关矩阵Σ;每轮以协方差Σ抽取后验样本,而Beta后验仅由真实奖励更新(即LLM只塑造采样器的运动,不塑造其信念)。理论方面给出理想化高斯采样器的自洽Bayesian regret界,其信息增益分解为K log T(来自K个聚类结构)与增长至d log T的岭项。
AI.result: 在16个合成Bernoulli家族上,T=2,500时相关采样器相较CTS降低19%的regret;T=25,000且使用数据自适应核时降低6-7%;在Microsoft MIND-small新闻基准(d=200真实文章)上降低41%。伪观测热启动无任何收益。无LLM的消融实验(使用受控质量的模拟oracle)表明:在无结构实例上收益来源于核形状本身(随机分区或对采样噪声做简单退火即可复现),而在匹配oracle质量下注入信念从不带来帮助。
AI.conclusion: √(d/K)的改进是有限时域的暂态效应,仅当簇内相关趋向1时才精确成立。LLM引导的相关采样通过核形状而非信念注入带来收益,收益随T增大而衰减。相关结构对采样动态的影响是关键机制,而LLM的"信念"内容并不起作用。

title: Does Muon Need Fine-Grained Spectral Shaping?
summary:
Muon combines current and past gradients into matrix momentum. For $M=UΣV^\top$, the idealized polar update $Q=UV^\top$ gives every singular direction the same weight. We refer to this as the flat profile. Several recent optimizers replace this flat profile with fine-grained spectral maps that give each direction its own gain. We ask how much of this spectral detail a Muon update needs. Our spectral diagnostics show that approximately $94$--$97\%$ of measured singular modes lie below an estimated noise edge, yet collectively align positively with a reference gradient.
  We introduce BulkBoost, a two-band spectral reweighting framework with fixed-rank and noise-calibrated variants. The latter uses split-minibatch gradient differences to calibrate a Marchenko--Pastur reference edge for Muon's Nesterov input, separating the bulk below the edge from the spikes above it. Both variants increase the bulk's relative weight through one shared gain while preserving the Frobenius norm of each matrix's unreweighted direction. For a fixed partition, our theory gives the first-order condition under which moving weight toward the bulk lowers the loss. It also quantifies the fraction of the maximal first-order improvement rate, over all per-mode reallocations, that two bands can capture. Across 30 continued-pretraining settings spanning Pythia-14M to 410M and six corpora, two-band reweighting is competitive with the fine-grained power-law profile of Freon and outperforms Spectra. Measured against Muon's flat profile, Freon reduces final loss by $0.022\%$ of the pre-adaptation loss on average, whereas the two-band variants achieve reductions of $0.073$--$0.147\%$. These observations suggest that useful departures from the flat profile are surprisingly low-dimensional: a single bulk-to-spike gain captures at least as much benefit as the fine-grained spectral profiles.

AI.tldr: Muon 的极坐标更新对所有奇异方向一视同仁（平坦谱），本文提出 BulkBoost：仅用"体-尖峰"两带重加权即可捕获细粒度谱优化器的大部分收益，且更简单、更稳定。
AI.motivation: 近期若干优化器（如 Freon、Spectra）用细粒度谱映射为每个奇异方向赋予独立增益，但作者质疑这种谱细节对 Muon 更新的必要性。谱诊断显示约 94–97% 的奇异模位于估计噪声边缘之下，却整体上与参考梯度正对齐，暗示有用信息可能是低维的。
AI.method: 提出 BulkBoost 双带谱重加权框架，含固定秩与噪声校准两种变体。噪声校准变体利用分小批量梯度差对 Muon 的 Nesterov 输入校准 Marchenko–Pastur 参考边缘，将边缘以下的"体"与边缘以上的"尖峰"分离；两种变体通过单一共享增益提高"体"的相对权重，同时保持各矩阵未重加权方向的 Frobenius 范数。理论给出"将权重移向体可降低损失"的一阶条件，并量化两带可捕获的最大一阶改进率比例。
AI.result: 在 Pythia-14M 至 410M、6 个语料的 30 个持续预训练设置上，两带重加权与 Freon 的细粒度幂律谱竞争并优于 Spectra。相对 Muon 平坦谱，Freon 平均降低最终损失 0.022%（占适配前损失），而两带变体降低 0.073–0.147%。
AI.conclusion: 对平坦谱的有效偏离出人意料地低维：单一"体到尖峰"增益即可获得与细粒度谱相当的收益，说明精细谱映射可能是冗余的。

title: Learning a Mixture of GFlowNets
summary: Learning an ensemble of GFlowNets to sample from a discrete target distribution has become a common approach for achieving better state space exploration and convergence than that of a monolithic sampler. However, these methods often add a substantial runtime overhead to the base model, and their conceptual connection remains elusive. To address this, we first propose a general-purpose theoretical framework for describing a mixture of GFlowNets, which we specialize into continuously (CI) and discretely indexed (DI) collections. On the one hand, we show CI GFlowNets can be interpreted through the lens of a random features expansion, provably boosting the sampler's expressivity in graph-structured tasks and reducing learning instability via spectral shifting. On the other hand, we demonstrate DI GFlowNets encompass prior approaches for GFlowNet training and provide the foundation for the newly proposed Stratum-Conditioned (SC) GFlowNets. This method, which is inspired by the Doob's h-transform of Markov chains, decomposes the state space according to a prescribed modular function and restricts each component to sample from a distinct subset of it. Importantly, SC GFlowNets support centralized and component-wise embarrassingly parallel training, and we show both of them significantly speed up learning convergence and mode coverage without introducing any non-negligible extra computation.

AI.tldr: 本文为GFlowNets的集成/混合建模提出统一理论框架，划分为连续索引(CI)与离散索引(DI)两类，并据此提出新的Stratum-Conditioned (SC) GFlowNets。
AI.motivation: 集成多个GFlowNets以采样离散目标分布虽能改善探索与收敛，但通常带来显著运行开销，且其概念联系尚不清晰。作者希望建立统一理论解释，并设计低开销、可并行的新方法。
AI.method: 提出描述GFlowNet混合的通用理论框架，分为连续索引(CI)与离散索引(DI)集合。CI视角借助随机特征展开解释，证明其提升图结构任务表达力并通过谱移动降低学习不稳定；DI视角涵盖已有GFlowNet训练方法，并支撑新提出的Stratum-Conditioned (SC) GFlowNets，其受Markov链Doob h-transform启发，按指定模函数分解状态空间，每个分量采样不同子集，支持集中式与分量级的 embarrassingly parallel 训练。
AI.result: CI GFlowNets可证明提升图结构任务表达力并降低学习不稳定性；DI GFlowNets统一已有方法；SC GFlowNets在不引入不可忽略额外计算的情况下，显著加速学习收敛并提升模式覆盖。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为GFlowNet集成提供了统一理论视角，并通过SC GFlowNets实现高效并行训练，在收敛速度与模式覆盖上优于基线且几乎无额外开销。

title: Extending Pathwise Gradients to Discrete Random Variables via Finite-Order Relaxation
summary: Pathwise gradients are preferred for continuous random variables because they are unbiased, low variance, and work with a single sample. For discrete variables, however, the pathwise identity cannot generally be exact for every differentiable function. We propose a general framework to construct finite-order exact pathwise gradient estimators for a range of common discrete variables such as Poisson. The estimator is the least-norm solution among all solutions that are unbiased for polynomials of degree at most. The resulting estimators preserve the hard forward sample, require no temperature tuning, and can be implemented in a few lines of codes. Against other admissible solutions, our estimator is unique and minimizes weight variance; in contrast, prior works use categorical variables or augmented representations to approximate non-categorical variables that induces excess variance and computations. To understand approximation bias for functions beyond the prescribed class, we also derive a non-asymptotic bias bound. In experiments our low order methods match or improve tuned baselines across linear, nonlinear and hierarchical latent-variable models, while out-speeding competitors in every runtime benchmark.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个通用框架，为 Poisson 等常见离散随机变量构造有限阶精确的路径梯度估计器。该估计器是满足至多给定阶多项式无偏约束的最小范数解，保持硬前向采样、无需温度调参、代码实现简单，并在实验中匹配或超越调优基线且运行更快。
AI.motivation: 路径梯度对连续随机变量具有无偏、低方差、单样本可用等优点，但对离散变量，路径恒等式一般无法对任意可微函数精确成立。既有工作常借助类别变量或增广表示来近似非类别变量，这会引入额外方差与计算开销。
AI.method: 提出构造有限阶精确路径梯度估计器的通用框架，适用于 Poisson 等常见离散变量。将估计器定义为在所有对至多给定阶多项式无偏的解中范数最小的解，从而保持硬前向采样且无需温度调参。同时为超出该函数类的近似偏差推导非渐近偏差界。
AI.result: 该估计器在所有可容许解中唯一，并最小化权重方差。实验中，低阶方法在线性、非线性及层次化潜变量模型上匹配或改进调优基线，并在所有运行基准测试中速度优于竞争者。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为离散随机变量提供了实现简洁、无需调参且高效精确的路径梯度估计器，在保持理论最优性的同时取得良好实验表现；超出预设函数类时可通过非渐近偏差界刻画近似偏差。

title: Adaptive Mean Estimation by In-Context Learning: A Gradient-Flow Analysis
summary: Prior Fitted Networks (PFNs) such as TabPFN now rival established statistical procedures across prediction and estimation tasks. A natural explanation is that PFNs have the property of statistical adaptivity, that is, they perform nearly as well as a method tailored to the true data-generating model for a heterogeneous set of models, while not being told which model the data comes from. We study how such adaptivity is learned in a controlled location-estimation problem. Each task is an unlabeled sample whose family is hidden: Gaussian data call for averaging, with error of order $n^{-1}$, whereas uniform data are best estimated from their extremes, at the faster rate $n^{-2}$. We also provide the example of a symmetric Gaussian mixture, for which a rate of $σ^2_n/n$ can be attained. On scalar inputs, softmax attention computes the derivative of the empirical cumulant-generating function. A single primitive therefore both supplies features that distinguish the families and forms estimators interpolating between the sample mean and the mid-range. We combine attention experts through either a softmax mixture of experts or a gated linear unit (GLU), and analyze stagewise gradient flow. With $\widetildeΩ(n^{1+ε})$ pretraining tasks, the learned estimator is asymptotically efficient on Gaussian tasks, within a factor $n^ε$ of the minimax rate on uniform tasks, and order-optimal on mixtures in a shrinking-variance regime. These guarantees extend to new locations and longer contexts. A risk decomposition separates expert error, routing error and normalization error, which clarifies the architectural contrast. Softmax gating enforces normalization and exact translation equivariance, whereas the GLU must learn it: its dynamics separate into fast bias removal followed by slow expert selection. End-to-end experiments recover the predicted specialization.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了Prior Fitted Networks(PFN)统计自适应能力的来源，在一个受控的位置估计问题中，证明了softmax注意力可计算经验累积生成函数的导数，从而同时提供区分数据族的特征与在均值和中程之间插值的估计量，并给出相应收敛速率保证。
AI.motivation: PFN（如TabPFN）已在预测与估计任务中媲美传统统计方法，普遍认为其具备"统计自适应"性质，但该性质如何在模型中被学习尚缺乏理论解释。作者希望在可控的最小设定下，厘清自适应能力的机制与可证明的保证。
AI.method: 构造受控的位置估计任务：每个任务为无标签样本，其分布族隐藏。高斯数据最优估计为样本均值（误差阶n^{-1}），均匀数据最优估计为中程（误差阶n^{-2}），并给出对称高斯混合的例子（可达速率σ²_n/n）。分析标量输入下的softmax注意力，指出其计算经验累积生成函数的导数；通过softmax混合专家或门控线性单元（GLU）组合注意力专家，并进行分阶段梯度流分析。
AI.result: 在约Ω̃(n^{1+ε})预训练任务下，所学估计量在高斯任务上渐近有效，在均匀任务上达到极小极大速率的一个n^ε因子以内，在收缩方差的高斯混合情形下达到阶最优。保证可推广到新位置与更长上下文。风险分解将误差分为专家误差、路由误差与归一化误差：softmax门控强制归一化并具备精确平移等变性，而GLU须自行学习该性质，其动力学分为快速偏差消除与缓慢专家选择两个阶段。
AI.conclusion: softmax注意力这一单一原语既能产生区分分布族的特征，又能构造在样本均值与中程间插值的估计量，从机制上解释了PFN的统计自适应。softmax混合专家与GLU的架构对比通过风险分解得到澄清，端到端实验重现了预测的专家特化现象。

title: Spectra: Exact Component Transport for Test-Time Prior Adaptation in Simulation-Based Inference
summary: Simulation-based inference (SBI) has become a powerful approach to Bayesian inference in complex scientific models whose likelihoods are difficult or impossible to evaluate. Amortized SBI learns reusable inference models from simulated data, enabling rapid posterior inference for new observations, and modern generative models have made these models increasingly expressive. However, this reuse is limited to the prior distribution chosen during training, whereas scientific analyses often need revised priors as knowledge accumulates or alternative assumptions are tested. We introduce Spectra, a test-time adaptation method for diffusion-based SBI. Spectra uses an exact score-transport identity to obtain the adapted score from a frozen diffusion model in closed form for structured prior changes, without additional simulation or training. Across six SBI benchmarks, Spectra achieves accurate adaptation under strong prior shifts at low online sampling cost. This enables pretrained SBI models to incorporate updated prior information at test time.

AI.tldr: Spectra是一种用于基于扩散模型的模拟推断（SBI）的测试时自适应方法，通过精确的score-transport恒等式，在冻结扩散模型上以闭式解获得适应新先验的score，无需额外模拟或训练，实现强先验偏移下的高效适应。
AI.motivation: 摊销式SBI虽能复用推断模型实现快速后验推断，但其复用性受限于训练时选定的先验分布；而科学分析常需随知识积累或假设检验而修正先验，因此需要一种能在测试时适应新先验的方法。
AI.method: 提出Spectra，一种针对扩散式SBI的测试时自适应方法。它利用精确的score-transport恒等式，对结构化先验变化，从冻结的扩散模型中以闭式解直接获得适应后的score，无需额外仿真或训练，在线采样成本低。
AI.result: 在六个SBI基准上，Spectra在强先验偏移下实现了准确的自适应，且在线采样成本低。
AI.conclusion: Spectra使预训练的SBI模型能够在测试时纳入更新后的先验信息，突破了摊销式SBI先验固定的限制。

title: Detecting a Shift Is Not Enough: Exact Minimax Limits of Linear Representation Repair
summary: A mean shift between two data sources can be easy to detect but hard to remove without substantially changing their representations. We cast its removal as a statistical decision problem: from noisy differences between paired calibration measurements in $\mathbb{R}^d$, learn one linear map, applied to both sources under a hard distortion budget, that leaves as little of the shift as possible on fresh data. We derive the exact finite-sample minimax risk over all such maps, $(d-k) \mathbb{E}[1/(d+2J)]$ with $J\sim\mathrm{Pois}(κ/2)$, where the budget allows deleting $k$ directions and $κ$ is the calibration signal-to-noise ratio. Projecting out the mean calibration difference attains it without knowing $κ$ or the noise scale. This exposes a detection-repair gap: detecting the shift needs only $κ\gg\sqrt d$, whereas removing a fixed fraction of it at constant distortion needs $κ\asymp d$, as for estimating its direction. Standard linear concept erasers (MP, SAL, LEACE) remove the same calibration difference, so the formula gives, before fitting, exactly how much shift they leave on fresh data and how much calibration a target requires. The limit is robust: pairing keeps it exact for non-Gaussian shared content, the projection keeps its guarantee under anisotropic noise, and selective abstention cannot close the gap. On paired clinical and wearable sleep EEG, where differences between participants act as calibration noise, the formula predicts the device shift left in new participants, and more recordings per person soon stop helping. Together, these results tell whether a correction that falls short needs a better method, more recordings, or more participants.

AI.tldr: 本文把"去除两个数据源之间的均值偏移"建模为统计决策问题：在硬性失真预算下图学习一个对两源共用的线性映射，使新数据上残余偏移最小；给出精确有限样本极小极大风险 (d−k)E[1/(d+2J)]，J~Pois(κ/2)，并证明对均值标定差做投影即可达到该风险，无需知道 κ 或噪声尺度。
AI.motivation: 两个数据源之间的均值偏移易于检测却难以在不显著改变表征的前提下移除。作者希望给出一个理论框架，量化在给定失真预算下"能去掉多少偏移"的极限，从而区分"修正不彻底"究竟是方法不足、需要更多记录、还是需要更多被试。
AI.method: 形式化为统计决策问题：从配对标定测量在 R^d 中的带噪差异出发，在硬失真预算下（允许删除 k 个方向）学习单一线性映射作用于两个数据源。推导该映射类上精确的有限样本极小极大风险，并给出达到该风险的估计量（投影掉均值标定差）。在非高斯共享内容、各向异性噪声、选择性弃权等设定下检验该结果的稳健性；并在配对临床/可穿戴睡眠 EEG 上做实证验证。
AI.result: 得到精确有限样本极小极大风险 (d−k)E[1/(d+2J)]，J~Pois(κ/2)，κ 为标定信噪比。投影掉均值标定差可在未知 κ 与噪声尺度时达到该风险。揭示检测-修复鸿沟：检测偏移只需 κ≫√d，而在常数失真下移除固定比例偏移需 κ≍d（与估计偏移方向同阶）。标准线性概念擦除器（MP、SAL、LEACE）移除相同的标定差，故该公式在拟合前即可精确预测其残留偏移及所需标定量。稳健性：配对使结论对非高斯共享内容精确成立，投影在各向异性噪声下保持保证，选择性弃权无法弥合鸿沟。在配对临床与可穿戴睡眠 EEG 上，公式预测了新被试中残留的设备偏移，并显示增加每人的记录数很快不再有帮助。
AI.conclusion: 该工作给出了均值偏移可修复性的精确极限，指出检测与修复存在本质鸿沟，并为标准线性擦除器提供拟合前的定量预测。其结论可用于判断一个未达标的校正是需要更好的方法、更多记录，还是更多被试。

title: Symmetry-Aware Feature Learning: A Polynomial Separation for Multi-Index Models
summary: We establish a polynomial sample complexity separation between symmetry-aware and symmetry-agnostic feature learning. We study growing-rank multi-index models with high-dimensional Gaussian covariates in $\mathbb{R}^d$ and $r=Θ(d^δ)$ teacher directions forming a cyclic symmetry orbit, where $0<δ<1/2$. We compare three ways of exploiting this structure: architectural weight sharing, data augmentation over the full symmetry group, and learning without access to the symmetry. In particular, we analyze a symmetry-tied convolutional network, an untied network, and the same untied network trained with full-group data augmentation, using spherical online SGD with correlation loss. For a class of polynomial links with information exponent $p\ge3$, we prove matching sample complexity bounds up to logarithmic factors: the tied and augmented learners achieve weak directional recovery in $\widetildeΘ(d^{p-1})$ samples, whereas the symmetry-agnostic learner requires $\widetildeΘ(rd^{p-1})$. For the pure quadratic Hermite link, the same separation holds for weak recovery of the teacher subspace, with sample complexities $\widetildeΘ(d)$ and $\widetildeΘ(rd)$, respectively. Thus, full-group data augmentation matches the sample efficiency of architectural weight sharing, and both provide a polynomial advantage over training without symmetry. For $p\ge3$, the proof reveals a two-stage mechanism: fluctuations at initialization select one direction in the teacher orbit, after which localized growth amplifies its overlap to the weak recovery scale while competing overlaps remain near their initialization scale.

AI.tldr: 本文建立了对称感知与对称无关特征学习之间的多项式样本复杂度分离：在秩增长的多指标模型中，权重共享与全群数据增强均可实现 $\widetilde\Theta(d^{p-1})$（纯二次情形为 $\widetilde\Theta(d)$）的样本复杂度，而忽略对称性的学习器需 $\widetilde\Theta(rd^{p-1})$（对应 $\widetilde\Theta(rd)$）。
AI.motivation: 旨在从理论层面量化"利用对称结构"（架构权重共享、数据增强）相对"不使用对称信息"在特征学习中的样本效率优势，并判定数据增强能否达到与架构权重共享同等的样本复杂度。
AI.method: 研究 $\mathbb{R}^d$ 中高斯协变量的秩增长多指标模型，教师方向数为 $r=\Theta(d^\delta)$（$0<\delta<1/2$）且构成循环对称轨道；比较三种学习器：对称绑定卷积网络、未绑定网络、以及带全群数据增强的未绑定网络，统一使用球面在线 SGD 与相关损失进行训练；对信息指数 $p\ge3$ 的多项式连接函数及纯二次 Hermite 连接分别给出匹配的上下界；对 $p\ge3$ 的情形通过初始化涨落选向与局部化增长放大的两阶段机制进行证明。
AI.result: 对 $p\ge3$ 的多项式连接，绑定学习器与增强学习器在 $\widetilde\Theta(d^{p-1})$ 样本内实现弱方向恢复，而对称无关学习器需 $\widetilde\Theta(rd^{p-1})$；对纯二次 Hermite 连接，弱恢复教师子空间的复杂度分别为 $\widetilde\Theta(d)$ 与 $\widetilde\Theta(rd)$。所有界在对数因子内匹配。结论上：全群数据增强在样本效率上与架构权重共享相当，二者相对无对称训练均有 $r$ 倍（多项式）优势。机制上：$p\ge3$ 时，初始化涨落先在教师轨道中选中一个方向，随后局部化增长将其重叠放大至弱恢复尺度，而竞争方向的重叠保持在初始量级。
AI.conclusion: 数据增强可完全替代架构权重共享以获得对称带来的样本复杂度优势，二者均比不使用对称的学习器有多项式级提升；样本复杂度分离由初始化涨落选向与局部化增长放大这一两阶段机制驱动。

title: Reinforcement Learning for Hierarchical Reasoning Rewards: Minimax-Optimal Rates with Transformers
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) has become a standard tool for post-training language models on reasoning tasks, where the policy is updated by reward feedback while exploring the space of responses. Despite its empirical success, theoretical understanding of RL post-training remains limited, in particular of why on-policy exploration combined with a neural reward model is effective. In this paper, we address this question by modeling the reward as a hierarchical function on the response space: the reward consists of infinitely many local components, each of which becomes relevant only after the preceding ones have been resolved. We show that a natural Transformer-based actor--critic algorithm, which alternates between sampling from the current KL-regularized policy, fitting a Transformer critic to the observed rewards, and updating the policy, achieves the minimax optimal rates in the query budget and in the regularization strength up to logarithmic factors, and is minimax optimal for a fixed number of prompts. In contrast, we prove that sampling from the fixed reference distribution, as in offline reward modeling, can limit regret decay to a logarithmic rate. These results show that on-policy exploration progressively zooms in on the region where the reward is concentrated, and quantify its benefit for RL post-training.

AI.tldr: 本文从理论上研究RL后训练中"on-policy探索+神经奖励模型"为何有效，通过将奖励建模为响应空间上的层级函数，证明基于Transformer的actor-critic算法可达minimax最优速率，而利用固定参考分布的offline奖励建模会将遗憾衰减限制在对数速率。
AI.motivation: RL已成为语言模型推理任务后训练的标准工具，但在理论上对其理解仍有限，尤其不清楚为何"on-policy探索结合神经奖励模型"是有效的。本文旨在从理论角度回答这一问题。
AI.method: 将奖励建模为响应空间上的层级函数：奖励由无穷多个局部组分构成，每个组分只有在前序组分被解决后才变得相关。在此基础上分析一种自然的基于Transformer的actor-critic算法，该算法在以下步骤间交替：(1)从当前KL正则化策略采样，(2)用Transformer critic拟合观测到的奖励，(3)更新策略。同时对比分析了从固定参考分布采样（如offline奖励建模）的情形。
AI.result: 证明该Transformer-based actor-critic算法在查询预算和正则化强度上达到minimax最优速率（至多相差对数因子），且在固定prompt数量下也是minimax最优的。相反，从固定参考分布采样（如offline奖励建模）会将遗憾衰减限制在对数速率。
AI.conclusion: 结果表胆单on-policy探索会逐步聚焦到奖励集中的区域，从而量化了其对RL后训练带来的收益，从理论上解释了on-policy探索结合神经奖励模型的有效性。

title: Early Memory Selection for Balanced Adam
comment: Includes theoretical proofs and reproducibility appendices. Code and data: https://github.com/AlbertoFdezHdez/Adam_beta_rule_cubic
summary: We propose a method for choosing the shared memory parameter $β_1=β_2=β$ in Adam from a short pilot training. The selected $β$ remains fixed during the subsequent full training. A local model of Adam's normalized direction balances sampling variability against the delay introduced by averaging past gradients. This balance gives a cubic memory rule, whose two coefficients are estimated from gradient probes at a few pilot checkpoints. The estimator uses the numerator and denominator jointly, preserving their covariance. With a 200-update pilot and sixteen probe gradients at each of four checkpoints, a seed-matched retrospective evaluation on eleven vision and language workloads reduces mean relative validation gap by 40.7% and worst-quarter mean gap by 44.3% against the grid representative of shared $β=0.95$. The mean gap is also 32.3% lower than that of the best constant $β$ chosen across all eleven workloads.

AI.tldr: 提出从短程预训练中选取Adam共享记忆参数β（β₁=β₂=β）的方法，选定后全程固定；基于归一化方向的局部模型导出三次记忆律并从少量检查点梯度探测估计系数，在11个视觉与语言任务上显著降低验证差距。
AI.motivation: Adam中共享的β（β₁=β₂）通常凭经验设为0.95等常数，但不同工作负载的最优β可能不同；网格搜索代价高，需要一个在短程预训练中即可可靠选取、且后续固定使用的实用准则。
AI.method: 用一个局部模型刻画Adam归一化更新方向，在采样变异与历史梯度平均带来的延迟之间做权衡，得到关于记忆的“三次律”；其两个系数由少量预训练检查点上的梯度探测估计。估计器联合使用分子与分母，保留二者协方差。实验设置为200次更新的预训练，在4个检查点各取16个探测梯度，选定β后在完整训练中保持固定。
AI.result: 在11个视觉与语言工作负载上进行种子匹配的回溯评估：相对以共享β=0.95为代表的网格基线，平均相对验证差距降低40.7%，最差四分之一平均差距降低44.3%；平均差距还比跨全部11个任务选出的最优常数β低32.3%。
AI.conclusion: 短程预训练加少量梯度探测即可为Adam选出优于固定经验和全局最优常数的共享β，说明共享记忆参数的可调性带来实质收益，且该选择流程开销低、可迁移到多类工作负载。

title: Neutrosophic Ensemble Classification for Uncertainty-Aware Bearing Fault Detection: Evidence from Laboratory and Variable-Speed Industrial Benchmarks
summary: Machine learning classifiers for bearing fault detection produce scalar confidence scores that conflate confident errors with genuinely ambiguous predictions, and the conventional truth/falsity pair (F = 1 - T) is algebraically redundant by construction. We operationalize a refined neutrosophic decomposition of a Random Forest + XGBoost + Logistic Regression ensemble into four indicators -- T-hat (top-class evidence), F-hat (best-competitor evidence), predictive entropy I1-hat, and decision disagreement I2-hat -- evaluated on two bearing benchmarks (CWRU and JNU, 600-1000 rpm) under a leave-one-condition-out protocol. On CWRU, after correcting a file-to-class mapping error, the ensemble reaches 100.00 percent accuracy on three of four held-out loads (92.27 percent on the fourth), leaving too few errors for uncertainty analysis. On JNU, holding out 1000 rpm, accuracy collapses to 40.64 percent, below a majority-class baseline; Logistic Regression (57.91 percent) generalizes far better than the tree ensembles. I1-hat shows a robust association with error beyond T-hat/F-hat, while I2-hat contributes little; standalone Logistic Regression confidence outperforms the full decomposition, a boundary condition we report honestly. Two further results extend this: fusing a time-domain and a frequency-domain model of the same signal and scoring their Jensen-Shannon divergence beats that model own entropy (AURC 0.29 vs. 0.36 on the standard split; 0.54 vs. 0.73 under a harder single-condition reproduction), the only indicator moving correctly under a CWRU-versus-JNU distributional-shift contrast; and, on CWRU alone, literature-verified bearing fault frequencies, correctly demodulated via the envelope spectrum, separate most fault classes almost perfectly (99.57 percent) using three interpretable features. Code, logs, and figures are released for independent verification.

AI.tldr: 论文将随机森林、XGBoost与逻辑回归集成模型的预测分解为四个中性论指标（T-hat、F-hat、预测熵I1-hat、决策分歧I2-hat），在CWRU与JNU轴承数据集上以留一工况协议评估，发现I1-hat对误差的关联性强于T-hat/F-hat，而独立的逻辑回归置信度优于完整分解，并给出时频域融合的Jensen-Shannon散度指标与基于包络谱的可解释特征方法。
AI.motivation: 机器学习轴承故障分类器输出标量置信度分数，将自信的错误与真正模糊的预测混为一谈，且传统真/假对（F = 1 - T）在构造上代数冗余，无法区分证据来源与不确定性类型。论文希望用更精细的中性论分解来刻画不确定性，并检验其在实际轴承基准上的有效性。
AI.method: 构建Random Forest + XGBoost + Logistic Regression集成，将其输出分解为四个中性论指标：T-hat（首类证据）、F-hat（最强竞争类证据）、预测熵I1-hat、决策分歧I2-hat；在CWRU与JNU两个轴承基准（600-1000 rpm）上采用leave-one-condition-out协议评估。此外，融合同一信号的时域与频域模型并用Jensen-Shannon散度作为不确定性指标；在CWRU上使用文献验证的轴承故障频率，通过包络谱解调提取三个可解释特征进行分类。
AI.result: CWRU上修正文件到类映射错误后，集成在四个留出负载中的三个达到100.00%准确率（第四个92.27%），剩余错误过少而无法进行不确定性分析。JNU上留出1000 rpm时准确率骤降至40.64%，低于多数类基线；逻辑回归（57.91%）泛化能力远优于树集成。I1-hat对误差的关联性强于T-hat/F-hat，I2-hat贡献很小；独立逻辑回归置信度优于完整分解。时频域融合的Jensen-Shannon散度优于模型自身熵（标准划分AURC 0.29对0.36；更难的单工况复现下0.54对0.73），且是唯一在CWRU对JNU分布偏移对比中方向正确的指标；在CWRU上包络谱解调的可解释特征以99.57%近乎完美地区分多数故障类别。
AI.conclusion: 精细的中性论分解在轴承故障检测中并未整体超越简单的逻辑回归置信度，I1-hat是其中较有效的误差关联指标而I2-hat作用有限；跨数据集分布偏移下，时频域融合的Jensen-Shannon散度显示出更稳健的不确定性表征能力；基于包络谱的物理可解释特征在单一数据集内可取得近乎完美的分类效果。论文诚实地报告了这些边界条件，并公开代码、日志与图表以供独立验证。

title: Comparative review of hybrid forecasting models for short-term prediction of building thermal load
summary: In this paper, a comparative review of different hybrid models for short-term forecasting of building thermal demand is carried out. Particularly, the assessment tackles the comparison of data-driven models enhanced with other state-of-the-art techniques. At the first step, the existing techniques reported in the literature are analysed. It is concluded that Metaheuristics or a data-driven model are used to identify the parameters of the basic model. The qualitative evaluation includes for each method the input and output features, main advantages and drawbacks. At the second step, an existing dataset of historical thermal demand from Scottish households, as well as historical weather forecasts are utilized to assess additionally the performance of existing hybrid methods. From the assessment of 13 hybrid methods, the Empirical Modal Decomposition - long short-term memory - Markov (EMD-LSTM-Markov) model can predict with the highest accuracy the day-ahead power pattern of heating and domestic hot water (DHW) demands. Though local power peaks are also accurately predicted, high power swells and spikes are underestimated. Other methods, such as Support Vector Machine - Simulated Annealing (SVM-SA) and Random Forest - Improved Sparrow Search Algorithm - LSTM (RF-ISSA-LSTM) predict a smooth pattern of heating and DHW demand profiles with rapid changes underestimating most power peaks.

AI.tldr: 本文对建筑短期热需求预测的多种混合模型进行了比较研究，利用苏格兰家庭历史热需求与天气预报数据评估13种混合方法，发现EMD-LSTM-Markov在日前供热与生活热水功率预测中精度最高。
AI.motivation: 建筑热需求（供热与生活热水）短期预测对能源系统调度与运行优化至关重要，而单一数据驱动模型在精度上存在局限，因此需系统比较各类混合模型的适用性与性能，明确其优劣。
AI.method: 首先对文献中现有混合技术进行定性综述，归纳其输入输出特征、主要优缺点，指出多数方法以元启发式算法或数据驱动模型辨识基础模型参数；其次基于苏格兰家庭历史热需求数据与历史天气预报数据，对13种混合方法开展定量评估与对比。
AI.result: 在13种混合方法中，EMD-LSTM-Markov对日前供热与生活热水（DHW）功率曲线预测精度最高，但会低估高功率涌流与尖峰；SVM-SA与RF-ISSA-LSTM等方法预测曲线平滑，在快速变化时低估多数功率峰值。
AI.conclusion: 混合模型整体优于单一模型，但不同方法在峰值与突变刻画上各有短板，EMD-LSTM-Markov综合表现最优；实际应用需根据预测目标在平滑性与峰值精度间权衡选择合适模型。

title: Learning When to Refine: Long-Horizon Reinforcement Learning for Budgeted Neural-Operator PDE Solvers
summary: Neural operators provide fast surrogates for time-dependent PDEs, but autoregressive deployment creates a refinement-allocation problem: prediction errors vary over space and time, while only a finite number of local corrections can be committed along a trajectory. We formulate this as budgeted adaptive neural-operator solving. A global Fourier neural operator advances the full field, a local operator proposes patch-wise residual corrections, and a set-aware selector chooses where to refine. A macro policy decides when and how much of the remaining refinement budget to spend. We introduce rollout-verified policy improvement (RV-PI), which evaluates feasible refinement counts through actual continuation rollouts of the learned PDE solver, converts long-horizon advantages into conservative policy targets, and accepts an update only when held-out trajectory error improves. On the shallow-water benchmark with a 32-intervention budget, RV-PI achieves a three-seed mean trajectory relative L2 error of 0.6910, improving over immediate-only policy improvement by 5.37% and RandomMacro by 2.41%. On the forcing-driven Brusselator benchmark with a 76-intervention budget, RV-PI attains 0.09954, improving over immediate-only policy improvement by 2.31% and RandomMacro by 5.32%. These results show that, under a fixed refinement budget, the value of a local correction depends on its downstream effect on the autoregressive trajectory, not only on its immediate error reduction.

AI.tldr: 本文将带预算的自适应神经算子求解建模为"精化分配"问题，提出 rollout 验证的策略改进（RV-PI），在两个 PDE 基准上以固定干预预算降低轨迹相对 L2 误差。
AI.motivation: 自回归部署神经算子时，预测误差在时空上分布不均，但沿轨迹只能执行有限次局部修正，因此需要解决"在何处、何时、花多少预算修正"的分配问题。
AI.method: 全局 Fourier 神经算子推进全场，局部算子提出分块残差修正，集合感知选择器决定修正位置，宏策略决定何时及花费多少剩余预算；并提出 RV-PI，通过真实 continuation rollout 评估可行精化次数，将长时程优势转为保守策略目标，仅在留出轨迹误差改善时接受更新。
AI.result: 浅水基准（32 次干预预算）三随机种子平均轨迹相对 L2 误差 0.6910，较 immediate-only 策略改进提升 5.37%，较 RandomMacro 提升 2.41%；受迫 Brusselator 基准（76 次预算）为 0.09954，分别提升 2.31% 与 5.32%。
AI.conclusion: 在固定精化预算下，局部修正的价值取决于其对自回归轨迹的下游影响，而不仅是即时误差下降。

title: Event-Driven ML Pipeline Orchestration for Manufacturing: An AWS Industry Experience
comment: Accepted in the 14th IEEE International Conference on Cloud Engineering (IC2E 2026). It will be hosted on October 13th-15th, 2026 at Santa Clara, California, USA
summary: We present an industry experience report on three years of operating an event-driven cloud infrastructure for continuous machine learning training in automotive manufacturing. Our system orchestrates GPU-accelerated training of product-specialized model pairs, a physics prediction model and a reinforcement-learning control policy, across multiple plants, coordinating long-running GPU workloads triggered by manufacturing events. The architecture combines Amazon ECS with EC2 GPU capacity providers, SQS-based messaging with dead-letter queues, and an admission-controlled Lambda dispatcher that enforces cluster concurrency limits. A Conductor orchestrator on ECS Fargate initiates dependency-aware retraining chains on a weekly schedule. The entire infrastructure is codified in modular Terraform with multi-account separation. From 40000+ production training jobs we report a 72-78% cost reduction versus always-on GPU infrastructure. A discrete-event simulation confirms that admission control is necessary (naive dispatch loses 65% of jobs) and that queue-draining matches AWS Step Functions latency while eliminating per-job startup overhead. We provide lessons learned and release the simulator and Terraform module skeletons as open-source artifacts.

AI.tldr: 面向汽车制造场景的事件驱动云上持续机器学习训练基础设施三年运行经验报告，基于ECS/EC2 GPU、SQS、Lambda准入控制与Conductor编排，在40000+训练作业上实现72-78%成本降低，并以离散事件仿真验证架构必要性。
AI.motivation: 持续机器学习训练（尤其是产品专用模型对的GPU加速训练）通常依赖常开GPU基础设施，成本高昂；同时制造事件触发的长时GPU作业需要跨工厂协调、并发限制与依赖管理。论文动机是分享工业界长期运营经验，回答此类事件驱动架构在成本、可靠性与调度开销上的实际收益。
AI.method: 架构上采用Amazon ECS结合EC2 GPU容量提供者执行GPU加速训练；使用SQS消息与死信队列解耦事件触发；由带准入控制的Lambda调度器强制集群并发上限；ECS Fargate上的Conductor编排器按周计划发起依赖感知的重训练链；全部基础设施以模块化Terraform实现多账户隔离。评估方法包括40000+生产训练作业的实测成本数据，以及一个离散事件仿真，用于对比准入控制与朴素调度、队列排空策略与AWS Step Functions的延迟和启动开销。
AI.result: 相比常开GPU基础设施，成本降低72-78%；仿真表明准入控制是必要的，朴素调度会丢失65%的作业；队列排空机制在延迟上与AWS Step Functions相当，同时消除了逐作业启动开销。
AI.conclusion: 论文总结三年工业运营经验，验证了事件驱动、准入控制与队列排空组合在多工厂持续机器学习训练中的成本与可靠性优势，并开源了仿真器与Terraform模块骨架，供同类场景复用。

title: Learning from Unreliable Trajectories: Adversarially-Robust Federated Q-Learning
summary: We study federated reinforcement learning in which multiple agents interact with a common Markov decision process and communicate through a central server to collaboratively learn the optimal state-action value function. Our goal is to understand whether the sample-efficiency benefits of collaboration can be retained when a fraction of the agents behave adversarially and transmit arbitrarily corrupted information. To address this problem, we introduce Robust Async-Fed-Q, an epoch-based federated learning algorithm that combines variance-reduced estimation of the Bellman optimality operator at the agents with robust aggregation at the server. We establish high-probability finite-time guarantees showing that the proposed method preserves the statistical gains of collaboration among the honest agents while tolerating adversarial corruption. In particular, the effect of the adversarial agents decreases as the amount of data collected by each honest agent grows and eventually vanishes in the infinite-sample limit. We complement these guarantees with information-theoretic lower bounds that characterize the unavoidable statistical cost of adversarial corruption, leading to the first nearly matching upper and lower bounds for adversarially robust federated reinforcement learning. We further extend our framework to accommodate single-trajectory Markovian sampling and heterogeneous partial coverage, where different agents may explore different regions of the state-action space and learning relies on their collective coverage. Finally, our epoch-based design substantially improves the best known communication complexity for federated Q-learning under asynchronous sampling.

AI.tldr: 本文研究存在对抗性代理的联邦强化学习，提出 Robust Async-Fed-Q 算法，结合方差缩减的 Bellman 最优算子估计与鲁棒聚合，给出了近乎匹配的上下界，并扩展至单轨迹马尔可夫采样与异构部分覆盖场景。
AI.motivation: 联邦强化学习中多个代理通过中心服务器协作学习最优状态-动作值函数，可提升样本效率；但部分代理可能表现对抗性并传输任意损坏信息。核心问题是：在存在对抗攻击时，协作带来的样本效率优势能否保留。
AI.method: 提出 Robust Async-Fed-Q：一种基于 epoch 的联邦学习算法，在代理端采用方差缩减的 Bellman 最优算子估计，在服务器端采用鲁棒聚合。进一步扩展框架以支持单轨迹马尔可夫采样和异构部分覆盖（不同代理探索状态-动作空间的不同区域，依赖集体覆盖进行学习）。
AI.result: 建立高概率有限时间保证，表明方法在容忍对抗性损坏的同时保留了诚实代理间协作的统计增益；对抗代理的影响随每个诚实代理数据量增加而减小，在无限样本极限下消失。给出信息论下界刻画对抗损坏的不可避免统计代价，得到对抗鲁棒联邦强化学习首个近乎匹配的上下界。epoch 设计显著改进了异步采样下联邦 Q 学习的最佳已知通信复杂度。
AI.conclusion: 在对抗性代理存在的情况下，联邦强化学习仍可保持协作的统计增益，且对抗影响可随数据量增长而消除；所提方法在统计与通信效率上均达到接近最优的表现。

title: AttSVD:Prompt-Adaptive Low-Rank KV Cache Compression via Attention-Guided SVD
summary: The key-value (KV) cache of autoregressive transformers grows linearly with context length and dominates memory at long context. Most training-free remedies evict low-importance tokens, an irreversible choice along the sequence axis. We instead keep every token and store it more cheaply along the "feature" axis. We therefore propose AttSVD, a new "interpretable" low-rank compression whose basis is derived from each prompt's own attention geometry: an online, per-prompt truncated SVD that keeps only the directions attention actually reads, cutting persistent per-head KV memory in proportion to the retained rank. We propose two decode-time caching strategies, accumulating and streaming, for short and long generation regimes. Furthermore, we propose two refinements that make compression adaptive. A per-matrix energy rule sizes the logit space and the attention mass independently. An attention-aware basis truncates only in the spaces attention actually reads, preserving both the attention logits and the attention output. The same factors also provide free, per-head interpretability insights into the effective rank and the geometry attention consumes. Across multiple models, on both an agentic benchmark and the full LongBench suite AttSVD stays on par with the dense cache while using up to 50% of the KV-cache memory.

AI.tldr: AttSVD是一种免训练的低秩KV缓存压缩方法，沿"特征"轴而非序列轴压缩，基于每个prompt自身的注意力几何做在线截断SVD，在LongBench和agentic基准上以不超过50%的KV缓存内存达到与稠密缓存相当的性能。
AI.motivation: 自回归Transformer的KV缓存随上下文长度线性增长，成为长上下文场景下的内存瓶颈。现有免训练方案多在序列轴上驱逐低重要性token，该选择不可逆，会永久丢失信息。作者转而保留全部token，改为在特征轴上以更低成本存储。
AI.method: 提出AttSVD：一种"可解释"的低秩压缩方法，其基底来自每个prompt自身的注意力几何，即在线、逐prompt的截断SVD，仅保留注意力实际读取的方向，按保留秩成比例降低每头KV的持久内存。提出两种解码期缓存策略——累加式（accumulating）与流式（streaming），分别适配短、长生成场景。另提出两项自适应改进：1）逐矩阵能量准则，独立确定logit空间与注意力质量的规模；2）注意力感知基底截断，仅在注意力实际读取的空间中截断，从而同时保持注意力logit与注意力输出。
AI.result: 在多个模型上，于一个agentic基准以及完整的LongBench套件上，AttSVD在使用至多50% KV缓存内存的情况下，性能与稠密缓存相当。此外，相同因子还免费提供逐头的可解释性洞察，包括有效秩与注意力所消耗的几何结构。
AI.conclusion: 沿特征轴做低秩压缩、并以注意力几何驱动的基底与自适应秩分配，是替代序列轴token驱逐的有效免训练KV缓存压缩路径，可在显著降低内存的同时保持长上下文性能。

title: QiYao-I: A Manifold Based Foundation Model for Irregular Multivariate Time Series Forecasting
summary: Irregular multivariate time series forecasting is a challenging yet important problem in real-world applications, where observations are often irregularly sampled and asynchronously recorded across variables. Existing time series foundation models are mostly built on regularly sampled sequences, making them difficult to generalize to irregular time intervals and asynchronous cross-variable dependencies. To address these challenges, we propose QiYao-I, a manifold based foundation model for irregular multivariate time series forecasting. Specifically, we introduce a novel sampling-conditioned temporal manifold attention mechanism that maps real timestamps into a learnable temporal manifold feature space and injects temporal manifold biases into attention layers, enabling the model to capture both irregular time intervals and local sampling structures. Further, we propose a dynamic variable interaction mechanism with frequency awareness. It selectively performs cross-variable message passing under asynchronous observations.
