Extensive experiments on real-world irregular multivariate forecasting benchmarks demonstrate that QiYao-I achieves superior performance compared with both time series foundation models and end-to-end irregular forecasting models, showing strong generalization ability in zero-shot and few-shot settings.

AI.tldr: 本文提出QiYao-I，一个基于流形的不规则多元时间序列预测基础模型，通过采样条件化时间流形注意力机制和频率感知的动态变量交互机制，解决不规则采样与异步跨变量依赖问题，在零样本和少样本设置下表现优异。
AI.motivation: 现实应用中，多元时间序列常存在不规则采样和跨变量异步记录的问题，而现有时间序列基础模型多基于规则采样序列构建，难以泛化到不规则时间间隔和异步跨变量依赖场景。
AI.method: 1）提出采样条件化时间流形注意力机制，将真实时间戳映射到可学习的时间流形特征空间，并向注意力层注入时间流形偏置，以捕捉不规则时间间隔与局部采样结构；2）提出频率感知的动态变量交互机制，在异步观测条件下选择性地执行跨变量消息传递。
AI.result: 在真实世界不规则多元预测基准上的大量实验表明，QiYao-I相较于时间序列基础模型和端到端不规则预测模型均取得更优性能，并在零样本与少样本设置下展现出强泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: QiYao-I验证了将时间流形建模与频率感知变量交互相结合的有效性，为不规则多元时间序列预测提供了一种可泛化的基础模型方案。

title: Learning to Remember: Distilling Memory Retention for Compact Recurrent Neural Networks
summary: Deep learning models, particularly recurrent neural networks and their variants, such as long short-term memory, have significantly advanced time series analysis. These models capture complex, sequential patterns in time series, enabling real-time assessments. However, their high computational complexity and large model sizes pose challenges for deployment in resource-constrained environments, such as wearable devices and edge computing platforms. Knowledge Distillation (KD) offers a solution by transferring knowledge from a large, complex model (teacher) to a smaller, more efficient model (student), thereby retaining high performance while reducing computational demands. Current KD methods, originally designed for computer vision tasks, neglect the unique temporal dependencies and memory retention characteristics of time series models. To bridge this gap, we propose a novel KD framework termed Memory-Discrepancy Knowledge Distillation (MemKD). MemKD leverages a specialized loss function to capture memory retention discrepancies between the teacher and student models across subsequences within time series data, ensuring that the student model effectively mimics the teacher's behaviour. This approach facilitates the development of compact, high-performing recurrent neural networks suitable for real-time, time series analysis tasks. We provide additional experiments, in-depth theoretical analysis, and insights into the proposed framework across extended time series benchmarks. Our experiments demonstrate that MemKD significantly outperforms state-of-the-art KD methods. Additionally, we demonstrate that it can match the teacher model's performance across a wide range of compression levels, achieving notable reductions in parameter count and memory usage without a significant loss in accuracy.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出MemKD——一种面向时间序列循环神经网络的知识蒸馏框架，通过捕捉师生模型在子序列上的记忆保持差异来指导学生模型，实现高效压缩且性能接近教师模型。
AI.motivation: 深度学习模型（如RNN/LSTM）在时间序列分析中表现优异，但其高计算复杂度与大模型体积难以部署在可穿戴设备、边缘计算等资源受限环境。知识蒸馏（KD）可将大模型（教师）知识迁移到小模型（学生），但现有KD方法源于计算机视觉任务，忽视了时间序列模型特有的时间依赖性与记忆保持特性，因此需要针对性设计。
AI.method: 提出Memory-Discrepancy Knowledge Distillation（MemKD）框架，采用专门的损失函数来捕捉教师与学生模型在时间序列各子序列上的记忆保持差异，从而约束学生模型有效模仿教师行为，构建紧凑且高性能的循环神经网络。
AI.result: 在扩展的时间序列基准上，MemKD显著优于当前最先进的KD方法；在多种压缩率下可匹配教师模型性能，在大幅减少参数量与内存占用的同时不显著损失精度。
AI.conclusion: MemKD弥补了传统KD方法在时间序列任务中的不足，为资源受限环境下部署实时时间序列分析模型提供了有效方案，并辅以理论分析与实验洞见。

title: Learning to Decide, Not to Reason: Parameter-Efficient Decision Operators via Low-Rank Activation Steering
summary: Injecting skills into a frozen language model currently costs a million parameters and a reinforcement-learning pipeline. We introduce \method{}, a System-1 decision operator trained by behavior cloning that lowers this cost by roughly two orders of magnitude. The default operator uses 330K parameters to match a 1.33M-parameter operator trained with reinforcement learning, exceeds or achieve comparable performance, while collapsing 3,685-token deliberation into a 6-token decision with no loss in accuracy. A rank-4 variant with 23K parameters, 1/58 of the strongest published skill operator, suffices for SearchQA and near-suffices for LiveMath, where higher rank still helps; the same recipe transfers across five tasks and three backbones, with out-of-distribution gains persisting on LiveMath problems released months after training. The gap to prior work is trainability, and it is set jointly by initialization and architecture: the initialization of prior operators zeroes the gradient of both large factor matrices at the first optimization step, whereas our zero-initialized output projection inside a shared low-rank backbone receives a gradient immediately, which a gradient-flow probe confirms directly. The gain isn't chain-of-thought compression: 23 of 57 LiveMath points beat the base model's best-of-8 sampling, and a logit-lens probe shows the operator amplifies the answer along the model's existing late-layer pathway, not writing it earlier. Gains track the base model's headroom across 13 base--task pairs, and skills compose as approximately linear operators that can be added, interpolated, and hot-swapped at inference time. Code on https://github.com/rlisml/decisionsteer.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 \method{}——一个用行为克隆训练的 System-1 决策算子，以约低两个数量级的参数量实现与强化学习算子相当的性能，并将长推理压缩为短决策。
AI.motivation: 向冻结语言模型注入技能目前需百万级参数和强化学习流程，成本高、难训练；作者认为与既有工作的差距根源在“可训练性”，而非能力上限。
AI.method: 采用行为克隆训练决策算子（System-1 决策算子）。默认算子 330K 参数，另有 rank-4（23K 参数）变体；架构上在共享低秩骨干内使用零初始化输出投影，以保证首步即有梯度。通过梯度流探针、logit-lens 探针进行机制验证。
AI.result: 330K 参数算子匹配 1.33M 参数 RL 算子，将 3,685 token 推理压缩为 6 token 决策且精度无损；23K 变体为最强已发表算子的 1/58，足以应对 SearchQA、近乎足以应对 LiveMath；配方跨 5 任务、3 骨干迁移，OOD 增益在训练后数月发布的 LiveMath 上仍保持；23/57 LiveMath 分数超过基模型 best-of-8；增益随 13 个基模型—任务对的 headroom 变化；技能近似线性算子，可相加、插值、热插拔。
AI.conclusion: 差距源于可训练性，由初始化与架构共同决定：先前算子的初始化在首步将大因子矩阵梯度置零，而本文零初始化输出投影可立即获得梯度。增益并非思维链压缩，而是沿模型既有后层通路放大答案。

title: Do Neural PDE Solvers Learn the Right Dynamics?
summary: Neural PDE solvers can achieve low prediction errors, but do they reproduce the dynamics of the systems they model? Prediction scores alone offer an incomplete answer: they measure agreement with reference solutions but provide limited insight into how errors accumulate, nearby states diverge, or extreme events arise. We propose an evaluation framework that directly examines these behaviors in deterministic and stochastic neural solvers. By evolving ensembles of nearby initial states and comparing them with direct numerical simulation, we assess three complementary aspects of learned dynamics: error formation, ensemble geometry, and extreme events. Experiments on two-dimensional Kolmogorov flow reveal limitations that conventional scores can obscure. Smaller trajectory errors can reflect weaker error amplification despite less accurate local updates. Models can match an ensemble's overall spread and effective dimension while failing to capture the spatial directions where nearby states diverge. Similarly, matching overall event frequencies can conceal failures to predict persistent extreme events. These findings show that improved prediction accuracy does not necessarily imply greater dynamical fidelity. Our framework makes this distinction measurable, providing concrete criteria for evaluating whether advances in neural PDE solvers better capture the underlying dynamics.

AI.tldr: 提出一个评估框架，通过演化邻近初始态集合与直接数值模拟对比，从误差形成、集合几何与极端事件三方面刻画神经PDE求解器的动力学保真度。
AI.motivation: 神经PDE求解器预测误差低，但预测分数只衡量与参考解的一致程度，无法揭示误差如何累积、邻近状态如何发散、极端事件如何产生，因此需直接检验其是否复现系统动力学。
AI.method: 构建评估框架，对确定性及随机神经求解器演化邻近初始态集合，并与直接数值模拟对比，评估三个互补方面：误差形成、集合几何、极端事件；在二维Kolmogorov流上开展实验。
AI.result: 较小的轨迹误差可能源于较弱的误差放大而非更准确的局部更新；模型可匹配集合的整体扩散与有效维度，却无法捕捉邻近状态发散的空间方向；匹配总体事件频率可能掩盖对持续性极端事件的预测失败。
AI.conclusion: 预测精度提升不必然意味着动力学保真度提升；该框架使这一区分可量化，为评估神经PDE求解器进展是否更好捕捉底层动力学提供具体标准。

title: EVFormer: An Egocentric Vision-EMG Bidirectional Attention Model for Bimanual Hand Pose Estimation
summary: Egocentric bimanual hand pose estimation is important for virtual interaction, wearable control, and rehabilitation, but visual observations are often degraded by self-occlusion, hand-hand contact, and object manipulation. We propose EVFormer, a multimodal framework that combines the current RGB frame with the preceding 200 ms of bilateral wrist surface electromyography (sEMG) to estimate 44 finger and wrist joint angles. EVFormer separately encodes visual spatial features and sEMG temporal features, enables cross-modal information exchange through sequential bidirectional cross-attention, and integrates the two modalities using feature-wise gated fusion. We evaluate EVFormer in a single-participant feasibility study using one synchronized public EgoEMG recording with chronologically separated training, validation, and test splits. On 296 test samples, EVFormer achieves a mean absolute error of 11.482 degrees, compared with 13.228-13.610 degrees for vision-only, sEMG-only, late-fusion, and training-mean baselines. This corresponds to relative error reductions of 13.20% compared with the vision-only model and 14.23% compared with late fusion. EVFormer also achieves the lowest error in four of the five evaluated gesture classes. These results provide preliminary evidence that feature-level interaction between egocentric vision and sEMG can improve bimanual hand pose estimation. Further evaluation across participants, recording sessions, sensor placements, and real-world interaction conditions is required to establish the generalizability of the approach.

AI.tldr: 提出多模态框架 EVFormer，融合当前 RGB 帧与既往 200 ms 双侧腕部 sEMG，估计 44 个手指与腕关节角度，在单被试可行性研究中取得优于单模态与晚融合基线的精度。
AI.motivation: 以自我中心视角进行双手姿态估计对视拟交互、可穿戴控制与康复具有重要意义，但自我遮挡、双手接触及物体操作会导致视觉观测质量退化，单靠视觉难以稳定估计手部姿态，因此需要引入肌电等互补模态。
AI.method: EVFormer 分别编码视觉空间特征与 sEMG 时序特征；通过顺序双向交叉注意力实现跨模态信息交换；再采用特征级门控融合整合两模态，输出 44 个手指与腕关节角度。评估基于一段同步公开的 EgoEMG 记录，采用单被试可行性研究，训练/验证/测试按时间顺序划分。
AI.result: 在 296 个测试样本上，EVFormer 的平均绝对误差为 11.482 度；仅视觉、仅 sEMG、晚融合及训练均值基线为 13.228–13.610 度。相对仅视觉降低 13.20%，相对晚融合降低 14.23%。在五类手势中的四类上误差最低。
AI.conclusion: 结果初步表明，自我中心视觉与 sEMG 的特征级交互可提升双手姿态估计精度；但方法的泛化性仍需跨被试、跨录制会话、跨传感器佩戴位置及真实交互条件下的进一步验证。

title: Uncertainty in Representation Learning on Knowledge Graphs
summary: Knowledge graph embedding (KGE) methods represent entities and predicates in continuous vector spaces to infer missing knowledge. Despite strong benchmark performance, their predictions often lack principled reliability guarantees, limiting their use in high-stakes applications. Moreover, uncertainty arises throughout the KGE pipeline, from incomplete or probabilistic input knowledge to stochastic training and prediction. This thesis systematically investigates three sources of uncertainty in KGE: knowledge uncertainty, arising from incomplete, noisy, or probabilistic input knowledge; algorithmic uncertainty, induced by randomness in model training; and predictive uncertainty, concerning the reliability of model outputs. To address algorithmic uncertainty, the thesis demonstrates that models trained under identical settings can produce substantially different predictions and introduces a voting-based aggregation framework to mitigate this instability. To quantify predictive uncertainty, it adapts conformal prediction to KGE, constructing answer sets with distribution-free coverage guarantees and extending them to provide predicate-conditional reliability guarantees. To support reasoning under knowledge uncertainty, it develops statistically valid prediction intervals for confidence-scored triples and an embedding-based approach to approximate probabilistic reasoning over statistical ontologies with formal soundness guarantees. Together, these complementary, model-agnostic methods provide a practical and theoretically grounded approach to uncertainty in KGE, advancing beyond predictive accuracy toward reliable and uncertainty-aware knowledge graph reasoning.

AI.tldr: 本论文系统研究知识图谱嵌入（KGE）中的三类不确定性——知识不确定性、算法不确定性与预测不确定性，并提出一系列模型无关的、具理论保证的方法来提升KGE推理的可靠性。
AI.motivation: 尽管KGE方法在基准测试中表现优异，但其预测往往缺乏有原则的可靠性保证，限制了其在高风险场景中的应用。此外，不确定性贯穿KGE全流程，从输入知识的不完整/概率性，到随机训练与预测，均会引入不确定性。
AI.method: 论文针对三类不确定性分别提出方法：针对算法不确定性，证明相同设置下训练的模型会产生显著不同的预测，并引入基于投票的聚合框架以缓解不稳定性；针对预测不确定性，将保形预测（conformal prediction）适配到KGE，构造具有无分布覆盖保证的答案集，并扩展为谓词条件化的可靠性保证；针对知识不确定性，开发带置信度三元组的统计有效预测区间，以及一种基于嵌入的方法来近似统计本体上的概率推理，并具备形式化可靠性保证。整体方法模型无关。
AI.result: 所提方法可缓解训练随机性带来的预测不稳定，构造具有无分布覆盖保证的预测集，并提供谓词条件化可靠性保证；同时为置信度三元组给出统计有效的预测区间，并实现对统计本体概率推理的具可靠性保证的近似。
AI.conclusion: 这些互补的、模型无关的方法为KGE中的不确定性提供了兼具实用性与理论基础的解决途径，推动知识图谱推理从单纯追求预测精度迈向可靠且具备不确定性感知的方向。

title: A Data-Driven Framework for Unsupervised Monitoring of Transmission Systems Using End-of-Line Testing Data: A Case Study at Ford Motor Company
summary: Sensing technologies have advanced rapidly across industries ranging from energy to automotive manufacturing. These systems generate high-dimensional (HD) data characterized by complex nonlinear patterns and strong temporal dependencies. Traditional statistical monitoring methods are often limited in their ability to capture such nonlinear structure. Likewise, many analytical approaches used in End-of-Line testing rely on predefined thresholds and heuristic rules, which restrict their ability to detect informative anomaly signatures in HD temporal data. In contrast, while modern deep learning and generative AI models offer strong predictive capabilities, they are often unsuitable in applications where data are costly to collect and where the monitoring system must remain interpretable, low-latency, computationally efficient, and usable by non-technical practitioners. To overcome these limitations, we propose an advanced multivariate monitoring framework for HD data. The framework operates in two stages. In the first stage, the data are preprocessed to remove incomplete and non-informative samples and to temporally align time series data. In the second stage, nonlinear dimensionality reduction is performed, followed by anomaly detection through a control chart based phase I monitoring procedure. The framework can be used in both unsupervised and supervised settings, depending on the availability of ground truth labels during training. Moreover, its flexible and modular structure allows practitioners to adapt its components to different domains and operational requirements. We evaluate the proposed framework on real production data from an automotive manufacturing environment at Ford Motor Company. The proposed method achieves higher accuracy, recall, and F1 score than the company's existing model, improving these metrics from 0.50, 0.30, and 0.429 to 0.625, 1.00, and 0.769, respectively.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种面向高维数据的两阶段多元监控框架：先预处理（清洗与时间对齐），再做非线性降维并结合控制图进行Phase I异常检测，支持无监督与有监督两种设置，在福特汽车制造产线真实数据上优于现有模型。
AI.motivation: 传感技术产生的高维数据具有复杂非线性与强时间依赖性；传统统计监控难以刻画非线性结构，End-of-Line测试多依赖预设阈值与启发式规则，难以识别高维时序中的有效异常特征；而深度学习与生成式AI虽预测力强，却在数据采集成本高、且要求可解释、低延迟、计算高效、便于非技术人员使用的场景中不适用。
AI.method: 提出两阶段多元监控框架。第一阶段：数据预处理，剔除不完整与非信息性样本，并对时间序列进行时间对齐。第二阶段：进行非线性降维，随后通过基于控制图的Phase I监控程序实施异常检测。框架模块化、灵活，可根据训练时是否有真值标签在无监督与有监督两种模式下运行，各组件可按领域与运行需求调整。
AI.result: 在福特汽车公司汽车制造环境的真实生产数据上评估，所提方法的准确率、召回率与F1分数均高于公司现有模型，分别由0.50、0.30、0.429提升至0.625、1.00、0.769。
AI.conclusion: 该框架在保持可解释性、低延迟与计算效率的同时，有效提升了高维时序数据的异常检测性能，适合非技术从业者使用，并可模块化迁移至不同领域与运行条件。

title: An Information-Theoretic Evaluation Framework for Benchmark and Model Diagnosis in Knowledge Tracing
summary: Knowledge tracing (KT) models are predominantly evaluated using aggregate metrics such as area under the curve (AUC) and accuracy. However, these global scores obscure where the remaining errors originate and fail to indicate whether a benchmark is approaching saturation. While estimating a global theoretical performance limit is challenging in realistic KT settings, it is possible to quantify local predictability. To address this, we propose an information-theoretic evaluation framework for KT benchmark diagnosis. We use Context Tree Weighting (CTW) on item-response histories and current-item queries as an operational causal uncertainty coordinate, while distinguishing it from the unobserved Local Irreducible Uncertainty (LIU) under the full KT information set. By projecting predictions onto this shared uncertainty coordinate, we evaluate model performance gains across distinct entropy bands rather than only at the global level. Comprehensive evaluations on NIPS Task 3/4 and Algebra 2005 reveal that model improvements are highly non-uniform. Modern KT models show substantial gains in high-entropy regions, and additional item-aware references, log-loss, and equal-frequency analyses support this localization. The framework also flags regions where apparent gains require checks for noise-sensitive behavior. By surfacing these local modeling failures alongside genuine gains, this approach provides a diagnostic tool for studying both residual predictive structure and the limitations of current KT benchmarks and models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个基于信息论的KT评测框架，用CTW构建“操作化因果不确定性坐标”，将模型预测投影到该坐标上按熵带评估，揭示模型改进在局部（尤其高熵区）高度不均，从而诊断基准与模型的剩余预测结构及失效区域。
AI.motivation: 现有知识追踪（KT）模型多用AUC、准确率等聚合指标评估，这类全局分数掩盖了错误来源，也无法判断基准是否接近饱和；而真实KT场景下估计全局理论性能上限很困难，因此需要转向可量化的“局部可预测性”评估。
AI.method: 提出信息论评测框架：以Context Tree Weighting（CTW）作用于题目作答历史与当前题目查询，作为可操作的因果不确定性坐标；同时将其与完整KT信息集下不可观测的Local Irreducible Uncertainty（LIU）区分开。把模型预测投影到这一共享不确定性坐标上，按不同熵带（entropy bands）而非仅全局层面衡量性能增益，并辅以item-aware参考、log-loss与等频分析。
AI.result: 在NIPS Task 3/4与Algebra 2005上评测显示，模型改进高度非均匀：现代KT模型在高熵区域增益显著；附加的item-aware参考、log-loss与等频分析支持这种局部化结论；框架还能标记出表面增益需警惕噪声敏感行为的区域。
AI.conclusion: 该框架通过同时呈现局部建模失败与真实增益，为研究KT的残余预测结构以及当前基准和模型的局限性提供了诊断工具，弥补了聚合指标的不足。

title: Repair Lot Skyline: A Weighted Constraint Satisfaction Approach to Pavement Repair Optimization from Geospatial Hazard Density
summary: Pavement agencies must translate a spatially distributed distress inventory into a bounded, actionable repair-lot plan: accident-critical defects (potholes) must always be addressed, lower-risk defects (cracks) should be included only when their benefit justifies the repair cost, and historical patch locations signal re-degradation risk without themselves triggering repair. We formalize this as a Repair Lot Skyline problem: a Weighted Constraint Satisfaction Problem (WCSP) defined over chainage (distance along the road) rather than over time, so that it requires only a single-epoch distress survey and makes no claim about future deterioration. The WCSP identifies 143 candidate hazard clusters (61 hard, 82 soft), of which 106 are merged into a final repair plan totaling 1,997.4 m---83.7% of the 2,385.9 m that would be required if every soft candidate were included regardless of cost. This plan covers 100% of observed potholes (138/138) and 91.6% of observed cracks (404/441), capturing 93.6% (542/579) of the total hazard benefit available in the full candidate set. The skyline frontier shows pronounced diminishing returns beyond this point: the remaining 37 excluded soft candidates would add only 6.8% additional benefit for a 19.4% increase in repair length. We further formalize the minimum-lot-length $L_{\min}$ and historical-context radius $κ$ as a joint, four-objective hyperparameter search over this WCSP; on the same case study, the recommended configuration ($L_{\min} = 14.7$ m, $κ= 10$ m) reduces repair-crew mobilizations by 7.1% relative to an untuned default, at the cost of a 12.9% larger budget and a 1.1-percentage-point lower crack coverage.

AI.tldr: 本文将路面病害修补规划形式化为沿里程(chainage)而非时间定义的四目标加权约束满足问题(WCSP)——Repair Lot Skyline问题,在只依赖单期病害检测数据、不预测未来劣化的前提下,用一个实例实现了100%坑槽覆盖、91.6%裂缝覆盖与93.6%的总危险收益,并给出最低修补段长 L_min 与历史上下文半径 κ 的联合超参数搜索方案。
AI.motivation: 路面管理机构需要把空间分布的病害清单转化为有界、可执行的修补批次方案:事故关键型病害(坑槽)必须全数处理,低风险病害(裂缝)仅在收益可抵成本时纳入,而历史补丁位置只作为再次劣化的风险信号、本身不触发修补。现有方法多依赖时间维度的劣化预测,需要多期数据并隐含未来劣化假设,缺乏以单期检测数据直接求解该带权约束规划问题的形式化框架。
AI.method: 将问题形式化为定义在里程(chainage)上的加权约束满足问题(WCSP),即 Repair Lot Skyline 问题,使求解仅需单期病害检测数据且不对未来劣化作任何断言;以硬约束(坑槽)与软约束(裂缝,按收益-成本权衡)区分候选病害,并把历史修补位置作为再劣化风险上下文而非触发条件。随后用 WCSP 识别候选危险簇并求解合并后的修补方案,刻画 skyline 前沿以展示收益递减;进一步把最小批次长度 L_min 与历史上下文半径 κ 作为联合四目标超参数,在该 WCSP 上进行搜索。
AI.result: 在案例研究中,WCSP 识别出143个候选危险簇(61个硬约束、82个软约束),其中106个被合并为最终修补方案,总长1,997.4 m,占"无成本考量下纳入全部软候选"所需2,385.9 m的83.7%;该方案覆盖100%的实测坑槽(138/138)、91.6%的实测裂缝(404/441),获得全候选集总危险收益的93.6%(542/579)。skyline 前沿显示明显收益递减:被排除的37个软候选仅带来6.8%的额外收益,却需增加19.4%的修补长度。超参数搜索推荐的配置(L_min=14.7 m,κ=10 m)相较未调优默认值减少7.1%的修补班组出动次数,代价是预算增加12.9%、裂缝覆盖率下降1.1个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 以里程为定义域、基于WCSP的 Repair Lot Skyline 框架可在单期病害检测数据下生成有界且可执行的修补批次方案,在保证关键病害全覆盖的同时对低风险病害实现收益驱动的取舍;skyline 前沿量化了边际收益递减,说明进一步纳入软候选性价比很低;L_min 与 κ 的联合四目标调优可显著降低班组出动次数,但需在预算与裂缝覆盖率之间显式权衡。后续工作可扩大案例验证并细化多目标权衡机制。

title: DART-ES: Difficulty-Aware Reweighting and Targeted Replay for Fine-Tuning LLMs with Evolution Strategies
summary: Evolution Strategies (ES) enable memory efficient full parameter fine-tuning of large language models (LLMs) using only forward computation. However, standard ES uniformly averages rewards across problems and compresses problem level population feedback into a single scalar, making it difficult to capture how the learning value of each problem changes with model capability. To address this limitation, we propose Difficulty-Aware Reweighting and Targeted Replay for Evolution Strategies (DART-ES). DART-ES estimates the local solvability of each problem from its pass rate across the perturbation population and aggregates historical observations to construct a dynamic difficulty state. This shared state jointly guides continuous difficulty reweighting and rare solvable sample replay, thereby improving perturbation direction evaluation and training data allocation without introducing an additional difficulty model or backpropagation. Extensive experiments show that DART-ES achieves good fine-tuning performance. DART-ES outperforms ES on all five base models and improves the average accuracy from 72.07\% to 73.53\%, exceeding the 73.26\% achieved by GRPO on GSM8K. Across five challenging mathematical reasoning benchmarks, DART-ES achieves an average accuracy of 49.20\%, compared with 48.34\% for ES and remains competitive with strong 7B models trained with RL. Further experiments show consistent gains in instruction tuning, code generation and the Countdown task with a 14B model, demonstrating strong generalization across tasks and scalability to larger models. Beyond performance gains, DART-ES also shows clear advantages in system efficiency. It reduces runtime per step by 15.2\%--50.2\% and peak memory usage per GPU by 21.1\%--51.1\% compared with GRPO. Despite performing full parameter fine-tuning, DART-ES also requires less runtime and GPU memory than GRPO+LoRA.

AI.tldr: 提出 DART-ES，通过难度感知重加权与稀有可解样本回放改进进化策略（ES）的微调效果与效率。
AI.motivation: 标准 ES 对不同问题统一平均奖励，并将问题级种群反馈压缩为单一标量，难以刻画每个问题的学习价值随模型能力变化的情况，限制了微调效果。
AI.method: DART-ES 依据扰动种群的通过率估计每个问题的局部可解性，并聚合历史观测构建动态难度状态；该共享状态同时指导连续难度重加权与稀有可解样本回放，从而改进扰动方向评估与训练数据分配，且无需额外难度模型或反向传播。
AI.result: 在五个基座模型上均优于 ES，平均准确率从 72.07% 提升至 73.53%，超过 GRPO 在 GSM8K 上的 73.26%；在五个数学推理基准上平均准确率 49.20%（ES 为 48.34%），与强 7B RL 模型相当。在 14B 模型的指令微调、代码生成与 Countdown 任务上均有一致增益。效率上，相较 GRPO 每步运行时间降低 15.2%–50.2%，每 GPU 峰值显存降低 21.1%–51.1%，并低于 GRPO+LoRA。
AI.conclusion: DART-ES 在不引入额外难度模型与反向传播的前提下同时提升微调性能与系统效率，具备跨任务泛化性与向更大模型扩展的能力。

title: STOCK-JEPA: Prior-Anchored Latent Revision Representation Learning in Equity Markets
summary: Learning effective representations helps characterize the structure and dynamics of equity markets from financial data with a low signal-to-noise ratio. Black-box deep models can capture complex patterns but may overfit sample noise and lack explicit economic structure. Meanwhile, classic linear financial models provide interpretable references, but their oversimplified assumptions leave non-linear signals uncaptured. To combine the strengths of these two directions, we propose Stock-JEPA, a joint-embedding predictive framework that learns predictable incremental revisions relative to a point-in-time financial prior. First, we leverage a low-complexity financial model to produce fixed statistics summarizing multi-horizon return and risk. A prior projector then maps these statistics into the target encoder's latent space as an anchor. Second, we design a context-conditioned revision predictor to estimate the future representation's predictable displacement from the anchor. Separate losses update the two branches: the anchor learns from prior statistics, while the revision captures additional predictable information from historical context. Third, we freeze all representation modules and train a downstream readout, evaluating its forecasts through cross-sectional ranking and portfolio performance. Theoretically, we prove that optimal revision reduces the prior anchor's expected squared error for the same future representation by exactly $\mathbb{E}[\|\boldsymbolΔ\|_2^2]$. This non-negative gain is the expected squared magnitude of the additional signal predictable from historical context. Experimentally, Stock-JEPA outperforms 13 strong baselines across large-scale China and U.S. equity universes on 5 key evaluation metrics. Ablation studies and representation analysis further demonstrate the value of the learned revisions for representation learning in equity markets.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Stock-JEPA，一种联合嵌入预测框架，学习相对于时点金融先验（point-in-time financial prior）的可预测增量修正（incremental revision），以融合低复杂度金融模型的可解释性与深度模型的非线性表达能力，用于刻画股票市场的结构与动态。
AI.motivation: 股票市场金融数据信噪比低，有效表征学习困难。黑盒深度模型能捕捉复杂模式，但易过拟合样本噪声且缺乏显式经济结构；经典线性金融模型具有可解释性，但其过度简化的假设无法捕捉非线性信号。因此需要一种方法同时结合二者优势。
AI.method: 提出Stock-JEPA联合嵌入预测框架：1）用低复杂度金融模型生成汇总多期收益与风险的固定统计量，由先验投影器（prior projector）映射到目标编码器潜空间作为锚点（anchor）；2）设计上下文条件修正预测器（context-conditioned revision predictor），估计未来表征相对锚点的可预测位移；3）两个分支分别用独立损失更新，锚点从先验统计学习，修正项从历史上下文捕捉额外可预测信息；4）冻结全部表征模块，训练下游读出层（readout），通过横截面排序与组合表现评估预测。
AI.result: 理论证明：最优修正可将先验锚点对同一未来表征的期望平方误差恰好降低 E[||Δ||₂²]，该非负增益即为历史上下文可预测的额外信号的期望平方幅度。实验上，Stock-JEPA在大规模中国与美国股票池、5项关键评价指标上优于13个强基线；消融研究与表征分析进一步验证了所学修正对股票市场表征学习的价值。
AI.conclusion: Stock-JEPA通过联合嵌入预测学习相对金融先验的可预测增量修正，有效融合了线性金融模型的经济结构与深度模型的非线性表征能力，在理论与实证上均证明了修正项带来非负的预测增益，并在中美股票市场取得优越表现。

title: Identifiable World Models from Pretrained Diffusion Representations
summary: Diffusion-based world models can generate and predict trajectories in high-dimensional dynamical systems, but predictive accuracy does not imply that their latent coordinates recover the underlying state variables or causal interactions. We ask whether a frozen pretrained diffusion model can be equipped with identifiable coordinates without retraining its generative backbone. We show that auxiliary-variable nonlinear ICA guarantees can be transferred to Contrastive Diffusion Alignment (ConDA), which learns only a lightweight alignment map on top of frozen diffusion latents. Under standard TCL/GCL assumptions, the aligned representation identifies latent dynamical states up to permutation and componentwise invertible transformations, preserves the latent dynamic structural causal model, and reduces lagged graph recovery to transition-Jacobian sparsity. We evaluate TCL-, GCL-, and CEBRA-based ConDA against TDRL, CaRiNG, IDOL, temporal SuaVE, and iVAE across physical and robotic video systems. TCL and GCL achieve near-perfect blockwise state recovery and competitive lagged graph recovery, including exact recovery in a simulated falling-body system. In a simulated bipedal robot, learned dynamics recover the sign and temporal structure of responses to held-out control perturbations. These results show that a frozen generative diffusion model can be equipped with coordinates that are identifiable, structurally interpretable, and useful for analyzing intervention-relevant dynamics.

AI.tldr: 冻结的预训练扩散模型可通过轻量对齐映射获得可辨识坐标，无需重训练生成主干，实现状态恢复与因果结构分析。
AI.motivation: 扩散世界模型虽能预测高维动力系统轨迹，但预测准确不等于潜在坐标恢复了真实状态变量或因果交互。作者希望在不重训练生成主干的前提下，为冻结扩散模型赋予可辨识坐标。
AI.method: 提出Contrastive Diffusion Alignment（ConDA）：将辅助变量非线性ICA的可辨识性保证迁移到冻结扩散潜变量之上，仅学习轻量对齐映射。理论上在TCL/GCL假设下，对齐表示可识别潜在动力状态（至排列与逐分量可逆变换），保留潜变量动态SCM，并将滞后图恢复归约为转移雅可比的稀疏性。实验对比TCL/GCL/CEBRA版ConDA与TDRL、CaRiNG、IDOL、temporal SuaVE、iVAE。
AI.result: 在物理与机器人视频系统中，TCL与GCL接近完美地实现分块状态恢复，滞后图恢复具竞争力，并在模拟落体系统中达到精确恢复；在模拟双足机器人中，所学动力学恢复了留出控制扰动响应的符号与时间结构。
AI.conclusion: 冻结的生成式扩散模型可被赋予可辨识、结构可解释、并可用于分析干预相关动力学的坐标。

title: Shaping the Wind: Nested Potentials for Kinematically Admissible Urban Wind Prediction
summary: Predicting transient urban winds is fundamental to understanding urban microclimates and designing climate-resilient cities. Building-resolving large-eddy simulation produces detailed incompressible urban wind fields at substantial computational cost for each layout. Neural surrogates offer a faster alternative by learning to predict the evolution of velocity fields. However, minimizing velocity prediction error does not guarantee local mass conservation and wall impermeability, which together define kinematic admissibility. This limitation stems from an unconstrained output representation: geometry conditioning guides predictions but does not restrict them to admissible velocity fields. Correcting boundary violations in these outputs changes the flux balance in adjacent fluid cells and may consequently compromise local mass conservation. To address the challenge, we propose Sculpt, a nested potential framework that builds the coupled, geometry-dependent constraints directly into its parameterization. This nested parameterization generates divergence-free velocity updates through the discrete curl of a volume vector potential on the native three-dimensional staggered grid. A shared scalar potential constrains the vector potential's boundary values so that the same operator also enforces impermeability, without a per-step pressure projection. Because backpropagation through this curl attenuates large-scale gradient signals, we parameterize the volume potential at multiple resolutions to better capture large-scale flow structures. We introduce UrbanWindFlow, an LES dataset spanning urban morphologies and inflow conditions, to evaluate accuracy and kinematic admissibility together.

AI.tldr: 提出Sculpt嵌套势框架，将无散度与不可渗透性约束直接内嵌于神经网络参数化中，实现城市瞬态风场的可容许速度预测。
AI.motivation: 建筑解析大涡模拟（LES）可生成精细的城市不可压缩风场，但每种布局的计算成本高昂；神经代理模型虽更快，但仅最小化速度预测误差无法保证局部质量守恒与壁面不可渗透性（即运动学可容许性）。根本原因在于输出表示无约束：几何条件只引导预测，并不将输出限制在可容许速度场空间内。而在输出上事后修正边界违规会改变相邻流体单元的通量平衡，从而可能破坏局部质量守恒。
AI.method: 提出Sculpt——一种嵌套势（nested potential）框架，将耦合的、依赖几何的约束直接构建进参数化。该嵌套参数化在原生三维交错网格上通过体积矢量势的离散旋度生成无散度速度更新；一个共享标量势约束矢量势的边界值，使同一算子同时施加不可渗透性，且无需逐步压力投影。由于旋度反传会衰减大尺度梯度信号，进一步在多个分辨率上参数化体积势以更好捕捉大尺度流动结构。同时构建UrbanWindFlow——覆盖多种城市形态与入流条件的LES数据集，用于联合评估精度与运动学可容许性。
AI.result: 构建了UrbanWindFlow LES数据集，涵盖多种城市形态与入流条件；Sculpt在统一评估下同时考察速度预测精度与运动学可容许性（无散度与不可渗透性），且无需每步压力投影。
AI.conclusion: 通过嵌套势参数化将无散度与不可渗透性硬约束内嵌于神经网络，Sculpt可在保持预测精度的同时保证运动学可容许性，为快速、物理一致的城市瞬态风场代理建模提供了新途径。

title: TRIAGE: Direction-Aware Mismatch Stabilization of Native NVFP4 Reinforcement Learning
summary: Low-precision execution can substantially accelerate reinforcement learning (RL) for large language models, but discrepancies between learner and sampler execution can destabilize policy optimization. In this paper, we characterize the interaction between mismatch and the policy-gradient direction, distinguishing locally amplifying from contracting update contributions that mismatch magnitude alone cannot identify. In native NVFP4 runs, we observe an early imbalance between the two amplifying regions, favoring negative-advantage, negative-gap updates. Their tail tokens become concentrated in a small fraction of response segments before mismatch spreads globally. Motivated by these findings, we introduce TRIAGE, a direction-aware stabilization method that uses segment-level diagnosis to selectively rebalance policy-gradient updates and applies bounded repair to residual severe mismatch. TRIAGE modifies the optimization objective while retaining native NVFP4 weight-and activation 4-bit (W4A4) forward execution on both the sampler and learner. Experiments on Qwen3-4B and Qwen3-30B-A3B show stable optimization throughout the evaluated training horizon and achieve full precision level performance across five mathematical reasoning benchmarks, while native NVFP4 with TRIAGE provides up to 2.3x higher rollout throughput than BF16.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TRIAGE，一种方向感知的稳定化方法，通过分段级诊断与有界修复，在原生NVFP4（W4A4）执行下稳定大语言模型强化学习策略优化，性能达到全精度水平并将rollout吞吐提升至多2.3倍。
AI.motivation: 低精度执行能显著加速大语言模型强化学习，但learner与sampler执行间的差异会破坏策略优化的稳定性；仅用不匹配幅度无法识别其对策略梯度方向的影响。
AI.method: 刻画不匹配与策略梯度方向的交互，区分局部放大与收缩的更新贡献；观察原生NVFP4运行中两类放大区域的早期失衡（偏向负优势、负gap更新）及尾部token在少数响应分段中的聚集；据此提出TRIAGE：基于分段级诊断选择性再平衡策略梯度更新，并对残余严重不匹配施加有界修复，仅修改优化目标，sampler与learner均保留原生NVFP4 W4A4前向。
AI.result: 在Qwen3-4B与Qwen3-30B-A3B上，训练全程优化稳定，在五个数学推理基准上达到全精度性能，且相比BF16实现至多2.3倍的rollout吞吐提升。
AI.conclusion: 方向感知的分段级诊断与有界修复可有效缓解低精度执行中learner-sampler不匹配带来的优化不稳定，在保持原生NVFP4 W4A4执行的同时兼顾性能与效率。

title: Skillful Data-Driven Subseasonal Soil Moisture Forecasting: Prospects and Limits for Flash Drought Prediction
comment: 27 pages, 8 figures, 5 tables. Accepted for publication in npj Hydrosphere. Supplementary information available with the published version
summary: Despite substantial progress in short-to-medium-range weather forecasting, predicting high-impact events such as flash droughts remains a key challenge for both early warning operations and physically-based subseasonal-to-seasonal (S2S) prediction systems. Here we demonstrate that, for S2S soil-moisture forecasting over Europe, forecast skill depends as much on how the prediction problem is formulated as on the forecasting model itself. Using a Vision Transformer-based architecture with dual-pathway temporal and spatial attention, we show that residual learning is essential to outperform persistence. This advantage is realized only when forecasting root-zone soil moisture in physical units rather than standardized anomalies, revealing that the target representation itself constrains predictability. A probabilistic extension via quantile-head fine-tuning further provides well-calibrated predictive distributions. Benchmarked against deep-learning and operational ECMWF S2S baselines over 2021-2022, our model achieves the highest deterministic and probabilistic skill at all lead times and reliably detects anomalously dry root-zone states (below the 20th percentile). Yet flash drought onset, defined by multi-pentad intensification criteria, remains a fundamental challenge shared across all current S2S systems. These findings advance data-driven S2S soil-moisture forecasting while highlighting the remaining challenge of predicting rapid drought development.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出基于Vision Transformer双路径时空注意力的S2S土壤湿度预报模型，发现预报技巧高度依赖问题建模方式（残差学习、物理单位目标、分位数概率化），在欧洲根区土壤湿度上全面优于深度学习与ECMWF业务基线，但骤发干旱爆发预测仍是共性难题。
AI.motivation: 短中期天气预报已取得显著进展，但骤发干旱等高影响事件的S2S（次季节至季节）预报仍是早期预警业务和物理模式系统的核心挑战；作者试图探究S2S土壤湿度预报技巧究竟受模型能力限制，还是更受预测问题本身表述方式的约束。
AI.method: 采用基于Vision Transformer的架构，结合时间与空间双路径注意力机制；引入残差学习以超越持续性（persistence）基准；将预报目标设为物理单位下的根区土壤湿度而非标准化异常；并通过分位数头（quantile-head）微调实现概率化扩展，输出校准良好的预测分布；以深度学习模型与ECMWF业务S2S系统作为基线，在2021—2022年欧洲区域进行对比评估。
AI.result: 在2021—2022年评估期内，模型在所有预报时效上取得最高的确定性技巧与概率技巧，并能可靠识别根区异常干燥状态（低于第20百分位）；残差学习对超越持续性基准不可或缺，且其优势仅在预报物理单位根区土壤湿度时才能体现；概率化扩展提供了校准良好的预测分布。
AI.conclusion: 预报技巧既取决于预报模型本身，也同等取决于预测问题的表述方式，目标表示形式本身构成可预报性的约束；然而，按多候（multi-pentad）强化标准定义的骤发干旱爆发，仍是当前所有S2S系统共同面临的根本性挑战。研究推进了数据驱动的S2S土壤湿度预报，同时凸显快速干旱发展预测的遗留难题。

title: What Must Replay Preserve? Separating Correctable Bias from Class Correspondence
summary: Class-incremental learning must recognize all classes seen so far without task labels. Logit replay methods such as DER and DER++ mitigate forgetting by matching the model's past predictions on stored examples. Deleting this matching reveals its benefit, but the resulting accuracy cost cannot show whether the stored scores themselves are needed, or whether the cost survives correction of the classifier's bias toward recent classes. We propose a diagnostic framework that treats a cached prediction as temporally heterogeneous supervision: it separates classes known when an example was stored from classes learned afterward, edits each group, and evaluates every model before and after a task-level offset that leaves within-task predictions unchanged. On CIFAR-100 with DER++, suitable fixed constants replace the unrefreshed stored scores of later-learned classes within an equivalence margin of 1 percentage point, and the offset reduces the cost of deleting their matching from 14.9 to 1.8 points. Reassigning the non-gold scores of classes known at storage, which preserves their values and each task's target probability, costs 4.3 points before and 4.0 after the offset, and a parallel cost persists in image distillation. In the tested fixed-head setting, the large cost of deleting later-class matching is thus mostly correctable by this offset, whereas the smaller cost of disrupting class correspondence persists. Code and data are available at anonymous.4open.science/r/replay-preserve-E22B.

AI.tldr: 提出诊断框架检验logit replay中存储分数是否真正必要：在CIFAR-100与DER++上，后续类存储分数可被固定常数在1个百分点等价范围内替代，且任务级offset将删除匹配的代价从14.9降至1.8个百分点；而破坏存储时已知类的类对应关系代价4.3/4.0个百分点，持续存在。
AI.motivation: logit replay方法（如DER、DER++）通过匹配模型对存储样本的过往预测来缓解遗忘。仅删除该匹配虽能观察其收益，但无法区分：精度损失究竟源于"存储分数本身必要"，还是源于分类器对近期类的偏置；即删除后的代价是否只是分类器偏置造成的、可通过校正消除。
AI.method: 提出诊断框架，将缓存预测视为"时间异质监督"：1) 按时序将类别分组——样本存储时已学的类 vs 之后学到的类；2) 分别编辑两组分数；3) 在任务级offset前后各评估一次模型，该offset不改变任务内预测（仅调整任务间偏置）。
AI.result: CIFAR-100 + DER++：用合适固定常数替代后学类的未刷新存储分数，与原始效果在1个百分点等价范围内；任务级offset将删除这些匹配的代价从14.9个百分点降至1.8个百分点。重分配存储时已知类的非gold分数（保持其数值与各任务目标概率）代价为offset前4.3、offset后4.0个百分点，且在图像蒸馏中同样存在类似代价。
AI.conclusion: 在固定分类头设定下，删除后学类匹配的大部分代价可由任务级offset校正，说明存储分数本身并非关键；而破坏存储时已知类的类对应关系所带来较小但持续的代价无法被该offset消除。代码与数据已开源。

title: Few-Shot Bioactivity Prediction with Meta-Learning under Assay Heterogeneity
summary: Accurate bioactivity prediction is a central challenge in early-stage drug discovery, as individual assays often contain too few measurements to train reliable models independently. Meta-learning offers a principled approach to this few-shot setting, but assay heterogeneity may limit its effectiveness. Here, we test this hypothesis and show that meta-learning performance degrades as meta-training tasks become more heterogeneous. To address this, we introduce MetaHeta, a meta-learning framework that accounts for assay heterogeneity by conditioning predictions on auxiliary data from related assays, with relatedness defined flexibly from available assay information. The architecture of MetaHeta combines linear attention over large auxiliary datasets with exact attention over scarce task-specific context, enabling efficient scaling to the former without compromising exact attention over the latter. We demonstrate the benefits of our approach on assays from ChEMBL and BindingDB, improving few-shot bioactivity prediction and downstream compound prioritization in retrospective Bayesian optimization.

AI.tldr: 论文提出MetaHeta元学习框架，通过基于相关测定辅助数据条件化预测来应对测定异质性，结合线性注意力与精确注意力，提升少样本生物活性预测及化合物优先级排序。
AI.motivation: 早期药物发现中生物活性预测面临单次测定数据过少、难以独立训练可靠模型的问题。元学习适用于此类少样本场景，但测定异质性可能限制其效果。作者旨在验证该假设并加以解决。
AI.method: 提出MetaHeta框架，通过基于相关测定的辅助数据条件化预测来显式建模测定异质性，相关性依据可用测定信息灵活定义。架构上结合对大规模辅助数据集的线性注意力与对稀缺任务特定上下文的精确注意力，从而在后者保持精确注意力的同时高效扩展前者。
AI.result: 在ChEMBL和BindingDB的测定数据上验证，方法提升了少样本生物活性预测性能，并改善了回顾性贝叶斯优化中的下游化合物优先级排序；同时实证元学习性能随元训练任务异质性增加而下降。
AI.conclusion: 测定异质性是制约元学习效果的关键因素，通过条件化于相关测定辅助数据可有效缓解该问题，MetaHeta在少样本生物活性预测与化合物优选任务中均展现出优势。

title: When Attention Does Not Explain the Peak: Temporal Reference vs. Forecast Output in Attention-Based Time-Series Forecasting
comment: NeurIPS 2026: Accepted to the TAE (Trust-AI-Eval) Workshop
summary: Attention maps are often interpreted as evidence of what a forecasting model uses when making predictions. In our load-forecasting model, a CLS representation of historical demand queries 24 future exogenous horizon tokens through cross-attention, inviting a temporal interpretation in which highly attended horizons may appear to explain forecast peak timing. We test this interpretation using a horizon-level attention descriptor, $Ψ_{\mathrm{out}}$. Across 31 day-aligned windows of the Panama load dataset, the forecast achieves a median peak-time error of 0 h and a 51.6% exact-match rate, whereas the argmax of $Ψ_{\mathrm{out}}$ has a median error of 5 h and 0% exact match. The forecast peak is closer to the observed peak in 27 of 31 windows. This dissociation is not merely an argmax artifact: within $\pm1$ h, attention reaches only $1.16\times$, $1.11\times$, and $1.14\times$ the uniform baseline around observed, predicted, and weekly-naive peaks, respectively, indicating weak and non-selective concentration. Yet the attention profile is structured, with cross-window consistency of 0.83. Replacing 12 future weather features with their training-set means makes the profile nearly uniform, showing sensitivity to future weather variation rather than fixed horizon position alone. The dissociation is also reproduced across three random-seed runs. These results show that structured, input-sensitive, and reproducible horizon-level cross-attention need not provide a valid peak-selective explanation of forecast behavior. The observed behavior is instead consistent with an internal horizon-reference role for integrating future exogenous information, although this functional role is not causally established.

AI.tldr: 该论文通过 horizon-level 注意力描述子 Ψ_out 检验负荷预测模型中跨注意力图的可解释性：预测峰值时刻准确（中位误差 0 h，51.6% 精确匹配），但注意力 argmax 峰值时刻中位误差 5 h、精确匹配率 0%，表明结构化、输入敏感且可复现的注意力并不构成对预测峰值时机的有效选择性解释。
AI.motivation: 注意力图常被直接解读为模型做预测时所依赖的证据。针对负荷预测模型中 CLS 表示通过跨注意力查询 24 个未来外生 horizon token 的结构，一种自然的时间性解释是：被高关注的 horizon 可能解释了预测峰值的时机。作者旨在检验这一解释是否成立，即高度关注的时间点是否真正对应预测峰值出现的时间。
AI.method: 提出 horizon-level 注意力描述子 Ψ_out，并在 Panama 负荷数据集的 31 个 day-aligned 窗口上进行实验。对比指标包括预测的中位峰值时间误差与精确匹配率、Ψ_out argmax 的中位误差与精确匹配率，以及预测峰值与观测峰值的接近程度。进一步考察注意力在观测峰值、预测峰值和 weekly-naive 峰值附近 ±1 h 内相对均匀基线的倍数，测量跨窗口一致性，并做消融：将 12 个未来天气特征替换为训练集均值以检验注意力对未来天气变化的敏感性；同时在三个随机种子运行下重复实验。
AI.result: 预测中位峰值时间误差为 0 h，精确匹配率 51.6%；而 Ψ_out argmax 中位误差 5 h，精确匹配率 0%。31 个窗口中 27 个窗口的预测峰值更接近观测峰值。该解离并非 argmax 伪影：在 ±1 h 内，注意力仅为均匀基线的 1.16×、1.11×、1.14×（分别对应观测峰值、预测峰值、weekly-naive 峰值），说明其集中度弱且非选择性。注意力轮廓本身具有结构，跨窗口一致性为 0.83；将 12 个未来天气特征替换为训练集均值后轮廓近乎均匀，说明其对未来天气变化敏感，而非仅由固定 horizon 位置决定。解离现象在三个随机种子运行中均可复现。
AI.conclusion: 结构化、输入敏感且可复现的 horizon-level 跨注意力并不必然提供对预测行为（峰值选择性）的有效解释。观测到的行为更符合一种“内部 horizon 参考”作用，用于整合未来外生信息；但该功能角色并未被因果性地确立。

title: SchemaFill: Efficient LLM Tool Calling via Slot-Parallel Speculative Decoding
summary: LLM agents interact with external systems by generating structured tool calls. Given a user request, conversational context, and a catalog of tool schemas, a tool-calling model must select tools and generate their arguments, potentially producing multiple calls in a single response. Standard autoregressive decoding generates these calls token by token, incurring substantial latency for requests involving multiple calls or many argument fields. The explicit argument structure offers opportunities for parallel generation, but later argument values may depend on preceding fields and calls, so independently generated values can differ from the target model's output. We present SchemaFill, a framework for efficient LLM tool calling through slot-parallel speculative decoding. SchemaFill generates future slot values concurrently as candidates, without requiring advance knowledge of the actual call sequence or argument values. Candidates spanning multiple fields and calls are concatenated for verification by the target model under the actual output prefix. Only verified tokens are committed, and the target supplies corrections when candidates disagree. This applies target verification while exploiting parallelism across slots and calls. On Glaive and BFCL, SchemaFill achieves up to a 4.05$\times$ improvement in end-to-end throughput over autoregressive decoding. Code is available at https://github.com/Czzzk/SchemaFill.

AI.tldr: 提出 SchemaFill 框架，通过槽位并行推测解码加速 LLM 工具调用的结构化生成，端到端吞吐最高提升 4.05×。
AI.motivation: LLM agent 通过生成结构化工具调用来与外部系统交互。面对多调用或多参数请求时，标准自回归逐 token 解码延迟很高。虽然参数结构为并行生成提供了机会，但后续参数值可能依赖前面的字段和调用，独立生成的值会与目标模型输出不一致，因此难以直接并行。
AI.method: SchemaFill 采用槽位并行推测解码：并发地生成未来槽位值作为候选，无需预先知道实际的调用序列或参数值；将跨多个字段和调用的候选拼接后，在目标模型真实输出前缀下进行验证；仅提交通过验证的 token，当候选与目标不一致时由目标模型提供修正。该方法在槽位和调用层面同时利用并行性，并施加目标模型验证。
AI.result: 在 Glaive 和 BFCL 数据集上，SchemaFill 相比自回归解码端到端吞吐最高提升 4.05×。代码已开源于 https://github.com/Czzzk/SchemaFill。
AI.conclusion: 通过将推测解码与结构化工具调用的槽位并行性结合，SchemaFill 在保证与目标模型输出一致（经目标验证）的前提下显著降低了工具调用的解码延迟，为高效 LLM agent 工具调用提供了可行方案。

title: Muon Is Theoretically Wrong For Convolutions, But Empirically Effective
summary: Muon, an optimizer known for its efficiency, has a clear interpretation for matrix-valued updates, but convolutional kernels are stored as four-dimensional tensors. Standard implementations reshape these tensors into matrices, a shortcut which breaks the theoretical understanding behind Muon. To investigate this, we formalize the corresponding optimization objective directly in convolutional operator geometry and introduce Convolutional Newton-Schulz (Conv-NS), which approximates the polar factor in this geometry while preserving kernel support. When applied in fast training experiments, Conv-NS and reshape-based Muon are both computationally efficient and achieve comparable accuracy on CIFAR-10 and ImageNet classification tasks. However, as one could expect a theoretically aligned Conv-NS to outperform reshape-based Muon, we investigate this mismatch between practice and theoretical understanding, with the hypothesis that exact convolutional orthogonalization may overconstrain updates. These findings highlight Muon's strong practical performance while opening directions for its further development on convolutions. Our code is publicly available at \href{https://github.com/thib-s/muonconv-cifar10-airbench}{github conv-muon}.

AI.tldr: 该文研究Muon优化器在卷积核上的理论解释问题，提出直接在卷积算子几何中形式化优化目标并设计Conv-NS方法，实验发现其与reshape版Muon精度相当，进而探讨理论与实践不匹配的原因。
AI.motivation: Muon优化器对矩阵型更新有清晰的理论解释，但卷积核以四维张量存储，标准实现将其reshape为矩阵，这一捷径破坏了Muon背后的理论理解。作者希望厘清卷积场景下Muon的正确理论形式。
AI.method: 在卷积算子几何中直接形式化对应的优化目标，提出Convolutional Newton-Schulz（Conv-NS），在该几何下逼近极因子（polar factor），同时保持卷积核的支撑集（kernel support）。
AI.result: 在快速训练实验中，Conv-NS与基于reshape的Muon均计算高效，并在CIFAR-10和ImageNet分类任务上取得相当的精度。
AI.conclusion: 尽管理论上对齐的Conv-NS本应优于reshape版Muon，实验结果却显示两者相当，作者假设精确的卷积正交化可能过度约束了更新。这些发现凸显了Muon的强实践性能，并为其在卷积上的进一步发展开辟了方向。

title: LiLib: Lifelong Air-to-Ground Path-Loss Prediction on UAVs via a Drift-Triggered Model Library
summary: UAVs that act as relays or base stations need accurate air-to-ground path-loss predictions for rate adaptation and placement, but propagation conditions change as a UAV moves between suburban, urban and high-rise areas, and the same areas are often revisited. Online regressors that adapt by forgetting must relearn each environment from scratch, whereas a single model trained on all data averages incompatible regimes. We propose LiLib, a lightweight continual-learning scheme in which a UAV maintains a small library of recursive-least-squares experts. A windowed residual test detects drift; a short probe phase then either reuses the best stored expert or creates a new one. In simulations based on four standard urbanization profiles, LiLib reduces prediction RMSE from 5.89 dB (best sliding-window baseline) to 4.03 dB (p < 0.001), lowers the error shortly after a return to a known environment from 12.3 dB to 5.7 dB, and recovers 99% of the throughput of a regime-aware oracle in rate adaptation. The library stores four experts in under 0.5 KB, and identifies regimes with 92% purity without labels. When a second UAV is initialized with the library of a peer, its error after environment changes halves. LiLib does not reach the oracle, and similar regimes may be merged when shadowing is strong. The results indicate that, for recurring drift, remembering is more effective than re-adapting.

AI.tldr: 提出LiLib：无人机用小型递归最小二乘专家库做持续学习，通过窗口残差检验检测漂移，并复用或新建专家，在重复经历的环境中比遗忘式在线回归更有效。
AI.motivation: 无人机作为中继或基站需要准确的空对地路径损耗预测以进行速率自适应和部署；但当无人机在郊区、城区和高层区域间移动且反复回访同一区域时，传播条件会变化。遗忘式在线回归器每次都要从头重学环境，而单一全数据模型会平均掉不兼容的传播机制，因此需要兼顾记忆与适应的轻量持续学习方案。
AI.method: LiLib维护一个由少量递归最小二乘专家组成的小型库；用窗口残差检验检测漂移，触发短暂探测阶段，然后复用库中最佳专家或创建新专家。实验基于四种标准城市化剖面进行仿真，并与滑动窗口基线及机制感知oracle比较，评估RMSE、回访已知环境后的误差、速率自适应吞吐量、库大小、无标签机制识别纯度以及同伴库初始化效果。
AI.result: 预测RMSE从最佳滑动窗口基线的5.89 dB降至4.03 dB（p < 0.001）；回到已知环境后不久误差从12.3 dB降至5.7 dB；在速率自适应中恢复机制感知oracle 99%的吞吐量；库仅存4个专家且小于0.5 KB；无标签机制识别纯度92%；第二架无人机用同伴库初始化后，环境变化后的误差减半。局限是未达到oracle，且阴影强时相似机制可能被合并。
AI.conclusion: 对于反复出现的漂移，记住已有传播机制比重新适应更有效；LiLib以极小的存储开销显著提升无人机空对地路径损耗预测与速率自适应性能，但仍未完全达到oracle水平。

title: Will the Judge Flip? Predicting Position-Sensitive LLM Judgments from Residual Stream Activations
comment: It was submitted to neurips workshop (JUDGE workshop) and received a review score 6.5 combined with one strong accept and one above threshold accept
summary: The order in which candidate responses are presented can change an LLM judge's verdict. Detecting such a position flip ordinarily requires judging each pair in both orders, which doubles the number of judgments. We investigate whether residual stream activations recorded immediately before the initial verdict can predict a flip. We use nested grouped cross-validation to evaluate regularized linear probes on 534 JudgeBench pairs for three Qwen3 judges and Llama-3.1-8B. The linear probes achieve AUROCs of .621-.850 and outperform a combined baseline that uses verbalized confidence, verdict-label logits, response lengths, and the judge's initial choice by .062-.113 AUROC. Linear probes trained on JudgeBench and then frozen achieve AUROCs of .685-.853 on 1,802 MT-Bench comparisons without MT-Bench fitting or recalibration. These results show that pre-verdict activations support prediction of susceptibility to candidate order and outperform the non-activation predictors evaluated here.

AI.tldr: 研究利用LLM评审做出初次裁决前的残差流激活，通过线性探针预测其是否容易因候选答案顺序改变而发生"位置翻转"，在JudgeBench和MT-Bench上均优于非激活基线。
AI.motivation: LLM评审（LLM judge）的裁决会受候选回答呈现顺序影响，产生"位置翻转"（position flip）。常规检测方法需对每对回答以两种顺序各评一次，使评判次数翻倍。作者希望探索是否能在不进行二次评判的前提下，仅凭初次裁决前的内部激活提前预测翻转风险，从而降低检测成本。
AI.method: 在534个JudgeBench配对样本上，对三个Qwen3评审模型及Llama-3.1-8B，记录做出初次裁决前的残差流激活，采用嵌套分组交叉验证（nested grouped cross-validation）评估正则化线性探针。以AUROC为指标，并将探针与一个综合非激活基线比较，基线特征包括言语化置信度、裁决标签logits、回答长度及评审的初次选择。还检验了跨数据集泛化：在JudgeBench上训练并冻结的探针直接用于1,802个MT-Bench比较，不进行MT-Bench拟合或重校准。
AI.result: 线性探针达到AUROC 0.621–0.850，比综合非激活基线高0.062–0.113 AUROC；在JudgeBench上训练后冻结，迁移到MT-Bench时仍达AUROC 0.685–0.853，无需再拟合或重校准。
AI.conclusion: 裁决前的残差流激活蕴含候选顺序易感性的可预测信号，其预测能力优于所评估的非激活类预测因子，表明可通过内部激活在单次评判后即估计翻转风险，避免成对双向评判带来的双倍开销。

title: SoloQ: Calibration-Free Quantization for Diffusion Language Models
summary: Diffusion large language models dLLMs) have emerged as a promising alternative to autoregressive language models through bidirectional diffusion-based token generation. However, their growing model sizes and high inference costs make efficient deployment challenging: full-sequence denoising repeatedly invokes compute-intensive forward passes, while block-diffusion models additionally introduce a memory-intensive KV-cache. Low-bit weight-activation quantization is therefore attractive, yet existing dLLM post-training quantization methods rely on calibration data despite activation distributions shifting across masking states and denoising steps. We present SoloQ, a calibration-free quantization framework that maps weights and activations into a normalized rotated basis with a predictable marginal distribution, enabling data-independent quantization. SoloQ combines a structured K-RPBH rotation with a lightweight rescaling correction for calibration-free quantization. Its predictable post-rotation distribution supports both distribution-matched codebooks and hardware-native NVFP4. For block-diffusion models, SoloQ further applies commit-time KV-cache quantization to compress persistent states without perturbing the actively denoised block. Across full-sequence dLLMs (LLaDA and Dream) and block-diffusion dLLMs(Fast-dLLM v2 and Nemotron-Labs-Diffusion), SoloQ retains accuracy under 4-bit quantization and outperforms calibration-based baselines on knowledge- and reasoning-intensive benchmarks. With NVFP4, SoloQ reduces peak memory by up to 2.61X and accelerates end-to-end inference by up to 2.24X.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 SoloQ，一种无需校准数据的扩散大语言模型（dLLM）低比特量化框架，通过可预测边缘分布的旋转基与提交时 KV-cache 量化，在 4-bit 下保持精度并显著降低内存与推理开销。
AI.motivation: 扩散大语言模型（dLLM）通过双向扩散生成 token，但模型规模增大与推理成本高导致部署困难：全序列去噪反复调用计算密集的前向传播，块扩散模型还引入内存密集的 KV-cache。低比特权重-激活量化虽有吸引力，但现有 dLLM 训练后量化方法依赖校准数据，而激活分布会随掩码状态和去噪步变化而漂移，导致校准不可靠。
AI.method: SoloQ 是无校准量化框架，将权重和激活映射到具有可预测边缘分布的归一化旋转基，从而实现数据无关量化。具体结合结构化 K-RPBH 旋转与轻量重缩放校正。旋转后分布可预测，支持分布匹配码本与硬件原生 NVFP4。针对块扩散模型，进一步采用提交时（commit-time）KV-cache 量化，压缩持久状态而不扰动正在去噪的活跃块。
AI.result: 在全序列 dLLM（LLaDA、Dream）与块扩散 dLLM（Fast-dLLM v2、Nemotron-Labs-Diffusion）上，SoloQ 在 4-bit 量化下保持精度，并在知识密集与推理密集基准上优于基于校准的基线。使用 NVFP4 时，峰值内存最多降低 2.61 倍，端到端推理最多加速 2.24 倍。
AI.conclusion: SoloQ 通过可预测旋转分布实现无校准量化，避免了 dLLM 激活漂移带来的校准依赖问题，并兼容 NVFP4 与块扩散 KV-cache 压缩，在多种 dLLM 架构上兼顾精度与部署效率。

title: The Implicit Bias of Hyperbolic Representation Learning for Multiclass Data: A Busemann Risk Perspective
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026 as a Spotlight
summary: We study the implicit bias of Riemannian gradient flow for hyperbolic multiclass classification with fixed class prototypes in hyperbolic space $\mathbb{H}^n$. Our framework accommodates general permutation invariant relative margin (PERM) losses, a class that includes cross entropy and other standard multiclass losses. Our analysis is based on a decomposition: at large radius, the distance to each prototype splits into a radial term and a direction-dependent term described by the Busemann function. This yields two main results. First, we prove a radial dichotomy: the sign of a drift coefficient $μ$ determines whether the radius is pushed toward the ideal boundary or back toward the interior; if the positive drift persists, then $r(t)=\frac{1}{2}\log t+O(1)$, while persistent negative drift returns the trajectory to the large-radius threshold in finite time. Second, we show that the boundary direction converges to a critical point of the Busemann risk on $\partial\mathbb{H}^n$. These results provide a rigorous asymptotic perspective on two phenomena we refer to as boundary saturation and near-boundary clustering in hyperbolic representation learning.

AI.tldr: 本文研究双曲空间 $\mathbb{H}^n$ 中固定类原型的多分类问题，分析黎曼梯度流的隐式偏置，利用 Busemann 函数分解距离，证明了半径的对偶二分性与边界方向收敛到 Busemann 风险的临界点。
AI.motivation: 双曲表示学习中出现边界饱和与近边界聚类现象，但缺乏严格的渐近理论解释；现有隐式偏置分析多针对欧氏空间，需推广到双曲流形上的多分类设定。
AI.method: 以固定类原型、一般置换不变相对间隔（PERM）损失（含交叉熵等）为框架；在大半径下将到各原型的距离分解为径向项与由 Busemann 函数刻画的方 向相关项，据此分析黎曼梯度流的渐近行为。
AI.result: 证明径向二分性：漂移系数 $\mu$ 的符号决定半径被推向理想边界还是返回内部；若正漂移持续则 $r(t)=\frac{1}{2}\log t+O(1)$，若负漂移持续则轨迹在有限时间内回到大半径阈值。进一步证明边界方向收敛到 $\partial\mathbb{H}^n$ 上 Busemann 风险的临界点。
AI.conclusion: 为双曲表示学习中的边界饱和与近边界聚类现象提供了严格的渐近解释，刻画了 PERM 损失下黎曼梯度流的隐式偏置。

title: Adversarial Training for Deep Hedging in Nonstationary Markets
summary: Deep hedging learns trading policies from historical or simulated market trajectories, yet under nonstationarity these training paths may not represent future market conditions. We propose WRAP (Wasserstein-Reweighting Adversarial Perturbation), a drift-aware adversarial training framework derived from a two-budget distributionally robust optimization (DRO) formulation. The formulation is anchored to a weighted empirical reference distribution whose fixed baseline weights are chosen to balance sampling uncertainty against temporal drift. Around this reference distribution, the ambiguity set addresses two complementary forms of distributional misspecification by allowing an adversary to reweight the observed trajectories subject to a $φ$-divergence constraint and perturb their paths subject to an optimal-transport (OT) constraint. We derive a joint first-order expansion in which the leading-order increase over the nominal expected loss decomposes into a reweighting contribution determined by the dispersion of hedging losses across trajectories and a transport contribution determined by the sensitivity of the loss to path perturbations. This expansion yields an explicit finite-dimensional adversarial attack that replaces the distributional inner supremum with a tractable first-order approximation. Across stationary and nonstationary Heston dynamics and a generalized affine diffusion (GAD), the experiments show complementary benefits from reweighting and transport, with joint adversarial training providing the largest gains under nonstationarity.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 WRAP，一种面向深度对冲的漂移感知对抗训练框架，基于双预算 DRO 推导一阶联合展开并构造有限维对抗攻击，在非平稳市场下取得最大收益。
AI.motivation: 深度对冲从历史或模拟轨迹中学习交易策略，但在市场非平稳条件下，训练路径可能无法代表未来市场状态，导致策略泛化性差。需要一种能够同时应对采样不确定性与时间漂移、并刻画分布误设的鲁棒训练方法。
AI.method: 提出 WRAP（Wasserstein-Reweighting Adversarial Perturbation），源自双预算分布鲁棒优化（DRO）公式。以加权经验参考分布为锚点，其固定基线权重用于平衡采样不确定性与时间漂移；围绕该参考分布构建模糊集，允许对抗者在 φ-散度约束下对观测轨迹重新加权，并在最优传输（OT）约束下扰动路径，从而覆盖重加权与路径扰动两类互补的分布误设。进一步推导联合一阶展开，将名义期望损失上的增量分解为：由对冲损失跨轨迹离散度决定的重加权项，以及由损失对路径扰动敏感度决定的传输项。
AI.result: 该一阶展开给出显式的有限维对抗攻击，将分布内层上确界替换为可处理的一阶近似。在平稳与非平稳 Heston 动力学以及广义仿射扩散（GAD）实验中，重加权与传输表现出互补收益，联合对抗训练在非平稳条件下增益最大。
AI.conclusion: WRAP 通过双预算 DRO 与一阶展开，将分布鲁棒对冲转化为可计算的对抗训练，验证了重加权与传输两种机制的互补性，表明联合对抗训练是应对市场非平稳性的有效途径。

title: Exact Unlearning via Quantized Sufficient Statistics
comment: 33 pages, 20 figures, 15 tables. Accepted at NeurIPS 2026
summary: Exact unlearning requires a deployed predictor to match one rebuilt without the information named by a deletion request. Existing general-purpose exact methods localize retraining through disjoint shards, but every request still invalidates a model, and smaller shards reduce the data available to each constituent predictor. We introduce Quantized Sufficient Statistics (QSS), which separates a small frozen schema from mutable, sum-decomposable content. The schema learns global structure; the content stores local prediction corrections as additive statistics indexed by quantized regions. Deleting content is therefore exact subtraction rather than optimization. We distinguish two guarantees: QSS-L exactly removes a label while retaining the unlabelled input, whereas QSS-E exactly removes both input and label by learning the schema without deletable examples. A deletion takes the arithmetic fast path with probability $1-ρ$ and triggers a full rebuild with probability $ρ$; all reported expected latencies include both events. Across 15 vision, text, and tabular datasets at $ρ=0.5\%$, QSS-L is within 2 percentage points of SISA on 11 tasks and provides 4--483$\times$ lower expected deletion latency on the low-class-count tasks where a compact schema is effective. QSS-E quantifies the additional accuracy cost of removing every trace of an input.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 Quantized Sufficient Statistics (QSS)，通过将模型分离为冻结的全局 schema 与可变、可加性求和的 content，使删除请求成为精确的减法运算，从而实现精确 unlearning，并以概率 1-ρ 走算术快路径。
AI.motivation: 现有通用精确 unlearning 方法（如 SISA）通过不相交分片实现重训练的局部化，但每个删除请求仍会使某个模型失效，且分片越小，每个子预测器可用数据越少，导致精度与延迟之间的权衡受限。作者希望避免删除即触发优化/重训练的高成本。
AI.method: 提出 QSS，将模型分为两部分：小的冻结 schema 学习全局结构；mutable content 以量化区域为索引，存储局部预测修正的可加统计量。删除内容因而是精确的减法而非优化。区分两种保证：QSS-L 精确删除标签但保留未标注输入；QSS-E 通过学习不含可删样本的 schema 来精确删除输入与标签。删除以概率 1-ρ 走算术快路径，以概率 ρ 触发完整重建。
AI.result: 在 15 个视觉、文本与表格数据集上，ρ=0.5% 时，QSS-L 在 11 个任务上精度与 SISA 相差 2 个百分点以内，并在紧凑 schema 有效的低类别数任务上实现 4--483 倍的期望删除延迟降低。QSS-E 量化了彻底移除输入痕迹所带来的额外精度代价。所有报告的期望延迟均包含快路径与重建两种事件。
AI.conclusion: QSS 通过 schema-content 分离与可加统计量实现精确删除的算术化，在低类别数任务上显著降低期望删除延迟且精度接近 SISA；QSS-E 进一步揭示了彻底删除输入痕迹的精度成本，为精确 unlearning 提供了新的延迟-精度权衡路径。

title: Distributionally Robust Mixture-of-Experts Training
summary: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) transformers scale capacity by activating only a few experts per token, but this sparsity creates a hidden reliability problem: when routing is imperfect, load-balanced models may send tokens to experts that are insufficiently trained for the assigned inputs. We propose Distributionally Robust MoE Training (DRMoET), a drop-in objective that treats layer-wise experts as endogenous robustness groups and optimizes high-loss routing outcomes rather than merely equalizing traffic. DRMoET updates a per-layer expert distribution by an entropy-regularized softmax rule on EMA-smoothed, activation-weighted expert losses, strengthening plausible non-top routing paths while preserving standard MoE computation. Under the FLAME-MoE recipe at 746M-total and 10.3B-total scales, DRMoET improves downstream averages over both standard FLAME-MoE and auxiliary-loss-free balancing. At 10.3B total parameters and 67B training tokens, DRMoET improves the seven-task average from 0.6625 to 0.6767, while the auxiliary-loss-free baseline achieves 0.6431. Mechanistic analyses show lower expert-loss variance with nearly unchanged mean loss, 4.3% lower excess loss under forced mid-$k$ misrouting, and improved domain-expert specialization. These results position routing robustness-not only utilization balance-as a practical objective for reliable sparse MoE scaling. Project page and code are available at: https://drmoet.github.io/.

AI.tldr: DRMoET将逐层专家视为内生鲁棒性分组，通过对EMA平滑、激活加权的专家损失施加熵正则softmax更新，优化高损失路由结果而非仅均衡流量，在FLAME-MoE配方下提升下游任务表现与路由鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: MoE Transformer通过每token激活少量专家实现容量扩展，但这种稀疏性带来隐藏的可靠性问题：当路由不完美时，负载均衡的模型可能将token分配给对相应输入训练不足的专家。现有方法多关注流量均衡或利用率，而未将路由鲁棒性作为优化目标。
AI.method: 提出Distributionally Robust MoE Training（DRMoET），一种即插即用目标：将逐层专家视为内生鲁棒性分组，优化高损失路由结果；通过熵正则化softmax规则在EMA平滑、激活加权的专家损失上更新每层专家分布，强化合理的非top路由路径，同时保持标准MoE计算不变。
AI.result: 在FLAME-MoE配方下，746M总参数与10.3B总参数规模均优于标准FLAME-MoE与无辅助损失均衡基线。10.3B总参数、67B训练token时，七任务平均从0.6625提升至0.6767，无辅助损失基线为0.6431。机制分析显示专家损失方差降低而均值几乎不变，强制mid-k误路由下超额损失降低4.3%，域-专家特化改善。
AI.conclusion: 路由鲁棒性——而不仅是利用率均衡——可作为可靠稀疏MoE扩展的实用优化目标。项目页面与代码见https://drmoet.github.io/。

title: Can LLM-assisted regularization increase forecast accuracy for migration flows in low data regimes?
summary: Predicting migration flows remains a significant challenge for traditional gravity-based forecasting models, which primarily rely on structured socio-economic indicators such as economic disparity, political stability, and geographic distance. This work investigates whether Large Language Models (LLMs) can improve migration forecasting by extracting contextual migration-related signals from news articles and incorporating them into a weighted Lasso forecasting framework through feature-specific regularization penalties. The proposed framework uses hierarchical LLM inference pipelines to classify migration-related push--pull signals from news data and evaluates the resulting forecasting performance across multiple migration corridors between November 2021 and November 2022, including Mexico--United States, Ukraine--Poland, and Syria--Turkey. Experimental results showed mixed performance across migration corridors and modeling strategies, and no single regularization approach consistently outperformed the others across all experiments. The best-performing Mexico configuration, which consisted of a gravity-based model augmented with the proposed push--pull ratios, achieved a Mean Absolute Percentage Error (MAPE) of 17.15%, while the strongest Syria configuration achieved a MAPE of 29.29% using Direct LLM-Lasso. For Ukraine, the best-performing configuration used LLM-Assisted Regularization (AR) and achieved a MAPE of 41.05%. Overall, the results suggest that contextual article-derived features and LLM-guided regularization can improve migration forecasting under certain conditions, although migration corridor characteristics, article volume, and hyperparameter configuration strongly influenced performance.

AI.tldr: 该研究探索用大语言模型从新闻中提取推拉信号，并以特征特定正则化融入加权Lasso预测迁移流，结果因走廊而异。
AI.motivation: 传统重力模型预测迁移流主要依赖经济差距、政治稳定性和地理距离等结构化社会经济指标，难以捕捉新闻等非结构化情境信号，因此作者希望验证LLM能否提升迁移预测能力。
AI.method: 提出以分层LLM推理管线对新闻中的迁移推拉信号进行分类，并将这些情境特征通过特征特定正则化惩罚融入加权Lasso预测框架；在2021年11月至2022年11月的墨西哥—美国、乌克兰—波兰、叙利亚—土耳其等多条迁移走廊上评估性能。
AI.result: 不同走廊和建模策略表现不一，无单一正则化方法在各实验中最优。墨西哥最佳配置为重力模型叠加推拉比值，MAPE为17.15%；叙利亚最佳为Direct LLM-Lasso，MAPE为29.29%；乌克兰最佳为LLM-Assisted Regularization（AR），MAPE为41.05%。
AI.conclusion: 文章派生的情境特征与LLM引导正则化在特定条件下可改善迁移预测，但迁移走廊特征、文章数量和超参数配置对性能影响显著。

title: Reward-Driven Learning under Prompt-Level Differential Privacy
summary: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) trains a language model on problems that may themselves be confidential, and the trained model can reveal which problems it saw. We study RLVR under prompt-level differential privacy: the released weights must be (ε,δ)-differentially private with respect to the presence of any one training problem. Taking the group of responses to one prompt as the privacy record, our method aggregates their gradients, clips the prompt's contribution once, adds Gaussian noise, and composes the privacy loss across updates, so the budget depends on neither the number of responses per prompt nor the clipping norm; to our knowledge this is the first differential privacy guarantee for RLVR training. We train Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct with LoRA at a per-run budget of ε=8 and compare, on the same prompts and at the same budget, a control that removes only the reward signal and two private supervised fine-tuning recipes. The reward signal improves accuracy over the control by 2.65 points on MATH and 3.24 on GSM8K, in every seed; the improvement survives a format-robust scorer, at 1.3 points on MATH, and is not explained by response length. At the same budget the private model outperforms both supervised recipes on MATH and GSM8K by 2.3 to 3.8 points, retains 85--90% of the gain of non-private GRPO on these tasks, and on MATH the noise of an eightfold tighter budget costs at most 1.2 points. The reward effect also carries to CommonsenseQA, an exploratory non-mathematical task. Verifier feedback thus remains a usable learning signal under prompt-level privacy.

AI.tldr: 本文首次为可验证奖励强化学习（RLVR）提供提示级差分隐私保证：将单个提示的全部响应作为隐私记录，聚合其梯度、对提示贡献仅裁剪一次并加高斯噪声，隐私预算与响应数及裁剪范数无关。在ε=8下训练Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct（LoRA），奖励信号仍带来显著且稳健的性能提升。
AI.motivation: RLVR在可能涉密的题目上训练语言模型，训练后的权重会泄漏模型见过的题目，存在隐私风险。然而现有工作缺乏针对RLVR训练的差分隐私保证。
AI.method: 在提示级差分隐私下训练：以单个提示的全部响应为隐私记录，先聚合这些响应的梯度，对提示的贡献只裁剪一次，再加入高斯噪声，并在各次更新间组合隐私损失。使用LoRA在ε=8预算下训练Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct，并设置仅去除奖励信号的对照组及两种隐私监督微调（SFT）配方进行对比。
AI.result: 奖励信号相比对照组在MATH上提升2.65分、GSM8K上提升3.24分，且在全部随机种子中一致；经格式鲁棒评分器后仍提升1.3分（MATH），且不能由响应长度解释。相同预算下，隐私模型在MATH与GSM8K上优于两种监督配方2.3至3.8分，保留非隐私GRPO增益的85%–90%；MATH上预算收紧八倍的噪声代价至多1.2分。奖励效应还能迁移到CommonsenseQA这一探索性非数学任务。
AI.conclusion: 在提示级隐私约束下，验证器反馈仍是可用且有效的学习信号，RLVR可以在提供差分隐私保证的同时保持大部分性能增益。

title: Constant-Curvature Sliced Gromov-Wasserstein for Heterogeneous Cross-Curvature Alignment
summary: Recent advances in representation learning have highlighted the utility of constant-curvature models, such as hyperbolic and spherical spaces, for modeling complex data. Mixed-curvature models further enhance this by integrating multiple constant-curvature components. However, these models typically learn each component space independently because spaces with different curvatures are inherently heterogeneous and lack a unified metric. Consequently, they lack explicit mechanisms to enforce geometric consistency across various spaces. Moreover, the problem of comparing probability distributions across mixed-curvature spaces remains unexplored. To compare distributions on heterogeneous spaces, Gromov-Wasserstein (GW) distances provide a principled framework by aligning their intra-space geometries. Building on this, we propose constant-curvature sliced Gromov-Wasserstein (CCSGW), a novel divergence for aligning distributions supported on heterogeneous constant-curvature spaces. We first introduce the missing geodesic-based one-dimensional projections for spherical spaces, and then extend sliced GW to constant-curvature spaces, enabling efficient and principled comparison across manifolds with different curvatures. This formulation preserves intrinsic geometric relationships while avoiding the high computational cost. We provide theoretical analysis showing that CCSGW controls intrinsic geometric discrepancy across heterogeneous spaces, promoting distribution-level geometric consistency. By integrating CCSGW into existing mixed-curvature learning tasks, including graph anomaly detection, graph node classification, and multimodal learning, we observe consistent performance gains across diverse settings.

AI.tldr: 本文提出常曲率切片Gromov-Wasserstein（CCSGW）散度，用于对齐异构常曲率空间上的分布，弥补混合曲率模型中缺乏统一度量与分布比较机制的问题。
AI.motivation: 混合曲率模型虽整合了多类常曲率成分，但不同曲率空间本质异构且缺少统一度量，导致各成分独立学习，缺乏显式的跨空间几何一致性约束；同时跨混合曲率空间的概率分布比较问题尚未被探索。
AI.method: 基于Gromov-Wasserstein距离通过对齐空间内部几何实现异构分布比较的思想，提出CCSGW。首先补齐球面空间缺失的基于测地线的一维投影，再将切片GW（sliced GW）扩展到常曲率空间，在保持内蕴几何关系的同时实现高效的跨流形比较，并给出控制异构空间内蕴几何差异的理论分析。
AI.result: 理论分析表明CCSGW能控制异构空间间的内蕴几何差异，促进分布层面的几何一致性；将其集成到图异常检测、图节点分类和多模态学习等混合曲率学习任务中，在多种设置下均获得一致的性能提升。
AI.conclusion: CCSGW为异构常曲率空间上的分布比较提供了有原则且高效的散度工具，可增强混合曲率模型的几何一致性，并在多类下游任务中带来稳定收益。

title: Data, Numbers, and Geometry: Three Tutorials on Numerical Methods, Machine Learning, and Evaluation
comment: Combined notes from three tutorials presented at the DANGER: Data, Numbers, and Geometry workshop (BIRS, Banff, April 2026). Includes links to companion code, Jupyter notebooks, and exercises
summary: We present three practical tutorials on numerical computation and machine learning for mathematical research, developed for the DANGER: Data, Numbers, and Geometry workshop held at the Banff International Research Station in April 2026. The first develops a numerical approach to exterior calculus from pointwise evaluations of differential forms, using a flux formulation of the exterior derivative. Examples in Euclidean space and on the sphere illustrate geometric identities, topological features, and the effects of approximation and finite precision. The second examines how mathematical structure guides neural network design through examples involving elliptic curves, quivers, and a boundary value problem. It explores how architectural choices affect learning and uses interval arithmetic to bound the residual of a trained network over the full interval of the boundary value problem. The third addresses the evaluation and presentation of machine learning results, covering performance metrics, statistical uncertainty, classification thresholds, receiver operating characteristic curves, and accessible figure design. Throughout, the tutorials distinguish numerical agreement, predictive accuracy, structural guarantees, and rigorous bounds as different forms of evidence. Each contribution can be read independently, with accompanying notebooks and exercises that allow readers to reproduce the examples and adapt the methods to other problems.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍三个面向数学研究的数值计算与机器学习实践教程，涵盖外微分数值方法、数学结构引导的神经网络设计，以及机器学习结果的评估与呈现，强调区分数值一致性、预测精度、结构保证与严格界等不同证据形式。
AI.motivation: 为2026年4月Banff国际研究站举办的DANGER（数据、数值与几何）研讨会开发实用教程，弥合数值计算、机器学习与数学研究之间的方法鸿沟，帮助数学研究者掌握可复现的计算工具并正确理解不同形式的证据。
AI.method: 教程一：基于微分形式的逐点求值，采用外微分的通量（flux）表述构造外微积分的数值方法，在欧氏空间与球面上验证几何恒等式、拓扑特征及近似与有限精度的影响；教程二：通过椭圆曲线、箭图（quiver）与边值问题等示例，探讨数学结构如何指导神经网络架构设计，并用区间算术对训练网络在边值问题整个区间上的残差进行界定；教程三：讨论机器学习结果的评估与呈现，涉及性能指标、统计不确定性、分类阈值、ROC曲线与可读性图表设计。
AI.result: 三个独立可读的教程各自配有笔记本与练习，读者可复现示例并将方法迁移至其他问题；案例展示了数值方法在几何与拓扑计算中的效果，架构选择对学习性能的影响，以及区间算术能够给出训练网络的严格残差界。
AI.conclusion: 贯穿全部教程的核心在于区分数值一致性、预测精度、结构保证与严格界这四种不同形式的证据，为数学研究中的计算实践提供方法论指导。

title: Benchmarking Time Series Foundation Models for Load Forecasting Under Covariate Uncertainty
comment: 5 pages, 1 figure, 5 tables. Accepted to the 2027 IEEE PES Grid Edge Conference & Expo, Salt Lake City, UT, USA, 19-22 April 2027
summary: Accurate short-term load forecasting (STLF) is essential for the reliable and efficient operation of modern power systems. While time series foundation models (TSFMs) have recently demonstrated remarkable performance across a wide range of forecasting tasks, their effectiveness for STLF under realistic operational conditions remains largely unexplored. In this paper, we present a comprehensive benchmark of four trained-from-scratch (TFS) models and four TSFMs across three real-world load forecasting datasets under operational scenarios that differ in the availability and quality of future covariate information. Our results show that Chronos-2 consistently achieves state-of-the-art performance in both zero-shot and fine-tuned settings when future covariates are available or accurately forecast. However, its performance degrades as covariate forecasts become increasingly noisy, whereas TimesNet exhibits greater robustness under severe covariate uncertainty. These findings demonstrate the effectiveness of covariate-informed TSFMs for STLF while highlighting the critical role of robust covariate modeling in real-world forecasting applications.

AI.tldr: 本文对4个从头训练模型与4个时间序列基础模型在3个真实负荷数据集上进行系统基准测试，考察未来协变量可用性与质量对短期负荷预测的影响。
AI.motivation: 短期负荷预测对电力系统可靠高效运行至关重要；时间序列基础模型虽在广泛预测任务中表现优异，但其在真实运行条件下用于短期负荷预测的有效性尚缺乏系统评估，尤其是未来协变量信息可用性与质量变化带来的影响未被充分探讨。
AI.method: 构建包含4个从头训练(TFS)模型和4个时间序列基础模型(TSFM)的基准测试，覆盖3个真实世界负荷预测数据集，并在未来协变量信息可用性与质量不同的运行场景（协变量可用、准确预测、噪声逐渐增大等）下进行零样本与微调设置对比评估。
AI.result: 当未来协变量可用或预测准确时，Chronos-2在零样本和微调两种设置下均持续取得最优性能；随着协变量预测噪声增大，其性能下降，而TimesNet在严重协变量不确定性下表现出更强的鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 结果验证了协变量感知的时间序列基础模型在短期负荷预测中的有效性，同时凸显了在真实预测应用中稳健协变量建模的关键作用。

title: Learning What to Distill: Bilevel Top-K Token Selection for Self-Distillation in Large Language Models
summary: Large language models have shown strong reasoning capabilities, but their high inference costs make knowledge distillation an important approach for transferring such capabilities to compact models in resource-constrained scenarios. On-policy self-distillation further reduces the reliance on external large teacher models while improving the reasoning ability of compact language models. However, existing methods typically either distill all token positions uniformly or select tokens using fixed heuristic criteria, assigning the same distillation strength to the selected positions rather than adaptively learning which tokens are most beneficial for distillation. To address these limitations, we propose BiToK-SD (Bilevel Top-K Token Selection for Self-Distillation), a bilevel-optimization-based token selection method that learns where distillation should be applied during on-policy self-distillation. Specifically, BiToK-SD is formulated as a bilevel optimization problem, where the lower-level problem models Top-K token selection as a differentiable threshold-based relaxation, allowing the selected positions to adapt as the student policy evolves, while the upper-level problem performs knowledge distillation on the selected positions. Experiments on mathematical reasoning benchmarks show that BiToK-SD achieves the best average performance among all compared methods while requiring only lightweight additional computation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出BiToK-SD，一种基于双层优化的Top-K token选择方法，用于在线策略自蒸馏，自适应学习蒸馏位置，在数学推理基准上取得最佳平均性能。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型推理能力强但推理成本高，知识蒸馏可将能力迁移到紧凑模型。在线策略自蒸馏虽减少对外部大教师模型的依赖，但现有方法要么对所有token位置均匀蒸馏，要么用固定启发式标准选择token并赋予相同蒸馏强度，无法自适应学习哪些token最有益于蒸馏。
AI.method: 将BiToK-SD形式化为双层优化问题：下层问题把Top-K token选择建模为可微的基于阈值的松弛，使被选位置能随学生策略演化而自适应调整；上层问题在选定的位置上执行知识蒸馏。
AI.result: 在数学推理基准上的实验表明，BiToK-SD在所有对比方法中取得最佳平均性能，且仅需轻量的额外计算。
AI.conclusion: BiToK-SD通过双层优化自适应选择蒸馏token，克服均匀蒸馏与固定启发式选择的局限，以低成本提升紧凑语言模型的推理能力。

title: Neural Fields Encode Adaptation Geometry
comment: 24 pages, 2 figures. Extended version of work accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Symmetry and Geometry in Neural Representations (NeurReps)
summary: Neural fields are usually evaluated by how well they reconstruct an observation. We show that this misses two useful properties of a fitted network: how easily it can adapt to new observations, and what its weights retain from earlier ones. We study these properties as adaptation geometry. For images, we meta-learn class-specific initializations, adapt each one to a new image, and measure how much the network must change to fit it. A simple local linear model closely predicts this adaptation cost, while replacing one network's tangent kernel with another's substantially worsens the prediction. Adaptation thus depends on the local geometry of the fitted network, not only on its current reconstruction. For physical fields, we repeatedly fit the same network to observations from a sequence. Its weights then retain information about that history. When two wave histories end at exactly the same observation, the final weights recover the sign of the wave velocity with 68.6% accuracy, whereas the current observation alone contains no such information and gives 50%. These two phenomena are quantitatively linked: tangent-kernel eigenvalues predict both which changes are easy to learn and how quickly they are overwritten by later fitting. Together, these results show that neural fields contain useful information beyond what they currently reconstruct: in how they can change and in how they got there.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出以"适应几何"来评估神经场，超越了仅看重构质量的传统评估方式。
AI.motivation: 传统上神经场（neural fields）仅以对观测数据的重构质量来评估，但作者认为这忽略了拟合网络的两个有用性质：一是网络适应新观测的难易程度，二是网络权重对早期历史信息的保留能力。因此作者希望从"适应几何"的角度揭示神经场中超越当前重构的信息。
AI.method: 作者从两方面研究适应几何：（1）对图像任务，元学习类特定的初始化，再将每个初始化适配到新图像，测量网络拟合新图像所需改变的幅度，并用局部线性模型预测该适应代价；同时通过用另一网络的切核（tangent kernel）替换来检验预测效果。（2）对物理场任务，将同一网络反复拟合一个序列中的观测数据，使权重积累历史信息，并比较两个波历史在最终观测完全相同时权重所保留的信息。
AI.result: 在图像任务中，简单的局部线性模型能较好地预测适应代价，而用另一网络的切核替换原切核会显著降低预测精度，说明适应取决于拟合网络的局部几何而非仅当前重构。在物理场任务中，当两个波历史在最终观测上完全相同时，最终权重能以68.6%的准确率恢复波速符号，而仅凭当前观测只能达到50%（无信息）。进一步，切核特征值与两类现象量化关联：它既预测哪些改变容易学习，也预测这些改变被后续拟合覆盖的速度。
AI.conclusion: 神经场不仅包含当前重构所反映的信息，还包含关于"它如何改变"以及"它如何演变而来"的额外有用信息。适应几何为评估神经场提供了新的视角。

title: Neural Algorithmic Reasoning for Graph Saddle Point Problems
summary: Neural algorithmic reasoning, or aligning a neural network with an algorithmic paradigm, has emerged as an approach to solving polynomial-time-solvable and computationally harder combinatorial optimization problems. We propose a new message-passing framework based on the Chambolle-Pock Primal--Dual Hybrid Gradient (PDHG) method called \textsc{GraphPDHG} for solving general graph saddle-point problems. Theoretically, we show that \textsc{GraphPDHG} can efficiently solve a family of graph saddle-point problems by simulating PDHG. We also show that our network can learn an accelerated PDHG algorithm. Experimentally, we support our results on accelerated PDHG by evaluating the performance of our model as a learned warm start for second-order optimization techniques (SSNAL). We also show that alignment with PDHG leads to stronger size generalization than non-aligned graph neural network (GNN) baselines. Overall, we propose a novel architecture for solving a general family of optimization problems on graphs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 GraphPDHG，一种基于 Chambolle-Pock 原始-对偶混合梯度（PDHG）方法的图消息传递框架，用于求解一般图鞍点问题，并在理论与实验上验证其可模拟并学习加速 PDHG 算法。
AI.motivation: 神经算法推理（将神经网络与算法范式对齐）已成为求解多项式时间可解乃至计算更难组合优化问题的重要途径；本文旨在为图上的鞍点问题族提供一种具有算法对齐特性的通用求解架构。
AI.method: 提出 GraphPDHG 消息传递框架，其结构与 Chambolle-Pock 原始-对偶混合梯度（PDHG）方法对齐；通过网络模拟 PDHG 迭代过程，并可学习到加速版本的 PDHG 算法。
AI.result: 理论上证明 GraphPDHG 能通过模拟 PDHG 高效求解一类图鞍点问题，并表明该网络可学习加速 PDHG；实验上以该模型作为二阶优化方法（SSNAL）的学习式热启动（warm start）验证了加速 PDHG 的性能，且与 PDHG 的对齐相比非对齐 GNN 基线带来更强的规模泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 提出了一种求解图上一般优化问题族的新型架构，验证了算法对齐对求解效率与规模泛化的积极作用。

title: Algorithmically Aligned Neural Agglomerative Tree Construction
summary: Linkage algorithms for hierarchical clustering (HC) are a powerful and efficient framework for constructing clustering trees, yet it is often unclear which merge rule best suits a given dataset or task. In contrast, neural approaches can learn from data, but often fail to retain the efficiency and size generalization of classical algorithms. We introduce NN-linkage, a neural network (NN) model that can learn task-specific and locally dependent merge rules while retaining the recursive structure and efficient inference of classical linkage algorithms. In particular, our model is algorithmically aligned with the Lance-Williams (LW) recurrence, a parameterized framework for defining a broad, continuous family of linkage rules for agglomerative HC. Classical methods such as single linkage (SL), complete linkage (CL), and average linkage arise as discrete choices within this broader family. We show that NN-linkage is a universal approximator for continuous linkage functions, including LW recurrences, and, when paired with a transformer encoding, can also approximate globally dependent rules such as robust single-linkage.
