We further show that NN-linkage can exactly implement any symmetric constant-coefficient LW recurrence across all input sizes. On the empirical front, we evaluate NN-linkage in real-world applications, clock-tree routing and phylogenetic reconstruction, using both synthetic and real datasets, demonstrating its effectiveness over both classical algorithms and other neural approaches. By learning merge rules directly from target trees, NN-linkage extends efficient HC to scientific and engineering objectives not adequately captured by existing hand-designed linkage rules.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 NN-linkage，一种与 Lance-Williams 递推算法对齐的神经网络模型，可在保持经典层次聚类效率与规模泛化的同时，学习任务特定且局部依赖的合并规则，并在时钟树布线与系统发育重建任务上优于经典算法与其他神经方法。
AI.motivation: 经典层次聚类的各种 linkage 算法高效且可扩展，但针对具体数据集或任务难以判断哪种合并规则最合适；神经方法虽能从数据中学习，却通常牺牲了经典算法的推理效率与规模泛化能力。因此需要一种兼具两者优势的方案。
AI.method: 提出 NN-linkage：以 Lance-Williams（LW）递推为算法骨架，将其中参数化的合并规则替换为由神经网络学习的函数，从而保留凝聚式层次聚类的递归结构与高效推理。该模型可学习任务特定、局部依赖的合并规则；结合 transformer 编码后可近似全局依赖规则（如 robust single-linkage）。理论上证明 NN-linkage 是连续 linkage 函数的通用逼近器，并能精确实现任意对称常系数 LW 递推（跨所有输入规模）。在真实应用中，于时钟树布线与系统发育重建任务上，使用合成与真实数据集进行评测，并与经典算法及其他神经方法对比。
AI.result: 理论上，NN-linkage 被证明为连续 linkage 函数（含 LW 递推）的通用逼近器，结合 transformer 编码可逼近全局依赖规则（如 robust single-linkage），并能精确实现任意对称常系数 LW 递推且适用于任意输入规模。实验上，在时钟树布线和系统发育重建应用中，基于合成与真实数据集，NN-linkage 的效果优于经典算法和其他神经方法。
AI.conclusion: NN-linkage 通过直接从目标树中学习合并规则，将高效层次聚类扩展到现有手工设计 linkage 规则难以充分刻画的科学与工程目标，兼顾了经典算法的效率、规模泛化性与神经方法的从数据学习能力。

title: Lock-in EP: An In-Situ Training Algorithm for Oscillatory Hardware
summary: Analog hardware platforms offer the potential to reduce energy consumption over digital architectures, but in order to succeed, large-scale analog systems must also be able to operate with or recover from the variability of their components. Towards this goal, we derive and demonstrate the lock-in equilibrium propagation (LIEP) training method. LIEP provides local gradient information for each component in an oscillatory network without separate forward and backward sweeps, potentially allowing for in-situ learning capabilities on analog oscillatory hardware platforms. We demonstrate that LIEP can be used both for ab-initio training as well as recovering performance when pre-trained parameters are perturbed. We show that LIEP can be formulated as a three-factor update rule, and suggest that although the method is currently only validated on shallow networks, alternate architectures may allow it to extend to deep and large-scale networks addressing complex tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出并验证了锁相均衡传播（LIEP）训练方法，可为振荡网络中各元件提供局部梯度信息，无需独立的前向与反向扫描，从而支持模拟振荡硬件上的原位学习。
AI.motivation: 模拟硬件平台有望比数字架构降低能耗，但要成功应用，大规模模拟系统必须能够应对元件变异并从中恢复，因此需要适配模拟硬件的训练方法。
AI.method: 推导并演示锁相均衡传播（LIEP）：利用振荡网络中的局部梯度信息进行训练，无需分离的前向和反向传播；并将该方法表述为三因子更新规则。
AI.result: LIEP 既可用于从头训练（ab-initio），也可在预训练参数受到扰动时恢复性能；但当前仅在浅层网络上得到验证。
AI.conclusion: LIEP 为模拟振荡硬件提供了一种潜在的原位学习方案，并具备三因子更新规则的形式；未来可通过替代架构将其扩展到深层和大规模网络，以应对复杂任务。

title: FlexiFlow: Bandit-based Model Switching in ML Workflows
summary: Model optimizations help improve inference performance and accuracy of ML workflows. However, relying on a single model to perform inference across all data batches often fails to maximize accuracy and thus overall performance. In many cases, alternate models could perform better on specific subsets of data where a primary model underperforms. Our experiments with real ML workflows indeed show that switching models improves workflow accuracy by up to 23%. Yet, current systems lack the ability to adaptively switch between models based on performance, forcing users to manually test models in sequence. We present FlexiFlow, a dataflow system that dynamically switches between alternate models when the current model exhibits low accuracy. FlexiFlow learns to rank models using a novel multi-armed bandit approach that accounts for model runtimes, probability of passing user-defined assertions, and the computational structure of the ML workflow. We show that the standard Thompson sampling approach is insufficient for switching models in ML workflows. In contrast, our proposed approaches are effective and scales to complex real-world ML workflows. Experiments show that switching models at runtime while reusing intermediate results provides higher accuracy, but also 48% efficiency gain compared to sequential workflow runs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 FlexiFlow 数据流系统，通过多臂老虎机算法在运行时动态切换备选模型，以在保证效率的同时提升 ML 工作流准确率。
AI.motivation: 单一模型难以在所有数据批次上达到最优准确率；实验表明切换模型可将准确率提升至多 23%，但现有系统缺乏基于性能的自适应切换能力，用户只能手动依次测试模型。
AI.method: FlexiFlow 是一种数据流系统，在当前模型准确率偏低时动态切换备选模型；它采用一种新颖的多臂老虎机方法对模型进行排序，综合考虑模型运行时间、通过用户自定义断言的概率以及 ML 工作流的计算结构。作者指出标准 Thompson 采样方法在此场景下不足，并提出改进方法以适配复杂真实工作流。
AI.result: 改进的切换方法有效且可扩展到复杂的真实 ML 工作流；运行时切换模型并复用中间结果不仅带来更高准确率，还相比顺序执行工作流获得 48% 的效率提升。
AI.conclusion: 在 ML 工作流中引入基于多臂老虎机的自适应模型切换并结合中间结果复用，可同时提升准确率与执行效率，优于手动顺序测试与标准 Thompson 采样方案。

title: Scale-Invariant Training for Time Series Foundation Models
summary: Time series foundation models (TSFMs) are trained on large collections of time series datasets that span various morphologies and domains. This setting exposes models to series whose scales -- typical magnitudes of their values -- can differ substantially. Affine scaling methods such as Reversible Instance Normalization (ReVIN) scale model inputs and reverse the transform before computing the loss. We show that this inversion multiplies each series' gradient by $b^p$ relative to loss on scaled targets, where $b$ is the scaling denominator (e.g., standard deviation) and $p$ is the loss degree. We call this scale-contaminated training (ScaleCon), because the scale of each series consequently becomes an importance weight, causing high-scale series to dominate training. For any scale-equivariant scaler and residual loss that is homogeneous of degree $p$, including MSE, MAE, and Quantile Loss, we prove that computing loss on scaled targets makes every mini-batch gradient and, consequently, the full optimization trajectory invariant to arbitrary independent rescaling of the training series, yielding scale-invariant training (ScaleIn). Notably, existing TSFMs use both objectives, with neither consistent reporting nor a common convention on how to compute training loss. We isolate the convergence disparity induced by ScaleCon and its correction under ScaleIn in controlled studies on synthetic and real data. In pretraining across four TSFM architectures, ScaleIn lowers MASE in all 24 architecture-benchmark comparisons, with average reductions across TSFMs of 18.8% on GIFT-Eval and 21.9% on the M-competitions. The gains extend to supervised neural forecasting, where it lowers MASE in 16 of 20 matched settings. Most existing time series forecasting pipelines can adopt ScaleIn with a one-line code change.

AI.tldr: 本文指出时序基础模型训练中仿射缩放（如ReVIN）在反变换后计算损失会导致"尺度污染训练"（ScaleCon），提出在缩放后的目标上计算损失以实现"尺度不变训练"（ScaleIn），并验证其一致提升预测性能。
AI.motivation: 时序基础模型在跨域、跨形态的时序数据集上训练，各序列的尺度（数值量级）差异巨大。现有仿射缩放方法（如ReVIN）在反变换后计算损失，使得序列尺度隐式地成为重要性权重，高尺度序列主导训练，且现有TSFM对训练损失计算方式缺乏统一约定与一致报告。
AI.method: 从理论上分析仿射缩放反变换对梯度的影响：当损失为p次齐次残差损失（如MSE、MAE、Quantile Loss）且缩放器尺度等变时，反变换使每条序列梯度相对缩放目标损失乘以b^p（b为缩放分母，如标准差），即ScaleCon。作者证明：在缩放后的目标上计算损失，可使任意小批量梯度乃至完整优化轨迹对训练序列的独立任意重缩放保持不变，即ScaleIn。并在合成数据与真实数据上的受控实验分离ScaleCon与ScaleIn的收敛差异，进而跨四种TSFM架构预训练评估。
AI.result: 在四种TSFM架构的24组架构-基准对比中，ScaleIn全部降低MASE，GIFT-Eval平均降低18.8%，M-competitions平均降低21.9%；在有监督神经预测中，20组匹配设置中有16组降低MASE。
AI.conclusion: 反变换损失引入的尺度污染会使高尺度序列主导训练并扭曲优化，而在缩放目标上计算损失可实现尺度不变训练，稳定提升预测精度。大多数现有时序预测流程仅需一行代码即可采用ScaleIn。

title: Weight Oracles: Reading Neural Network Weights with Language Models
comment: Spotlight at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Neural Network Artifacts as a New Data Modality (NeuralArtifacts), Paris. 14 pages, 10 figures
summary: Interpretability methods for neural networks are predominantly reactive: they analyse activations produced during specific forward passes, requiring known inputs to find hidden capabilities such as backdoors. We propose Weight Oracles, fine-tuned language models that diagnose properties of a target network by reading its raw weights directly, without behavioural testing. We investigate this paradigm in two phases. Phase I establishes feasibility: through a staged curriculum and an external chain-of-computation that delegates parameter-free operations to deterministic code, an explainer LLM learns to simulate the forward pass of small transformers from their weights, achieving 99% holdout accuracy on unseen targets. Phase II repurposes this infrastructure for safety auditing. We train an oracle on natural language diagnostic questions about weight anomalies using only benign pathologies as training signal, and evaluate it zero-shot on backdoors absent from training. The oracle achieves AUROC 0.93 on attention-routed backdoors and 0.81 across a diversified threat distribution including stealth and adversarially regularized variants. Hand-crafted statistical detectors are sharp on the threat models they implicitly target but collapse on threat-model shift, while the oracle remains uniformly competent across attack types. Scaling to realistic model sizes remains the principal open challenge.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Weight Oracles：经微调的语言模型直接读取目标网络原始权重来诊断其属性，无需行为测试。第一阶段验证可行性，解释器 LLM 通过学习可模拟小 Transformer 前向传播，留出目标准确率达 99%；第二阶段用于安全审计，仅用良性病理作为训练信号，在未见后门上零样本检测，注意力路由后门 AUROC 0.93，多样化威胁分布下 0.81，且在威胁模型迁移时显著优于手工统计检测器。
AI.motivation: 现有神经网络可解释性方法大多是"反应式"的：只能分析特定前向传播中产生的激活值，必须依赖已知输入才能发现隐藏能力（如后门）。这限制了在未知输入、仅掌握模型权重场景下的安全审计能力，因此作者希望让模型能够仅凭原始权重直接诊断网络属性。
AI.method: 工作分为两个阶段。阶段一验证可行性：采用分阶段课程学习，并引入外部"计算链"（chain-of-computation），将无需参数的操作委托给确定性代码执行，使解释器 LLM 学会从权重模拟小型 Transformer 的前向传播。阶段二将基础设施转向安全审计：用关于权重异常的自然语言诊断问题训练 oracle，训练信号仅来自良性病理，并在训练中未包含的后门上做零样本评估。
AI.result: 阶段一在未见目标上达到 99% 留出准确率。阶段二 oracle 在注意力路由后门上达到 AUROC 0.93，在包含隐蔽型与对抗正则化变体的多样化威胁分布上达到 AUROC 0.81。相比之下，手工设计的统计检测器在其隐含针对的威胁模型上表现锐利，但在威胁模型迁移时性能崩溃，而 oracle 在不同攻击类型上保持一致的检测能力。
AI.conclusion: Weight Oracles 表明，直接从原始权重诊断网络属性是可行且有效的，为安全审计提供了一种非反应式、跨攻击类型稳健的新范式；而扩展到真实规模的模型仍是当前的主要开放挑战。

title: Selective Critique for Cost-Aware LLM Agents in Long-Horizon Decision Making
summary: Improving the reliability of large language model (LLM) agents in long-horizon decision-making remains a key challenge. When deployed as autonomous agents interacting with complex environments, early mistakes can propagate through trajectories and cause cascading failures. Recent approaches improve reliability by incorporating external critique or deliberation, but invoking these mechanisms at every step substantially increases token consumption and latency, limiting practical deployment. We propose SAG (Self-improving Agent with Gated critique), a cost-aware framework that formulates critique invocation as a step-wise decision problem during long-horizon interaction. SAG introduces a lightweight, training-free gating mechanism that estimates the utility of critique using action-level ambiguity signals--global entropy and local top-2 margin--computed over admissible actions. From a decision-theoretic perspective, this mechanism approximates the Value of Information (VoI) of critique, enabling the agent to selectively allocate expensive feedback only when its expected benefit justifies the cost. SAG further incorporates online bootstrapped self-improvement, allowing the actor to internalize critic-assisted behaviors and progressively reduce reliance on critique. Across three long-horizon interactive benchmarks and multiple backbone models, SAG substantially improves the performance-cost trade-off compared with both no-critique and always-on critique agents. On ALFWorld, SAG increases task success from 24.6% to 78.4% while maintaining a token budget comparable to ReAct, yielding a $3.1\times$ improvement in normalized token efficiency. Moreover, a 7B actor with a lightweight 3B critic achieves performance comparable to a 14B actor without critique, showing that selective critique can recover most of the reliability benefits of deliberation while dramatically reducing inference cost.

AI.tldr: SAG 是一个成本感知的框架，将外部批评（critique）调用建模为长程交互中的逐步决策问题，通过轻量、免训练的门控机制选择性触发批评，从而在显著提升任务成功率的同时控制 token 消耗。
AI.motivation: LLM 智能体在长程决策中可靠性不足：早期错误会沿轨迹传播导致级联失败。现有方法通过外部批评或审议提升可靠性，但每一步都调用会使 token 消耗与延迟大幅增加，难以实际部署。因此需要一种在需要时才调用昂贵反馈的机制。
AI.method: 提出 SAG（Self-improving Agent with Gated critique）：将批评调用形式化为逐步决策问题。引入轻量、免训练的门控机制，利用动作级歧义信号（全局熵与局部 top-2 margin）估计批评的效用；从决策论角度看，该机制近似批评的信息价值（VoI），仅在期望收益超过成本时分配反馈。此外加入在线自举自改进，使 actor 内化 critic 辅助行为，逐步减少对批评的依赖。
AI.result: 在三个长程交互基准和多种骨干模型上，SAG 相比无批评与始终开启批评的智能体显著改善了性能-成本权衡。在 ALFWorld 上，任务成功率从 24.6% 提升至 78.4%，token 预算与 ReAct 相当，归一化 token 效率提升 3.1×。此外，7B actor 搭配轻量 3B critic 即可达到无批评的 14B actor 的性能水平。
AI.conclusion: 选择性批评能够在显著降低推理成本的同时，恢复大部分审议带来的可靠性收益，为长程 LLM 智能体提供了一种可扩展的可靠性与效率兼顾方案。

title: CausalBind: Causal Modeling and Learning for Protein-Molecule Virtual Screening
summary: Protein-molecule virtual screening is increasingly cast as a problem of representation learning in a shared embedding space. Existing methods rely on dense holistic alignment, entangling invariant binding determinants with nuisance correlations and limiting transfer to new targets. It has been noted that binding in protein-molecule systems involves sparse cross-modality interactions: binding is governed by a small contact interface and a few decisive local interactions (e.g., hydrogen bonds, hydrophobic contacts, and salt bridges) rather than the global structures of the protein and molecule. We hypothesize that uncovering and leveraging sparse interaction patterns is critical for generalization beyond the training data, as these patterns are reusable and expected to improve performance across different scenarios. In this paper, we aim to identify and leverage sparse interaction patterns, and verify our hypothesis. Since the training data contain only observed binding pairs, we formalize this prior via a V-structure causal model under Heckman-style selection, and establish three theoretical results: (i) the latent concepts of interacting proteins and molecules are not identifiable without appropriate sparsity constraints; (ii) these concepts and their sparse interactions are component-wise identifiable under structural sparsity conditions; and (iii) a low-rank relaxation of these conditions yields subspace identifiability of the concepts and interactions. Inspired by these principles, we propose CausalBind with three implementation variants. Extensive experiments on DUD-E and LIT-PCBA benchmarks show that all variants consistently outperform strong retrieval baselines, with the largest gains on LIT-PCBA early enrichment, and further generalize to target- and scaffold-level out-of-distribution splits. Code is available at https://github.com/lokali/CausalBind.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CausalBind，通过V结构因果模型与稀疏性约束识别蛋白质-分子间稀疏交互模式，在DUD-E和LIT-PCBA上超越强检索基线并提升OOD泛化。
AI.motivation: 现有蛋白质-分子虚拟筛选方法依赖稠密整体对齐，将不变结合决定因素与噪声相关性纠缠在一起，限制了对新靶点的迁移能力。作者认为结合由稀疏跨模态交互（小接触界面与少量决定性局部相互作用）主导，挖掘并利用这种稀疏交互模式对超越训练数据的泛化至关重要。
AI.method: 将稀疏交互先验形式化为Heckman式选择下的V结构因果模型，建立三个理论结果：无稀疏约束时隐概念不可辨识；结构稀疏条件下成分级可辨识；低秩松弛给出子空间可辨识性。据此提出CausalBind，含三个实现变体。
AI.result: 在DUD-E和LIT-PCBA基准上，所有变体一致优于强检索基线，在LIT-PCBA早期富集上增益最大，并在靶点级和骨架级分布外划分上展现泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 稀疏交互模式的识别与利用可提升虚拟筛选的泛化性能，理论与实验共同支持该假设。代码已开源。

title: RELACE: retrospective likelihood-based action credit estimation for long-horizon language agents
summary: Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) avoids a separate critic by estimating advantages from rollout groups. For multi-turn agents, however, trajectory-level supervision provides coarse, noisy credit: terminal rewards do not locate errors and can penalize useful actions alongside mistakes. Group-in-Group Policy Optimization (GiGPO) and subsequent methods refine supervision through state-conditioned comparisons, but their credit estimates remain sensitive to downstream decisions and outcomes. We introduce RELACE, Retrospective Likelihood-based Action, a critic-free framework that integrates retrospective action assessment with state-conditioned advantage estimation. RELACE evaluates executed actions through teacher-forced likelihood scoring under both their original contexts and outcome-augmented contexts. Comparing these likelihoods yields a trajectory-normalized retrospective factor that captures outcome-dependent changes in action plausibility, rather than hindsight plausibility alone. We use this factor to reweight discounted task returns and construct local advantages by comparing weighted returns among actions from equivalent states within a task. This couples retrospective relevance with observed reward, producing fine-grained credit that complements trajectory-level GRPO supervision. Temporal smoothing and success-protecting masking further stabilize the local signal. RELACE requires neither auxiliary value nor reward models nor additional autoregressive rollouts for credit estimation. Experiments on ALFWorld and WebShop with Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct and Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct demonstrate substantial improvements over GRPO, GiGPO, and HCAPO. With the 1.5B model, RELACE achieves $96.35\%$ success on ALFWorld and $79.43\%$ on WebShop, surpassing GiGPO by $5.47$ and $5.60$ percentage points, respectively.

AI.tldr: RELACE是一种无需critic的多轮智能体强化学习框架，通过教师强制似然评分构造轨迹归一化的回溯因子，对折扣回报加权以生成状态条件下的细粒度信用，在ALFWorld和WebShop上显著优于GRPO、GiGPO和HCAPO。
AI.motivation: GRPO依赖轨迹级分组估计优势，对多轮任务而言信用分配过于粗糙且含噪：终端奖励无法定位错误，并可能同时惩罚有用动作与失误；GiGPO等后续方法虽通过状态条件比较细化监督，但其信用估计仍对下游决策与结果敏感。因此需要一种既无需critic、又能提供细粒度信用且对下游结果不敏感的信用分配机制。
AI.method: RELACE（Retrospective Likelihood-based Action）在原始上下文与结果增强上下文下，对已执行动作进行教师强制似然评分；比较两者似然得到轨迹归一化的回溯因子，用以刻画结果导致的动作合理性变化，而非单纯的事后合理性。该因子对折扣任务回报加权，并通过在同一任务内比较等价状态下动作的加权回报来构造局部优势，将回溯相关性与观测奖励耦合。此外引入时间平滑与成功保护掩码以稳定局部信号。方法无需辅助价值模型、奖励模型，也无需额外自回归采样。
AI.result: 在ALFWorld与WebShop上，使用Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct和Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct均较GRPO、GiGPO、HCAPO有显著提升。1.5B模型下，ALFWorld成功率达96.35%，WebShop达79.43%，分别超出GiGPO 5.47和5.60个百分点。
AI.conclusion: RELACE以无critic方式将回溯动作评估与状态条件优势估计结合，提供可与轨迹级GRPO监督互补的细粒度信用，且不依赖额外价值/奖励模型或额外自回归采样，在多轮智能体任务上验证了有效性。

title: Towards Explainable Benchmarking for Data-driven Post-Wildfire Debris Flow Prediction
summary: Post-wildfire debris flows (PFDFs) are destructive sediment-laden hazards triggered when intense rainfall strikes recently burned terrain, destabilizing hillslopes and threatening infrastructure, local economies, and community safety. Data-driven methods have been proposed to learn predictive patterns directly from historical PFDF observations. However, the current research landscape of data-driven PFDF prediction remains highly fragmented across feature spaces, model architectures, and evaluation protocols, making rigorous comparison and the derivation of scientific insights difficult. Moreover, existing studies lack a systematic investigation into the relative importance of heterogeneous factors (e.g., meteorological conditions, terrain characteristics, soil properties, and burn severity) in triggering PFDF. To address these limitations, we present a unified benchmark for data-driven PFDF prediction, enabling fair and comprehensive evaluation across diverse models and feature configurations. Furthermore, to better understand the underlying drivers of PFDF formation, we propose a reinforcement learning-based feature selection framework that identifies factors whose perturbations render positive and negative events indistinguishable, thereby discovering the regional underlying mechanisms of PFDF occurrence across regions. Our code and benchmark are publicly available at https://github.com/KINDLab-Fly/PFDF-Benchmark.

AI.tldr: 本文针对灾后泥石流（PFDF）数据驱动预测研究碎片化、缺乏异质因子重要性系统分析的问题，构建了统一的预测基准，并提出基于强化学习的特征选择框架以识别区域触发机制。
AI.motivation: PFDF是强降雨冲击火烧迹地引发的破坏性灾害，威胁基础设施与社区安全。现有数据驱动研究在特征空间、模型架构和评估协议上高度碎片化，难以严格比较与提炼科学规律；同时缺乏对气象、地形、土壤、火烧严重度等异质因子相对重要性的系统研究。
AI.method: 提出统一的PFDF数据驱动预测基准，支持跨多种模型与特征配置的公平、全面评估；并设计基于强化学习的特征选择框架，通过识别使正负样本变得不可区分的因子扰动，发现不同区域PFDF发生的区域内在机制。
AI.result: 建立了可公开获取的基准与代码（https://github.com/KINDLab-Fly/PFDF-Benchmark），实现跨模型、跨特征配置的公平比较，并识别出各区域对PFDF触发具有判别力的关键因子。
AI.conclusion: 统一基准有助于规范PFDF预测的模型评估与可复现研究，强化学习特征选择为揭示PFDF形成的区域驱动机制提供了新途径。

title: Dynamic Budget Allocation for LLM Evaluation under Hard Resource Constraints
summary: We evaluate large language models (LLMs) in multi-turn interactions through their time-to-event: the number of interaction steps required to produce an event of interest, such as a successful jailbreak or agentic task completion. Under limited compute, interactions may be terminated before the event occurs, so that event times are only partially observed (censored). Existing allocation methods for calibrating time-to-event bounds satisfy the budget only in expectation and can exceed the available budget on a particular evaluation run. Enforcing a hard constraint is particularly challenging as the cost of a trajectory is initially unknown. We introduce Hard-budget Allocation with Reflow for Predictive calibration (HARP), a budget allocation that satisfies hard resource constraints and adaptively reallocates unused budget. We show how to use HARP to construct lower predictive bounds (LPBs) on the time-to-event and to estimate evaluation metrics such as the jailbreak rate on a fixed benchmark. Although HARP induces dependence in acquisition decisions across different trajectories, we prove that HARP never exceeds the target budget, that its LPBs have finite-sample coverage guarantees, and that its metric estimates are unbiased. Experiments on agentic task success, LLM jailbreaks, toxic content generation, and RAG hallucinations show that HARP achieves coverage close to the nominal level with low variance, while never exceeding the given budget.

AI.tldr: 提出 HARP，一种满足硬预算约束并自适应重分配剩余预算的分配方法，用于多轮交互下事件时间的预测校准。
AI.motivation: 评估 LLM 多轮交互时关注"事件发生所需交互步数"，但算力有限会导致交互被提前终止、事件时间被删失。现有分配方法仅能在期望意义上满足预算，单次评估可能超支；而由于轨迹成本事先未知，施加硬约束尤为困难。
AI.method: HARP（Hard-budget Allocation with Reflow for Predictive calibration）：一种硬资源约束下的预算分配方法，可自适应重分配未使用预算；在此基础上构造事件时间的下预测界（LPB），并估计固定基准上的评估指标（如越狱率）。
AI.result: 理论证明 HARP 绝不超过目标预算、其 LPB 具有有限样本覆盖保证、指标估计无偏。在智能体任务成功、LLM 越狱、有害内容生成和 RAG 幻觉实验中，HARP 的覆盖接近名义水平且方差低，同时从不超预算。
AI.conclusion: HARP 为多轮交互评估提供了兼具硬预算约束、覆盖保证与无偏估计的实用方案。虽然其采集决策在轨迹间引入依赖，但理论与实验均验证了其有效性与可靠性。

title: Multigroup Fairness and Omniprediction: Separations and Equivalences
summary:
Omniprediction is a learning guarantee which requires a single predictor to be competitive relative to the best hypothesis from a benchmark class for any loss chosen from a family of loss functions. Loss Outcome Indistinguishability (loss OI for short) is a stronger notion that implies omniprediction. It requires the predicted distribution on labels to be indistinguishable from the true distribution to tests that depend on the loss functions and the benchmark class. Multiaccuracy and multicalibration are multigroup fairness notions that generalize classical notions of calibration and accuracy in expectation. Most known learning algorithms for omniprediction (both for the standard notion and for strengthenings like loss OI) rely on some version of these multigroup fairness notions, or on an intermediate notion called calibrated multiaccuracy. We ask if this is necessary: Does omniprediction require some form of multigroup fairness?
  We show that the answer is no for (plain) omniprediction, and yes for loss OI. First, a sequence of works shows that multicalibration or calibrated multiaccuracy imply omniprediction. We rule out even a weak converse, by showing that omniprediction for proper losses does not imply even accuracy in expectation, a much weaker notion than any of calibration, multiaccuracy, or multicalibration. Second, prior work showed how to achieve loss OI from a combination of calibration and multiaccuracy. We show a converse: loss OI is equivalent to a form of calibrated multiaccuracy.

AI.tldr: 本文研究 omniprediction 是否需要多群体公平性（multigroup fairness）。结论是：普通 omniprediction 不需要，而更强的 loss OI 恰恰等价于一种 calibrated multiaccuracy。
AI.motivation: 多数已知 omniprediction（含 loss OI 强化版）算法依赖多群体公平性概念（multicalibration、multiaccuracy 或 calibrated multiaccuracy），因此作者追问：omniprediction 是否本质上必须依赖某种多群体公平性？
AI.method: 理论分析与反例/等价性构造：(1) 针对 proper losses，构造反例证明 omniprediction 不蕴含期望精度；(2) 证明 loss OI 与 calibrated multiaccuracy 之间的双向蕴含关系。
AI.result: （1）omniprediction for proper losses 不蕴含期望精度，从而排除任何弱反向蕴含；（2）loss OI 等价于一种 calibrated multiaccuracy。
AI.conclusion: 普通 omniprediction 不要求多群体公平性；而 loss outcome indistinguishability 则等价于 calibrated multiaccuracy，即该强化版才与多群体公平性本质相关。

title: Inference and learning in sparse autoencoders as natural gradient flow
summary: Sparse autoencoders are widely used to uncover interpretable features in neural networks, yet reliable recovery remains difficult when features overlap or activate infrequently. These challenges involve both inferring which features explain an input and learning the dictionary that represents them. Here, we unify inference and dictionary learning as natural-gradient flows on a shared variational free energy. We instantiate this framework as BeFOND, an encoder-free sparse coding model with closed-form inference and learning dynamics. We show how recurrent explaining away reduces interference between overlapping features, while Fisher preconditioning can compensate for the slow learning of rare features. On synthetic data, BeFOND improves dictionary recovery and rare-feature detection, with a growing advantage over amortized baselines as superposition increases. On language-model activations, it improves single-feature concept detection and selective intervention, outperforming pretrained reference SAEs with substantially less training data. Its feature quality continues to improve with dictionary width, whereas the evaluated baselines largely plateau. Together, these results show how improving inference and learning within a unified probabilistic framework can make better use of data and dictionary capacity to interpret and intervene on neural representations.

AI.tldr: 该论文将稀疏自编码器的推断与字典学习统一为共享变分自由能上的自然梯度流，提出无编码器稀疏编码模型BeFOND，在合成数据和语言模型激活上均提升字典恢复、稀有特征检测与可解释干预效果。
AI.motivation: 稀疏自编码器虽广泛用于揭示神经网络中的可解释特征，但当特征重叠或激活频率低时，特征恢复仍不可靠。这一困难同时涉及"推断哪些特征解释当前输入"与"学习表示这些特征的字典"两个环节，而现有方法往往割裂处理二者。
AI.method: 作者把推断与字典学习统一为在同一变分自由能上的自然梯度流，并据此实例化为BeFOND——一个无编码器（encoder-free）的稀疏编码模型，其推断与学习动力学均具有闭式解。其中循环式的"explaining away"机制用于削弱重叠特征间的干扰，Fisher预条件则用于补偿稀有特征学习缓慢的问题。
AI.result: 在合成数据上，BeFOND改善了字典恢复与稀有特征检测，且随叠加程度增加，相对摊销（amortized）基线的优势不断扩大。在语言模型激活上，它提升了单特征概念检测与选择性干预能力，用远少于预训练参考SAE的训练数据即取得更优表现。其特征质量随字典宽度持续提升，而所评估的基线大多趋于平台期。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，在统一的概率框架内同时改进推断与学习，能更充分地利用数据与字典容量，从而更好地解释并干预神经表征。

title: Fed-BRDECS: Privacy-Preserving and Heterogeneity-Aware Federated Deep Embedded Clustering
summary: Federated deep clustering seeks to learn clustering-friendly representations from decentralized unlabeled data while preserving client privacy. However, Deep Embedded Clustering (DEC)-style objectives depend on global soft-assignment statistics that require clients to reveal their sensitive information. We propose Fed-BRDECS, a privacy-preserving and heterogeneity-aware federated deep embedded clustering framework. Fed-BRDECS replaces the globally normalized clustering objective with a locally computable sample-stability loss, avoiding the transmission of local soft-assignment distributions. To tackle non-IID client distributions, we introduce prediction-balanced sampling, which oversamples locally rare predicted clusters without requiring ground-truth labels, and centroid-level restarting, which periodically refreshes biased or inactive centroids. Experiments on image and text clustering benchmarks show that Fed-BRDECS consistently outperforms representative federated clustering and deep clustering baselines under both IID and non-IID partitions. We further demonstrate its applicability to federated time-series anomaly detection, where it improves reconstruction-based detectors without adding inference-time cost.

AI.tldr: 提出Fed-BRDECS，用局部可计算的样本稳定性损失替代需全局统计的DEC目标，并结合预测平衡采样与质心重启，实现隐私保护且抗异构的联邦深度聚类。
AI.motivation: 联邦深度聚类需在保护客户端隐私的同时，从去中心化无标签数据中学习聚类友好表征。但DEC式目标依赖全局软分配统计量，迫使客户端泄露敏感信息；同时客户端数据非IID分布带来挑战。
AI.method: 以局部可计算的样本稳定性损失替代全局归一化聚类目标，避免传输本地软分配分布；针对非IID引入预测平衡采样（无需真值标签，对本地稀有预测簇过采样）与质心级重启（周期性刷新有偏或失活质心）。
AI.result: 在图像与文本聚类基准上，IID与非IID划分下均持续优于代表性联邦聚类与深度聚类基线；在联邦时间序列异常检测中提升基于重构的检测器且不增加推理开销。
AI.conclusion: Fed-BRDECS在保护隐私的同时有效应对数据异构，具备跨任务（聚类与异常检测）的通用性与实用性。

title: What pass@k Cannot Measure: Evaluating Diversity and Capability Retention after Post-Training
comment: 10 pages, 2 figures. Accepted to the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Transitioning from Pre-training to Post-training (non-archival)
summary: pass@$k$, the fraction of problems a model solves within $k$ sampled attempts, is the field's default protocol for deciding whether reinforcement-learning (RL) post-training on verifiable rewards improved a model. At the population level, pass@$k$ depends only on a problem's probability of a correct sample, with no term for how it is distributed across outputs. We show this gap is not academic. Training Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct on grade-school math with Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) and with rejection-sampling fine-tuning (RFT, training on the model's own shortest verifier-passed rollout) moves three complementary diversity measures (token-level entropy, answer-level entropy, unique answers per prompt) in opposite directions, with zero overlap across three seeds per arm. The gap survives restricting to verifier-correct completions only (lexical diversity among correct solutions is 15% lower for GRPO, after controlling for length) and a count-controlled check isolating diversity among incorrect answers alone, ruling out that GRPO's higher accuracy alone explains it. Yet pass@8 and pass@32 show no consistent winner on GSM8K, and a hard MATH-500 subset shows the same pattern: separation only at low $k$. Compared against the starting checkpoint, no trained arm significantly improves hard-problem coverage: RFT is significantly worse, while GRPO is statistically indistinguishable from it - so GRPO's pass@1 edge over RFT reflects a smaller loss relative to Base, not a capability gain, a missing-control issue, not a failure of pass@$k$. On GSM8K, only pass@1, with no role in detecting diversity by construction, separates the arms cleanly, rewarding the arm whose correct solutions are least diverse. We argue this is a concrete instance of a standard evaluation protocol missing a property it is routinely used to certify.

AI.tldr: 通过GRPO与RFT微调实验证明，pass@k仅依赖单题正确抽样概率、对答案分布不敏感，会掩盖RL后训练对多样性的破坏，构成评价协议缺失关键属性的具体案例。
AI.motivation: pass@k是判断可验证奖励强化学习后训练是否提升模型的默认协议，但在总体层面它只取决于问题被正确采样的概率，不含正确性在输出间分布的信息。作者要检验这一理论缺口是否有实际后果，即是否存在多样性显著变化而pass@k无法察觉的情形。
AI.method: 以Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct为基座，在小学数学任务上分别用GRPO与RFT（在模型自身最短的通过验证器rollout上训练）微调，每种方法跑三个随机种子；用三种互补多样性指标（token级熵、答案级熵、每提示唯一答案数）对比。并做两类控制：仅保留验证器正确的完成（控制长度后的词法多样性）与仅统计错误答案中的多样性（计数控制），以排除准确率差异导致多样性的可能。随后在GSM8K上比较pass@8与pass@32，并在MATH-500难题子集上检验不同k下的分离情况，同时以初始checkpoint为基准考察难题覆盖率。
AI.result: GRPO与RFT使三种多样性指标呈相反方向变化，三个种子间零重叠。仅限正确完成时，GRPO的词法多样性在控制长度后低15%；仅看错误答案的计数控制同样成立，排除高准确率解释。但pass@8与pass@32在GSM8K上无一致胜者，MATH-500难题子集仅在低k出现分离。相对初始checkpoint，没有任何训练臂显著提升难题覆盖率：RFT显著更差，GRPO与基座统计上不可区分。GSM8K上只有pass@1能清晰区分两臂，而pass@1在构造上不承担检测多样性功能，最终奖励了正确解多样性最低的一臂。
AI.conclusion: GRPO相对RFT的pass@1优势只是相对Base损失更小，而非能力提升，属于缺失对照问题而非pass@k本身失效。但整体说明pass@k这一标准评价协议缺失其常被用于认证的属性（输出多样性），是一类评估协议缺口的实例。

title: Evaluation of Active Feature Acquisition Policies with Tabular Foundation Models
summary: Active feature acquisition learns policies that sequentially acquire features to maximize information about a target variable. We study how to learn and evaluate such policies from finite offline data using prior-data fitted networks (PFNs), which are off-the-shelf models that output posterior predictive distributions without task-specific training. We show that under the imbalanced coverage of offline data, using total predictive entropy as a reward creates an epistemic bias that penalizes acquiring sparsely observed features. Specifically, this reward conflates epistemic uncertainty (arising from lack of offline data) with aleatoric uncertainty (arising from uninformative features). To address this, we target the posterior expected (aleatoric) entropy instead of the total predictive entropy output by a PFN for evaluating feature acquisitions. Empirical evaluations on synthetic and real-world datasets demonstrate that our approach consistently reduces value estimation bias and yields credible intervals with strong empirical coverage, which can translate to improved downstream policy selection.

AI.tldr: 本文研究在有限离线数据下，利用先验数据拟合网络（PFN）学习与评估主动特征获取策略，并指出在数据覆盖不均衡时，以总预测熵作为奖励会引入认知偏差，从而使稀疏观测到的特征被惩罚。
AI.motivation: 主动特征获取需要序列化地获取特征以最大化目标变量信息，但从有限离线数据中学习并评估此类策略存在困难。PFN 虽可无需任务特定训练直接输出后验预测分布，但在离线数据覆盖不均衡时，总预测熵作为奖励混同了认知不确定性（来自离线数据不足）与偶然不确定性（来自特征本身无信息量），导致价值估计产生偏差。
AI.method: 针对上述问题，作者提出不以 PFN 输出的总预测熵作为评估特征获取的奖励，而是以事后期望（偶然）熵为目标。该方法旨在剥离来自离线数据不足的认知不确定性，从而避免对稀疏观测特征的惩罚。
AI.result: 在合成数据集和真实世界数据集上的实证评估表明，该方法一致地降低了价值估计偏差，并产生具有较强经验覆盖率的可信区间，进而可转化为更优的下游策略选择。
AI.conclusion: 在离线数据不均衡覆盖条件下，使用事后期望偶然熵替代总预测熵，可有效缓解 PFN 评估主动特征获取策略时的认知偏差，提高价值估计与策略选择的可靠性。

title: Benchmarking Label-Revealed Online Updates for EEG BCI Decoding
summary: Electroencephalography (EEG) signals drift over time, which can cause static brain-computer interface (BCI) models to degrade in practice. We present a benchmark for online adaptation and compare two widely used pipeline families, Common Spatial Patterns (CSP) and Riemannian covariance-based methods, under time-ordered prequential (test-then-train) evaluation. We examine (i) which pipelines benefit most from label-revealed updates, (ii) whether controlled forgetting of older data improves robustness, and (iii) how a minimal-calibration cold start compares with starting from a pretrained model. Across four datasets (three motor-imagery datasets and one movement-decoding dataset), label-revealed online updates improve 13 of 14 model/dataset pairs on the two largest streams, with relative accuracy gains of up to about 18% over a frozen model. A Shapley-based data-valuation analysis over temporal blocks assigns the largest mean value to the most recent block in each of the three analyzed datasets, while older blocks retain positive value.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一个用于EEG脑机接口在线自适应的基准，在按时间排序的预序（先测后训）评估下比较CSP与黎曼协方差方法两大流程族。
AI.motivation: EEG信号随时间漂移，导致静态BCI模型在实践中性能退化，因此需要系统评估在线自适应策略。
AI.method: 构建在线自适应基准，在预序评估协议下对比CSP与基于黎曼协方差的两类流程；考察三个问题：(i)哪些流程最受益于标签揭示更新，(ii)对旧数据的有控遗忘是否提升鲁棒性，(iii)最小校准冷启动与预训练模型起始的对比；并在四个数据集（三个运动想象、一个运动解码）上进行实验，另用基于Shapley的数据估值分析时间块价值。
AI.result: 在两个最大数据流上，标签揭示的在线更新使14个模型/数据集对中的13个得到提升，相对冻结模型准确率增益最高约18%；Shapley时间块估值显示三个分析数据集中最近时间块平均价值最大，且较旧时间块仍保持正价值。
AI.conclusion: 在线标签揭示更新能显著缓解EEG漂移导致的模型退化，近期数据价值最高但旧数据并非无用，为在线BCI自适应提供了基准与实证依据。

title: StaFIR: Convex Learning of Stationarity-Aware Causal Filters
comment: Accepted at the TS-LIMITS Workshop at NeurIPS 2026
summary: Reducing nonstationarity in a persistent time series entails deciding how much of its temporal dependence to remove. In finance, fractional differencing is often tuned using the Augmented Dickey--Fuller (ADF) test, limiting the search to a one-parameter family of lag profiles and addressing input preservation only indirectly. We propose StaFIR, a causal finite-impulse-response filter with a learned nonnegative mixture of exponential lag profiles. Its convex learning objective balances empirical stationarity with similarity to the input. We evaluate StaFIR on ARFIMA--GARCH controlled settings and rolling financial series, including a realized-volatility forecasting task. The experiments show that StaFIR adjusts its filtering strength to persistence while limiting unnecessary transformation in stationary regimes. In downstream forecasting, there is no clear accuracy difference from fixed half-order differencing, while StaFIR achieves higher measured similarity to the raw signal. A complementary direct forecasting experiment finds that greater input similarity is associated with smaller forecasting penalties, although the raw representation remains stronger.

AI.tldr: 本文提出StaFIR——一种因果有限脉冲响应滤波器，通过可学习的非负指数滞后曲线混合来减少时间序列的非平稳性，其凸目标函数在经验平稳性与输入相似性之间取得平衡。
AI.motivation: 减少持续性时间序列的非平稳性需要权衡去除多少时间依赖。金融中常用分数差分，但通常借助ADF检验进行调参，这既把搜索限制在单参数滞后曲线族中，又只能间接处理输入保持问题。
AI.method: StaFIR采用因果FIR滤波器，其滞后曲线为可学习的非负指数曲线混合；学习目标为凸函数，同时兼顾经验平稳性与对输入的相似性。在ARFIMA–GARCH受控设置及滚动金融序列（含已实现波动率预测任务）上进行评估。
AI.result: StaFIR能随持续性调整滤波强度，并在平稳区制下限制不必要的变换。下游预测中，其精度与固定半阶差分无明显差异，但对原始信号的相似度更高；补充的直接预测实验表明，输入相似度越高，预测损失越小，不过原始表示仍更强。
AI.conclusion: StaFIR以凸学习方式在平稳化与信息保持之间实现可调折中，在保持与固定半阶差分相当预测精度的同时提升输入相似度，为分数差分的调参与输入保持提供了一种更具原则性的替代方案。

title: Fork-and-Flush: Escaping Idea Basins in Autoresearch Agents
summary: Autoresearch agents tackle open-ended problems by repeatedly proposing candidate solutions, evaluating them, and using feedback to guide subsequent experiments. We show that independent runs of the same agent on the same task often plateau at substantially different scores, with gaps that persist even after considerable additional compute. Embedding their candidate artifacts by functional similarity provides further evidence that trajectories remain in localized regions of the solution space, which we call idea basins. To help agents escape these basins, we study a simple periodic intervention, fork-and-flush. Our method forks the agent into parallel trajectories, each inheriting the accumulated workspace but starting with a fresh chat context. After running each trajectory for a fixed horizon, the agent continues from the highest-scoring one. Across 13 long-horizon research and engineering tasks, with individual agent runs lasting up to several days, fork-and-flush outperformed the single-run and best-of-N baselines by a relative improvement of 66.0% and 44.4%, respectively, on the min-max normalized average score under an equal compute budget.

AI.tldr: 自主研究智能体在相同任务上的独立运行常会陷入不同的"想法盆地"（解空间局部区域），导致分数分化且额外算力无法弥合。作者提出 fork-and-flush 干预：将智能体分叉为并行轨迹，共享工作区但重置对话上下文，固定时间后从得分最高的轨迹继续。在13项长时程任务上，该方法在等算力下相对单次运行和 best-of-N 分别提升66.0%和44.4%。
AI.motivation: 自主研究智能体（autoresearch agents）通过反复提出候选方案、评估并利用反馈指导后续实验来解决开放式问题。但相同智能体、相同任务的独立运行往往收敛到差异显著的分数上，且这种差距即使追加大量算力也难以消除，说明轨迹被限制在解空间的局部区域（想法盆地），需要一种机制帮助其逃离。
AI.method: 作者先通过将候选成果按功能相似性嵌入，验证轨迹确实停留在解空间的局部区域，即"想法盆地"。为此提出 fork-and-flush 这一简单的周期性干预方法：将智能体分叉为多条并行轨迹，每条轨迹继承累积的工作区，但从全新的对话上下文开始；每条轨迹运行固定时间窗口后，智能体从得分最高的那条轨迹继续推进。
AI.result: 在13项长时程科研与工程任务上（单次智能体运行可长达数天），fork-and-flush 在等算力预算下，以 min-max 归一化平均分衡量，相对单次运行基线提升66.0%，相对 best-of-N 基线提升44.4%。
AI.conclusion: 并行分叉并重置上下文的干预能有效帮助自主研究智能体摆脱想法盆地，在同等算力下显著优于单次运行与 best-of-N 策略，表明上下文多样性与高分轨迹选择的结合是提升长时程自主研究效率的有效手段。

title: Interpretable Hypergraph Learning via Neural Additive Models
summary: Hypergraphs offer a natural framework for modeling networked data, where dependencies among entities are governed by higher-order interactions. While hypergraph learning methods such as hypergraph neural networks have demonstrated remarkable predictive performance, most existing approaches rely on black-box message-passing architectures, making it difficult to disentangle the contributions of node attributes and higher-order structural information. To address this challenge, we introduce the hypergraph neural additive network (HGNAN), an inherently interpretable framework for learning on hypergraph-structured data. HGNAN extends classical neural additive models to higher-order relational data by integrating feature-wise nonlinear decomposition with hypergraph-aware structural aggregation, enabling transparent prediction for both node- and hyperedge-level tasks. Extensive experiments on benchmark datasets demonstrate that HGNAN achieves performance comparable with state-of-the-art hypergraph learning methods while providing intrinsic and meaningful interpretability.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出超图神经加性网络（HGNAN），一个面向超图结构数据的固有可解释学习框架，在保持与现有先进方法相当性能的同时提供内在可解释性。
AI.motivation: 超图能自然建模实体间的高阶交互依赖，但现有超图学习方法多依赖黑盒消息传递架构，难以辨析节点属性与高阶结构信息的各自贡献。
AI.method: HGNAN将经典神经加性模型扩展到高阶关系数据，融合特征维度的非线性分解与超图感知的结构聚合，支持节点级与超边级任务的透明预测。
AI.result: 在基准数据集上的大量实验表明，HGNAN达到与当前最先进超图学习方法相当的性能，同时提供内在且有意义可解释性。
AI.conclusion: HGNAN在超图学习任务中实现了预测性能与固有可解释性的兼顾，为高阶关系数据的可解释建模提供了可行方案。

title: Efficient Multimodal Inference through Adaptive Acquisition and Sequential Fusion
summary: Multimodal systems often encode every available input, even when a subset suffices for prediction. Adaptive acquisition can reduce this cost by using predictions from incrementally fused evidence to decide which modality to encode next and when to stop. However, sequential fusion makes these predictions order-dependent, so decisions based on them may need to distinguish factorially many histories of the same acquired set. We introduce SemARC, which couples a Sequential Modality Aggregator (SeMA) with an Adaptive Runtime Controller (ARC) and uses acquired evidence to select each modality before its encoder runs. SeMA executes only selected encoder and fusion branches, updates a fixed-size state, and predicts after each acquisition without recomputing earlier branches. We supervise every acquisition prefix under randomized modality subsets and orders to encourage consistent predictions across acquisition orders. ARC combines a set-dependent marginal-utility prior with residual fitted-Q learning to select the next available modality or stop, without inspecting unacquired inputs or retaining acquisition order. Across six multimodal classification datasets and eleven baselines, SemARC achieves 3.2% higher macro-F1 and 61.4% lower total inference GFLOPs on average relative to each dataset's most accurate baseline. End-to-end latency falls by 44.0% across GPU and CPU and by 47.2% on Android INT8 relative to the fastest measured baseline, on average. Under varying runtime modality missingness, SemARC still skips available modalities, matching or exceeding the best baseline macro-F1 in 21 of 24 conditions with 14.8% lower total GFLOPs on average. SemARC thus offers a practical path toward efficient multimodal inference across heterogeneous devices.

AI.tldr: SemARC 通过序列模态聚合器与自适应运行时控制器，在编码前决定是否获取每个模态并适时停止，实现高效多模态推理。
AI.motivation: 多模态系统通常对全部可用输入进行编码，即便子集已足够预测；序列融合带来顺序依赖，基于其预测的获取决策可能需区分同一集合的多种历史，难以泛化。
AI.method: 提出 SemARC，耦合 SeMA 与 ARC。SeMA 只执行被选中的编码与融合分支，维护固定大小状态，每次获取后预测且不重算早期分支；在随机模态子集与顺序下监督每个获取前缀以增强顺序一致性。ARC 将集合相关的边际效用先验与残差 fitted-Q 学习结合，在不解未获取输入、不保留获取顺序的情况下选择下一模态或停止。
AI.result: 在六个多模态分类数据集、十一个基线上，相对各数据集最准确基线平均提升 3.2% macro-F1，降低 61.4% 总推理 GFLOPs；端到端延迟在 GPU 与 CPU 上降低 44.0%，Android INT8 降低 47.2%。在运行时模态缺失条件下，24 个情形中 21 个持平或超越最佳基线 macro-F1，平均降低 14.8% GFLOPs。
AI.conclusion: SemARC 为跨异构设备的高效多模态推理提供了实用路径。

title: Adapting to Changes in Agent Behavior via Finite-Depth Policy Sensitivity
summary: Adapting a reinforcement learning policy to changes in another agent's behavior typically requires a large amount of new interaction data. Policy sensitivity provides a first-order prediction of how a locally optimal policy changes with a behavioral parameter, but its computation requires second-order derivatives whose effects propagate across future interactions. We develop a finite-depth framework to estimate this sensitivity by approximating the policy Hessian and mixed derivative using information from a reference environment. The method features an adjustable propagation depth which determines where derivative propagation along the trajectory is truncated. We characterize the derivative contributions omitted by finite-depth propagation and derive truncation-error bounds for the approximated derivatives and resulting policy sensitivity. The bounds are nonincreasing with propagation depth and vanish at full-horizon propagation. Using a belief-driven pursuit-evasion game as a validation scenario, the proposed method generally achieves lower derivative-estimation errors as the propagation depth increases and outperforms the baseline methods in both estimation accuracy and policy adaptation. The sensitivity-based initialization improves zero-shot return over direct transfer, and also shows advantages for the subsequent fine-tuning in the target environment.

AI.tldr: 提出有限深度框架估计强化学习策略对他人行为变化的敏感度，通过截断策略Hessian和混合导数的传播来降低计算需求，并给出截断误差界。
AI.motivation: 当其他智能体行为发生变化时，适配RL策略通常需要大量新交互数据。策略敏感度可一阶预测局部最优策略如何随行为参数变化，但其计算依赖二阶导数，且这些导数的影响会沿未来交互传播，计算代价高。
AI.method: 构建有限深度框架，借助参考环境信息近似策略Hessian与混合导数，以估计策略敏感度；引入可调传播深度，决定沿轨迹在何处截断导数传播。
AI.result: 刻画了有限深度传播所忽略的导数贡献，推导了近似导数及所得策略敏感度的截断误差界；误差界随传播深度非增，并在全时域传播时消失。在信念驱动的追逃博弈中，传播深度增加时导数估计误差总体降低，估计精度与策略适配均优于基线。敏感度初始化相比直接迁移提升了零样本回报，并对目标环境中的后续微调也有优势。
AI.conclusion: 有限深度敏感度估计可在可控计算成本下有效预测策略随他人行为参数的变化，并改善跨环境迁移与微调性能。

title: SpecBraM: What Should an EEG Foundation Model Predict? Masked Band-Power Prediction versus Waveform Reconstruction
comment: 12 pages, 3 figures, 9 tables; includes an appendix
summary: Self-supervised EEG models often reconstruct masked waveforms or predict discrete codes. We study a task-aligned alternative: masked band-power prediction (MBP), which predicts fixed narrow-band log spectral energy for masked channel-time patches. This target retains rhythm power relevant to sleep staging while avoiding phase-sensitive waveform reconstruction and a learned codebook. Across three pretraining seeds, we compare band-power and waveform targets with matched backbones, pretraining data (2,388 hours), and training steps, including a 2x2 tokenizer-by-target design. On ISRUC and HMC sleep staging, MBP exceeds raw- and band-waveform reconstruction by 1.6-2.8 balanced-accuracy points with all labels and 4.7-7.3 points with 1% of labels under a strict linear probe; the target effect exceeds the tokenizer effect. Its frozen features reach 0.7916/0.7425 balanced accuracy, versus 0.7636/0.7227 for a matched rich handcrafted spectral baseline, although the gap is about one point with 1% of labels. Full fine-tuning reaches 0.8107/0.7669. The gains do not extend to every task with spectral cues, including motor imagery, depression screening, and vigilance regression. These results support choosing pretraining targets to match the physical quantities and spatial and temporal scales relevant to downstream labels.

AI.tldr: 提出掩码频带功率预测（MBP）自监督任务，预测被掩蔽通道-时间块的窄带对数谱能量；在睡眠分期上优于波形重构，但增益不泛化到所有任务。
AI.motivation: 现有自监督EEG模型多采用掩码波形重构或离散码本预测，前者对相位敏感、后者依赖学习到的码本，均与下游睡眠分期所需的节律功率等物理量不直接对齐。作者希望探索一种与任务物理量对齐的预训练目标。
AI.method: 提出掩码频带功率预测（MBP）：对被掩蔽的通道-时间补丁预测固定的窄带对数谱能量。控制变量比较频带功率与波形目标，匹配骨干网络、预训练数据（2,388小时）与训练步数，并设2×2的tokenizer-by-target设计，跨三个预训练种子。下游在ISRUC与HMC睡眠分期数据集上以严格线性探针与全微调评估。
AI.result: MBP较原始波形与频带波形重构在全标签下提升1.6-2.8平衡准确率点，1%标签下提升4.7-7.3点；目标效应大于tokenizer效应。冻结特征达0.7916/0.7425平衡准确率，优于匹配的丰富手工谱基线0.7636/0.7227，但1%标签下差距约1点；全微调达0.8107/0.7669。增益未扩展到运动想象、抑郁筛查和警觉度回归等任务。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持按下游标签相关的物理量及空间、时间尺度来选择预训练目标；MBP在睡眠分期标签相关节律功率上有效，但并非通用增益。

title: Robust Importance Sampling for Rare Events via Constrained Gaussian Mixtures
summary: We study estimating rare-event probabilities $I = \mathbb{P}(g(\mathbf{X}) > γ)$ with $\mathbf{X} \sim \mathcal{N}(\boldsymbolμ, \boldsymbolΣ)$ and general $g : \mathbb{R}^d \to \mathbb{R}$. We address this problem through importance sampling, and propose a framework that substantially improves efficiency and robustness over baselines such as crude Monte Carlo, adaptive cross-entropy, variational-inference-based methods (including reverse- and forward-KL approaches), as well as Safe-ICE, Subset Simulation, and Sequential Monte Carlo, drawing on ideas from both rare-event estimation and cross-entropy optimization. The key contribution has two parts: first, we separate the problem into coverage, to overcome the cold-start barrier, and fitting, to refine proposals once a meaningful signal is available; second, we constrain the final GMM proposal so that it has finite importance-sampling variance (since coverage alone is not sufficient -- without safeguards, importance sampling may still suffer from infinite variance). Together, these ingredients yield expressive proposals; finite variance does not by itself guarantee practical stability at a fixed sampling budget. Extensive experiments demonstrate substantial variance reduction, strong robustness across diverse benchmarks, and favorable cost--efficiency trade-offs, with the proposed approach often outperforming these baselines, particularly in high-dimensional and multimodal settings where competing methods frequently become unstable or fail. Our code is available at https://github.com/lorek/robust-cfi-is.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于重要性采样的稀有事件概率估计框架，通过"覆盖+拟合"两阶段分离设计以及有限方差约束的GMM提议分布，显著提升效率与稳健性。
AI.motivation: 稀有事件概率估计中，crude Monte Carlo效率极低，而自适应交叉熵、变分推断（正/反KL）、Safe-ICE、子集模拟、序列蒙特卡洛等方法常面临冷启动困难、提议分布表达能力不足，或在无保护措施时重要性采样出现无限方差、固定采样预算下不稳定等问题。
AI.method: 在重要性采样框架下，借鉴稀有事件估计与交叉熵优化的思想，将问题分解为两部分：（1）coverage（覆盖）阶段以克服冷启动障碍；（2）fitting（拟合）阶段在获得有效信号后细化提议分布。同时对最终的高斯混合模型（GMM）提议分布施加约束，保证其重要性采样方差有限。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，该方法在多种基准上实现显著方差缩减、强稳健性与良好的成本—效率权衡，常优于crude Monte Carlo、自适应交叉熵、变分推断类方法、Safe-ICE、子集模拟及序列蒙特卡洛等基线，尤其在高维多模态场景中，竞争方法往往不稳定或失效。
AI.conclusion: 将覆盖与拟合分离并结合有限方差GMM约束，可得到表达力强且实用的提议分布；单纯有限方差不足以保证固定采样预算下的稳定性，但该框架整体实现了效率与稳健性的双重提升。代码已开源。

title: Who Bears the Burden? Learning Responsibility for Shared Constraints in Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning
comment: 20 pages, 2 figures, 4 tables. Project page with code: https://lira-marl.github.io
summary: When multiple agents share a cost budget, a common Lagrange multiplier can enforce the aggregate constraint but does not determine how its penalty should be allocated across agents. Uniform penalties ignore heterogeneity in the rewards agents sacrifice, while agent-specific multipliers may still rely on the same aggregate cost signal. We introduce Lagrangian Responsibility Allocation (LiRA), which learns each agent's share of a common multiplier by optimizing social welfare over a finite training horizon. The multiplier enforces the aggregate budget, while responsibility shares redistribute its influence without modifying the original rewards or constraints. For convex games under standard regularity conditions, varying these shares induces a smooth family of normalized generalized Nash equilibria in which active constraints remain at their budgets while welfare varies. To optimize responsibility before convergence, we derive a welfare gradient that accounts for both learning updates and the induced change in data distribution. Across CityLearn, MABIM, Harvest, and MetaDrive, spanning 3 to 400 agents, LiRA improves average social welfare by up to 29% over uniform and agent-specific multiplier baselines. Grid and driving costs remain within budget, inventory violations decrease, and Harvest makes more effective use of available budget.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Lagrangian Responsibility Allocation (LiRA)，通过学习每个 agent 对公共 Lagrange 乘子的责任份额，并优化有限训练时域内的社会福利，在满足聚合预算约束的同时实现更优的福利分配。
AI.motivation: 多个 agent 共享成本预算时，单一公共 Lagrange 乘子只能保证聚合约束，却无法决定惩罚如何在 agent 间分摊。均匀惩罚忽视各 agent 牺牲奖励的异质性，而 agent 特定的乘子可能仍依赖同一聚合成本信号，难以实现合理责任分配。
AI.method: LiRA 为每个 agent 学习其对公共乘子的责任份额，乘子负责强制预算约束，责任份额在不改变原始奖励或约束的前提下重新分配其影响。作者在标准正则条件下证明，对于凸博弈，改变这些份额可诱导出一族平滑的归一化广义 Nash 均衡；并推导出考虑学习更新与数据分布变化的社会福利梯度，以便在收敛前优化责任分配。
AI.result: 在 CityLearn、MABIM、Harvest 和 MetaDrive 四个环境、3 至 400 个 agent 上，LiRA 相较均匀乘子和 agent 特定乘子基线将平均社会福利最多提升 29%；电网和驾驶成本保持在预算内，库存违规减少，Harvest 更有效地利用了可用预算。
AI.conclusion: LiRA 通过可学习的责任份额在公共 Lagrange 乘子框架下解耦约束执行与惩罚分配，在多 agent 共享预算场景中显著提升社会福利并保持成本合规。

title: Source-Learned Reliance for Selective Test-Time Adaptation of Multimodal Time Series
summary: Multimodal wearable systems must remain reliable when sensor streams become noisy or unavailable. Existing multimodal test-time adaptation (TTA) methods often assess reliability online, but cross-modal agreement can be misleading when sensors measure different physical processes, and evaluating alternative modality configurations adds inference cost. We propose CARAT, which decouples model reliance from runtime corruption detection to guide omission or attenuation, amortizing reliance estimation through source training. An asymmetric modality-dropout curriculum prepares a missingness-resilient backbone for omission and derives a frozen, backbone-specific reliance proxy from windowed input-projection gradient norms. At deployment, a lightweight one-class detector flags suspect streams, and the proxy guides a joint choice between replacing the suspect set with the backbone's trained missingness symbol and attenuating its representations before fusion, without candidate-subset evaluation. Across four wearable datasets, five corruption types, three backbones, and eight TTA baselines, CARAT achieves the highest overall macro-F1 and best mean rank (2.42), exceeding EATA, the strongest baseline, by 1.58 F1 points across 12 equally weighted dataset-backbone settings. Across five profiled configurations, CARAT uses 9.49% fewer GFLOPs and updates 47.82% fewer parameters than EATA. A pattern also emerges across sensing regimes: multimodal TTA methods such as PTA are competitive on IMU-dominated homogeneous datasets, whereas unimodal TTA methods like TENT and EATA match or exceed it on heterogeneous datasets. These results position CARAT as a practical default to wearable TTA, offering competitive robustness with modest computational requirements and benefits that vary across backbones and dataset regimes.

AI.tldr: CARAT：将模型“依赖度估计”与在线“损坏检测”解耦，通过源域训练摊销依赖度估计，部署时以轻量检测器与冻结依赖代理指导缺失符号替换或表征衰减，无需候选子集评估。在4个可穿戴数据集、5种损坏、3种骨干、8个TTA基线上取得最高宏F1与最佳平均秩(2.42)，较EATA高1.58个F1点，GFLOPs少9.49%、参数量更新少47.82%。
AI.motivation: 可穿戴多模态系统在传感器流含噪或缺失时须保持可靠。现有多模态TTA多依赖在线可靠性评估，但跨模态一致性在传感器测量不同物理过程时可能产生误导，且评估替代模态配置会额外增加推理成本，需要更低成本、更可靠的鲁棒性引导机制。
AI.method: 提出CARAT：(1) 用非对称模态dropout课程训练缺失鲁棒骨干；(2) 由窗口化输入投影梯度范数导出冻结的、骨干特定的依赖代理(reliance proxy)；(3) 部署时用轻量单类检测器标记可疑流；(4) 依赖代理指导在“用骨干已训练的缺失符号替换可疑集”与“在融合前衰减其表征”之间做联合选择，避免候选子集评估。
AI.result: 在4个可穿戴数据集、5种损坏类型、3种骨干、8个TTA基线上，CARAT总体宏F1最高、平均秩最佳(2.42)，在12个等权数据集-骨干设置上超过最强基线EATA 1.58个F1点；在5个剖析配置下，GFLOPs比EATA少9.49%，参数更新少47.82%。另观察到传感格局规律：多模态TTA（如PTA）在IMU主导的同质数据集上有竞争力，而单模态TTA（TENT、EATA）在异质数据集上持平或更优。
AI.conclusion: CARAT可作为可穿戴TTA的实用默认方案：以适度计算开销提供有竞争力的鲁棒性，且收益随骨干与数据集格局变化；其核心价值在于解耦依赖估计与损坏检测并摊销至源域训练。

title: Harmful SFT Leaves a Continuous Trace in LLM Checkpoint Updates
summary: Safety auditing of post-trained large language models typically relies on model behavior, requiring model execution and depending on the coverage of available evaluations. This work asks a different question: Do the target behaviors optimized during supervised fine-tuning (SFT) leave readable evidence directly in checkpoint updates? We find that harmful-compliance SFT induces a continuous, objective-dependent ordering in checkpoint-update space. Using a reference geometry defined by pure harmful-compliance, safety-targeted, and benign-utility SFT, we find that a checkpoint-level coordinate s_H tracks controlled harmful-objective composition with Spearman correlations of 0.986-0.992 across four 7-8B backbones, with the same ordering persisting at larger model scales. Matched compliance-versus-refusal controls show that this checkpoint trace reflects the SFT objective rather than harmful-input exposure, while additional controls rule out simple explanations based on harmful-example count or generic training intensity. Building on this structure, we introduce TRACE, a weights-only auditing method that localizes an unknown checkpoint update relative to frozen harmful and non-harmful reference prototypes and converts this geometry into a continuous harmful-objective score. TRACE requires neither model queries nor access to the unknown SFT data, and can be evaluated directly from checkpoint updates. Across distribution shifts, unseen data, different SFT configurations, partial checkpoint access, and LoRA/full-parameter fine-tuning, the trace remains stable and is positively associated with independently measured attack success rates. TRACE remains informative even at low harmful-objective proportions, providing a complementary auditing signal when behavioral evaluation is unavailable or incomplete. Code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/Code4TRACE-54D3.

AI.tldr: 本文发现有害合规监督微调(SFT)会在检查点更新空间中留下可读的、与目标成分相关的连续排序痕迹，并据此提出仅依赖权重的审计方法TRACE，无需模型查询或访问SFT数据即可给出连续有害目标分数。
AI.motivation: 现有对后训练大模型的安全审计主要依赖模型行为，需要执行模型且受评估覆盖范围限制。作者转而追问：SFT所优化的目标行为是否直接在检查点更新中留下可读证据，从而提供行为评估之外的补充审计信号。
AI.method: 利用由纯有害合规、安全导向与良性效用三类SFT定义的参考几何，构造检查点级坐标s_H；据此提出TRACE方法，将未知检查点更新相对于冻结的有害/非有害参考原型进行定位，并把该几何关系转化为连续的有害目标分数，仅使用权重更新，无需模型查询或未知SFT数据。
AI.result: s_H与受控有害目标成分的Spearman相关性在四个7-8B骨干上达0.986-0.992，且该排序在更大规模模型上持续存在；合规-拒绝对照表明该痕迹反映SFT目标而非有害输入暴露，并排除有害样本数量或训练强度等解释。在分布偏移、未见数据、不同SFT配置、部分检查点访问及LoRA/全参数微调下痕迹保持稳定，并与独立测量的攻击成功率正相关，在低有害目标比例下仍有信息量。
AI.conclusion: 检查点更新空间携带可读的SFT目标几何痕迹，TRACE为行为评估不可用或不完整时提供了一种互补的、仅基于权重的连续安全审计信号。

title: Activation Denoising: A Robustness View on Parallel vs Sequential LLM Quantization
summary: Post-training quantization is a powerful tool for compressing large language models. The most scalable methods quantize every layer in parallel, but quantization errors then compound through the residual stream, as no layer corrects for the errors of the layers before it. Sequential quantization accounts for this error compounding by re-calibrating each layer on the already-quantized outputs of its predecessors, yielding stronger results but at the cost of a serial schedule that becomes a bottleneck at scale. As a solution, we propose parallel quantization with activation denoising, which recovers much of the sequential benefit while keeping quantization fully parallel. Rather than re-calibrating layer-by-layer, we take a robustness perspective and model the upstream error as noise, regularizing to be robust to it through a preprocessing step followed by metric-weighted rounding. Applied at every layer, this regularization forms a depth-compounding smoothness penalty that dampens how strongly quantization errors amplify through the model. Unlike orthogonal rotations commonly used in quantization, which must preserve the model's function, we multiply the weights by a more general linear transformation. We find that the two are complementary and their effects compound. Empirically, our robustness regularization recovers a significant part of sequential quantization's benefit in a single parallel pass, at a fraction of its time. Overall, by treating compounding quantization errors as a robustness problem, we offer a principled foundation for more efficient and accurate LLM quantization at scale.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"并行量化+激活去噪"方法：将上游量化误差建模为噪声，通过预处理与度量加权舍入做鲁棒性正则化，在保持全并行效率的同时逼近串行量化的精度，并可与正交旋转互补叠加。
AI.motivation: LLM后训练量化中，最可扩展的做法是逐层并行量化，但量化误差会沿残差流逐层累积，因为没有任何一层去修正前层的误差；串行量化通过在已量化前驱输出上重新校准每层来缓解误差累积，精度更好，但串行调度在规模化时成为瓶颈。因此需要一种既保持并行效率、又能获得串行收益的方法。
AI.method: 不再逐层重新校准，而是采取鲁棒性视角，把上游误差视为噪声：对每层先用预处理步骤使权重/激活对该噪声鲁棒，再进行度量加权舍入（metric-weighted rounding）。该正则化施加在每一层上，构成一个随深度复合的平滑性惩罚（depth-compounding smoothness penalty），从而抑制量化误差在模型中的放大。此外，作者用更一般的线性变换乘权重（不要求像正交旋转那样保持模型函数不变），并发现该变换与正交旋转互补、效果可叠加。
AI.result: 鲁棒性正则化在单次并行前向中即可恢复串行量化相当一部分的精度收益，且耗时仅为后者的一小部分；所提线性变换与常用正交旋转的效果可相互叠加。
AI.conclusion: 将复合量化误差视为鲁棒性问题，为大规模、高效且高精度的LLM量化提供了有原则的理论基础。

title: Targeted search shows that random-device testing underestimates worst-case error in a simulated wave-based neural operator
comment: 50 pages (19 main text and references, 31 Supplementary Information), 5 figures, 1 table
summary: Wave-based processors promise fast, energy-efficient Fourier layers for neural operators. They are usually validated on randomly sampled devices, but using them requires knowing how large their error can become under fabrication and alignment variation. In a stylised numerical case study, a hybrid Fourier neural operator runs its four spectral layers on simulated coherent 4f processors with 32 toleranced knobs, whose half-widths are representative rather than calibrated. For 120 models (four tasks, six training methods, five seeds), we compared the worst of N random in-spec devices with a searched one. On a deterministic simulator with one frozen draw of the random static errors, the searched device's held-out error was 1.08-3.10 times the maximum over 200 Monte Carlo devices and 1.06-2.71 times that over 1000. With 20 fresh static draws, it still exceeded the maximum over 200 random devices in 116 of 120 models. Under uniform sampling, the probability of drawing such a device is at most 0.37% per model (two-sided 95% Clopper-Pearson), which says nothing about how large its error is. The gap persisted with uniform or Sobol' sampling at the search's budget, shared knobs, a second crosstalk model, box scales of 0.25-2 and a pixel-level device model. Models trained only with random static errors reached 3.7-39.9 times their nominal error on searched devices, and fine-tuning on random and gradient-searched devices gave the lowest searched error of the six in all 20 task-seed pairs. For two heat-exchanger quantities, a search targeted at each exceeded the worst of 1000 random devices in all 39 models, and hence the Wilks 95/95 limit (worst of 59). For the mean pressure of 11 models, no random device exceeded a 1% error threshold, but the searched device did. Random testing estimates how often errors exceed a threshold; worst-device search gives a lower bound on how large they can be.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过数值案例表明：将混合傅里叶神经算子的谱层部署在模拟相干4f波处理器上时，基于随机器件采样的测试严重低估了最坏情况误差；对抗式"最坏器件搜索"能找到误差远超随机蒙特卡洛器件的器件，为误差上界提供了更可靠的下界证据。
AI.motivation: 波基处理器有望为神经算子提供快速、节能的傅里叶层，但通常只在随机采样的器件上验证。实际部署时需要知道在制造与对准偏差下误差能达到多大。随机测试只能估计"误差超过阈值的频率"，却无法回答"误差究竟能有多大"，因此需要一种能给出误差规模下界的最坏情形评估方法。
AI.method: 采用风格化数值案例研究：混合傅里叶神经算子的四个谱层运行在模拟相干4f处理器上，含32个带容差的旋钮（半宽为代表性取值而非标定值）。对120个模型（4任务×6训练方法×5随机种子），将N个随机在规格内器件的最坏结果与一个经搜索得到的器件对比。在确定性模拟器上用一次冻结的随机静态误差抽样，并在20次全新静态抽样、均匀与Sobol'采样、共享旋钮、第二种串扰模型、0.25–2的箱尺度以及像素级器件模型下检验该差距的稳健性。
AI.result: 在单次冻结静态误差下，搜索器件的留出误差为200个蒙特卡洛器件最大值之1.08–3.10倍、1000个器件最大值之1.06–2.71倍；在20次新静态抽样中，仍有116/120个模型超过200个随机器件的最坏值。均匀采样下抽出此类器件的概率至多每模型0.37%（双侧95% Clopper-Pearson）。仅用随机静态误差训练的模型在搜索器件上误差达标称的3.7–39.9倍；在随机与梯度搜索器件上微调，在全部20个任务-种子对中给出六种方法里最低的搜索误差。对两个换热器量，针对性搜索在全部39个模型中均超过1000个随机器件的最坏值，因而超过Wilks 95/95限（59个的最坏值）；对11个模型的平均压力，无随机器件超过1%误差阈值，而搜索器件则超过。
AI.conclusion: 随机测试估计误差超过阈值的频率，而最坏器件搜索给出误差能达到多大的下界。二者互补：仅靠随机采样验证会系统性低估波基神经算子处理器的真实误差规模，应引入对抗式最坏器件搜索来刻画部署时的误差上界风险。

title: Foundation Model-Aided Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning for Wireless Random Access Network Optimization
comment: This paper has been accepted in ACM International Symposium on Theory, Algorithmic Foundations, and Protocol Design for Mobile Networks and Mobile Computing (MobiHoc) 2026
summary: Random access (RA) is one of the most foundational medium access control (MAC) layer scheduling schemes for handling unpredictable data traffic from multiple terminals. While multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) has been explored to optimize RA-based wireless networks, its reliance on experience-driven, distributed policy learning incurs significant training overhead for each optimization task, limiting its feasibility in real-world applications. In this work, we propose to leverage a foundation model (FM) to improve MARL efficiency across diverse RA network optimization tasks. Specifically, we design an FM-aided actor-critic algorithm within a consensus-based decentralized MARL architecture and provide its convergence analysis under local reward exchanges and nonlinear value function approximations to show that our algorithm achieves the same convergence order as the conventional MARL with critic model exchanges and linear approximations. Our numerical results show that our FM-based approach significantly enhances MARL speed for RA network optimization.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于基础模型（FM）辅助的actor-critic算法，嵌入基于共识的去中心化MARL架构，以提升随机接入（RA）网络优化中多智能体强化学习的训练效率，并给出收敛性分析。
AI.motivation: RA是处理多终端不可预测流量的基础MAC层调度方案，MARL虽可用于优化RA无线网络，但其依赖经验驱动的分布式策略学习，每个优化任务都需大量训练开销，限制了实际部署可行性。因此需要提升MARL在不同RA优化任务中的效率。
AI.method: 设计FM辅助的actor-critic算法，将其嵌入基于共识（consensus-based）的去中心化MARL架构中；在局部奖励交换与非线性值函数近似条件下进行收敛性分析。
AI.result: 收敛性分析表明，该算法达到与传统MARL（使用critic模型交换与线性近似）相同的收敛阶；数值结果显示基于FM的方法显著提升了RA网络优化的MARL训练速度。
AI.conclusion: 利用基础模型可有效提升MARL在多类RA网络优化任务中的效率，且不牺牲收敛性能，为RA网络的实用化智能优化提供了可行途径。

title: Which and When to Admit: Gradient Admission for Data-Centric Small Language Model Finetuning
summary: LoRA fine-tuning adapts small language models (SLMs) to heterogeneous instruction data within a low-rank update subspace, making it vulnerable to three structural problems: conflicting gradients that cancel, static data selection that cannot track evolving learning dynamics, and subspace saturation that causes later updates to overwrite useful directions. We argue that effective adaptation therefore requires controlling which data-induced gradients enter the LoRA subspace and when. We propose GRADE (GRadient-Aligned Data-centric rEcipe), a data-centric framework combining two mechanisms: a state-aware selector that continually admits samples aligned with the evolving multi-task gradient field, and a self-calibrating step-level gate that rejects updates likely to cause destructive overwrite near saturation. Across three current-generation backbones and a heterogeneous seven-dataset instruction pool, GRADE outperforms strong data-selection and PEFT-stabilization baselines in accuracy and robustness. It is the only method to improve consistently over standard LoRA on every architecture, while producing more coherent gradient trajectories and less destructive overwrite. These results show that successful SLM adaptation depends not only on which data are selected, but also on which gradients are allowed to enter and persist in the constrained update subspace.

AI.tldr: 提出GRADE数据中心框架，通过状态感知样本选择与自校准步级门控，控制进入LoRA子空间的梯度，缓解梯度冲突、静态选样与子空间饱和三大问题。
AI.motivation: LoRA微调在异构指令数据下存在三个结构性问题：梯度冲突导致相互抵消、静态数据选择无法跟踪动态学习过程、低秩子空间饱和使后期更新覆盖有用方向。因此有效适配需要控制哪些数据诱导的梯度进入LoRA子空间以及何时进入。
AI.method: GRADE（GRadient-Aligned Data-centric rEcipe）包含两个机制：(1) 状态感知选择器，持续纳入与演化中的多任务梯度场对齐的样本；(2) 自校准步级门控，拒绝在接近饱和时可能造成破坏性覆盖的更新。
AI.result: 在三种当代骨干模型和包含七个数据集的异构指令池上，GRADE在准确率和鲁棒性上优于强数据选择与PEFT稳定化基线；是唯一在所有架构上一致优于标准LoRA的方法，并产生更连贯的梯度轨迹和更少的破坏性覆盖。
AI.conclusion: 成功的SLM适配不仅取决于选择哪些数据，还取决于允许哪些梯度进入并在受限更新子空间中持久保留。

title: Global Transport Couplings for Classifier-Free Guided Flows
summary: Optimal-transport couplings have been shown to reduce training variance in unconditional flow models, but their role in conditional generation remains unclear. A natural approach constructs separate couplings for each condition, but this is impractical for large or continuous conditioning spaces found in modern image foundation models. We introduce Global Transport (GT), a global class-agnostic optimal-transport coupling, computed without class labels. GT can associate different conditions with different regions of the source noise, and consequently worsens performance without guidance. However, when combined with classifier-free guidance (CFG), GT consistently improves generation across domains, model scales, and sampling budgets. This reversal suggests that couplings for conditional flows should be evaluated both empirically and theoretically under the guided flow used at inference, rather than on unguided generation. We evaluate GT over both discrete class and continuous text conditioned image generation across model scales, and investigate how coupling choice alters guided trajectories. These results identify coupling design in the guided flow setting as a simple training time axis to improve performance without modifying existing architectures, samplers, or guidance mechanisms.

AI.tldr: 提出全局传输（GT）——一种无需类别标签的全局类别无关最优传输耦合，在无引导时性能变差，但与CFG结合后跨领域、模型规模和采样预算一致提升生成质量，提示条件流的耦合设计应在推理所用的引导流下评估。
AI.motivation: 最优传输耦合已被证明能降低无条件流模型的训练方差，但其在条件生成中的作用尚不明确。直观做法是为每个条件构造单独的耦合，然而对于现代图像基础模型所面临的大规模或连续条件空间并不可行。因此需要一种可扩展的耦合设计，并厘清耦合在条件流中的真实作用。
AI.method: 提出Global Transport（GT）：一种全局、类别无关的最优传输耦合，计算时不使用类别标签，可将不同条件关联到源噪声的不同区域。在离散类别条件与连续文本条件的图像生成任务上评估GT，覆盖不同模型规模，并结合classifier-free guidance（CFG）分析耦合选择如何改变引导轨迹，同时在引导流下对耦合进行经验与理论评估。
AI.result: GT在无引导设置下因将不同条件映射到源噪声不同区域而降低性能；但与CFG结合后，GT在多个领域、模型规模和采样预算下均一致提升生成质量。这种反转现象在离散类别和连续文本条件、不同模型规模上均得到验证。
AI.conclusion: 条件流的耦合应在推理时实际使用的引导流下进行评估，而非仅基于无引导生成。耦合设计构成了引导流设定下一条简单的训练时改进轴，无需修改现有架构、采样器或引导机制即可提升性能。

title: TAFFY: A Task-Adaptive Tabular Foundation Model with In-Context Diversity
summary: Recent progress in tabular foundation models suggests that training on synthetic tasks can substantially improve in-context learning capabilities, with overall performance largely depending on how well models can infer task-specific predictive relationships from the available context during inference. In this paper, we introduce TAFFY, a tabular foundation model with an In-Context Diversity Prior and a Task-Conditioned Looped Transformer that strengthen this ability. Specifically, to construct each synthetic pretraining context, the In-Context Diversity Prior samples from multiple related environments derived via controlled interventions and distribution shifts on a shared causal process. This in-context diversity encourages the model to learn a more comprehensive and task-specific representation. Moreover, the Task-Conditioned Looped Transformer iteratively and selectively applies a shared group of Transformer blocks to refine contextual representations, with a task-conditioned gate modulating the final hidden-state update. This enables task-adaptive iterative refinement. Together, these components encourage the model to identify predictive relationships from contextual contrasts during pretraining and dynamically modulate context integration for each task. Across six classification and five regression benchmark datasets, TAFFY attains the lowest average rank.

AI.tldr: TAFFY是一种表格基础模型，通过上下文多样性先验和任务条件循环Transformer增强从上下文推断任务特定预测关系的能力，在6个分类和5个回归基准上取得最低平均排名。
AI.motivation: 表格基础模型的上下文学习性能主要取决于模型能否从可用上下文中推断出任务特定的预测关系。现有方法在构造合成预训练任务时，上下文多样性不足，且上下文整合方式缺乏任务自适应性，限制了模型学习全面且任务特定的表示。
AI.method: TAFFY包含两个核心组件：(1) 上下文多样性先验（In-Context Diversity Prior）：在共享因果过程上通过受控干预和分布偏移，从多个相关环境中采样构造合成预训练上下文，引入上下文对比以鼓励学习任务特定表示；(2) 任务条件循环Transformer（Task-Conditioned Looped Transformer）：迭代且选择性地对一组共享Transformer块进行复用，以精化上下文表示，并用任务条件门控调节最终隐状态更新，实现任务自适应的迭代精化。
AI.result: 在6个分类和5个回归基准数据集上，TAFFY取得了最低的平均排名。
AI.conclusion: 通过在预训练中引入上下文多样性对比，并结合任务条件的迭代精化机制，TAFFY能够有效识别预测关系并动态调节上下文整合，从而在表格分类与回归任务上优于现有方法。

title: Complementary Feature Domains: Information Preservation Does Not Imply Predictive-Contribution Preservation
summary: Complementary Feature Domains (CFD) theory characterizes predictive value as a context-indexed contribution system induced jointly by representations and their realization family. We show that Shannon-information preservation does not imply preservation of this contribution system: an invertible representation transformation can leave target information unchanged while altering predictive contribution under a restricted decision family. We formalize the resulting transition through a CFD contribution defect that measures how contextual contributions change under controlled recoding. For bounded Lipschitz utility, we show that each coalition utility shift is bounded by the behavioral distance between the attainable action sets before and after recoding; consequently, every contextual contribution defect is bounded by the sum of the corresponding coalition incompatibilities. Exact behavioral closure yields invariance, while increasingly accurate compensation yields restoration. A controlled ECG experiment illustrates the mechanism: a nonlinear bijective recoding preserves the information in a frozen time-frequency representation but changes accuracy under a fixed affine learner; applying the exact inverse restores all tested coalition accuracies. The result separates information preservation from realization-dependent contribution and provides a quantitative transition law for multi-representation prediction.

AI.tldr: 论文提出互补特征域（CFD）理论，指出Shannon信息保持不等价于预测贡献保持：可逆表示变换可在信息不变条件下改变受限决策族下的预测贡献，并给出贡献缺陷的过渡定律。
AI.motivation: 传统观点将预测价值等同于信息的保留，但表示与其实现族共同决定预测贡献。作者希望区分"信息保持"与"实现依赖的贡献保持"，解释为何可逆变换仍会改变预测表现，并量化这种转变。
AI.method: 形式化CFD贡献缺陷，度量受控重编码下上下文贡献的变化。针对有界Lipschitz效用，证明每个联盟效用偏移由重编码前后可达动作集之间的行为距离界定，从而将上下文贡献缺陷界定为相应联盟不兼容性之和。分析精确行为闭包（不变性）与逐步精确补偿（恢复性）两种情形。用受控ECG实验验证：非线性双射重编码保持冻结时频表示中的信息，但在固定仿射学习器下改变准确率；施加精确逆变换后恢复所有测试联盟准确率。
AI.result: 理论上：任一联盟效用偏移受可达动作集行为距离上界约束，故每个上下文贡献缺陷受联盟不兼容性之和约束；精确行为闭包导致不变性，渐近精确补偿导致恢复。实验上：非线性双射重编码不改变冻结时频表示的信息量却改变固定仿射学习器的准确率，精确逆变换可恢复全部测试联盟准确率。
AI.conclusion: 研究将信息保持与实现依赖的预测贡献严格分离，为多表示预测提供了定量过渡定律，说明预测价值是表示与其实现族共同诱导的上下文索引贡献系统。

title: Mechanistic Interpretability of Atmospheric Rivers in GraphCast
summary: While AI weather models now rival operational forecasts, how they represent the atmosphere internally remains an open question: feature attribution reveals which input patterns matter, not what the model computes or how it combines information internally. We train sparse autoencoders (SAEs) on GraphCast to uncover its learned concepts, using atmospheric rivers as our phenomenon of focus. Both standard and Matryoshka SAEs show GraphCast computes atmospheric river intensity, measured by integrated vapor transport (IVT), as a stable internal variable, despite IVT being neither an input nor a target. In contrast to the unstructured concept retrieval of the standard SAE, the Matryoshka SAE orders concepts by importance and exposes their relations. Atmospheric river concepts persist across depth and direct interventions confirm causality. This method offers a way to find internal variables and determine which of them the model actually relies on, which is a prerequisite for asking whether those variables remain meaningful as the phenomenon changes under a warming climate.

AI.tldr: 该研究用稀疏自编码器（SAE）在GraphCast中提取内部概念，发现模型虽然未将大气河强度（IVT）作为输入或预测目标，却将其计算为稳定的内部变量；Matryoshka SAE还能按重要性排序并揭示概念间关系，干预实验证实其因果作用。
AI.motivation: 当前AI天气模型在预报性能上已可与业务模式媲美，但其内部如何表征大气仍不清楚。既有特征归因方法只能说明哪些输入模式重要，无法揭示模型内部计算什么、如何组合信息，因此需要一种能刻画模型内部概念的机制可解释性方法。
AI.method: 在GraphCast上训练稀疏自编码器（SAE），包括标准SAE与Matryoshka SAE，以大气河为关注现象，检测模型中是否存在与大气河强度（以积分水汽输送IVT度量）对应的内部概念变量，并通过跨深度分析和对内部表示的因果干预验证其作用。
AI.result: 标准SAE与Matryoshka SAE均显示GraphCast将IVT计算为稳定的内部变量，尽管IVT既非输入也非目标；标准SAE的概念检索是无结构的，而Matryoshka SAE能按重要性对概念排序并揭示概念间关系；大气河概念在深度方向上持续存在，干预实验证实其因果性。
AI.conclusion: SAE方法可用于发现模型的内部变量，并判断哪些变量被模型真正依赖，这为研究这些内部变量在气候变暖导致现象变化时是否仍具意义提供了前提。

title: Hub for Outliers, Spokes for Inliers: Uniform Latent Space Construction for Dual-Mismatched Semi-Supervised Learning
comment: Equal contribution by Li Yuan and Yaxin Hou. Corresponding author: Yuheng Jia. Emails: {yuan-li,yaxin,230259148,yhjia}@seu.edu.cn, gaoyb@qlu.edu.cn. 18 pages
summary: Semi-supervised learning typically assumes that labeled and unlabeled data share an identical class distribution and label space. However, this setting is often violated: unlabeled data may be imbalanced and contain unknown class samples, causing mismatches in both class distribution and label space. Such dual mismatch leads to majority classes dominating the latent space and unknown class samples being overconfidently misclassified, degrading feature discriminability and pseudo-label quality. To address this, we propose a hub-spoke latent geometry, where known classes are uniformly distributed around a central hub and each class forms compact clusters around its prototype, while the hub provides an anchor for a low-evidence region specifically designed for high-uncertainty unknown class samples. Integrated with an evidence-based classifier, this geometry ultimately enhances feature discriminability and uncertainty separation by mitigating majority-class domination through structured feature organization and guiding high-uncertainty unknown class samples toward the hub. Extensive experiments show that our method outperforms state-of-the-art methods, with a maximum improvement of 3.25% across various settings.

AI.tldr: 本文针对半监督学习中类别分布与标签空间双重不匹配问题，提出"轮毂-辐条"（hub-spoke）隐空间几何结构，将已知类均匀分布在中心轮毂周围并形成紧凑簇，轮毂作为高不确定性未知类的低证据锚点区域，结合证据分类器提升特征判别性与不确定性分离，实验最多提升3.25%。
AI.motivation: 半监督学习通常假设有标签与无标签数据共享相同的类别分布与标签空间，但现实中无标签数据往往类别不均衡且包含未知类样本，导致类别分布与标签空间的双重不匹配。这种不匹配会造成多数类主导隐空间、未知类样本被过度自信地误分类，从而损害特征判别性和伪标签质量。
AI.method: 提出轮毂-辐条（hub-spoke）隐空间几何结构：已知类均匀分布在中心轮毂周围，每类围绕其原型形成紧凑簇；轮毂作为低证据区域的锚点，专门用于容纳高不确定性的未知类样本。该几何与基于证据（evidence-based）的分类器相结合。
AI.result: 通过结构化特征组织缓解多数类主导，并引导高不确定性未知类样本向轮毂聚集，从而提升特征判别性和不确定性分离。在多种设置下的广泛实验表明，该方法优于现有最先进方法，最大提升达3.25%。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的hub-spoke隐空间几何结合证据分类器，能有效应对类别分布与标签空间的双重不匹配问题，在多种半监督场景中取得领先性能。

title: AFA-BANDIT: Provably Near-Optimal Online Multi-Feature Classification Under Budget Constraints
summary: Active Feature Acquisition (AFA) is a classification problem in which an agent decides which costly features to acquire before predicting each sample's label. Unlike batch AFA, which trains a fixed policy and classifier offline on fully observed data, online AFA updates its predictor from revealed labels as samples arrive. Existing online methods either use deep reinforcement learning (RL) without performance guarantees or maximize cost-adjusted reward rather than enforce a global budget. We formulate online AFA as a combinatorial Bandits with Knapsacks (BwK) problem that couples acquisition and prediction. Unlike prior bandit-based AFA and classical BwK, our setting has combinatorial complexity, evolving rewards, a global budget, and structured side information. We obtain an improved regret upper bound over standard BwK bounds in this framework, leveraging a cardinality-aware confidence bound and the subset update structure. To avoid an exponentially large action space, we propose \emph{LP-Chain}, a variant that searches a cost-aware chain of feature subsets with a size that grows linearly with the number of features. While the regret upper bound is specific to the combinatorial framework, \emph{LP-Chain} empirically achieves comparable predictive performance. On synthetic data, \emph{LP-Chain} outperforms HEDGE-based BwK and deep RL-based online AFA baselines and scales favorably to more features.

AI.tldr: 本文将在线主动特征获取（AFA）建模为带背包的组合赌博机（BwK）问题，提出LP-Chain算法在预算约束下联合优化特征获取与预测，取得更优遗憾上界并在实验中优于基线。
AI.motivation: 在线AFA需要在样本到达时从揭示的标签中更新预测器并决定获取哪些代价高昂的特征。现有在线方法要么使用深度强化学习而缺乏性能保证，要么只最大化代价调整后的奖励而无法强制全局预算约束。因此需要一个既有理论保证又能满足全局预算的在线AFA框架。
AI.method: 将在线AFA形式化为带背包的组合赌博机问题，耦合特征获取与预测决策，问题具有组合复杂度、动态奖励、全局预算和结构化边信息。提出基数感知置信界并利用子集更新结构以获得改进的遗憾上界；为规避指数级动作空间，设计LP-Chain，在随特征数线性增长的子集链上进行代价感知搜索。
AI.result: 在该框架下获得优于标准BwK界的遗憾上界；LP-Chain尽管遗憾上界针对组合框架，但在经验上取得可比的预测性能。在合成数据上，LP-Chain优于基于HEDGE的BwK和基于深度RL的在线AFA基线，并能良好扩展到更多特征。
AI.conclusion: 将在线AFA统一为组合BwK问题，既提供了带全局预算的理论保证，又通过LP-Chain实现可扩展的高效求解，验证了组合赌博机视角在在线主动特征获取中的有效性。

title: Complementary Supervised and Self-Supervised Representations for Out-of-Distribution Graph Learning
summary:
Out-of-distribution (OOD) generalization remains challenging for graph neural networks (GNNs), as graph distributions can vary substantially across time and domains. Supervised and self-supervised graph representation learning are guided by distinct objectives and offer different perspectives on graph representations. In this work, we study whether self-supervised representations (SSL) can provide complementary signals to improve supervised OOD node classification. We develop two backbone-agnostic frameworks that exploit such information at different stages of learning and prediction. Co-Train jointly learns supervised and SSL representations and adaptively integrates them during training, while Dual-Space Retrieval performs non-parametric prediction in the two representation spaces and combines their predictions through confidence-aware fusion at inference time. The supervised and SSL encoders are separately parameterized and need not share the same GNN architecture.
  We evaluate multiple GNN backbones and two distinct SSL objectives, DGI and GRACE, on four graph benchmarks spanning temporal and cross-domain distribution shifts. Extensive experiments show that Co-Train consistently outperforms strong supervised OOD baselines, while Dual-Space Retrieval achieves competitive performance as a flexible non-parametric alternative. Results across different backbones and SSL objectives, together with representation analyses and ablations, demonstrate that SSL representations provide complementary information to supervised representations and can improve OOD node classification across diverse settings.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究自监督表示（SSL）能否为监督式OOD节点分类提供互补信号，提出两种与骨干无关的框架Co-Train和Dual-Space Retrieval，并在多个图基准上验证其有效性。
AI.motivation: 图神经网络（GNN）的分布外（OOD）泛化仍然具有挑战性，因为图分布会随时间和领域发生显著变化。监督式与自监督式图表示学习由不同目标驱动，能提供关于图表示的不同视角，因此作者希望探究SSL表示能否为监督式OOD节点分类提供互补信息。
