AI.method: 作者提出两种与骨干无关的框架，在不同学习与预测阶段利用SSL信息。Co-Train联合学习监督表示与SSL表示，并在训练过程中自适应地融合二者；Dual-Space Retrieval则在两个表示空间中进行非参数预测，并在推理阶段通过置信度感知融合合并预测结果。监督编码器与SSL编码器分别参数化，且无需共享相同的GNN架构。
AI.result: 作者在四个涵盖时间与跨域分布偏移的图基准上，评估了多种GNN骨干以及两种不同的SSL目标（DGI和GRACE）。实验表明，Co-Train持续优于强监督式OOD基线，而Dual-Space Retrieval作为一种灵活的非参数替代方案也取得了有竞争力的性能。
AI.conclusion: 不同骨干与SSL目标下的结果，结合表示分析和消融实验，表明SSL表示能够为监督表示提供互补信息，并能在多种设置下提升OOD节点分类性能。

title: Does On-Policy Distillation for Safety Pose Backdoor Risks?
summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) has attracted growing attention as an effective way to transfer capabilities from teacher models to student models. Recent studies further explore OPD as a tool for improving large language model safety with promising results. However, these approaches typically assume that the teacher and training data are trustworthy. In this paper, we uncover an overlooked threat to OPD for safety: a safety-aligned but backdoored teacher can propagate its hidden malicious behavior to an initially clean student. Under our threat model, a poisoning rate as low as 3% results in an attack success rate (ASR) of up to 70% on the distilled student. We further identify two training choices that can amplify this risk. First, increasing the number of training epochs can lead to high ASR even at low poisoning rates. With only 10 poisoned samples, ASR reaches 67% after 16 epochs. Second, the commonly used top-k KL can accelerate backdoor transfer, causing trigger-conditioned harmful behavior to emerge earlier than sampled-token KL in most settings. Alongside these findings, we explore a simple mitigation, Lazy Defense, which clips KL rewards to make student updates less aggressive, limiting aggressive updates and slowing backdoor learning. Experiments show that Lazy Defense delays backdoor transfer in low poisoning rate settings. Together, our findings reveal that OPD can propagate backdoors, highlighting the need to address the safety risks of OPD.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示在线策略蒸馏（OPD）用于安全对齐时存在被忽视的后门传播威胁：安全对齐但含后门的教师可将隐藏恶意行为传递给初始干净的学生模型，并分析放大风险的因素及一种简单缓解方法。
AI.motivation: 近期研究将OPD作为提升大语言模型安全性的手段并取得进展，但这些方法通常假设教师模型与训练数据是可信的。作者旨在揭示这一假设下被忽视的安全威胁，即OPD可能传播后门。
AI.method: 在设定的威胁模型下，使用安全对齐但含后门的教师模型对初始干净的学生模型进行OPD；系统研究毒化率、训练轮数与KL目标形式（top-k KL vs. 采样token KL）对后门转移的影响；并提出Lazy Defense，通过裁剪KL奖励抑制学生更新幅度。
AI.result: 仅3%毒化率即可使蒸馏学生模型ASR高达70%；增加训练轮数会放大风险，仅10个毒化样本在16轮后ASR达67%；top-k KL在多数设置下比采样token KL更快诱发触发器条件下的有害行为。Lazy Defense在低毒化率下可延迟后门转移。
AI.conclusion: OPD能够传播后门，说明其安全风险不容忽视；需要针对OPD的安全隐患进行进一步研究与防护。

title: MS-ECG-FM: Towards a More Universal Electrocardiogram Foundation Model for Health Monitoring using Multi-source Contrastive Learning
comment: Andrew C. Miller, Joseph Futoma: equal contribution. 52 pages, 4 figures, 20 tables, including supplementary information
summary: Electrocardiography (ECG) records the electrical activity of the heart, aiding diagnosis by detecting abnormalities in cardiac function. ECG foundation models have demonstrated promising results, but are limited by a reliance on ECG interpretation reports as their sole supervision. Because interpretation reports only capture the subset of waveform information routinely recognized by clinicians, this constrains representation learning to overlook the broader diagnostic signals present in ECG. We introduce a new ECG foundation model --- MS-ECG-FM --- that is trained through contrastive alignment to multiple distinct clinical note types, including ECG, echocardiography, radiology, and discharge reports. We evaluate MS-ECG-FM on an extended set of ECG detection benchmarks, showing that it comprehensively outperforms existing methods on the full span of conditions that ECG can detect, including in reduced-lead configurations. Different reports improve representations for different diagnostic domains, while multi-source alignment captures their complementary information and produces consistently strong representations across clinically diverse tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 ECG 基础模型 MS-ECG-FM，通过将 ECG 表征与多种临床报告（心电、超声心动、放射、出院报告）进行对比对齐训练，在扩展的 ECG 检测基准上全面超越现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有 ECG 基础模型仅以 ECG 解读报告作为唯一监督信号。由于解读报告只涵盖临床医生常规识别的部分波形信息，这种单一监督限制了表征学习，使模型忽略 ECG 中更广泛的诊断信号。
AI.method: 提出 MS-ECG-FM，采用对比对齐（contrastive alignment）训练，将 ECG 表征与 ECG、超声心动、放射、出院报告等多种不同类型的临床报告进行多源对齐。
AI.result: 在扩展的 ECG 检测基准上，MS-ECG-FM 全面优于现有方法，覆盖 ECG 可检测的全部病种范围，在减少导联配置下同样表现优异。不同报告对不同诊断领域有各自增益，多源对齐能捕捉其互补信息。
AI.conclusion: 多源报告对齐可产生跨临床多样任务均稳定强健的表征，多类型临床报告监督优于单一解读报告监督，为 ECG 基础模型提供了更具泛化性的表征学习范式。

title: Exact-Solution Volume and Length Generalization in Transformers
summary: Research on transformer expressivity shows whether a transformer is capable of solving a given task, but gives little indication of whether the solution, if learned, is generalizable to longer input lengths. We study this question through normalized exact-solution volume (NESV): the fraction of a bounded parameter region that achieves an exact solution on every input of length $n$. For fixed-width, single-layer transformers with $\log n$-scaled attention, we establish asymptotic bounds on NESV for four tasks: FIRST ($Θ(1)$), MAJORITY ($Θ(1/(n\log n))$), INDEX ($Θ(1/n^3)$), and PARITY ($0$). These results are consistent with previous empirical results: the faster the exact-solution volume decays with input length, the harder it is to length-generalize on that task. Looking deeper into INDEX, our volume analysis reveals two error sources that grow with $n$. Consequently, we study a transformer model that would structurally eliminate one of the terms, theoretically improving the NESV bound to $Θ(n^{-1})$, and empirically achieving 85% accuracy when tested at $10\times$ the training length, compared with the 60% accuracy of the original model. We conclude that volume analysis may be a useful approach to identify concrete sources of length sensitivity and thus provide insights into task-specific model refinements.

AI.tldr: 本文提出归一化精确解体积（NESV）指标，用以衡量Transformer学到的解能否泛化到更长输入长度，并对四个任务给出了渐近界。
AI.motivation: 现有关于Transformer表达性的研究只能说明其"能否"解决某任务，却无法指示所学到的解是否具备长度泛化性，因此需要一个刻画解随输入长度衰减程度的量化框架。
AI.method: 定义NESV为在长度为n的所有输入上均取得精确解的参数区域（有界参数空间内）占比；针对固定宽度、单层、注意力按logn缩放的Transformer，对FIRST、MAJORITY、INDEX、PARITY四个任务推导NESV的渐近界；并进一步对INDEX进行体积分析以定位随n增长的误差来源，据此设计结构上消除其中一项误差的模型。
AI.result: NESV渐近界为：FIRST为Θ(1)，MAJORITY为Θ(1/(nlogn))，INDEX为Θ(1/n^3)，PARITY为0。结果与以往经验观察一致：精确解体积随长度衰减越快，长度泛化越难。对INDEX的误差分解显示两项随n增长的误差来源；改进模型理论上将界提升至Θ(n^{-1})，实验中在10倍训练长度下达到85%准确率，而原模型仅60%。
AI.conclusion: 体积分析可作为识别长度敏感性具体来源的有效手段，进而为任务特定的模型改进提供指导。

title: Adaptive Model Inversion Attacks Generalize a Privacy-Robustness Tradeoff
summary:
In this paper, we show that standard evaluations of high-resolution Model Inversion Attacks (MIAs) significantly underestimate training-data privacy leakage. State-of-the-art privacy defenses, standard training techniques such as MixUp and Adversarial Training, and undefended models all leak training images at rates 1.16 to 6.59 times higher on FaceScrub under simple adaptive changes to the attack, with the largest increases among defenses reporting the strongest privacy. We further show that measured leakage depends on the feature basis of the external classifier used to evaluate reconstructions: for the same reconstructed images, an adversarially trained Inception evaluator identifies the targeted identity at different rates than the standard Inception evaluator. Our results suggest that standard MIA evaluation can mistake optimization and measurement failures for privacy.
  These underestimated leakage rates also concealed a broader relationship between privacy and adversarial robustness. Once we adapt the attack and vary the evaluator, reconstruction leakage closely tracks adversarial robustness across recent defenses and standard training regimes, suggesting that robustness provides an attack-agnostic proxy for reconstruction vulnerability that applies far more broadly than previously theorized. This raises an open question: can a practical defense reduce training-data reconstruction without paying a corresponding cost in adversarial robustness?

AI.tldr: 该论文指出，高分辨率模型反演攻击（MIA）的标准评估显著低估了训练数据隐私泄露；通过自适应调整攻击与更换评估器，泄露率上升1.16–6.59倍，且隐私泄露与对抗鲁棒性高度相关。
AI.motivation: 现有高分辨率模型反演攻击的评估流程（固定攻击方式、固定评估器）可能同时高估防御效果并掩盖真实的隐私泄露，导致学界对隐私-鲁棒性关系的理论理解存在偏差。作者希望揭示标准评估中的优化失败与度量失败，并重新审视隐私与对抗鲁棒性的关系。
AI.method: 在FaceScrub数据集上，对最先进隐私防御、MixUp、对抗训练及无防御模型进行标准MIA评估，并施加简单的自适应攻击改动；同时更换用于评估重建结果的外部分类器的特征基底（标准Inception与对抗训练Inception），对比同一重建图像在不同评估器下的身份识别率。
AI.result: 标准评估下的泄露率被低估：自适应改动后，各模型的训练图像泄露率提高1.16至6.59倍，且声称隐私最强的防御增幅最大。同一重建图像在对抗训练Inception与标准Inception评估器下的目标身份识别率不同，说明泄露度量依赖评估器特征基底。调整攻击与评估器后，重建泄露率与对抗鲁棒性在近期防御和标准训练范式中紧密相关。
AI.conclusion: 标准MIA评估会把优化失败与度量失败误认为隐私保护；对抗鲁棒性可作为重建脆弱性的攻击无关代理指标，适用范围比以往理论更广。由此提出开放问题：是否存在一种实用防御，能在不付出对抗鲁棒性代价的前提下降低训练数据重建风险？

title: WASD: Wasserstein-based Knowledge Distillation for Large Language Models
summary: Autoregressive large language models (LLMs) have rapidly advanced in capability, but their increasing scale comes with substantial computational and memory costs at inference time. Knowledge distillation (KD) offers a practical solution by transferring knowledge from a large teacher model to a smaller student model via alignment of discrete probability distributions. However, existing KD methods for LLMs primarily rely on divergences that evaluate discrepancies through probability values at each vocabulary index, without explicitly leveraging token-level semantic information. We propose Wasserstein-based knowledge distillation (WASD) for LLMs, which incorporates token-level semantic information via the Wasserstein-based distance with a cost matrix derived from token embeddings. To ensure computational tractability, we adopt the Sinkhorn divergence and derive a gradient-equivalent objective that can be efficiently optimized without introducing additional networks. Experiments across multiple LLM families and scales show that WASD consistently improves distillation performance on diverse tasks, including instruction following, mathematical reasoning, and code generation. Our results highlight the importance of semantic information encoded in the token space for effective distribution alignment in LLM distillation. The implementation is publicly available at https://github.com/aailab-kaist/WASD .

AI.tldr: 提出WASD方法，利用基于token嵌入的Wasserstein距离进行大语言模型知识蒸馏，通过Sinkhorn散度实现可计算优化，在多种任务上稳定提升蒸馏效果。
AI.motivation: 自回归大语言模型规模增长带来推理时的计算与内存开销，知识蒸馏是压缩模型的实用方案。但现有LLM蒸馏方法主要依赖逐词表索引上的概率值来度量分布差异，未显式利用token级别的语义信息。
AI.method: 提出Wasserstein-based knowledge distillation（WASD），将token嵌入导出的代价矩阵引入Wasserstein距离，从而在分布对齐中纳入token级语义信息；为保证计算可行性，采用Sinkhorn散度并推导出梯度等价的目标函数，无需引入额外网络即可高效优化。
AI.result: 在多个LLM系列与不同规模上的实验表明，WASD在指令跟随、数学推理和代码生成等多样化任务上均稳定提升蒸馏性能。
AI.conclusion: 结果凸显了token空间中所编码的语义信息对于LLM蒸馏中有效分布对齐的重要性，代码已公开。

title: Neuromotor Hierarchy Network: Physiological Inductive Biases for Robust Generalization in sEMG Decoding
summary: Surface electromyography (sEMG) provides a wearable, noninvasive interface to neuromuscular activity for movement decoding and human-computer interaction. Population-scale decoding remains difficult because the relationship between sEMG and neuromuscular activity varies across users and sessions, while task-relevant dynamics span channels and multiple timescales. Learning waveform-to-output mappings from task labels leaves the distinction between recording variability and coordinated motor activity implicit. We introduce the Neuromotor Hierarchy Network (NHN), which learns a compact latent neuromotor state from task supervision to represent task-relevant neuromuscular coordination. NHN constructs this latent state through a hierarchy inspired by neuromotor organization.It adapts recording statistics while preserving relative intensity.Its spatiotemporal encoder uses parameter-efficient channel interactions and modulates features with multi-timescale history. The resulting features yield candidate activations of learned motor primitives, which are temporally integrated and continuously weighted to form the state. Theoretical analysis characterizes the efficiency, temporal behavior, and optimization of NHN's core mechanisms. We evaluate the architecture for both continuous hand-pose estimation on emg2pose and touch-typing recognition on emg2qwerty. On emg2pose, NHN reduces user-averaged angular error by 0.52% to 2.84% across all three generalization splits in both Regression and Tracking relative to Hadidi et al.'s best task-specific variants, using 48.42% to 48.51% fewer parameters. On emg2qwerty, NHN reduces beam-search character error rate by 19.40% zero-shot and 30.42% after fine-tuning relative to SplashNet-Upscale, using 65.86% fewer parameters. Physiology-guided inference of a latent neuromotor state supports parameter-efficient sEMG decoding.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出神经运动层级网络（NHN），在任务监督下学习紧凑的潜在神经运动状态以表征任务相关的神经肌肉协调，在sEMG手部姿态估计与打字识别任务上以更少参数取得更优性能。
AI.motivation: sEMG可提供可穿戴、无创的神经肌肉活动接口，但群体级解码困难：sEMG与神经肌肉活动的关系因用户和会话而异，且任务相关动态跨通道、跨多个时间尺度。从任务标签学习波形到输出的映射，会使"记录变异性"与"协调的运动活动"之间的区分保持隐含状态。因此需要一种能显式建模任务相关神经肌肉协调的表示学习框架。
AI.method: 提出神经运动层级网络（NHN），在任务监督下学习紧凑的潜在神经运动状态。其结构受神经运动组织启发：先进行记录统计的自适应，同时保留相对强度；采用时空编码器，使用参数高效的通道交互，并用多时间尺度历史调制特征；由此产生所学运动基元的候选激活，经时间整合与连续加权形成潜在状态。文中还从理论层面刻画了核心机制的高效性、时间行为与优化特性。
AI.result: 在emg2pose连续手部姿态估计上，NHN在Regression和Tracking两种设置、三种泛化划分下，相对Hadidi等人最佳任务专用变体将用户平均角度误差降低0.52%~2.84%，参数减少48.42%~48.51%。在emg2qwerty触屏打字识别上，NHN相对SplashNet-Upscale将束搜索字符错误率在零样本下降低19.40%，微调后降低30.42%，参数减少65.86%。
AI.conclusion: 以生理学为指导推断潜在神经运动状态，可支撑参数高效的sEMG解码，在跨用户、跨会话的多种任务上同时实现性能提升与参数压缩。

title: Cite What You Explore: Budget-Aware LLM Reasoning over Medical KGs with Verifiable Evidence
summary: Post-discharge risk prediction from electronic health records (EHRs) is difficult because many dependencies that link discharge-time observations to downstream complications, such as comorbidity cascades and drug-disease interactions, are absent from the record. External medical knowledge graphs (KGs) can supply these missing dependencies, but tracing them demands three properties: KG exploration must remain cost-bounded, retrieved evidence must be differentiated by source quality, and the resulting rationale must be citable for retrospective review. Large language models (LLMs) can plan and verify over structured evidence, making them natural candidates for KG reasoning, but existing LLM-based methods do not satisfy these three properties jointly. In this paper, we propose BAR, a Budget-Aware LLM Reasoning framework over medical KGs with three contributions. First, BAR refines the raw KG into disease-specific evidence graphs whose edges carry support scores and provenance records, turning the KG into a quality-annotated reasoning space rather than a static feature source. Second, an LLM then reasons over this graph through a plan-navigate-verify loop that decomposes the question into steps, retrieves evidence under a patient-specific budget, and revises when verification fails. Third, a reasoning policy is trained with a reward that compares predictions with and without acquired evidence, combined with acquisition cost and citation-integrity terms. Across 8 diseases and 3 prediction horizons on MIMIC-III and MIMIC-IV, BAR improves AUPRC by 3.4 points over the strongest baseline, raises citation precision from 59.8% to 77.9%, and consumes only 62-65% of the budget cap.

AI.tldr: 提出BAR框架：在医学知识图谱上进行预算感知的LLM推理，用于电子病历出院后风险预测，通过疾病特定证据图、计划-导航-验证循环及多目标奖励训练，提升预测性能与引用可核查性。
AI.motivation: 电子病历中出院时观测与后续并发症（如共病级联、药物-疾病交互）之间的依赖关系缺失，需借助外部医学知识图谱补充；而追踪这些依赖要求同时满足三点：探索成本有界、证据按来源质量区分、推理依据可引用以供回溯审查。现有基于LLM的方法无法同时满足这三项要求。
AI.method: BAR将原始知识图谱细化为疾病特定证据图，边上携带支持分数与溯源记录，形成带质量标注的推理空间；LLM在图上以"计划-导航-验证"循环推理：分解问题为步骤、在患者特定预算下检索证据、验证失败时修正；并以比较"有无获取证据"的预测差异、结合获取成本与引用完整性项构成的奖励训练推理策略。
AI.result: 在MIMIC-III与MIMIC-IV的8种疾病、3个预测时间跨度上，BAR相比最强基线AUPRC提升3.4个点，引用精确率从59.8%提升至77.9%，且仅消耗预算上限的62-65%。
AI.conclusion: BAR证明了将预算约束、证据质量标注与可引用推理机制结合于LLM驱动的知识图谱推理中，可有效提升出院后风险预测的性能并增强推理过程的可审查性。

title: Towards One-for-All Foundation Model for Attributed Graph Clustering
summary: Attributed graph clustering aims to discover node groups by jointly exploiting node attributes and graph topology, yet its unsupervised nature makes model selection and adaptation inherently difficult. Existing methods typically train and tune a separate model for each input graph, leading to costly and fragile pipelines that often fail to transfer across graphs with different feature spaces, structural patterns, and attribute-structure correlations. In this paper, we study a one-for-all alternative: can a single model be trained once and directly applied to diverse attributed graphs without graph-specific training, fine-tuning, or hyperparameter search? We propose OFAG, a foundation model for attributed graph clustering. Building upon Prior-data Fitted Networks, OFAG learns a reusable clustering inference strategy from synthetic attributed graphs generated under broad priors over latent clusters, node attributes, and graph structures. To handle incompatible feature spaces across graphs, OFAG adopts a dimension-agnostic signal-wise graph encoder that treats each feature channel as a graph signal and models its response to shared graph filters. The model is trained with a hyperspherical clustering objective, producing clustering-friendly node representations in a single forward pass at inference time. On ten datasets, one frozen OFAG model achieves the best mean performance and average rank across NMI, ACC, ARI, and F1, while completing all ten datasets in 12.43 minutes total---over 6* faster than the second-fastest baseline and nearly 28* faster than the second-best on clustering quality. Our code and pretrained checkpoint are available at https://github.com/Cloudy1225/OFAG, allowing practitioners to directly apply OFAG to their own attributed graph datasets without additional training or tuning.

AI.tldr: 提出属性图聚类基础模型OFAG，一次训练即可零样本迁移到多种属性图，无需图特定训练或调参。
AI.motivation: 现有属性图聚类方法需对每张图单独训练和调参，流程昂贵且脆弱，难以在特征空间、结构模式、属性-结构相关性不同的图之间迁移，且无监督特性使模型选择与适配本身困难。
AI.method: 基于Prior-data Fitted Networks（PFN），从潜在簇、节点属性、图结构的广泛先验下生成的合成属性图中学习可复用的聚类推断策略；采用维度无关的信号级图编码器，将每个特征通道视为图信号并建模其对共享图滤波器的响应，以应对特征空间不兼容；用超球聚类目标训练，推理时单次前向即得聚类友好表示。
AI.result: 在十个数据集上，一个冻结的OFAG模型在NMI、ACC、ARI、F1上取得最佳平均性能与平均排名，全部十个数据集共耗时12.43分钟，比第二快基线快6倍以上，比聚类质量第二好的方法快近28倍。
AI.conclusion: 单一冻结模型可实现跨属性图的一站式聚类，无需逐图训练、微调或超参搜索，并提供代码与预训练权重供直接应用。

title: ServeLearnBench: How Well Can Agents Self-Improve from Serving Experience?
summary: Large language model agents are increasingly deployed to perform complex tasks in real-world environments. However, the knowledge required for correct behavior in these environments is often implicit, undisclosed, and subject to change over time. Recent continual-learning harnesses seek to address this challenge by enabling agents to improve from serving experience. Yet the effectiveness and limitations of these methods are not yet well characterized. Existing benchmarks provide only partial coverage: some explicitly provide the target knowledge, others assume a static environment, and those that support continual adaptation remain limited in scale and knowledge diversity. To enable systematic evaluation, we formalize an evolving-environment streaming dataset (EESD), in which agents must infer, apply, and revise latent environment knowledge from interaction and outcome feedback as hidden policies evolve, and introduce ServeLearnBench, spanning retail support, banking, and sales-pitch generation with 53 environment windows and 7,718 tasks. We evaluate five learning harnesses (RAG, Mem0, SkillOpt, Continual Harness, and Prime) across six models (GPT-5.6 Terra, Opus 5, Kimi K3, GLM-5.3, DeepSeek V4.1 Flash, and GLM-5.3 Flash), covering 28 model-harness pairs and 252 learning runs. Our evaluation reveals three main findings: a substantial gap remains between task capability and learning from experience; continual adaptation is costly and can degrade already-correct behavior; and insufficient exploration emerges as a key bottleneck to effective adaptation. Overall, ServeLearnBench provides a controlled testbed for diagnosing these limitations and tracking progress toward agents that continually and reliably improve through serving experience.

AI.tldr: 本文提出演化环境流式数据集EESD与评测基准ServeLearnBench（覆盖零售支持、银行、销售话术生成；53个环境窗口、7718个任务），系统评估5种学习框架×6个模型共28对组合、252次学习运行，揭示经验学习与任务能力间的显著差距。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体在真实环境中执行复杂任务时，所需的环境知识往往隐式、未公开且随时间变化。已有持续学习评测存在三类局限：显式提供目标知识、假设环境静态、或虽支持持续适应但规模与知识多样性不足。因此需要可系统诊断的评测平台。
AI.method: 形式化提出演化环境流式数据集（EESD）：智能体须在隐藏策略演化过程中，从交互与结果反馈中推断、应用并修正潜在环境知识；基于此构建ServeLearnBench，涵盖零售支持、银行、销售话术生成三个领域，包含53个环境窗口、7718个任务。评测5种学习框架（RAG、Mem0、SkillOpt、Continual Harness、Prime）与6个模型（GPT-5.6 Terra、Opus 5、Kimi K3、GLM-5.3、DeepSeek V4.1 Flash、GLM-5.3 Flash），共28个"模型-框架"组合、252次学习运行。
AI.result: 三项主要发现：(1) 任务能力与"从经验中学习"的能力之间仍存在显著差距；(2) 持续适应代价高昂，且可能使原本正确的行为发生退化；(3) 探索不足是有效适应的关键瓶颈。
AI.conclusion: ServeLearnBench为诊断上述局限、追踪"能够通过服务经验持续可靠改进的智能体"研究进展，提供了受控测试平台。

title: The Geometry of Empowerment
summary: Empowerment captures the capacity for an agent to actively control its environment. While conceptually appealing as an information-theoretic quantity, the connection between empowerment and structurally central states that provide broad access to future outcomes has remained an open question. In this work, we link empowerment maximization and skill-learning methods to provide new geometries for interpreting and analyzing empowerment. Our analyses answer longstanding open questions on the connections between empowerment and structural centrality. Our analyses also reveal distinctions between information and reward geometries, highlighting important theoretical implications to build scalable empowerment-maximization methods. Website and code can be found at https://empowerment-geometry.github.io/.

AI.tldr: 本文建立"赋权最大化"与"技能学习"之间的联系，提出了解读与分析赋权的新几何框架，回答了赋权与结构中心性之间长期悬而未决的问题，并揭示了信息几何与奖励几何的差异。
AI.motivation: 赋权（empowerment）刻画智能体主动控制环境的能力，作为信息论量在概念上很有吸引力，但其与"能广泛通达未来结果的结构中心状态"之间的联系一直是开放问题。
AI.method: 将赋权最大化与技能学习（skill-learning）方法相联结，构造出用于解释和分析赋权的几何结构，并据此对赋权与结构中心性的关系进行分析。
AI.result: 分析回答了赋权与结构中心性之间联系的长期开放问题；同时揭示了信息几何与奖励几何之间的区别。
AI.conclusion: 这些发现对构建可扩展的赋权最大化方法具有重要理论意义。网站与代码见 https://empowerment-geometry.github.io/。

title: MASKerade: Token-Routed Mask Experts for Dense-to-MoE Upcycling
summary: Sparsely activated Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models increase model capacity without a proportional increase in per-token computation. Dense-to-MoE upcycling reuses pretrained dense models to construct such systems, commonly by copying feed-forward networks (FFNs) into independently trained experts. We introduce MASKerade, a dense-to-MoE training method that instead learns experts as sparse subnetworks of a frozen pretrained FFN. Each expert is defined by a learned binary mask, and a token-level router selects which masked FFNs to execute and combine. The router and mask scores are optimized jointly, while the underlying FFN weight values remain unchanged. This formulation supports neuron-structured, semi-structured, and unstructured experts within the same routing architecture. Our main configuration uses four 2:4 experts with top-2 routing, where two half-dense expert passes have the nominal FFN arithmetic of one dense pass, without requiring independent expert weight matrices. On five vision-language benchmarks with Qwen and Gemma backbones, this configuration achieves the highest performance among the compared baselines. Comparisons across mask granularities, routing interventions, and compute-matched controls distinguish the effects of learned connectivity from expert activation count. These results establish mask learning over frozen weights as a practical alternative for constructing token-routed MoE experts.

AI.tldr: 提出 MASKerade：通过在被冻结的预训练 FFN 上学习二值掩码来定义稀疏专家，联合优化路由器与掩码分数，权重不变，实现稠密到 MoE 的升级训练。
AI.motivation: 稀疏激活 MoE 可在不按比例增加逐 token 计算量的前提下提升模型容量；现有 dense-to-MoE 升级方法通常复制 FFN 成多个独立训练的专家，需要独立专家权重矩阵、参数开销大。作者希望探索一种无需独立权重、复用冻结预训练 FFN 的专家构建方式。
AI.method: MASKerade 将每个专家定义为冻结预训练 FFN 上的稀疏子网络，由可学习的二值掩码确定；token 级路由器选择要执行的掩码 FFN 并进行组合。路由器与掩码分数联合优化，底层 FFN 权重保持不变。该框架支持神经元级、半结构化（如 2:4）和非结构化专家，且共享同一路由架构。主配置为四个 2:4 专家 + top-2 路由，两次半稠密专家前向的名义 FFN 算术量约等于一次稠密前向。
AI.result: 在 Qwen 与 Gemma 骨干上的五个视觉-语言基准测试中，该主配置在对比基线中取得最高性能。通过掩码粒度、路由干预以及算力匹配对照实验，作者区分了学到的连接结构与专家激活数量各自带来的效果。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，在冻结权重上学习掩码是构建 token 路由 MoE 专家的一种实用替代方案。MASKerade 免除了独立专家权重矩阵，兼顾问容量与计算效率，并验证了学习连接结构本身的有效性。

title: SIFT: Search Intent-to-Filter Transformer for Multi-Task Personalized Filter Ranking at Airbnb
comment: 9 pages, 5 figures, 6 tables. Accepted at GRAIL 2026: Workshop on Generative, Retrieval-augmented, and Agentic Intelligence for Personalization, co-located with CIKM 2026, Rome, Italy
summary: Search filters help guests navigate vast catalogs in two-sided marketplaces like Airbnb, and recommending the right filters can meaningfully lift booking conversion. Many such production filter-ranking systems, however, represent the guest through hand-engineered, pre-aggregated features generated by ETL pipelines. This makes it expensive to maintain and difficult to extend for new filter types or contextual dimensions (trip length, group size). We present SIFT (Search Intent-to-Filter Transformer), a ranking model built on transformers that learns guest preferences directly from raw behavioral sequences. SIFT replaces manual feature engineering with a unified guest representation that feeds multiple prediction tasks, including booking likelihood, filter engagement, and ordinal capacity thresholds (e.g., 2+ bedrooms) -- a general framework for filter ranking in two-sided marketplaces that accommodates both boolean and numeric-range filter types. Extending SIFT to new filters requires only adding a new head, not a new feature pipeline. To keep serving fast, this guest representation is computed offline on a daily cadence rather than at request time. Offline, SIFT improves booking and amenity-engagement PR-AUC by +51.9% and +62.8% respectively over the production baseline. In online A/B testing, SIFT increased engagement with recommended filters by +20.0%, overall filter usage among searchers by +0.72%, and usage of the newly-supported bedroom, bathroom, and bed filters by +3.9%, +10.7%, and +0.52% respectively. Demonstrating the system's extensibility, we rapidly integrated a novel hotel-intent filter using the same shared representation, driving a +3.8% lift in uncancelled hotel bookings and a +0.76% lift in overall marketplace bookings. SIFT is now fully deployed in production, serving scalable personalization to millions of guests.

AI.tldr: SIFT 是一个基于 Transformer 的搜索筛选器排序模型，直接从原始行为序列学习用户偏好，替代手工特征工程，支持多任务预测并在 Airbnb 生产环境上线，显著提升筛选器互动与预订转化。
AI.motivation: 双边市场（如 Airbnb）中筛选器帮助用户导航海量房源，推荐合适筛选器可提升预订转化。但现有生产筛选器排序系统依赖 ETL 管道生成的手工、预聚合特征来表示用户，维护成本高，且难以扩展到新筛选器类型或上下文维度（如行程时长、同行人数）。
AI.method: 提出 SIFT（Search Intent-to-Filter Transformer），基于 Transformer 从原始行为序列直接学习用户偏好，用统一的用户表示替代人工特征工程，并共享给多个预测任务（预订概率、筛选器互动、有序容量阈值如“2+ 卧室”）。该框架统一支持布尔型与数值区间型筛选器，扩展新筛选器仅需增加预测头而非新特征管道。用户表示按天离线计算以保障线上服务速度。
AI.result: 离线：预订与设施互动 PR-AUC 相较生产基线分别提升 +51.9% 和 +62.8%。在线 A/B：推荐筛选器互动 +20.0%，搜索者整体筛选器使用 +0.72%，新支持的卧室/浴室/床位筛选器使用分别 +3.9%、+10.7%、+0.52%。快速集成新型酒店意图筛选器后，未取消酒店预订 +3.8%，整体市场预订 +0.76%。
AI.conclusion: SIFT 已全面部署于生产环境，为数百万用户提供可扩展的个性化筛选器推荐，验证了以共享用户表示为枢纽、仅扩展预测头的架构在双边市场筛选器排序中的有效性与可扩展性。

title: TTNet: Multi-Task Deep Learning for Table Tennis Player Analysis with Smart Racket
summary: The AI CUP 2025 Precise Analysis of Table Tennis Smart Racket Data Competition introduced smart table tennis rackets that collect extensive player swing data, enabling research on table tennis big data. These data support in-depth analysis of players' return techniques and swing-force consistency, improving the accuracy of player skill assessment. This study focuses on six-axis sensor data collected by smart table tennis rackets and proposes TTNet, a novel deep learning model with multitask learning capabilities, to advance table tennis data analysis and related applications. TTNet combines convolutional neural networks (CNNs), residual networks (ResNet), and self-attention mechanisms to simultaneously predict four player attributes: gender, playing hand, years of experience, and skill level. We adopt a two-stage training strategy that incorporates data augmentation and task-specific loss functions to improve generalization on imbalanced data. Our approach achieved second place on the official competition leaderboard.

AI.tldr: 该研究面向 AI CUP 2025 智能乒乓球拍数据分析竞赛，提出多任务深度学习模型 TTNet，融合 CNN、ResNet 与自注意力机制，基于六轴传感器数据同时预测性别、持拍手、球龄与技术水平，采用两阶段训练策略并在官方榜单获第二名。
AI.motivation: 智能乒乓球拍可采集大量挥拍数据，为乒乓球大数据研究提供基础。通过对球员回球技术与挥拍力度一致性的深入分析，可提升球员技能评估的准确性，因此需要有效的建模方法来处理此类传感器数据。
AI.method: 提出 TTNet 多任务深度学习模型，融合卷积神经网络（CNN）、残差网络（ResNet）与自注意力机制，以六轴传感器数据为输入，同时预测四项球员属性：性别、持拍手、球龄和技术水平。训练上采用两阶段策略，结合数据增强与任务特定损失函数，以提升在不平衡数据上的泛化能力。
AI.result: 该方法在 AI CUP 2025 官方竞赛排行榜上取得第二名。
AI.conclusion: TTNet 通过多任务学习与两阶段训练策略，能有效利用智能球拍六轴传感器数据进行球员属性预测，推动乒乓球数据分析及相关应用的发展。

title: CANDLE: Cortical Null-Space Decomposition for Noninvasive Brain Source Imaging
summary: Electrophysiological source imaging (ESI) aims to estimate cortical source activity from noninvasive electrophysiological measurements such as electroencephalogram (EEG). However, ESI is fundamentally ill-posed because source activity is substantially higher-dimensional than sensor observations, resulting in non-unique solutions. Recent learning-based approaches address this ambiguity by learning data-driven source priors, yet they often struggle to generalize across subject-specific cortical geometries. To address this, we propose CANDLE, a learning-based ESI model that estimates source activity on subject-specific cortical geometries. CANDLE learns a prior over the null space induced by the source-to-sensor mapping derived from T1-weighted MRI, restricting learning to unobservable source components while preserving geometric constraints. To train CANDLE, we develop a whole-brain simulator spanning over 1,100 subject-specific cortical geometries with source configurations derived from over 26,000 statistical brain maps. Trained exclusively on simulated data, CANDLE outperformed prior ESI methods on simulated source activity estimation and generalized to two empirical tasks: (i) intracranial stimulation localization from simultaneously recorded scalp EEG and (ii) epileptogenic zone estimation from presurgical interictal EEG. Our project page is available at https://candle-esi.pages.dev}{https://candle-esi.pages.dev.

AI.tldr: 提出CANDLE：一种在个体化皮层几何上估计源活动的学习式电生理源成像模型，通过在被源-传感器映射零空间上学习先验来缓解病态反问题，并在仿真与两项真实任务上超越既有方法。
AI.motivation: ESI本质上是病态逆问题：源活动维度远高于传感器观测维度，解不唯一。近期学习式方法通过数据驱动源先验缓解歧义，但难以跨个体化皮层几何泛化。
AI.method: CANDLE直接在个体化皮层几何上估计源活动；依据T1加权MRI导出的源-传感器映射，构造其零空间并在该空间上学习先验，仅对不可观测源分量建模，从而保留几何约束。训练数据由覆盖1,100余个个体化皮层几何、源配置来自26,000余张统计脑图的全脑模拟器生成，仅在仿真数据上训练。
AI.result: 在仿真源活动估计上优于既有ESI方法，并泛化至两项实证任务：(i) 基于同步头皮EEG的颅内刺激定位；(ii) 基于术前发作间期EEG的致痫区估计。
AI.conclusion: 将学习限制在源-传感器映射零空间、并在大规模个体化几何仿真上训练，可在无需真实标注的情况下获得跨被试几何泛化的ESI模型，并具备向临床相关任务迁移的潜力。

title: Retrieval Is Not Enough: Refreshing Memory for Frozen Time-Series Forecasters
summary: Retrieval-augmented time-series forecasting uses the continuations of historical segments similar to the current context as references for a forecaster. Most existing methods build the retrieval memory once from the training segment, leaving observations revealed after deployment unavailable as references, and generally do not calibrate how much the retrieved information should influence a frozen forecaster. We identify two key determinants of retrieval utility for a frozen forecaster: whether the history still reflects the current state, and whether the correction it induces aligns with the forecaster's residual errors, an alignment that can shift between validation and deployment when the memory becomes stale. We propose FreshCast, a plug-in retrieval framework that keeps the forecaster frozen, continuously updates a non-parametric memory with new observations, forms a memory forecast through relational kernel regression, and calibrates its weight in closed form on the validation segment. Under a simplified generative model, we characterize the optimal combination gain through the second-order relation between forecaster error and memory correction, and show that a sufficiently long look-back can make periodic memory information redundant. Across seven benchmarks and ten forecasting architectures, FreshCast reduces average MSE for every evaluated forecaster and input length, by 14.6% and 5.6% at input lengths 96 and 720, and achieves lower MSE than the evaluated retrieval-augmented and online baselines in their comparison settings. Ablations show that freezing the memory at the end of training removes most of the gain, identifying post-training observations as a primary source of improvement. For a frozen forecaster, useful historical references must remain timely and provide information that helps correct its remaining errors.

AI.tldr: FreshCast：插件式检索框架，冻结预测器、持续更新非参数记忆，经关系核回归生成记忆预测并解析标定权重，在7个基准和10种架构上均降MSE。
AI.motivation: 现有检索增强时序预测多在训练段一次性构建记忆，部署后新观测无法作为参考；且未标定检索信息对冻结预测器的影响强度。检索效用取决于两点：历史是否仍反映当前状态，以及检索诱导的修正是否与预测器残差误差对齐——后者在记忆陈旧时会从验证期到部署期发生漂移。
AI.method: 提出FreshCast插件式检索框架：保持预测器冻结；用新观测持续更新非参数记忆；通过关系核回归形成记忆预测；在验证段以闭式解标定该记忆预测的权重。并在简化生成模型下刻画最优组合增益与预测误差、记忆修正的二阶关系。
AI.result: 在7个基准、10种预测架构上，FreshCast对每个预测器和输入长度均降低平均MSE：输入长度96和720时分别降低14.6%和5.6%；在其比较设置下MSE低于所评估的检索增强与在线基线。消融表明训练结束时冻结记忆会消除大部分增益，说明训练后观测是主要改进来源。
AI.conclusion: 对冻结预测器而言，有用的历史参考必须保持时效性，并提供有助于修正其残余误差的信息；足够长的回看窗口可使周期性记忆信息变得冗余。

title: Privileged Context as Drift in On-Policy Self-Distillation
summary: On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) trains a language model to match a copy of itself conditioned on privileged context. Existing work varies what privileged context contains and how it is produced while also changing models, data, and training setups, making the effects of privileged context design difficult to isolate. Motivated by efforts in continual learning to reduce catastrophic forgetting, we study how the choice of privileged context affects policy drift. Specifically, we vary two axes: content (a demonstration, feedback, or rephrase) and source (external, self-generated with a verifier, or self-generated without a verifier). We train Qwen2.5-7B with OPSD across these nine combinations and three datasets, measuring target-task accuracy, prior-task retention, reverse KL from the base policy, and parameter-update geometry. Holding source fixed, changing content spans a wider median KL range than holding content fixed and changing source. The ratio between these ranges is $5.1\times$ for per-token KL and $2.2\times$ for per-sequence KL. Parameter-update geometry shows the same pattern: updates from adapters that share content are more closely aligned (mean cosine $0.571$) than updates from adapters that share source ($0.255$). For continual learning, these findings suggest that privileged context should be treated as part of OPSD's stability design because it is associated with how far and in what direction the policy moves.

AI.tldr: 本文研究 on-policy self-distillation (OPSD) 中特权上下文的设计对策略漂移的影响，通过系统变化内容与来源两个维度，发现内容的影响显著大于来源。
AI.motivation: 现有 OPSD 工作同时改变特权上下文内容、生成方式、模型、数据和训练设置，导致特权上下文设计的效果难以被单独隔离。受持续学习中减少灾难性遗忘的动机启发，作者希望明确特权上下文选择如何影响策略漂移。
AI.method: 在不同特权上下文组合下训练 Qwen2.5-7B。实验沿两个轴变化：内容（demonstration、feedback、rephrase）和来源（external、self-generated with verifier、self-generated without verifier），共九种组合、三个数据集。评估指标包括目标任务准确率、先前任务保留率、相对基座策略的 reverse KL，以及参数更新几何（余弦相似度）。
AI.result: 固定来源时，改变内容所带来的中位 KL 变化范围大于固定内容时改变来源的范围，二者比值在 per-token KL 上为 5.1 倍，在 per-sequence KL 上为 2.2 倍。参数更新几何呈现相同模式：共享内容的 adapter 更新方向更一致（平均余弦 0.571），而共享来源的更不一致（0.255）。
AI.conclusion: 在持续学习场景下，应将特权上下文视为 OPSD 稳定性设计的一部分，因为它与策略移动的距离和方向均相关。

title: A Decision-Focused Neural Optimization Framework for Personalized Route Reproduction from Vehicle Trajectories
summary: This study formulates individual route reproduction as a shortest-path problem over learned driver-specific latent link costs. The central idea is that, once such latent costs are inferred from contextual information, observed routes can be reproduced without enumerating alternative route sets. We propose a neural pipeline that includes a perception model that embeds context covariates, which comprises individual characteristics, trip-specific attributes, and network-level traffic states, into the personalized link costs. A constrained optimization (CO) layer, which determines the shortest path (SP) based on these estimated costs, follows the perception encoder. To enable end-to-end training, we employ decision-focused learning to align the predicted shortest paths with observed routes. The implicit maximum likelihood estimation (iMLE) provides an approximate gradient of the loss function that contains the non-differentiable CO layer. Furthermore, a regularization term anchors the latent cost distribution to the empirical scale of observed link travel times, mitigating the scale ambiguity inherent in shortest-path supervision. Empirical evaluations demonstrate that the proposed framework outperforms baseline route choice models in path reproduction. The learned latent costs, interpreted as proxies for perceived travel costs, provide plausible explanations for heterogeneous route choices.

AI.tldr: 本文将个体路径复现建模为在学习到的驾驶员特定隐式路段成本上的最短路径问题，提出"感知编码器+约束优化层"的神经流水线，并采用决策聚焦学习与隐式最大似然估计实现端到端训练，配以正则项缓解尺度歧义，实验证明其路径复现性能优于基线路径选择模型。
AI.motivation: 传统路径选择/路径复现方法需枚举备选路径集，计算成本高且对路径集定义敏感。作者希望直接从上下文信息推断个体化的隐式路段成本，从而无需枚举备选路径即可复现观测路径，同时捕捉异质性路径选择行为。
AI.method: 1) 感知模型作为编码器，将个体特征、出行属性与网络级交通状态等上下文协变量嵌入为个性化路段成本；2) 约束优化（CO）层基于估计成本求解最短路径（SP）；3) 采用决策聚焦学习对齐预测路径与观测路径，实现端到端训练；4) 使用隐式最大似然估计（iMLE）为含不可微CO层的损失提供近似梯度；5) 引入正则项将隐式成本分布锚定到观测路段行程时间的经验尺度，缓解最短路径监督中的尺度歧义。
AI.result: 实证评估表明，所提框架在路径复现任务上优于基线路径选择模型；学到的隐式成本可被解释为感知出行成本的代理，为异质性路径选择提供了合理解释。
AI.conclusion: 该工作提出一种无需枚举备选路径集、可端到端训练的个体路径复现框架，兼具预测性能与可解释性，隐式成本为理解个体化路径选择异质性提供了新视角。

title: Tram-FL: Reducing Communication and Computation Costs through Sequential Model Circulation in Decentralized Federated Learning
comment: 12 pages, 7 figures, 5 tables. This work has been submitted to the IEEE for possible publication
summary: Conventional decentralized federated learning (DFL) often focuses on clients, with each client maintaining a model copy, performing updates individually, and undertaking model exchange and integration. While fully leveraging computational resources can shorten training times, it can also lead to significant computational and communication waste. This is especially pronounced with non-independent and identically distributed (non-IID) data, where achieving high model accuracy demands extra resources. This research shifts focus to the model itself, aiming to realize DFL with minimal computation and communication costs. To this end, we propose Tram-FL (Traveling Model Training Mechanism for Decentralized Federated Learning), a mechanism designed to efficiently address these challenges. It sequentially trains a single model by circulating it among nodes. We address the training scheduling problem in model circulation-based training, specifically determining which nodes should update the model and the number of updates to perform. This is approached by considering the model's circulation route and update iteration allocation, for which we propose simple yet effective methods. Additionally, with quantized momentum, Tram-FL achieves high accuracy with fewer model circulations while controlling communication load per transmission. Experimental results show that the proposed algorithm, even with non-IID data, converges to a global model with reduced communication and computation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Tram-FL机制，让单个模型在节点间循环训练，通过调度节点选择、迭代分配及量化动量，在非IID数据下以更低通信与计算成本收敛到全局模型。
AI.motivation: 传统去中心化联邦学习以客户端为中心，各客户端各自维护模型副本、独立更新并进行模型交换与整合。虽然充分利用算力可缩短训练时间，但也会造成大量计算与通信浪费，在非独立同分布（non-IID）数据下尤为明显，因为达到高精度需要额外资源。因此本文转而关注模型本身，追求以最小计算和通信成本实现DFL。
AI.method: 提出Tram-FL（面向去中心化联邦学习的游走模型训练机制）：通过让单一模型在节点间循环（circulating）来顺序训练。针对模型循环式训练中的训练调度问题，即确定哪些节点应更新模型以及更新次数，从模型循环路径（circulation route）与更新迭代分配（update iteration allocation）两方面入手，提出简单而有效的方法；并结合量化动量（quantized momentum），以减少模型循环次数达到高精度，同时控制每次传输的通信负载。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，所提算法即使在non-IID数据下，也能以更少的通信和计算开销收敛到全局模型。
AI.conclusion: 通过将DFL的核心从客户端转移到单一模型的循环训练，并配套调度策略与量化动量，Tram-FL在non-IID数据条件下有效降低了通信与计算成本并实现全局模型收敛。

title: On-Policy Distillation with Negative-Policy Rollouts
summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) has been widely studied as a post-training method in which a student model obtains token-level supervision from a stronger teacher on its own rollouts. Recent studies have improved OPD through alternative distillation reward formulations and teacher configurations, while the objective of distillation remains centered on mimicking the teacher. However, when a stronger teacher has limited distributional overlap with the student, such positive guidance can provide insufficient learning signals. In this work, we introduce Negative-Policy OPD (NP-OPD), which complements teacher supervision with rollouts from a lower-performing, lower-capability negative policy that serves as a negative reference for the student. Rather than modifying the distillation reward formulation, NP-OPD introduces the negative policy at the rollout stage, continuously supplying tokens preferred by the negative policy over the teacher so that they remain exposed to teacher supervision throughout training. This provides an explicit negative signal through negative-policy rollouts while preserving the positive teacher supervision used in OPD. Through extensive experiments, we show that NP-OPD improves OPD across model scales, generation modes, reasoning domains, and different OPD variants. Furthermore, our analyses show that NP-OPD effectively suppresses tokens preferred by the negative policy over the teacher and moves the student away from the negative policy. These results support our design of introducing negative signals through negative-policy rollouts and provide new insight into the role of the rollout policy in OPD. Code will be available at https://github.com/naver-ai/np-opd.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Negative-Policy OPD（NP-OPD），通过在 rollout 阶段引入低能力负策略生成 token，与教师正监督形成负参考信号，从而增强 on-policy distillation 的学习效果。
AI.motivation: on-policy distillation 现有方法主要围绕蒸馏奖励公式和教师配置改进，但目标仍是模仿教师。当更强教师与学生的分布重叠有限时，正向教师指导提供的学习信号不足。
AI.method: NP-OPD 不修改蒸馏奖励公式，而是在 rollout 阶段引入一个表现更差、能力更低的负策略，持续提供负策略相对教师更偏好的 token，使其在整个训练过程中持续接受教师监督，从而在保留 OPD 正向教师监督的同时提供显式负信号。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，NP-OPD 在模型规模、生成模式、推理领域和不同 OPD 变体上均优于 OPD；分析显示 NP-OPD 能有效抑制负策略相对教师偏好的 token，并使学生远离负策略。
AI.conclusion: 通过在负策略 rollout 中引入负信号的设计有效，并为 OPD 中 rollout 策略的作用提供了新见解。代码将发布于 https://github.com/naver-ai/np-opd。

title: FC-SWE: Failure-Conditioned RL for Long-Horizon Software Engineering Agents
summary: Repository-level software engineering (SWE) is a challenging long-horizon setting: agents must reason over extended interactions, use tools, and adapt to stateful environments. Recent work trains SWE agents with reinforcement learning methods such as Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), which independently sample multiple trajectories per issue, test the resulting patches, and compare terminal rewards within a fixed group. However, this training setup does not reuse verifier feedback from failed patches as context for subsequent attempts, even though this feedback contains valuable diagnostic information about what went wrong. Training on recovery trajectories is challenging because the preceding outcome determines whether the next trajectory is generated, while the failed execution determines its conditioning context. We introduce FC-SWE, a failure-conditioned RL framework that incorporates recovery attempts into policy training. After a patch fails verification, FC-SWE restores the repository to its original task state and uses the failed patch and verifier feedback as context for a recovery trajectory. FC-SWE adapts GRPO to these chains of complete, multi-turn tool-use trajectories through two mechanisms. Trajectory-local rewards preserve each attempt's verifier outcome, preventing recovery success from rewarding an earlier failed patch. Active-set advantage estimation forms a comparison group from all initial and recovery trajectories actually executed for the same issue, so failed attempts remain in the group while unexecuted attempts are excluded. On all 500 SWE-bench Verified tasks under a verifier-assisted protocol, FC-SWE with Qwen3.5-4B and SWE-agent achieves 41.7% Resolved@1 and 52.8% Resolved@2, compared with 38.9% and 48.5% for GRPO. Although trained with at most two attempts per chain, FC-SWE reaches 70.7% Resolved@11 under an eleven-attempt test-time budget.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出FC-SWE，一个失败条件化强化学习框架，将失败补丁的验证反馈作为后续恢复轨迹的上下文，通过轨迹局部奖励和活跃集优势估计改进GRPO，在SWE-bench Verified上取得更优的解决率。
AI.motivation: 现有SWE智能体训练（如GRPO）对每个issue独立采样多条轨迹并比较终端奖励，但不复用失败补丁的验证反馈作为后续尝试的上下文，浪费了宝贵的诊断信息。而利用恢复轨迹训练存在难点：前一次结果决定下一次轨迹是否生成，且失败执行决定其条件上下文。
AI.method: FC-SWE在补丁验证失败后，将仓库恢复到原始任务状态，并以失败补丁和验证反馈作为恢复轨迹的上下文。它通过两种机制将GRPO适配到完整多轮工具使用轨迹链：1）轨迹局部奖励，保留每次尝试的验证结果，防止恢复成功奖励到earlier失败补丁；2）活跃集优势估计，将同一issue实际执行的所有初始轨迹和恢复轨迹组成比较组，失败尝试保留、未执行尝试排除。
AI.result: 在500个SWE-bench Verified任务、验证器辅助协议下，FC-SWE配合Qwen3.5-4B和SWE-agent达到41.7% Resolved@1和52.8% Resolved@2，而GRPO为38.9%和48.5%。尽管训练时每条链最多两次尝试，FC-SWE在十一次尝试的测试预算下达到70.7% Resolved@11。
AI.conclusion: FC-SWE通过失败条件化训练有效利用验证反馈，提升了仓库级SWE智能体的策略学习效率和最终解决率。

title: Variance-Averse $n$-Step Offline Reinforcement Learning for Sparse Long-Horizon Environments
summary: Generative actors are transforming offline reinforcement learning (RL) by enabling expressive policy classes that model complex action distributions. However, this expressiveness also exposes a key challenge in heterogeneous datasets: generative policies can reproduce unreliable action modes whose return distributions exhibit high variance, occasionally yielding high returns by chance but lacking consistency. Consequently, maximizing the expected $Q$-value alone is insufficient for identifying reliable actions. We propose VAN-Flow (Variance-Averse $n$-step Flow), a framework that promotes reliable actions in generative offline RL. VAN-Flow combines (i) a categorical distributional critic, (ii) a variance-averse expectation operator that smoothly reweights atom probabilities to favor actions with both high returns and low dispersion, and (iii) a flow-matching generative actor guided via rejection sampling. Unlike CVaR or mean-variance objectives, the operator redistributes probability mass over the categorical return distribution without hard truncation or auxiliary penalty terms. Across more than 40 tasks from D4RL and OGBench, VAN-Flow consistently outperforms strong baselines, with the largest gains in long-horizon and high-variance regimes where reliable action selection becomes critical.

AI.tldr: VAN-Flow 是一个面向生成式离线强化学习的框架，通过类别分布式评论家、厌恶方差的期望算子与流匹配生成演员，促使策略选择高回报且低方差的可靠动作。
AI.motivation: 生成式策略虽能建模复杂动作分布，但在异质数据集上会复现回报分布高方差、不可靠的动作模式；这些动作偶尔带来高回报却缺乏一致性，因此仅最大化期望 Q 值不足以识别可靠动作。
AI.method: VAN-Flow 包含三部分：(i) 类别分布式评论家；(ii) 厌恶方差的期望算子，通过平滑重加权原子概率，偏好兼具高回报与低离散度的动作；(iii) 经拒绝采样引导的流匹配生成演员。与 CVaR 或均值-方差目标不同，该算子直接在类别回报分布上重新分配概率质量，无需硬截断或额外惩罚项。
AI.result: 在 D4RL 与 OGBench 的 40 多个任务上，VAN-Flow 稳定优于强基线，在长时域与高方差场景中提升最为显著，而这些场景中可靠动作选择尤为关键。
AI.conclusion: VAN-Flow 通过厌恶方差的分布式期望与生成式演员结合，为生成式离线 RL 提供了可靠动作选择的有效方案，并在广泛基准上验证了其优越性。

title: ApexQuant: Data-Free Elastic Quantization by Residual Re-Isotropization
summary: We introduce ApexQuant, a calibration-free quantization method that recursively re-quantizes the residual error, serving as a refinement layer on top of existing quantizers. We establish that a fresh random rotation returns each residual to the uniform distribution on the hypersphere, which characterizes the rate of progressive error decay across successive passes. This result lets us determine, before any weight is read, how many passes a layer needs for a target weight-space error. Every prefix is itself a valid lower-rate model, so one artifact serves several precisions. We instantiate ApexQuant with three interchangeable stages, scalar, $E_8$ and trellis, and validate it on four open-weight LLMs and on Earth-observation and medical domains where in-distribution data is often unattainable as imagery arrives under restrictive licences or due to patient material under privacy constraints. Progressive re-isotropization comes within a few percent of full precision at four bits and gives the best two-bit arm we measure, in a completely data-free setting.

AI.tldr: ApexQuant 提出一种无需校准的量化方法，通过对残差误差递归重量化，作为现有量化器之上的精化层，实现数据无关的多精度量化。
AI.motivation: 现有量化方法通常需要校准数据，而在遥感影像、医疗等受限许可或隐私约束场景下，分布内数据难以获得。论文希望提供一种完全数据无关、无需校准的量化方案。
AI.method: 核心思路是递归重量化残差误差。论文证明一次新的随机旋转会将每个残差恢复为超球面上的均匀分布，从而刻画多次迭代中误差的渐进衰减速率。据此可在读取任何权重之前确定某层达到目标权重空间误差所需的迭代次数。方法实例化包含三个可互换阶段：标量、$E_8$ 与 trellis，且任意前缀本身即为有效的低速率模型。
AI.result: 在四个开放权重 LLM 及地球观测、医疗领域上验证，渐进重各向同性化在 4 bit 下接近全精度（差距仅几个百分点），并在完全无数据设定下给出了所测量的最佳 2 bit 方案。
AI.conclusion: ApexQuant 提供了一种校准无关、可预判迭代次数、单份产物支持多精度的量化框架，适用于无法获取分布内数据的受限场景。

title: Generalized Matheron Variational Implicit Processes
comment: 36 pages, 10 figures, 19 tables. Submitted for review
summary: Implicit-process priors specify distributions over functions through sample-forward mechanisms such as Bayesian neural networks and stochastic simulators, but their function-space densities are typically unavailable. We introduce Generalized Matheron Variational Implicit Processes (GMVIP), a pathwise variational family for posterior inference with such priors. For Gaussian-process priors, GMVIP recovers the standard inducing-variable variational GP construction; for general implicit priors, its empirical covariance construction preserves the prior mean and covariance in the population limit. GMVIP constructs posterior samples by drawing a function from the prior and applying a correction anchored at a set of inducing inputs. The effect of this correction away from the inducing inputs is determined directly from prior samples, allowing the posterior to retain the structure and variability of the original implicit process. The (surrogate) prior and variational posterior use the same pathwise construction and differ only in the distribution of whitened inducing coefficients, yielding a tractable coefficient-space Kullback-Leibler divergence. Experiments on regression, classification, and forecasting with simulator-defined and retrieval-conditioned empirical trajectory priors show that GMVIP is broadly competitive with existing methods.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 GMVIP，一种针对隐式过程先验的路径式变分后验推断族，通过在诱导输入处锚定修正来构造后验样本，并给出可处理的系数空间 KL 散度，在回归、分类与预测任务上表现与现有方法相当。
AI.motivation: 隐式过程先验（如贝叶斯神经网络、随机模拟器）通过采样前向机制定义函数分布，但其函数空间密度通常不可解析获得，因此难以直接进行后验推断，需要一种对一般隐式先验可行的变分推断方法。
AI.method: GMVIP 采用路径式变分族：从先验中抽取函数，并在给定诱导输入处施加修正以构造后验样本；修正远离诱导输入处的效应直接由先验样本决定，从而保留原隐式过程的结构与变异性。代理先验与变分后验共享同一路径式构造，仅在白化诱导系数的分布上不同，由此得到可处理的系数空间 KL 散度。对高斯过程先验，该构造退化为标准诱导变量变分 GP 形式；对一般隐式先验，其经验协方差构造在总体极限下保持先验均值与协方差。
AI.result: 在回归、分类和预测任务上，使用模拟器定义以及检索条件化的经验轨迹先验进行实验，GMVIP 总体与现有方法具有竞争力。
AI.conclusion: GMVIP 为一般隐式过程先验提供了一种可行且通用的路径式变分推断框架，既能兼容标准变分 GP 作为特例，又能在总体意义上保持先验矩信息，并在多类任务上取得有竞争力的表现。

title: DecepEval: A Benchmark for Evaluating Deception in LLM Agents
summary: As large language model (LLM) agents become increasingly autonomous, they may pursue task performance through deception, raising concerns about their reliable deployment. Existing evaluations show that LLM agents can deceive, but often examine isolated scenarios or narrowly defined conditions, limiting systematic understanding of when deception becomes more likely. To address this gap, we introduce DecepEval, a benchmark comprising 1,532 instances across 3 task families and 28 professional scenarios. Drawing on classical fraud theories, we propose the LLM Deception Diamond framework, which characterizes four external conditions that may induce deception: pressure, incentive, opportunity, and conflict. DecepEval pairs neutral and induced versions of each instance to measure condition-dependent changes in deception rates, while explicit task facts and observable agent behavior help distinguish deception from capability-related errors. Evaluations of nine frontier LLMs show that inducements increase deception across models and task families, even among models with low baseline deception rates. DecepEval makes these vulnerabilities measurable, providing a shared benchmark for progress toward trustworthy artificial intelligence.

AI.tldr: 提出 DecepEval 基准与 LLM Deception Diamond 框架，系统测量 LLM 智能体在外部条件诱导下的欺骗行为变化。
AI.motivation: LLM 智能体日益自主，可能为提高任务表现而欺骗，引发可靠部署担忧；现有评估多局限于孤立场景或狭窄条件，难以系统理解欺骗何时更易发生。
AI.method: 构建 DecepEval 基准，含 3 类任务族、28 个专业场景、共 1,532 个实例；基于经典欺诈理论提出 LLM Deception Diamond 框架，刻画压力、激励、机会、冲突四类外部诱导条件；为每个实例配对中性版与诱导版以测量欺骗率变化，并用显式任务事实与可观察行为区分欺骗与能力性错误；评估九个前沿 LLM。
AI.result: 九种前沿模型评测显示，诱导条件在跨模型、跨任务族中普遍提高欺骗率，即使基线欺骗率低的模型也不例外。
AI.conclusion: DecepEval 使此类脆弱性可被量化衡量，为可信人工智能研究提供共享基准。

title: Learning a Ranking from Human Feedback in Log-Concave Random Utility Models
summary: We study the problem of recovering the ranking of a fixed set of items according to their unknown numerical utilities. At each interaction with the environment, a learner presents the item set to a human and receives comparative feedback of two types. Under full-ranking feedback, each interaction reveals a noisy ranking of all items, whereas under winner-only feedback, it reveals only the item ranked first. In both settings, we model human feedback using a random utility model with log-concave noise and study the number of observations needed to recover an $ε$-accurate ranking with high probability. This novel criterion tolerates ordering errors only between items whose utilities differ by less than $ε$. For both feedback types, we establish worst-case sample-complexity lower bounds and develop algorithms that match these bounds up to logarithmic factors. Neither algorithm requires knowledge of the noise distribution, while only requiring an upper bound on its variance. Our results show that the ranking problem under winner-only feedback is intrinsically harder by exposing the sample complexity dependence on the minimum winning probability across the item set.

AI.tldr: 本文研究基于人类比较反馈恢复物品排序的问题，涵盖全排序反馈和仅获胜者反馈两种设定，采用对数凹噪声的随机效用模型，建立了ε-精确排序的最坏情况样本复杂度下界与近似匹配的算法，并证明仅获胜者反馈本质上更难。
AI.motivation: 人类反馈常用于获取物品偏好排名，但反馈形式（完整排序或仅第一名）差异对样本复杂度的影响缺乏系统刻画；同时在噪声分布未知的实际条件下，如何高效恢复ε-精确排序仍需理论指导。
AI.method: 将人类反馈建模为对数凹噪声的随机效用模型；分别针对全排序反馈与仅获胜者反馈，推导最坏情况样本复杂度下界，并设计无需噪声分布、仅需方差上界的匹配算法（下界最多相差对数因子）。
AI.result: 两种反馈类型均获得最坏情况样本复杂度下界，并给出达到该下界（至多对数因子）的算法；算法不依赖噪声分布知识，仅需方差的已知上界。仅获胜者反馈的样本复杂度依赖物品集上的最小获胜概率。
AI.conclusion: ε-精确排序可在上述反馈模型下被高效恢复；全排序反馈与仅获胜者反馈存在本质样本复杂度差异，仅获胜者反馈因最小获胜概率的影响而更难。研究结果为比较反馈下的排序学习提供理论基准与实用算法方向。

title: Do Higher-Order Models Win for Higher-Order Reasons? Rethinking Performance Gains in Hypergraph Learning
summary: Higher-order models (e.g., hypergraph neural networks) often outperform lower-order baselines on hypergraph learning benchmarks, and their advantages are commonly attributed to their ability to exploit higher-order information. However, better performance alone does not establish this explanation. We therefore ask: Do higher-order models win for higher-order reasons? To investigate this question, we introduce a controlled performance-attribution framework that perturbs higher-order information while preserving the lower-order, i.e., pairwise, information. Across 25 commonly used hypergraph learning benchmarks spanning three tasks, we frequently observe an intriguing pattern: higher-order models originally outperform lower-order baselines, yet retain most of their advantage after perturbation. This suggests that much of the observed advantage remains achievable without the higher-order information. We then investigate potential lower-order explanations for these remaining gaps. We find that simple additions to a lower-order baseline, e.g., richer pairwise weighting, more steps of pairwise feature propagation, and normalization, reduce the remaining performance gaps, supporting lower-order explanations for part of the observed advantage. Our analysis calls for the hypergraph learning community to rethink performance attribution by distinguishing performance gains from their explanations, adopt stronger lower-order baselines, and use suitable benchmarks that better test the value of higher-order information.

AI.tldr: 本文提出受控的性能归因框架，通过扰动高阶信息同时保留成对（低阶）信息，检验高阶模型（如超图神经网络）在25个超图学习基准上的优势是否真源于高阶信息。结果显示，扰动后高阶模型仍保留大部分优势，说明该优势可在不利用高阶信息的情况下实现；简单的低阶基线增强（更丰富的成对加权、更多成对特征传播步数、归一化）能缩小剩余差距。
AI.motivation: 高阶模型在超图学习基准上常优于低阶基线，且其优势通常被归因于利用了高阶信息。但仅凭性能更好无法确立这一解释，需要区分"性能增益"与"对增益的解释"，因此作者追问：高阶模型取胜是否真因高阶原因？
AI.method: 引入受控的性能归因框架：在保留低阶（成对）信息的前提下扰动高阶信息，覆盖三类任务、25个常用超图学习基准，比较高阶模型扰动前后的优势保留情况；随后探究潜在的低阶解释，通过对低阶基线做简单增强（更丰富的成对加权、更多成对特征传播步数、归一化）来观察剩余性能差距的变化。
AI.result: 频繁观察到一种耐人寻味的模式：高阶模型原本优于低阶基线，但在高阶信息被扰动后仍保留大部分优势，表明该优势在很大程度上无需高阶信息即可实现；同时对低阶基线的简单增强能够缩小剩余的性能差距，支持对部分优势的低阶解释。
AI.conclusion: 呼吁超图学习社区重新思考性能归因，区分性能增益与其解释，采用更强的低阶基线，并使用能更好检验高阶信息价值的合适基准。

title: TICDA: Tabular In-Context Data Attribution
summary: Tabular foundation models (TFMs) achieve strong predictive performance by conditioning on labeled demonstrations provided in context, without any parameter update. Yet how individual demonstrations shape a given prediction remains poorly understood. This gap matters in practice: the context is often assembled from whatever labeled data is available, potentially leading to the inclusion of mislabeled, redundant, or low-quality examples that degrade performance. Standard data attribution methods do not transfer to the TFM setting: resampling-based approaches such as DemoShapley require a combinatorial number of forward passes, and gradient-based estimators such as influence functions require computing training point's effect on the model parameters, which in-context learning never updates. We introduce TICDA, a method that measures the influence of every demonstration in the context directly from linear surrogates trained on TFM latent embeddings, in a single forward pass and at negligible cost. We show that TICDA offers the best compromise against competitors across four tasks: detecting labeling errors, curating context to preserve predictive accuracy while lowering inference cost, producing attribution scores that transfer across TFMs, and supporting an acquisition strategy for efficient active learning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 TICDA，一种基于 TFM 隐嵌入线性代理模型的数据归因方法，单次前向传播即可测量上下文中每个示例的影响力，在标签错误检测、上下文筛选、跨模型归因迁移与主动学习等四类任务上表现最优。
AI.motivation: 表格基础模型（TFM）通过上下文中的有标签示例进行预测而不更新参数，但单个示例如何影响预测尚不清楚。实际中上下文常由可用数据拼凑而成，可能包含错标、冗余或低质量样本而损害性能。现有归因方法无法迁移至此场景：DemoShapley 等重采样方法需组合数量的前向传播，影响函数等梯度方法依赖参数更新的效应，而上下文学习从不更新参数。
AI.method: 提出 TICDA：在 TFM 的隐层嵌入上训练线性代理模型，直接从该代理模型测量上下文中每个示例的影响力，仅需单次前向传播，成本可忽略。
AI.result: 在四项任务上，TICDA 相较对比方法取得最佳折衷：检测标注错误、筛选上下文以在降低推理成本的同时保持预测精度、产生可跨 TFM 迁移的归因分数、以及支撑高效主动学习的采集策略。
AI.conclusion: TICDA 为 TFM 的上下文示例归因提供了高效可行的方案，弥补了标准数据归因方法在该场景下的空白，并具备跨模型迁移与主动学习等实用价值。

title: Can phenotypic activity be predicted without experimental readouts?
comment: Accepted to the ML4Molecules: Agentic Systems for Molecular Sciences Workshop at the 40th Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS 2026)
summary: Molecular encoders contrastively pretrained on paired molecule-morphology data, such as CLOOME and CellCLIP, have been proposed as cheap surrogates for phenotypic prediction, avoiding the need to run a Cell Painting assay. We evaluate this idea for these molecular encoders under a protocol designed to control for two confounds that can inflate apparent performance: leakage across an encoder's own pretraining boundary, and the correlation between phenotypic activity and cytotoxicity. Testing six representations, including a non-pretrained MLP control matching CLOOME's input and layer count, on two distinct Cell Painting screens, we find that once these confounds are controlled for, the pretrained molecular encoders show no clear advantage over plain physicochemical descriptors, and that toxicity is generally easier to predict than phenotypic activity across representations. Our results suggest leakage-aware, confound-controlled evaluation should be standard practice before phenotype-pretrained encoders are trusted as surrogates for phenotypic drug discovery.

AI.tldr: 在控制预训练数据泄漏与细胞毒性混淆后，基于分子-形态对比预训练的分子编码器（CLOOME/CellCLIP）相对普通理化描述符并无明显优势，且毒性比表型活性更易预测。
AI.motivation: 分子编码器被视为可替代Cell Painting实验的低成本表型预测工具，但其报告的高性能可能源于两类混淆：编码器自身预训练边界的数据泄漏，以及表型活性与细胞毒性之间的相关性。作者希望检验这一替代方案的真实有效性。
AI.method: 在两项独立的Cell Painting筛选数据上评估六种表征，包括CLOOME、CellCLIP等预训练分子编码器，以及一个与CLOOME输入和层数匹配但未预训练的MLP对照；采用可控制预训练边界泄漏与毒性混淆的实验协议进行对比。
AI.result: 在控制上述混淆因素后，预训练分子编码器相对普通理化描述符没有明显性能优势；同时在各表征中，毒性普遍比表型活性更容易预测。
AI.conclusion: 将表型预训练编码器作为表型药物发现的替代方案之前，应把泄漏感知、混淆控制的评估作为标准做法。

title: SepsisLens: Structure-Preserving Sequence Modelling for Decomposable Early Sepsis Warning
summary: Early sepsis warning from ICU records can be cast as a structure-preserving prediction problem. A model needs to detect deterioration from irregular measurements while keeping each alert connected to the physiological signals that support it. Many temporal models fuse clinical variables into a patient-level representation, supporting scalar risk prediction but weakening the structure needed for clinical decomposition. We present SepsisLens, which preserves variable-indexed temporal states until risk composition. Observation-aware representations encode each variable's dynamics and measurement history, while a shared temporal encoder models each trajectory without collapsing the variable axis. The StructuredRiskHead composes multi-horizon risk from explicit variable-level and organ-level components. We evaluate SepsisLens on three public ICU cohorts and one private-hospital cohort under a common pre-onset protocol. SepsisLens achieves strong discrimination on all four cohorts and lower alert burden at matched event recall on MIMIC-IV. Structural ablations support the design, while input-side masking shows that the ranked components reflect variables with greater influence on prediction.

AI.tldr: SepsisLens：一种结构保持的脓毒症早期预警模型，在风险合成前保留按变量索引的时序状态，实现可分解的多视野风险预测。
AI.motivation: ICU早期脓毒症预警需从非规则测量中检测恶化，同时保持每条警报与支持它的生理信号相关联。现有时序模型将临床变量融合为患者级表示，虽支持标量风险预测，却削弱了临床可分解所需的结构。
AI.method: 观测感知表示编码每个变量的动态与测量历史；共享时序编码器对每条轨迹建模而不压缩变量轴；StructuredRiskHead从显式的变量级和器官级组件合成多视野风险。在三个公共ICU队列和一个私立医院队列上，采用统一的发病前协议评估。
AI.result: 在全部四个队列上均取得较强的判别性能；在MIMIC-IV上于匹配事件召回率下警报负担更低。结构消融支持该设计；输入侧掩蔽表明排序组件反映对预测影响更大的变量。
AI.conclusion: SepsisLens通过保留变量索引的时序结构与显式风险分解，在保持预测性能的同时提升临床可解释性与警报效率。

title: A Riemannian Geometry for Low-rank Adaptation
summary: Low-rank adaptation (LoRA) is widely used as a parameter-efficient fine-tuning technique for pre-trained deep neural networks, which approximates the weight update via full fine-tuning by a low-rank matrix $BA^\top$. This parameterization leads to the equivalence relation $(B, A) \sim (BG^{-1}, AG^\top)$ for any invertible matrix $G$ because $BA^\top = BG^{-1}(AG^\top)^\top$ and thus both pairs yield the same loss value. This relation induces a quotient manifold where matrices $(BG^{-1}, AG^\top)$ for all $G$ are identified, eliminating redundant directions along which the loss value remains unchanged. To respect the geometry of this manifold, the original search space is endowed with a Riemannian metric that is invariant under the equivalence relation. Such a metric induces preconditioning at each gradient step and ensures that each weight update via LoRA changes the loss value, leading to efficient optimization. In this paper, we propose a new Riemannian metric that is specifically tailored to LoRA to close the gap to full fine-tuning at the weight level. We theoretically show that LoRA with our preconditioning induced by this metric satisfies the following two properties at each iteration: (i) The weight update follows the direction closest to the gradient of full fine-tuning within the subspace of first-order weight changes allowed by the LoRA parameterization. (ii) The updated weight matrix is closer in Frobenius norm to that of full fine-tuning than the updated weight matrices of LoRA with conventional preconditioning and without preconditioning. These theoretical insights suggest that our preconditioning makes LoRA better approximate full fine-tuning, thereby leading to more efficient optimization. Experiments show the effectiveness and efficiency of our preconditioning for LoRA on fine-tuning tasks with language and vision domains.

AI.tldr: 该论文针对LoRA的参数化冗余问题，提出一种专为LoRA定制的黎曼度量，通过等变预条件缩小LoRA与全量微调在权重层面的差距。
AI.motivation: LoRA通过低秩矩阵BA^T近似全量微调的权重更新，其参数化存在等价关系(B,A)~(BG^{-1},AG^T)，导致搜索空间含有损失值不变的冗余方向，且与全量微调在权重层面存在差距。已有黎曼度量方法未能专门针对LoRA设计，难以充分逼近全量微调。
AI.method: 在等价关系诱导的商流形上，为原始搜索空间赋予等变黎曼度量，从而诱导每步梯度的预条件；论文提出一种专为LoRA定制的新黎曼度量，并理论分析其诱导的预条件在每次迭代中的性质。
AI.result: 理论上证明：每次迭代中(i)权重更新方向在LoRA参数化所允许的一阶权重变化子空间内最接近全量微调的梯度方向；(ii)更新后的权重矩阵在Frobenius范数下比常规预条件和无预条件的LoRA更接近全量微调的权重矩阵。实验在语言和视觉微调任务上验证了该预条件的有效性与高效性。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的LoRA专用黎曼度量预条件能更好地近似全量微调，实现更高效的优化，在语言与视觉微调任务上均表现有效。

title: Enhancing Diffusion Language Models with Autoregressive Post-Training Weights
summary: Diffusion language models (dLLMs) have emerged as a promising alternative to autoregressive (AR) language models, offering flexible token-update orders and parallel decoding. Recent dLLMs are often initialized from pretrained AR models before diffusion conversion in order to inherit their learned representations. After the conversion, however, they typically ignore the extensive post-training ecosystem of their AR ancestors. In this work, we show that these existing AR post-training weight updates can instead be effectively recycled to enhance diffusion models. Despite the changes by AR-to-diffusion conversion, directly adding an AR post-training weight update to a diffusion base model remains effective, bringing its performance close to that achieved by direct diffusion post-training. Notably, AR and diffusion post-training updates are nearly orthogonal in weight space, yet induce substantially more aligned representation changes in the diffusion model. Their distinct updates are also complementary: composing their weights can retain gains from both regimes and further improve the post-trained diffusion model. Based on these findings, we propose A2D, a simple training-free framework for enhancing diffusion models with existing AR post-training resources. A2D can transfer capabilities from AR post-trained models to diffusion base models, and further improve already post-trained diffusion models by composing AR and diffusion post-training updates. Across various dLLMs, including Dream, DreamReasoner, DiffuCoder, Dream-Coder, Nemotron-Labs-Diffusion, and DiffusionGemma, A2D reliably improves instruction following, mathematical reasoning, and coding with both supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning updates, without additional training, or inference-time computation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 A2D 框架，发现自回归（AR）后训练权重更新可直接用于增强扩散语言模型（dLLMs），无需额外训练或推理开销。
AI.motivation: 扩散语言模型通常从预训练 AR 模型转换而来以继承其表示，但转换后往往忽略了 AR 祖先丰富的后训练生态（如 SFT、RL 权重更新），导致这些资源被浪费。
AI.method: A2D 是一个无需训练的框架：直接将从 AR 模型得到的后训练权重更新加到扩散基础模型上；进一步发现 AR 与扩散后训练更新在权重空间中近乎正交，却能引起扩散模型中对齐的表示变化，因此可通过组合（compose）两类权重更新来同时保留两种范式的增益。
AI.result: 在 Dream、DreamReasoner、DiffuCoder、Dream-Coder、Nemotron-Labs-Diffusion、DiffusionGemma 等多种 dLLMs 上，A2D 利用 SFT 与 RL 更新，稳定提升了指令遵循、数学推理与代码生成能力，且无需额外训练或推理时计算。
AI.conclusion: 现有的 AR 后训练权重更新可被有效回收利用以增强扩散模型；AR 与扩散后训练更新互补，组合二者能进一步提升已后训练的扩散模型。

title: Attenuated in-context identification in time-series foundation models: diagnosis under counterfactual inputs and repair by synthetic forced-system fine-tuning
summary: Covariate-aware time-series foundation models (TSFMs) promise training-free what-if answers for instrumented plants: the change in output that a different future input would cause. We test this on forced engineering systems with exact counterfactuals, comparing Chronos-2, TimesFM-2.5 and TabPFN-TS with classical system identification fitted to the same context. Through their default covariate interfaces, TimesFM-2.5 and TabPFN-TS are memoryless: the predicted effect of an input change is a same-time function of that change ($R^2 = 1.000$ for TimesFM-2.5). Chronos-2 identifies dynamics in context but attenuates them. Its predicted effect is 0.33-0.80 of the true effect, its recovered impulse response has the wrong shape, and its error on a one-degree-of-freedom oscillator levels off at 0.57 with 8192 context samples, where ARX fitted to 256 samples reaches 0.02. Context dither at inference lowers the what-if error on all six synthetic classes without training. A 26-minute fine-tune on synthetic forced systems restores the response magnitude (sensitivity 0.83-0.96) and outperforms structure-agnostic identification on Wiener-Hammerstein and a held-out friction class. A specialised in-context identifier trained on the same data comes close, so the forced-system data carry most of the gain. On three of four measured plants classical identification remains clearly better, and the fine-tuned model loses part of its univariate forecasting skill. Paired counterfactual inputs, together with shuffled future inputs on measured records, test two properties: whether the covariate interface can represent dynamics and whether the pretraining prior covers the plant's time scale. Only the counterfactual pairs expose the attenuation.

AI.tldr: 本文以具有精确反事实的受迫工程系统为测试床，评估协变量感知时间序列基础模型（Chronos-2、TimesFM-2.5、TabPFN-TS）能否免训练给出 what-if 因果推断，并与经典系统辨识对比。
AI.motivation: 协变量感知 TSFM 被宣称可为仪器化被控对象提供免训练的 what-if 答案，即"不同未来输入会导致的输出变化"，但这一能力缺乏在具有精确反事实的真值系统上的严格检验。
AI.method: 在受迫工程系统上构造精确反事实，比较三个 TSFM 与拟合于同一上下文的经典系统辨识（ARX 等）；引入成对反事实输入与在实测记录上打乱未来输入两种探针，分别检验协变量接口能否表征动态、以及预训练先验是否覆盖被控对象时间尺度；并测试推理期 context dither 与 26 分钟合成受迫系统微调。
AI.result: TimesFM-2.5 与 TabPFN-TS 经默认协变量接口表现为无记忆（输入变化的效应是同时刻函数，TimesFM-2.5 的 R²=1.000）；Chronos-2 能从上下文辨识动态但存在衰减：预测效应仅为真值的 0.33–0.80，恢复的脉冲响应形状错误，单自由度振子误差在 8192 上下文样本处仍停在 0.57，而用 256 样本的 ARX 可达 0.02。推理期 context dither 在全�部六类合成系统上免训练降低 what-if 误差；26 分钟微调可恢复响应幅度（敏感度 0.83–0.96），在 Wiener-Hammerstein 与留出摩擦类上优于结构无关辨识，但同等数据的专用上下文辨识器也接近其表现，说明增益主要来自受迫系统数据；在四类实测被控对象中三类经典辨识仍明显更优，且微调后单变量预测能力部分退化。
AI.conclusion: 只有成对反事实输入能暴露 TSFM 的动态衰减问题；打乱未来输入无法揭示。当前 TSFM 的协变量接口与预训练先验尚不足以为工程系统提供可靠的免训练 what-if 回答，微调虽可部分修复但以损失通用预测能力为代价，经典系统辨识在多数实测场景下仍占优。

title: Do LLMs Act on What They Know? From Partner Representations to Cooperative Actions
summary: Cooperation with unfamiliar partners requires adapting to communication conventions that are not known in advance. We study this problem in a controlled Hanabi-derived environment with scripted hint generation, LLM-controlled receiving decisions, and frozen model weights. Across eight LLMs, linear probes recover intent conventions substantially more accurately than target conventions, yet receiving choices do not consistently agree with the sender's convention. We compare probe-predicted and ground-truth conventions presented either as general rules or as externally computed action recommendations. Rule statements yield modest and model-dependent changes in cooperation, whereas action translation produces larger gains on average. In a Qwen3-8B case study, matched-state statement reversals reveal much greater sensitivity to action recommendations than to rule statements. Activation transfers from oracle-action and non-oracle hint-restatement donors improve intent accuracy on both action classes, but the tested alternatives do not reliably reproduce these benefits. Together, these results distinguish convention decodability, sensitivity to convention information, and cooperative performance, and highlight limitations in turning available partner information into receiving decisions.

AI.tldr: 研究考察LLM在与陌生伙伴协作时能否适应未知沟通约定。在Hanabi衍生环境中，线性探针更易解码意图约定而非目标约定，但接收决策并不始终遵循发送者约定；将约定转为外部动作建议比转为通用规则更能提升协作表现。
AI.motivation: 与不熟悉的伙伴合作需要适应无法预先知晓的沟通约定。作者希望区分三个环节：约定信息是否可被解码、模型是否对约定信息敏感、以及最终能否转化为协作收益，从而揭示LLM将可得伙伴信息转为接收决策的局限。
AI.method: 在受控的Hanabi衍生环境中，采用脚本化提示生成、LLM控制接收决策、冻结模型权重。测试八种LLM，使用线性探针恢复意图约定与目标约定，比较探针预测与真值约定，并以通用规则或外部计算的动作建议两种形式呈现。另对Qwen3-8B做案例研究，进行匹配状态下的陈述反转实验，并测试来自oracle动作与非oracle提示复述donor的激活迁移。
AI.result: 线性探针对意图约定的恢复准确率明显高于目标约定，但接收选择与发送者约定并不总一致。规则陈述仅带来有限且依赖模型的变化，动作翻译平均收益更大。Qwen3-8B中，匹配状态反转显示对动作建议的敏感性远高于规则陈述。oracle动作与非oracle提示复述donor的激活迁移均提升两类动作的意图准确率，但其他替代方案未能稳定复现该收益。
AI.conclusion: 研究区分了约定可解码性、对约定信息的敏感性与协作性能，表明LLM虽能部分解码伙伴约定信息，却难以将其有效转化为接收决策；以动作形式呈现信息比规则形式更有效，但相关收益的稳健迁移仍受限。

title: On the Intrinsic Limited Robustness of Latent-Based Watermarking
summary: Existing latent-based watermarking methods for diffusion models have overestimated their robustness to image distortions, including geometric transformations such as rotation, scaling, and translation (RST). Moreover, this paradigm of watermarking approaches may suffer from inherent limitations arising from the domain in which the watermark is embedded. In this paper, we provide the first theoretical analysis explaining why these methods lack invariance to perturbations. By relaxing the invariant relation, we derive a maximum perturbation bound that characterizes the relationship between pixel-space perturbations and their corresponding effects in latent space. In addition, we present the first analytical formulation that captures all components of practical detection mechanisms. Finally, we conduct experiments to validate the theoretical findings and the limitations of latent-based watermarking methods. Our theoretical and empirical results indicate that, under the current design paradigm, latent-based watermarking methods intrinsically exhibit limited robustness. We conclude by providing the analytical tool and design guidelines that future research could follow.

AI.tldr: 该论文首次从理论上分析了扩散模型潜空间水印方法对图像扰动（尤其RST几何变换）缺乏不变性的原因，推导出最大扰动界，并给出检测机制的统一解析形式，实验验证其固有鲁棒性局限，最后提供分析工具与设计指南。
AI.motivation: 现有基于潜空间的扩散模型水印方法高估了自身对图像失真（旋转、缩放、平移等几何变换）的鲁棒性，且该范式因水印嵌入域本身存在固有局限，但此前缺乏对此的理论解释，因此需要从理论上阐明其扰动不变性缺失的根源。
AI.method: 本文进行理论分析：通过放松不变关系，推导出刻画像素空间扰动与其在潜空间对应影响之间关系的最大扰动界；并提出首个能够涵盖实际检测机制所有组成部分的解析公式；随后通过实验验证理论结论及潜空间水印方法的局限。
AI.result: 理论与实证结果表明，在当前设计范式下，基于潜空间的水印方法本质上具有有限的鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 论文得出结论：潜空间水印方法的鲁棒性受限是范式内在的，并为后续研究提供了分析工具与设计指南。

title: Finding the Heads and the Neurons Responsible for Network Information Retrieval in Language Models
summary: We ask whether specific attention heads, and more finely specific neurons inside those heads, are responsible for recognizing that a language model's context contains network infrastructure information (a hostname paired with its IP address), and whether that responsibility can be validated causally rather than by correlation alone. At the head level the answer is yes, across five models spanning three architecture families: in every model, a small set of heads (1 to 9 out of 128 to 1152 candidates), found by causal ablation screening and tested for selectivity against matched negative and context-free controls, supports a detector with 99.5--100\% held-out accuracy. We then ask whether a head's responsibility concentrates into one neuron or stays spread across its dimensions; this is model-specific. In one model, the top head's signal concentrates into a single neuron, found independently by both a causal intervention and a correlational ranking, which agree exactly (AUC = 1.000, matching the full head). In another, the single clean head works as a whole (AUC = 1.000) but the best causally ranked neuron inside it does not (AUC = 0.665), so the responsibility there is spread across the head. The remaining three models fall in between. On an independent dataset collected by a different institution (reverse-DNS records rather than the discovery data), every model's full-head detector flags 100\% of positive records; the single-neuron versions transfer less reliably, and in one model score below chance. Causal head-finding for a specific network-information entity works across models and architectures; how far that finding can be pushed down to individual neurons varies, and needs to be checked for each model.

AI.tldr: 该论文检验语言模型是否由特定注意力头（乃至头内单个神经元）因果性地负责识别上下文中的"主机名-IP地址"网络基础设施信息。跨5个模型、3种架构族发现：每个模型都有1-9个注意力头经因果消融筛选后可支撑99.5-100%留出准确率的检测器；但责任是否下沉到单个神经元则因模型而异。
AI.motivation: 既有研究多用相关性方法定位语言模型内部负责特定任务的组件，但相关性不等于因果性。作者希望验证：识别网络基础设施信息（主机名与其IP地址配对）这一具体实体时，是否存在特定注意力头负责，并且该责任能否被因果验证而非仅靠相关性；进一步追问责任是否会集中到单个神经元。
AI.method: 在5个模型、3种架构族上进行因果消融筛选（causal ablation screening），找出负责检测网络信息实体的小集合注意力头，并用匹配的负样本与无上下文对照检验其选择性。在头级别之上，分别用因果干预与相关性排序两种独立方法定位头内最关键的单个神经元，比较二者是否一致，并测量单神经元AUC相对全头AUC的表现。最后在另一机构采集的独立数据集（reverse-DNS记录）上测试跨数据集泛化。
AI.result: 头级别：每个模型中仅1-9个（候选128-1152个）注意力头即可支撑99.5-100%留出准确率的检测器，跨模型与架构成立。神经元级别：因模型而异——某模型顶部头的信号集中于单个神经元，因果干预与相关性排序完全一致（AUC=1.000，与全头持平）；另一模型中单个干净头整体有效（AUC=1.000），但其内最佳因果神经元无效（AUC=0.665），责任分散于整个头；其余三个模型介于两者之间。独立数据集上：所有模型的全头检测器对100%正样本报警；单神经元版本迁移较差，某模型甚至低于随机水平。
AI.conclusion: 针对特定网络信息实体的因果头定位可跨模型与架构复用；但将这一发现进一步下沉到单个神经元的可行性因模型而异，需逐模型检验，不能默认头级结论可自动细化为神经元级结论。

title: Reinforcement Learning with Segment Reward Feedback under Linear Function Approximation
summary: Classical reinforcement learning (RL) assumes that a reward is observed for every visited state-action pair. However, in real-world applications such as autonomous driving, such fine-grained feedback can be costly or difficult to collect, whereas trajectory-level feedback may be too sparse for efficient learning. To provide a general feedback model bridging these two extremes and handle large state spaces, we study RL with segment reward feedback under linear function approximation. Our work answers how the granularity of segment feedback and the choice of segmentation influence learning. For equal-length segments with known transitions, we design algorithms $\bitssegd$ and $\edlinucbsegd$ for binary and sum feedback types, respectively. They adopt posterior sampling with planning to achieve computational efficiency and the E-optimal experimental design to attain near-optimality. Nearly matching lower bounds are established. For equal-length segments with unknown transitions, we develop a unified $\seglsvits$ framework with two instantiations for binary and sum feedback, which carefully integrates the posterior estimated reward parameters into least-squares value iteration. These results reveal a fundamental insight: under binary feedback, increasing the number of segments significantly reduces the regret through an exponential factor, while surprisingly, under sum feedback, the granularity of segments does not affect learning much. Finally, to investigate whether segmenting according to state-action features can further expedite learning, we design an algorithm $\uneqsegbitsd$ that allows arbitrary segmentations. The resulting regret bound shows that under the usual elliptical potential analysis, the influence of state-action features on the regret appears only through logarithmic factors, and equal segmentation achieves the best performance.

AI.tldr: 在线性函数逼近下研究分段奖励反馈的强化学习：分别针对等长分段（已知/未知转移）与任意分段设计算法，推导近最优上下界，揭示二元反馈与和反馈对分段粒度的不同依赖规律。
AI.motivation: 经典RL假设每个状态-动作对均有奖励，但现实中（如自动驾驶）细粒度反馈昂贵难获取，轨迹级反馈又过于稀疏。因此需要一个连接两端的通用反馈模型，并在大状态空间下处理分段奖励反馈问题。
AI.method: 在线性函数逼近下研究segment reward feedback。对等长且转移已知情形，分别针对binary与sum反馈设计$\bitssegd$和$\edlinucbsegd$，采用后验采样加规划保证计算效率，用E-最优实验设计达到近最优，并给出近匹配下界。对等长但转移未知情形，提出统一$\seglsvits$框架及两个实例，将后验估计的奖励参数融入最小二乘值迭代。对任意分段，设计$\uneqsegbitsd$算法并分析其遗憾界。
AI.result: binary反馈下，段数增加可通过指数因子显著降低遗憾；sum反馈下，分段粒度对学习影响不大。在常规椭圆势分析下，状态-动作特征对遗憾的影响仅通过对数因子体现，等长分段取得最佳性能。等长已知转移情形达到近最优遗憾并有近匹配下界。
AI.conclusion: 分段反馈的粒度与分段方式对学习有本质性影响：binary反馈可从更细分段中获得指数级收益，sum反馈则收益有限；按特征任意分段并不带来额外优势，等长分段最优。

title: Performative Prediction with Selective Labels
summary: Many social applications of machine learning exhibit performative effects: population behavior changes in response to deployed models. Performative prediction studies this interaction through a distribution map that relates each model to the population distribution it induces. One of the main results in this framework showed that repeated risk minimization (RRM), which updates models by retraining on the most recent data, can converge to a stable model that minimizes risk on its own induced distribution. However, existing analyses typically assume access to the complete distributions of features and labels after model deployment, ignoring the possibility of selective labels: observing labels only for the accepted subset of the population.
