In this work, we formalize performative prediction with selective labels and show that retraining only on observed data can misguide the retraining procedure and undermine the guarantees of convergence to a stable solution. We then propose a worst-case objective based on knowledge of a confidence interval on the probability of a positive label. Applying RRM to this objective permits us to remain within a bounded distance to the true stable point. Under a sensitivity assumption on the conditional label distribution, we further show how previously accepted data can tighten these confidence intervals over time. Experiments in a lending application with fairness regularization show that our robust optimization approach closely matches the performance of RRM with complete label access.

AI.tldr: 本文形式化了带选择性标签的表演性预测问题，发现仅用观测数据重训练会破坏RRM的收敛保证，提出基于阳性标签概率置信区间的鲁棒目标以保持与真实稳定点的有界距离，并在贷款实验中验证了有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有表演性预测分析假设部署后可获得完整的特征与标签分布，忽略了选择性标签问题——即只能观测到被接受子集的标签。这种假设在实际场景中不成立，而选择性标签会误导重训练过程，削弱收敛到稳定解的保证。
AI.method: 作者形式化带选择性标签的表演性预测框架；构建基于阳性标签概率置信区间知识的worst-case目标函数；对该目标应用重复风险最小化(RRM)，使模型与真实稳定点保持有界距离；在条件标签分布的敏感度假设下，利用先前接受的数据随时间收紧置信区间。
AI.result: 实验在带公平正则化的贷款应用中开展，结果表明所提出的鲁棒优化方法性能接近具有完整标签访问权的RRM。
AI.conclusion: 在存在选择性标签的表演性预测场景中，鲁棒优化可在仅观测接受子集标签的条件下近似实现完整标签访问时的收敛与性能，为保证稳定解提供了可行路径。

title: Scalable extraction and visualization of multi-attribute logical and functional dependencies in tabular data
comment: 31 pages, 4 figures, submitted to Pattern Recognition Journal
summary: Understanding the structural relationships among attributes in tabular data is fundamental to machine learning and pattern recognition. While functional dependency (FD) discovery has been extensively studied, scalable discovery of logical dependencies (LDs), particularly as the number of attributes and dependency order increase, remains underexplored. These dependencies capture non-deterministic, condition-specific relationships among pairwise or multiple attributes. Furthermore, existing approaches do not provide a unified framework for extracting multi-attribute LDs and FDs. To address these limitations, we propose LDTool and HLDTool for extracting and visualizing multi-attribute LDs and FDs from tabular data. LDTool extends dependency discovery beyond pairwise relationships, while HLDTool enables scalable extraction through hypergraph-guided search-space reduction. Experiments on three simulated and eleven real-world datasets demonstrate that the proposed framework extracts meaningful LDs and FDs while improving scalability. LDTool recovers the same FDs as existing FD discovery methods with lower runtime in high-dimensional feature spaces, whereas HLDTool enables dependency discovery in datasets with hundreds of features. The proposed framework provides interpretable visualizations of dependency structures and supports applications in exploratory data analysis and the quantitative evaluation of synthetic tabular data.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 LDTool 与 HLDTool，用于从表格数据中提取并可视化多属性逻辑依赖（LD）与函数依赖（FD），通过超图引导的搜索空间缩减提升可扩展性。
AI.motivation: 表格数据中属性间结构关系对机器学习与模式识别至关重要。现有函数依赖（FD）发现研究充分，但逻辑依赖（LD）的可扩展发现（尤其随属性数量与依赖阶数增加）仍缺乏探索；LD 能刻画成对或多属性间非确定性、条件特定的关系，且现有方法缺乏统一框架同时提取多属性 LD 与 FD。
AI.method: 提出 LDTool 和 HLDTool 两个工具：LDTool 将依赖发现从成对关系扩展到多属性关系；HLDTool 通过超图引导的搜索空间缩减实现可扩展提取，并支持依赖结构的可解释可视化。
AI.result: 在 3 个模拟数据集与 11 个真实数据集上实验：框架可提取有意义的 LD 与 FD 并提升可扩展性；LDTool 在高维特征空间中与现有 FD 发现方法恢复相同 FD 且运行时间更低；HLDTool 可在数百个特征的数据集上完成依赖发现。
AI.conclusion: 该框架提供依赖结构的可解释可视化，可支持探索性数据分析以及合成表格数据的定量评估等应用。

title: OxiGen: Oxidation-State-Aware Crystal Generation
summary: Generative models have the potential to accelerate inorganic materials discovery by enabling inverse design, but generating experimentally realisable crystals remains challenging. Oxidation states are widely used to assess the compositional validity of crystals and guide inorganic materials discovery. While existing generative models for crystals can generate materials with charge-neutral oxidation-state assignments, they poorly reproduce the distributions of oxidation states observed in synthesised materials. To address this limitation, we propose OxiGen, an oxidation-state-aware crystal diffusion model that explicitly represents oxidation states during generation. OxiGen enforces global charge neutrality by construction using a structured output layer with exact inference over a finite-state automaton. Empirically, OxiGen substantially improves oxidation-state fidelity, generates the highest rate of stable, unique, and novel crystals among evaluated methods, and maintains high compositional validity even under property conditioning.

AI.tldr: OxiGen是一种氧化态感知的晶体扩散模型，在生成过程中显式建模氧化态，通过有限状态自动机的结构化输出层保证全局电荷中性，从而提升氧化态保真度与稳定、独特、新颖晶体的生成率。
AI.motivation: 生成模型有望加速无机材料的逆向设计，但生成实验可实现的晶体仍有挑战。氧化态常用于评估晶体组成有效性并指导材料发现，而现有生成模型虽能生成电荷中性的氧化态分配，却难以复现合成材料中氧化态的分布。因此需要一种在生成过程中显式考虑氧化态的方法。
AI.method: 提出OxiGen，一种氧化态感知的晶体扩散模型，在生成过程中显式表示氧化态。模型通过带精确推断的结构化输出层，基于有限状态自动机在构造上强制满足全局电荷中性。
AI.result: 实验表明，OxiGen显著提升了氧化态保真度，在所评估方法中生成稳定、独特且新颖晶体的比例最高，并且在性质条件约束下仍保持较高的组成有效性。
AI.conclusion: 显式建模氧化态并结合电荷中性的结构化约束，可有效改善晶体生成的质量与有效性，为无机材料逆设计提供了更实用的生成框架。

title: Structure-Aware Graph Abstention for Reliable Selective Forecasting
summary: Selective forecasting abstains on high-risk test windows under a retained-coverage budget. Existing gates such as TEM (Brusokas et al., 2025) score each forecast as a whole; for multivariate outputs, trajectories can look plausible while violating dependencies among variables. We treat instance-level plausibility and relational consistency as distinct reliability axes and operationalize the latter via a learned sparse graph and a Dirichlet-style structural energy E_struct, trained with error-weighted graph regularization and score-error alignment. On seven long-horizon benchmarks and four backbones, structural gating often reduces selective MSE versus TEM at matched coverage, with the largest gains where cross-variable structure appears more informative in our benchmarks; gains are not universal, indicating a complementary abstention signal. Table 1 is a Protocol A ranking diagnostic (seed 2024); three-seed deployable Protocol B on an aligned subset is in Table 3 (full validation-to-test grids: Appendix A).

AI.tldr: 该论文提出将选择性预测的可靠性分解为"实例级合理性"与"关系一致性"两个正交维度，并用可学习的稀疏图与Dirichlet风格结构能量E_struct实现结构门控，在多变量长时预测中提升选择性精度。
AI.motivation: 现有选择性预测门控（如TEM）将每条预测整体打分为单一可靠性分数，对多变量输出而言，轨迹本身看似合理却可能违反变量间依赖关系，这类关系层面的失效无法被实例级评分捕获。
AI.method: 把实例级合理性与关系一致性视为两条独立的可靠性轴；用可学习稀疏图建模变量间结构，并定义Dirichlet风格的结构能量E_struct；训练时采用误差加权图正则化与分数-误差对齐（score-error alignment）联合优化，形成结构门控用于在高风险测试窗口上弃答。
AI.result: 在7个长时预测基准与4种骨干网络上，匹配覆盖率下结构门控常能降低选择性MSE（相对TEM），在基准中跨变量结构信息更丰富的场景增益最大；但增益并非普适，说明其提供的是互补的弃答信号。表1为Protocol A排序诊断（seed 2024），表3为对齐子集上的三随机种子可部署Protocol B，完整验证-测试网格见附录A。
AI.conclusion: 关系一致性可作为独立于实例级评分的选择性预测信号，与TEM类门控互补；结构门控在信息丰富时收益明显，但不保证全面提升，需与既有门控结合使用。

title: Uncertainty Quantification Is Indispensable for Reliable Connectome-Based Graph Learning: A Narrative Review and Case Study
summary: While graph neural networks (GNNs) have shown substantial promise in connectome-based diagnostic classification, deterministic models inevitably suppress pipeline-induced noise and model ambiguities, yielding overconfident predictions. Although uncertainty quantification (UQ) is widely adopted in voxel-level segmentation, its role in connectomic graph learning remains largely unaddressed. This paper presents a comprehensive narrative review of UQ frameworks tailored to connectome graph learning alongside an empirical case study demonstrating the perils of uncalibrated predictions. We delineate sources of aleatoric and epistemic uncertainty across neuroimaging pipelines and review prominent UQ paradigms, from Bayesian approximations and ensemble methods to evidential learning and conformal prediction. In our case study, a temporal Graph Attention Network (GAT) trained on dynamic functional connectivity (dFC) matrices from the SUDMEX CONN dataset achieves 80.0% diagnostic accuracy (F1 = 0.794) for Cocaine Use Disorder. However, a post-hoc uncertainty audit via Monte Carlo dropout reveals severe overconfidence (ECE = 0.127), with misclassified subjects assigned prediction confidences up to 95%. This empirical divergence between discrimination and calibration underscores the confidence paradox in deep connectomics. Our findings establish that rigorous UQ, calibration, and selective prediction mechanisms are indispensable for deploying trustworthy graph-based biomarkers in clinical neuroscience.

AI.tldr: 本文综述面向连接组图学习的不确定性量化（UQ）框架，并通过案例研究揭示未校准预测的隐患：时间GAT在SUDMEX CONN数据集上诊断可卡因使用障碍达80.0%准确率（F1=0.794），但蒙特卡洛dropout审计显示严重过度自信（ECE=0.127），误分类被试置信度高达95%，揭示了深度连接组学中的"置信度悖论"。
AI.motivation: GNN在基于连接组的诊断分类中表现良好，但确定性模型会抑制数据管线噪声与模型歧义，导致过度自信的预测。尽管UQ在体素级分割中已广泛应用，其在连接组图学习中的作用仍未被充分探讨。
AI.method: 采用叙事性综述方法，梳理面向连接组图学习的UQ框架：1) 界定神经影像管线中偶然不确定性与认知不确定性的来源；2) 回顾主流UQ范式，包括贝叶斯近似、集成方法、证据学习与保形预测；3) 开展经验性案例研究，基于SUDMEX CONN数据集的动态功能连接（dFC）矩阵训练时间图注意力网络（GAT），并通过蒙特卡洛dropout进行事后不确定性审计。
AI.result: 案例研究中，时间GAT对可卡因使用障碍的诊断准确率为80.0%（F1=0.794）。然而事后UQ审计显示严重过度自信，期望校准误差（ECE）达0.127，且误分类被试的预测置信度最高可达95%。
AI.conclusion: 区分能力与校准度之间的经验性背离凸显了深度连接组学中的"置信度悖论"。研究结论表明，严格的UQ、校准及选择性预测机制对于在临床神经科学中部署可信的图基生物标志物不可或缺。

title: Sensor Geometry as a Flow-Matching Prior for Multi-Channel Brain Signals
summary: Flow-matching models start from an isotropic Gaussian source, the standard choice when the correlation structure of the data is unknown in advance. For multi-channel brain recordings, however, part of this structure is known in advance. Electrodes sit at fixed positions on the head, and volume conduction through the skull and scalp makes nearby electrodes co-vary in a way that is shared across subjects. Existing EEG generative models nonetheless leave the network to learn this from scratch. We put this structure into the source instead. From the sensor coordinates alone, we build a k-nearest-neighbor graph and take a graph-Matérn function of its Laplacian as the source covariance, so the flow starts from spatially coherent patterns rather than channel-independent noise. The change adds no learned parameters, works with any coupling and any drift network, and uses the same three hyperparameters on every dataset. Across eight EEG datasets and four flow-matching methods, the graph-Matérn source lowers the spectral discrepancy between generated and real signals in the five clinical bands (PSD-KL) on most datasets. PSD-KL falls by 12% to 17% in geometric mean over datasets depending on the method and by up to 40% on PhysioNet-MI, the densest montage. We show that the improvement stems from the spatial eigenvectors of the local graph of sensor positions, since randomizing the eigenvectors while preserving the eigenvalue spectrum eliminates the gain. Furthermore, a prior fitted directly to the empirical data covariance performs worse than isotropic noise. The same construction applies unchanged to MEG, intracranial EEG with patient-specific grids, and a traffic-sensor network, lowering PSD-KL for every method on each. https://jd730.github.io/projects/GraphPrior

AI.tldr: 该论文提出用基于传感器坐标的图-Matérn先验替代流匹配模型的各向同性高斯源，在不增加参数的前提下提升脑电等信号生成质量。
AI.motivation: 多通道脑记录（如EEG）中，电极空间位置固定，颅骨与头皮体积传导导致邻近电极共变，这种空间结构跨被试共享，是可预先获知的。但现有EEG生成模型仍从各向同性高斯噪声出发，让网络从零学习该结构，既低效又浪费已知信息。
AI.method: 仅利用传感器坐标构建k近邻图，取其拉普拉斯算子的图-Matérn函数作为源协方差，使流从空间相干的模式而非通道独立噪声出发。该方法不引入任何可学习参数，兼容任意耦合与漂移网络，且在全部数据集上使用同样的三个超参数。
AI.result: 在8个EEG数据集和4种流匹配方法上，图-Matérn源在多数数据集上降低了五临床频段生成信号与真实信号的谱差异（PSD-KL）。各方法跨数据集几何平均下降12%–17%，在最密集导联的PhysioNet-MI上最高下降40%。实验表明增益源于传感器局部图的空间特征向量：随机化特征向量而保留特征值谱会消除增益；而直接拟合经验数据协方差的先验反而不如各向同性噪声。该构造同样适用于MEG、患者个性化网格的颅内EEG以及交通传感器网络，且对所有方法均降低PSD-KL。
AI.conclusion: 将已知的传感器空间结构编码进流匹配的源分布，是一种无需参数、通用且有效的先验设计，可跨模态与任务一致地改善生成信号的频谱保真度。

title: Accelerating the Development of PLGA In Situ Forming Depots Through AI-Driven Multi-Objective Optimization
summary: Developing long-acting injectable formulations requires the simultaneous optimization of drug loading, release kinetics, viscosity, injectability, stability and other objectives. To navigate this multidimensional space, Corbion and Intrepid combined Corbion's diverse PURASORB bioresorbable polymer library with Intrepid Labs' proprietary AI algorithm (ANDROMEDA 1) to develop in situ forming depots for a therapeutic peptide. Over approximately 15 weeks, 181 unique formulations spanning drug loadings of 6-12% w/w were prepared and characterized through broad design-space mapping and targeted multi-objective optimization. Four lead candidate formulations were identified at 6%, 9%, and 12% w/w drug loading. Each met the predefined viscosity and injectability criteria while providing distinct 30-day in vitro release profiles. The study evaluated polymers spanning a broad range of molecular weights, including commercially available PURASORB grades and new polymers under development by Corbion to expand its polymer toolbox. ANDROMEDA 1 identified that polymers with intermediate molecular weights provided a favorable balance between sustained release and solution viscosity. Together, these findings demonstrate how integrated polymer expertise and AI-driven optimization can rapidly identify differentiated formulation candidates, focus the development space, and establish a strong data-driven foundation for further optimization and in vivo evaluation.

AI.tldr: Corbion与Intrepid合作，将PURASORB可生物降解聚合物库与AI算法ANDROMEDA 1结合，约15周内制备并表征181种原位成型缓释制剂，筛选出4个满足黏度与可注射性标准、具有差异化30天体外释放行为的先导候选配方。
AI.motivation: 长效注射制剂开发需同时优化载药量、释放动力学、黏度、可注射性、稳定性等多维目标，传统试错式筛选效率低、开发空间大，亟需数据驱动与AI辅助的多目标优化策略来快速聚焦候选配方。
AI.method: 将Corbion多样化PURASORB生物可吸收聚合物库（涵盖宽分子量范围，含商业化牌号及在研新聚合物）与Intrepid Labs专有AI算法ANDROMEDA 1整合，针对一种治疗性多肽构建原位成型储库（in situ forming depot）。约15周内制备并表征181种独特配方，载药量为6–12% w/w，采用宽范围设计空间映射与靶向多目标优化相结合的策略。
AI.result: 识别出4个先导候选配方，载药量分别为6%、9%和12% w/w，均满足预设黏度与可注射性标准，并提供各自不同的30天体外释放曲线。ANDROMEDA 1表明中等分子量聚合物在缓释性能与溶液黏度之间取得有利平衡。
AI.conclusion: 整合的聚合物专业能力与AI驱动优化可快速识别差异化配方候选、聚焦开发空间，并为后续优化及体内评价建立坚实的数据驱动基础。

title: Decision-Focused Learning in MDPs: An Occupancy Measure Approach
summary: In this work, we consider decision-focused learning (DFL) for a Markov decision process (MDP), where existing methods differentiate through the KKT conditions of the Bellman equation and require solving a linear system over all state-action pairs, limiting its scalability. We address this by reformulating the MDP as an occupancy measure-based linear program (LP), whose feasible region is induced by predicted dynamics, and we derive a closed-form gradient by identifying the active constraints in the feasible polyhedron via the pivoting algorithm. This occupancy measure-based LP layer raises two challenges: (1) LP's solution gradient is discontinuous when active constraints change, and (2) the LP backward cost still scales with the state size, which is costly for large or continuous state spaces. We address the challenges with an augmented Lagrangian surrogate and smooth the boundary jumps by random row sketching of the constraints, and a learnable soft state-aggregation layer and its function-approximation generalization that scales the LP to large finite and continuous-state MDPs. Across multiple tasks, our methods reach lower regret than KKT-based DFL and two-stage baselines with significantly lower computation cost. The source code for all experiments is available at https://github.com/A-Eshragh/State_Aggregation_Project.

AI.tldr: 该论文针对MDP中的决策聚焦学习（DFL）可扩展性问题，将MDP重构为基于占用测度的线性规划（LP），提出闭式梯度、增广拉格朗日代理与随机行草图、可学习软状态聚合层，实现低遗憾与低计算成本。
AI.motivation: 现有DFL方法对Bellman方程的KKT条件求导，需在所有状态-动作对上求解线性系统，因而可扩展性受限，难以处理大规模或连续状态空间。
AI.method: 将MDP重构为基于占用测度的LP，其可行域由预测动力学诱导；通过枢轴算法识别可行多面体的活跃约束，推导闭式梯度。针对活跃约束变化导致LP解梯度不连续的问题，引入增广拉格朗日代理并通过约束的随机行草图平滑边界跳变；针对LP反向计算仍随状态规模增长的问题，提出可学习的软状态聚合层及其函数逼近泛化，将LP扩展至大规�模有限与连续状态MDP。
AI.result: 在多个任务上，所提方法相比基于KKT的DFL与两阶段基线取得更低遗憾，且计算成本显著降低。所有实验源代码已公开。
AI.conclusion: 通过占用测度LP层、增广拉格朗日平滑与状态聚合，可在保证梯度质量的同时显著提升DFL的可扩展性与效率。

title: Atom-JEPA: Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture for 3D Atomistic Systems
summary: Large-scale self-supervised pretraining has reshaped modern machine learning, substantially advancing the ability of language and vision models to generalize across downstream tasks. While deep learning has driven considerable progress in modeling atomistic systems in recent years, self-supervised pretraining in this domain has not yet achieved comparable downstream generalization. To address this, we introduce Atom-JEPA, a self-supervised pretraining framework that learns latent representations from unlabeled 3D structures through complementary atom-level and substructure-level objectives inspired by joint-embedding predictive architectures. We pretrain Atom-JEPA on large-scale molecular and crystalline datasets and evaluate its transfer performance by fine-tuning on a diverse set of downstream property prediction tasks. Atom-JEPA achieves state-of-the-art performance on molecular ADMET and quantum-chemical property prediction tasks, and is highly competitive in predicting the physical properties of crystalline materials. These results demonstrate the potential of latent-space predictive pretraining to support broad downstream generalization from structural data alone. Code and pretrained model checkpoints are publicly available at https://github.com/khelverskovp/atom-jepa

AI.tldr: 提出Atom-JEPA自监督预训练框架，从无标注3D结构学习潜表征，在分子与晶体性质预测任务上取得优异迁移性能。
AI.motivation: 自监督预训练在语言和视觉领域显著提升下游泛化能力，但在原子尺度建模（分子、晶体）中尚未取得可比的泛化效果。本文旨在弥补这一差距，实现仅依赖结构数据的广泛下游泛化。
AI.method: 提出Atom-JEPA，受联合嵌入预测架构（JEPA）启发，通过原子级与子结构级互补目标，从无标注3D结构中学习潜空间表征；在大规模分子与晶体数据集上进行预训练，并在多样化的下游性质预测任务上微调以评估迁移性能。
AI.result: 在分子ADMET与量子化学性质预测任务上达到最先进性能，在晶体材料物理性质预测上具有高度竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明潜空间预测式预训练能够仅凭结构数据支撑广泛的下游泛化，为原子系统建模提供了有前景的预训练范式；代码与预训练模型已公开。

title: VETTA: Coordinating Turn- and Token-Level Credit Assignment for Multi-Turn LLM Agents
summary: Multi-turn LLM agents often receive sparse task feedback across several interactions, while generating each response token by token. This creates two related credit-assignment questions: which responses helped achieve the outcome, and which generation decisions mattered within each response? Existing methods typically focus on only one level: turn-level methods evaluate complete responses but do not distinguish the decisions within them; token-level methods can propagate feedback across turns but do not explicitly model credit for each response. These complementary limitations motivate learning credit at both levels and coordinating it in a single policy update. We introduce VETTA, a credit assignment method that jointly learns turn- and token-level values through separate heads on a shared lightweight critic. VETTA computes advantages along both temporal sequences and combines each turn advantage with a within-response-centered token residual for PPO updates. Furthermore, to reduce value-learning cost, the critic retains only early Transformer blocks from the pretrained checkpoint used to initialize the actor. On two challenging agent benchmarks, ALFWorld and WebShop, VETTA improves success rates over PPO by 37.5% and 22.3%, respectively, with Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct and achieves success rates of 95.5% and 76.0%, respectively, with Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct. Critic-depth comparisons further show strong task performance with substantially lower critic-side computation. These results suggest that a compact shared critic can coordinate turn- and token-level credit to improve agent performance while keeping value estimation efficient. Code is available at https://github.com/Jiaju-Chen/VETTA-official.

AI.tldr: VETTA 提出一种在多轮 LLM 智能体中同时学习回合级与 token 级价值的信用分配方法，通过共享轻量评论家上的双头结构协调两层信用，并在 PPO 更新中融合优势，显著提升 ALFWorld 与 WebShop 成功率。
AI.motivation: 多轮 LLM 智能体在多次交互中仅获得稀疏任务反馈，且响应逐 token 生成，因此存在两个层级的信用分配问题：哪些响应有助于达成结果（回合级），以及每个响应内部哪些生成决策重要（token 级）。现有方法通常只关注单一层级：回合级方法评估完整响应但无法区分其内部决策；token 级方法能跨回合传播反馈但未显式建模每个响应的信用。二者互补的局限促使作者在一个策略更新中同时学习并协调两个层级的信用。
AI.method: 提出 VETTA，在共享的轻量评论家（critic）上通过独立的值头联合学习回合级与 token 级价值。沿时间序列计算回合优势，并将每个回合优势与响应内中心化的 token 残差相结合，用于 PPO 更新。为降低价值学习成本，评论家仅保留用于初始化 actor 的预训练检查点中的早期 Transformer 块。
AI.result: 在 ALFWorld 与 WebShop 两个具有挑战性的智能体基准上，使用 Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct 时，VETTA 相比 PPO 的成功率分别提升 37.5% 与 22.3%；使用 Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct 时成功率分别达到 95.5% 与 76.0%。评论家深度对比进一步表明，在显著降低评论家侧计算量的情况下仍能保持较强任务性能。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，一个紧凑的共享评论家能够协调回合级与 token 级信用，在保持价值估计高效的同时提升智能体性能。代码已开源。

title: SSR: Sparse Segment Reduction for Ternary GEMM Acceleration
comment: Published in the Proceedings of the Design, Automation & Test in Europe Conference (DATE 2026)
summary:
Large Language Models (LLMs) require substantial computational resources, limiting their deployment on resource-constrained hardware. Ternary LLMs mitigate these demands through weight quantization via ternary values, achieving significant compression often with 50-90% sparsity. However, existing approaches have limitations: methods optimized for ternary weights, such as BitNet, redundant segment reduction (RSR), and its improved version RSR++, do not exploit sparsity structures, while conventional sparse formats neglect ternary characteristics, foregoing dual optimization opportunities.
  In this paper, we introduce Sparse Segment Reduction (SSR), a ternary matrix multiplication method designed to accelerate the inference of ternary LLMs and general Ternary Weight Networks (TWNs). SSR has a dedicated optimized ternary data format and an algorithm that systematically exploits sparsity patterns through computation trees that scale with the sparsity. SSR provides theoretical gains with asymptotically faster inference than RSR++ for sparsity above 50%, while practical evaluations reveal performance improvements across all sparsity levels. Evaluation results show that SSR achieves 2.1-11.3x speedup over RSR++ on ternary GEMM with 45-95% sparsity. Furthermore, SSR achieves 3.5-6.3x end-to-end speedup and 4.9% of memory saving over RSR++ on the Llama-3 1B model inference.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Sparse Segment Reduction (SSR)，一种面向三值权重网络（TWN）和量化LLM推理的三值矩阵乘法加速方法，通过专用三值数据格式与计算树算法系统利用稀疏性，在多个稀疏度下相较RSR++实现显著加速。
AI.motivation: LLM推理算力需求大，难以部署于资源受限硬件；三值量化可实现50-90%稀疏度压缩，但现有方法未能同时利用三值特性与稀疏结构：BitNet、RSR、RSR++等针对三值权重优化的方法忽略稀疏结构，而传统稀疏格式忽略三值特性，导致双重优化机会被浪费。
AI.method: 提出SSR（Sparse Segment Reduction）三值矩阵乘法方法：设计专用的优化三值数据格式；配合基于计算树（computation trees）的算法，使计算规模随稀疏度扩展，从而系统性地利用稀疏模式。
AI.result: 稀疏度高于50%时，SSR理论上比RSR++渐近更快；各稀疏度下实测均有提升。三值GEMM在45-95%稀疏度下相较RSR++加速2.1-11.3x；在Llama-3 1B端到端推理中相较RSR++加速3.5-6.3x，并节省4.9%内存。
AI.conclusion: SSR同时利用三值特征与稀疏结构，弥合了现有三值优化方法与稀疏格式之间的空白，在理论与实测上均优于RSR++，可作为三值LLM及通用TWN的高效推理加速方案。

title: Climbing the Design Ladder: Sequential Knowledge Distillation for Early-Stage Circuit Timing Prediction
summary: Integrated circuit design involves multiple design stages: logic synthesis, floorplanning, placement, and routing, with each stage taking hours to weeks to complete. Discovering timing violations late in this flow forces costly iterations back to earlier stages, wasting computational resources and delaying product launches. While predicting post-routing timing from early-stage data could prevent these failures, existing machine learning approaches struggle with the massive abstraction gap between post-synthesis logical descriptions and post-routing physical layouts. We propose STEP-KD (Sequential Timing Evaluation via Progressive Knowledge Distillation), which leverages intermediate design stages as ``stepping stones'' for progressive knowledge transfer rather than attempting direct prediction. STEP-KD trains teacher models at the post-routing, post-placement, and post-floorplan stages, then sequentially distills their knowledge to a post-synthesis student model through representation alignment. Experiments on diverse circuits demonstrate that STEP-KD reduces timing prediction error compared to direct distillation and supervised baselines, and in most settings compared to the industry-standard Static Timing Analysis (STA) tool. STEP-KD reduces the weighted mean absolute percentage error of Total Negative Slack prediction to 19.78\%, compared with 74.84\% for STA. Our proposed method is step forward to identify timing problems earlier, avoiding expensive late-stage redesigns.

AI.tldr: 提出STEP-KD方法，通过将多个中间设计阶段作为"踏脚石"进行渐进式知识蒸馏，把后布线时序知识逐级传递给后综合阶段的学生模型，从而在早期实现高精度时序预测。
AI.motivation: 集成电路设计流程包含逻辑综合、布局规划、布局、布线等多个阶段，各阶段耗时长。若在后布线阶段才发现时序违规，需回退到早期阶段反复迭代，浪费计算资源并延误产品上市。现有机器学习方法难以跨越后综合逻辑描述与后布线物理布局之间的巨大抽象鸿沟，因此需要一种能弥合该鸿沟的早期时序预测手段。
AI.method: 提出STEP-KD（Sequential Timing Evaluation via Progressive Knowledge Distillation）。与直接预测不同，该方法利用中间设计阶段作为"踏脚石"进行渐进式知识迁移：分别在后布线、后布局、后布局规划阶段训练教师模型，再通过表示对齐（representation alignment）依次将其知识蒸馏到后综合阶段的学生模型中。
AI.result: 在多种电路上的实验表明，STEP-KD相较直接蒸馏和监督基线降低了时序预测误差，在多数设置下也优于工业标准静态时序分析（STA）工具。STEP-KD将总负裕量（Total Negative Slack）预测的加权平均绝对百分比误差降至19.78%，而STA为74.84%。
AI.conclusion: STEP-KD为更早识别时序问题提供了可行路径，有助于避免代价高昂的后期重新设计。

title: Learning PDE solution operators with variable initial conditions via Latent Dynamics Networks
summary: In many-query scenarios, data-driven surrogate models provide an efficient alternative to high-fidelity solvers for simulating physical systems governed by Partial Differential Equations (PDEs). In this context, the Latent Dynamics Network (LDNet) has recently demonstrated remarkable performance in predicting the response of spatio-temporal systems, combining Neural Ordinary Differential Equations with nonlinear dimensionality reduction. However, the original formulation assumes a fixed initial condition, limiting its applicability to many real-world applications where a system evolves from varying starting states. In this work, we overcome this limitation while keeping the end-to-end training procedure of the original LDNet and its encoder-free nature, which preserves its intrinsic independence from spatial resolution and grid topology. We infer the initial latent state directly from a small set of early-time observations, treating latent-state initialization as an adaptation problem, and investigate two strategies: an auto-decoding formulation and a meta-learning approach in which the initial latent state acts as a task-specific context variable. We demonstrate the accuracy of the proposed methods across diverse physical phenomena, spanning advection-diffusion, fluid dynamics, and solid mechanics. Meta-learning markedly accelerates latent-state inference and induces smoother, better-conditioned optimization landscapes, and spontaneously organizes the latent space into a structured representation that reflects physically meaningful features of the underlying dynamics. The coordinate-based decoder enables training from spatially subsampled data while recovering high-resolution solution fields at inference. The resulting approach provides an efficient and resolution-independent surrogate modeling framework for many-query simulations of time-dependent PDEs with varying initial conditions.

AI.tldr: 本文扩展了LDNet，使其支持变化初始条件：通过少量早期观测推断初始隐状态，提出auto-decoding与meta-learning两种策略，在多种物理系统中验证了精度与效率。
AI.motivation: 原始LDNet假设固定初始条件，限制了其在系统从不同初始状态演化这一常见实际场景中的应用，因此需要一种能在保持端到端训练和无编码器特性的前提下处理变化初始条件的方法。
AI.method: 保留原LDNet的端到端训练流程与无编码器特性，将初始隐状态推断视为适应问题，从少量早期观测中推断初始隐状态；研究两种策略：auto-decoding公式，以及将初始隐状态作为任务特定上下文变量的元学习方法。采用基于坐标的decoder，支持从空间下采样数据训练并在推理时恢复高分辨率解场。
AI.result: 在advection-diffusion、流体动力学和固体力学等多种物理现象上验证了方法的准确性。元学习显著加速了隐状态推断，产生更平滑、条件更好的优化景观，并自发将隐空间组织为反映底层动力学物理特征的结构化表示。基于坐标的decoder支持从空间下采样数据训练并恢复高分辨率解场。
AI.conclusion: 该方法为具有变化初始条件的时间依赖PDE多查询模拟提供了一个高效且与分辨率无关的代理建模框架。

title: MetaLearnNCA: Few-Shot Offline Meta-Learning via Interacting Neural Cellular Automata
summary: Few-shot meta-learning traditionally formulates task adaptation either as analytical gradient descent through unrolled computational graphs or as metric-based distance comparisons over flattened 1D fea- ture vectors, which either incur costly test-time backpropagation or discard native 2D spatial geometry. In this work, we propose METALEARNNCA, a decentralized framework that achieves few-shot adapta- tion through the dynamical interaction of coupled Neural Cellular Automata (NCAs) without computing analytical gradients during inference. MetaLearnNCA decomposes task adaptation into an Active- NCA, which executes task inference conditioned on a continuous 2D spatial memory grid termed the spatial program, and a learned Meta-NCA, which acts as a decentralized cellular optimizer by diffusing spatial error residuals across local neighborhoods to dynamically update this program. METALEARN- NCA is competitive against canonical meta-learners in-distribution (96.12% on Omniglot) with Out-Of- Distribution transfer gains on MNIST, KMNIST, and Fashion-MNIST transfer across 10 independent testing seeds across 1-, 5-, and 10-shot regimes (e.g., surpassing Prototypical Networks by +10.54% on 10-shot MNIST and a +3.87% gain on 10-shot Fashion-MNIST over FOMAML). Our results establish that robust, gradient-free learning-to-learn can emerge from decentralized cellular dynamics on non-von Neumann substrates.

AI.tldr: 提出MetaLearnNCA，一种通过耦合神经细胞自动机动态交互实现少样本适应的去中心化框架，推理时无需解析梯度。
AI.motivation: 传统少样本元学习要么依赖展开计算图的解析梯度下降（带来昂贵的测试时反向传播），要么基于扁平化1D特征向量做度量比较（丢弃原生2D空间几何），因此需要一种既梯度无关又保留空间结构的适应方法。
AI.method: 将任务适应分解为两个耦合组件：Active-NCA基于连续2D空间记忆网格（spatial program）执行任务推断；Meta-NCA作为去中心化细胞优化器，在局部邻域内扩散空间误差残差，动态更新该program。
AI.result: 在Omniglot分布内达到96.12%，与经典元学习器相当；在MNIST、KMNIST、Fashion-MNIST的分布外迁移中，跨10个独立测试种子、1/5/10-shot设置取得提升，例如10-shot MNIST超Prototypical Networks +10.54%，10-shot Fashion-MNIST较FOMAML +3.87%。
AI.conclusion: 在非冯·诺依曼基底上，稳健的、无梯度的learning-to-learn能力可由去中心化细胞动力学涌现，证明空间几何感知与无需反向传播的元学习可兼得。

title: PHBA: Prefix-State Hybrid Block Attention
summary: Hybrid architectures combining linear sequence models with softmax attention provide an effective balance between efficient long-context modeling and precise token retrieval. Existing designs such as Native Hybrid Attention (NHA) combine compressed long-term states with sliding-window attention, but their exact attention is restricted to a fixed local window. In this work, we introduce Prefix-State Hybrid Block Attention (PHBA), which replaces local sliding-window attention with top-k block-sparse retrieval and couples each retrieved block with a compact prefix state summarizing its preceding context. The prefix states are constructed by a gated linear recurrence at block boundaries and retrieved together with the corresponding token blocks, allowing the model to combine precise long-range evidence with compressed historical context within a unified layer. We further develop a hardware-aware Triton implementation that streams routed token blocks and prefix states without materializing large intermediate tensors. Experiments show that PHBA improves long-context and retrieval performance over strong linear and hybrid baselines while retaining efficient training and inference.

AI.tldr: 提出PHBA，用top-k块稀疏检索替代局部滑窗注意力，并将每个检索块与其前缀状态耦合，结合门控线性递归与硬件感知Triton实现，在长上下文与检索任务上优于线性及混合基线且保持高效。
AI.motivation: 现有混合架构（如NHA）虽结合压缩长时状态与滑窗注意力，在长上下文效率与精确检索间取得平衡，但其精确注意力受限于固定局部窗口，难以在窗口外进行精确的长程检索。
AI.method: PHBA以top-k块稀疏检索替换局部滑窗注意力；在块边界处通过门控线性递归构建紧凑前缀状态，使其与对应token块一同被检索，从而在单一层内融合精确长程证据与压缩历史上下文；并设计硬件感知的Triton实现，流式处理被路由的token块与前缀状态，避免物化大型中间张量。
AI.result: 实验表明，PHBA在长上下文与检索性能上优于强线性基线和混合基线，同时保持高效的训练与推理。
AI.conclusion: PHBA通过块稀疏检索与前缀状态的耦合设计，突破固定局部窗口限制，实现精确长程证据与压缩上下文的统一，是一种高效且性能更优的混合注意力方案。

title: How Bregman Divergences Shape Shampoo
summary: Understanding the principles behind Shampoo has recently guided the development of more effective neural network optimizers. These methods learn a preconditioner by optimizing the Frobenius or Kullback-Leibler (KL) divergence against the gradient second moment. In this work, we investigate how the choice of divergence shapes preconditioning, which remains unclear and blocks further improvements. To do so, we develop a unified Bregman divergence framework that connects all popular divergences, allowing us to study them jointly. Through empirical spectral analysis of gradient second moments, we examine how divergence choice shapes Kronecker approximation and interacts with finite-sample error in preconditioning. We find that some divergences can better compensate for finite-sample underestimation of the empirical second moment, helping explain the differing behavior of their corresponding Shampoo variants. We further validate this explanation through GPT-2 pretraining experiments. By connecting divergence choice to practical training behavior, we believe our framework provides principled guidance for understanding the foundations of, and further improving, Shampoo.

AI.tldr: 本文提出统一的Bregman散度框架，将Shampoo各类预条件器所对应的散度（Frobenius、KL等）纳入同一分析视角，通过梯度二阶矩的谱分析揭示散度选择如何影响Kronecker近似与有限样本误差，并据此解释不同Shampoo变体的行为差异。
AI.motivation: Shampoo及其变体在优化预条件器时分别采用Frobenius散度或KL散度来拟合梯度二阶矩，但散度选择如何塑造预条件效果尚不清晰，这一空白阻碍了对Shampoo原理的理解与进一步改进。作者希望厘清散度选择与训练行为之间的因果联系，为该类优化器提供理论指导。
AI.method: 1）构建统一的Bregman散度框架，将现有流行的散度统一表示，实现联合研究；2）对梯度二阶矩进行经验谱分析，考察散度选择如何塑造Kronecker近似结构，以及其与预条件中有限样本误差的交互作用；3）结合GPT-2预训练实验对所提出的解释进行验证。
AI.result: 谱分析表明，不同散度在补偿经验二阶矩的有限样本低估方面能力不同，从而解释了对应Shampoo变体之间的行为差异；该解释在GPT-2预训练实验中得到了进一步验证。
AI.conclusion: 将散度选择与实际训练行为相连接，该Bregman散度框架为理解Shampoo的内在基础并进一步改进其算法提供了有原则的指导。

title: FlowCF: Sparse Counterfactual Explanations for Mixed-Type Tabular Data using Flow Matching
comment: Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Geometric Distributional Deep Learning (GDDL) Workshop
summary: In the field of Explainable AI (XAI), counterfactual (CF) explanations interpret a model's decision by suggesting the changes to the input that would lead to a more favourable outcome. To be useful in practice, such an explanation should change few features and change them as little as possible, properties known as sparsity and proximity. We observe that existing methods remain limited in this respect, especially for numerical features, whether they are model-agnostic and amortised, or gradient-based with full access to the model. In this paper, we propose FlowCF, a model-agnostic generative method that frames CF generation as sparse transport from the factual to the target class. We solve this transport with flow matching, which we extend to mixed feature types with a novel mixed flow operator, and exploit the resulting geometry to optimise for sparsity through a gating network that minimises the number of features the transport changes. Extensive experiments on six benchmark datasets demonstrate that FlowCF produces the best numerical sparsity and proximity, changing 29% of the numerical features where the best baseline changes 89%, at 70% smaller displacement, while remaining comparable on the other desiderata.

AI.tldr: 本文提出FlowCF，一种模型无关的生成式反事实解释方法，将反事实生成建模为从事实类到目标类的稀疏传输，用流匹配求解并扩展到混合特征类型，通过门控网络优化稀疏性。
AI.motivation: 现有反事实解释方法在稀疏性（sparsity）和邻近性（proximity）上仍有局限，尤其是针对数值特征：无论是模型无关的摊销方法，还是可完全访问模型的梯度方法，都难以同时实现少改特征且改动幅度小。
AI.method: FlowCF将反事实生成视为从事实样本到目标类的稀疏传输问题，采用流匹配（flow matching）求解该传输；作者将其扩展至混合特征类型，提出新的混合流算子（mixed flow operator），并利用所得几何结构，通过一个门控网络（gating network）最小化被改动的特征数量，从而优化稀疏性。
AI.result: 在六个基准数据集上的大量实验表明，FlowCF在数值稀疏性和邻近性上表现最佳：仅改动29%的数值特征，而最优基线改动89%，且位移小70%，同时在其它评价指标上保持相当水平。
AI.conclusion: FlowCF通过将反事实生成建模为稀疏传输并结合流匹配与门控机制，显著改善了数值特征上的稀疏性与邻近性，是一种有效的模型无关反事实解释方法。

title: From Shared Demand Patterns to Local Uncertainty: Probabilistic Load Forecasting by Mixing Compact Adaptations
summary: Probabilistic load forecasting has been widely studied for power-system operation and planning, but customer- and transformer-level forecasting introduces a distinct scalability challenge. At these levels, load uncertainty is strongly affected by customer behavior, weather, and mixed load composition, making it difficult for a single shared model to capture heterogeneous patterns. Using separate probabilistic models can improve local accuracy, but becomes costly to train, store, update, and validate at scale. To address this challenge, we develop a scalable customer-aware forecasting framework that learns common demand behavior through a shared model while adapting only a compact subset of parameters. Rather than using an independent model for each load or assigning each load to a specialized model, the proposed design learns a small bank of low-dimensional adaptation components and allows each load to combine them according to its forecasting characteristics. This preserves shared knowledge across customers while providing sufficient flexibility for heterogeneous and mixed load compositions. Experiments on 590 load profiles from the SMART-DS dataset show consistent improvements in deterministic accuracy and probabilistic quality over statistical, neural-network, Transformer-based, and pretrained time-series baselines, while retaining low storage and inference costs.

AI.tldr: 提出一种可扩展的客户感知概率负荷预测框架，通过共享模型加小型低维自适应组件库来兼顾精度与扩展性。
AI.motivation: 客户级和变压器级概率负荷预测存在特定的可扩展性挑战：该层级负荷不确定性受用户行为、天气和混合负荷构成影响，单一共享模型难以捕捉异质模式；而为每个负荷单独建模虽能提升局部精度，却在大规模场景下训练、存储、更新和验证成本过高。
AI.method: 提出的框架学习一个共享模型以捕获共同需求行为，仅自适应调整一小部分紧凑参数。不同于为每个负荷使用独立模型或分配专用模型，该设计学习一个小型低维自适应组件库，并允许每个负荷依据自身预测特征组合这些组件。由此在保留跨客户共享知识的同时，为异质和混合负荷构成提供足够灵活性。
AI.result: 在SMART-DS数据集的590条负荷曲线上的实验表明，该方法在确定性和概率质量指标上均稳定优于统计模型、神经网络、Transformer类及预训练时间序列基线，同时保持较低的存储和推理成本。
AI.conclusion: 通过在共享模型上仅组合少量低维自适应组件，可在客户/变压器级概率负荷预测中同时实现高精度与低存储、低推理开销，为大规模异质负荷场景提供实用的可扩展方案。

title: Valid for Free: Homophily-Gated Conformal Prediction for Training-Free Node Classification with Tabular Foundation Models
summary: Tabular foundation models (TFMs) can classify the nodes of a graph without training on it, by reading node and neighborhood features as table rows next to labeled context rows. Work in this line reports predictive performance, not conformal coverage or prediction-set size. To our knowledge, we give the first reliability study of the setting, with TabICL as the TFM and half of each graph as labeled context. As for any predictor fixed before calibration, a frozen in-context predictor makes split conformal prediction exactly valid in finite samples, with no training, validation fold, or tuning on the target graph. An audit across ten graphs then shows that the training-free TabICL posterior has lower expected calibration error (ECE) than GCN with temperature scaling (GCN+TS) on nine of them. Its mean ECE over the ten graphs is 0.019, about 35 percent below the 0.029 of GCN+TS. We also introduce HG-DAPS, a training-free diffusion score whose homophily gate reads only the in-context labels, so the guarantee still holds. Relative to adaptive prediction sets (APS), it reduces mean set size by 5.8 to 17.1 percent on six homophilous graphs and changes it by under 1 percent on four heterophilous ones. On two binary, class-imbalanced graphs, a pre-registered trap case shows that gating on raw rather than adjusted homophily lowers coverage among low-homophily nodes by 0.27 and 0.12. Marginal coverage stays at the nominal 0.90 and masks this drop.

AI.tldr: 本文首次研究表格基础模型（TabICL）用于图节点分类时的可靠性：利用冻结的上下文预测器实现有限样本下精确有效的分裂共形预测，并提出免训练的扩散分数HG-DAPS以缩小预测集，同时揭示原始同质性门控会隐性降低低同质性节点的覆盖率。
AI.motivation: 现有表格基础模型（TFM）可将节点及邻域特征作为表格行输入，从而在未训练的图上完成节点分类；但已有工作仅报告预测性能，缺乏对共形覆盖率与预测集大小的可靠性研究，因此需要对该设定进行首次系统的可靠性审计。
AI.method: 以TabICL作为TFM，将每张图的一半节点作为带标签上下文行；由于预测器在校准前即固定，冻结的上下文预测器使分裂共形预测在有限样本下精确有效，无需训练、验证折或目标图调参。进行十张图的审计，比较TabICL后验与温度缩放GCN（GCN+TS）的ECE；提出免训练扩散分数HG-DAPS，其同质性门控仅读取上下文标签以保持有效性，并与自适应预测集（APS）比较集大小；在两个二元类不平衡图上进行预注册陷阱实验，比较原始与调整同质性门控下的覆盖率。
AI.result: 训练无关的TabICL后验在十张图中有九张ECE低于GCN+TS，平均ECE为0.019，比GCN+TS的0.029低约35%。HG-DAPS在六张同质图上将平均集大小相对APS减少5.8%至17.1%，在四张异质图上变化小于1%。预注册陷阱实验显示，以原始而非调整同质性进行门控会使低同质性节点覆盖率下降0.27和0.12，而边际覆盖率仍保持在名义水平0.90，掩盖了这一下降。
AI.conclusion: 冻结的表格基础模型上下文预测器可实现无需训练、有限样本有效的共形预测，且校准误差优于温度缩放GCN；HG-DAPS能在保持有效性前提下有效缩小同质图预测集。但需注意门控基于原始同质性会隐性损害低同质性节点的条件覆盖率，即使边际覆盖率看似达标。

title: Singular Value Decomposition: A Geometric Rediscovery, Where Proofs Become Algorithms
summary:
This article is a geometric rediscovery of the singular value decomposition, with a further claim: the construction it builds is the machinery behind much of machine learning. The same argument that answers an idle question about ellipses is the algorithm behind principal component analysis, kernel methods, and PageRank, and it is not only the results that transfer but the proofs themselves, run as procedures.
  The usual introduction states $A = UΣV^T$ and justifies it via the spectral theorem applied to $A^T A$. This is correct but unilluminating, since it assumes a powerful theorem to reach a result that is, in the end, about ellipses. Part I reverses the order. A linear map sends the unit circle to an ellipse; one asks which input directions map to its axes, and finds, example after example, that they are perpendicular. In the plane this can be watched: rotate a frame, track how far its images are from perpendicular, and a sign change forces a frame where they are exactly perpendicular, which is also where the map stretches hardest. Maximizing the stretch and recursing generalizes this to n dimensions, with singular values falling out in order, and the construction proves the spectral theorem rather than assuming it.
  Part II puts each construction to work: maximize-and-recurse becomes the power method and PageRank; the lemma locating the maximizer becomes the stopping rule of gradient descent; the duality between $A^T A$ and $A A^T$ becomes the transport at the heart of kernel PCA. Each connection is stated with its boundary, saying what the decomposition supplies and where another idea takes over. Prerequisites are the standard sophomore sequence, and the worked examples are small enough to check by hand.

AI.tldr: 本文以几何方式重新推导奇异值分解（SVD），主张其构造过程是众多机器学习算法背后的统一机制：同一套"最大化拉伸并递归"的论证既解释了椭圆性质，也支撑主成分分析、核方法与PageRank，且迁移的不只是结论，连证明本身都可作为过程来执行。
AI.motivation: 传统SVD教学直接给出 A = UΣV^T 并借助对 A^T A 应用谱定理来证明，虽然正确却缺乏启发性——它用了一个强大的定理去得出一个本质上关于椭圆的结论。作者希望颠倒这一顺序，从几何直观出发，使SVD的构造自然生长出来，并揭示它作为机器学习核心机制的普遍性。
AI.method: 第一部分逆转推导顺序：线性映射将单位圆映为椭圆，追问哪些输入方向映射到椭圆的轴，并通过逐个例子发现它们彼此垂直。在平面中可直观观察：旋转一个框架、追踪其像偏离垂直的程度，符号变化迫使存在一个恰好垂直的框架，这同时也是映射拉伸最强的方向。将该"最大化拉伸并递归"的过程推广到n维，奇异值按序自然浮现，且该构造反过来证明了谱定理而非假设它。第二部分将各构造投入应用：最大化-递归成为幂法与PageRank；定位最大值的引理成为梯度下降的停止准则；A^T A 与 A A^T 的对偶成为核PCA核心的传输机制。每个联系都界定了适用边界，说明分解提供了什么、何处需由其他思想接管。
AI.result: 作者建立了一条从椭圆几何到机器学习的统一链条：SVD的几何构造可证明谱定理；最大化-递归构造对应幂法与PageRank；最大化引理对应梯度下降停止规则；A^T A 与 A A^T 的对偶对应核PCA中的传输。每处连接均配有边界说明，且示例足够小可手工验证，仅需大学二年级标准数学基础。
AI.conclusion: SVD并非仅是一个代数分解结果，而是一种可执行的过程性构造；它在几何上源于椭圆的轴问题，在机器学习中则体现为主成分分析、核方法与PageRank等算法的共同机制。通过颠倒传统"先定理后结论"的顺序，本文使SVD的证明本身即为算法，从而在几何直觉与机器学习方法之间架起一座教学与理论兼顾的桥梁。

title: How Learning Governs Unlearning across the Memorization-Generalization Spectrum
summary: While unlearning seeks to negate undesired capabilities acquired through learning, little research has examined how the way models learn shapes their subsequent unlearning. In this paper, we investigate this connection from the perspectives of memorization and generalization, the two most representative yet competing strategies that models employ during training. We first classify memorization- and generalization-heavy models using grokking in modular addition and compare their responses to unlearning, showing that the latter suffer greater retain damage, i.e., a larger performance drop on the retain set. Furthermore, we conduct a finer-grained analysis by introducing bucketed modular addition, in which the respective contributions of the two strategies can be explicitly controlled across the memorization-generalization spectrum. In this setup, we reaffirm that the same trend persists and is nearly monotonic. We further demonstrate that this relationship also holds in LLM unlearning across verbatim and factual recall settings. Finally, we provide two practical insights for developing better unlearning methods, highlighting the importance of accounting for learning dynamics in unlearning.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了模型的"学习方式"如何影响其后续的"遗忘"（unlearning）效果，从记忆与泛化两种策略出发，发现泛化型模型在遗忘时对保留集的损伤更大，并在模运算、大语言模型等多种设定下验证了这一近乎单调的关系。
AI.motivation: 遗忘（unlearning）旨在消除模型通过学习获得的不良能力，但以往研究很少探讨"模型如何学习"是否会塑造其"如何遗忘"。作者希望揭示学习策略（记忆 vs. 泛化）与遗忘行为之间的内在联系。
AI.method: 1) 利用模加法中的 grokking 现象区分"记忆为主"和"泛化为主"的模型，比较二者对遗忘的响应；2) 提出"分桶模加法"（bucketed modular addition），在记忆-泛化谱系上显式控制两种策略的贡献，进行细粒度分析；3) 在大语言模型遗忘中，跨逐字记忆（verbatim recall）与事实记忆（factual recall）两种设定进行验证。
AI.result: 泛化型模型在遗忘后遭受更大的保留集损伤（retain damage），即保留集性能下降更严重；在分桶模加法设定下，该趋势依然存在且近乎单调；这一关系在大语言模型遗忘的逐字与事实召回场景中同样成立。
AI.conclusion: 学习策略与遗忘效果之间存在稳定的关联，遗忘研究应考虑模型的学习动态。作者据此提出两条对开发更优遗忘方法的实践启示。

title: Random Feature Gaussian Process Attention: Linear-Time Probabilistic Attention with Calibrated Uncertainty
summary: Transformers provide a state-of-the-art modeling framework, yet poor calibration limits their reliability in safety-critical applications. A promising direction addresses this issue by interpreting attention as a Gaussian process (GP) posterior, which enables principled uncertainty calibration but incurs cubic complexity in sequence length due to the inversion of the kernel; although decoupled GP variants reduced the cost to quadratic, the computation remains prohibitive in practice. In this paper, we propose the plug-and-play random Fourier feature Gaussian process attention (RFF-GPA) module, which represents the attention as a GP with a stationary kernel approximated by random Fourier features. This low-rank approximation results in linear-time complexity for approximating the posterior mean and variance, making it far more scalable compared to previous work. Empirical results on multiple real-world datasets show that our attention module improves calibration while maintaining predictive accuracy, and simultaneously reduces computational complexity to linear in the sequence length.

AI.tldr: 本文提出即插即用的随机傅里叶特征高斯过程注意力（RFF-GPA）模块，用随机傅里叶特征近似平稳核，将注意力建模为GP后验，把后验均值与方差的计算复杂度从三次/二次降到线性，兼顾校准性与预测精度。
AI.motivation: Transformer虽建模能力强，但校准性差，在安全关键场景可靠性不足。已有工作将注意力解释为高斯过程后验以实现有原则的不确定性校准，但核矩阵求逆带来序列长度的三次复杂度；解耦GP变体虽降到二次，实际计算仍过于昂贵。
AI.method: 提出即插即用的RFF-GPA模块：将注意力视为使用平稳核的高斯过程，并用随机傅里叶特征对该核进行低秩近似，从而线性时间地近似GP后验的均值与方差。
AI.result: 在多个真实数据集上的实验表明，该注意力模块在保持预测精度的同时改善了校准性能，并将计算复杂度降至关于序列长度的线性级别。
AI.conclusion: RFF-GPA以线性复杂度实现GP后验注意力的不确定性校准，兼顾可扩展性、校准性与预测精度，可作为即插即用模块替代既有GP注意力方案。

title: CNet: A Complex-Valued Deep Learning Framework with Wirtinger Autodifferentiation and FFT--Hadamard Convolution
summary:
CNet is a C++/CUDA framework for building and training deep complex-valued neural networks (CVNNs) and, more generally, for optimizing complex-valued functions by gradient descent with Wirtinger (CR-calculus) derivatives. It takes a physics-native stance: a network is a cascade of complex -- and often unitary (the DFT) -- operations acting on an amplitude vector, and classification is a Born-rule measurement $p_k = |z_k|^2 / \|z\|^2$ rather than a softmax over real logits. Every layer ships a CPU reference and a CUDA kernel checked against finite differences, and the computation graph is cloned across the batch for GPU execution. On top of the base layers we add signal-processing primitives that turn the identity conv(x,k) = IFFT(FFT(x) . FFT(k)) into a learnable complex convolutional network, together with a true-Adam optimizer and a reduced-memory inference mode.
  We report three studies. First, a fully complex-valued, FNet-style causal sequence model built on a new $O(N \log N)$ causal Fourier mixer -- a triangular-masked DFT evaluated by a Bluestein / chirp-z factorization: once properly tuned it matches or exceeds a parameter-matched real-valued causal FNet on character-level language modeling, reaching the real model's converged quality in under half the training steps. Second and third, bottleneck analyses on radio-modulation classification (RML2016.10a) and the Fourier phase problem of coherent-diffraction imaging, which isolate exactly where complex-valued networks still need new operators. Across all three the complex formulation provably learns the physically correct structure.
  Code: https://github.com/crasmarum/CNet

AI.tldr: CNet：一个C++/CUDA复数神经网络框架，采用物理原生视角（复数/酉算符级联+玻恩规则测量），提供CPU参考与CUDA核逐层校验、复数卷积的FFT可学习实现、真Adam优化器与低内存推理模式；在复值因果FNet（O(N log N)因果傅里叶混合器，Bluestein/chirp-z三角掩码DFT）上以不到一半训练步数达到参数匹配实值模型收敛质量，并通过RML2016.10a与相干衍射成像傅里叶相位问题两个瓶颈分析定位复数网络仍欠缺的算符。
AI.motivation: 现有深度学习框架以实值运算与实值logits+softmax为默认范式，缺乏对复值网络的原生支持：复数梯度需用Wirtinger（CR-calculus）微积分，复卷积需借助FFT实现，物理成像与射频信号等任务本身天然是复值/相位相关的，用实值网络建模难以保证学到物理正确的结构。作者因此构建一个"物理原生"的复数框架并借此定位复数网络当前的算子空白。
AI.method: 1) CNet框架：C++/CUDA，网络视为作用于幅度向量的复（常为酉，如DFT）算符级联，分类用玻恩规则测量 p_k=|z_k|^2/||z||^2 替代实logits softmax；用Wirtinger导数做梯度下降；每层配CPU参考实现与CUDA核并用有限差分校验；计算图按batch克隆以适配GPU；含真Adam优化器与低内存推理模式。2) 信号处理原语：将恒等式 conv(x,k)=IFFT(FFT(x)·FFT(k)) 变为可学习的复数卷积网络。3) 复值因果FNet：新提出O(N log N)因果傅里叶混合器，即用Bluestein/chirp-z分解计算的三角掩码DFT。4) 三个研究：(a)字符级语言建模，与参数匹配的实值因果FNet对比；(b)无线电调制分类RML2016.10a上的瓶颈分析；(c)相干衍射成像的傅里叶相位问题瓶颈分析。
AI.result: 复值FNet经充分调参后在字符级语言建模上匹配或超越参数匹配的实值因果FNet，并以不到一半的训练步数达到实值模型的收敛质量；在RML2016.10a与相干衍射成像傅里叶相位问题两项瓶颈分析中定位出复值网络仍需新算符的具体位置；三项研究均表明复数表述可证明地学到物理正确的结构。
AI.conclusion: CNet验证了以复值/酉算符级联加玻恩规则测量为核心的物理原生深度学习框架的可行性：复值模型能以更高训练效率达到或超越实值基线，并具备学到物理正确结构的可证明性；同时通过语言建模之外的调制分类与相位恢复瓶颈分析，明确了复值网络未来需要发展的新算子方向。代码已开源。

title: Multi-Label Perceptual Bug Detection in Video Games using Deep Learning on Gameplay Footage
summary: Traditional approaches for automated bug detection in video games, such as manual testing, can be beneficial for the improvement of quality assurance, but they can be expensive and time-consuming. The scarce number of tools available to detect multiple perceptual bugs in the same video frame introduces detection challenges for automated bug detection tools in real-world scenarios. We propose a deep learning model for multi-label perceptual bug detection and compare it against video classification models such as Inflated 3D ConvNet and 3D ResNet. Our proposed model, ResNet-BiLSTM, achieved an F1 score of 85.78% on the benchmark dataset. Our results demonstrated that temporal dependency modelling is beneficial for accurate video-based bug detection. We believe this work with multi-label perceptual bug detection on gameplay videos will help save resources spent on manual testing workloads in video games. Furthermore, we introduce a new dataset with multi-label perceptual bugs in this work. The dataset contains 77,969 video clips across different genres of games with approximately 1.2 million frames, containing combinations from 5 classes of bugs in the same video frame.

AI.tldr: 提出ResNet-BiLSTM多标签感知缺陷检测模型，在基准数据集上F1达85.78%，并发布含77,969个视频片段、约120万帧、5类缺陷组合的新数据集。
AI.motivation: 传统人工测试成本高、耗时长；现有自动检测工具稀缺，难以在同一视频帧中检测多种感知缺陷，导致真实场景下自动化缺陷检测面临挑战。
AI.method: 构建深度学习模型ResNet-BiLSTM进行多标签感知缺陷检测，并将其与I3D、3D ResNet等视频分类模型进行对比，以验证时序依赖建模的有效性。
AI.result: 所提ResNet-BiLSTM在基准数据集上取得85.78%的F1分数；实验表明时序依赖建模有助于提升基于视频的缺陷检测准确率。
AI.conclusion: 该工作将多标签感知缺陷检测应用于游戏视频，有望减少视频游戏人工测试工作量；同时发布包含多标签感知缺陷的新数据集，涵盖多种游戏类型、77,969个视频片段、约120万帧，并包含同一帧中5类缺陷的组合。

title: MemFLoRA: Memory-Floor LoRA for CNN Adaptation at the Edge
comment: Accepted at the 32nd Asia and South Pacific Design Automation Conference (ASP-DAC 2027), January 25-28, 2027, Tokyo, Japan. Code: https://github.com/mehmetemreakbulut/MemFLoRA
summary: On-device learning is necessary when the model encounters user-,sensor-, or environment-specific shifts after deployment. Although parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) methods, particularly Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) variants, enable efficient adaptation at the edge, the limiting resource for Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) adaptation is often not the number of trainable parameters but the activation state that must be retained until the backward pass. This paper introduces Memory-Floor LoRA (MemFLoRA), a low-rank CNN adapter built around a memory-first design principle rather than a direct application of transformer-oriented LoRA. Instead of merely reducing trainable weights, we define an activation-memory-floor criterion: trainable backward computations must not depend on full-width layer inputs. The resulting adapter freezes the down-projection, trains a scale-matched up-projection, and combines eval-mode backbone normalization with activation-minimal backward rules, reducing saved state to the low-rank branch. Evaluated on three Human Activity Recognition (HAR) datasets and two CNN backbones under subject, body-location, and sensor-placement shifts, MemFLoRA reduces saved-activation memory by 98.5-98.7% and peak training-state memory by 94.9-97.3% relative to full fine-tuning, while matching or exceeding CNN PEFT baselines.

AI.tldr: 提出MemFLoRA：一种面向CNN端侧适配的激活内存优先低秩适配器，将反向传播保存状态压缩至低秩分支，显著降低训练内存且保持或超越CNN PEFT基线。
AI.motivation: 端侧学习需要模型在部署后适应用户、传感器或环境偏移。现有PEFT（如LoRA变体）多面向Transformer，直接用于CNN适配时瓶颈并非可训练参数量，而是必须保留到反向传播的激活状态，导致内存开销大。
AI.method: 提出MemFLoRA，以"内存优先"为设计原则构建低秩CNN适配器，并定义激活内存下界准则：可训练的反向计算不得依赖全宽度层输入。具体做法是冻结下投影、训练尺度匹配的上投影，并将eval模式的主干归一化与激活最小化反向规则结合，使保存状态缩减为低秩分支。
AI.result: 在3个HAR数据集和2个CNN主干上，针对被试、身体位置与传感器放置偏移进行评估：相比全量微调，保存激活内存降低98.5–98.7%，训练峰值状态内存降低94.9–97.3%，同时匹配或超越CNN PEFT基线。
AI.conclusion: MemFLoRA表明，面向CNN端侧适配应以激活内存而非可训练参数量为核心设计目标；满足激活内存下界准则的低秩适配可在大幅降低训练内存的同时保持甚至提升适配性能。

title: Variance-Optimal Off-Policy Evaluation with Conjunct Effect Modeling
summary: Off-policy evaluation (OPE) for contextual bandit policies becomes challenging when action-level importance weighting incurs excessive variance. Doubly robust (DR) estimation remains unbiased under common support but retains these high-variance action-level weights. A prior estimator, Off-policy evaluation with Conjunct Effect Model (OffCEM), replaces them with more stable cluster-level weights, at the cost of relying on local correctness of the reward model. In this paper, we show that, under the assumptions required by DR and OffCEM, there exists an unbiased family of estimators that interpolates between OffCEM and DR. Building on this result, we propose the Variance Optimal-CEM (VOCEM) estimator, which selects the interpolation coefficient to minimize variance. We derive the population-optimal coefficient in closed form and show that the resulting estimator has variance no larger than either endpoint, OffCEM or DR. Experiments in controlled synthetic settings and on two large-action benchmarks show that VOCEM improves upon both endpoints in all 23 evaluated conditions, exhibiting greater stability and empirical robustness.

AI.tldr: 本文提出VOCEM估计器，在OffCEM与DR之间进行无偏插值并选择方差最小的插值系数，方差不超过两端点，在23个评估条件下均优于两者。
AI.motivation: 上下文赌博机的离策略评估（OPE）中，动作级重要性权重会带来过大方差。双重鲁棒（DR）估计虽在共同支撑下无偏，却仍保留高方差的动作级权重；而OffCEM用更稳定的簇级权重替代，却依赖奖励模型的局部正确性。作者希望在两者之间找到兼顾无偏性与低方差的方案。
AI.method: 在DR与OffCEM所需假设下，证明存在一个无偏估计器族，可在OffCEM与DR之间插值；据此提出VOCEM估计器，通过选择插值系数来最小化方差，并推导出总体最优系数的闭式解。
AI.result: 理论证明所得估计器方差不超过OffCEM与DR任一端点。在受控合成实验及两个大动作空间基准上，VOCEM在全部23个评估条件下均优于两端点，表现出更强的稳定性与经验鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: VOCEM通过在OffCEM与DR间做方差最优的无偏插值，统一并改进了两类估计器，为高方差动作级权重问题提供了有效且稳健的OPE方案。

title: Probabilistic Counterfactual Inference for Discrete Outcomes in Gaussian-Process Causal Models
summary: Counterfactual inference in Gaussian-process structural causal models (GP-SCMs) has been developed primarily for continuous endogenous variables, limiting applicability to causal graphs that contain discrete child nodes with continuous parents. We introduce a unified probabilistic framework for counterfactual inference with heterogeneous variable types by pairing GP predictors with explicit exogenous noise mechanisms. For discrete outcomes, we derive exact conditional noise-abduction procedures using a uniform threshold for binary variables, a Gumbel-max race for nominal categories, and a latent Gaussian cut-point model for ordinal ones. In each case, we propagate abducted noise through interventions while accounting for posterior uncertainty in the GP latent functions, and prove that the resulting mechanisms reproduce the fitted model's observational and interventional distributions. On synthetic SCMs with known ground-truth counterfactuals, we evaluate estimation accuracy, consistency, and robustness to coupling misspecification. A key finding is that applying a categorical coupling to ordinal data inflates counterfactual error roughly threefold even when observational fit remains comparable, and that this error does not diminish with more data. As the training set grows, the fitted structural equation converges to the truth while the counterfactual error flattens onto a floor. In the reverse direction, forcing a false order onto nominal data instead degrades the fitted equation itself. The choice of coupling must therefore be justified on structural grounds rather than read off the fit.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一个统一概率框架，用于在GP-SCM中处理连续父节点与离散子节点混合的反事实推断，通过显式外生噪声机制推导二值、名义与有序变量的精确噪声回溯过程，并证明其再现观测与干预分布。
AI.motivation: 现有GP-SCM反事实推断主要针对连续内生变量，难以适用于包含离散子节点（连续父节点）的因果图；且离散变量的耦合（噪声机制）选择缺乏结构依据，误用会带来难以消除的反事实误差。
AI.method: 将GP预测器与显式外生噪声机制配对：二值变量用均匀阈值法、名义类别用Gumbel-max竞争、有序变量用潜高斯切点模型，实现精确条件噪声回溯；在干预下传播回溯噪声并计入GP潜函数后验不确定性，证明机制复现拟合模型的观测与干预分布；在已知真值反事实的合成SCM上评估精度、一致性与对耦合误设的鲁棒性。
AI.result: 对有序数据误用类别耦合时，即使观测拟合相当，反事实误差约放大三倍，且随数据量增加不下降；随训练集增大，拟合结构方程收敛到真值，但反事实误差趋于平台；反向地，对名义数据强加虚假顺序会损害拟合方程本身。
AI.conclusion: 离散结果的耦合（噪声机制）必须基于结构理由选择，而不能仅凭拟合优度判断；观测拟合良好并不保证反事实推断正确。

title: GeneICL: A Tabular Foundation Model for Bulk Transcriptomics
summary: Gene expression is widely measured in biomedicine, yet clinical outcome prediction remains challenging due to high dimensionality, strong feature correlations, and limited labeled data. Large self-supervised transcriptomic foundation models often fail to outperform simple supervised baselines. Tabular foundation models offer an alternative through in-context learning, but are typically pretrained on generic synthetic data rather than transcriptomic structure. We ask whether transcriptomics-aware pretraining, rather than scale, is the missing ingredient. Towards this end, we introduce GeneICL, a 4.2M-parameter tabular foundation model combining a semi-synthetic pretraining prior built from measured bulk expression profiles with a parameter-efficient recurrent architecture. We further enable right-censored survival prediction via a training-free reduction to regression using Cox partial-likelihood residuals. We evaluate GeneICL on 80 clinical outcome-prediction tasks spanning classification, regression, and survival. Tabular foundation models consistently outperform self-supervised transcriptomic models, while GeneICL achieves the best overall rank among evaluated foundation models and tuned baselines. GeneICL does so with up to 387$\times$ fewer parameters, no gradient updates at inference, and predictions within seconds on a laptop CPU.

AI.tldr: GeneICL 是一个 4.2M 参数的表格基础模型，通过转录组感知的半合成预训练与参数高效循环架构，在 80 个临床结局预测任务上超越自监督转录组模型及调优基线，且推理无需梯度更新、可在笔记本 CPU 秒级完成。
AI.motivation: 基因表达测量在生物医学中广泛应用，但临床结局预测受高维度、强特征相关性和标注数据有限制约。大型自监督转录组基础模型常难超越简单监督基线；表格基础模型虽可借上下文学习，但其预训练多用通用合成数据而非转录组结构。作者因此追问：缺失的关键是否是转录组感知的预训练，而非单纯规模扩张。
AI.method: 提出 GeneICL：4.2M 参数表格基础模型，结合由实测 bulk 表达谱构建的半合成预训练先验与参数高效循环架构。并通过对 Cox 偏似然残差的回归化约简，实现免训练的右删失生存预测。
AI.result: 在涵盖分类、回归、生存分析的 80 个临床结局预测任务上评估：表格基础模型一致优于自监督转录组模型，GeneICL 在受评基础模型与调优基线中取得最佳总体排名，参数量最多减少 387 倍，推理无梯度更新，笔记本 CPU 上数秒内完成预测。
AI.conclusion: 转录组感知的预训练（而非规模）是提升临床结局预测的关键要素；GeneICL 以极小参数与极低推理成本实现领先性能，为转录组临床预测提供了高效实用的表格基础模型方案。

title: Optimal and Efficient Online Inverse Optimization
summary: In online inverse linear optimization, a learner recommends an action and then observes the choice of an expert who maximizes a fixed, unknown linear objective on $\mathbb{R}^{d}$; the goal is to learn to optimize this objective without observing it. Sakaue recently obtained the optimal regret $O(\sqrt d)$ with a randomized algorithm making $(dT)^{O(d)}$ linear optimizations per round, and asked whether it can be attained in polynomial time. We answer positively: our deterministic algorithm has regret $O(\sqrt d)$ for every horizon $T$ and runs in time polynomial in $d$ and $T$. It is a variant of the variable-metric algorithms of Sakaue et al.\ and Cai et al., in which a metric update is revoked once the query point moves far enough from where the update was made.

AI.tldr: 本文解决了在线逆线性优化中实现最优遗憾且多项式时间算法的问题，提出了确定性算法，达到O(√d)遗憾且复杂度为d和T的多项式。
AI.motivation: 在线逆线性优化中，学习者需通过观察专家在未知线性目标下的选择来学习优化该目标。Sakaue最近用随机算法达到了最优遗憾O(√d)，但每轮需要(dT)^{O(d)}次线性优化，并询问能否在多项式时间内达到该遗憾。本文旨在肯定回答这一问题。
AI.method: 提出一种确定性算法，是Sakaue等人和Cai等人变尺度算法的变体，其中一旦查询点远离更新位置足够远，就撤销该度量更新。
AI.result: 该算法对任意时间范围T均达到O(√d)遗憾，且运行时间为d和T的多项式。
AI.conclusion: 在线逆线性优化可以在多项式时间内达到最优遗憾O(√d)，且无需随机化。

title: On the Computational Tractability of Robust Bandits
summary: Learning when the environment does not belong to the learner's hypothesis class is typically handled using agnostic learning guarantees. However, for anything beyond supervised learning, agnostic guarantees are difficult to come by. Recently, imprecise bandits (Kosoy, 2025) (later renamed to robust bandits in Appel and Kosoy, 2025) were introduced as another approach to unrealizable learning in the bandits setting and a $Θ(\sqrt{T})$ regret learner was shown for a large class. However, no computational guarantees were provided. In this paper we identify a special case that admits a polynomial-time learner with $\tilde{O}(\sqrt{T})$ regret. We also show that several small generalizations of this special case are NP-hard thus indicating that the special case is at the boundary of what is tractable. It has been recently suggested (Kosoy, 2018) that computationally efficient learners for unrealizable learning problems are crucial for solving the AI alignment problem. This work is a small step in that direction.

AI.tldr: 本文针对不精确（鲁棒）bandits中不可实现学习问题，识别出一个可在多项式时间内求解、取得 Õ(√T) 遗憾的特例，并证明该特例的若干小推广均为 NP-hard，表明其处于可解性的边界。
AI.motivation: 当环境不属于学习器假设类（不可实现学习）时，监督学习可用 agnostic 保证处理，但监督学习之外难以获得 agnostic 保证。不精确 bandits 被提出作为 bandits 场景下另一种处理不可实现学习的方法，并已有 Θ(√T) 遗憾学习器，但缺乏计算保证。作者认为计算高效的不可实现学习器对解决 AI 对齐问题至关重要，因此希望填补计算复杂度方面的空白。
AI.method: 在 Kosoy (2025)/Appel and Kosoy (2025) 提出的不精确（鲁棒）bandits 框架下，识别出一个特殊子类；为该子类设计多项式时间学习算法，并分析其遗憾界。同时通过归约证明该特例的若干小幅推广具有 NP-hard 性质。
AI.result: 该特例存在多项式时间学习器，遗憾界为 Õ(√T)；其若干小推广被证明为 NP-hard。
AI.conclusion: 该特例位于不可实现 bandits 学习计算可解性的边界附近：既存在高效算法，稍加推广即变为难解。作者将其视为面向 AI 对齐的计算高效不可实现学习研究的初步进展。

title: Reinforcement Learning with Conformal Action Sets: An Application to Sequential Recommendation
summary: Sequential recommenders typically use a fixed slate size even though the number of useful alternatives changes within a session. We propose Reinforcement Learning with Calibrated Pruning (RLCP), which adapts the retained action set using critic scores and an online threshold. The threshold is updated from binary feedback indicating whether the set contains an action in a proxy target. We prove a deterministic bound on the observed proxy miss rate along adaptive trajectories. To quantify the effect of pruning on reward, we derive an exact decomposition of value loss into filtering and selection losses. Under explicit proxy and critic approximation conditions, this decomposition yields a finite session reward bound that also accounts for imperfect selection and set truncation, without requiring the learning parameters to converge. Experiments on KuaiRand-Pure and MovieLens 1M compare two RLCP implementations with four RL baselines. In each of the 19 configurations, at least one RLCP variant achieves the highest catalog diversity, reaching $1.11\times$ to $5.21\times$ that of the strongest baseline, with competitive session depth and no larger retained sets.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RLCP（带校准剪枝的强化学习），利用评论家分数与在线阈值自适应调整保留动作集，并给出代理漏检率、价值损失分解与有限会话奖励界，实验证明其能显著提升目录多样性。
AI.motivation: 序列推荐器通常使用固定的候选集（slate）大小，但一次会话中有效备选数量会动态变化；固定大小可能导致保留低质量动作或过度裁剪，因此需要一种能够自适应调整保留动作集合的方法。
AI.method: 提出RLCP：基于critic分数与在线阈值来校准并剪枝保留动作集；阈值通过二元反馈更新，该反馈表示集合中是否包含位于proxy目标中的动作。理论上证明自适应轨迹上proxy漏检率的确定性界；并推导价值损失的精确分解为过滤损失与选择损失。在显式proxy与critic近似条件下，给出有限会话奖励界，且不要求学习参数收敛。
AI.result: 在KuaiRand-Pure与MovieLens 1M上，将两种RLCP实现与四种RL基线比较；在全部19个配置中，至少一种RLCP变体取得最高catalog diversity，达到最强基线的1.11倍至5.21倍，同时session depth具竞争力且保留集合规模不比基线更大。
AI.conclusion: RLCP能够在动态调整保留动作集的同时提供理论保证，并在多个数据集与配置下显著提升目录多样性，且不牺牲会话深度或增大保留集合。

title: Linear Bandits under Exact Sliding-Window Constraints
comment: 53 pages, including supplementary material; 8 figures and 6 tables
summary: We study linear bandits under exact sliding-window constraints, where every consecutive block of actions must belong to a prescribed feasible set. In the offline setting, where the reward function is known, we show that convexity and cyclic-shift invariance make a stationary solution optimal when $w\mid T$ and within an additive $O(w)$ gap otherwise. In the online setting, we show that geometric structure alone is insufficient for learning, and sublinear regret can be impossible. We introduce a transition diameter $τ$ that quantifies feasible reachability and develop a rare-switching OFUL algorithm with regret $\widetilde{O}(d\sqrt{T}+τd+w)$ against the offline-optimal feasible trajectory. Finally, we remove cyclic invariance and consider general sliding-window constraints, where optimal behavior may be non-stationary. We represent recent action history as the state of a finite-memory control problem and introduce a history-state diameter $D$ that measures feasible communication between viable histories. Combining optimistic remaining-horizon planning with rare policy updates, we obtain a regret bound of $\widetilde{O}(d\sqrt{T}+dD+w)$. We evaluate our approach on real-world and synthetic benchmarks, showing that it maintains exact feasibility while achieving reward and regret comparable to baselines with substantially fewer policy updates.

AI.tldr: 本文研究精确滑动窗口约束下的线性赌博机问题，分别分析离线最优解结构、在线可学习性与紧致约束下的次线性遗憾算法。
AI.motivation: 经典线性赌博机假设每步动作独立可选，但许多真实场景要求每个连续动作块属于给定可行集（如资源调度、轮转分配）。这种滑动窗口约束下，可行轨迹间的可达性受限，几何结构可能不足以支撑学习，因此需要刻画在线学习的可能性与最优结构。
AI.method: 离线：证明凸性与循环平移不变性使平稳解在 w|T 时最优，否则差距为 O(w)。在线：引入转移直径 τ 量化可行可达性，提出稀有切换 OFUL 算法；进一步去除循环不变性，将最近动作历史建模为有限记忆控制问题状态，引入历史-状态直径 D，结合乐观剩余视界规划与稀有策略更新。
AI.result: 在线一般紧致约束下，仅凭几何结构可导致次线性遗憾不可实现；稀有切换 OFUL 相对离线最优可行轨迹取得 Õ(d√T+τd+w) 遗憾；一般滑动窗口约束下取得 Õ(d√T+dD+w) 遗憾。真实与合成基准上保持精确可行性，且在显著更少策略更新下达到与基线可比的奖励和遗憾。
AI.conclusion: 滑动窗口约束使可行可达性成为在线学习核心瓶颈；转移直径/历史-状态直径刻画该瓶颈并指导稀有切换与乐观规划，实现可行性与低遗憾、低更新频率的统一。

title: Neural Petri flows for chemical reactions
summary: Petri nets have been used to describe chemical processes such as reactions.They map well to chemistry: Places are the bonds between atoms and the free valence of each atom, a token is a unit of bond order, a transition forms or breaks a bond, the conserved quantities are the valence budgets of the atoms, and the enabling rule is the valence rule. These semantics are not guaranteed by learned models of reactions or neural networks that are built on Petri nets that use the net as a scaffold for message passing. Here, we ask what architecture remains a Petri net for every value of its weights. We find the answer in the theory, where all semantics of a net share the firing form $m^\prime=m+Cσ$, locality, as enabling reads only the inputs of a transition, and the enabling rule, and we prove that conservation forces the firing form and that non-negativity forces the enabling rule on local rate laws. This leaves free the rate law, which is the propensity of each transition to fire. We introduce Neural Petri Flow, which learns this rate law, or a readout for classification, and hard-wires the rest as parameter-free layers. On what we denote a valence net, atom mapping, reaction classification, and forward prediction become three tasks on one firing vector. Without training, the minimum firing vector maps 88.8% of the curated Golden set against 85.6% for RXNMapper, and 88.7 against 77.9% of the enzymatic reactions of EnzymeMap. On USPTO-480K, NPF trained on these firing vectors predicts 87.7% of the products and 67.4% when trained on a 1% subset of the training reactions. EC numbers of ECREACT are predicted at the third level for 90.2% of reactions, 5.6 points ahead of the best published method. With electrons as tokens, the same token game predicts 90.5% of the elementary steps of FlowER first, ahead of the published baseline, and every top-1 prediction is a valid molecule without a filter.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 Neural Petri Flow（NPF），一种在任意权重取值下都严格保持 Petri 网语义的架构：仅学习速率律（或分类读出），其余部分以无参数层硬编码，从而在原子映射、反应分类与正向预测三类任务上取得领先结果。
AI.motivation: 化学过程（如反应）可用 Petri 网描述：位置对应原子间键与自由价，token 对应键级单位，变迁对应成键/断键，守恒量为原子价预算，使能规则即价规则。然而现有基于 Petri 网的化学反应学习模型或神经网络多将网仅作为消息传递的脚手架，并不保证这些语义。作者因此追问：何种架构对任意权重取值都仍是一个 Petri 网。
AI.method: 作者从理论出发，指出网的全部语义共享激发形式 m′=m+Cσ、局部性（使能仅读取变迁输入）以及使能规则，并证明：守恒性强制了该激发形式，非负性在局部速率律上强制了使能规则；仅速率律（即变迁激发的倾向）保持自由。据此提出 Neural Petri Flow（NPF）：学习该速率律或用于分类的读出，其余部分硬编码为无参数层。在价网（valence net）上，原子映射、反应分类与正向预测三者统一为一个激发向量上的任务。
AI.result: 无需训练时，最小激发向量在精选 Golden 集上映射准确率 88.8%（RXNMapper 为 85.6%），在 EnzymeMap 酶反应上为 88.7%（对比 77.9%）。在 USPTO-480K 上，NPF 以这些激发向量训练可预测 87.7% 的产物；仅用 1% 训练子集时为 67.4%。ECREACT 的 EC 编号在第三层级预测准确率达 90.2%，领先最佳已发表方法 5.6 个百分点。以电子为 token 时，同一 token 博弈对 FlowER 的基本步骤首次预测率 90.5%，优于已发表基线，且每个 top-1 预测无需过滤即为有效分子。
AI.conclusion: NPF 表明，通过理论约束将 Petri 网语义硬编码为无参数层、仅学习速率律，可构建对任意权重都严格忠实于 Petri 网语义的架构，并在原子映射、反应分类与正向预测等多个化学任务上以单一激发向量统一建模并取得领先或可竞争的性能。

title: Conformal Prediction Sets Quantify Information Gain: A Theoretical Perspective
summary: Conformal prediction is a popular tool for uncertainty quantification that outputs prediction sets with finite-sample coverage guarantees. While prediction set size is commonly used as a heuristic measure of uncertainty, the information-theoretic basis for this interpretation remains poorly understood. In this work, we provide such a foundation using a decision-theoretic generalization of entropy tailored to set-valued prediction. In particular, we introduce a family of generalized information measures based on the size and coverage of conformal prediction sets. Notably, Shannon mutual information admits an exact integral representation in terms of these measures. We then show that, in standard classification settings, the reduction in conformal set size from additional information (i) is sandwiched between calibration-dependent members of this family and (ii) obeys a data processing inequality, both up to finite-sample calibration and model error terms. Together, our results formally relate conformal prediction to classical information-theoretic quantities and justify using set-size reduction as an information gain metric. Empirically, we validate our theory across 11 classification settings and show that set-size reduction and Shannon mutual information can rank features differently in a greedy feature selection experiment.

AI.tldr: 本文为“共形预测集大小可衡量不确定性”这一启发式做法提供信息论基础，提出基于集合大小与覆盖率的广义信息度量族，并证明其与香农互信息的积分表示关系。
AI.motivation: 共形预测能给出具有有限样本覆盖保证的预测集，其集合大小常被当作不确定性或信息量的启发式指标，但这种解释缺乏信息论层面的理论支撑。
AI.method: 采用面向集合值预测的决策论熵推广，定义一族基于共形预测集大小与覆盖率的广义信息度量；证明香农互信息可由该度量族精确积分表示；在标准分类设定下分析额外信息带来的共形集大小缩减，推导夹逼界与数据处理不等式（含有限样本校准与模型误差项）。
AI.result: 香农互信息获得基于该度量族的精确积分表示；集大小缩减被校准相关的度量族成员上下夹逼，并满足数据处理不等式；在11种分类设定中验证理论，且贪婪特征选择实验显示集大小缩减与香农互信息可能给出不同的特征排序。
AI.conclusion: 该工作将共形预测与经典信息论量建立形式化联系，为以集大小缩减作为信息增益度量提供了理论依据，同时提示其与互信息在特征排序上可能不一致。

title: What Does Fréchet Distance Measure? A Directional Decomposition
summary: The Fréchet distance is a de facto standard for evaluating generative models across domains, appearing as FID for images and FVD for videos. It summarizes the discrepancy between generated and reference distributions in a single scalar, with lower values typically interpreted as better generation quality. However, this scalar view can obscure what drives the comparison. For example, in COCO dataset, increasing the number of diffusion sampling steps improves ImageReward scores yet worsens (increases) FID. Motivated by this mismatch, we seek to make the Fréchet distance more interpretable by uncovering where the discrepancy lies. To this end, we introduce directional Fréchet distance, the expected squared projection of the optimal transport displacement onto a given direction. Across our image, video, and protein case studies, we find that a small number of interpretable directions account for much of the distance. We use these directions to explain the FID increase in terms of semantic concepts represented by CLIP embeddings, quantify FVD's bias toward per-frame appearance, and revisit the interpretation of Protein FID. We open-source our codebase at https://github.com/yhlee-add/directional-fd.

AI.tldr: 提出方向性Fréchet距离，将FID/FVD等生成模型评估指标分解为可解释方向上的投影，揭示距离来源。
AI.motivation: Fréchet距离（如图像的FID、视频的FVD）是生成模型评估的事实标准，但其单标量形式掩盖了差异的来源。例如在COCO数据集上，增加扩散采样步数会提升ImageReward却使FID变差，这种矛盾促使作者寻求让Fréchet距离更可解释的方法。
AI.method: 引入方向性Fréchet距离（directional Fréchet distance），即最优传输位移在给定方向上的期望平方投影。通过寻找少数可解释方向来分解总体距离。
AI.result: 在图像、视频和蛋白质案例研究中发现，少数可解释方向即可解释大部分距离。用这些方向以CLIP嵌入表示的语义概念解释了FID升高现象，量化了FVD对逐帧外观的偏好，并重新审视了Protein FID的解释。
AI.conclusion: 方向性Fréchet距离能有效揭示生成模型评估指标背后的差异来源，提升FID/FVD等的可解释性，代码已开源。

title: Principles that Guide, Actions that Inform: Agent Evolution via Knowledge Abstraction
summary:
Large language model (LLM) agents have demonstrated strong capabilities in interactive environments, yet their ability to continually evolve from experience remains limited. Although fine-tuning enables adaptation, its dependence on parameter access and high computational costs restrict its flexibility, especially for large-scale and closed-source LLMs. External memory offers an alternative by allowing agents to accumulate experience without modifying model parameters. However, existing methods mainly focus on experience representation and organization, while the acquired knowledge remains tightly coupled with specific tasks and contexts, limiting generalization. A key challenge is how to transform concrete interactions into abstract and reusable knowledge that guides future decisions beyond individual experiences.
  To address this challenge, we propose SAGA (\underline{\textbf{S}}elf-evolving \underline{\textbf{A}}gents through Experience-\underline{\textbf{G}}rounded \underline{\textbf{A}}bstraction), a framework for experience-grounded knowledge abstraction and utilization in LLM agents. SAGA progressively transforms interaction trajectories into episodic descriptions, reusable procedures, and principles with explicit applicability conditions, while maintaining links to execution evidence. Retrieved principles are instantiated into task-specific guidance and used to refine candidate actions through corrective feedback and resampling. This creates an execution--abstraction feedback loop, where accumulated knowledge guides future interactions and new experiences continuously update hierarchical memory. Experiments on ScienceWorld and ALFWorld demonstrate improved task performance, with ablation studies highlighting the importance of contextual instantiation and action regulation for leveraging principle-level knowledge.

AI.tldr: 提出SAGA框架，将LLM智能体的交互轨迹逐级抽象为情节描述、可重用流程和带适用条件的原则，并实例化指导行动，实现执行-抽象闭环，提升ScienceWorld与ALFWorld任务表现。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体难以从经验中持续进化：微调依赖参数访问且算力开销大，对大规模闭源模型不适用；外部记忆方法虽无需改参数，但现有工作侧重经验的表示与组织，知识仍与具体任务和情境强耦合，泛化性差。核心挑战在于如何把具体交互转化为抽象、可复用的知识，以指导超越单个经验的未来决策。
AI.method: SAGA将交互轨迹逐步转化为情节描述、可重用流程、以及带明确适用条件的原则，并保留与执行证据的链接；检索到的原则被实例化为任务特定指导，并通过纠正性反馈与重采样来精炼候选动作，形成执行—抽象反馈循环，累积知识指导后续交互、新经验持续更新分层记忆。
AI.result: 在ScienceWorld和ALFWorld上的实验显示任务性能提升；消融研究强调了上下文实例化与动作调控对于利用原则级知识的重要性。
AI.conclusion: SAGA通过经验接地抽象实现分层知识抽取与利用，在不修改模型参数的前提下增强智能体的持续进化与跨任务泛化能力。

title: JIVEAdapter: A Multi-Task Additive Low-Rank Adapter via Joint and Individual Variation Explained (JIVE)
summary: Parameter-efficient fine-tuning adapts pretrained models at a fraction of the cost of full fine-tuning, yet most low-rank adapters are single-task and represent each weight update multiplicatively, leaving no explicit account of what is shared across tasks and what is task-specific. We introduce JIVEAdapter, a multi-task "additive" low-rank adapter inspired by statistical Joint and Individual Variation Explained (JIVE). JIVEAdapter decomposes every weight update into a Joint structure shared across all tasks plus a per-task Individual structure, penalizes the Individual structures to be near-orthogonal to the Joint so shared and task-specific signal stay "interpretable" and separated, and allocates rank adaptively across a shared Joint pool and a per-task Individual pool. The Joint is learned once, jointly over a task group or incrementally, one task at a time, then frozen and reused as a prior for new tasks without retraining the shared part. On GLUE and SuperGLUE with DeBERTaV3-base, JIVEAdapter is competitive with strong single-task and multi-task low-rank baselines at a matched per-task effective rank, without extra modules such as MoE, and when a related held-in task exists its frozen Joint serves a held-out task by reusing that task's Individual with only a cheap per-direction scale, otherwise training a small new one.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 JIVEAdapter，一种受统计 JIVE 启发的多任务加性低秩适配器，将权重更新分解为跨任务共享的 Joint 结构与各任务专属的 Individual 结构，并施加近正交惩罚与自适应秩分配。
AI.motivation: 多数低秩适配器为单任务设计，且以乘性方式表示权重更新，无法显式区分跨任务共享信息与任务专属信息。
AI.method: JIVEAdapter 将每个权重更新分解为所有任务共享的 Joint 结构加每任务 Individual 结构；惩罚 Individual 与 Joint 近似正交以保持可解释性；在共享 Joint 池与 Individual 池间自适应分配秩；Joint 可联合学习或逐任务增量学习，随后冻结并作为新任务的先验复用。
AI.result: 在 GLUE 与 SuperGLUE 上基于 DeBERTaV3-base，在匹配的每任务有效秩下，JIVEAdapter 与强单任务及多任务低秩基线相当，且无需 MoE 等额外模块；当存在相关 held-in 任务时，冻结的 Joint 可通过仅加廉价逐方向缩放复用该任务的 Individual 来服务 held-out 任务，否则训练一个小的新 Individual。
AI.conclusion: JIVEAdapter 通过加性分解与正交约束实现共享与任务专属信号的显式分离，并提供可冻结、可复用的共享先验，为参数高效多任务适配提供了一种无需额外模块的可行方案。

title: Inference-Time Projection for Physically Valid Biomolecular Diffusion Models
summary: AlphaFold 3-style cofolding models predict biomolecular complexes with high structural accuracy, yet a large fraction of their outputs are physically invalid: chains overlap at interfaces, ligand bond lengths and angles are distorted, rings are non-planar, and stereocentres are inverted. Current approaches either steer the sampler with physics-informed potentials, which multiplies sampling cost and memory overhead making inference impossible on large complexes, or finetune the model, costing time and tying the fix to one architecture. We observe that, unlike structural accuracy, physical validity is fully verifiable at inference time from quantities the sampler already holds. We therefore treat physical validity as a constrained inference problem and introduce two closed-form projection operators applied to the diffusion model's denoised clean-coordinate estimate, $\hat{x}_0$: an inter-chain van der Waals projection that pushes apart the most severely clashing atom pairs, and a ligand distance-geometry projection that restores bond lengths, angles, internal contacts, planarity and chirality. Both operators are local, sparse and displacement-capped, require no network evaluations, gradients or importance sampling, and leave the denoiser and its weights untouched, so they can be dropped into any AF3-style sampler without retraining. Applied to two independently developed models, Boltz-2 and OpenFold-3, across five benchmarks (CASP15, CASP16, the PoseBusters monomer and complex sets, and the Boltz physical-validity test set), our method recovers perfect physical validity while preserving structural-accuracy and ligand-placement metrics. These gains are achieved with negligible runtime and memory overhead, providing a practical, model-agnostic route to physically valid all-atom structure prediction.

AI.tldr: 提出两种闭式投影算子，作用于AF3类共折叠扩散模型去噪后的干净坐标估计x̂₀，实现无需重训练、开销可忽略的物理有效性修复，在Boltz-2与OpenFold-3及五个基准上恢复完美物理有效性并保持结构精度。
AI.motivation: AF3类共折叠模型虽结构精度高，但大量输出物理无效：链间界面重叠、配体键长键角畸变、环非平面、手性中心反转。现有方案或引入物理势引导采样器（采样成本与显存开销倍增，大复合物无法推断），或微调模型（耗时且与单一架构绑定），均不理想。作者观察到物理有效性不同于结构精度，可在推断时从采样器已有量中完全验证，故将其视为约束推断问题。
AI.method: 将物理有效性作为约束推断问题，在扩散模型去噪后的干净坐标估计x̂₀上施加两个闭式投影算子：（1）链间范德华投影，推开最严重冲突的原子对；（2）配体距离几何投影，恢复键长、键角、内部接触、平面性与手性。两算子均为局部、稀疏、位移上限约束，无需网络评估、梯度或重要性采样，不修改去噪器及其权重，可直接嵌入任意AF3风格采样器而无需重训练。
AI.result: 在两种独立开发的模型（Boltz-2、OpenFold-3）与五个基准（CASP15、CASP16、PoseBusters单体与复合物集、Boltz物理有效性测试集）上，方法恢复完美物理有效性，同时保持结构精度与配体放置指标，运行时间与内存开销可忽略。
AI.conclusion: 该工作提供了实用、模型无关的途径，实现全原子结构预测的物理有效性，可即插即用于任意AF3风格采样器。

title: AMBER: Training Long-Horizon Web Agents through Append-Only Memory
summary: Modern language-model agents increasingly interact with external environments over long-horizon, multi-step trajectories, where the accumulated interaction history can quickly exceed practical context budgets. To ensure reliability, agents must maintain factual information over long horizons, remember execution errors and corrective feedback, and track progress across actions.
