summary: Logic programming is increasingly used as the symbolic component of neurosymbolic AI systems. We survey the main rule-based languages in this setting, namely Datalog, answer set, and probabilistic logic programs, along four axes: semantics, expressiveness, neural integration, and evaluation mechanism. We analyse over 50 recent systems and applications, comparing formalism usage across four research areas: databases and programming languages, machine learning, vision, and robotics. We provide a decision matrix mapping application scenarios to required features and close by outlining open problems.

AI.tldr: 本文综述了神经符号AI中基于规则的主要逻辑编程语言（Datalog、答案集程序、概率逻辑程序），沿语义、表达能力、神经集成与求值机制四个维度分析50余个近期系统，并给出面向应用场景的决策矩阵。
AI.motivation: 逻辑编程日益成为神经符号AI系统的符号组件，但该领域语言选择与系统设计缺乏统一视角，研究者难以判断在不同任务中应采用何种形式化语言及其对应特性。
AI.method: 选取Datalog、答案集程序（ASP）与概率逻辑程序三类基于规则的语言，沿语义（semantics）、表达能力（expressiveness）、神经集成（neural integration）与求值机制（evaluation mechanism）四条轴线进行综述式比较；分析超过50个近期系统与应用，并跨数据库与编程语言、机器学习、视觉、机器人四个研究领域比较形式化方法的使用差异；构建将应用场景映射到所需特性的决策矩阵。
AI.result: 形成了三类语言在四条轴线上的系统性对比，揭示了不同研究领域在形式化选择上的偏好与差异，并产出可指导场景选型的决策矩阵。
AI.conclusion: 该综述为神经符号AI中逻辑编程组件的语言选型提供了结构化框架与决策依据，并指出若干待解决的开放问题，为后续研究指明方向。

title: Rationale-Guided Policy Optimization: Learning to Reason with Adaptive Rationale Scaffolding
summary: On-policy reinforcement learning has become a central paradigm for improving the reasoning abilities of large language models. However, its effectiveness is often limited by reward sparsity: when a model fails to discover correct trajectories for difficult problems, the optimization process receives little useful signal and may stagnate. Existing approaches mitigate this issue by incorporating off-policy demonstrations, expert traces, or model-generated solutions, but they typically require the auxiliary data to match the format of the reinforcement-learning task, often relying on rejection sampling from stronger models to obtain suitable training trajectories. We introduce Rationale-Guided Policy Optimization (RGPO), a framework that adaptively leverages ground-truth rationale information according to the model's current capability while preserving its freedom to explore. Rather than treating reference solutions as fixed imitation targets, RGPO uses them as temporary scaffolds: rationales help the model generate improved responses, after which only higher-reward, model-generated solutions are transferred back to the original unguided setting. This design allows training to exploit available ground-truth information without requiring off-policy data to follow the same format as the RL task. Across both language-only and vision-language reasoning settings, RGPO consistently improves performance over RLVR baselines, and ablation studies show that adaptive rationale guidance is a key contributor to these gains. These results suggest that RGPO offers a practical and general approach for reducing reward sparsity, stabilizing reinforcement learning, and improving reasoning performance in both text-only and multimodal models.

AI.tldr: RGPO 提出一种"思维链脚手架"框架：依据模型当前能力自适应引入真值思维链，帮助生成更优回答后仅将高奖励的模型自生成解回传至无引导的原始 RL 设置，无需离策略数据与 RL 任务格式对齐，即可缓解奖励稀疏。
AI.motivation: 在线策略强化学习是提升大模型推理能力的核心范式，但存在奖励稀疏问题：面对难题时模型难以发现正确轨迹，优化信号不足导致训练停滞。已有方法通过离策略示范、专家轨迹或模型自生成解来缓解，但通常要求辅助数据与 RL 任务格式一致，往往依赖从更强模型中进行拒绝采样来获得合适训练轨迹，成本高且通用性受限。
AI.method: 提出 Rationale-Guided Policy Optimization（RGPO）。不把参考答案当作固定模仿目标，而将其作为临时脚手架：根据模型当前能力自适应地利用真值思维链信息，辅助模型生成更优回答；随后只把奖励更高、由模型自身生成的解转移到原始的无引导环境中继续训练。该设计既保留了模型的探索自由，又使训练能够利用可得真值信息，且不要求离策略数据与 RL 任务格式相同。
AI.result: 在纯语言推理与视觉-语言推理两类设置中，RGPO 相对 RLVR 基线均取得稳定的性能提升；消融实验表明，自适应思维链引导是带来这些增益的关键因素。
AI.conclusion: RGPO 是一种实用且通用的方法，能够降低奖励稀疏性、稳定强化学习过程，并同时提升纯文本与多模态模型的推理表现。

title: Trajectory-Retrieval Speculative Decoding: When Does a Model's Own History Help?
summary: Long chain-of-thought reasoning increases sequential decoding cost while creating a growing history of potentially reusable continuations. We investigate when this history supplies useful drafts and complements an existing drafter. Controlled source comparisons reveal trajectory-specific reuse, motivating our method Trajectory-Local Adaptive Retrieval (TLAR). TLAR retrieves approximately matched continuations from the current trajectory and uses recent verification outcomes to adapt retrieval activation and candidate width. TLAR combines retrieved continuations with model-generated drafts in a shared candidate tree, preserving the target model's output distribution through exact verification. Across code debugging, mathematics, and open-ended writing, our evaluation connects source reuse, incremental acceptance, and execution cost. Combining TLAR with strong retrieval baselines improves token acceptance under matched verification budgets and increases end-to-end throughput over the draft-model baseline. These findings support generated trajectories as runtime memory for adaptive inference.

AI.tldr: 提出TLAR，从当前推理轨迹中检索近似匹配的续写作为草稿，并结合模型生成草稿，在精确验证下提升推测解码效率。
AI.motivation: 长链思维推理增加顺序解码成本，同时积累大量可能可复用的续写历史，需探究该历史何时能提供有用草稿并补充现有草稿模型。
AI.method: 受控来源对比揭示轨迹特异性的复用，据此提出Trajectory-Local Adaptive Retrieval（TLAR）。TLAR从当前轨迹检索近似匹配续写，利用近期验证结果自适应调整检索激活与候选宽度，并将检索续写与模型草稿合并入共享候选树，通过精确验证保持目标模型输出分布。
AI.result: 在代码调试、数学和开放式写作任务上，评估关联了来源复用、增量接受与执行成本。TLAR与强检索基线结合，在相同验证预算下提高token接受率，并相较草稿模型基线提升端到端吞吐。
AI.conclusion: 生成轨迹可作为自适应推理的运行时记忆。

title: Evaluating Escalation Signals for LLM Routing: Targets, Controls, and Five Ways to Fool Yourself
summary: Deciding when to escalate a query from a small language model to a larger one requires a cheap signal that predicts, before the large model is called, whether escalating would help. Semantic entropy, originally developed to detect hallucinations, is a natural candidate: it measures how much a model's sampled answers disagree in meaning, and high disagreement often signals an unreliable answer. We test it across three benchmarks and two model families. On GSM8K, with a small/large pair about twelve times apart in size, semantic entropy reliably distinguishes the small model's mistakes (AUROC 0.871) and improves routed accuracy over random escalation by up to nine points at matched cost. An earlier strong-looking result on a synthetic benchmark proved misleading: a simple rule based only on question difficulty, with no model involved, matched semantic entropy almost exactly. This paper's main contribution is a set of checks that catch this before it is reported as real. We show that scoring a cheap, question-only difficulty estimate alongside any signal reveals whether the signal adds real information or just tracks how hard a question looks; that two reasonable definitions of "escalation worked" can produce very different results on the same data; that a benchmark can leave almost no room for any signal to beat simply always using the large model; and that the true cost of live sampling can make routing more expensive than calling the large model directly. For a cheaper alternative that reuses cached past outcomes, we show how to predict whether it will work on a new dataset -- confirmed by correctly forecasting a collapse from AUROC 0.908 to chance level (0.518) ahead of time. We offer these as a general checklist for evaluating escalation signals.

AI.tldr: 本文测试语义熵作为"是否将查询从小模型升级到大模型"的廉价信号，并提出一套评估该类信号的通用检查清单，以识别虚假有效的结果。
AI.motivation: 决定何时将查询从小语言模型升级到更大模型，需要一个在调用大模型之前就能预测升级是否有益的廉价信号。语义熵（原用于检测幻觉）是自然候选，但存在被表面结果误导的风险，需要严格的验证方法。
AI.method: 在三个基准和两个模型家族上测试语义熵：GSM8K上小/大模型规模相差约12倍；并设计一组检查方法：将仅基于问题难度的廉价估计与任何信号并列打分，以判断该信号是否提供真实增量信息；比较两种"升级有效"定义；评估基准是否几乎不给任何信号留出超越"总是用大模型"的空间；核算实时采样的真实成本；以及对复用缓存历史结果的更廉价替代方案进行跨数据集可行性预测。
AI.result: GSM8K上语义熵能可靠区分小模型的错误（AUROC 0.871），在成本匹配下相比随机升级可将路由准确率提升最多9个百分点。但在合成基准上的一个看似很强的结果被证明具有误导性：一个不涉及任何模型、仅基于问题难度的简单规则几乎与语义熵完全持平。廉价缓存的替代方案可从AUROC 0.908预先正确预测其在新数据集上崩溃至随机水平（0.518）。
AI.conclusion: 本文主要贡献是一套能在结果被当作真实发现报道之前识别虚假有效性的检查方法，可作为评估升级（路由）信号的通用清单。

title: Evaluate the Stack, Not the Layer: Do Deterministic and LLM Gates for Agent Actions Fail Independently?
comment: 15 pages, 1 figure, 10 tables. Artifact (data, scripts, provenance): https://github.com/chenglin1112/evaluate-the-stack
summary: Runtime gates for agent tool calls are stacked on the assumption that their errors multiply. We test it on 1,119 labelled agent actions from three corpora, without an adaptive adversary. The stack has one deterministic rule layer and four LLM judges, three of them re-collected with the served model recorded on every call. We read each stack as a number of multiplication-equivalent layers, n_mult, with its floor under perfect coupling. Under the STRICT miss definition (escalation to a human scored as not stopped), any two judges compose to about 1.2 to 1.4 layers (φ median +0.430, 6 of 6 pairs significant, floors 1.02 to 1.17). The rule layer plus one judge composes to 1.86 to 2.09 layers (φ median +0.014, 0 of 4 significant, floors 1.01 to 1.09). Under PRIMARY (escalation scored as caught) the bands are 1.21 to 1.57 and 1.80 to 2.13. Intervals separate on the pooled data, point estimates split on each corpus, and a third-vendor judge lands in the judge band. Solo accuracy does not predict what a layer adds: a cloud rule pack lowers the rule layer's solo miss rate by 20% and adds no new joint coverage. The difficulty share of judge coupling is not identifiable: 31.8% to 61.8% depending on the probe and the miss definition. One judge tier was served by an unrequested model version in 50 of 112 batches, concentrated on the external corpus. That event overturned a pre-declared analysis rule, and the scoring of review verdicts reversed five conclusions. We report both.

AI.tldr: 对1,119条已标注智能体动作（三个语料）检验"运行时门控错误可乘"假设：两层LLM法官组合约等于1.2–1.4个乘性层，规则层加一法官约1.86–2.09层；单层准确率无法预测其边际增益，法官间耦合的"难度占比"不可识别（31.8%–61.8%）。
AI.motivation: 运行时门控（规则层+LLM法官）被广泛叠加使用，其隐含假设是各层错误相互独立、误差可乘、层数越多防护越强。本文质疑并实证检验这一"乘性叠加"假设，同时考察单层准确率能否预测其联合防护增益，以及模型版本漂移对分析结论的影响。
AI.method: 在无自适应对手条件下，使用来自三个语料的1,119条人工标注智能体动作。门控栈含1个确定性规则层与4个LLM法官（其中3个在每次调用记录实际服务模型后重新采集）。将整个栈折算为"乘性等价层数"n_mult，并给出完美耦合下的下界（floor）。定义两种漏检口径：STRICT（升级给人工计为未拦截）与PRIMARY（升级计为已拦截）。统计上报告φ（成对相关系数中位数）、分对显著性、区间与逐语料点估计，并做第三方厂商法官验证。
AI.result: STRICT口径下：任意两个法官组合约1.2–1.4层（φ中位+0.430，6/6对显著，下界1.02–1.17）；规则层+1法官为1.86–2.09层（φ中位+0.014，0/4对显著，下界1.01–1.09）。PRIMARY口径下两区间分别为1.21–1.57与1.80–2.13。区间在合并数据上可分离，点估计在单个语料上分裂，第三方厂商法官落入法官区间。云端规则包将规则层单层漏检率降低20%却不增加联合覆盖。法官耦合中的难度占比不可识别（31.8%–61.8%）。112个批次中有50批的法官层被非请求的模型版本服务，集中于外部语料。
AI.conclusion: 门控叠加的乘性假设不成立：同构法官之间高度耦合，层数增益远低于名义层数，而规则层与法官之间几乎不共享信息、增益接近"1+1≈2"。单层准确率不能预测其对栈的边际贡献。模型版本漂移这一意外事件推翻了预设分析规则，并使评审结论评分反转了5项结论，作者对两种结果均予报告。

title: MemCo: Memory-Centric Collaboration for Generalizing LLM Agents to Unseen Environments
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents increasingly operate in interactive environments, where they need to make sequential decisions through observation, action, and feedback. Although memory can help agents reuse experience, existing work designs memory in isolation, where collecting enough trajectories to populate it is expensive. Existing shared-memory approaches mitigate isolated experience by pooling episodic memories across tasks and environments. However, retrieving shared memory is challenged by the granularity, where retrieved memories can be either too specific to preserve current grounding or too coarse to support the next action. In this work, we propose MemCo, a memory-centric collaboration framework for generalizing LLM agents to unseen interactive environments. It maintains complementary local and global memory spaces, preserving environment-specific details locally while promoting transferable workflows induced from local trajectories to global memory. During online interaction, MemCo routes relevant local and global memories in terms of the agent's current state and decision phase, enabling agents to reuse the experience of other agents without blindly transferring environment-specific details. Experiments on interactive decision-making benchmarks show that MemCo improves task success and reduces redundant exploration compared with isolate-memory and shared-memory baselines. Our code is available at https://github.com/SYannL/nvdamas.

AI.tldr: 提出 MemCo，一种以记忆为中心的 LLM 智能体协作框架，通过互补的局部与全局记忆空间及基于状态与决策阶段的路由机制，实现交互环境中经验的高效复用与泛化。
AI.motivation: LLM 智能体日益在交互环境中做序贯决策，记忆可帮助复用经验，但现有工作孤立地设计记忆，收集足够轨迹填充成本高昂；共享记忆虽可跨任务/环境汇聚情节记忆，却在检索粒度上存在两难：过细会破坏当前情境接地，过粗又难以支撑下一步动作。
AI.method: MemCo 维护互补的局部与全局记忆空间：局部保留环境特定细节，全局则从局部轨迹中归纳可迁移的工作流。在线交互时，依据智能体当前状态与决策阶段路由相关的局部和全局记忆，从而复用其他智能体的经验而不盲目迁移环境特定细节。
AI.result: 在交互式决策基准上，MemCo 相比孤立记忆与共享记忆基线提升了任务成功率，并减少了冗余探索。代码已开源。
AI.conclusion: 通过局部—全局互补记忆与细粒度路由，MemCo 在缓解记忆检索粒度困境的同时，增强了 LLM 智能体向未见交互环境的泛化能力。

title: Defense-in-Depth for LLMs: Evaluating Memory Gates Against Activation-Induced and Memory-Induced Sycophancy
comment: Accepted to NeurIPS (IAB, RTCA, AIWILD, and CL4FM)
summary: Long-term memory allows Large Language Models (LLMs) to maintain personalized context across interactions, but retrieved user history can induce memory-induced sycophancy, causing models to favor stored user beliefs over objective evidence. Existing defenses primarily operate on retrieved context and are rarely evaluated jointly with internal behavioral bias. We introduce a $2 \times 2$ defense-in-depth framework separating internal activation steering from external memory handling. We extract sycophancy steering directions from 100 paired prompts and evaluate four open-weight models across 10 steering coefficients and five memory-defense configurations on MemSyco-Bench (answers for all 1,550 items; defense conditions judged on a fixed 250-item subsample), with three LLM judges. Three of the five configurations are new (rewriting every memory, a Router Gate that keeps, rewrites, or drops each memory, and dropping all memory); the other two are MemSyco's baselines. Selective Router Gate filtering preserves substantially more of MemSyco's average accuracy than complete memory removal, and this separation persists when the models are steered toward sycophancy. On Llama 3.1 8B with Router Gate, mild inverse steering ($α= -1.5$) lowers judge-averaged sycophancy from 35.80% to 31.32% while average accuracy moves from 43.99% to 43.31%; this reduction has the same direction under all three judges but is not statistically significant (paired $p = 0.08$ to $0.63$ on 149 items). External memory filtering is the part of the design that holds up; our data do not show that inverse steering adds to it.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一个2×2纵深防御框架，将内部激活引导与外部记忆处理分离，用于缓解LLM长期记忆引发的谄媚问题。实验表明，外部记忆过滤（尤其是Router Gate）效果稳健，但反向激活引导并未显示出额外增益。
AI.motivation: 长期记忆使LLM能维持个性化上下文，但检索到的用户历史会诱发"记忆诱导谄媚"（memory-induced sycophancy），即模型倾向于迎合存储的用户信念而忽视客观证据。现有防御主要作用于检索上下文，且很少与内部行为偏置联合评估。
AI.method: 提出2×2纵深防御框架，分离内部激活引导与外部记忆处理。从100对提示中提取谄媚引导方向，在MemSyco-Bench上评估4个开源权重模型、10个引导系数和5种记忆防御配置，并使用3个LLM评判器。其中3种配置为新设计（改写所有记忆、Router Gate决定保留/改写/丢弃每条记忆、丢弃所有记忆），另2种为MemSyco基线。
AI.result: 选择性Router Gate过滤比完全移除记忆更能保留MemSyco的平均准确率，且该分离在模型被引导向谄媚时仍成立。在Llama 3.1 8B配Router Gate时，温和反向引导（α=-1.5）将评判器平均谄媚率从35.80%降至31.32%，平均准确率从43.99%变为43.31%；该下降在三个评判器下方向一致，但在149个样本上不具统计显著性（配对p=0.08至0.63）。
AI.conclusion: 外部记忆过滤是设计中稳健有效的部分；数据未显示反向激活引导能带来额外增益。

title: 2d-fet-bench: from spatial reasoning to fet design on flakes
summary: Field-effect transistor (FET) layouts on exfoliated two-dimensional flakes are typically drawn by hand for each flake, placing contacts and gates to match its position and outline in optical micrographs. To our knowledge, no executable benchmark tests whether language-model agents can perform this flake-specific construction reliably. We introduce 2D-FET-Bench V2, a benchmark of 128 layout tasks built from microscopy-derived flake contours, including hole-containing flakes and multi-flake tasks. Each task supplies a textual device specification and contour coordinates. An agent generates typed polygon and path operations rendered to GDSII. A deterministic verifier checks geometric and structural requirements, and a separate integrity check verifies that the supplied contours remain unchanged. Scripted reference layouts pass all 128 tasks, showing that every task is solvable. We evaluate six models and seven workflow and scaffold variants of GPT5.6-Luna, with five attempts per task. The best-performing configuration in the six-model panel, GPT5.6-Luna with ReAct-3, passes 62.3% of attempts and solves 80.5% of tasks at least once (coverage) and 43.8% in all five attempts (consistency). ReAct-3 exceeds the one-pass Plan-and-Execute by 27.0 pass@1 points at 2.46 times the tokens. An expert audit of one sampled verifier-passing layout per covered task, across five ReAct-3 configurations, accepts 56.4% to 63.5% of them. The benchmark evaluates geometric and structural FET layout construction.

AI.tldr: 提出2D-FET-Bench V2基准，用128个基于显微图像轮廓的FET版图任务，评估语言模型智能体生成GDSII版图的几何与结构能力。
AI.motivation: 二维材料剥落薄片的FET版图通常需按每片薄片手工绘制，缺乏可执行的基准来检验语言模型智能体能否可靠完成此类薄片定制版图构建。
AI.method: 构建128个版图任务，含带孔薄片与多薄片任务，提供器件规格文本与轮廓坐标；智能体生成带类型的多边形/路径操作并渲染为GDSII；确定性验证器检查几何与结构要求，另设完整性检查确保给定轮廓不被修改；以脚本参考版图全部通过验证任务可解性；评测6个模型及GPT5.6-Luna的7种工作流/脚手架变体，每任务5次尝试。
AI.result: 脚本参考版图通过全部128个任务；六模型面板中最佳配置GPT5.6-Luna+ReAct-3每次尝试通过率62.3%，任务覆盖率80.5%，5次全通过一致性43.8%；ReAct-3较单次Plan-and-Execute的pass@1高27.0点，但token消耗为2.46倍；对每个覆盖任务抽样一个验证通过的版图经专家审核，在5种ReAct-3配置下接受率为56.4%–63.5%。
AI.conclusion: 该基准可评估FET版图的几何与结构构建能力，并揭示当前语言模型智能体在此类薄片定制版图任务上仍存在显著差距。

title: Adaptive Gait Biofeedback With Participant-Held-Out Modeling and Participant-Specific Updating in Chronic Ankle Instability
comment: 28 pages (14-page main manuscript and 14-page supplementary material), 5 main figures
summary: Adaptive gait biofeedback may support repeated practice in chronic ankle instability, but its evaluation must address model performance and human response. We evaluated a temporal convolutional classifier on protocol-defined, angle-derived GOOD/BAD gait-cycle labels using participant-held-out leave-one-subject-out (LOSO) cross-validation in 20 participants. Seven participants in the adaptive-intervention group completed nine sessions over three weeks, with one motion-capture recording analyzed per session. Models updated after failed sessions were compared offline with their parent models on the same-session validation subset used for candidate selection and the first subsequent adaptive-session recording. Frontal-plane ankle angle was compared between the adaptive group and 10 sequentially enrolled controls at Baseline, Post, and 7-day Retention. Across 20 held-out folds, mean fold-level area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUROC) was 0.948, sensitivity for angle-threshold-exceeding BAD cycles was 0.941, and specificity for angle-threshold-meeting GOOD cycles was 0.366. Mean BAD-class F1 was higher in candidate models by 0.187 on the same-session subset and 0.118 on the first subsequent recording. At Post, the adaptive group had a baseline-adjusted frontal-plane ankle angle 5.168 degrees lower than controls (95% confidence interval, 1.766-8.569 degrees lower); the Retention contrast was uncertain. These findings characterize population-model discrimination and offline participant-specific updating during repeated biofeedback use, alongside a nonrandomized Post frontal-plane ankle angle association. They do not establish independent clinical gait classification or a causal benefit of updating.

AI.tldr: 该研究评估了用于慢性踝关节不稳自适应步态生物反馈的时序卷积分类器，并在非随机对照设计中考察了人体响应。
AI.motivation: 自适应步态生物反馈可能支持慢性踝关节不稳患者的重复练习，但对其评价需同时涵盖模型性能与人体响应两方面。
AI.method: 20名参与者采用留一被试交叉验证（LOSO）评估时序卷积分类器，标签为协议定义的、基于角度的GOOD/BAD步态周期。自适应干预组7人完成3周共9次训练，每次分析一次动作捕捉记录；将失败会话后更新的模型与其父模型在候选选择所用的同会话验证子集及随后的首个自适应会话记录上进行离线比较。自适应组与10名顺序入组对照者的额状面踝关节角度在基线、干预后和7天保持期进行比较。
AI.result: 20个留出折的平均折级AUROC为0.948；对超过角度阈值BAD周期的敏感度为0.941，对符合角度阈值GOOD周期的特异度为0.366。候选模型的平均BAD类F1在同会话子集上高0.187，在首个后续记录上高0.118。干预后，自适应组经基线校正的额状面踝关节角度比对照低5.168度（95%CI 1.766–8.569），保持期对比结果不确定。
AI.conclusion: 结果刻画了群体模型判别能力及重复生物反馈使用中的离线个体化更新，并呈现了非随机化的干预后额状面踝关节角度关联；但未确立独立的临床步态分类能力，也未证明模型更新的因果获益。

title: When Does AI Supervision Help? A Role-Aware Study of Network Fraud Decision Management with Blockchain Auditability
summary: When does a second artificial intelligence (AI) component improve a primary network-fraud decision rather than add operational burden? We study this question through a role-aware Decider-Supervisor (DS) framework with blockchain auditability, evaluating four directional configurations that combine centralised machine learning, a Federated Averaging (FedAvg)-trained federated meta-model, and Base or Quantized Low-Rank Adaptation (QLoRA) large language model variants. The analysis compares primary-only and supervised decisions using non-hard fraud performance, intervention burden, conditional calibration, traffic-mix and Review-capacity sensitivity, dependability tests, and blockchain lifecycle controls. The deterministic hard gate resolves 89.994% of fraudulent requests, leaving the non-hard population as the main AI decision setting. Conditional validation calibration does not produce a consistently transferable supervisory advantage on deployment replay. DS-3 QLoRA is the least disruptive supervised configuration, but it still underperforms its primary FedAvg stage in F1 and total errors. Across 36 reweighted traffic mixtures, supervision reduces total errors only for DS-4 Base in two extreme high-fraud scenarios. Blockchain tests support digest verification, tamper detection, authorisation, single-use review resolution, and post-finalisation integrity, while exposing a pre-finalisation single-write limitation. The results show that the value of AI supervision depends on role assignment, calibration, escalation policy, traffic composition, and lifecycle controls rather than on the presence of a second model alone.

AI.tldr: 本文提出角色感知的"决策者-监督者"（DS）框架，结合区块链可审计性，评估AI监督在何种条件下能改善网络欺诈决策而非增加运营负担。
AI.motivation: 探究何时引入第二个AI组件能真正提升主要网络欺诈决策效果，而非仅增加运营负担，明确AI监督价值的边界条件。
AI.method: 构建角色感知的Decider-Supervisor（DS）框架，配备区块链可审计性；评估四种方向性配置，组合集中式机器学习、FedAvg训练的联邦元模型，以及Base或QLoRA大语言模型变体；采用非硬欺诈性能、干预负担、条件校准、流量混合与审核容量敏感性、可靠性测试及区块链生命周期控制等指标，对比仅主决策与监督决策。
AI.result: 确定性硬门限解决89.994%欺诈请求，非硬群体成为主要AI决策场景；条件验证校准未在部署重放中产生一致可迁移的监督优势；DS-3 QLoRA为干扰最小的监督配置，但在F1和总误差上仍不及主FedAvg阶段；36种重加权流量混合中，仅DS-4 Base在两个极端高欺诈场景下降低总误差；区块链测试支持摘要验证、篡改检测、授权、单次审核解析及最终化后完整性，但存在最终化前单写局限。
AI.conclusion: AI监督的价值取决于角色分配、校准、升级策略、流量构成及生命周期控制，而非仅取决于是否存在第二个模型。

title: COMPASS: Finding Where Reasoning Lives in Language Models
summary: Explicitly eliciting reasoning substantially improves LLM performance. Existing approaches require a predefined characterization of reasoning, whether through CoT prompt design, contrastive CoT directions, or via SAE derived reasoning features. For mathematical reasoning with verifiable answers, we show that a much simpler signal suffices, which is the correctness of the model's own direct answer attempts. This signal yields a latent direction that elicits reasoning. This direction is decodable within the activations of most attention heads, but only a small subset of them can be effectively intervened. We introduce COMPASS, an inference-time steering method that identifies these heads using a logit-space attribution score and steers their activations along the correctness direction, requiring only per-head activation statistics. Across three model families and multiple math benchmarks, COMPASS outperforms the activation-steering baselines we compare against, improves GSM8K accuracy by 16 percentage points on average, and approaches CoT accuracy with 20-70\% fewer generated tokens. Interventions transfer without re-fitting to unseen benchmarks, and ablations show that both the correctness direction and the small set of heads carrying it are necessary, with the effect concentrated in remarkably few heads.

AI.tldr: 本文提出COMPASS，一种推理时激活引导方法：利用模型自身直接作答的正确性信号构造潜在正确性方向，通过logit空间归因分数识别可干预的注意力头并沿该方向引导激活，从而在数学推理中激发推理能力。
AI.motivation: 现有激发LLM推理的方法依赖预定义的推理刻画方式，如CoT提示设计、对比式CoT方向或SAE导出的推理特征，这些方法需要预先定义"推理"的表征。作者希望证明对于有可验证答案的数学推理任务，一个更简单的信号——模型自身直接作答是否正确——就足以引导推理，从而避免对推理特征的人为预定义。
AI.method: 1) 用模型直接作答的正确性作为信号，提取一个潜在的正确性方向用于激发推理；2) 发现该方向可在多数注意力头的激活中解码，但只有少数头可被有效干预；3) 提出COMPASS：用logit空间归因分数识别这些可干预的头，仅需各头激活统计量，在推理时沿正确性方向对其激活进行引导。
AI.result: 在三个模型家族和多个数学基准上，COMPASS优于所比较的激活引导基线；GSM8K准确率平均提升16个百分点；以少20-70%的生成token逼近CoT准确率；干预无需重新拟合即可迁移到未见基准；消融实验表明正确性方向与承载该方向的少数头均为必要，且效果集中在极少数头上。
AI.conclusion: 直接作答的正确性是一个足以激发推理的简单信号；基于该信号的方向在注意力头层面可解码，但仅少数头可被有效干预。COMPASS通过logit空间归因定位这些头并进行轻量级引导，实现了高效、可迁移的推理增强。

title: PsyCIDRA: A Dual-Agent Framework for Psychiatric Interviewing and Diagnostic Reasoning
summary: Large language models show promise in clinical reasoning, but psychiatric interviewing requires guiding an evolving conversation. Their ability to carry out this interactive assessment remains less studied. We present PsyCIDRA, a dual-agent framework linking free-form psychiatric interviewing with diagnostic reasoning for expert review. Its interviewer agent uses tools to maintain working notes, load expert-written skills, and retrieve ICD-11 references to guide inquiry. Its diagnostic reasoning agent then receives the completed interview transcript and reports hypotheses alongside supporting, conflicting, and missing evidence, withholding a final hypothesis when none is sufficiently supported. Using patient profiles generated with PsyCPG, we first evaluate PsyCIDRA in simulation. Across four models on 53 evaluation cases, it achieves higher diagnostic agreement than direct prompting. On 81 held-out simulated cases, rank-1 accuracy is 60.5% versus 51.9%. In a blinded study of 101 human participants in separate arms, PsyCIDRA agrees with psychologists on whether to propose a diagnostic hypothesis in 79.6% of cases, compared with 65.4% for direct prompting. Together, these findings support the potential of LLM agents to assist psychiatric assessment through free-form dialogue. By examining diagnostic reasoning, interview quality, and safety together, this study contributes to understanding the capabilities and limitations of psychiatric interview agents.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PsyCIDRA双智能体框架，将自由形式的精神科访谈与诊断推理相链接，并通过模拟病例与人类盲法研究验证其诊断一致性优于直接提示。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型在临床推理中展现潜力，但精神科访谈需要引导动态演进的对话，其交互式评估能力研究不足。
AI.method: 构建双智能体框架：访谈智能体通过工具维护工作笔记、加载专家编写的技能、检索ICD-11参考以引导询问；诊断推理智能体接收完整访谈记录，报告假设及支持、冲突与缺失证据，证据不足时不给出最终假设。使用PsyCPG生成的患者画像在模拟环境中评测，并开展101名人类参与者的盲法分臂研究。
AI.result: 53例评估病例、四个模型上诊断一致性高于直接提示；81例留出模拟病例的rank-1准确率为60.5%（直接提示为51.9%）；101名参与者盲法研究中，是否提出诊断假设与心理学家的吻合率为79.6%（直接提示为65.4%）。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持LLM智能体通过自由对话辅助精神科评估的潜力；通过综合考察诊断推理、访谈质量与安全性，有助于理解精神科访谈智能体的能力与局限。

title: MARS: Multi-resolution Adaptive Routing for Sequential Recommendation
summary: Long-history recommenders often compress each user's history into a compact, candidate-independent memory that is cached and reused to score large candidate pools. We show that real user histories exhibit multi-scale semantic structure, with short-lived intent, medium-term interests, and long-term preferences coexisting in one sequence, and that monolithic cached memories preserve these scales unevenly: linear probes recover recent and mid-range content far worse than long-range content. We call this failure mode \textit{temporal aliasing}. We propose \textbf{MARS}, a multi-resolution user memory that writes the full history into recurrent state tracks anchored to different half-lives, and a sparse routing reader that materializes compact seed memories by selecting the relevant temporal resolutions for each seed, preserving fixed-size candidate scoring. MARS outperforms strong baselines on three public datasets, with gains that grow with history length. Component-matched ablations with paired tests show that temporal diversity and selective routing each contribute beyond what hard-window memories or added capacity provide. The advantage of MARS over its interface-matched baseline also widens after within-user behavioral shifts, at about $1.02\times$ that baseline's warm-cache serving latency for $1{,}000$ candidates per user.

AI.tldr: 长历史推荐中，将用户历史压缩为单一缓存记忆会不均匀地保留多尺度语义（短期意图、中期兴趣、长期偏好），导致"时间混叠"问题；本文提出MARS多分辨率用户记忆，用不同半衰期的循环状态轨道写入全历史，并用稀疏路由读取器按种子选择时间分辨率，生成紧凑种子记忆，保持固定尺寸候选打分。
AI.motivation: 现有长历史推荐器通常把用户历史压缩为与候选无关的紧凑记忆并缓存复用，以对大规模候选项池打分。然而真实用户历史存在多尺度语义结构（短期意图、中期兴趣、长期偏好共存于同一序列），单一整体式缓存记忆对各尺度的保留并不均衡：线性探针恢复近期与中期内容的效果显著差于长期内容，作者将此失效模式称为"时间混叠"。
AI.method: 提出MARS，一种多分辨率用户记忆：将完整历史写入锚定于不同半衰期的循环状态轨道（recurrent state tracks），并设计稀疏路由读取器，为每个种子选择相关的时间分辨率以物化紧凑种子记忆，从而在保持固定尺寸候选打分的前提下实现多尺度记忆。
AI.result: MARS在三个公开数据集上优于强基线，且增益随历史长度增加而增大；组件匹配的消融与配对检验表明，时间多样性与选择性路由各自带来超越硬窗口记忆或单纯增加容量的收益；在用户内部行为转变后，MARS相对接口匹配基线的优势进一步扩大；服务延迟约为该基线热缓存延迟的1.02倍（每用户1000个候选）。
AI.conclusion: 将用户历史压缩为单一缓存记忆会产生时间混叠，无法均衡保留多尺度语义。MARS通过多分辨率状态轨道与稀疏路由读取器，在保持固定尺寸候选打分与近热缓存延迟的同时显著提升长历史推荐效果，且优势随历史长度与行为转变而增强。

title: From Local Evidence to Safety Verdicts: Causal Tracing in Vision-Language Models
summary: A vision-language model may need to combine an image with a prompt to recognize a safety risk that neither reveals alone. Where does this joint safety judgment become accessible inside the model? We introduce SSU-Bench, a dataset of matched safe and unsafe image-text combinations constructed using single-item prompt edits or image edits with annotated intended regions. Using three vision-language models, we transfer internal states between paired inputs and measure the resulting change in the safety verdict. Across models and both types of counterfactual, interventions at the changed input positions are effective in earlier decoder layers, while interventions at the final input token become effective later. Directions estimated from other examples produce similar late-layer effects. A linear readout of the final-token state also predicts the model's own verdict, including incorrect judgments, and cross-model comparisons reveal similarities in the patterns of counterfactual change. These findings identify a recurring transition in where interventions can influence a joint safety verdict and distinguish a readable model decision from a correct safety judgment.

AI.tldr: 论文提出SSU-Bench数据集（配对的安全/不安全图文组合），通过内部状态迁移实验定位视觉语言模型中联合安全判断的可干预位置，发现"变更输入位置"的干预在较浅解码层有效、最终输入token的干预在较深层有效，并区分了"可读的模型决策"与"正确的安全判断"。
AI.motivation: 单模态信息本身无害（或不显风险），风险只在图像与文本联合时显现，因此模型必须在融合后进行计算判断。作者关心这一"联合安全判断"在模型内部何处变得可访问、可干预，并希望厘清模型内部决策读数与真实安全判断之间的区别。
AI.method: 构建SSU-Bench：通过单项提示编辑或图像编辑（附标注的预期区域）生成配对的安全/不安全图文样本。在三个视觉语言模型上，对配对输入之间进行内部状态迁移（激活替换/干预），测量安全结论的变化；并做跨样本方向估计、最终token状态的线性探针读数、以及跨模型对比。
AI.result: 在两类反事实与各模型上，针对"被改变输入位置"的干预在较早解码层有效；针对最终输入token的干预则在较晚层才有效。由其他样本估计的方向产生类似的晚期层效应；最终token状态的线性读出可预测模型自身的判定（含错误判定）；跨模型比较显示反事实变化模式具有相似性。
AI.conclusion: 联合安全判断存在一个跨模型反复出现的"层间转折点"：干预有效位置从浅层（变更位置）转向深层（最终token）。同时，可线性读出的模型决策并不等同于正确的安全判断，二者需加以区分。

title: Grounding What Shapes the Plan: Rethinking Groundedness for Physical Intelligence in Autonomous Driving
summary: Driving models increasingly ground reasoning in causal relations, spatial structure, perceptual evidence, and predicted futures. These advances make reasoning more faithful to the driving scene, but leave a fundamental question unresolved: what should groundedness mean when the model ultimately outputs an action? Correctly grounded reasoning does not, by itself, ensure desirable driving outcomes. We introduce GroundAct, which starts from a simple premise: driving unfolds through physical entities and their interactions. Entities therefore become the unit of grounding; a lightweight reference token keeps each selected entity's continuous state addressable through symbolic reasoning; and only the referenced entities' interactions with the evolving proposal correct the plan. The result is an explicit path from what reasoning grounds to what the plan does, which we call grounded planning. To assess its practical value, we evaluate GroundAct in both open- and closed-loop settings. GroundAct shows strong open-loop planning across normal, out-of-distribution, and safety-critical scenarios, with closed-loop results extending this evidence to driving in simulation.

AI.tldr: GroundAct提出以物理实体作为grounding单元，通过轻量reference token保持实体连续状态在符号推理中可寻址，仅用被引用实体与演化proposal的交互修正规划，形成从推理依据到规划动作的显式"grounded planning"路径，在开环与闭环评测中验证其规划有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有驾驶模型将推理建立在因果、空间结构、感知证据和未来预测上，使推理更贴合场景，但未解决一个根本问题：当模型最终输出动作时，groundedness应意味着什么。推理grounded正确并不自动保证驾驶结果理想，需要建立从推理依据到规划动作的可控显式路径。
AI.method: 以物理实体及其交互为出发点，将实体设为grounding单元；使用轻量reference token在符号推理过程中保持每个被选实体的连续状态可寻址；仅让被引用实体与不断演化的proposal进行交互来修正规划，从而形成显式的grounded planning机制。
AI.result: 在开环与闭环设置下评测，GroundAct在正常、分布外与安全关键场景中均展现较强的开环规划能力；闭环仿真驾驶结果进一步支持了该方法的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 以实体为单元、通过reference token连接符号推理与连续状态、并以实体交互修正规划的grounded planning范式，能够将groundedness落实到规划动作层面，在多种场景及闭环仿真中均具备实用价值。

title: A Systematic Investigation of Bias in Large Language Models for Advertising Relevance
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to judge how well an advertisement matches a query, but the fairness of these judgments has received limited attention. We conduct a systematic study of fairness in relevance judgments made by LLMs for queries and advertisements. Our counterfactual framework examines the effects of advertiser identity and possible popularity, input language, and demographic wording. We study GPT-4o as a categorical relevance judge and a Qwen-7B model trained specifically for relevance prediction. The advertiser and language experiments use query and advertisement pairs sampled from real advertising logs. Controlled synthetic queries are used to study demographic associations in employment, housing, and credit. For both models, changing the advertiser identity or input language can alter the relevance assessment. Selected demographic comparisons also show patterns consistent with common stereotypes, particularly those involving gender and occupation. We further study mitigation during model inference and training. The results indicate that its effectiveness depends on whether advertiser information is relevant to the query and how advertiser labels are distributed in the training data. These findings can help advertising practitioners identify fairness risks and develop suitable mitigation methods for LLM relevance systems.

AI.tldr: 本文系统研究了LLM在广告相关性判断中的公平性问题，通过反事实框架考察广告商身份、流行度、输入语言与人口统计措辞对相关性评分的影响，并探讨推理与训练阶段的缓解方法。
AI.motivation: LLM被越来越多用于评估广告与查询的匹配度，但其判断的公平性受到的关注有限，广告从业者需要识别相关公平性风险。
AI.method: 构建反事实框架，考察广告商身份与流行度、输入语言、人口统计措辞四类因素；研究对象为作为分类相关性评判者的GPT-4o，以及专门为相关性预测训练的Qwen-7B模型。广告商与语言实验使用来自真实广告日志的查询-广告对；人口统计关联实验使用在就业、住房和信贷领域构造的受控合成查询。同时在模型推理和训练阶段研究缓解方法。
AI.result: 对两个模型而言，改变广告商身份或输入语言均会改变相关性评估结果；部分人口统计比较呈现出与常见刻板印象一致的模式，尤其是涉及性别与职业的比较。缓解方法的效果取决于广告商信息是否与查询相关，以及训练数据中广告商标签的分布情况。
AI.conclusion: LLM相关性判断存在可测量的公平性风险，其缓解需结合广告商信息与查询的相关性及训练数据中标签分布来设计；研究结论有助于广告从业者识别公平性风险并制定合适的缓解策略。

title: Decoupled Multi-Agent Orchestration
summary: Learned orchestration can automatically construct effective language-model multi-agent systems, but existing approaches couple planning to fixed worker pools and train decomposition and collaboration from the same terminal outcome, limiting transfer and obscuring credit assignment. We introduce DeOrch, which separates worker-agnostic planning from concrete worker selection. Its two-stage planner first decomposes the task without worker information, then chooses collaboration operations using compact, worker-identity-free matchability feedback from the pool, enabling conditional credit assignment to decomposition and collaboration decisions. A lightweight matcher estimates worker suitability from behavior on a fixed probe set and adapts online with a contextual bandit, allowing new workers to be incorporated without retraining the planner or matcher. Across diverse in- and out-of-distribution tasks, DeOrch outperforms prior automatic MAS orchestration methods with fewer worker calls than competing learned orchestrators, remains effective when transferred to an entirely unseen worker pool without retraining, and shows consistent gains from both components.

AI.tldr: DeOrch提出一种解耦式的多智能体编排框架，将"与worker无关的任务规划"与"具体worker选择"分离，通过两阶段规划器与轻量级matcher实现条件化信用分配，并可无需重训练地适配全新worker池。
AI.motivation: 现有多智能体系统（MAS）编排方法将规划与固定worker池耦合，且用同一终端结果同时训练任务分解与协作决策，导致迁移性差、信用分配不清晰。
AI.method: DeOrch将worker无关规划与具体worker选择解耦：两阶段规划器先在不依赖worker信息下分解任务，再基于池中紧凑的、不含worker身份的可匹配性反馈选择协作操作，从而实现条件化信用分配；另有轻量matcher通过固定探针集上的行为估计worker适配度，并用上下文bandit在线自适应，支持新增worker无需重训练规划器或matcher。
AI.result: 在多样化的分布内与分布外任务上，DeOrch优于既有自动MAS编排方法，且worker调用次数少于对比的学习式编排器；迁移到完全未见过的worker池且不重训练时仍保持有效；两个组件均带来一致增益。
AI.conclusion: 通过解耦规划与worker选择并引入条件化信用分配，DeOrch在性能、调用效率与跨worker池迁移能力上均取得优势，验证了该设计范式的有效性。

title: Navigating Route Latent Space for Synthesizable Molecular Design
summary: Goal-directed molecular design has advanced rapidly, yet a substantial proportion of designed molecules remain difficult to synthesize in practice, limiting their real-world utility. Prior synthesizability-aware methods either project generated molecules back to synthesizable analogs that deviate from the intended target, or optimize directly in discrete synthesis spaces that lack a continuous landscape for efficient search. We argue that this limitation mainly comes from the search space rather than the optimizer. To address this, we propose RouteFlow, a framework that reformulates synthesizable molecular design as a search over a continuous route latent space, where each latent maps back to a complete synthesis route and synthesizability is inherently preserved. To navigate this space, we adopt reward-guided flow matching as an efficient sampler that steers toward high-property regions. Since reward optimization may push latents off the manifold of real synthesis routes, where decoding becomes unreliable, we further introduce a cycle-consistency mechanism to stabilize fine-tuning. Across 16 optimization tasks from Therapeutic Data Commons, RouteFlow achieves the best sample efficiency among synthesizability-aware baselines, with the best synthetic accessibility and the highest retrosynthesis success rate. Our results also confirm that the proposed cycle-consistency reliably keeps optimization on-manifold while improving target properties, supporting effective synthesizable molecular discovery.

AI.tldr: RouteFlow将可合成分子设计重构为在连续合成路线隐空间中的搜索，结合奖励引导的流匹配采样与循环一致性机制，在16个TDC任务上实现了最佳样本效率和最高的逆合成成功率。
AI.motivation: 现有可合成性感知方法存在两难：将生成分子投影回可合成的类似物会偏离目标分子；而在离散合成空间中直接优化又缺乏连续景观，搜索效率低。作者认为该瓶颈主要来源于搜索空间而非优化器。
AI.method: 提出RouteFlow框架，在连续的"路线隐空间"（route latent space）中进行搜索，每个隐变量可解码为一条完整合成路线，从而天然保持可合成性；采用奖励引导的流匹配（reward-guided flow matching）作为高效采样器引导向高性质区域；并引入循环一致性（cycle-consistency）机制稳定微调，防止优化将隐变量推离真实合成路线流形导致解码不可靠。
AI.result: 在Therapeutic Data Commons的16个优化任务上，RouteFlow在可合成性感知基线中取得最佳样本效率，同时具有最佳合成可及性和最高逆合成成功率；循环一致性机制能可靠地保持优化在流形上并提升目标性质。
AI.conclusion: 以连续合成路线隐空间替代离散合成空间或投影修正，是解决可合成分子设计的有效途径，支持高效、可合成的分子发现。

title: Unanimously Wrong: Certified Abstention from How Medical LLM Consensus Forms
comment: Accepted at the GenAI4Health Workshop at NeurIPS 2026
summary: In clinical practice, agreement among independent experts is treated as evidence of reliability, and multi-round consensus has become a core mechanism of agentic medical question-answering systems. When such a system must decide whether to trust its own answer, the prevailing signal is again agreement, now among the sampled answers. But agreement is a fragile proxy for correctness. A system can be unanimously wrong, returning the same incorrect answer on every sample, and on these questions agreement-based signals carry no information. The cause is that these signals read only the final state of the consensus and discard how it was reached. Agreement that was reached by resolving disagreement with evidence looks identical, at the end, to agreement that was present from the first sample because every sample shares one misconception. ProbeGuard is a certified abstention framework that bases the abstention decision on how the consensus formed. Process features trace agreement trajectories, minority persistence, and retrieval saturation. For unanimous votes, rationale semantic entropy checks whether the reasons behind the vote cohere, and an active probe retrieves counter-evidence and measures whether the consensus survives. A stratified Learn-then-Test calibration then converts these scores into a distribution-free bound on selective risk. We evaluate ProbeGuard on three medical QA benchmarks and a hard-frontier reference, with a published multi-round agentic RAG substrate, against six abstention baselines. On MedQA, 13.4% of unanimous votes are wrong, and no agreement-based signal can flag them. Process signals raise the discrimination of correct from incorrect consensus from chance to 0.696 AUROC. The certified rule answers six in ten unanimous-layer questions at an observed selective risk of 9.0%, and nine in ten once in-domain calibration data accumulate.

AI.tldr: ProbeGuard：一个基于"共识如何形成"的认证式弃权框架，用于医疗问答智能体系统，突破了一致性信号无法识别"全体一致却错误"的盲区。
AI.motivation: 在智能体医疗问答系统中，一致性（专家间一致、多轮共识、多次采样答案一致）被当作可靠性证据。但一致性是正确性的脆弱代理：系统可能"全体一致地错误"，此时基于一致性的信号完全无信息量。根因在于这类信号只读取共识的最终状态，丢弃了共识达成的过程——通过证据解决分歧而形成的共识，与因所有样本共享同一误解而从一开始就存在的一致性，在末端表现完全相同。
AI.method: ProbeGuard 将弃权决策建立在共识形成过程之上：1）过程特征追踪一致性轨迹、少数意见持续性与检索饱和度；2）对全票一致者，用理由语义熵检验投票背后理由是否自洽；3）主动探针检索反证并测量共识是否存续；4）分层 Learn-then-Test 校准将得分转化为对选择性风险的免分布界。
AI.result: 在三个医疗QA基准及一个困难前沿参照上，基于已发表的多轮智能体RAG底座，对比六个弃权基线：MedQA上13.4%的全票一致答案是错误的，且无任何基于一致性的信号能将其标记；过程信号将正确与错误共识的区分度从随机水平提升至0.696 AUROC。认证规则在观察到的选择性风险9.0%下回答十分之六的全票一致层问题，当域内校准数据积累后提升至十分之九。
AI.conclusion: 仅依赖一致性判断可信度存在结构性盲区，而基于共识形成过程的信号可有效识别"全体一致却错误"的样本，并通过认证式弃权在可控选择性风险下显著提高回答覆盖率，为医疗问答智能体提供可靠的不确定性判别机制。

title: Cooperating with Future Collaborators: Multi-Agent RL under Staggered Participation
summary: In cooperative Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning (MARL), agents are often trained under concurrent participation, while in many tasks some agents act earlier and leave task-relevant information that becomes useful to agents participating later. We study this setting as staggered participation (SP), which introduces a cross-time, cross-agent learning dependency because an early action may affect the return through the information it provides and the later policy that uses it. Learning under SP therefore requires both identifying what information is useful for future decisions and learning how later agents should use it. We propose Staggered Participation Learning (SPL), a training-time augmentation that addresses these two parts with prospective acquisition supervision for earlier agents and outcome-supervised receiver learning for later agents. We evaluate SPL across multiple policy-based MARL backbones, environments, and staggered-participation patterns. Across 60 MPE/RWARE backbone setting comparisons, SPL achieves higher observed mean task completion in every case, with an average difference of 14.1%. The gains also extend to eight-agent teams and a physics-based UAV-UGV environment in Isaac Lab, providing evidence across algorithmic, temporal, and embodied settings.

AI.tldr: 本文研究协同多智能体强化学习中的"错峰参与(SP)"场景：部分智能体先行动并留下对后续智能体有用的信息。作者提出SPL训练期增强方法，通过前瞻性获取监督与结果监督的接收者学习分别训练早期与后期智能体，在60组MPE/RWARE对比中平均提升14.1%，并扩展至八智能体和Isaac Lab具身环境。
AI.motivation: 传统协同MARL假设智能体同时参与训练，但许多任务中智能体错峰行动：早期智能体的动作会通过其遗留的任务相关信息影响后期智能体的决策与回报，形成跨时间、跨智能体的学习依赖。该场景下需同时识别对后续决策有用的信息，并教会后期智能体如何利用这些信息，现有方法未针对性处理。
AI.method: 提出错峰参与学习(SPL)，一种训练期增强方法，包含两部分：面向早期智能体的前瞻性获取监督(prospective acquisition supervision)，引导其产生对后期有用的信息；面向后期智能体的结果监督接收者学习(outcome-supervised receiver learning)，使其学会利用接收到的信息。方法可叠加于多种基于策略的MARL骨干之上。
AI.result: 在多种基于策略的MARL骨干、环境及错峰参与模式下评估。60组MPE/RWARE骨干设置对比中，SPL在每一组均取得更高的观测平均任务完成度，平均差异达14.1%。增益同样体现在八智能体团队以及Isaac Lab中基于物理的UAV-UGV环境，验证了算法层面、时间层面与具身层面的有效性。
AI.conclusion: SPL为错峰参与这一跨时间、跨智能体依赖的MARL设定提供了有效训练方案，在多种骨干、任务模式与具身环境中一致提升任务完成度，表明该方法具有较好的通用性与可扩展性。

title: Representation Bias, Correction Transfer, and Resolution Sensitivity in Three-Dimensional Mitochondrial Morphometry
summary: Quantitative imaging pipelines can produce precise but systematically different measurements of the same object. We present an empirical reliability assessment of three-dimensional mitochondrial morphometry that connects representation bias, a controlled processing intervention, correction transfer, and resolution sensitivity. Using 2,720 development objects from the 3D Mitochondria Shape Library for Optical Microscopy, we find that occupancy-derived volumes exceed reference mesh volumes by 3.665% on average despite an intraclass correlation coefficient of 0.994. Boundary analysis identifies an outward label displacement of 0.00304 normalized units. In a controlled label-pipeline reimplementation, removing the depth offset reduces volume error in all 55 analyzed objects by a mean of 1.57 percentage points, approximately 45% of mean reproduced inflation; the source of the remainder is not isolated. A frozen regression using occupancy-derived features reduces median absolute percentage error from 3.481% to 0.664% in 2,728 previously unused objects from the same resource. However, its calibrated error bound covers only 92.1% overall and 49.2% in a low-occupancy subgroup, demonstrating that accuracy and uncertainty transfer must be evaluated separately. In 550 rat-cortex objects from the MitoEM resource, coarsening in-plane spacing from 8 to 24 nanometers changes median surface area by minus 10.60% and sphericity by plus 11.76%, despite a rank correlation of 0.994. These results provide quantitative checks for distinguishing processing-induced descriptor changes from candidate biological differences, without establishing biological invariance or cross-source correction transfer.

AI.tldr: 该研究对三维线粒体形态计量进行经验性可靠性评估，揭示占用体积比参考网格体积平均高3.665%，并通过校正回归与分辨率敏感性分析说明准确度与不确定性迁移需分别评估。
AI.motivation: 定量成像流程能对同一物体产生精确但系统性不同的测量结果，因此需要区分处理引入的描述符变化与潜在的生物学差异，评估表示偏差、处理干预、校正迁移和分辨率敏感性等环节的可靠性。
AI.method: 使用3D Mitochondria Shape Library for Optical Microscopy的2,720个发育对象进行三维线粒体形态计量；开展边界分析、受控标签-流程重实现（去除深度偏移）；对2,728个未使用对象训练冻结回归并用占用特征校正；在MitoEM的550个鼠皮层对象中把面内间距从8纳米粗化至24纳米。
AI.result: 占用派生体积平均超出参考网格体积3.665%，但组内相关系数达0.994；标签向外位移0.00304归一化单位。去除深度偏移使55个对象体积误差平均降低1.57个百分点，约为再现膨胀均值的45%，其余来源未分离。冻结回归将中位绝对百分比误差从3.481%降至0.664%，但校准误差界仅覆盖总体92.1%、低占用子组49.2%。面内间距粗化使中位表面积变化-10.60%、球形度+11.76%，秩相关仍为0.994。
AI.conclusion: 该工作提供了量化检查方法，用于区分处理诱导的描述符变化与候选生物学差异，但未建立生物学不变性或跨来源校正迁移。

title: LSC-DPO: Learning-Signal-Controlled Direct Preference Optimization
summary: Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) has become a standard reward-model-free approach for aligning language models with preference data. However, as the scaled preference margin grows during training, the logistic DPO loss becomes progressively less sensitive to further changes. We study DPO from a loss-level geometric perspective and identify the sigmoid factor as a learning signal that characterizes the local sensitivity of the objective. Based on this view, we propose Learning-Signal-Controlled Direct Preference Optimization (LSC-DPO), which dynamically regulates the learning signal near a target regime. A log-space analysis establishes conditions for stable tracking of the target learning-signal regime. Experiments on AlpacaEval 2, MT-Bench, and Anthropic-HH show that LSC-DPO consistently improves over DPO and strong preference-optimization baselines. We further find that different coefficient initializations induce distinct transient learning-signal trajectories even when their later signal levels become similar. Based on this observation, we derive a signal-budget compensation rule that adjusts the target learning signal to compensate for these transient differences. The resulting compensation substantially reduces performance variation across coefficient initializations.

AI.tldr: 本文从损失层面的几何视角研究DPO，将sigmoid因子视为刻画目标局部敏感性的"学习信号"，提出LSC-DPO动态调控该信号至目标区间，并推导信号预算补偿规则以降低系数初始化带来的性能波动。
AI.motivation: DPO已成为语言模型偏好对齐的标准无奖励模型方法，但训练中偏好边际（preference margin）不断增大，导致logistic损失对后续变化越来越不敏感，学习信号逐渐衰减。作者希望从损失几何层面理解并缓解这一信号饱和问题。
AI.method: 1）从损失级几何视角分析DPO，将sigmoid因子识别为表征目标局部敏感性的学习信号；2）提出LSC-DPO，将学习信号动态调节至目标区间；3）通过对数空间分析建立稳定跟踪目标学习信号区间的条件；4）观察到不同系数初始化会产生不同的瞬态学习信号轨迹（即使后期信号水平相近），据此推导信号预算补偿规则，调整目标学习信号以补偿瞬态差异。
AI.result: 在AlpacaEval 2、MT-Bench和Anthropic-HH上，LSC-DPO持续优于DPO及强偏好优化基线。信号预算补偿规则显著降低了不同系数初始化之间的性能波动。
AI.conclusion: 将DPO的sigmoid因子视为可控学习信号，为理解并改进偏好优化提供了有效的损失级几何框架；动态信号调控与瞬态补偿能同时提升性能并增强对超参数初始化的鲁棒性。

title: Beyond Scalar IoU: Structured Verification from Rollout Groups for Video Temporal Grounding
summary: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) provides a natural framework for adapting pretrained models to video temporal grounding, where generated temporal intervals can be scored directly against ground truth intervals. Yet existing overlap verifiers typically score each rollout independently, leaving the joint structure of the rollout group unused. We introduce SUTURE, which conditions verification on the rollout group and exploits its structure at two complementary scales: disagreement across rollouts controls how strongly the target is reweighted, while coverage at each position determines where reward mass is redistributed. We show that the resulting verifier admits an exact decomposition into the standard IoU term and a covariance correction determined by the rollout group. A local gradient diagnostic finds a preference for responses covering relatively less supported target regions in the analyzed groups. Across five temporal grounding benchmarks, SUTURE improves grounding performance at every reported IoU threshold. Its trained policy also shows less video-start anchoring in reasoning traces: for later events, the first temporal mention more often overlaps the annotated target. Together, these results show that the joint structure of a rollout group can support a more informative temporal verifier.

AI.tldr: 提出 SUTURE，一种在视频时序定位 RLVR 中基于 rollout 组结构进行条件化验证的奖励方法，可分解为 IoU 项与协方差修正项。
AI.motivation: 现有基于重叠度（IoU）的可验证奖励对每个 rollout 独立打分，忽略了同一 rollout 组的联合结构，导致奖励信号信息量受限。
AI.method: 将验证条件化于 rollout 组，在两个尺度上利用其结构：组内分歧度控制目标的重加权强度，各位置的覆盖率决定奖励质量的再分配；理论证明该验证器可精确分解为标准 IoU 项加上由 rollout 组决定的协方差修正项，并用局部梯度诊断分析其偏好。
AI.result: 在五个时序定位基准上，SUTURE 在所有报告的 IoU 阈值上均提升定位性能；训练的推理轨迹中视频起始锚定（video-start anchoring）减少，对于较晚事件，首个时序提及更常与标注目标重叠。
AI.conclusion: rollout 组的联合结构可为时序验证器提供更具信息量的奖励信号，从而改进视频时序定位的强化学习训练。

title: VALSE: Vertical Adaptive Layer Skipping for Efficient Inference in Large Language Models
summary: This paper establishes a theoretical framework for vertical adaptive layer skipping, proving three foundational results: (i) an Expected FLOPs formula (theorem 2) giving a closed-form expression for the computational cost of arbitrary per-sample skip schedules as a function of layer-wise skip probabilities; (ii) function-space superset (theorem 10) and strict inclusion (theorem 11) theorems showing that skip-layer models are strictly contained in---yet meaningfully approximate---the full-layer function space, with an explicit separating example; and (iii) a structural duality between VALSE and Mixture-of-Experts architectures (proposition 6), positioning vertical depth-wise sparsity as the orthogonal counterpart to horizontal width-wise sparsity. Building on this theory, we propose VALSE (Vertical Adaptive Layer Skipping for Efficiency), a per-sample, non-contiguous layer skipping method: a lightweight difficulty estimator scores each input from the first few layers, and per-layer gates selectively skip redundant layers---including arbitrary middle layers while retaining deeper ones---so that only the necessary depth is activated for each input, whose feasibility is preliminarily assessed at prototype scale.

AI.tldr: 本文为垂直自适应层跳过（VALSE）建立理论框架，证明关于计算成本、函数空间包含关系及与MoE结构对偶的三个基础性结论，并提出一种按样本、非连续的层跳过方法。
AI.motivation: 为"按样本跳过冗余层"这一垂直深度方向稀疏化范式提供理论支撑，明确其计算成本可解析表达、与全层模型函数空间的关系，以及与水平宽度方向稀疏（MoE）的对应关系，从而推动高效推理方法的设计。
AI.method: 理论层面：(i) 定理2给出任意逐样本跳层调度的期望FLOPs闭式公式，以逐层跳过概率为自变量；(ii) 定理10、11给出函数空间超集与严格包含结论，并用显式分离例子说明跳层模型严格包含于全层函数空间但可有效逼近；(iii) 命题6揭示VALSE与MoE的结构对偶性。方法层面：提出VALSE，用轻量难度估计器基于前几层为每个输入打分，配合逐层门控选择性跳过冗余层（含任意中间层而保留更深层），仅激活所需深度。
AI.result: 获得三项理论结果：期望FLOPs闭式表达式、跳层模型相对全层模型的函数空间严格包含与逼近关系（含分离例子），以及VALSE与MoE在垂直/水平稀疏上的结构对偶；VALSE方法在原型规模上初步验证了可行性。
AI.conclusion: 垂直深度稀疏可作为水平宽度稀疏（MoE）的正交对应物，VALSE在理论与初步实验上均具备可行性，为逐样本非连续跳层的高效推理奠定基础。

title: BioStudyBench: Evaluating Agents on Post-Cutoff Biomedical Studies
summary: We evaluate whether AI agents can match the reported findings of published biomedical studies using public data. Existing evaluations do not consistently separate analysis from prior knowledge or retrieval of the published answer. We introduce BioStudyBench, a benchmark of 25 long-horizon analysis tasks drawn from studies first published between July and September 2026, after the developer-reported knowledge cutoffs of the models we evaluate, semi-automatically filtered down from 404,019 PubMed records. In each task, the agent receives a neutral research question but no data files, so it must find and download the relevant public data, search the literature through tools that return only records dated before its cutoff, and report findings through data analysis. To measure gains over prior knowledge, we run every task both with and without access to data and tools. Across eight models, access to data and tools raises the pass rate by 47 percentage points on average over the no-data baseline. Open-weight models across sizes trail closed-weight models, with the best open-weight model passing 81.3% of tasks against 94.7% for the best closed-weight model.

AI.tldr: 提出 BioStudyBench 基准，评估 AI 智能体能否仅凭中立问题、通过自主检索公共数据与分析来复现已发表生物医学研究的结论，以剥离先验知识与答案检索的影响。
AI.motivation: 已有评测未能把"数据分析能力"与"模型先验知识或对已发表答案的检索"清晰区分开，导致对 AI 智能体真实科研分析能力的评估被高估。
AI.method: 构建含 25 个长程（long-horizon）分析任务的基准，任务取自 2026 年 7—9 月首次发表的研究，晚于所评模型的开发者报告知识截止时间，由 404,019 条 PubMed 记录半自动筛选而来。任务仅给出中立研究问题、不提供数据文件；智能体须自行检索并下载相关公开数据，通过仅返回其截止日期之前记录的文献工具进行检索，并以数据分析方式报告结论。为量化相对先验知识的增益，每个任务分别在"有数据与工具"和"无数据与工具"两种条件下运行。
AI.result: 在八个模型上，相比无数据基线，提供数据与工具平均使通过率提升 47 个百分点；开源权重模型随规模增大仍落后于闭源模型，最佳开源权重模型通过率 81.3%，最佳闭源模型为 94.7%。
AI.conclusion: 数据与工具的可及性是 AI 智能体复现生物医学研究发现的关键增益来源，当前开源权重模型与闭源模型之间仍存在明显能力差距。

title: Learning to Outgrow a Theory: Experimental Discovery Beyond the Initial Hypothesis Space
summary: Scientific discovery systems typically optimize experiments within a fixed hypothesis space. This creates a failure mode when all available candidates omit the same missing mechanism: candidate disagreement can collapse even while the model class is systematically wrong. We formulate experimental model-class revision, in which a discovery policy jointly proposes a structural edit and a diagnostic experiment that tests whether that edit is necessary. The method couples a class-level distinguishability objective, in which one shared parameterization must explain all selected experiments, with anytime-valid sequential evidence that triggers structural revision only after the current class is rejected. On 400 held-out controlled dynamical environments, the joint policy reaches 89.5% exact recovery with a budget of 32 real experiments, improving the strongest matched baseline by 10.0 percentage points while requiring fewer executed experiments and candidate fits. The learned revision-experiment pairing transfers across unseen mechanism combinations, held-out but expressible primitives, parameter extrapolation, and shifted experiment costs; when the true mechanism is outside the edit grammar, it detects library insufficiency in 88% of cases with a 5.5% false-support rate. Revision gains also transfer to ODEBench and ODEBase model-library tasks, as well as DiscoverPhysics worlds. These results support a view of scientific discovery in which deciding what mechanisms a theory should make expressible and where to collect evidence are treated as a single sequential decision problem.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出"实验性模型类修正"问题：发现策略联合提出结构编辑与诊断实验，通过类级可区分性目标与随时有效的序贯证据触发结构修正，在400个受控动力环境上以32次实验达89.5%精确恢复率，超越最强基线10个百分点，并具备良好的迁移能力。
AI.motivation: 传统科学发现系统在固定假设空间内优化实验，存在系统性失效模式：当所有候选都遗漏同一缺失机制时，候选间分歧会坍缩，即便模型类整体错误也无法察觉。因此需要将"理论应使哪些机制可表达"与"在何处采集证据"统一为一个序贯决策问题。
AI.method: 将问题形式化为实验性模型类修正：发现策略联合提出结构编辑与检验该编辑是否必要的诊断实验。方法耦合两个要素：（1）类级可区分性目标，要求单一共享参数化能解释所有选定实验；（2）随时有效的序贯证据，仅在当前模型类被拒绝后才触发结构修正。
AI.result: 在400个留出受控动力环境上，联合策略以32次真实实验预算达89.5%精确恢复率，较最强匹配基线提升10.0个百分点，且所需执行实验与候选拟合更少。学到的"修正—实验"配对可迁移至未见机制组合、留出但可表达的基元、参数外推及实验成本偏移；当真实机制超出编辑语法时，88%情形能检测出库不足，假支持率5.5%。修正增益亦迁移至ODEBench、ODEBase模型库任务及DiscoverPhysics世界。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持一种科学发现视角：决定理论应使哪些机制可表达，与决定在何处采集证据，应被视为单一序贯决策问题，从而避免固定假设空间下的系统性失效。

title: Measuring climate backlash in Twitter and Reddit archives: Lexical definitions, recorded responses and participant turnover
summary: Social media archives are often used to study resistance to climate action, but words, response counters and observed participants do not measure the same social process. We examine four supplied Twitter and Reddit archives by processing all registered files without sampling and applying transparent, non-exclusive lexical rules. The study links frame co-occurrence to source-specific temporal and response models, then separates event-period changes among returning authors from participant turnover. Renewable-energy terms accompany cost-related language on Reddit, yet narrower backlash phrases sharply reduce cross-source contrasts and reverse the sign of the Paris Agreement contrast in submissions. Cross-discourse history does not improve eligible primary-context forecasts. Denial/hoax terms are associated with higher recorded Twitter likes, whereas Reddit response associations depend on frame, outcome and author specification. Around the 2019 global climate strike, returning-author expression and participant turnover both contribute to increased protest-language shares. An archive endpoint prevents the corresponding Climate Twitter migration inference. Most crossed-cluster estimates lack released intervals, and joint author/month response covariance estimates fail, restricting formal inference. These results show how operational definitions, platform-specific response fields and observation boundaries shape what can be claimed about climate backlash. The contribution is an archive-based account of these measurement consequences, rather than a measure of individual opposition, persuasion or advocacy-induced backlash.

AI.tldr: 通过对四个Twitter与Reddit气候相关档案进行全量、无抽样的词法规则分析，论文揭示了操作定义、平台响应字段与观测边界如何塑造关于气候"抵制"（backlash）的可推断结论。
AI.motivation: 社交媒体档案常被用来研究对气候行动的抵制，但词频、回应计数与观测到的参与者并非衡量同一社会过程；作者希望厘清这些测量差异对研究结论的影响。
AI.method: 全量处理四个已发布的Twitter与Reddit档案（不抽样），应用透明且非排他的词法规则；将框架共现与来源特定的时间模型、响应模型相连接，并把事件期变化分解为"回访作者"与"参与者更替"两部分。
AI.result: Reddit上可再生能源术语与成本相关语言共现；较窄的抵制措辞显著削弱跨来源对比，并反转《巴黎协定》对比的符号。跨话语历史未提升合格主语境预测。否认/骗局术语与Twitter记录点赞更高相关，而Reddit响应关联取决于框架、结果与作者设定。2019年全球气候罢工前后，回访作者表达与参与者更替共同提高抗议语言份额。档案终点阻止了相应的Climate Twitter迁移推断；多数跨簇估计缺少已发布的区间，作者/月份联合响应协方差估计失败，限制了形式化推断。
AI.conclusion: 操作定义、平台特定响应字段与观测边界共同决定了关于气候抵制的可主张结论；本文贡献在于基于档案刻画这些测量后果，而非测量个体反对、说服或倡导引发的抵制本身。

title: Matching Object or Relation? Tracing Abstract Reasoning Inside VLMs
summary: Vision Language Models (VLMs) excel on visual benchmarks but fail systematically on tasks requiring abstract reasoning. Existing benchmarks document this failure but cannot say \emph{why} it happens or which cognitive capability is missing. We close this gap by adopting the Relational Match-to-Sample (RMTS) paradigm from comparative and developmental psychology and pairing it with a mechanistic analysis of the model's internals. On a parametrically controlled stimulus set evaluated across frontier API models (GPT, Claude, Gemini) and three open-source families (Qwen3.5, Gemma-4, InternVL3), we identify four levers that shift VLMs toward the relational match---capability tier, model scale, the number of objects per scene, and the absence of per-object stimulus noise---together producing a developmental-like trajectory that mirrors the human \emph{relational shift}. Opening up the model, a per-layer representational similarity analysis and a causal mediation analysis reveal that VLM abstract reasoning is implemented by two competing circuits: an early circuit that organises images by their surface object features, and a late circuit that organises them by their abstract relation. Extending the analysis to ARC-AGI-1, we find that ablating the relational heads identified on RMTS degrades performance more than ablating random heads, indicating that the relational circuit is recruited beyond our controlled stimuli. We hope this mechanism-level view serves as a step toward understanding how abstract reasoning is implemented in VLMs.

AI.tldr: 该论文采用心理学中的关系匹配样本(RMTS)范式，结合机制可解释性分析，揭示视觉语言模型(VLM)抽象推理失败的原因，并发现其由早期"表面特征电路"与晚期"抽象关系电路"竞争实现。
AI.motivation: 现有基准虽记录了VLM在抽象推理任务上的系统性失败，但无法解释失败原因，也无法指出缺失的具体认知能力。作者希望填补这一从"现象描述"到"机制解释"的空白。
AI.method: 采用比较与发展心理学的关系匹配样本(RMTS)范式，构建参数化控制的刺激集，评测前沿API模型(GPT、Claude、Gemini)与三个开源模型族(Qwen3.5、Gemma-4、InternVL3)；通过逐层表征相似性分析(RSA)与因果中介分析(CMA)打开模型内部；并将分析扩展到ARC-AGI-1进行消融验证。
AI.result: 识别出四个影响VLM向关系匹配转变的杠杆：能力层级、模型规模、每场景物体数量、无逐物体刺激噪声，共同产生类似人类"关系转变"的发展轨迹。机制上发现两个竞争电路：早期电路按表面物体特征组织图像，晚期电路按抽象关系组织图像。在ARC-AGI-1上消融RMTS识别出的关系头，性能下降显著大于消融随机头。
AI.conclusion: VLM的抽象推理由早期表面特征电路与晚期关系电路的竞争实现；关系电路可迁移至受控刺激之外的任务，说明其并非任务特化。该机制层面的视角为理解VLM抽象推理的实现方式提供了基础。

title: Massive Activation Gating Channel in Large Language Models
summary: Massive activations, a phenomenon in which a small number of hidden channels exhibit exceptionally large magnitudes, are pervasive in large language models (LLMs). However, the mechanism by which a token develops massive activations as it propagates through a pretrained LLM remains poorly understood. In this paper, we find that the emergence of massive activations is controlled by a single channel in the input embedding to a spike feed-forward network (FFN). The position of this channel is fixed for a particular LLM. We name this channel the massive activation gating channel (MAGC). When the value of the MAGC is sufficiently large (or small, depending on the LLM), the output of the spike FFN exhibits massive activations. Examining six LLMs across four model families and different model sizes, we verify the existence and effect of MAGC. We further provide a theoretical explanation of the mechanism by which MAGC induces massive activations. When the value of MAGC is sufficiently large (or small), the output of a spike FFN asymptotically reduces to a quadratic form that mixes a few columns of the down-projection matrix of the FFN. Since these columns exhibit the shape of massive activations, the output therefore exhibits massive activations.

AI.tldr: 本文发现大语言模型中的"大规模激活"(massive activations)现象由尖峰FFN输入嵌入中的单一通道控制，称为MAGC，并给出理论解释。
AI.motivation: 大规模激活现象在LLM中普遍存在，但一个token在预训练LLM中传播时如何产生大规模激活的机制尚不清楚，本文旨在揭示这一机制。
AI.method: 作者定位到尖峰FFN输入嵌入中的单一通道（MAGC），其位置对特定LLM固定；通过在四个模型家族、不同规模的六个LLM上实验验证MAGC的存在及作用，并从理论上分析MAGC诱导大规模激活的机制。
AI.result: 当MAGC的值足够大（或足够小，取决于LLM）时，尖峰FFN的输出呈大规模激活；在六个LLM上验证了MAGC的存在和效果，并从理论上证明此时FFN输出渐近退化为混合FFN下投影矩阵若干列的二次形式，这些列具有大规模激活的形态，因而输出表现出大规模激活。
AI.conclusion: 大规模激活的产生由尖峰FFN输入嵌入中的单一固定通道MAGC控制，其机制可由FFN输出的二次形式渐近退化来解释。

title: EIO-Agents: The Missing Semantic Layer for AI Agent Evaluation
summary: AI agents are entering production in increasingly consequential environments without a shared semantic standard for what their evaluations actually mean. Scores, traces, judge outputs, and multi juror findings are increasingly used to justify readiness and release decisions, yet they often do not specify what evidence supports a claim, what that evidence can establish, or how the claim leads to a decision. We introduce EIO-Agents, an open specification for interoperable AI agent evaluation built on two layers. The Evaluation Intelligence Ontology (EIO) provides the semantic layer through typed evidence, versioned behavioral predicates, evidence contracts, claims, witness rules, proof status, recurrence, and computable derivations for metrics, findings, controls, and PASS, REVIEW, or BLOCK decisions. The Portable Evaluation Record (PER) provides the system of record: a canonical, content addressed representation of one evaluation that preserves the evidence to decision chain and can be re derived, explained, and verified. Scores summarize, juries interpret, and traces record, but none of them define what the evidence means or what it can prove. EIO provides that missing semantic contract, while PER preserves the resulting evaluation as a portable and verifiable system of record. As AI agents assume greater operational responsibility, evaluation must become more than a collection of scores and verdicts; it must become an accountable artifact whose meaning, evidence, limitations, and decisions can be independently checked.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 EIO-Agents 开放规范，通过评估智能本体（EIO）语义层与可移植评估记录（PER）系统记录层，为 AI 智能体评估建立可互操作的语义标准，使评估成为可独立核验的问责性制品。
AI.motivation: AI 智能体正进入高影响生产环境，但评估缺乏共享语义标准：分数、轨迹与评审输出常被用于支撑就绪与发布决策，却未说明证据支撑何种主张、证据能证明什么、主张如何导向决策。
AI.method: EIO-Agents 采用双层开放规范。语义层 EIO 提供类型化证据、带版本的行为谓词、证据契约、主张、见证规则、证明状态、复现与可计算推导，覆盖指标、发现、控制及 PASS/REVIEW/BLOCK 决策。记录层 PER 以内容寻址的规范化表示保存单次评估，保留“证据—决策”链条，并支持再推导、解释与验证。
AI.result: EIO 填补了语义契约的缺失，PER 将评估结果保存为可移植、可验证的系统记录，实现评估记录的再推导与独立核验。
AI.conclusion: 随着 AI 智能体承担更大运行责任，评估不应只是分数与裁决的集合，而应成为其含义、证据、局限与决策均可被独立检查的问责性制品。

title: BluffJAX: Adversarial Imperfect Information Games in JAX
summary: We introduce BluffJAX: an open-source suite of adversarial imperfect information games in JAX. We provide canonical implementations of games designed for high simulation throughputs and parallelization on GPU accelerators. Our suite consists of well-studied benchmarks such as Texas Hold'Em Poker and Kuhn Poker, as well as games that have not been previously studied in reinforcement learning research, such as Bluff, Stud Poker, and Kemps. We hope that implementing a variety of game mechanics and difficulties will introduce new challenges and foster novel research directions in game-theoretic methods for RL. We benchmark the throughput performance and memory usage of our environments in single and multi-GPU settings, demonstrating scaling of up to hundreds of millions of samples per second, and motivating the usage of BluffJAX over related GPU and CPU-based libraries. We benchmark reinforcement learning, tree search, and game-solving algorithms in JAX in order to provide users with baseline results and facilitate future comparisons.

AI.tldr: 本文提出BluffJAX——一个基于JAX的开源不完美信息对抗博弈环境套件，包含德州扑克、Kuhn扑克及Bluff、Stud Poker、Kemps等博弈，支持GPU并行高吞吐模拟，并给出RL、树搜索与博弈求解基准。
AI.motivation: 现有博弈论强化学习研究缺乏统一、高效的GPU并行不完美信息博弈环境，且被研究博弈种类有限，限制了对新博弈机制与难题的探索，需要一个高吞吐、易扩展的基准套件。
AI.method: 构建基于JAX的开源博弈套件，提供面向GPU加速器高模拟吞吐与并行化的规范化实现；涵盖经典基准（Texas Hold'Em、Kuhn Poker）及此前未被RL研究涉及的博弈（Bluff、Stud Poker、Kemps）；在单GPU与多GPU下测量吞吐与显存开销，并对RL、树搜索、博弈求解算法进行基准测试。
AI.result: 环境吞吐可达每秒数亿样本，并在单/多GPU下展现出良好扩展性；提供了RL、树搜索与博弈求解算法在JAX中的基线结果。
AI.conclusion: BluffJAX凭借高吞吐与多样化博弈机制，优于相关GPU/CPU库，可为博弈论RL方法提供新挑战与研究基准。

title: On the Boundary of Admission Gates: An Injected-Truth Study of Falsification-First Selection in Quantitative Strategy Research
comment: 12 pages, 3 figures, 7 tables. Code and data to reproduce every result: https://github.com/simplify23/quant-trading-agent
summary: Strategy research conflates two problems: finding a profitable rule, and establishing that the finding is not search luck. The latter calls for admission gates -- statistical criteria that must be satisfied before a conclusion is adopted -- yet whether gates work, and at what cost, remains untested. We introduce an injected-truth protocol with a random-admission control that adopts at the same rate as the gate; only if the gate beats this control does it carry information rather than merely raise a threshold. Across synthetic and real-calibrated panels, gates eliminate false discoveries in the weak-signal regime but cut adoption to 1--7%, and add nothing when signals are strong. Most importantly, criteria computed on absolute rather than excess returns silently reject every candidate, including true signals. Keywords: multiple testing, backtest overfitting, strategy admission, injected-truth validation, excess returns, false discovery rate

AI.tldr: 本文提出"注入真值"（injected-truth）验证协议，并配以与门控采纳率相同的随机采纳对照，系统检验策略筛选中的统计准入门的有效性与代价。
AI.motivation: 策略研究中混淆了两个问题：一是找到盈利规则，二是证明该发现并非搜索运气所致。后者需要统计准入标准（admission gates），但门控是否真正有效、代价多大，此前尚缺乏检验。
AI.method: 引入注入真值协议，设置随机准入对照（其采纳率与门控相同）；只有当门控表现优于该对照时，才说明其携带信息而非仅提高门槛。在合成数据与实盘校准面板上评估多种统计准则。
AI.result: 在弱信号情形下，门控可消除虚假发现，但采纳率降至1%–7%；在强信号情形下则无增益。最关键的是：基于绝对收益（而非超额收益）计算的准则会静默地拒绝所有候选策略，包括真实信号。
AI.conclusion: 统计准入门并非普遍有效：其价值高度依赖信号强度，且须以随机采纳为基线才能判断其信息含量；同时收益度量的选择（绝对vs.超额）会决定门控是过滤噪声还是误杀全部信号。

title: AgentMemGate: Addressing Speculation Contamination in Conversational Assistant Memory
comment: Accepted at the PALM Workshop at NeurIPS 2026. 15 pages, 4 figures
summary: Conversational AI assistants with long-term memory extract facts from user messages into a store consulted in later conversations. A stated plan can enter that store as fact: a user who might move to Seattle may be recorded as already living there. We call this speculation contamination. Final-state memory benchmarks miss this error because they do not probe intermediate state and include few unresolved speculations. We present AgentMemGate, a write-time gate for profile-store memory that classifies extracted statements as speculation, completed event, correction, or other. Speculations remain outside memory, with conditions governing later promotion or deletion. We also contribute a dataset of multi-session conversations in which plans are confirmed, abandoned, or left unresolved. On our 147-conversation held-out set, Mem0 and Graphiti assert unresolved plans as current state for 35.2% and 27.3% of pending plans. On the core benchmark, AgentMemGate eliminates all observed contamination relative to the identical ungated pipeline (87.5% to zero for the most exposed extraction style) and raises task accuracy from 65% to 95%. On the harder held-out set, gated contamination is 3.4% to 5.7% and task accuracy rises by 9 to 13 percentage points. Our analysis identifies field matching as the main remaining bottleneck: realistic speculations often match no profile field and never reach the gate. We release our datasets, prompts, and evaluation code.

AI.tldr: 提出 AgentMemGate 写入门控，将推测性陈述从长期记忆画像中拦截，显著降低"推测污染"并提升多轮任务准确率。
AI.motivation: 长期记忆型对话助手会把用户消息中的事实存入记忆库，供后续会话查询。但一个"计划"（如可能搬到西雅图）会被当作既成事实写入，形成推测污染。现有最终状态记忆评测无法捕捉该错误，因为不考察中间状态，且样本中未解决推测极少。
AI.method: 提出 AgentMemGate：在写时（write-time）对抽取语句进行四分类（推测、已完成事件、纠正、其他）；推测不进入记忆，而是保留在外部并附带条件，用于后续升级为事实或删除。同时构建多会话对话数据集，其中计划被确认、放弃或保持未决。
AI.result: 在 147 个对话的留出集上，Mem0 与 Graphiti 分别将 35.2% 和 27.3% 的未决计划断言为当前状态。核心基准上，AgentMemGate 相对同款无门控管线将污染从 87.5% 降至 0，任务准确率由 65% 升至 95%；较难的留出集上门控污染为 3.4%–5.7%，准确率提升 9–13 个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 写入门控能有效消除推测污染并提升多轮任务表现；主要剩余瓶颈是字段匹配——真实推测常无法匹配任何画像字段，从而绕过门控。作者开源数据集、提示词与评测代码。

title: Evidence Before Sampling: Interpretable Implicit Negative Candidate Discovery for Recommendation
summary: Recommender systems learn from observed user-item interactions, but explicit negative feedback is often unavailable. Since deep learning models require negative signals for training, negative sampling methods typically treat selected unobserved interactions as negatives. However, a missing interaction does not explain why a user is uninterested in an item or whether there is sufficient evidence to label it negative. This is especially important in business recommendation, where negative signals should be interpretable and aligned with business objectives. We formulate implicit negative candidate discovery to identify unobserved interactions supported by observed customer behavior. We encode these patterns as symbolic rules, score them based on support, informativeness, and product relevance, and rank the retained rules by evidence. An LLM then interprets the retained rules using business objectives and domain knowledge; the interpretations are combined with the statistical evidence in the final report. We evaluate our method in an industrial B2B setting and across five public recommendation datasets. Candidate-quality evaluations in the industrial setting and three public datasets show higher precision than the evaluated baselines, while symbolic selection improves downstream test PR-AUC by 12.5% over random selection with four negatives per positive example in the industrial task. Our results show that negative candidate validity can be evaluated separately from downstream recommendation performance. This distinction enables evidence-based, business-aligned, and explainable negative selection, improving both interpretability and model training in sparse, skewed, real-world recommendation settings.

AI.tldr: 提出隐式负候选发现任务，用符号规则识别有观测行为支撑的未交互负样本，并由LLM结合业务目标解读，提升B2B推荐中负采样精度与可解释性。
AI.motivation: 推荐系统依赖负信号训练，但显式负反馈缺失，负采样通常将随机未观测交互当作负样本。然而"未交互"无法解释用户为何不感兴趣，也缺乏足够证据判定其为负。业务推荐场景尤其需要负信号可解释且与业务目标一致。
AI.method: 将隐式负候选发现形式化为：从观测到的客户行为中挖掘模式，编码为符号规则；基于支持度、信息量与产品相关性对规则打分；按证据强度对保留规则排序；再用LLM结合业务目标与领域知识对规则进行解读，并将解读与统计证据合并成最终报告。
AI.result: 在工业B2B场景与五个公开推荐数据集上评估。工业场景及三个公开数据集的候选质量评估中，精度高于所比较的基线；在工业任务中，每正例四个负样本的设置下，符号选择使下游测试PR-AUC相比随机选择提升12.5%。
AI.conclusion: 负候选的有效性可与下游推荐性能分开评估。这一区分使负样本选择具备证据支撑、业务对齐与可解释性，在稀疏、偏斜的真实推荐场景中同时改善可解释性与模型训练。

title: PERSIST: Who-What-When Memory Across Sessions for Full-Duplex Spoken Dialogue
summary: Modern voice assistants may be shared by multiple users and should be able to answer questions about earlier conversations such as "When did I originally plan to leave?" or adapt their behavior to individual users based on past interactions. This requires more than retrieving a topically similar passage: the assistant must identify the current speaker, recover the relevant past state, and distinguish it from later revisions. We present PERSIST, a persistent memory system for multi-session, multi-speaker spoken dialogue that explicitly models Who, What, and When. PERSIST structures cross-session histories into readable event records and retrieves them with a 3W joint scoring mechanism that combines semantic content, acoustic speaker identity, and temporal state. For real-time full-duplex interaction, PERSIST further reuses intermediate representations from the dialogue backbone, avoiding query-audio re-encoding and reducing retrieval latency from 578.42 ms to 7.03 ms. We also introduce SpokenTrace, a diagnostic benchmark that factorizes evaluation along memory tasks and speaker-query types, exposing failures in recall, speaker attribution, and temporal-state tracking. On SpokenTrace, PERSIST achieves 85.08% end-to-end task accuracy and improves all-support EM@3 from 49.01% with BGE-large to 82.10%.

AI.tldr: PERSIST：面向多会话、多说话人语音对话的持久记忆系统，显式建模"谁、什么、何时"，通过3W联合打分检索事件记录，并复用对话骨干中间表示实现全双工低延迟检索；同时提出诊断基准SpokenTrace，端到端任务准确率85.08%，all-support EM@3从49.01%提升至82.10%。
AI.motivation: 现代语音助手常被多用户共享，需要回答关于先前会话的问题（如"我最初计划什么时候出发"），并基于历史交互为不同用户个性化调整行为。这不仅是主题相似段落检索，而要求系统识别当前说话人、恢复相关历史状态，并区分其与后续修订版本，即需要显式处理跨会话的说话人、内容与时间状态。
AI.method: 提出PERSIST持久记忆系统：1) 将跨会话历史结构化为可读的事件记录；2) 采用3W联合打分机制，融合语义内容、声学说话人身份与时间状态进行检索；3) 面向实时全双工交互，复用对话骨干的中间表示，避免对查询音频重复编码，将检索延迟从578.42 ms降至7.03 ms。同时构建SpokenTrace诊断基准，按记忆任务与说话人查询类型分解评估。
AI.result: 在SpokenTrace基准上，PERSIST取得85.08%的端到端任务准确率，all-support EM@3由BGE-large的49.01%提升至82.10%；检索延迟由578.42 ms降至7.03 ms。基准评估同时暴露出在回忆、说话人归属与时间状态跟踪方面的失败模式。
AI.conclusion: 通过显式建模Who、What、When并复用对话骨干表示，PERSIST在多会话、多说话人语音对话的持久记忆与低延迟检索上显著优于基线；SpokenTrace提供了可分解的诊断评估，揭示现有系统在召回、说话人归属与时间状态跟踪上的不足。

title: How Well Do LLMs Reason with Noisy Evidence? An Active Visual Reasoning Benchmark
summary: Real-world reasoning rarely reduces to static question answering: agents must actively gather information from tools and sensors that are often noisy and unreliable. Yet most existing active reasoning benchmarks assume that environmental feedback is trustworthy, or introduce noise without exposing an explicit, calibrated uncertainty signal, leaving open how LLMs should reason when the evidence itself is uncertain. We introduce VisualNoiseQA, a novel benchmark for active reasoning under noisy visual feedback. A text-only LLM must solve VQA problems by iteratively querying a fixed, off-the-shelf VLM treated as a stochastic visual sensor. For each query, we draw multiple samples and expose an empirical uncertainty signal via self-consistency, enabling the reasoner to probe from different angles and decide what to ask next and when to stop. Our construction is automatic and scalable: starting from diverse VQA sources and two noisy VLMs, we retain only questions where the sensor is inconsistent yet human-solvable. We evaluate multiple LLM reasoners on 1,000 instances spanning perception, chart understanding, and knowledge-intensive reasoning. VisualNoiseQA thus provides a controlled playground to study how different LLMs exploit uncertainty signals for robust reasoning.

AI.tldr: 提出VisualNoiseQA基准，研究LLM在带噪声视觉反馈下的主动推理，将VLM视为随机视觉传感器并通过自一致性暴露经验不确定性信号。
AI.motivation: 现有主动推理基准通常假设环境反馈可信，或虽引入噪声但未提供显式且校准的不确定性信号，因此无法考察LLM在证据本身不确定时应如何推理。
AI.method: 构建方式：让纯文本LLM通过迭代查询固定的现成VLM（随机视觉传感器）来解决VQA问题；每次查询采样多次，用自一致性给出经验不确定性信号，使推理器可从不同角度探测并决定下一个问题与停止时机；自动可扩展流程从多样VQA来源与两个噪声VLM出发，仅保留传感器不一致但人类可解的题目。
AI.result: 在覆盖感知、图表理解与知识密集型推理的1000个实例上评估了多个LLM推理器。
AI.conclusion: VisualNoiseQA为研究不同LLM如何利用不确定性信号进行鲁棒推理提供了受控实验平台。

title: ST-Bench: A Spatial-Temporal Benchmark for Multi-Agent System Generation on Scientific Research Tasks
summary: The rapid progress of LLM-based multi-agent systems (MAS) has shown that they largely outperform single agents on coding, math, and QA tasks, where executable tests provide a binary success signal. Whether this advantage transfers to real scientific data analysis remains untested. We introduce ST-Bench, a benchmark designed to answer two questions: whether MAS outperform single agents on complex scientific data analysis tasks, and if so, by how much and at what additional cost. ST-Bench contains 100 data science tasks adapted from published Earth science studies across hydrology, agriculture, and wetland methane research, expanded into 2,067 queries grounded in additional published studies and validated by domain experts. Using ST-Bench, we evaluate five recent MAS generation methods under two training protocols, against single-agent baselines on the same GPT-5 backbone. Nine of the ten MAS configurations exceed the cheapest single-agent baseline, with the strongest reaching nearly three times its composite score. This gain is primarily attributable to coverage: trained workflows produce realistic numerical metrics on a larger fraction of queries, while the quality of those metrics, conditional on producing realistic output, is comparable to that of the single-agent baseline. The strongest configuration requires approximately four times the single-agent inference time, whereas a more economical workflow captures the majority of the benefit at less than twice the cost. MAS specialization confers measurable benefit on scientific data analysis, but the benefit is conditional rather than universal.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出ST-Bench基准，用100个地球科学数据分析任务（扩展为2067条查询）检验LLM多智能体系统（MAS）是否优于单智能体，发现10种MAS配置中9种超过最便宜的单智能体基线，最强配置综合得分近3倍，但代价约4倍推理时间，增益主要来自覆盖率而非指标质量。
AI.motivation: LLM多智能体系统在编码、数学、问答等有可执行测试提供二元成功信号的领域显著优于单智能体，但这一优势能否迁移到真实的科学数据分析任务尚未得到验证；本文旨在回答MAS是否在复杂科学数据分析上优于单智能体，以及优势幅度与额外成本。
AI.method: 构建ST-Bench基准：包含100个数据科学任务，改编自水文学、农业和湿地甲烷研究领域的已发表地球科学研究，扩展为2067条查询，这些查询基于其他已发表研究并由领域专家验证。在相同GPT-5骨干模型上，采用两种训练协议评估五种近期MAS生成方法，并与单智能体基线对比。
AI.result: 十种MAS配置中有九种超过最便宜的单智能体基线，最强配置综合得分接近其3倍。增益主要归因于覆盖率：训练后的工作流在更大比例的查询上产生真实数值指标，而在产生真实输出的条件下，指标质量与单智能体基线相当。最强配置约需单智能体4倍推理时间，而更经济的配置以不到2倍成本获得大部分收益。
AI.conclusion: MAS专业化在科学数据分析上带来可测量的收益，但该收益是有条件的而非普遍适用的；优势主要体现为覆盖率提升，且需权衡推理成本。

title: OTel: Open Telco AI Datasets, Benchmarks, and Models
comment: Accepted to NeurIPS 2026, ED Track, Spotlight
summary: We present Open Telco (OTel), an open telecom AI resource that releases derived telecom datasets for retrieval, reranking, instruction tuning, and safety/abstention, together with 30 full-parameter post-trained baselines spanning 10 embedding models, 3 rerankers, and 17 language models. The community has already engaged substantially with the resource: as of May 3, 2026, the released models have been downloaded over 16 million times and the project has received 157+ pieces of media coverage worldwide. Building on prior open telecom datasets and benchmarks, OTel provides documented telecom data sources, held-out evaluation partitions, trained embedding models, rerankers, context-grounded LLMs, and safety/abstention data in one unified resource.
