Each baseline starts from an open-weight model and is post-trained on OTel-derived data using an open training recipe, then evaluated on held-out OTel evaluation partitions. OTel post-training improves performance across all three model families: embedding retrieval reaches 93.1% NDCG@10, reranking reaches 0.947 MRR@10, and language-model correctness reaches 87.8%. We release OTel as a reproducible starting point and invite the community to expand the data, improve embedding and reranking models, and build stronger context-grounded telecom LLMs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 OTel，一个开放电信 AI 资源，公开电信领域衍生数据集（检索、重排序、指令微调、安全/拒答）及 30 个全参数后训练基线，覆盖 10 个嵌入模型、3 个重排序器和 17 个语言模型，并取得显著性能与社区影响力。
AI.motivation: 此前已有开放电信数据集与基准，但缺乏将文档化数据源、留出评估划分、训练好的嵌入模型、重排序器、上下文接地 LLM 以及安全/拒答数据统一整合的资源，研究者难以获得可复现的起点。
AI.method: OTel 释出电信衍生数据与基于开放权重模型的后训练基线：每个基线从开放权重模型出发，使用开放训练配方在 OTel 衍生数据上做全参数后训练，再在留出的 OTel 评估划分上评测；涵盖嵌入检索、重排序、指令微调与安全/拒答等任务。
AI.result: 后训练在三个模型系列上均带来提升：嵌入检索达 93.1% NDCG@10，重排序达 0.947 MRR@10，语言模型正确率达 87.8%。截至 2026 年 5 月 3 日，发布模型下载量超 1600 万次，项目获得 157+ 篇全球媒体报道。
AI.conclusion: OTel 作为可复现的起点对外发布，作者邀请社区扩展数据、改进嵌入与重排序模型，并构建更强的上下文接地电信 LLM。

title: Attacca: Goal-Directed Control under State Continuity for Long-Horizon Embodied Agents
summary: A central capability of embodied agents is to accomplish complex objectives through sequences of interdependent tasks. Yet existing visual goal-conditioned policies underlying these agents are typically evaluated on isolated interactions where the target is already visible, and thus do not capture the conditions that arise during continuous long-horizon task execution. In such settings, each task begins from the state left by the previous one: the agent may end at a different position and orientation, the world may have been modified, and the next interaction target may lie outside the current field of view. As a result, agents relying on such policies may struggle to proceed to the next task when they cannot ground their target in the current observation. To address this challenge, we propose Attacca, a new approach that trains visual goal-conditioned policies on complete search-to-interact trajectories using goal images decoupled from the execution environment. Attacca uses context-decoupled goal sampling to pair each demonstration with a class-compatible masked goal image from another world, removing direct scene and pose correspondence. It learns dense current-view grounding through a target-mask prediction head, providing auxiliary supervision beyond action imitation. We further introduce behavioral-phase conditioning that teaches the policy to distinguish Search, Approach, and Interact stages and adapt its control as execution progresses. We evaluate Attacca on multiple short- and long-horizon embodied tasks in Minecraft. Our method achieves 39.0-47.5% clean success, improving over the strongest baseline by 1.7-2.4x. On long-horizon tasks, it attains 54%, 30%, and 28% completion, yielding up to a 7x improvement.

AI.tldr: 提出 Attacca，通过解耦目标图像、目标掩码预测与行为阶段条件化训练视觉目标条件策略，显著提升长时程具身任务性能。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉目标条件策略多在目标已可见的孤立交互上评估，未涵盖长时程连续执行中目标不在视野、世界状态被修改、起始位姿变化等真实情形，导致智能体在无法对目标进行当前观测定位时难以推进下一任务。
AI.method: 1) 在完整的"搜索—交互"轨迹上训练策略；2) 上下文解耦目标采样：为目标示范配对来自其他世界、类别兼容的掩码目标图像，去除场景与位姿对应；3) 目标掩码预测头提供密集的当前视角定位辅助监督；4) 行为阶段条件化，区分 Search、Approach、Interact 三阶段并随执行进程调整控制。
AI.result: 在 Minecraft 多个短时程与长时程具身任务上，Attacca 取得 39.0–47.5% 的干净成功率，较最强基线提升 1.7–2.4 倍；长时程任务完成率为 54%、30%、28%，最高提升达 7 倍。
AI.conclusion: 将目标图像与执行环境解耦、并以目标定位与行为阶段作为辅助监督，能有效应对长时程任务中目标不可见与状态漂移问题，显著优于现有视觉目标条件基线。

title: OOPMAS: Object-Oriented Multi-Agent Systems for Query-Level Workflow Generation
summary: Multi-agent systems (MAS) powered by large language models have shown strong performance across code generation, mathematical reasoning, and question answering. However, existing methods for automating MAS design mostly operate at the task level, producing a single fixed workflow per benchmark that is applied uniformly to all queries. This assumption fails under realistic conditions. Query difficulty varies widely within a task, and real-world workloads mix heterogeneous task types. We introduce OOPMAS, a training-free framework that generates both the agent set and the coordination workflow at the granularity of individual queries. Agents are represented as object-oriented class definitions with dedicated roles, tools, and persistent state, and workflows are expressed as executable main functions over these agent objects. A dynamic skill library accumulates structured lessons from execution feedback across optimization rounds, enabling in-context improvement without any gradient updates or fine-tuning. On a mixed-task benchmark of queries spanning code, math, and QA, OOPMAS achieves 89.6% accuracy, outperforming the strongest baseline by 18.1 percentage points. A model-swap study across four LLM backbones shows consistent scaling, reaching 92.4% with the strongest model.

AI.tldr: OOPMAS：免训练框架，以面向对象智能体类和可执行主函数表示工作流，在单查询粒度生成智能体集合与协调流程，配合动态技能库，在混合任务基准上达89.6%准确率，超最强基线18.1个百分点。
AI.motivation: 现有MAS自动化设计方法多在任务层面操作，为每个基准生成单一固定工作流并统一应用于所有查询，忽略了查询难度差异大、真实负载混合异构任务类型的问题。
AI.method: 免训练框架；智能体表示为具有专属角色、工具和持久状态的对象类定义；工作流表示为可执行main函数；动态技能库跨优化轮次从执行反馈中积累结构化经验，实现上下文内改进，无需梯度更新或微调。优化过程基于执行反馈迭代。
AI.result: 在覆盖代码、数学、问答的混合任务基准上准确率89.6%，超最强基线18.1个百分点；四款LLM骨干的模型替换研究显示一致扩展性，最强模型达92.4%。
AI.conclusion: OOPMAS验证了在单查询粒度自动化设计MAS的有效性，面向对象抽象与动态技能库结合可在免训练条件下显著提升混合异构任务表现，并随骨干模型能力提升而稳定扩展。

title: Illusory Pattern Perception Drives Spurious Inference in Large Language Models
summary: Illusory pattern perception is a well-documented human cognitive tendency to infer meaningful relationships in data that is actually random. Such a tendency, often described as "connecting the dots" where none exist, can result in systematic reasoning errors. This paper investigates whether Large Language Models (LLMs) exhibit such perceptual tendencies, which can lead to systematic errors in downstream applications. To our knowledge, this work presents the first systematic study of illusory pattern perception in LLMs, adapting classic psychological paradigms to three tasks with direct empirical comparison to human behaviors. We find that LLMs frequently exhibit stronger illusory pattern perception than humans. In particular, models tend to over-associate frequent positive attributes with majority groups or large organizations, and show increased tendencies to construct causal narratives from ambiguous events. To uncover the mechanism behind these behaviors, we develop a feature interpretability framework based on Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs) to analyze internal representations. Our results reveal that holistic frequency perception and analytic cognitive orientation are linked to the emergence of illusory perceptions. These findings highlight a previously underexplored cognitive-like illusion that may affect the reliability of LLM reasoning. Code available at https://github.com/NusIoraPrivacy/illusory.

AI.tldr: 本文首次系统研究大语言模型（LLM）中的错觉模式感知（illusory pattern perception），发现LLM比人类更易在随机数据中推断虚假关联，并通过稀疏自编码器（SAE）揭示其内部机制。
AI.motivation: 错觉模式感知是人类一种有据可查的认知倾向，即在本质随机的数据中推断出有意义的关联，常被称为"在不存在处连线"，会导致系统性推理错误。本文关注LLM是否也表现出此类感知倾向，从而在下游应用中产生系统性错误。
AI.method: 将经典心理学范式改编为三项任务，对LLM行为与人类行为进行直接实证比较；并构建基于稀疏自编码器（SAE）的特征可解释性框架，分析LLM的内部表征以揭示机制。
AI.result: LLM频繁表现出比人类更强的错觉模式感知：倾向于将高频正面属性与多数群体或大型组织过度关联，并更易从模糊事件中构建因果叙事。SAE分析表明，整体频率感知与分析性认知取向与错觉感知的出现相关。
AI.conclusion: 本文揭示了LLM中一种此前未被充分探索的类认知错觉，可能影响LLM推理的可靠性。代码已开源于 https://github.com/NusIoraPrivacy/illusory 。

title: Thin Evidence, Thick Priors: How Language Models Substitute Identity for Missing Financial Facts
comment: 49 pages, 17 figures, 12 tables; Submitted & Accepted to ICAIF'2026
summary: People increasingly ask large language models what to do with their money, yet seldom describe their finances in full. This paper asks what a model does with the gap. Holding finances fixed and changing only who the investor is said to be, we grade the financial evidence in the prompt from eight facts to none and measure how far the recommended equity allocation moves. Across 96,600 prompts to Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct, built from 100 financial profiles, 138 personas and seven disclosure conditions, the average gap between two personas with identical finances rises from 4.78 percentage points at full disclosure to 10.34 points with no financial facts. A two-way cluster bootstrap counting duplicated prompts once places the ratio at 2.16 (95% interval 1.69 to 2.79), and the rise is already 1.69-fold with a single fact left. Identity explains 5% of within-profile variation in advice at full disclosure and 96% with no disclosure. Household size is the only attribute whose influence grows reliably as evidence is withdrawn. Once standard errors are clustered on the persona, the unit to which identity was assigned, most attribute-specific interactions reported in the conference version lose significance, and gender instead appears as a small standing gap that full disclosure does not close. Stating risk appetite alone brings the swing into the range seen with two to seven generic facts. With no facts, the model's one-line rationale cites incomes, debts and savings it was never told, and these invented finances turn adverse more often for larger households. Inside the network, gender is linearly decodable at every layer, and ablating the gender direction at five layers leaves the aggregate identity swing unchanged. Advisory systems built on such models should be audited at the disclosure levels users actually reach, and judged across the whole identity space rather than one attribute at a time.

AI.tldr: 当财务事实缺失时，大模型给出的股票配置建议会随投资者"身份"大幅波动：全披露时同一财务下不同人设差距4.78个百分点，无任何财务事实时扩大到10.34个百分点，比值2.16；身份可解释的组内差异从5%升至96%。
AI.motivation: 用户常向大模型咨询理财，但很少完整描述自身财务状况，提示中存在"信息缺口"。论文想考察模型如何填补这一缺口，即当财务事实被撤走时，建议在多大程度上由投资者身份而非财务证据驱动。
AI.method: 控制财务不变，仅改变投资者"身份"；将提示中的财务证据从8项事实递减至0项。构建96,600条提示（100个财务画像×138个人设×7种披露条件），投喂Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct，测量推荐股票配置比例的变化；用双向聚类bootstrap（重复提示只计一次）估计比值；对家庭规模等属性做交互分析；并对网络各层做性别方向的线性解码与消融。
AI.result: 同财务两身份的平均差距从全披露的4.78个百分点升至无披露的10.34个百分点；bootstrap比值2.16（95%区间1.69–2.79），仅剩1项事实时已达1.69倍。身份对组内建议差异的解释力从全披露的5%升至无披露的96%。仅家庭规模的影响力随证据撤除而稳定增强。以人设（身份所赋单位）聚类标准误后，会议版中多数属性交互不再显著；性别表现为全披露也无法消除的小幅恒定差距。仅声明风险偏好即可带来相当于2–7项通用事实的波动。无事实时，模型的一句话理由会虚构未被告知的收入、债务与储蓄，且这些虚构财务对大家庭更常转为不利。性别方向在各层均可线性解码，但在5层中消融该方向并未改变总体身份波动。
AI.conclusion: 基于此类模型的理财顾问系统，应在用户实际达到的披露水平上进行审计，并在整个身份空间而非单一属性上评估公平性与稳定性；单纯消融显式性别方向不足以消除身份驱动的建议偏差。

title: Agentic Semantic Sensing for Resource-Adaptive AI-RAN
summary: Semantic sensing (SemS) acquires task-relevant information rather than reconstructing complete physical information. Existing SemS formulations typically operate open loop: sensing configurations and observation schedules are fixed before inference and cannot respond to evolving task-level evidence. We propose Agentic SemS, a closed-loop framework for AI-enabled radio access networks (AI-RANs) that controls sensing within a communication-feasible profile set. A profile-conditioned causal Transformer updates the semantic belief from streaming observations, while key-value caching enables efficient state updates across profile changes without repeatedly processing the complete history. A semantic utility network estimates the task-level benefit of acquiring the next observation block under each feasible profile after accounting for sensing cost. The resulting continuation utilities jointly support next-profile selection and semantic early exit, adapting sensing configuration and duration to evolving evidence. The expected semantic gain is further related to conditional mutual information, providing a value-of-information interpretation of continued online sensing. Experiments on Widar3.0 with six emulated sensing profiles show that, in comparison with full-sequence High, the resource-efficient Agentic setting reduces normalized cumulative sensing cost by 25.33% while achieving 85.79% Macro-F1. At the same utility checkpoint, semantic early exit provides a further 12.35% cost reduction over adaptive sensing without early exit, with a 0.97-percentage-point Macro-F1 decrease.

AI.tldr: 提出Agentic SemS闭环语义感知框架，在通信可行剖面子集内动态控制感知配置与时长，兼顾任务性能与感知开销。
AI.motivation: 现有语义感知(SemS)多为开环：感知配置与观测调度在推理前固定，无法根据任务级证据演化自适应调整，造成资源浪费或信息不足。
AI.method: 1) 面向AI-RAN，将感知约束在通信可行剖面集内形成闭环控制；2) 采用剖面条件因果Transformer，从流式观测更新语义信念，并用KV缓存支持剖面切换下的高效状态更新；3) 语义效用网络在计入感知成本后估计各可行剖面下获取下一观测块的任务级收益；4) 以延续效用联合驱动下一剖面选择与语义早退，自适应配置与时长；5) 将期望语义增益联系条件互信息，给出在线持续感知的信息价值解释。
AI.result: 在Widar3.0、六种仿真感知剖面下：相比全序列High，资源高效Agentic设置使归一化累计感知成本降低25.33%，同时达到85.79% Macro-F1；在同一效用检查点，语义早退在无早退自适应感知基础上再降12.35%成本，Macro-F1仅下降0.97个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 闭环Agentic SemS可在通信可行约束下自适应配置与时长，显著降低感知开销且保持较高任务精度；条件互信息为持续感知提供价值信息理论依据。

title: DHCG: Dynamic Construction of Hierarchical Collaboration Graphs for LLM-Based Multi-Agent Reasoning
summary: LLM-based multi-agent systems (MAS) have demonstrated strong capabilities in solving complex problems across diverse domains. Recently, the dynamic orchestration of agent systems has become an important research direction. However, existing methods suffer from limited composition, misaligned dependencies, and inflexible scale, restricting their ability to adapt to reasoning requirements during execution. To address these limitations, we reframe MAS design as a partially observable Markov decision process, in which both the composition and scale of the MAS are dynamically determined. We propose DHCG, a novel framework that coordinates three modules (Planner, Worker, and Generator) to progressively construct a dynamic hierarchical collaboration graph from scratch based on the query and evolving execution feedback. At each step, guided by feedback, the Planner generates a set of distinct and complementary roles tailored to the current reasoning needs and selectively routes relevant information to each role. It can also finalize the hierarchical collaboration graph early or progressively expand it when additional reasoning is required. We further introduce action-aware preference optimization to train the Planner to make more effective decisions when constructing hierarchical collaboration graphs. We systematically evaluate DHCG across code generation, mathematical reasoning, and domain-specific reasoning benchmarks. DHCG achieves state-of-the-art average performance among the compared methods, improving over the single-agent baseline by 13.06 points and outperforming both static and dynamic MAS baselines by 2.77-8.02 points. Additional experiments further demonstrate its generalization across different Planner backbones and unseen Worker models.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出DHCG框架，将多智能体系统（MAS）设计重构为部分可观测马尔可夫决策过程，通过Planner、Worker、Generator三模块逐步构建动态层次协作图，并引入动作感知偏好优化训练Planner，在多个推理基准上取得最优平均性能。
AI.motivation: 现有基于LLM的多智能体系统动态编排方法存在三大局限：组合有限（limited composition）、依赖关系错位（misaligned dependencies）、规模不灵活（inflexible scale），难以在执行过程中适应推理需求的变化。因此需要一种能动态确定智能体组合与规模的编排机制。
AI.method: 将MAS设计重构为部分可观测马尔可夫决策过程，使智能体的组合与规模均动态确定；提出DHCG框架，由Planner、Worker、Generator三个模块协同，基于查询和演化中的执行反馈从零逐步构建动态层次协作图。每一步中，Planner在反馈指导下生成一组针对当前推理需求的不同且互补的角色，并将相关信息选择性路由到各角色；框架可提前终止层次协作图或按需渐进扩展。此外引入动作感知偏好优化（action-aware preference optimization）训练Planner，使其在构建层次协作图时做出更有效决策。
AI.result: 在代码生成、数学推理和领域特定推理基准上系统评估DHCG：在对比方法中达到最优平均性能，较单智能体基线提升13.06分，优于静态和动态MAS基线2.77–8.02分。额外实验表明其在不同Planner骨干网络和未见Worker模型上具有泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: DHCG通过将MAS动态编排建模为POMDP并结合动作感知偏好优化，有效克服了现有方法在组合、依赖与规模灵活性上的不足，实现了更强的适应性和跨领域、跨模型泛化能力，在多种推理任务上达到领先水平。

title: RA-MoWE: Workflow-Affinity Embeddings for Query Clustering and Agentic Workflow Generation
summary: Agentic workflows enable large language models (LLMs) to solve complex tasks by coordinating reasoning, tool use, and verification. However, a workflow optimized for an entire task collection can overlook differences in the reasoning strategies that individual queries need, while searching for a new workflow for every query repeats costly optimization. To address this tradeoff, we introduce RA-MoWE, a framework that uses workflow-affinity embeddings to cluster queries and guide the generation of reusable expert workflows. Each embedding records how well a fixed set of reference workflows solves a query, revealing similarities in which reasoning strategies are effective. RA-MoWE uses each cluster's queries and average embedding to initialize and refine a specialized workflow through execution feedback. An embedding encoder predicts these embeddings from query text, allowing new queries to select a generated expert without first executing the reference workflows. On a 300-query test set drawn from four benchmarks spanning mathematics, science, and programming, RA-MoWE improves average task score by 4.04 percentage points over selecting among the reference workflows, while using 27.7% fewer language-model calls at inference.

AI.tldr: 提出RA-MoWE框架，通过工作流亲和度嵌入对查询聚类并生成可复用专家工作流，缓解"单一全局优化工作流"与"逐查询优化高成本"之间的权衡。
AI.motivation: 面向整个任务集合优化的单一工作流会忽略单个查询在推理策略需求上的差异；而为每个查询单独搜索新工作流又会重复付出高昂的优化成本。论文旨在解决这一权衡问题。
AI.method: RA-MoWE使用工作流亲和度嵌入（workflow-affinity embeddings）刻画"固定参考工作流集合"对某查询的求解效果，据此对查询聚类，并引导生成可复用的专家工作流。每个簇利用其查询集合与平均嵌入来初始化并借助执行反馈精炼出一个专用工作流；同时训练一个嵌入编码器，由查询文本直接预测亲和度嵌入，使新查询无需先执行参考工作流即可选择合适专家。
AI.result: 在覆盖数学、科学与编程三个领域的四个基准、共300条查询构成的测试集上，RA-MoWE相较"在参考工作流中择优"平均任务得分提升4.04个百分点，同时推理阶段的语言模型调用次数减少27.7%。
AI.conclusion: 以工作流亲和度嵌入为中间表示进行查询聚类与专家工作流生成，可在提升复杂任务求解效果的同时降低推理开销，为LLM智能体工作流的可复用、可迁移优化提供了可行路径。

title: WorkflowOps: Learning Agent Collaboration Priors for Multi-Agent Workflow Orchestration
summary: Multi-agent systems are increasingly deployed for complex knowledge work, yet their orchestration layers remain largely memoryless: each new task is decomposed, assigned, and executed from scratch with no benefit from prior successful executions. We present WorkflowOps, a multi-agent workflow orchestration framework that learns agent collaboration priors from historical workflows and expands its agent pool on demand to cover new capability requirements. Our approach introduces three coupled mechanisms. First, a transition probability matrix captures pairwise agent collaboration frequencies from past workflows and applies them as soft guidance during DAG workflow construction through intra-layer ordering optimization, probability-thresholded edge suggestion, and transitive reduction for parallelism maximization. Second, a sufficiency-driven agent creation loop detects capability gaps via semantic matching scores, generates specialized agents through an LLM, and simultaneously injects them into the collaboration matrix, so that newly created agents are immediately usable with predicted collaboration priors. Third, a layered semantic matching strategy uses pre-trained sentence embeddings for fast, deterministic capability matching as a first pass, invoking LLM verification only for low-confidence cases, thereby reducing LLM routing calls by over 80\% compared to pure-LLM approaches. Experiments on mixed code, math, and question-answering suites show that WorkflowOps improves end-to-end pass rates over recent workflow-construction baselines, with the largest gains on structured, decomposable tasks where past agent handoff patterns transfer.

AI.tldr: WorkflowOps 是一个多智能体工作流编排框架，通过从历史工作流中学习智能体协作先验并按需扩展智能体池，提升复杂知识任务的端到端通过率。
AI.motivation: 现有多智能体系统编排层基本"无记忆"：每个新任务都从零开始分解、分配和执行，无法利用以往成功执行的经验，导致重复劳动与效率损耗。作者希望让编排层具备记忆能力，复用历史协作模式，并在能力不足时动态扩展智能体池。
AI.method: 提出三个耦合机制：(1) 转移概率矩阵，从历史工作流统计智能体两两协作频率，在 DAG 构建中通过层内排序优化、概率阈值化边建议与传递约简实现软引导并最大化并行度；(2) 充分性驱动的智能体创建循环，用语义匹配分数检测能力缺口，经 LLM 生成专用智能体并同步注入协作矩阵，使新智能体立即可用并带有预测的协作先验；(3) 分层语义匹配策略，先用预训练句向量做快速确定性匹配，仅对低置信度样本调用 LLM 验证。
AI.result: 相比纯 LLM 路由方案，LLM 调用减少 80% 以上；在代码、数学与问答混合测试集上，端到端通过率优于近期工作流构建基线，在结构化、可分解且历史智能体交接模式可迁移的任务上增益最大。
AI.conclusion: 将历史协作先验与按需智能体扩展结合，可在显著降低 LLM 开销的同时提升多智能体编排性能；协作记忆对结构化任务尤其有效。

title: Self-Referenced Social Preferences: Cooperation without Observing Others Rewards
summary: Social preferences can promote cooperation in multi-agent reinforcement learning, but existing approaches often require agents to observe the rewards of their peers. In many real-world interactions, however, an agent can, as humans do, observe others' behavior and outcomes without access to their private reward signals. We introduce self-referenced social preferences, in which each agent learns a model of its own reward, applies it to other agents' observed transitions to assess their outcomes from its own perspective, and feeds these self-referenced assessments into standard social preferences. We study two ways to incorporate these assessments: modifying the learning reward, or using them to weight policy updates. We evaluate the approach on three sequential social dilemmas, Escape Room, Clean Up, and Commons Harvest, which require volunteering, public-good contribution, and resource restraint, respectively. Across all three environments, agents learn cooperative behavior without observing others' rewards, including in settings where independent learners fail to cooperate, and frequently achieve more equitable divisions of jointly produced returns than agents with access to true rewards. The effective integration point depends on the social preference: inequity aversion works best in the reward together with a value look-ahead, whereas a purely benevolent preference benefits from policy-update weighting. Under partial observability, the policy-update approach continues to support cooperation. These results show that explicit access to other agents' reward signals is not necessary for learning cooperative behavior: social preferences can instead be grounded in self-referenced assessments of others' outcomes derived from their observed behavior.

AI.tldr: 本文提出“自参照社会偏好”（self-referenced social preferences），让每个智能体用自身奖励模型去评估他人的转移，从而在无法观测他人私有奖励的情况下学习合作行为。
AI.motivation: 现有多智能体强化学习中的社会偏好方法通常要求智能体观测同伴的奖励信号，而在许多真实交互中，智能体只能像人类一样观察到他人的行为与结果，无法获取其私有奖励。因此需要一种不依赖他人真实奖励的合作机制。
AI.method: 提出自参照社会偏好：每个智能体学习自身奖励模型，将其应用于其他智能体观测到的转移，从而从自身视角评估他人结果，并把这种自参照评估输入标准社会偏好中。研究两种整合方式：一是修改学习奖励，二是用评估结果对策略更新加权。在Escape Room、Clean Up、Commons Harvest三个序贯社会困境任务上评估，分别考察自愿参与、公共品贡献与资源节制。
AI.result: 在三个环境中，智能体均能在不观测他人奖励的情况下学到合作行为，包括独立学习者无法合作的场景；并且常比能获取真实奖励的智能体实现更公平的共同收益分配。有效整合点取决于社会偏好类型：不公平厌恶在奖励中结合价值前瞻效果最好，而纯利他偏好更适合策略更新加权；在部分可观测条件下，策略更新加权方法仍能支持合作。
AI.conclusion: 显式获取他人奖励信号并非学习合作行为的必要条件；社会偏好可以建立在由他人可观测行为推导出的自参照结果评估之上。

title: Textual Environmental Context and Spatial Graphs for LLM-Based Regional SST Forecasting
summary: Sea surface temperature (SST) forecasting depends on local temporal persistence, regional spatial dependence, and environmental conditions that evolve with the forecast date. We study how these heterogeneous conditions can be presented to a large language model (LLM) for regional multi-step forecasting without serializing the full SST grid as text. We formulate forecasting as conditional numerical generation: historical SST and anomaly sequences, date-aligned environmental records, and static ocean knowledge form a textual context, while regional spatial state is supplied through continuous graph-derived prefixes. A static graph encodes persistent geographic--climatological relations, and a dynamic graph encodes recent SST correlations and localized tropical-cyclone influence. Two graph neural networks produce a target-node representation that is mapped by a spatial-prefix fusion and injected into the LLM input. On SST forecasting in the South China Sea, the complete configuration achieves the best MAE and $\Rtwo$ among the compared methods over ten forecast steps. Alongside the numerical forecast, a rule-based module matches predicted trends and environmental-factor directions with knowledge entries to return source-linked, post-hoc contextual explanations.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一种将图神经网络空间前缀注入大语言模型的条件数值生成框架，用于南海海表温度（SST）区域多步预测，并附加基于规则的可溯源事后解释模块。
AI.motivation: SST预测依赖局部时间持续性、区域空间依赖以及随预测日期变化的环境条件，这些异质条件难以在不将整个SST网格序列化为文本的前提下，有效呈现给大语言模型。因此需要一种无需文本化全网格、又能融合空间与环境信息的预测范式。
AI.method: 将预测建模为条件数值生成：以历史SST与异常序列、日期对齐的环境记录、静态海洋知识构成文本上下文；区域空间状态通过连续的图导出前缀提供。构建静态图编码持久的地理—气候关系，动态图编码近期SST相关性与局地热带气旋影响；两个图神经网络生成目标节点表示，经空间前缀融合映射后注入LLM输入。
AI.result: 在南海SST预测任务上，完整配置在十个预测步长内的MAE与R²均优于所比较的方法。同时，基于规则的模块将预测趋势与环境因子方向同知识条目匹配，返回带来源链接的事后情境解释。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，通过图导出的连续空间前缀而非文本化全网格，可将异质时空与环境条件有效注入LLM，实现准确的区域多步SST预测，并在数值预测之外提供可溯源的事后解释。

title: Continuous Memory Machines
comment: NeurIPS 2026 Workshop: Personalized, Aligned, Long-Term Memory for AI Systems (PALM)
summary: Recurrent neural networks typically compress information into a single vector-valued recurrent state, forcing short-term computation and long-term retention to share the same representation. Past extensions alleviate this bottleneck by increasing the memory capacity or separating timescales, but lack the combination of rapid neuron-level processing and longer-term retention found in biology. To that end, we introduce the Continuous Memory Machine (CMM), a recurrent architecture with matrix-valued short- and long-term memory states serving distinct functional roles. Building on the Continuous Thought Machine (CTM), the CMM's short-term memory tracks recent neural activity, with uniquely parameterized neuron-level models learning to use these activity patterns for computation. A persistent long-term memory stores information for later use, with a Transformer jointly updating both memory stores, providing an expressive bidirectional read--write mechanism such that each store can reorganize its own contents and both read from and write to the other. Across algorithmic, in-context learning, and recurrent reasoning tasks, the CMM outperforms a broad suite of baselines, exhibiting stronger generalization than prior memory-augmented networks while preserving the CTM's interpretable attention patterns. Code is available at https://github.com/SakanaAI/continuous-memory-machines.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出连续记忆机器（CMM），一种具有矩阵值短期与长期记忆状态的循环架构，二者承担不同功能角色，并通过Transformer联合更新，在算法、上下文学习与推理任务上超越多种基线。
AI.motivation: 传统循环神经网络将信息压缩为单一向量值循环状态，导致短期计算与长期保持共享同一表示，形成瓶颈。已有扩展通过增大记忆容量或分离时间尺度缓解该问题，但未能同时实现生物学中的神经元级快速处理与长期保持。
AI.method: CMM基于连续思维机器（CTM），采用矩阵值短期和长期记忆状态：短期记忆跟踪近期神经活动，用独特参数化的神经元级模型学习利用活动模式进行计算；持久长期记忆存储信息供后续使用。一个Transformer联合更新两种记忆，提供富有表达力的双向读写机制，使每种记忆可重组自身内容并相互读写。
AI.result: 在算法任务、上下文学习和循环推理任务中，CMM优于广泛的基线套件，展现出比先前记忆增强网络更强的泛化能力，同时保留了CTM可解释的注意力模式。
AI.conclusion: CMM通过解耦短期与长期记忆并引入双向读写机制，实现了快速神经元级处理与长期保持的结合，为循环架构的记忆设计提供了新思路，代码已开源。

title: SIGMA: Self-Improving Alignment Generalization from a Model Spec
summary: LLM agents are increasingly capable of executing complex tasks and of recursively improving themselves on easy-to-verify objectives such as software engineering and mathematics. Since alignment is much harder to verify, this creates a growing risk of capabilities increasing without appropriate safety alignment, especially as capabilities expand to auto-research and cybersecurity. Existing approaches focus on capability self-improvement using verifiable feedback or on alignment training with supervision from stronger models or curated data, creating an external supervision bottleneck for alignment. We ask whether current models can improve their own safety alignment, and propose SIGMA, a data generation and training pipeline enabling alignment self-improvement that generalizes to out-of-distribution settings. Given only a "Model Spec" stating the model's desired behavior, SIGMA leverages a model's reasoning capabilities to strengthen its own safety reasoning. SIGMA first performs spec-guided task synthesis, using the candidate model as a task designer agent to generate diverse alignment dilemma scenarios and convert them into training tasks that stress-test its understanding of the Model Spec. Next, SIGMA conducts self-judged alignment training through supervised fine-tuning and rubric-based reinforcement learning with the model itself as the reward model. Despite training only on single-turn chat data, SIGMA improves safety alignment in multi-turn agentic environments (AgentHarm harmfulness decreases from 22.6 to 14.8; Agentic Misalignment decreases from 79.1 to 3.8), outperforms Deliberative Alignment and Constitutional AI baselines, and retains general capability. Analyses show that a Model Spec balancing harmlessness and helpfulness, test-time reasoning for safety deliberation, and high-quality rubrics from SIGMA's task designer agent are crucial for effective self-improvement.

AI.tldr: 论文提出SIGMA，一个仅凭“Model Spec”即可实现对齐自我改进的数据生成与训练流水线，通过规范引导的任务合成与自我评判训练，显著提升多轮智能体环境中的安全对齐表现。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体在软件工程、数学等易验证目标上具备自我递归改进能力，而对齐难以验证，导致能力增长可能脱离安全对齐，尤其在自动科研与网络安全领域风险加剧。既有方法或依赖可验证反馈做能力自改进，或依赖更强模型监督与人工数据做对齐训练，形成“外部监督瓶颈”。论文据此追问：当前模型能否实现自身安全对齐的自我改进。
AI.method: 提出SIGMA，一个数据生成与训练流水线，实现可泛化至分布外场景的对齐自我改进。输入仅为描述期望行为的“Model Spec”。第一步为规范引导的任务合成：将候选模型充当任务设计智能体，生成多样化的对齐困境场景，并转化为压力测试其对Model Spec理解程度的训练任务。第二步为自我评判的对齐训练：采用监督微调与基于评分标准（rubric）的强化学习，并以模型自身作为奖励模型。
AI.result: 尽管仅使用单轮对话数据训练，SIGMA在多轮智能体环境中改善了安全对齐：AgentHarm有害性从22.6降至14.8，Agentic Misalignment从79.1降至3.8；性能优于Deliberative Alignment与Constitutional AI基线，同时保持通用能力。分析表明，兼顾无害性与有用性的Model Spec、面向安全审议的测试时推理、以及任务设计智能体提供的高质量评分标准，是有效自我改进的关键。
AI.conclusion: 当前模型具备一定程度的安全对齐自我改进潜力，无需依赖更强外部监督即可实现；SIGMA在单轮训练下可泛化至多轮智能体场景并保持通用能力。其效果依赖平衡的Model Spec、测试时安全推理与高质量评分标准，为缓解能力增长与安全对齐脱节的风险提供了可行路径。

title: Can Agents Work for Everyone? Cross-User Reliability for Mobile GUI Agents in Personalized User Interfaces
summary: Mobile GUI agents increasingly operate on interfaces influenced by users' histories and preferences, but their reliability across different users remains underexplored. We introduce PAIR (Personalized Application-state Instantiation and Rendering), a pipeline for constructing user-conditioned application states that enables controlled evaluation of the same task across different users. We further introduce RePAIR (Reinforcement learning with Personalization-Aware Interaction Rewards), a training approach that learns from cross-user differences in subgoal outcomes to improve reliability across user-conditioned mobile environments. Across six agents, we find substantial variation in task success across users and consistently lower subgoal achievement in user-conditioned UI contexts (6.98 to 15.4 pp). This gap further increases for personal targets drawn from each user's own content (8.77 to 22.0 pp). Failures in these contexts frequently involve selecting another item instead of the intended target, particularly before target exposure. Finally, RePAIR improves user-conditioned SAR (+5.87 pp), all-success (+7.50 pp), and overall Task SR (+9.42 pp) over its supervised fine-tuning parent on unseen users, providing initial evidence that explicitly learning from cross-user variation can improve GUI-agent reliability.

AI.tldr: 论文提出PAIR构建用户条件化应用状态以受控评估移动GUI智能体的跨用户可靠性，并提出RePAIR利用跨用户子目标差异进行强化学习；实验发现六种智能体在个性化UI下成功率显著下降，RePAIR在未见用户上带来明显提升。
AI.motivation: 移动GUI智能体日益运行在受用户历史与偏好影响的界面上，但其在不同用户间的可靠性尚未被充分研究；缺乏可控制变量、跨用户可比的任务评估手段，也缺少针对用户条件化环境的训练方法。
AI.method: 1) PAIR（Personalized Application-state Instantiation and Rendering）：一条构建用户条件化应用状态的流水线，使同一任务可在不同用户间受控评估；2) RePAIR（Reinforcement learning with Personalization-Aware Interaction Rewards）：一种训练方法，从跨用户子目标结果的差异中学习，以提升用户条件化移动环境中的可靠性；3) 在六种智能体上进行评估，对比用户条件化UI与通用UI、个人目标与一般目标，并在未见用户上比较RePAIR与其监督微调基线。
AI.result: 跨用户任务成功存在显著差异；在用户条件化UI上下文中的子目标达成率持续更低（低6.98–15.4个百分点）；当目标来自用户自身内容时差距进一步扩大（低8.77–22.0个百分点）；此类失败常表现为选择了非目标项，且在目标出现之前尤为频繁。RePAIR相比其监督微调父模型在未见用户上提升：用户条件化SAR +5.87 pp、all-success +7.50 pp、总体Task SR +9.42 pp。
AI.conclusion: 个性化会系统性削弱GUI智能体的可靠性，且该问题在目标与用户私有内容相关时更严重；显式利用跨用户差异进行强化学习（RePAIR）可有效提升用户条件化环境下的可靠性，为个性化GUI智能体的评估与训练提供了初步证据与可行路径。

title: Learning from Revision Consequences: Hindsight Meta-Experience Distillation for Self-Improving Agents
summary: As agents continuously improve by generating and revising Skills, the process that discovers and refines those Skills becomes a learnable object in its own right. Task-Skills directly act on task execution, whereas Meta-Skills govern how agents discover and improve future Skills; their value therefore emerges through the subsequent search processes they induce. Existing approaches improve Meta-Skills from observed raw Skill-search trajectories and branch outcomes. However, branch performance entangles the effects of the initial discovery state and the Meta-Skill revision that generated the search process, making it difficult to characterize what a particular revision actually changed, and pushing updates toward revisions that benefit from favorable states rather than those that improve the process. We introduce HMED (Hindsight Meta-Experience Distillation), a mechanism for constructing Meta-Experience for self-improving agents. HMED revisits the completed event from which a revision originates and re-executes the incumbent and revised Meta-Skills from the same restored discovery state, so that the changes associated with the revision can be observed under a shared condition. Each comparison is distilled into a Meta-Experience, a structured record that can be reused by future updates, so that even revisions that are not ultimately retained still contribute a learning signal. Across three interactive agent benchmarks and both open-source and closed-source models, HMED consistently improves Skill discovery performance over strong baselines, shifting Meta-Skill learning beyond branch outcomes toward the consequences of changing the improvement process.

AI.tldr: 提出 HMED（Hindsight Meta-Experience Distillation），通过"恢复同一发现状态并重执行新旧 Meta-Skill"来解耦分支收益与修订本身的效果，并将比较结果蒸馏为可复用的 Meta-Experience，从而改进 Meta-Skill 的学习。
AI.motivation: 随着智能体通过生成与修订 Skills 不断自我改进，"发现与精炼 Skills 的过程"本身成为可学习对象。其中 Task-Skills 直接作用于任务执行，而 Meta-Skills 决定智能体如何发现与改进未来 Skills，其价值体现在所诱导的后续搜索过程上。现有方法从原始 Skill 搜索轨迹与分支结果中改进 Meta-Skills，但分支表现同时纠缠了"初始发现状态"和"生成该搜索过程的 Meta-Skill 修订"两方影响，难以刻画某次修订究竟改变了什么，导致更新偏向于"受益于有利状态"的修订，而非"真正改进流程"的修订。
AI.method: HMED 机制用于为自我改进智能体构建 Meta-Experience：回溯某次修订所源自的已完成事件，从同一恢复的发现状态出发，分别重执行 incumbent Meta-Skill 与 revised Meta-Skill，使修订带来的变化在共享条件下被观测（受控对比）。每次对比被蒸馏为一条结构化的 Meta-Experience 记录，可供未来更新复用；因此即使最终未被保留的修订也能贡献学习信号。
AI.result: 在三个交互式智能体基准上，针对开源与闭源模型，HMED 在 Skill 发现性能上持续优于强基线，将 Meta-Skill 学习从"分支结果导向"转向"改进过程本身后果导向"。
AI.conclusion: 通过状态恢复与受控重执行解耦混淆因素，并以 Meta-Experience 形式沉淀可复用经验，HMED 为 Meta-Skill 的自我改进提供了更可靠的学习信号，且对未保留修订亦能实现信号利用。

title: Learning in Dreams, Winning in Reality: A Continuous Dyna Loop for a Ten-Hero MOBA
comment: 15 pages, 11 figures. Code, policies, evaluation and videos: https://github.com/JordyKieto/puffermoba-dyna
summary: World models are usually judged from the inside: by prediction loss, by the return a policy earns in imagination, or by how convincing their frames look. We judge one from the outside. We learn a structured, multi-agent world model of a complete ten-hero MOBA (206 units, every hero acting every tick, games of up to 6,000 ticks), train a policy only inside it with 1,400-tick free-running imagined episodes, and measure that policy in the real game against the opponent the game ships with. The real game never provides a gradient; it provides the policy's own games as training data for the world model, and an online evaluation that selects and anchors the policy. Run as a continuous asynchronous Dyna loop, the policy wins 70.2% of real games as radiant (421 of 600; 95% CI 66.4-73.7) on seeds never used for any decision, up from 0% for dream training alone and 33.7% before the loop. It wins none as dire, and neither does the shipped opponent when it plays itself. Four findings explain the result. Model exploitation is invisible from inside the dream: every unanchored run collapsed within a few updates while no in-dream metric tracked the collapse. A world model that is accurate on its training corpus is badly wrong on the policy's own games, and Dyna repairs it there, which is worth +9.2 points of real win rate with the policy recipe held fixed. Finally, the policy inherits its world model's fidelity profile mechanic by mechanic: the model represents the macro game but not crowd control, cast timing or lethality, and the policy wins by map-wide pressure with almost no coordinated fighting. We release the world model, the dream-PPO harness, a world-model debugger, the evaluation protocol, and every policy and log.

AI.tldr: 本文提出从"外部"评判世界模型：在完整十英雄MOBA（206个单位、最长6000 tick）中学习结构化多智能体世界模型，仅在梦中以1400 tick自由推演训练策略，再在真实游戏中与内置对手对战评估，采用异步Dyna循环后真实胜率达70.2%（radiant方），揭示模型利用不可见、训练语料准确不等于策略分布准确、策略继承世界模型保真度轮廓等发现。
AI.motivation: 以往世界模型多从内部指标评判（预测损失、想象回报、画面逼真度），这些内部指标与真实下游表现可能脱节，甚至掩盖模型利用与崩溃。作者希望从外部（真实游戏中的胜率）来评判世界模型，并检验"能否仅在世界模型内训练策略、却迁移到真实游戏"。同时探究世界模型在策略自生成分布上的准确性、模型利用的可观测性，以及策略从世界模型继承何种能力轮廓。
AI.method: 构建完整的十英雄MOBA多智能体世界模型（206个单位，每hero每tick行动，对局最多6000 tick）；仅在该世界模型内用1400-tick自由推演（free-running）episode训练策略（dream-PPO）；真实游戏不提供梯度，仅提供策略自身对局作为世界模型的训练数据，并用作在线评估以选择与锚定策略。整体以连续异步Dyna循环运行，世界模型与策略互相迭代。评估在从未用于任何决策的随机种子（seeds）上，与游戏内置对手对战，以真实胜率衡量；并进行消融（仅梦中训练、去除循环等）与机制层面的保真度分析。
AI.result: 策略作为radiant方在600局真实对局中赢421局，胜率70.2%（95% CI 66.4–73.7），种子均未用于任何决策；仅凭dream training为0%，加入循环前为33.7%。作为dire方胜率为0，内置对手自对弈时同样为0。明确Dyna在线修复价值+9.2个真实胜率百分点（策略配方固定）。模型利用在梦中不可见：所有未锚定（unanchored）运行在数次更新内崩溃，且无任何梦中指标能追踪该崩溃。世界模型在其训练语料上准确，但在策略自对局分布上严重错误。策略逐机制继承世界模型保真度：模型能表征宏观大局，但不能表征crowd control、施法时机与致命性，策略靠全图压制取胜，几乎没有协同团战。
AI.conclusion: 从外部评判世界模型是可行且必要的：真实胜率暴露出内部指标无法察觉的模型利用与分布失配。Dyna式在线数据修复与策略锚定是获得真实迁移的关键；策略能力受限于世界模型的逐机制保真度。作者开源世界模型、dream-PPO框架、世界模型调试器、评估协议及全部策略与日志，以支持外部评判范式与可复现研究。

title: Same Feedback, Different Answer: Measuring Run-to-Run Instability in Frontier-Model Customer Feedback Analysis
summary: AI agents are increasingly being programmed to automate knowledge work over large collections of unstructured data. Such automation requires repeatability: when the underlying evidence is unchanged, the agent's categories, priorities, and counts should not shift materially between runs, even if each individual answer appears plausible. We introduce a repeat-run evaluation framework that aligns semantically equivalent categories and focuses on two operating metrics: theme churn, the normalized change in the returned category set, and volume disagreement, the change in counts for categories that persist. We evaluate three recurring customer-feedback tasks across eight frontier models, corpus sizes from 100 to 5,000 records, multiple prompts, and three execution designs: raw generation, taxonomy-free hierarchical decomposition, and a taxonomy-grounded agent (TGA) using persistent themes, subthemes, and record-level predictions. With Claude Opus 4.8 and the 1,000-record corpus fixed, TGA reduces theme churn by 86--88% relative to both raw generation and hierarchical decomposition, while matched-theme volumes have zero disagreement. The taxonomy-grounded agent is more stable than every raw model in the screen, remains more stable at each corpus size, and keeps this advantage when theme matching is made stricter or looser. Although evaluated on customer feedback, the framework targets repeated synthesis of unstructured corpora more broadly, including financial reports, legal documents, incident records, and scientific literature. Overall, these results show that taxonomy grounding produces more consistent and repeatable outputs for recurring knowledge work.

AI.tldr: 提出可重复性评估框架（主题churn、数量分歧两个指标），比较三种执行方式；在8个前沿模型、100–5000条语料上验证，taxonomy-grounded agent（TGA）主题churn降低86–88%，匹配主题数量分歧为0。
AI.motivation: AI智能体被越来越多地用于自动化处理大规模非结构化数据的知识工作，此类自动化需要可重复性：当底层证据不变时，智能体的类别、优先级和计数不应在多次运行间发生实质变化，即使每个单独答案看起来都合理。然而现有评估缺乏针对跨运行稳定性的度量。
AI.method: 引入重复运行评估框架，对齐语义等价的类别，并聚焦两个运行指标：主题churn（返回类别集合的归一化变化）和数量分歧（持续存在类别的计数变化）。评估三个反复出现的客户反馈任务，覆盖8个前沿模型、100至5000条语料规模、多个提示词，以及三种执行设计：原始生成、无taxonomy的层次分解、以及使用持久主题/子主题与记录级预测的taxonomy-grounded agent（TGA）。
AI.result: 在固定Claude Opus 4.8与1000条语料下，TGA相对原始生成和层次分解将主题churn降低86–88%，匹配主题的数量分歧为0。TGA比筛选中所有原始模型更稳定，在各语料规模下均保持更稳定，且在主题匹配更严格或更宽松时仍保持优势。
AI.conclusion: taxonomy grounding可为反复进行的知识工作带来更一致、更可重复的输出；虽然评估基于客户反馈，该框架面向更广泛的非结构化语料重复综合场景，包括财务报告、法律文件、事件记录和科学文献。

title: SpeedrunBench: Challenging LLM Agents with Video Game Speedrunning
summary: Frontier LLM agents have been shown to be capable of solving increasingly complex tasks for which humans have measurable solutions. This begs the pertinent question of whether LLM agents can go beyond what humans have already solved. The ability to develop sophisticated strategies to tackle consequential problems becomes paramount as well-trodden, human-developed solutions become insufficient for problems for which we lack context or enough training data. We study agents' capability of such strategy formation through the communal practice of video game speedrunning. In speedrunning, practitioners compete to find the fastest way to complete a video game under certain conditions, and in so doing uncovering interesting unorthodox play styles that require a thorough understanding and mastery of the underlying game mechanics. We introduce SPEEDRUNBENCH, a benchmark that evaluates frontier LLM agents across 9 different games. To perform well in this benchmark, agents must repeatedly improve their strategy, reflect on their performance, exploit their gained knowledge, and reason across a long-horizon of actions to improve on an increasingly difficult problem: being faster than themselves and everyone else. Our experiments show that while frontier agents approach human world records in simple platformer games, they remain behind human performance on longer, more complex games under practical budgets. These results suggest that SPEEDRUNBENCH is a useful testbed for studying agents' strategy formation capabilities as well as being a saturation-resistant evaluation measure, as there is almost always a faster completion time waiting to be discovered.

AI.tldr: 提出 SPEEDRUNBENCH 基准，用 9 款游戏的速通任务评估前沿 LLM agent 的策略形成能力。
AI.motivation: 前沿 LLM agent 已能解决人类有可测量解法的复杂任务，但关键问题是：当缺乏上下文或训练数据、人类既有方案不足时，agent 能否超越人类已解出的方案？需要一种能持续考察策略形成能力的评测环境。
AI.method: 借鉴速通（speedrunning）这一社群实践——玩家在特定条件下竞速寻找通关最快路径，需深入理解并掌握游戏机制、发掘非正统玩法。基于此构建 SPEEDRUNBENCH，覆盖 9 款游戏。完成基准要求 agent 反复改进策略、反思表现、利用已获知识，并在长时程动作序列上推理，以不断刷新自身与人类的最快纪录。
AI.result: 实验表明，在简单平台跳跃类游戏中，前沿 agent 可逼近人类世界纪录；但在更冗长、更复杂的游戏上，在现实算力预算内仍落后于人类水平。
AI.conclusion: SPEEDRUNBENCH 是研究 agent 策略形成能力的有效测试平台，同时是抗饱和的评测指标——因为几乎总存在更快的通关时间等待被发现。

title: Beyond Corrected Memory: Execution Consistency in Multi-Agent Systems
summary: Shared memory coordinates agents' actions, but correct records do not establish that those actions satisfy task requirements. Memory governance and failure diagnosis regulate or inspect recorded information; they do not by themselves establish whether it is sufficient to judge task duties. We define execution consistency through duties governing state use, information handoffs, and final-state agreement, with explicit evidence conditions for judging fulfillment. Our core claim is that identical retained records can correspond to compliant and violating executions under the same task rule. Controlled removal of evidence such as receipt, action dependence, or response validity leaves 82.4% of opposite-label pairs indistinguishable; restoration separates 97.9% of the merged pairs. Natural-log annotations identify the defined violations in actual executions. However, existing logs do not always explicitly represent the execution relationships needed for these judgments. To assess the definition's practical value, we use CAVERT, a framework for consistency diagnosis and recovery, to extract supported relationships from logs and apply these criteria. It consistently outperforms contract-prompted LLM and rule-based baselines in diagnosis across all 12 benchmark-executor settings. Under the same gate and executor limits, it also outperforms rule-guided recovery in all four evaluated environments. These findings identify execution evidence that agent-memory and execution interfaces should preserve for reliable judgment.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"执行一致性"概念，通过职责（状态使用、信息交接、最终状态一致）及证据条件判定执行是否合规，指出相同留存记录可能同时对应合规与违规执行；并构建CAVERT框架从日志抽取支撑关系进行诊断与恢复。
AI.motivation: 共享记忆能协调智能体行动，但记录正确并不等于行动满足任务要求。现有的记忆治理与失败诊断只规范或检查"记录的信息"，无法判断信息是否足以判定任务职责是否被履行，因此需要一个基于职责与证据的执行一致性判定标准。
AI.method: 形式化定义执行一致性：以状态使用、信息交接、最终状态一致的职责为核心，并设定判定履行的显式证据条件；通过受控移除证据（回执、动作依赖、响应有效性）与恢复实验验证记录与标签的可分性；利用自然日志标注验证违规可识别性；提出CAVERT框架，从日志中抽取被支撑的执行关系并应用该准则进行一致性诊断与恢复。
AI.result: 受控移除证据后，82.4%的相反标签对变得不可区分；证据恢复后可分离97.9%的合并对。自然日志标注可识别定义的违规。CAVERT在全部12个基准-执行器设置中诊断均优于契约提示LLM与规则基线；在相同门控与执行器限制下，于四个评估环境的恢复均优于规则引导恢复。
AI.conclusion: 判定执行合规性依赖于对执行证据的保留与显式表达，而仅靠记录正确性不足。研究明确了智能体记忆与执行接口应保留的执行证据类型，为可靠判定提供依据。

title: DSV-Mem: Evaluating Multimodal Memory in Professional Workflows for MLLM Agents
summary: Conversational MLLM agents are increasingly expected to assist in professional workflows, from AI research and engineering design to product management and business operations. Yet this capability remains underexplored: existing benchmarks largely focus on informal, everyday interactions and personal-life scenarios featuring photographic natural images, isolated static artifacts, and recall-oriented questions. In contrast, professional scenarios often involve structured, information-heavy artifacts that undergo frequent revisions and authority updates, and compositional queries requiring reconciliation of many artifact versions while tracking state precisely. To address these challenges, we introduce DSV-Mem, a benchmark for evaluating Dense Stateful Visual Memory. DSV-Mem comprises expert-reviewed scenarios and 1,000 questions across five user-oriented categories (Current State, Past State, Derived State, Change History, and Conflict/Refusal). A Hartley-inspired criterion favors questions with broader visual-evidence inspection demands. We also introduce a generation harness that produces evaluation suites by decoupling state-transition synthesis from conversation filling. Evaluation over 27 configurations spanning frontier and open-weight models and memory management methods reveals that the strongest baseline scores below 45% on DSV-Mem. Analysis surfaces findings: 1) multimodality and information density both contribute to difficulty, but state evolution, particularly the number of governing updates, is the dominant tested factor. Raw conversation/haystack length, OCR, and arithmetic are not the primary bottlenecks; 2) models often fail to verify user premises against prior state updates before answering; 3) increased reasoning effort and memory management methods yield limited gains, whereas state-aware designs prove more effective. The benchmark and code will be publicly released.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DSV-Mem基准，用于评测密集状态型视觉记忆（Dense Stateful Visual Memory），包含专家审核场景与1,000道题（五类），并配套解耦状态转移合成与对话填充的生成框架；在27种配置下最强基线低于45%，表明状态演化（治理性更新数量）是主导难点，模型常忽略对用户前提的状态校验，而状态感知设计比增大推理量/通用记忆管理更有效。
AI.motivation: 现有对话式MLLM智能体基准多聚焦非正式日常互动与个人生活场景，使用自然照片、孤立静态物件与回忆型问题；而专业工作流涉及结构化、信息密集、频繁修订与权限更新的多版本artifact，以及需跨多版本精确追踪状态的组合式查询，这种能力评测严重欠缺。
AI.method: 构建DSV-Mem基准：专家审核的场景与1,000道题，覆盖Current State、Past State、Derived State、Change History、Conflict/Refusal五类；采用Hartley启发式准则偏向需要更广视觉证据检索的问题；提出生成框架，将状态转移合成与对话填充解耦以批量生成评测套件；在27种前沿与开源权重模型/记忆管理方法配置上评测。
AI.result: 最强基线在DSV-Mem上得分低于45%。多模态与信息密度均增加难度，但状态演化（尤其治理性更新数量）是主导因素；原始对话长度、OCR与算术不是主要瓶颈；模型回答前常未依据先前状态更新校验用户前提；增加推理投入与通用记忆管理增益有限，状态感知设计更有效。
AI.conclusion: DSV-Mem揭示了对话式MLLM智能体在专业场景下的状态型视觉记忆能力短板，指明状态演化处理与状态感知设计为核心方向；基准与代码将公开。

title: ChartBmkAgent: Harness-Governed Multi-Agent Construction of Chart QA Benchmarks from Sparse Error-Taxonomy Specifications
summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) advance rapidly, while conventional benchmark development lags behind, delaying investigation of newly observed capability gaps. Such investigation requires an expressive task format and an on-demand construction process: information-rich charts make chart question answering (Chart QA) suitable for probing coupled perception and reasoning. Automated Chart QA construction is intended to shorten the benchmark-development cycle by turning identified gaps into targeted samples on demand. Current methods, however, commonly separate target guidance from scratch generation: target-guided systems often require prepared data, charts, or templates, while scratch-generation systems primarily ensure artifact validity, without explicitly controlling whether newly synthesized requirements and content remain aligned with an externally specified diagnostic target. We introduce ChartBmkAgent, which turns an identified capability gap into targeted diagnostic evidence by constructing complete Chart QA samples from sparse error-taxonomy specifications. Throughout construction, a central harness governs specialized agents, requires stage-specific evidence of alignment with the original error category, and records the basis for each acceptance decision. On 300 taxonomy-wide samples, MLLM accuracies ranged from 32.7% to 84.3% with distinct category profiles, showing that generated samples reveal capability differences. Across three source-model comparisons, targeted follow-ups scored 50.0% versus 82.2% on matched controls ($p=8.96\times10^{-6}$); all six cross-model comparisons had the same direction, demonstrating targeted validation and diagnostic-data generation. Multiple evaluator models assessed whether each sample tested its specified error category; 86.4% met this criterion, providing empirical evidence of target preservation.

AI.tldr: 提出 ChartBmkAgent，从稀疏的错误分类学规格出发按需构建完整 Chart QA 样本，将识别到的能力缺口转化为有针对性的诊断证据，并验证了样本的区分能力与目标保持性。
AI.motivation: 多模态大模型能力快速演进，而基准开发滞后，难以及时探查新出现的能力缺口。该类探查需要表达力强的任务格式与按需构建流程：图表信息丰富，适合探测感知与推理的耦合。现有自动化 Chart QA 构建方法将"目标引导"与"从零生成"分离——前者依赖预置数据、图表或模板，后者主要保证产物有效性，未显式控制新合成内容是否与外部指定的诊断目标保持一致。
AI.method: 提出 ChartBmkAgent：由中央调度框架（harness）统筹多个专用智能体，从稀疏的错误分类学规格生成完整 Chart QA 样本；构建过程中要求每个阶段提供与原始错误类别对齐的证据，并记录每次接受决策的依据。
AI.result: 在 300 个覆盖全分类学的样本上，MLLM 准确率介于 32.7%–84.3%，且呈现出不同的类别画像，说明生成样本能揭示能力差异。在三组源模型对比中，针对性追问得分 50.0% 对比匹配对照的 82.2%（p=8.96×10⁻⁶）；六组跨模型对比方向一致。多个评估模型判定样本是否检验其指定错误类别，86.4% 满足该标准。
AI.conclusion: ChartBmkAgent 实现了有针对性的验证与诊断数据生成，并为目标保持提供了实证支持，可在按需条件下将能力缺口转化为诊断证据。

title: Test-Time Agent Evolution for Long-Horizon Legal Reasoning
summary: Legal intelligence aims to support reliable decision-making across long-horizon legal processes involving evolving case states and multiple roles. However, real-world legal deployment exhibits substantial case heterogeneity in facts, evidence, and procedural contexts, exposing the limitations of static agent strategies. Moreover, legal reasoning is inherently interdependent across roles and procedural stages, making global reliability fundamentally different from isolated role competence. To address these challenges, we study training-free test-time agent adaptation, where agents continuously exploit deployment-time signals from preceding cases and ongoing interactions without updating model parameters. We propose \method, which introduces \emph{Test-Time Memory Evolution} to retrieve reusable experience from previous cases, adapt it to the current factual and procedural context, and consolidate accumulated experience for subsequent decision-making. Further, \emph{Rubric-Aligned Collaboration} verifies and revises role-specific actions according to behavioral and procedural requirements, enabling coordinated decision-making across roles and stages. Extensive experiments on J1-EVAL and LegalWorld across five backbone models demonstrate consistent improvements over representative reasoning and agent baselines with reasonable interaction and computational costs. Ablation and case studies further show that the two components provide complementary benefits in experience adaptation and cross-role coordination, improving the reliability and efficiency of long-horizon legal reasoning.

AI.tldr: 本文研究无需训练的法律智能体测试时自适应方法，提出双组件框架，在J1-EVAL与LegalWorld上验证其在长程法律推理中的可靠性提升。
AI.motivation: 法律智能需在案件状态演进、多角色参与的长程流程中支撑可靠决策；但真实案件在事实、证据与程序语境上高度异质，静态智能体策略失效。同时法律推理跨角色、跨阶段相互依赖，全局可靠性与单角色能力并不等同。
AI.method: 提出训练自由的测试时智能体自适应框架：（1）测试时记忆演化，从既往案件检索可复用经验，适配当前事实与程序语境，并固化累积经验供后续决策；（2）评分标准对齐协作，依据行为与程序规范校验、修订角色特定动作，实现跨角色、跨阶段的协同决策。全程不更新模型参数，仅利用部署期信号。
AI.result: 在J1-EVAL与LegalWorld两个基准、五种主干模型上，较代表性推理与智能体基线取得一致提升，交互与计算开销合理。消融实验与案例研究表明两个组件在经验适配与跨角色协调上提供互补收益。
AI.conclusion: 训练自由的测试时自适应可有效缓解案件异质性与跨角色依赖带来的可靠性瓶颈，提升长程法律推理的可靠性与效率，其中记忆演化与评分对齐协作是互补关键。

title: Partially Observable Zero-shot coordination by Predicting Intention of Partner
summary: Zero-shot coordination in embodied settings requires acting while the partner is intermittently out of view, leaving existing methods with ambiguous partner representations and uncertainty over hidden partner states. We propose Predicting Intention of Partner (PIP) to jointly address these challenges. PIP uses a Joint-view VAE to distill richer training-time evidence from the union of both agents' local observations into a partner representation available from local observations alone. Partner-state Belief networks further infer the partner's hidden location and behavioral tendencies from the ego agent's interaction history. We evaluate PIP in Burrito-PO, Overcooked-PO, and a Melting Pot substrate, together with a human evaluation in Burrito-PO. PIP attains the highest mean performance among the compared methods across all three benchmarks. Human evaluation and diagnostic analyses further support coordination with unseen partners and the contributions of both components under partner occlusion.

AI.tldr: 提出PIP方法，通过Joint-view VAE与Partner-state Belief网络解决具身零样本协作中伙伴间歇不可见导致的表征模糊与隐藏状态不确定问题，在三个基准及人评中取得最高平均性能。
AI.motivation: 具身场景下的零样本协作要求智能体在伙伴间歇性脱离视野时仍能行动。现有方法在此情形下存在两个问题：伙伴表征模糊，以及对伙伴隐藏状态的不确定性。论文旨在联合缓解这两类挑战。
AI.method: PIP由两部分组成：(1) Joint-view VAE，在训练阶段从双方局部观测的并集中蒸馏更丰富的证据，学得仅凭自身局部观测即可获得的伙伴表征；(2) Partner-state Belief网络，依据自我智能体的交互历史推断伙伴的隐藏位置与行为倾向。二者协同应对伙伴被遮挡的情形。
AI.result: 在Burrito-PO、Overcooked-PO以及一个Melting Pot子环境三项基准上，PIP在对比方法中取得最高平均性能；Burrito-PO的人评实验及诊断性分析进一步支持其与未见伙伴的协作能力，并验证两个组件在伙伴遮挡条件下的各自贡献。
AI.conclusion: PIP通过联合视角蒸馏的伙伴表征与基于交互历史的伙伴状态信念推断，有效提升了伙伴间歇不可见条件下的零样本协作性能，组件消融与人评均证明其有效性。

title: Which alloy composition,what process parameters? Inferring the recipe from optimized metallic microstructure and texture
summary: The mechanical properties of a metallic alloy are set by its microstructure and texture: the size and shape of its grains and the orientation of their crystals. That structure is in turn set by a recipe, the alloy composition together with the processing parameters. Alloy development runs this chain forwards, tuning the structure until a target property is met. Running it backwards, from an optimized structure to the recipe that would produce it, still relies on expert knowledge. We ask whether this backwards step can be learned. On an in-house dataset of 107 magnesium alloy extrusion conditions across 14 alloys, each with optical micrographs and an X-ray texture measurement, we compare three descriptors of microstructure and texture: conventional grain and texture statistics, a vision embedding from a pretrained image encoder, and a graph neural network on the grain network. Each is paired with prediction heads for two tasks: the alloy composition given the process (Task A), and the process parameters given the composition (Task B). Under 5-fold cross-validation, the conventional descriptors identify the correct alloy for 65% of held-out conditions, against 17% for always guessing the most common alloy, while the learned embeddings stay below 30%. The process parameters are recoverable but noisier: compared with using the composition alone, the microstructure roughly halves the temperature error. Because only a few alloys were cast and only a few press settings were used, both answers are discrete, and heads that pick from these known options, while respecting their order, worked better than heads that predict a free value.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨能否从镁合金的显微组织与织构"反推"其制备配方：在107个挤压条件、14种合金的自建数据集上，比较传统晶粒/织构统计量、预训练图像编码器视觉嵌入与晶粒网络图神经网络三类描述子，分别预测合金成分（Task A）和工艺参数（Task B）。结果显示传统描述子对合金识别率达65%（远高于基线的17%），学习型嵌入低于30%；工艺参数可部分恢复，显微组织使温度误差约减半；且离散有序选项的分类头优于自由值回归头。
AI.motivation: 合金开发通常正向进行：由成分与工艺参数决定显微组织与织构，进而决定力学性能，并据此调优结构以满足目标性能。然而从优化后的结构反推能产生它的配方仍依赖专家知识，这一逆向步骤是否可学习尚不清楚。作者希望验证：能否用数据驱动方法，由显微组织与织构直接预测合金成分与工艺参数。
AI.method: 基于自建数据集，涵盖14种合金、107种镁合金挤压条件，每个条件配有光学显微照片与X射线织构测量。比较三类显微组织/织构描述子：(1) 传统晶粒与织构统计量；(2) 预训练图像编码器得到的视觉嵌入；(3) 在晶粒网络上运行的图神经网络。每个描述子搭配两个预测头：已知工艺预测合金成分（Task A），已知成分预测工艺参数（Task B）。实验采用5折交叉验证。
AI.result: 5折交叉验证下，传统描述子对留出条件的合金识别准确率为65%，而始终猜最常见合金的基线仅为17%；两种学习型嵌入（视觉嵌入与GNN）均低于30%。工艺参数可被恢复但噪声更大：与仅使用成分相比，加入显微组织信息使温度误差约减半。由于铸造合金种类与压机设置数量有限，两类答案均为离散的；在已知选项集合中选择并尊重其顺序的预测头，优于直接预测自由数值的回归头。
AI.conclusion: 从显微组织与织构反推合金成分与工艺参数这一逆向步骤在一定程度上是可学习的：合金成分识别可达较高准确率，工艺参数可部分恢复但噪声较大。在这一小样本、离散配方空间中，简单的传统统计描述子反而优于学习型嵌入，且离散有序分类头优于连续回归头，说明数据规模与配方离散性对方法选择具有决定性影响。

title: Mathematical Proof Assistants for Teaching Logic: The LogiKEy Methodology
summary: We report on an approach to teaching logic to mixed groups of computer science, mathematics, and philosophy students, based on the logico-pluralistic LogiKEy methodology, used for more than a decade in courses, summer schools, and tutorials. LogiKEy uses classical higher-order logic (HOL) as a universal metalogic in which object logics, classical and non-classical alike, are encoded by defining their semantics; through these semantical embeddings a single proof assistant (e.g. Isabelle/HOL), with its automated theorem provers and (counter-)model finders, becomes one environment in which students learn, experiment with, and compare logics. After making the pedagogical case for proof assistants in the logic classroom, we present a graded sequence of classroom examples, each transition motivated by a limitation of the preceding representation, by a need for more explicit modelling resources, or by a new application. A liars-and-truth-tellers puzzle leads from propositional to modal logic; the Wise Men puzzle leads on to dynamic epistemic logic; Boolos's curious inference illustrates what a higher-order meta-logic buys, even for automated proof search; Chisholm's paradox takes the sequence into deontic logic, and from standard to dyadic deontic logic; and Gödel's ontological argument brings it to a research-level metaphysical argument. We then rebut the objection that embedding everything in classical HOL is monism rather than pluralism, reflect on three years of teaching such a course, and sketch the portability of the approach beyond Isabelle.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍基于LogiKEy方法论的教学方案，将逻辑学课程面向计算机、数学与哲学混合背景学生，以经典高阶逻辑(HOL)作为通用元逻辑，通过语义嵌入在单一证明助手(如Isabelle/HOL)中编码和比较多种对象逻辑，并给出一系列递进式课堂案例。
AI.motivation: 面向计算机科学、数学和哲学混合背景的学生教授逻辑学具有挑战性，需要一个统一环境让学生能够学习、实验并比较经典与非经典逻辑，而证明助手可为逻辑课堂提供这样的教学支持。
AI.method: 采用逻辑多元主义(pluralistic)的LogiKEy方法论，以经典高阶逻辑(HOL)作为通用元逻辑，通过定义语义对对象逻辑(经典与非经典)进行语义嵌入；借助单一证明助手(如Isabelle/HOL)及其自动定理证明器与(反)模型查找器，构建统一的逻辑学习与实验环境，并设计递进式课堂案例序列。
AI.result: 给出了逐步递进的课堂案例序列：说谎者与诚实者谜题引向命题逻辑到模态逻辑；智者谜题引向动态认知逻辑；Boolos的奇特推理展示高阶元逻辑对自动证明搜索的价值；Chisholm悖论引向道义逻辑，从标准道义逻辑到二元道义逻辑；Gödel本体论论证达到研究级形而上学论证水平。
AI.conclusion: 反驳了"将一切嵌入经典HOL是单一论而非多元论"的质疑，总结了三年此类课程的教学经验，并概述了该方法在Isabelle之外的移植性。

title: Learn2Play Bench: How Well Do LLM Agents Learn from Experience in Unfamiliar Environments?
summary: Learning from experience is essential for LLM agents to adapt to unfamiliar and dynmaic environments. Evaluating this ability is therefore important for understanding how effectively agents acquire and use new knowledge. Existing benchmarks have sought to evaluate this ability, but they primarily evaluate tasks whose rules are provided in the instructions or already familiar to pretrained models, making it difficult to distinguish learning from interactions from reasoning with existing knowledge. To address this, we introduce Learn2Play Bench, a benchmark of newly designed text-based games, whose rules are novel or counterintuitive, requiring agents to acquire knowledge through interaction rather than rely solely on pretrained knowledge. These games provide reproducible feedback and automatic scoring, enabling controlled evaluation of learning across repeated attempts. We also vary game instances to test whether agents can apply what they have learned to new situations. Therefore, we evaluate how backbone models, self-evolving methods, and agent harnesses affect agents' learning ability, revealing three findings: (1) Experience retention: Retaining complete records of actions and feedback can support more effective learning than summarizing these experiences into rules or strategies. (2) Human agent gap: Top-performing human players achieve higher peak scores than the evaluated agents. Human explore more varied strategies, and repeat actions less. (3) Harness matters: With the backbone fixed, changing the harness can improve performance while reducing estimated inference cost. Together, these findings provide insights into how LLM agents learn from experience and suggest directions for future work to improve their learning ability. Project website: https://liushiliushi.github.io/learn2play-bench-website/

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Learn2Play Bench，一个由规则新颖或反直觉的文本游戏组成的基准，用于评估 LLM 智能体从交互经验中学习的能力。实验揭示三个发现：保留完整经验记录优于总结成规则；人类玩家峰值成绩更高且策略更多样；在不改变骨干模型的情况下更换 harness 可提升性能并降低推理成本。
AI.motivation: 从经验中学习是 LLM 智能体适应陌生、动态环境的关键能力。现有基准多以指令中已给出规则或预训练模型已熟悉的游戏为任务，导致难以区分"从交互中学习"与"用已有知识推理"，因此无法纯粹评估经验学习能力。
AI.method: 设计 Learn2Play Bench：一批新构造的文本游戏，其规则新颖或反直觉，迫使智能体必须通过交互获得知识；游戏提供可复现反馈与自动评分，支持对多次尝试中的学习过程进行受控评估；同时变换游戏实例，检验智能体能否将所学迁移到新情境。在此基础上，系统评估骨干模型、自进化方法与 agent harness 三方面因素对学习能力的影响。
AI.result: 三点发现：(1) 经验保留——保留完整的动作与反馈记录比将其总结为规则或策略更有利于学习；(2) 人机差距——顶尖人类玩家的峰值分数高于被测智能体，人类探索的策略更丰富、重复动作更少；(3) Harness 影响显著——在骨干模型固定的情况下，更换 harness 既能提升性能又能降低估计的推理成本。
AI.conclusion: 该工作提供了一个可区分"经验学习"与"已有知识推理"的评测范式，并揭示经验表示方式、探索行为与 harness 设计是影响 LLM 智能体经验学习能力的关键因素，为后续提升其学习能力的研究指明方向。

title: Quantum Entangled Multimodal Fusion Networks (QEMFN): Resource-Aware Hybrid Vision-Language Fusion via Trainable Entanglement
summary: Multimodal vision-language systems typically fuse image and text embeddings through classical operators such as concatenation, attention, bilinear pooling, or tensor interactions. We propose Quantum Entangled Multimodal Fusion Networks (QEMFN), a hybrid quantum-classical framework that introduces parameterized entanglement as a structured inductive bias for multimodal fusion. Pretrained visual and textual features are projected into compact latent spaces, encoded as angle-parameterized quantum states, processed through intra-modal and paired cross-modal entangling circuits, and measured to produce fused representations for retrieval. Under matched parameter budgets and identical frozen CLIP backbones, QEMFN outperforms classical fusion baselines on COCO-5k and Flickr30k, including multilayer perceptron, tensor fusion, FiLM, cross-attention, compact transformer, and a dequantized paired-topology analogue. An ablation suite isolates the quantum module's contribution from the surrounding classical projections, and quantum-centric analyses report Meyer-Wallach entangling capability, expressibility, gradient variance against barren-plateau bounds, and entropy-performance correlation under controls for training progress alongside an intervention study on the entangling component. QEMFN is executed under shot-based estimation, a noise-modeled fake backend, and a real superconducting device with zero-noise extrapolation. This work does not claim quantum computational advantage; the contribution is the framework together with a controlled empirical and quantum-centric evaluation that positions trainable entanglement as an interpretable, hardware-executable fusion mechanism at scales accessible on contemporary devices.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出量子纠缠多模态融合网络（QEMFN），一种混合量子-经典框架，将参数化纠缠作为结构化归纳偏置用于多模态融合，在检索任务上以相同参数预算和冻结CLIP骨干超越多种经典融合基线，并进行了系统的量子中心评估与真实量子硬件执行。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态视觉-语言系统主要依赖拼接、注意力、双线性池化或张量交互等经典算子进行图像与文本嵌入融合，缺乏将可训练纠缠作为结构化归纳偏置的融合机制，且量子融合机制在真实硬件上的可执行性与可解释性尚未得到受控评估。
AI.method: QEMFN将预训练视觉与文本特征投影到紧凑潜在空间，编码为角度参数化的量子态；经由模态内与配对跨模态纠缠电路处理，测量后生成融合表示用于检索。在匹配参数预算与相同冻结CLIP骨干条件下与经典基线（MLP、张量融合、FiLM、交叉注意力、紧凑Transformer及去量子化的配对拓扑对应体）对比；消融实验隔离量子模块贡献；量子中心分析报告Meyer-Wallach纠缠能力、表达性、梯度方差与贫瘠高原边界、熵-性能相关性（控制训练进度），并对纠缠组件进行干预研究；执行方式涵盖基于采样的估计、噪声建模的模拟后端以及真实超导器件配合零噪声外推。
AI.result: 在COCO-5k与Flickr30k检索任务上，QEMFN在匹配参数预算和相同冻结CLIP骨干下优于全部经典融合基线；消融实验验证了量子模块的独立贡献；量子分析给出纠缠能力、表达性、梯度方差与贫瘠高原边界的关系及熵-性能相关性；模型可在采样估计、噪声模拟后端和真实超导硬件（配合零噪声外推）上执行。
AI.conclusion: 本文不主张量子计算优势，其贡献在于提出该框架并开展受控的实证与量子中心评估，将可训练纠缠定位为一种可解释、可在当代设备规模上硬件执行的融合机制。

title: OSFP4: Joint Optimization of Diagonal Smoothing and Block Scales for NVFP4 Quantization
summary: NVFP4 is an attractive datatype for large language model (LLM) inference, offering compact storage and native tensor-core acceleration. However, preserving accuracy using NVFP4 requires careful quantization. In this work we develop a novel quantization scheme called Optimized Smoothing and Scaling for NVFP4 (OSFP4). For each linear projection it uses a diagonal smoothing matrix whose entries are optimized to minimize the squared matrix-product quantization error under NVFP4, taking into account the rounding procedure that is used (either round-to-nearest, or GPTQ-style successive interference cancellation). This requires performing joint optimization on the smoothing entries as well as the block scales, which is facilitated by analyzing a multiplicative-dither FP4 quantizer instead of the fixed deterministic one. Experiments show that OSFP4 achieves the highest average accuracy among the evaluated competitors in the corresponding quantization settings, while retaining approximately 94-97\% of vendor NVFP4 prefill throughput on the measured workloads. Our code is available in https://github.com/neriahbd/OSFP4

AI.tldr: 本文提出OSFP4量化方案，通过优化对角平滑矩阵与块缩放，在NVFP4下最小化矩阵乘积量化误差，兼顾精度与吞吐。
AI.motivation: NVFP4数据类型具有紧凑存储与原生张量核加速优势，适合LLM推理，但保持精度需要精细的量化设计，现有方法在NVFP4下精度保持不足。
AI.method: OSFP4对每个线性投影使用对角平滑矩阵，其元素经优化以在NVFP4下最小化平方矩阵乘积量化误差，同时考虑舍入过程（最近舍入或GPTQ式逐次干扰消除）；需联合优化平滑项与块缩放，通过分析乘性抖动FP4量化器而非固定确定性量化器来实现。
AI.result: 实验表明，在相应量化设置下，OSFP4在所评估的竞争方法中取得最高平均精度，同时在所测工作负载上保留了约94-97%的厂商NVFP4预填充吞吐。
AI.conclusion: OSFP4是一种面向NVFP4的高效量化方案，在精度与吞吐间取得良好平衡，代码已开源。

title: Sensor-Language-Action Models
summary: Sensors are useful not only for understanding the world but also for deciding what to do next. Existing sensor models however largely stop at perception: they recognize states or predict outcomes, leaving actions modeled separately through task-specific and often closed label spaces. We introduce Sensor-Language-Action (SLA) modeling, a framework that connects multimodal sensor observations, natural language, and actions within a unified model. SLA uses language as a semantic interface between sensing and acting, allowing heterogeneous actions to be represented, predicted, and explained while remaining grounded in the underlying sensor evidence. We build a large-scale SLA benchmark consisting of datasets that span more than 116,000 individuals, 79 sensor modalities, and 60 action groups, together with a multi-faceted captioning pipeline that aligns user context, sensor dynamics, and action evidence. Building on this framework, we present OpenSLA, a unified SLA model for hierarchical action prediction, state understanding, and action explanation. Extensive experiments on real-world tasks in clinical prediction, operating rooms, and metabolic health verify its superior performance over the state-of-the-art. OpenSLA also demonstrates intriguing capabilities including language-guided evidence grounding and zero-shot generalization to unseen actions and cohorts.

AI.tldr: 提出传感器-语言-动作（SLA）建模框架，用语言作为感知与行动的语义接口，并构建大规模基准与统一模型OpenSLA，在临床与健康任务上超越SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有传感器模型多止步于感知，仅做状态识别或结果预测，动作建模被分离处理且依赖任务特定、封闭的标签空间，缺乏感知与行动的统一连接。
AI.method: 提出SLA建模范式，以自然语言作为连接多模态传感器观测与动作的语义界面，使异质动作可被表示、预测与解释且扎根于传感器证据；构建覆盖超116,000个体、79种传感器模态、60个动作组的大规模基准及多层面描述生成管线，对齐用户情境、传感器动态与动作证据；据此提出统一模型OpenSLA，支持分层动作预测、状态理解与动作解释。
AI.result: 在临床预测、手术室与代谢健康等真实任务上，OpenSLA性能超越现有最先进方法，并展现语言引导的证据定位与对未见动作和人群的零样本泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: SLA将感知与行动统一于语言介导的框架中，配合大规模基准与统一模型，验证了该范式在真实场景的有效性与泛化潜力。

title: MASC: A Multi-Agent Self-Calibration Framework with Latent Construct Alignment for Consistent Client Role-Playing in Psychological Counseling
summary: Large language models are increasingly used to simulate clients for counselor training and psychological counseling research, but reliable simulation requires clients to remain psychologically coherent across extended interactions. Existing role-playing methods largely rely on static profile prompts and may exhibit persona drift, unrealistic cooperativeness, or inconsistent psychological states, communicative actions, and emotions. Existing evaluations also lack a unified testbed for both stable client characteristics and evolving psychological dynamics. We propose MASC, a Multi-Agent Self-Calibration framework with latent construct alignment for consistent client role-playing in psychological counseling. MASC combines construct-guided generation, collaborative refinement, consistency verification, and memory-based revision in a closed calibration loop that detects and corrects inconsistencies as dialogue unfolds. We further introduce CRPC-Bench, a benchmark covering session-level profile information and Big-Five personality traits, as well as turn-level psychological state, communicative action, and emotion expression. CRPC-Bench contains 38 motivational interviewing client profiles augmented with personality and emotion annotations. Experiments show that MASC outperforms existing methods across profile, personality, receptivity, and turn-level consistency, with the heterogeneous configuration achieving the strongest overall performance. MASC and CRPC-Bench provide a unified foundation for developing and evaluating psychologically coherent client simulations for AI-assisted counseling research and training.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MASC多智能体自校准框架与CRPC-Bench基准，用于心理咨询中具有心理一致性的来访者角色扮演。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型被用于模拟来访者以支持咨询师培训和心理咨询研究，但可靠的模拟要求来访者在长程交互中保持心理一致性。现有角色扮演方法依赖静态人设提示，易出现人设漂移、不真实的配合度，以及心理状态、沟通行为与情绪不一致；同时缺乏统一测试平台来同时评估稳定的来访者特征与动态心理变化。
AI.method: MASC是一个多智能体自校准框架，采用潜在构念对齐，整合构念引导生成、协同精炼、一致性验证与基于记忆的修正，形成闭环校准回路，在对话推进中检测并纠正不一致。同时构建CRPC-Bench基准，涵盖会话级人设信息与大五人格特质，以及轮次级心理状态、沟通行为与情绪表达，包含38个动机式访谈来访者画像并附人格与情绪标注。
AI.result: 实验表明MASC在人设、人格、接受度与轮次级一致性上均优于现有方法，其中异构配置取得最佳整体性能。
AI.conclusion: MASC与CRPC-Bench为AI辅助咨询研究与培训中开发、评估心理一致的来访者模拟提供了统一基础。

title: zkLLMPoT: Efficient Zero Knowledge Proof of Training for Large Language Models
summary: Auditing the claimed outcomes of large language model (LLM) training is challenging when model weights and training data are private, while cryptographically proving the full training process is prohibitively expensive at Transformer scale. We present zkLLMPoT, a zero-knowledge framework that certifies auditor-defined properties of a trained checkpoint through forward evaluation rather than verification of its optimization trajectory. zkLLMPoT includes 2 phases: 1) The trainer fixes the architecture and the model weights are committed. Then the auditor selects challenge sequences, preventing the trainer from modifying the checkpoint in response to the audit data. 2) Then the trainer proves the objective value attained by the committed model on those sequences. This formulation makes the certification cost independent of the number of training iterations, without revealing model weights or requiring access to private training data. We build on sumcheck- and lookup-based arguments to certify Transformer computations, while supporting next-token loss and task-specific audit objectives. Across four model families, operator-level benchmarks yield proving times of 41-59 seconds for 1.1-1.5B-parameter models and 131 seconds at 13B for the covered operators, with verification below half a second at a sequence length of 512.

AI.tldr: 提出 zkLLMPoT，一种零知识框架，通过对已提交检查点进行前向评估来证明审计者定义的性质，而非验证训练轨迹，使认证成本与训练迭代次数无关。
AI.motivation: LLM 训练结果的审计面临困难：模型权重与训练数据通常私有，而对完整训练过程进行密码学证明在 Transformer 规模下成本过高。
AI.method: 两阶段设计：1）训练者固定架构并承诺模型权重，审计者随后选择挑战序列，防止训练者根据审计数据修改检查点；2）训练者证明承诺模型在这些序列上达到的目标值。基于 sumcheck 与 lookup 类论证来认证 Transformer 计算，并支持下一词元损失与任务特定审计目标。
AI.result: 在四个模型家族上，算子级基准测试显示：1.1–1.5B 参数模型证明时间为 41–59 秒，13B 模型在覆盖算子上为 131 秒；序列长度 512 时验证时间低于 0.5 秒。
AI.conclusion: zkLLMPoT 使认证成本与训练迭代次数解耦，无需泄露模型权重或访问私有训练数据，为私有权重与数据条件下的 LLM 训练结果审计提供了可行方案。

title: SCOPE: Certified Theorem Proving with a Language Model as the Policy Planner
summary: In proof assistants such as Lean, a generated proof must pass machine compilation checks, so evaluation needs no human scoring. Direct generation fails on multi-step numeric propositions: a proof is valid only if every content integer is correct, so the pass rate is bounded by the k-th power of the per-integer accuracy. Controlled corruption across 2,617 reference proofs confirms this power law. SCOPE (State-Conditioned Operator Planning and Execution) enforces the natural division of labor: the model plans over an operator vocabulary, a symbolic engine executes the numerics, and a compiler renders the proof. On a 218-problem suite it certifies 191/218 (87.6%) with a 135M backbone; the 7B DeepSeek-Prover-V1.5-RL certifies 18/218 at 27.5 times the tokens and 37.5 times the wall-clock, and DeepSeek-Prover-V2-7B certifies zero on a bidirectional dual suite. Multi-step thinking costs 6.12 discrete decision actions per problem and produces no natural-language thinking text. Replacing the lagged engine state in the decision frame with the current one lifts the pass rate from 117/218 to 191/218, while up-weighting the chain-end loss hurts. On the public Lean-Workbook library, 2,132 of 3,536 gradeable admissible problems certify (60.29%) with zero regression on the main suite. All readings come from a version-frozen review with independent rechecks and reverse verification. Restricting free generation and keeping decision-time information visible is a more direct route than enlarging the model.

AI.tldr: 在Lean等证明助手中，证明必须通过机器编译检查，因此无需人工评分。直接生成在多步数值命题上失败，因为证明有效需每个整数正确，通过率被单整数准确率的k次方界定。SCOPE（状态条件算子规划与执行）通过分工解决：模型在算子词汇表上规划，符号引擎执行数值计算，编译器渲染证明。
AI.motivation: 直接生成方法在多步数值命题上存在结构性缺陷：证明有效要求所有内容整数均正确，因此整体通过率受限于单整数准确率的k次方（幂律）。这意味着即便模型单步准确率很高，多步组合下通过率也会指数级下降，单纯扩大模型规模并非有效路径。
AI.method: 提出SCOPE（State-Conditioned Operator Planning and Execution），强制自然分工：模型仅在算子词汇表上进行规划，符号引擎负责执行数值运算，编译器负责渲染最终证明。此外，将决策帧中滞后的引擎状态替换为当前状态，并检验了对链尾损失加权的效果。
AI.result: 在218题测试集上，135M主干模型认证191/218（87.6%）；7B的DeepSeek-Prover-V1.5-RL仅认证18/218，且消耗27.5倍token与37.5倍墙钟时间；DeepSeek-Prover-V2-7B在双向对偶套件上认证为零。多步思考平均每题消耗6.12个离散决策动作，且不产生自然语言思考文本。将滞后引擎状态替换为当前状态，通过率从117/218提升至191/218，而对链尾损失加权反而有害。在公开Lean-Workbook库上，3,536个可评分可采纳问题中认证2,132个（60.29%），主套件零退化。
AI.conclusion: 限制自由生成并保持决策时信息可见，比扩大模型规模更直接有效。所有读数来自版本冻结评审，并经过独立复核与反向验证。

title: MedZERO: Self-Evolving Agents for Open-Ended Medical Reasoning Through Controlled Knowledge Accumulation
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have shown promise in medical question answering and clinical reasoning, yet their improvement remains constrained by static parametric knowledge and costly expert supervision. Self-evolving agents offer a promising alternative by enabling models to improve through iterative task generation and problem-solving. However, most existing self-evolving methods are designed for easily verifiable domains such as mathematics and coding, where solutions can be checked by exact answers or executable programs. Medical reasoning is fundamentally different: it is open-ended, knowledge-intensive, and often only partially verifiable. We present MedZERO, a self-evolving framework for open-ended medical reasoning. MedZERO couples an Examiner that generates frontier medical question-option pairs with a Reasoner that solves them through evidence-grounded multi-turn reasoning with external knowledge tools. To support reliable, continual improvement, MedZERO adopts controlled knowledge accumulation, which maintains temporary exploratory knowledge and curated persistent knowledge in reasoning. We evaluate MedZERO on five public medical reasoning benchmarks using 4B- and 8B-scale base models under open-ended evaluation. Across all settings, MedZERO consistently outperforms the underlying base models and prior self-evolving baselines, achieving up to 13.7 average accuracy-point gains over the next-best self-evolving baseline.

AI.tldr: MedZERO：面向开放式医学推理的自进化框架，通过Examiner- Reasoner双角色协同与受控知识积累，在5个医学推理基准上4B/8B模型显著超越基线与先前自进化方法（最高提升13.7个百分点）。
AI.motivation: LLM在医学问答与临床推理中虽有潜力，但受限于静态参数化知识和高昂的专家监督成本。现有自进化方法多针对数学、代码等易验证领域（精确答案或可执行程序验证），而医学推理具有开放式、知识密集型、仅部分可验证的特性，直接迁移效果不佳，因此需要专门面向开放式医学推理的自进化框架。
AI.method: MedZERO采用自进化框架，耦合两个角色：Examiner负责生成前沿医学"问题-选项"对；Reasoner借助外部知识工具进行基于证据的多轮推理求解。为支持可靠且持续的改进，引入受控知识积累机制，在推理过程中同时维护临时探索性知识与经筛选的持久性知识。
AI.result: 在5个公开医学推理基准上，以4B与8B规模基座模型进行开放式评估，MedZERO在所有设置下均稳定优于底层基座模型及先前自进化基线，相比次优自进化基线平均准确率最高提升13.7个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 面向开放式医学推理的自进化是可行的；通过任务生成-求解闭环与受控知识积累，可在缺乏精确验证信号与专家监督的条件下实现持续性能提升，为知识密集型开放域推理的自进化提供了一种有效范式。

title: An AI-Assisted Formalization of the Poincaré Conjecture
summary: We present an AI-assisted Lean 4 formalization of the Poincaré conjecture. The project began with limited reusable formal infrastructure for the geometric analysis behind the proof. To organize this work, we combined a proof blueprint prepared by mathematicians with explicit milestone statements. These milestones enabled parallel agent work and gave mathematicians clear points to locate blockers and provide effective mathematical guidance. Our analysis identifies the human interventions and organizational choices behind this workflow. The project provides a starting point toward reusable infrastructure for future formalization projects; such infrastructure, once developed, could eventually reduce the cost of verifying mathematical results in geometric analysis.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了利用AI辅助在Lean 4中形式化庞加莱猜想的工作流程与经验。
AI.motivation: 证明背后的几何分析缺乏可复用的形式化基础设施，导致形式化成本高昂。
AI.method: 将数学家编写的证明蓝图与明确的里程碑陈述相结合，支持多智能体并行工作，并使数学家能定位阻塞点并提供有效指导。
AI.result: 识别出该工作流程中关键的人工干预与组织决策，并形成了初步的可复用基础设施。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为未来形式化项目提供了起点；此类基础设施一旦成熟，有望降低几何分析中数学结果的验证成本。

title: MoF: Preference-Aware Mixture Modeling for Black-Box LLM Personalization
summary: Proprietary Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated remarkable capabilities across a wide range of tasks, yet aligning their outputs with diverse user preferences remains challenging. Existing personalization approaches for black-box LLMs often rely on user-specific scoring heads, causing the number of personalized parameters to grow linearly with the number of users and requiring additional adaptation for unseen users. To address these limitations, we propose Mixture-of-Facets (MoF), a scalable personalization framework for black-box LLMs that models user preferences as compositions of shared latent preference facets rather than dedicated user-specific parameters. MoF performs personalization through history-conditioned routing over shared facet heads, enabling personalization for users unseen during training without additional parameter updates. Across diverse personalization tasks, MoF delivers stronger personalization performance while maintaining a more scalable and parameter-efficient design than prior approaches. Additional analysis indicates strong generalization to unseen users.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Mixture-of-Facets（MoF），一种面向黑盒大语言模型的可扩展个性化框架。MoF 将用户偏好建模为共享潜在偏好"facet"的组合，通过基于历史条件的路由机制实现个性化，避免了用户专属参数的线性增长，并能泛化到训练中未见的用户。
AI.motivation: 专有大语言模型（LLM）性能强大，但使其输出与多样化用户偏好对齐仍具挑战。现有黑盒 LLM 个性化方法多依赖用户专属打分头（scoring heads），导致个性化参数量随用户数线性增长，且面对新用户需额外适配，可扩展性差。
AI.method: 提出 Mixture-of-Facets（MoF）框架：将用户偏好表示为若干共享潜在偏好 facet 的组合，而非为每个用户分配专属参数；通过历史条件路由（history-conditioned routing）在共享 facet 头之间进行组合，从而支持对训练中未见用户的个性化，且无需额外参数更新。
AI.result: 在多种个性化任务上，MoF 取得了更强的个性化性能，同时相比先前方法保持了更高的可扩展性与参数效率；额外分析表明其对未见用户具有良好的泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: MoF 通过共享 facet 组合与历史条件路由，为黑盒 LLM 提供了一种可扩展、参数高效且能泛化到未见用户的个性化方案，克服了用户专属参数随用户数线性增长的瓶颈。

title: Explainable Failure Prediction and Prevention in Maritime
summary: Maritime systems operate in highly dynamic environments where unexpected equipment failures can compromise safety, reliability, and operational efficiency. Recent advances in artificial intelligence (AI), machine learning, digital twins, and predictive maintenance enable proactive failure prediction and prevention. However, ensuring trustworthy and explainable decision-making remains a major challenge in safety-critical maritime applications. This chapter reviews key AI technologies required for explainable failure prediction and prevention in maritime systems and presents a conceptual architecture capable of supporting autonomous or human-in-the-loop corrective actions.
